title: Budget Act of 2024.
summary: Amends the Budget Act of 2024 to change existing state appropriations, effective immediately as a budget bill.

title: State government: emergency services: nonprofit service providers.
summary: Lets nonprofits with state contracts modify service methods or request flexibility during emergencies, and requires agencies to ensure funding for canceled services.

title: Budget Acts of 2023 and 2024.
summary: Amends the 2023 and 2024 Budget Acts by changing and adding appropriations, effective immediately as a Budget Bill.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: exemption: Five-Mile Basin.
summary: Exempts a City of Chico project to remove sediment from the Five-Mile Basin from California Environmental Quality Act review.

title: Drought.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive wording change to existing authority for advance payment of drought grant funds.

title: Contractors: failure to pay wages: discipline.
summary: Authorizes the Attorney General to seek discipline against contractor licenses for failing to pay workers wages owed.

title: Public health: emergency plans and wildfire research.
summary: Requires the state public health department to finish its air quality emergency plan by 2027 and requires counties to conduct public outreach on their plans.

title: Tribal financial information: public records: exemption.
summary: Exempts financial information that Indian tribes provide to state or local agencies for financial assistance from public records disclosure.

title: Drowning prevention: public schools: informational materials.
summary: Requires drowning-prevention groups supplying free school materials to provide English versions and align with CDC guidance; directs the education department to post water safety resources.

title: Firearms: concealed carry.
summary: Expands the list of disqualifying acts for concealed carry licenses, adds spouse-as-owner licensing rules, and broadens perjury.

title: Land use: development project review.
summary: Shortens the deadline for responsible agencies to approve or disapprove development projects from 90 days to 45 days.

title: Alcoholic beverages: licenses: County of San Luis Obispo.
summary: Authorizes up to 10 additional on-sale liquor licenses for San Luis Obispo County eating places, capped at 5 per year, with transfer and resale restrictions.

title: Teacher credentialing: administrative services credential: occupational and physical therapists.
summary: Lets occupational and physical therapists qualify for school administrative services credentials, raises the experience requirement to five years, and allows waivers.

title: Budget Act of 2025.
summary: Makes appropriations for state government support for fiscal year 2025-26 and declares it takes effect immediately as a Budget Bill.

title: Local government: broadband: traffic control requirements: state standard.
summary: Declares legislative intent to later enact a state standard for local traffic control requirements during broadband deployment.

title: Crimes: child abuse and neglect: sentence credits.
summary: Makes certain child abuse crimes serious felonies for enhancements and bars inmate firefighter credit earning for those convicted.

title: Medi-Cal: immigration status.
summary: Makes people without satisfactory immigrant status ineligible for Medi-Cal and redirects their funding to a fund paying Medicare Part B premiums.

title: Peace officer training: behavioral health.
summary: Requires patrol officers and patrol supervisors to complete a behavioral health training course, which POST may develop with local behavioral health and community partners.

title: Traffic safety: speed limits.
summary: Lets the state Department of Transportation set lower speed limits on non-freeways and requires peace officers to issue only warnings for the first 30 days of a lower limit.

title: Discrimination and harassment prevention training.
summary: Allows employers to satisfy sexual harassment training requirements by showing a certificate of completion from the past two years.

title: Power facility and site certifications: thermal powerplants: geothermal resources.
summary: Allows geothermal powerplants of 50-150 MW to skip state certification through 2030, shifting review to local agencies under CEQA.

title: Energy: electrical and gas corporations: general rate cases.
summary: Requires utilities to submit extra rate-case information, including 10 years of rate-of-return data and distribution capacity project forecasts, to the Public Utilities Commission.

title: Automated decision systems.
summary: Regulates developers and deployers of automated decision systems used in consequential decisions, adding disclosure, appeal, and Attorney General enforcement duties.

title: Enhancing Law Enforcement Activities Subaccount: identification of unidentified human remains.
summary: Allows county sheriffs to use up to 20% of law enforcement subaccount funds to identify unidentified human remains.

title: Budget Act of 2025.
summary: Amends the Budget Act of 2025 to adjust state government appropriations for fiscal year 2025-26 and takes effect immediately.

title: Public utilities: energy: taxpayer funding: reporting.
summary: Requires investor-owned utilities to report large taxpayer grants or loans, penalizes noncompliance, and directs benefits to ratepayers until 2036.

title: Housing: local educational agencies.
summary: Extends and revises state rules allowing affordable and employee housing on school district land, applying Housing Accountability Act and density bonus eligibility, through 2036.

title: Authority to remove vehicles.
summary: Removes local authority to tow and impound vehicles with five or more unanswered parking violations or unpaid traffic tickets.

title: Coastal resources: coastal development permits and procedures: Zero Emissions Port Electrification and Operations project.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Makes the Los Angeles Harbor Department sole coastal permit authority for a port electrification project, with 90-day deemed-approval deadlines.

title: Department of Fish and Wildlife: San Gabriel Valley Bear Management and Community Safety Act.
summary: Requires Fish and Wildlife to create a San Gabriel Valley bear management plan, set encounter-reduction goals, and track bears entering neighborhoods.

title: Standby Caretaker Act.
summary: Lets custodial parents nominate a standby caretaker for their child upon an activating event, with court hearings, confidential records, and a perjury-backed form.

title: Public utilities: electrical corporations: energization.
summary: Requires utilities to meet energization timelines, publish application checklists and examples, and transmit approvals electronically to applicants.

title: Cannabis: testing: quality assurance.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice
summary: Adds cannabis testing and retest rules, lets the state test retail stock, requires retailers to provide certificates of analysis on request, and ends random monitor reviews.

title: Community colleges: temporary employees.
summary: Requires community college districts to follow collective bargaining terms when terminating temporary employees, and declares part-time faculty have no reasonable assurance of continued employment.

title: Statements of financial interest: digital financial assets.
summary: Adds digital financial assets to the investments that public officials and designated employees must disclose on economic interest statements, starting 2027.

title: Budget Acts of 2022, 2023, and 2024.
summary: Amends the 2022, 2023, and 2024 Budget Acts by changing, adding, and repealing appropriation items, and takes effect immediately.

title: County treasurer: settlement of accounts.
summary: Extends from 10 to 12 business days the deadline for a county treasurer to provide the auditor a monthly cash settlement upon request.

title: Hazardous waste control laws: exemption: geothermal resources.
summary: Expands the hazardous waste exemption for geothermal waste by removing its limits and caps the generation fee on non-exempt geothermal waste at $10 per ton.

title: Coverage for behavioral health visits.
summary: Requires large group health plans and insurers to cover up to 12 behavioral health visits for wildfire-affected enrollees, without utilization review.

title: Eminent domain: appraisals: compensation.
summary: Raises the cap on public entities' reimbursement of owners' independent appraisal costs in eminent domain purchases from $5,000 to $8,000.

title: Teacher credentialing: programs of professional preparation: youth mental health.
summary: Requires teacher preparation health education to include a basic understanding of youth mental health.

title: Community colleges: California College Promise: fee waiver eligibility.
summary: Extends California College Promise fee waiver eligibility by two additional years for community college students who enter upper-division baccalaureate coursework.

title: Criminal procedure: postconviction discovery.
summary: Expands postconviction discovery access for state prison defendants, broadens discovery materials, and adds prosecutor proffer and trial counsel file-retention duties.

title: Public health: substance use disorder.
summary: Expands who may possess and distribute overdose-reversal opioid antagonists, removes the training requirement, and adds civil liability protection for good-faith administration.

title: Bears: hunting: use of dogs.
summary: Authorizes the Fish and Game Commission to set seasons allowing dogs to pursue bears, with conditions, after a bear plan update.

title: State-funded assistance grants and contracts: advance payments.
summary: Requires state agencies to advance grant payments to eligible nonprofits and tribes for certain 2027 awards, with an opt-out option.

title: Budget Act of 2025.
summary: Amends the 2025 Budget Act by changing, adding, and repealing appropriation items for the 2025-26 fiscal year.

title: Elections: residency: displacement by natural disaster.
summary: Clarifies that voters displaced temporarily by a natural disaster do not lose their voting domicile if they intend to return.

title: Health care coverage: health care provider credentials.
summary: Requires health plans and insurers to use a standard credentialing form and decide provider credentials within 90 days, with provisional approval otherwise.

title: The Cannella Environmental Farming Act of 1995: Managed Honeybee Health Program.
summary: Creates a Managed Honeybee Health Program with optional grants and a dedicated special fund, contingent on legislative appropriation.

title: Age verification signals: software applications and online services.
summary: Requires operating system providers and app stores to collect age information at account setup and share age-bracket signals with developers starting 2027.

title: Tule East Groundwater Sustainability Agency Act.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Creates the Tule East Groundwater Sustainability Agency and requires it to develop and implement a plan for sustainable groundwater management.

title: California State University and University of California: financial incentives: nonprofit organizations: service learning.
summary: Authorizes participating CSU and UC campuses to offer financial incentives to partnering nonprofits to support undergraduate service learning programs.

title: Short-lived climate pollutants: recovered organic waste product: agricultural crop preparation service.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Environment and energy
summary: Exempts agricultural crop preparation services from state organic waste and edible food recovery requirements if they avoided landfilling organic waste since 2016.

title: Vehicles: statewide application of the code.
summary: Makes technical, nonsubstantive changes to state vehicle and driver's license provisions that apply uniformly statewide.

title: Workers’ compensation.
summary: Requires payors' explanations of review to list provider network IDs and contact emails, provide contract copies on request, and allows electronic authorization requests.

title: California Food Assistance Program: sponsor deeming rules.
summary: Stops applying federal sponsor deeming rules to the California Food Assistance Program, so more noncitizen households could qualify starting 2028.

title: Budget Acts of 2021, 2023, 2024, and 2025.
summary: Amends the 2021, 2023, 2024 and 2025 Budget Acts by changing appropriation items and takes effect immediately as a Budget Bill.

title: Unlawfully restrictive covenants: housing developments.
summary: Lets housing developments on redeveloped commercial sites and certain easements override private covenants that bar residences, subject to state housing laws.

title: Route 76: Payómkawish Highway.
summary: Names specified portions of Route 76 the Payómkawish Highway and requires signs once nonstate donations cover their cost.

title: Digital financial assets.
summary: Authorizes digital financial asset payments for goods and services and sets escheatment and key-transfer rules for dormant digital asset accounts.

title: Educational technology: evaluation and selection.
summary: Requires local school agencies to involve teachers and parents in selecting required educational technology and to review digital materials.

title: Public employees’ retirement: deferred retirement option program: public employee health benefits.
summary: Creates a voluntary Deferred Retirement Option Program within PERS for specified California Highway Patrol and firefighter state employees, contingent on a cost-neutral actuarial analysis.

title: Accessory dwelling units: proof of residential occupancy requirements.
summary: Lets local agencies require ADU owners to certify, and annually recertify, that the unit is occupied as a residential dwelling for at least six months a year.

title: Gill nets: permits.
summary: Limits transfers of gill and trammel net permits to family members from 2027, bars further transfers, and ends disability and death transfers.

title: Personal Income Tax Law: exclusions: first responders: overtime pay.
summary: Excludes overtime wages of qualified first responders from state income tax for tax years 2025 through 2029.

title: Motor Vehicle Fuel Tax Law: suspension of tax.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Taxes and budget
summary: Suspends the motor vehicle fuel tax for one year, requires savings be passed to consumers, and transfers General Fund money to the fuel account.

title: Vehicles: Blackout License Plate Program.
summary: Creates a black-and-white California Blackout license plate program, a 2028 Olympic plate, and a Los Angeles fire relief fund.

title: Budget Act of 2025.
summary: Amends the Budget Act of 2025 by changing one appropriation item and declares immediate effect as a Budget Bill.

title: School construction: school wellness centers.
topics: Children and families; Government and administration
summary: Requires cities and school and community college districts to disclose legal invoices and expenses, and requires new school construction to include a wellness center space.

title: Housing developments: urban lot splits: historical resources.
summary: Requires ministerial approval of urban lot splits and certain housing developments on parcels no longer covered by the broader historic-resource exclusions.

title: Local control funding formula: concentration grants: charter schools: waiver.
summary: Lets charter schools seek a State Superintendent waiver to calculate their concentration grant on their own enrollment instead of the district's unduplicated-pupil limit.

title: Search warrants: newborn screening program.
summary: Limits when newborn blood samples can be released to law enforcement, allowing release only for missing-person DNA cases, and requires reporting of warrant requests.

title: Leading Ethical AI Development (LEAD) for Kids Act.
topics: AI and technology; Children and families
summary: Bars companion chatbots from children unless they cannot foreseeably encourage self-harm, violence, drug use, or disordered eating; adds AG penalties and private lawsuits.

title: Credit card transaction fees: tax payments: Consumer Inflation Reduction and Tax Fairness Act.
summary: Bars card networks, banks and processors from factoring certain state and local taxes and fees into interchange fees, enforceable under the Unfair Competition Law.

title: Immigration services: grants.
summary: Bars state-funded immigration legal grants from being used to obstruct federal enforcement or deportation of felons present in the U.S. unlawfully.

title: Public employees’ retirement: felony convictions.
summary: Requires public employers to continue misconduct investigations after retirement and refer possible crimes to law enforcement, and makes felony-convicted employees forfeit retirement benefits.

title: Emergency services available during natural disasters.
summary: Requires CalHHS to convene a working group that will recommend how to evacuate and shelter older adults and disabled people in long-term care during disasters.

title: Older adults: emergency shelters.
summary: Requires counties to arrange MOUs giving aging, independent living, and resource center partners access to evacuation shelters for older adults and disabled people.

title: Budget Acts of 2023, 2024, and 2025.
summary: Amends the 2023, 2024, and 2025 Budget Acts by changing appropriation items and takes effect immediately as a Budget Bill.

title: Residential developments: building standards: review.
summary: Requires HCD to study allowing 3-10 unit residential developments under the California Residential Code and report findings, with no change to current requirements.

title: Criminal procedure: discrimination.
summary: Lets defendants seek disclosure of evidence and broader court remedies for claims that convictions or sentences were racially discriminatory.

title: Elections: ballot mistakes.
summary: Requires the Secretary of State to develop uniform statewide standards for voters to correct ballot mistakes, with regulatory authority to enforce them.

title: Employment Development Department: disclosure of wage information: qualified third-party vendors.
summary: Lets employees authorize EDD to release their wage information to qualified third-party vendors, with confidentiality protections and misdemeanor penalties for unauthorized disclosure.

title: CalWORKs.
summary: Expands CalWORKs aid and child care eligibility for parents whose children were removed, and exempts reunification families from certain immunization and welfare-to-work requirements.

title: Fire protection: privately contracted fire prevention resources: public water sources.
summary: Requires the state to adopt rules barring private firefighting contractors from connecting equipment to public water sources without approval and backflow devices.

title: Qualified ABLE Program: CalABLE accounts: funding.
summary: Expands funding sources and outreach for California ABLE accounts for people with disabilities, and adds an FTB refund deposit option for the ABLE trust.

title: Voter registration: California New Motor Voter Program.
summary: Bars DMV from offering voter registration attestation or sending records to the Secretary of State for applicants who show they are not U.S. citizens.

title: Firearms.
summary: Bars licensing for more disqualifying records and drug users, adds NICS reporting, and lets licensees transport unloaded, locked firearms on public transit.

title: Civil appeals: stay of enforcement.
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Bars automatic appeal stays of court orders finding voting-rights map or at-large election violations; violators must reimburse county election costs.

title: Budget Act of 2025.
summary: Amends the Budget Act of 2025 by changing certain appropriation items, and takes effect immediately as a Budget Bill.

title: Foster care payments.
summary: Requires counties to pursue SSI reconsideration and appeals for terminated foster youth, expands fiduciary protections for SSA benefits, and extends a benefit-month rule to all youth.

title: On-sale general public premises: drug testing devices.
summary: Adds carfentanil and fentanyl to the controlled substances that drug testing devices offered by Type 48 bars must detect.

title: Nursing: students in out-of-state nursing programs.
summary: Allows out-of-state distance nursing students who are state residents to provide nursing services under in-person RN supervision, and bars clinical placements that would displace in-state students.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: exemptions: housing development projects: natural and protected lands: record of proceedings.
summary: Expands CEQA exemptions for housing rezoning and semiconductor plants while broadening protected natural lands excluded from those exemptions.

title: Change of name and gender and sex identifier.
summary: Eliminates objections to adult gender-identity name changes, requires courts to grant qualifying petitions without hearings, and removes a judgment-filing deadline for gender marker changes.

title: License plates: obstruction or alteration.
summary: Bars installing shades or tints that obstruct license plate readers, bans manufacturing such devices in California, and sets $1,000 fines per item.

title: Marine Carbon Initiative.
summary: Creates a Marine Carbon Initiative under the Air Resources Board, with a council, a research grant program, and $2 million annually upon appropriation.

title: Crimes: vehicular manslaughter while intoxicated.
summary: Increases probation for DUI-related vehicular manslaughter convictions from up to 1–2 years to 3–5 years.

title: Public health: kratom.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Taxes and budget
summary: Regulates kratom products under food and drug law, requiring registration, labeling, age-21 sales limits, flavor bans, and a 15% tax.

title: Western Joshua Tree Conservation Act: industrial projects and commercial projects: tree removal and trimming.
summary: Lets cities approve Joshua tree take for commercial and industrial projects and eases no-fee removal permits near homes.

title: Budget Act of 2026.
summary: Appropriates funds for state government operations for fiscal year 2026-27 and takes effect immediately as a Budget Bill.

title: Alcoholism or drug abuse treatment facilities: County of Orange pilot program.
summary: Creates a pilot program placing a state investigator in Orange County to investigate complaints against licensed adult alcohol and drug treatment facilities, funded by the county.

title: Vehicles: license plates: 8-letter license plates.
summary: Creates an optional 8-character license plate program, with fees deposited into a new fund supporting open space and state recreation.

title: Firearms: concealed carry licenses.
summary: Extends concealed carry license validity from two years to four years, phased in for licenses issued from 2026 and 2027.

title: Public postsecondary education: academic exchange programs: plan.
summary: Requires CSU to adopt a plan, starting 2027-28, to increase student exchanges with Mexican public universities, contingent on appropriated funds.

title: Crimes: torture of a minor: parole.
summary: Bars parole eligibility for adults convicted of torturing a child 14 or younger in their care until at least 10 years served.

title: Data centers: waste heat energy.
topics: AI and technology; Environment and energy
summary: Allows data center waste heat capture projects to get I-Bank climate financing and qualify for renewable energy credits under the RPS.

title: Water: schoolsites: lead testing.
summary: Requires water systems to report school and childcare lead-testing outreach and declinations, and the state to publish that data online.

title: Trespass.
summary: Makes trespass on Indian lands a misdemeanor, including reentry within 48 hours after an exclusion order, and adds tribal police warnings.

title: California Education Interagency Council.
summary: Establishes the California Education Interagency Council and an associated office within the Government Operations Agency to coordinate education and workforce initiatives.

title: Developmental services: initial intake.
summary: Requires regional centers to hold case conferences for child welfare-involved youth during developmental services intake, bars age-based denials of assessment, and posts intake data.

title: Crimes: impeding emergency personnel.
summary: Makes operating a drone in violation of emergency-scene interference rules during fire emergencies a felony, punishable by jail and fines.

title: Budget Act of 2026.
summary: Makes state government appropriations for fiscal year 2026-27 and amends the Budget Act's list of related appropriation bills.

title: Victim compensation.
summary: Revises California victim compensation eligibility, verification and derivative-victim loss-of-income rules, deletes some denial grounds, and lowers the derivative-victim cap to $70,000.

title: Plastic Bulk Merchandise Containers: proof of ownership.
summary: Adds a seller's email address to the proof of ownership record required when recyclers buy or transport plastic bulk merchandise containers.

title: Sea level rise and groundwater rise: contaminated sites: report.
summary: Requires new developments near vulnerable contaminated sites to complete a sea level and groundwater rise risk assessment, and requires a state report on those sites.

title: Controlled substances: research.
summary: Expedites and streamlines state review of Schedule I and II controlled-substance research and exempts panel members reviewing projects from open-meeting rules until 2028.

title: Net energy metering: construction of renewable electrical generation facilities: public works project requirements.
topics: Environment and energy; Labor and employment
summary: Exempts entities that hire contractors to build NEM-eligible renewable facilities from public works prevailing wage rules, and keeps those facilities NEM-eligible after certain wage violations.

title: Conservatorships.
summary: Allows conservators to place conservatees in secured-perimeter residential, intermediate care, or skilled nursing facilities, with court approval for certain subsequent moves and new regulations.

title: State Air Resources Board: regional air quality incident response program.
summary: Expands state air monitoring program to fund a regional network of air quality incident response centers, subject to appropriation.

title: Cigarette and Tobacco Products Licensing Act of 2003: nitrous oxide: licensure.
summary: Requires license suspension for repeat nitrous oxide violations and bars licenses for retailers convicted of nitrous oxide distribution crimes.

title: County officers: coroners: in-custody deaths.
summary: Bans sheriff-coroners from determining in-custody death causes starting 2027, requiring independent examiners instead, and applies the rule to all counties.

title: Evidentiary privileges: union agent-represented worker privilege.
summary: Creates a privilege protecting confidential communications between union agents and represented workers from disclosure in court, except criminal proceedings.

title: Budget Act of 2026.
summary: Budget Act of 2026 making state government appropriations for fiscal year 2026-27, amending existing budget items, and taking effect immediately.

title: Safety rules and regulations: notice.
summary: Adds the nearest Division of Occupational Safety and Health office's email address to the required workplace safety notice, and makes nonsubstantive changes to seasonal labor wage provisions.

title: Pupil transportation: schoolbuses: zero-emission vehicles: scrapping.
summary: Lets schoolbus agencies cite infrastructure and repair gaps to delay zero-emission bus mandates and exempts certain older buses from HVIP scrapping rules.

title: Tax Equity Allocation.
summary: Removes certain Rancho Mirage property tax exchange revenues from reductions to qualifying cities' Tax Equity Allocation distributions, changing local property tax shares.

title: Federally qualified health centers: mission spend ratio.
summary: Requires federally qualified health centers to meet a 90% mission spend ratio, report revenues, pay registration fees, and face penalties for noncompliance.

title: Emergency vehicles: fee and toll exemptions.
summary: Adds ambulances to the emergency vehicles exempt from tolls and charges when displaying exempt plates.

title: Peace officers: mental health liaisons.
summary: Lets local governments designate existing counseling or mental health employees as liaisons to support peace officers' mental health.

title: Elections: voter registration.
summary: Allows online voter registration without a California driver's license or ID card, using the last four SSN digits, and adds an electronic signature image for verification.

title: Electricity: rates: optional dynamic rate tariffs.
summary: Requires the PUC to develop optional dynamic electricity rate tariffs for utility customers, with time-varying rates and customer data access.

title: Criminal procedure: search warrants.
summary: Requires an independent hearing and a preponderance-of-evidence showing by the seizing agency before stolen or embezzled currency is returned to its owner, plus 10-day prosecutor notice.

title: Teacher credentialing: dual credentialing.
summary: Requires the teacher credentialing commission to create efficient routes for dual multiple-subject and special education credentialing by March 2027.

title: Budget Acts of 2022, 2023, 2024, and 2025.
summary: Amends the 2022–2025 Budget Acts by changing, adding, and repealing appropriation items; takes effect immediately as a Budget Bill.

title: Foster care: rights of foster youth.
summary: Requires the State Department of Social Services to provide foster parents and others educational resources on culturally appropriate grooming and hygiene products for foster children.

title: Early literacy: professional development: instructional materials.
summary: Requires teachers and staff to complete state-approved literacy training by 2029 and mandates new state-adopted reading materials aligned to standards.

title: Pupil instruction: dual enrollment.
summary: Requires high schools without dual enrollment to create community college partnerships starting 2029-30, with courses leading to a degree, credential, certificate, or transfer.

title: Commission on Teacher Credentialing: membership.
summary: Changes the Commission on Teacher Credentialing's membership to add early childhood educators and reduce public representatives from three to two.

title: Personal Income Tax Law: exclusions: first responders: overtime pay.
summary: Excludes overtime pay for first responders on emergency operations from state income tax for 2025 through 2029.

title: Workers’ compensation: peace officers.
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Extends the workers' compensation heart-trouble presumption to peace officers employed by the State Department of State Hospitals.

title: Medi-Cal managed care plans: enrollees with other health care coverage.
summary: Lets Medi-Cal fee-for-service providers bill managed care plans for costs not covered by other coverage without in-network contracts, and limits added billing burdens.

title: Firearms: converter pistols.
summary: Bans licensed dealers from selling machinegun-convertible pistols, treats converter-equipped versions as illegal machineguns, and adds escalating dealer penalties.

title: Mobilehome parks: rent caps: City of Torrance.
summary: Extends mobilehome park rent caps to Torrance parks, freezes rents at January 2026 levels plus the allowed increase, and extends the repeal date to 2036.

title: Birth conditions monitoring.
summary: Lets local health officers monitor birth conditions within 12 months of birth, order providers and labs to report data, and extends confidentiality to those conditions.

title: Budget Act of 2026.
summary: Amends the 2026-27 Budget Act by changing, adding, and repealing appropriation items, effective immediately as a budget bill.

title: Political Reform Act of 1974: campaign disclosures.
summary: Removes penalty exemption for unlabeled paid third-party online campaign posts, imposing joint liability and reporting statements on committees.

title: General plan: annual report: congregate care for the elderly.
summary: Lets planning agencies count approved congregate care units for the elderly toward up to 15% of their housing needs allocation in annual reports.

title: Department of Transportation: climate change vulnerability assessment: community resilience assessment.
summary: Requires Caltrans to identify community resilience indicators and assess social and economic impacts within its climate vulnerability reports.

title: Navigation rules.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to state navigation rules for steam and sailing vessels.

title: Coerced marriage.
summary: Eliminates the crime of compelling defilement, applies the forced-marriage crime regardless of victim age, and lets courts allow late nullity petitions for forced marriages.

title: Pupil safety: teen dating violence.
summary: Requires the state to develop and schools to post teen dating violence prevention guidance and statewide resource lists on their websites.

title: Employment: immigration and work authorization.
summary: Requires employers to grant unpaid leave for immigration matters, reinstate or rehire workers with work authorization problems, and bars immigration-based discrimination, with a 25-employee exemption.

title: Reporting mechanism: child sexual abuse material.
topics: AI and technology; Children and families
summary: Requires social media platforms to provide clear CSAM reporting mechanisms, hash-matching and human review, third-party audits, and civil penalties for noncompliance.

title: Income and corporate taxes: tax credits: motion pictures.
summary: Expands California motion picture tax credits to more productions and single-member LLCs, raising the credit rate to 35% or 40%.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: exemption: public access: nonmotorized recreation.
summary: Extends a CEQA exemption for nonmotorized recreation access to county park agencies, adding natural resource plan and funding findings.

title: Budget Acts of 2022, 2023, 2024, and 2025.
summary: Amends the Budget Acts of 2022 through 2025 by changing appropriation items, effective immediately as a Budget Bill.

title: Single-Occupancy Cell Pilot Program.
summary: Requires CDCR to pilot single-occupancy cells for voluntary participants at four prisons, covering 10% of each facility's population, with a 2028 report.

title: Alameda-Contra Costa Transit District: board of directors: election: compensation.
summary: Eliminates AC Transit's at-large director seats, requires all seven directors be elected by ward, and changes director pay adjustment rules.

title: Horses: horse shows, competitions, and sales.
summary: Raises the fee thresholds that determine which horse shows and competitions are subject to state equine event regulation, letting the Secretary adjust them by regulation.

title: State Fire Marshal: home hardening certification program.
summary: Directs the State Fire Marshal's advisory committee to develop, by 2027, a home hardening certification program for wildfire-resistant measures in existing buildings.

title: Prisons: elderly employment.
summary: Lets older or disabled inmates elect to keep working, cut hours, or retire, and bars CDCR from punishing that choice.

title: Vehicles: local regulation: Department of Transportation.
summary: Requires Caltrans to weigh costs against alternatives when approving local traffic ordinances on state highways and explain rejections in writing.

title: Water infrastructure: dams and reservoirs: water release: false pretenses.
summary: Prohibits releasing stored water from federally owned and operated reservoirs in California under false pretenses, with injunctive relief available to state officials.

title: School districts: reorganization: State Department of Education approval process.
summary: Lets the State Department of Education transfer territory between school districts when a city meets specified conditions, with optional financial remuneration.

title: Food packaging: hazardous chemicals.
summary: Bans food packaging containing intentionally added bisphenols or ortho-phthalates from 2028, and sets up later limits on trace levels with penalties.

title: Recycling: market development payments: polyethylene terephthalate plastic.
summary: Extends until 2029 the state's authority to make market development payments for PET plastic beverage containers, with up to $35 million annually.

title: Budget Act of 2025.
summary: Expresses legislative intent to enact future statutory changes relating to the Budget Act of 2025.

title: Local agencies: airports: alternative customer facility charges.
summary: Raises the maximum airport rental car facility charge from $9 to $12 per day and expands permitted uses of related bond proceeds.

title: Driver’s licenses: identification cards.
summary: Requires DMV to let people 62 and older apply for a senior citizen ID card using the license cancellation or surrender form.

title: Controlled substances: human chorionic gonadotropin.
summary: Removes human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) from the Schedule III controlled substances list under California's Uniform Controlled Substances Act.

title: Illegal disposal site abatement.
summary: Authorizes the waste department, if funded, to create regulations, enforcement strategies, and local teams to clean up and deter illegal dumping and abandoned recreational vehicles.

title: Junior accessory dwelling units.
summary: Relaxes owner-occupancy for junior ADUs without shared sanitation, but requires local ordinances to set rental terms longer than 30 days.

title: Law schools: externships: compensation.
summary: Requires law schools to allow students to be paid by externship sites while earning academic credit, starting August 2026.

title: Williamson Act contracts: cancellation fees: photovoltaic solar facilities.
summary: Lets the Secretary of Natural Resources waive Williamson Act cancellation fees for certain solar facilities and voids contracts on qualifying certified solar land.

title: Tenancy: just cause termination: rent increases.
summary: Lowers allowable annual rent increases to 2% plus CPI or 5%, removes separate-ownership exemptions, and makes tenant protections permanent.

title: Mortgages.
summary: Narrows trustee's sale eligible bidders to exclude owner-occupants and nonprofits, and requires bidders to include a 1.2% bid amount.

title: Student personal information.
summary: Extends student privacy protections to more online operators, bars using student data to train AI, adds higher-education privacy law, and allows private lawsuits.

title: Health omnibus trailer bill.
summary: Health omnibus trailer bill extending state hospital Enhanced Treatment Program to 2030 and authorizing psychiatric hospital staffing standards via emergency regulations.

title: Military equipment.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice; Transportation
summary: Restricts police purchases of drones unless they have data-collection opt-outs and data is stored with American companies barred from sharing it.

title: Public social services: state of emergency or health emergency.
summary: Requires continuous eligibility for social services and Medi-Cal after state or health emergencies, with automatic restoration and good-cause rules.

title: Challenges to housing and community-serving projects.
summary: Allows defendants to seek litigation security from plaintiffs who challenge community-serving projects, not just low- and moderate-income housing projects.

title: Employees: workplace violence prevention plans: topics and trainings.
summary: Requires schools and community colleges to provide annual deescalation training to staff who interact with students, and expands community college workplace violence plan training.

title: Elections: Voter Bill of Rights.
summary: Adds to the Voter Bill of Rights a notice that voters may get a new ballot if they have none or it is damaged.

title: California Housing Justice Act of 2026.
summary: Requires the state housing department to create homelessness and housing affordability finance plans with performance metrics, reported to the Legislature by 2030, contingent on appropriation.

title: Fair Debt Settlement Practices Act.
summary: Extends existing debt settlement consumer protections to commercial debtors, adding obligations on debt settlement providers.

title: Electrical corporations and gas corporations: rate recovery: political activities and promotional advertising.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Bars utilities from recovering political influence and promotional advertising costs from ratepayers, requires disclosure of who pays for messages, and imposes civil penalties.

title: Department of Transportation: transferred property: City of Lynwood.
summary: Requires the Department of Transportation to release a 15-year public-use deed restriction on a parcel transferred to the City of Lynwood, and makes technical changes to speed contest laws.

title: Wildlife grants: Shared Habitat Alliance for Recreational Enhancement program.
summary: Makes state grants to the SHARE program mandatory, raises landowner compensation caps to $52 per acre and $87 per participant, and adds inflation adjustments.

title: Transit and Intercity Rail Capital Program: loans: transit operating purposes: San Francisco Bay area.
summary: Requires a state loan of up to $590 million to the Bay Area's regional transportation planning agency to fund transit operators, repaid through future allocations and transit fund security.

title: Maintenance of the codes.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive cleanup changes to various code provisions, as recommended by the Legislative Counsel, to maintain the codes.

title: Part-Time Community College Faculty Health Insurance Program.
summary: Redirects unused part-time community college faculty health insurance funds into a new continuously appropriated fund and states legislative intent for districts to negotiate health benefits by 2030.

title: Adult day programs: administration of intranasal emergency antiseizure medications.
summary: Lets licensed adult day programs have trained staff or volunteers administer intranasal seizure medication to clients on request, with training standards and liability protections.

title: Public Utilities Commission: organization.
summary: Requires the PUC to create an ethics reporting portal or email and bars staff from working on proceedings they previously sponsored testimony in.

title: Clean Transportation Program: eligible programs and projects: electric vehicle charging stations: vandalism deterrence.
summary: Adds deterring and combating vandalism of public EV charging stations to the categories eligible for Clean Transportation Program funding.

title: Accountants.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Labor and employment
summary: Creates an alternative CPA licensing pathway, broadens license reciprocity, and removes a practice-privilege experience requirement, starting 2027.

title: Energy: renewable energy resources program.
summary: Expands the renewable energy resources program's definition of eligible generation facilities to include those that began commercial operation on January 1, 2005.

title: California Prompt Payment Act: late payment penalties.
summary: Changes the Prompt Payment Act's late-payment extension for Forestry and Fire Protection invoices from fire season to peak fire staffing period.

title: Peace officers: confidentiality of records.
summary: Lets courts consider whether an officer is undercover when deciding if disclosing peace officer records would endanger safety.

title: Credit unions.
summary: Changes the deadline for credit unions to notify members of officer or committee suspensions from seven days to seven business days.

title: Human services.
summary: Codifies an existing disaster-assistance appropriation, requires evaluating fruit and vegetable EBT pilots, and changes CalWORKs reporting.

title: Department of Financial Protection and Innovation: state payments.
summary: Lets the state financial regulator adopt rules allowing certain DFAL license and other payments to be made with stablecoins, through 2032.

title: Firefighters: personal protective equipment.
summary: Requires the state workplace safety board to consider revising firefighter PPE standards by 2028 to reduce PFAS and other hazardous substances, and requires a DOSH progress report by 2026.

title: State Energy Resources Conservation and Development Commission: report: electrical grid infrastructure manufacturing.
summary: Requires the Energy Commission to report by July 1, 2026 on the status of electrical grid infrastructure manufacturing in California.

title: Residential tenancy: habitability: inspection and right to cure.
summary: Lets landlords opt into habitability inspections, creating a presumption of compliance and a cure period before a dilapidation counts as a violation.

title: Common interest developments: association management and meeting procedures.
summary: Tightens common interest development board meeting rules, banning serial off-meeting deliberations and requiring recorded meetings and minutes to be available to members.

title: California Library Services, Equity in Opportunity Act.
summary: Renames the California Library Services Act and its board, shrinks the board to 11 members, and shifts the board to an advisory role.

title: Data collection: race and ethnicity: minimum categories.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Requires state agencies collecting race and ethnicity data to use minimum categories, creates a Chief Statistician, and limits federal sharing of personal data.

title: Firearms: safety certificates.
summary: Requires firearm importers to obtain safety certificates and mandates an 8-hour training course with live-fire exercises for applicants starting 2027.

title: Elections: statewide initiative and referendum petitions: disclosures.
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Adds disclosure requirements for initiative petitions and ballot labels, including top funders of committees supporting or opposing statewide measures.

title: Court reporting: digital reporters and legal transcriptionists.
summary: Creates state certifications for digital reporters and legal transcriptionists, allows them to perform court recording and transcription, and protects certified shorthand reporters from displacement.

title: Public social services trailer bill.
summary: Revises mandated reporter rules: exempts adult-only care facility staff, requires a standardized reporter training curriculum, and adds county prevention-plan requirements.

title: Department of Motor Vehicles: private industry partner fees.
summary: Caps fees that second-line partners charge for online DMV registration renewals and requires website links stating DMV services carry no additional cost.

title: California Renewables Portfolio Standard Program: hydroelectric generation.
summary: Expands the state's Renewables Portfolio Standard to count all hydroelectric generating facilities as eligible renewable resources, not just small ones.

title: Child abuse or neglect: reporting.
summary: Requires child welfare agencies to send abuse reports to parents' attorneys and to attorneys for children in the same placement, with personal identifying information redacted.

title: Fleeing the scene of an accident.
summary: Removes the statute of limitations for felony hit-and-run crimes causing death or permanent serious injury, allowing charges to be filed at any time.

title: Pupil literacy: administrative services credential program standards and professional development: instructional materials.
summary: Requires a literacy professional development list and funding for K-5 teachers, administrator credential literacy standards, and new ELA instructional materials adoption.

title: Juveniles: incarcerated parent: visitation.
summary: Requires foster care and reunification orders for jailed parents to include in-person visitation rights, with reporting by child welfare agencies and county jails.

title: Health facilities: cardiac surgery.
summary: Allows hospital cardiac surgery teams using extracorporeal bypass to include one surgeon plus two PAs or registered nurses instead of three surgeons.

title: Rental passenger vehicles: electronic surveillance technology: renter liability for loss due to theft.
topics: AI and technology; Consumer protection and business
summary: Allows rental companies to use geofence tracking of vehicles and limits the theft-liability presumption to renters whose authorized driver returns the key.

title: Public works: prevailing wages.
summary: Starting July 2027, prevailing wage rate changes would apply to large public works contracts of $35 million or more, with a new petition process for rate reviews.

title: Medical staff: health care provider credentialing.
summary: Lengthens hospital medical staff reappointment and competency re-demonstration cycles from every 2 years to every 3 years.

title: Crimes: looting.
summary: Makes looting felonies, adds looting for petty theft during emergencies, and enhances penalties for impersonating officials during looting.

title: Early childhood education and childcare.
summary: Extends childcare eligibility for added children, lowers the daily-rate threshold to 5 hours, and extends the rate supplement through 2026 with new appropriations.

title: Emergency services: disaster preparedness.
summary: Requires OES to hold biennial disaster tabletop exercises, report results, and run community preparedness training in vulnerable regions.

title: Family reunification services.
summary: Limits the bar on family reunification services for parents convicted of violent felonies to cases where the victim was a child or shared-child partner.

title: Student loans: California Legislative Staff Education Loan Repayment Program.
summary: Creates a student loan repayment program for full-time California legislative staff, contingent on future appropriation.

title: Water conservation: water wise designation.
summary: Creates a voluntary statewide 'water wise' designation for commercial, industrial, and institutional businesses that meet water-efficiency best practices.

title: Local control funding formula: school districts and charter schools: pupils experiencing homelessness: supplemental and concentration grants: regional adjustment factors: grade-span adequacy adjustments.
summary: Changes the school funding formula to add homeless pupils to supplemental and concentration grant eligibility, raise the supplemental add-on to 35%, and adjust base grants for inflation and regional costs.

title: Mental health services: assisted outpatient treatment.
summary: Makes technical, nonsubstantive changes to Laura's Law provisions on assisted outpatient treatment for people with mental illness.

title: Single-family and multifamily housing units: preapproved plans.
summary: Requires local agencies to create preapproved housing plan programs and act on qualifying applications within 30 days, with annual reporting on units approved.

title: Climate change: market-based compliance mechanism: extension.
summary: Extends and revises California's cap-and-invest greenhouse gas market program, directing regulators to meet emissions goals while considering affordability and ratepayer impacts.

title: California Developmental Disability Services Quality, Performance, and Outcomes Act of 2025.
summary: Requires the developmental services department to map regional center quality measures and develop uniform performance benchmarks, reporting by 2028.

title: Workers’ compensation: cannabis industry.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Labor and employment
summary: Lets the workers' comp administrator require cannabis licensees to prove coverage, with compliance schedules, assistance, and relief from prior liability.

title: Education finance: education omnibus budget trailer bill.
summary: Expands state oversight of county office of education budgets and fiscal distress, adding notification and intervention authority for the Superintendent.

title: Postrelease community supervision.
summary: Requires CDCR to give county probation earlier written and verbal notice of prisoners' release dates and care manager contacts, and coordinate releases to the right county.

title: CalFresh: maintenance of benefit level.
summary: Requires the state to maintain CalFresh benefit levels at January 2025 amounts if federal cuts occur, using state funds subject to appropriation.

title: University of California: faculty and employee housing.
summary: Authorizes the University of California to create affordable housing programs for its faculty and employees, and allows occupancy limited to UC staff on UC or auxiliary land.

title: Restitution: priority.
summary: Requires criminal restitution orders to be paid before all fines, restitution fines, penalty assessments, and other fees.

title: Elections: official canvass.
summary: Requires counties to speed up vote counting, post results twice weekly, and certify election results within 21 days.

title: Hospitals: medical staff membership.
summary: Expands required hospital medical staff organization and membership provisions to include dentists, podiatrists, psychologists, and nurse practitioners and other licensed professionals.

title: Elementary and secondary education: omnibus.
summary: Omnibus education bill that lets credentialholders add subjects they already hold credentials for, clarifies physical education minute calculations by schooldays, and fixes cross references.

title: Public postsecondary education: admissions standards and criteria.
summary: Requests UC and CSU to align high school course admission criteria with state board standards and to revise the course certification process.

title: Copper theft.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice
summary: Makes unlawful possession of copper without proof of lawful purchase a crime and adds record-keeping duties for metal dealers.

title: Personal income tax: rate.
summary: Temporarily lowers California personal income tax rates by one percentage point for taxable years 2025 through 2029.

title: Taxation.
summary: Taxes digital products like software as tangible property under sales tax, prohibits Bradley-Burns revenue-sharing deals, and extends the $5 million business credit limit through 2029.

title: Developmental services: denials of services and notices of actions.
summary: Requires regional centers to document consumers' service denials, notices of action, and appeals in their plans, and adds denial data to the annual report.

title: Workplace surveillance tools.
topics: AI and technology; Civil rights and liberties
summary: Regulates employer use of workplace surveillance tools and worker data, requiring notice and prohibiting facial recognition and certain inferences, with civil penalties.

title: Public utilities: judicial review.
summary: Extends review deadlines for utility commission decisions and bars recovering judicial review costs from ratepayers.

title: Local Transportation Authority and Improvement Act: Sacramento Transportation Authority.
summary: Expands Sacramento transportation tax uses and allows smaller-area tax votes, and authorizes STA bonds for toll lanes payable from toll and sales tax revenue.

title: Teacher credentialing: substitute teachers: days of service.
summary: Reinstates the 60-day substitute teacher authorization through 2029, with board approval required for longer assignments.

title: State parks: Accessibility Advisory Committee.
summary: Creates an advisory committee to recommend ways to improve accessibility of state parks for people with disabilities.

title: Air quality: wildland vegetation management burning: permits: exemption.
summary: Exempts wildland vegetation burning from air permits when run by designated agencies, and requires state rules and best-practice guidelines for such burns.

title: Wildfire safety: fuels reduction projects.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Temporarily exempts critical wildfire fuels reduction projects in very high fire hazard zones from CEQA and requires agency reports on the emergency fuels proclamation.

title: Electricity: expedited utility distribution infrastructure undergrounding program.
summary: Exempts approval of electric utility distribution infrastructure undergrounding plans from California Environmental Quality Act review.

title: Adult Reentry Grant Program.
summary: Moves the Adult Reentry Grant Program to HCD to fund permanent supportive housing and reentry services for formerly incarcerated people, and requires homelessness risk assessments before prison release.

title: Higher education budget trailer bill.
summary: Higher education trailer bill funding two UC student housing grants, adds KIDS savings outreach to schools, and sets later timing for CSU academic standards work.

title: Pupil discipline: expulsions: procedures.
summary: Requires districts to help expelled pupils complete rehabilitation plans, bars cost and access barriers to readmission, and requires readmission unless narrow findings apply.

title: Criminal procedure: Safer Communities Through Opportunities Act.
summary: Allows courts to grant pretrial diversion for felony offenses, with dismissal after compliance and public-safety findings required.

title: Administrative Procedure Act: proposed regulations: cost of living impact on residents of the state.
summary: Adds cost-of-living impact analysis and review standards to the Administrative Procedure Act for state agency regulations, with the Office of Administrative Law overseeing it.

title: Noncertificated employees: applicants: previous employment: California School Information Services.
summary: Requires noncertificated school job applicants to disclose more prior employers and creates a statewide data system tracking egregious misconduct investigations.

title: Employment: nonpayment of wages: complaints.
summary: Revises the Labor Commissioner's wage complaint process, sets timelines, allows up to a 30% administrative fee, and creates a Wage Recovery Fund.

title: California State University: skilled and trained workforce requirement.
summary: Requires CSU design-build contractors and their subcontractors to commit to a skilled and trained workforce for apprenticeable building trades work, with exemptions including housing.

title: Insurance: Climate and Sustainability Insurance and Risk Reduction Grant Program.
summary: Creates a grant program, funded upon appropriation, for climate risk insurance proofs of concept and community-purchased insurance testing, with reporting and a 2035 repeal.

title: Swimming pool safety: building codes: condominium units.
summary: Requires condo balcony, patio and terrace pools to meet home drowning-prevention standards and exempts them from public pool rules.

title: California Energy Consumer Freedom Act.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration; Transportation
summary: Bars state and local governments from adopting rules that effectively ban gas appliances or gasoline vehicles, declaring the matter statewide.

title: Human trafficking: data.
summary: Requires the DOJ to publish human trafficking arrest and victim counts on the OpenJustice portal, with local agencies reporting the data.

title: Public resources trailer bill.
summary: Authorizes a nonprofit to build a Holocaust memorial at Exposition Park and expands Bay Fill fund uses to include enforcement.

title: Single-family residential real property: corporate entity: ownership.
summary: Prohibits corporate entities owning over 1,000 single-family homes from buying more homes to lease, with AG enforcement and penalties.

title: Student financial aid: Pay it Forward, Pay it Back Pilot Program: study.
summary: Requires the Student Aid Commission to study a proposed Pay it Forward, Pay it Back pilot for CSU and UC students and report by 2027.

title: Language access.
summary: Revises state agency language access rules, broadening the non-English-speaker threshold and replacing language surveys with needs assessments.

title: Polluters Pay Climate Superfund Act of 2025.
summary: Creates a climate superfund requiring large fossil fuel producers to pay cost recovery demands for 1990–2024 greenhouse gas damages to California.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: transportation impact mitigation: Transit-Oriented Development Implementation Program.
summary: Lets projects meet CEQA transportation mitigation by paying a per-mile fee into the Transit-Oriented Development Implementation Fund for regional housing near transit.

title: State contracts: certification process: forced labor and human trafficking.
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Requires state contractors on large contracts to certify compliance with anti-human-trafficking rules, notify employees, and ensure subcontractor compliance.

title: Alcoholic beverages: distilled spirits.
summary: Expands alcohol privileges for craft distillers and winegrowers, allows out-of-state direct shipping with a required permit, and extends direct shipping until 2027.

title: Classified employees: school districts and community college districts: contracting out: training requirements.
summary: Requires school and community college districts to pay classified staff for mandated training and guarantees fringe benefits for contracted workers doing classified jobs.

title: Hiring of real property: fees and charges.
summary: Limits landlord fees and utility billing for rentals, requires full price disclosure in listings, and adds treble damages liability for violations.

title: Early voting: satellite locations.
summary: Lets vote-by-mail voters cast ballots at satellite locations starting 29 days before an election, requires Saturday early voting in statewide elections, and drops the voter ID envelope requirement.

title: Medi-Cal: managed care organization provider tax.
summary: Imposes a $8.85 per-enrollee monthly MCO tax for 2027–2029, depositing revenue into a new Medi-Cal Stability Fund.

title: Transit operators: paratransit: recertification of eligibility.
summary: Requires transit operators to create a streamlined paratransit recertification process for eligible persons with permanent disabilities.

title: Job postings.
summary: Requires private employers who publicly advertise job postings to state whether the posting is for an actual vacancy.

title: State parks: Elephant Hill: City of Los Angeles.
summary: Authorizes the State Parks department to lease Elephant Hill in Los Angeles to the city and MRCA and classify it as a state park unit.

title: Property taxation: newly constructed property: reconstruction of damaged or destroyed property.
summary: Lets assessors treat rebuilds of 2025 fire-damaged properties under modified standards as substantially equivalent, avoiding reassessment.

title: GO-Biz: local immigrant integration initiatives: reporting.
summary: Moves the deadline for GO-Biz's annual immigrant integration grant report to May 1 and makes a nonsubstantive Government Code change.

title: Pupil instruction: newcomer pupils: migrant education: migrant regions.
summary: Makes newcomer-student curriculum resources optional for ELA/ELD materials and revises the definition of migrant service regions.

title: Parties to crime.
summary: Makes technical, nonsubstantive changes to the Penal Code provision classifying principals and accessories to crimes.

title: Department of Transportation: state highways.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive wording change to the provision assigning the Department of Transportation responsibility for state highways.

title: Deferred entry of judgment pilot program.
summary: Extends a young-adult deferred entry of judgment pilot in Butte, Nevada, and Santa Clara Counties to 2029 and moves its compliance review to the Office of Youth and Community Restoration.

title: Remote accessible vote by mail systems: testing and examination: report.
summary: Requires the Secretary of State to publish online its report on whether remote accessible vote by mail systems were certified.

title: Education finance: education omnibus trailer bill.
summary: Education omnibus trailer bill: replaces county office differentiated-assistance add-ons with a universal county grant from 2026-27 and makes state action on negative fiscal certifications mandatory.

title: Electricity: renewable energy subscription programs.
summary: Revises the community renewable energy subscription program with 5 MW facility caps, a 5 GW total cap, a 7-year limit, and PUC review requirements.

title: Immigration: immigrant youth: access to legal counsel.
summary: Requires the state to fund and contract legal counsel services for immigrant youth, subject to available funding, through nonprofit or public defender offices.

title: Stolen or embezzled property: description.
summary: Allows police and sheriff property clerks to record descriptions of stolen or embezzled property in a computer database instead of a book.

title: Firearms: ghost guns.
summary: Expands ghost gun restrictions to machineguns and large-capacity magazine files, criminalizes aiding unlawful manufacture, and adds firearm barrel sale requirements.

title: Pupil nutrition: restricted school foods and ultraprocessed foods of concern: prohibition.
summary: Phases out ultraprocessed and restricted foods in schools, bans vendors from offering them from 2032, and requires vendor reporting and state rulemaking.

title: Income taxes: credits: rehabilitation of certified historic structures.
summary: Extends the historic structure rehabilitation tax credit for 2027-2031, removing the housing bonus and residential credit and letting the Legislature set the annual cap.

title: Air districts: administrative rulemaking: standardized regulatory impact analysis.
summary: Requires certain regional air districts to prepare standardized regulatory impact analyses when adopting major regulations, with state-mandate reimbursement provisions.

title: Marriage: prohibition on minors.
summary: Prohibits anyone under 18 from obtaining a marriage license or establishing a domestic partnership, and repeals minor-marriage reporting provisions.

title: Motor Vehicle Fuel Tax Law: adjustment suspension.
summary: Allows the Governor to suspend the July 2025 inflation adjustment to the motor vehicle fuel tax and requires a funding replacement proposal.

title: County and city jails: incarcerated person contacts.
summary: Requires county and city jails to notify medical-release contacts and next of kin within 24 hours of an incarcerated person's death.

title: Climate change.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Extends Energy Commission EPIC follow-on funding to 2028, adds a 5% chair salary raise, and requires a nonrefundable $750,000 application deposit.

title: Foster care: placement.
summary: Makes a technical, nonsubstantive change to a foster care provision on assigning siblings to the same social worker.

title: Communications: broadband internet service providers.
topics: AI and technology; Consumer protection and business
summary: Requires broadband providers to report pricing and speed data, run a consumer complaint process with credits for unresolved complaints, and face penalties for noncompliance.

title: Department of Motor Vehicles: occupational licensees.
summary: Adds internet domain names to the restricted uses of the Department of Motor Vehicles name and initials by DMV occupational licensees.

title: Public utilities: ratesetting proceedings: local publicly owned electric utilities: California Renewables Portfolio Standard Program.
summary: Bars consent-agenda approval of large utility rate increases, requires public comment before voting on increases over 5%, and extends a renewables procurement exemption for certain local utilities beyond 2030.

title: Recycling: beverage containers.
summary: Declares legislative intent to later enact policies encouraging use of in-state collected recycled plastic beverage containers in manufacturing and packaging.

title: Regional housing needs: regional transportation plan.
summary: Extends timelines for state and regional housing need determinations and changes how subregional housing shares are allocated.

title: Housing developments: ordinances, policies, and standards.
summary: Expands housing-law definitions so housing projects are deemed consistent with other public agencies' requirements when substantial evidence supports it.

title: Jury duty.
summary: Requires the Judicial Council to also post its jury pilot program report on its public website.

title: Mortgages: hazard insurance proceeds: interest.
summary: Lets lenders pay hazard insurance escrow interest directly to borrowers, sets payment methods, and cancels uncashed checks after 90 days.

title: Criminal procedure: sentencing.
summary: Bars juvenile adjudications from counting as strikes for sentence enhancements and allows vacating them and resentencing affected defendants.

title: Transportation.
summary: Reimplements a DMV private-partner transaction fee through 2028 and lets Finance shift capital outlay support funds with zero net change.

title: Energy.
topics: Environment and energy; Labor and employment
summary: Creates an industrial thermal energy storage incentive program within the long-duration storage program and requires project labor agreements for funded construction after 2027.

title: Vehicles: leaving the scene of an accident.
summary: Raises prison terms to 7, 8, or 9 years for drivers who flee the scene of accidents causing permanent serious injury or death.

title: Personal Income Tax Law: credits: medical expenses.
summary: Allows a state income tax deduction for out-of-pocket medical costs, capped at $5,000 per year, for 2025 through 2029.

title: Office of Emergency Services: firefighting mutual aid.
summary: Requires the Office of Emergency Services to create a firefighting mutual aid prepositioning program and a reimbursement program for deployed agencies.

title: Emergency services: catastrophic plans: recovery frameworks.
summary: Requires state and local governments to develop catastrophic disaster recovery frameworks by January 2027, using federal grant funding where possible.

title: State Fire Marshal: lithium-ion battery facilities: guidance.
summary: Requires the State Fire Marshal, with OES, to develop fire prevention, response, and recovery measures for utility-grade lithium-ion battery storage facilities.

title: Political Reform Act of 1974: prospective employment.
summary: Requires specified public officials to disclose arrangements for prospective employment under the Political Reform Act, by specified deadlines.

title: Beer: labeling: temporary licensing.
summary: Exempts special-event temporary beer licenses from the mislabeled draught beer ban, applies the ban to all licensees, and bars misidentifying products.

title: Registered environmental health specialists.
summary: Revises registration, education, exam and trainee supervision rules for environmental health specialists and expands their scope of practice to body art and medical waste.

title: Juveniles.
summary: Clarifies that county-residence and probation-supervision rules for juvenile wards also cover those discharged from secure youth treatment facilities.

title: Labor.
summary: Creates a bargaining advisory committee to study statewide bargaining for IHSS and extends state disability benefits to career executive appointees.

title: High-Speed Rail Authority: Senate confirmation.
summary: Requires Governor-appointed High-Speed Rail Authority members to be confirmed by the Senate.

title: Ticket sellers: proof of purchase.
summary: Requires ticket sellers to deliver proof of purchase, refund defective or undelivered tickets, deliver e-tickets within 24 hours, and disclose sale details.

title: County community schools and juvenile court schools: administration and operation.
summary: Lets county boards of education contract with local school districts within the county to run county community and juvenile court schools.

title: Workers’ compensation: qualified medical evaluators.
summary: Requires the workers' comp administrator to create standard medical evaluation request and QME report forms, with regulations due by January 2027.

title: Real property tax: welfare exemption: moderate-income housing.
summary: Extends a property tax welfare exemption to rental housing serving low- and moderate-income households for 2027–2029 lien dates.

title: Public utilities: bills and notices: consolidation and transparency.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Environment and energy
summary: Requires utilities to show quarterly on customer bills the costs from state requirements, and asks the PUC to study consolidating billing notices.

title: Local educational agencies: reserve funds.
summary: Requires HCD to create a form for school districts to signal interest in housing on their land and provide predevelopment technical assistance.

title: Automatic temporary restraining orders.
summary: Makes temporary restraining orders in family law cases automatically effective and bars both parties from letting insurance plans lapse starting 2027.

title: The Department of Consumer Affairs.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive changes to the statutes establishing the Department of Consumer Affairs within the Business, Consumer Services, and Housing Agency.

title: Parking violations.
summary: Allows parking penalties to be reduced or waived for hardship or homelessness, and lets payment plan requests be filed at any time.

title: California Global Warming Solutions Act of 2006: scoping plan.
summary: Requires the Air Resources Board to include greenhouse gas emissions from wildlands and forest fires in its climate scoping plan.

title: Housing.
summary: Removes local objective standards and ministerial review requirements for certain ADUs, and bars fees in deed restrictions on ADUs and JADUs.

title: State and local government: data protection and privacy: immigration.
topics: AI and technology; Civil rights and liberties; Immigration
summary: Restricts state and local agencies from collecting immigration-related personal data or sharing it with federal immigration enforcement without a judicial warrant, with State Auditor review.

title: Electricity.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Abolishes the Electricity Oversight Board and Power Exchange, drops the attorney requirement for the Energy Commission's public advisor, and extends the energy conservation act to 2038.

title: Electricity: customer generators: departing load charges.
summary: Directs the Energy Commission to study and design a new customer generation system and departing load charge process, reporting to the Legislature by 2027.

title: Communications: lifeline telephone service program.
summary: Bars the lifeline phone program from sharing applicant data with government or immigration authorities without a court order or warrant.

title: Paint product recovery program: paint recovery: education and outreach.
summary: Expands the paint stewardship program's purpose to include paint recovery, and makes paint education and outreach mandatory, including apprenticeship training.

title: Air pollution control and air quality management districts: permit information: internet website.
summary: Requires air districts to post a public online map of permitted facilities that use emission reduction credits, with specified permit information.

title: Teacher preparation programs: school districts and county offices of education: English learners.
summary: Lets school districts and county offices run teacher prep programs for bilingual and English learner certificates, subject to Commission approval standards.

title: Licensed Dentists from Mexico Pilot Program.
summary: Replaces the Dentists from Mexico pilot with a new program licensing Mexican-trained dentists to work at federally qualified health centers, funded by philanthropy.

title: Residential building permits: inspections: Housing Accountability Act.
summary: Requires local building departments to inspect permitted residential work within 10 business days of completion notice, and treats missed deadlines as housing project disapprovals under the Housing Accountability Act.

title: State employees: compensation: firefighters.
summary: Requires state pay for rank-and-file CAL FIRE firefighters to be within 15% of average salaries at 20 listed California fire departments, implemented through bargaining.

title: Public Resources.
summary: Establishes round 7 of the Homeless Housing, Assistance, and Prevention program with a $500 million appropriation and exempts housing-element rezonings from CEQA.

title: School accountability: school climate report.
summary: Requires districts and charter schools serving grades 5-12 to annually compile and publish a school climate report and improvement plan.

title: California Rangeland, Grazing Land, and Grassland Protection Program.
summary: Appropriates $400 million in bond funds for grants to acquire conservation easements on privately owned working lands.

title: Hospital pricing.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Requires hospitals from 2027 to screen patients, presumptively qualify CalFresh/CalWORKs enrollees for charity care and discounts, and delay billing until notice.

title: Water quality: permits.
summary: Requires the state water board to create a statewide stormwater permit for large commercial, industrial and institutional properties, with multiple compliance options.

title: Transitional housing placement providers.
summary: Requires county foster transitional housing contracts to let participants lead roommate and bedroom-sharing decisions and bar terms that create unreasonable admission barriers.

title: California American Freedmen Affairs Agency.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Creates the California American Freedmen Affairs Agency to verify American Freedmen status and keep a registry, subject to appropriation, with limits on sharing personal data.

title: Hunting licenses: information on firearms.
summary: Requires the Fish and Wildlife department, starting July 2027, to give hunting license buyers information on firearm safe storage, parental liability, state gun laws, and legal transfers.

title: Asset forfeiture: human trafficking.
summary: Extends existing asset forfeiture and receivership procedures to all human trafficking offenses involving commercial sex, regardless of victim age.

title: Public social services: tax-exempt nonprofit organizations.
