summary: Expands eligibility for state immigrant and asylee service grants to nonprofits that qualify for state tax-exempt status.

title: Protected species: California Endangered Species Act.
summary: Bans trade in illegally taken wildlife, adds species to a provisional list when federal protections weaken, and shields federally authorized take from liability.

title: Taxation.
summary: Changes how vehicle sales tax is paid and filed through DMV and CDTFA, lets large dealers be exempted from DMV payment, and extends marketplace collection to e-waste fees.

title: California Affordable Drug Manufacturing Act of 2020: opioid antagonists.
summary: Bars state agencies from noncompetitively contracting for opioid antagonists with drug makers that settled multistate opioid epidemic claims, voiding such contracts.

title: Department of Justice: online missing person registry.
summary: Requires the Attorney General to build a public database for reporting and searching for missing children, and offers free DNA testing to reunified parents.

title: Agricultural commissions and reports.
summary: Shifts annual grape crush report and assessment deadlines later, adds nursery license enforcement powers, and expands commission membership and marketing standard authority.

title: County employees’ retirement: administration: retirement board member compensation for meetings.
summary: Lets county boards allow retirement board members' meeting pay to rise by up to 5% yearly, and adds Orange County findings.

title: CalWORKs.
topics: Children and families; Labor and employment
summary: Removes work-hour and AFDC tests for CalWORKs deprivation and allows aid to families of striking parents or caretakers, plus orders an expansion feasibility study.

title: Lubricants and waste oil: producer responsibility.
summary: Creates a producer responsibility program for lubricants and waste oil, requiring a producer organization to run free collection and management, pending CalRecycle approval.

title: Health masks: right to wear.
summary: Gives individuals the right to wear health masks in public places to protect personal or public health.

title: Home improvement and home solicitation: right to cancel contracts: notice.
summary: Requires home improvement cancellation notices to be delivered by email, with seller-provided contact details, and lets buyers complain to the contractors board if notices are missing.

title: Medi-Cal reimbursements: nonemergency ambulance and other transportation.
summary: Raises Medi-Cal nonemergency ambulance payments to 80% of Medicare rates, lets nonphysicians certify medical necessity, and allows GPS mileage records.

title: Workers’ Compensation: Subsequent injuries payments.
summary: Changes how permanent disability is measured for workers' compensation subsequent-injury fund eligibility, using impairment ratings without occupation or age adjustments.

title: Education finance: education omnibus trailer bill.
summary: Education omnibus trailer bill extending funding deadlines for math training and prekindergarten grants and expanding how some prekindergarten funds may be used.

title: Plastic Pollution Prevention and Packaging Producer Responsibility Act.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive wording change to the plastic packaging producer responsibility goal requiring source reduction of plastic covered material.

title: Workplace surveillance.
topics: AI and technology; Civil rights and liberties; Labor and employment
summary: Limits employer workplace surveillance tools, bans monitoring employees in bathrooms, lets workers leave tools outside, and sets $500 per-violation penalties.

title: Medicinal cannabis: shipments.
summary: Lets licensed microbusinesses ship medicinal cannabis directly to patients until 2029 and bars localities from banning such shipments.

title: Crimes: homicide.
summary: Narrows justifiable homicide defenses, including defense of habitation or property, and adds circumstances where homicide is not justifiable.

title: California State Library: study: official state energy.
summary: Designates solar energy as the official state energy and requires a State Library study and report on the best candidate.

title: Habilitation services.
summary: Removes the CARF accreditation requirement for work activity and supported employment programs, substituting department-adopted service standards for regional center monitoring.

title: Farmworkers: benefits.
summary: Creates a presumption until 2031 that heat-related injuries of farmworkers whose employers violate heat illness standards are work-related, and funds administration with $5 million.

title: Information Practices Act of 1977.
summary: Extends the state information privacy act to local agencies from 2028, tightens personal data use and discipline, and broadens permitted disclosures of personal information.

title: Department of Transportation: transferred property: City of Lynwood.
summary: Lets the state transportation department, on the City of Lynwood's request, swap a deed restriction on a transferred parcel to another parcel, with reporting to the Legislature.

title: Department of Insurance: housing insurance study.
summary: Requires the Insurance Department, subject to appropriation, to study insurance availability and costs for affordable housing entities and report recommendations.

title: Public Safety.
summary: Repeals the Rehabilitation Oversight Board and the Council on Criminal Justice and Behavioral Health, and removes Inspector General oversight of prison reform delivery.

title: Transportation network company drivers: labor relations.
summary: Gives rideshare drivers collective bargaining rights, with procedures for driver organization certification, elections, and sectoral bargaining enforced by the Public Employment Relations Board.

title: Contractors: discipline: building law violations.
summary: Expands contractor discipline grounds to include violations of architecture, engineering, land surveying and structural pest control prohibitions.

title: Public Utilities Commission: energy efficiency programs: report.
summary: Requires electric climate credits go to residential customers in summer months, favoring hotter regions, and makes energy efficiency program reporting annual.

title: Local alternative transportation improvement program: Feather River crossing.
summary: Lets local agencies propose a transportation program for canceled Feather River crossings and directs sale proceeds from excess properties to regional priorities.

title: Restrictions on firearm possession: pilot project.
summary: Lets four counties pilot temporary emergency gun violence restraining orders requested by district attorneys, with data reporting and evaluation through 2032.

title: Cartwright Act: restraint of trade.
summary: Expands the Cartwright Act to make unlawful any restraint of trade or monopolization or monopsonization, with specified conditions.

title: Public postsecondary education: residency: dependents of members of the Armed Forces: reenrollments.
summary: Extends military dependents' in-state tuition classification to students granted reenrollment rights even after the service member transfers out of state or retires.

title: Electrical modernization zones.
summary: Directs the state to identify six electrical infrastructure modernization zones, prioritize them for load growth, and expedite utility cost recovery there.

title: Average daily attendance: emergencies: immigration enforcement activity: independent study plans.
summary: Adds immigration enforcement to emergency attendance-credit rules for school funding, capped at 10 missed days per pupil, requires independent study plans, and exempts related documents from public records law.

title: Consumer protection: ticket sellers.
summary: Expands ticket-sale rules, banning speculative ticket sales and bot circumvention, and imposes liability and penalties on sellers and resale platforms.

title: Higher education budget trailer bill.
summary: Higher education trailer bill requiring cradle-to-career data-sharing agreements, moving student housing reports to February, and stating intent for basic needs funds.

title: Employment Development Department: policies and practices.
summary: Changes the Employment Development Department's annual fraud prevention tool assessment report to biennial, starting January 1, 2027.

title: Pupils: school attendance: residency requirements.
topics: Children and families; Labor and employment
summary: Defines "foster youth" for school residency rules and requires a state database of minors' work permits starting in 2030-31.

title: Community air protection programs: financial support.
summary: Continuously appropriates 10% of Greenhouse Gas Reduction Fund proceeds to the Air Resources Board for community air quality grants, technical help, and incentives.

title: State real property: office space: consolidation.
summary: Requires the Department of General Services to audit state office space use annually and consolidate space, reserving freed space for UC, CSU and community colleges.

title: Personal Income Tax Law: credits: insurance.
summary: Creates a personal income tax credit, for 2026-2030, for residential property insurance premiums above the taxpayer's 2023 fire insurance premium.

title: Location privacy.
topics: AI and technology; Civil rights and liberties
summary: Prohibits covered entities from collecting or processing location information unless necessary for requested services, adds notice and policy duties, and bars government agencies from monetizing location data.

title: Alcohol and other drug programs.
summary: Requires licensed alcohol and drug treatment facilities to submit added incident information within 30 days and requires the department to issue deficiency notices after resident death investigations.

title: Guaranteed income payments: consideration as income or resources.
summary: Exempts guaranteed income payments from income and resource counts for means-tested programs, including Medi-Cal, CalFresh, and CalWORKs.

title: Santa Ana River Conservancy Program: lower Santa Ana River region.
summary: Requires at least 60% of Santa Ana River Conservancy Program project funds to go to urbanized lower-river projects benefiting disadvantaged communities or vulnerable populations.

title: Jury service exemptions.
summary: Lets people 80 or older seek a permanent jury service excuse for medical impairment using a written attestation instead of a provider's letter.

title: Courts.
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Makes technical court administration changes: repeals a juror pilot, shifts reporting deadlines, authorizes courthouse sales, and backfills $4.69 million for court facilities.

title: English learners: reclassification: English language proficiency assessment.
summary: Sets a new English Learner Progress Indicator score criterion for reclassifying students as English proficient starting July 2026.

title: University of California: branch campus of a school of medicine in the County of Kern: feasibility study.
summary: Requires UC, upon appropriation, to study the feasibility of a Kern County medical school branch campus and report to the Governor and Legislature.

title: Foreign labor contractor registration: agricultural workers.
summary: Extends California's foreign labor contractor registration and enforcement rules to agricultural workers under the H-2A visa program starting July 2027.

title: Protective orders: Wyland’s Law.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice
summary: Authorizes an automated DOJ notification system for protective order petitioners and protected persons, subject to appropriation, and opens certain records to inspection.

title: Private security services: patrol operators: training.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive change to the existing security guard registration training requirement for private patrol operators.

title: CalAccount Program.
summary: Creates a state CalAccount Program offering a free, federally insured transaction account, and requires employers to offer direct deposit into it.

title: Reimbursement for pharmacist services.
summary: Raises Medi-Cal reimbursement for advanced practice pharmacists to physician rates and requires private plans to cover their services.

title: The California Water Plan: water storage.
summary: Requires the state's California Water Plan to designate water storage as the preferred method for meeting increased water demands.

title: Smog check: exemption.
summary: Extends the smog check renewal exemption from pre-1976 vehicles to any motor vehicle 30 or more model years old.

title: Pupil rights: school graduation ceremonies and related events: adornments.
summary: Extends pupils' right to wear cultural or religious adornments to graduation-related events, bars preapproval requirements, and lets pupils and families define qualifying regalia.

title: State government.
summary: Restructures the Consumer Privacy Fund into subfunds, directing privacy enforcement penalties to enforcement and grant programs.

title: State Legislature: nondisclosure agreements.
summary: Bans legislators from entering or requesting nondisclosure agreements about proposed legislation, voids such agreements, and makes violations a crime.

title: Occupational safety and health: employee refusal to perform hazardous tasks.
summary: Lets employees in good faith refuse hazardous tasks, requires full pay during refusals, and bars discipline for refusing, including domestic workers.

title: Renewable electrical generation facilities: electrified commuter railroads: regenerative braking: net billing.
summary: Counts regenerative braking from electrified commuter trains as renewable generation eligible for net billing, and requires utilities to adopt a compliant tariff with metering.

title: Water quality: state certification.
summary: Requires a public hearing on request before the water board acts on hydroelectric water quality certifications, bars delegating that authority, allows cost fees.

title: Rental passenger vehicle transactions: third parties.
summary: Extends rental car pricing and disclosure rules to third-party sellers, requires total charge estimates including taxes and fees, and requires disclosure of vehicle fuel source.

title: Consideration when determining child custody: human trafficking.
summary: Requires courts deciding child custody best-interest determinations to consider admissible evidence that a parent caused human trafficking of the child or other parent.

title: Wards: probation.
summary: Caps juvenile probation at 12 months unless extended after a hearing, requires individualized conditions, and removes some court-ordered fines, work programs and conditions.

title: Income taxes: credits: motion picture credit.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Taxes and budget
summary: Removes the good-faith effort option for motion picture credit diversity workplans, requiring applicants to actually meet diversity goals to qualify.

title: Child welfare services: prevention services: Indian tribes.
summary: Lets state-tribal child welfare agreements cover foster-care prevention and requires funding, subject to appropriation, for tribal independent legal representation.

title: Vehicles: speed safety system pilot program.
summary: Adds the City of Sacramento to the cities authorized to run a speed safety camera pilot program.

title: State employment: state bargaining units.
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Approves specified state employee bargaining unit agreements, appropriates funds for their pay provisions, and continues pay funding if the 2026-27 and 2027-28 budgets are late.

title: Wildland firefighters: Formerly Incarcerated Firefighter Certification and Employment Program.
summary: Creates a program requiring CAL FIRE to certify incarcerated firefighters at release and give formerly incarcerated applicants hiring preference, subject to appropriation.

title: Education-related positions: previous employment disclosures: Commission on Teacher Credentialing: unprofessional conduct.
summary: Requires school employers to check applicants' prior employment misconduct history before hiring, and makes noncompliance unprofessional conduct subject to Commission action.

title: Ethics Over Aesthetics Act.
summary: Prohibits importing for profit, selling, or offering for sale transgenic pets with cosmetic traits, with per-animal civil penalties of at least $5,000.

title: Public employees’ retirement benefits.
summary: Revises public pension rules: caps pensionable pay for new members, creates new safety retirement formulas starting 2027, and increases fund expenditures.

title: Summary proceedings for obtaining possession of real property: procedural requirements.
summary: Limits courts' authority to postpone unlawful detainer demurrer or motion-to-strike hearings, allowing later dates only by stipulation or good cause.

title: Unlawfully restrictive covenants: housing developments: Palisades Fire.
summary: Makes recorded restrictive covenants unenforceable against affordable housing developments in counties under the January 2025 Palisades Fire emergency.

title: Health facilities: perinatal services.
summary: Makes perinatal services a required basic service for general acute care hospitals, and requires hospitals without them to submit compliance plans.

title: Behavioral health multidisciplinary personnel team.
topics: AI and technology; Criminal justice; Health care
summary: Authorizes counties to create behavioral health teams that link justice-involved people with mental illness to services in jail and after release, with confidential information sharing.

title: Law enforcement: settlement agreements.
summary: Makes agreements between police employers and officers that destroy, remove, or conceal misconduct records publicly disclosable, and declares severability.

title: Tribal gaming: compact ratification.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Environment and energy
summary: Ratifies a December 2025 amendment extending the Yurok Tribe's gaming compact and exempts related actions from CEQA review.

title: State Bargaining Unit 9 and State Bargaining Unit 12.
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Approves state employee bargaining agreements for Units 9 and 12, makes unfunded pay terms contingent on appropriation, and extends related budget continuous appropriations.

title: Public school governance: board member compensation.
summary: Raises the maximum monthly compensation authorized for city, county, and school district board members, scaled by attendance.

title: Education finance: transitional kindergarten: funding for basic aid school districts and necessary small schools.
summary: Requires state funding for transitional kindergarten in basic aid districts and necessary small schools, with a General Fund appropriation starting 2025-26.

title: Elections: voter registration information: elected officials and candidates.
topics: AI and technology; Elections and voting
summary: Makes elected officials' and candidates' home address, phone and email confidential in voter records, with an opt-out option.

title: California Gambling Control Commission.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Adds gaming law experience as a qualifying background for one California Gambling Control Commission member, plus technical changes.

title: Personal opioid drug deactivation and disposal systems.
summary: Requires the state health department, subject to appropriation, to create a program distributing opioid deactivation and disposal systems to individuals.

title: Forestry: internal combustion engines: industrial operations: fire toolbox.
summary: Requires industrial operations near forest land using combustion engines to keep dedicated fire toolboxes with enough extinguishers to equip every employee.

title: Crimes: sexual assault.
summary: Adds 5-, 7-, or 9-year prison terms for caretakers who assault dependent persons with intent to commit specified sexual offenses.

title: Hemp: low-dose hemp drinks.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice; Taxes and budget
summary: Authorizes licensed hemp manufacturers to sell low-dose THC hemp drinks to adults 21 and older, subject to testing and a 10% retail excise tax.

title: Workers’ compensation.
summary: Requires physicians and other interested parties to disclose financial interests in writing to payers when claims arise from referrals in workers' compensation.

title: Department of Transportation: encroachment permits: broadband facilities.
summary: Requires Caltrans to standardize and expedite encroachment permit review for broadband facilities, and deems complete applications approved.

title: Generators: air pollution regulations: income tax credits.
topics: Environment and energy; Taxes and budget
summary: Exempts backup generator sales during declared power-loss emergencies from air rules and creates a 2026–2030 income tax credit for generator purchases.

title: State Bargaining Unit 6.
summary: Approves State Bargaining Unit 6's 2025-2028 labor agreement and appropriates funds for its pay and benefit provisions.

title: Community colleges: Baccalaureate Degree in Nursing Pilot Program.
summary: Creates a 10-district pilot letting community colleges offer Bachelor of Science in Nursing degrees, with LAO evaluation and repeal in 2035.

title: Pupil records: parental access.
summary: Clarifies that parents' right to access school records covers both official and unofficial pupil records, and deletes an obsolete reference.

title: Fresh Start Grants: Personal Income Tax Law: credits.
summary: Creates Fresh Start Grants, having county welfare departments deliver refundable tax credit value to CalFresh recipients through a new continuously appropriated fund.

title: Emergency services.
summary: Lets counties provide ambulance services directly and requires written policies before contracting with emergency ambulance providers.

title: Electrical corporations: connections: affordable housing projects.
summary: Requires electric utilities to connect affordable housing projects within 60 days and delays certain rate increases if they miss the deadline.

title: Artificial intelligence: auditors: registration.
summary: Creates an AI auditor registry and bars unregistered persons from offering or conducting covered AI audits starting in 2029.

title: Attached residential condominium sales: liquidated damages.
summary: Raises the cap on liquidated damages a seller can keep from a defaulting buyer of a new condominium from 3% to 6% of purchase price.

title: Planning and Zoning Law: housing elements: rezoning.
summary: Extends by six months the deadline for cities and counties to complete required rezoning after failing to adopt a compliant housing element.

title: Electricity: interconnections.
summary: Requires the grid operator and large utilities to plan for and use surplus interconnection capacity in their integrated resource plans and transmission planning.

title: Intermodal roadability inspection program.
summary: Expands port terminal chassis inspections, requires defects be repaired before transport, extends record retention, and mandates follow-up inspections after failed reinspections.

title: California Cannabis Tax Fund: Department of Cannabis Control: Board of State and Community Corrections grants.
summary: Funds cannabis track-and-trace and illicit enforcement, and repeals the ban on local grants for localities that prohibit cannabis businesses.

title: Utilities: service outages and updates: alerts.
summary: Requires utilities to automatically enroll customers in service outage alerts by March 2026, with opt-out and online contact updates.

title: Voter education and outreach plans.
summary: Replaces state-run voter registration programs with county voter education and outreach plans covering vote-by-mail and military and overseas voter options.

title: Special education: pupil transfers: residency requirements: records.
summary: Requires schools to continue or newly adopt special education plans for transferring students and extends military-family residency rules to all pupils with active-duty parents.

title: Sustainable Groundwater Management Act: groundwater adjudication.
summary: Requires groundwater agencies to review sustainable yield every seven years and bars courts from setting yields above valid plan yields in adjudications.

title: Landlord-tenant: internet service provider subscriptions.
summary: Requires landlords to let tenants opt out of paying for third-party internet subscriptions included in rent, with rent deduction and anti-retaliation protections.

title: California Health Care Quality and Affordability Act.
summary: Expands health care affordability oversight to management services organizations, requiring them to report data and notify the state of certain agreements and transactions.

title: Property taxation: redemption: permanent installment plan.
summary: Lets taxpayers who have applied for a delinquent-tax installment plan request a one-year deferral during declared emergencies, and removes an obsolete definition.

title: Energy: Voluntary Offshore Wind and Coastal Resources Protection Program: community capacity funding activities and grants.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Expands the offshore wind program's funding to local and tribal communities and requires offshore wind entities to report donations to eligible recipients every 90 days.

title: Department of Health Care Access and Information.
summary: Requires health facilities, clinics, home health agencies, and hospices to report employee health coverage waiting periods, and the department to post them online.

title: California Health Benefit Exchange: automatic health care coverage enrollment.
summary: Requires Covered California to automatically enroll individuals in health plans upon receiving a complete insurance affordability program application, starting July 2026.

title: Deaf and Disabled Telecommunications Program.
summary: Extends the Deaf and Disabled Telecommunications Program surcharge through 2034 and directs collections to its administrative fund.

title: Surplus land.
summary: Requires state agencies' annual surplus land reports to include underused land regardless of disposal readiness, with a DGS report to the Legislature due 2030.

title: Vehicles: Road Usage Charge Technical Advisory Committee.
summary: Extends the road usage charge pilot advisory committee sunset to 2035 and requires a commission report on mileage-based fee research by 2027.

title: Health and care facilities: clinics: licensing.
summary: Makes technical, nonsubstantive changes to state licensing provisions for health facilities, including clinics.

title: Transportation electrification: electric vehicle charging stations: payment methods.
summary: Lets the state energy commission modify required payment methods for EV chargers as technology and costs change.

title: Corrections.
summary: Requires prisons to adopt heat-safety measures, including cooling, shade, monitoring, training, and Cal/OSHA worker safety rules.

title: San Joaquin River Parkway: pit dewatering.
summary: Prohibits pit dewatering in shallow-groundwater and subsurface-river areas within the San Joaquin River Parkway.

title: Diablo Range Conservation Program.
summary: Creates a Diablo Range Conservation Program and fund to acquire and restore habitat, with grants and appropriated money.

title: Consumer credit report: sale of property: natural disasters.
summary: Bars credit reports and credit decisions from using sales of uninhabitable properties in areas under a gubernatorial disaster emergency.

title: California Affordable Childcare Act: Personal Income Tax and Corporation Tax.
topics: Children and families; Taxes and budget
summary: Imposes a 0.5% tax on California income above $10 million for 2026-2030, depositing revenue into a fund for child care grants.

title: Behavioral health reimbursement.
summary: Requires a specified health plan to fully reimburse enrollees for out-of-network behavioral health care and mental health prescriptions until corrective action is completed.

title: Developmental services.
summary: Revises the Self-Determination Program, adds provider compliance conditions for quality incentives, and makes implicit bias training subject to appropriation.

title: County recorders: fees.
summary: Raises county recorder document recording fees, dedicates the revenue to recorder offices, and ends the general fund deposit requirement.

title: Personal income taxes: credit: medical services: rural areas.
summary: Creates a temporary personal income tax credit for medical services performed in rural California areas, capped at $5,000 per taxpayer yearly.

title: Homelessness Accountability, Recovery, and Treatment Act.
summary: Lets agencies send up to 40% of homelessness funds to recovery housing outside Housing First and requires nonprofits to report standardized performance metrics.

title: Education finance: funding: noncredit instruction.
summary: Requires the Board of Governors to allocate base funding for categorical programs, such as disabled student services and mental health, to qualifying noncredit colleges and centers.

title: Health care boards: workforce data collection.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to existing health board requirements to collect licensee workforce data for planning.

title: Personal Income Tax Law: Corporation Tax Law: credits: cleanup costs.
summary: Creates a temporary 2026-2030 income and corporation tax credit for costs of removing encampments, illegal dumping, and abandoned property.

title: State Air Resources Board: air pollution regulations: private fleets: exception.
summary: Bars the Air Resources Board from enforcing rules that compel private fleets to comply until a required federal Clean Air Act waiver is obtained.

title: Juveniles: registration.
summary: Requires juveniles discharged or paroled from a secure youth treatment facility for specified sex offenses to register as sex offenders.

title: School finance: administrative employee-to-teacher ratio: Paradise Unified School District.
summary: Exempts Paradise Unified from a state support reduction for excess administrative staff in 2024-25 through 2026-27 and requires a report.

title: Public retirement systems: development projects: labor standards.
summary: Requests a UC Berkeley Labor Center study of labor standards in real estate and infrastructure projects funded by PERS and STRS portfolios, due 2028.

title: Health.
summary: Allows out-of-state health professionals to serve 2028 Olympic events, and ties state immunization recommendations to a state baseline instead of federal bodies.

title: Pesticide testing.
summary: Extends the sunset date from January 1, 2027 to January 1, 2030 for existing pesticide cholinesterase testing and reporting requirements.

title: County of Merced Citizens Redistricting Commission.
summary: Creates an 11-member Citizens Redistricting Commission in Merced County to adjust county supervisorial district boundaries.

title: Essential Worker Commission.
summary: Creates an Essential Worker Commission to study essential worker issues and a legal work program providing pathways for essential workers to work lawfully.

title: Personal income taxes: unemployment insurance: tips.
topics: Labor and employment; Taxes and budget
summary: Excludes tips from state income tax and from wages for income tax withholding and unemployment insurance, for 2026 through 2030.

title: Publication: newspapers of general circulation.
summary: Requires legally mandated public notices to appear in newspapers' print editions, their websites, and a statewide notice repository.

title: Downtown revitalization and economic recovery financing districts.
summary: Lets cities and counties other than San Francisco create downtown districts that use tax revenue from commercial-to-residential conversions, with revised financing plan and labor standards.

title: Community colleges: job market study.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to the existing community college job market study requirement for vocational programs.

title: Unclaimed property: escheat to the state.
summary: Revises unclaimed property law so owner notices go only to valid addresses, and securities join intangible interests subject to escheatment.

title: Coastal resources: California Coastal Sanctuary: tidelands and submerged lands: oil and gas development.
summary: Bars state tideland oil and gas leasing in marine protected areas and sanctuaries, and bars infrastructure supporting certain federal offshore leases.

title: Children: temporary custody.
summary: Shortens the deadline for prospective adoptive parents to file an adoption request after a placement agreement from 10 to 7 working days.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: exemptions: housing development projects: energy systems and electronics: labor standards.
summary: Subjects transient lodging rezonings and some projects to full CEQA review, and exempts large builder's remedy housing projects from limited CEQA review.

title: California Children’s Services Program: providers.
summary: Allows paneled nurse practitioners, physician assistants and certified registered nurses to treat CCS patients without cosignature and bill Medi-Cal directly.

title: State Teachers’ Retirement System.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive change to the name of the Teachers' Retirement Law, with no change to pension benefits.

title: State mandates: claims.
summary: Lowers the minimum dollar amount for state mandate reimbursement claims from $1,000 to $800.

title: Public postsecondary education: student health: contraception and emergency contraception information.
summary: Requires CSU campuses, and requests UC campuses, to provide adoption information wherever contraception information is available to students.

title: Pupil literacy: credential program standards and professional development: instructional materials.
summary: Requires the state to adopt new English language arts and ELD instructional materials by 2027, requires districts to follow updated guidance, and sets new literacy preparation standards for credentials.

title: State Board of Forestry and Fire Protection: defensible space requirements: ember-resistant zones: emergency regulations: California Environmental Quality Act.
summary: Requires the state fire board to adopt defensible space regulations and lets local fire agencies set alternative ordinance-based requirements for very high hazard zones.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: California Vegetation Treatment Program.
summary: Requires the Board of Forestry to update the vegetation treatment program EIR, expanding treatable areas and recognizing cultural burning.

title: General plan: environmental justice element: disadvantaged communities.
summary: Requires cities and counties to meaningfully involve disadvantaged communities in developing their environmental justice general plan element and sets a revised adoption deadline.

title: Physical therapy and veterinary medicine: animal physical therapy.
summary: Allows licensed physical therapists with specified training to provide animal physical therapy under veterinary supervision or referral.

title: Hazardous waste: underground storage tanks.
summary: Expands hazardous waste permit exemptions for onsite lab waste treatment and excludes more fluid-holding tanks from underground storage tank regulation.

title: Human services.
summary: Requires counties in homelessness assistance programs to adopt public policies, complaint processes, and state hearing rights for service reductions.

title: Prescription drug pricing.
summary: Prohibits drug manufacturers from restricting 340B clinics' purchases or delivery through contract pharmacies, and requires clinics to annually verify compliance with federal rules.

title: Department of Consumer Affairs: regulatory boards.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to Department of Consumer Affairs board provisions, including removal procedures for board members.

title: Public postsecondary education: community colleges: baccalaureate degree program: Allan Hancock College.
summary: Allows the Board of Governors to approve an Allan Hancock College baccalaureate program without the usual written agreement with objecting universities.

title: Interscholastic athletic programs: emergency action plans.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to existing rules requiring school athletic programs to have written emergency action plans.

title: Housing preferences.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice
summary: Requires denying housing preferences for certain transgender, nonbinary, or intersex incarcerated people who committed specified offenses against opposite-gender victims, housing them by anatomy.

title: Developmental services: data.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive technical change to a Department of Developmental Services data-update requirement for regional center placements.

title: Groundwater adjudication.
summary: Revises groundwater adjudication procedures for small users, adds presumptions and burdens for small claims, and requires technical reports from groundwater agencies.

title: Residential property insurance: tree fire risks.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Exempts insured homeowners from tree removal laws, ordinances, fees and fines when the insurer and CAL FIRE confirm the tree is a fire risk.

title: Ethnic studies: content standards, curriculum frameworks, instructional materials, and compliance monitoring.
summary: Requires high school ethnic studies standards, frameworks, and course content rules, including a 2029-30 graduation requirement and multicultural content mandates.

title: Disaster preparedness: public water systems.
summary: Makes only nonsubstantive wording changes to existing disaster preparedness and emergency response rules for large public water systems.

title: Education finance: education omnibus trailer bill.
summary: Adds a provider intent-declaration step and capped review fees for literacy professional development programs, and changes how $200M in teacher literacy training funds are apportioned.

title: Food facilities: retail food safety.
summary: Revises California Retail Food Code rules on grease traps, passthrough windows, and wall and restroom exemptions, mostly easing existing requirements for food facilities.

title: Resource and referral agencies.
summary: Repeals a COVID-era childcare resource and referral provision and adds upon-appropriation duties for these agencies to assist childcare providers during disasters.

title: California Sea Level Rise State and Regional Support Collaborative.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive wording change to the state's sea level rise support collaborative within the Ocean Protection Council.

title: Voidable transactions: remedies: choice of law.
summary: Changes the location rule for individual debtors in voidable transfer claims to principal residence or domicile.

title: Health care cost targets.
summary: Requires health care cost targets for providers to be adjusted upward when prescription drug costs grow faster than targets.

title: Building Homes and Jobs Trust Fund.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to the Building Homes and Jobs Trust Fund provision, with no substantive change to funding.

title: Meal program: senior citizens.
summary: Allows senior meal projects to offer to-go pickup for virtual group dining and drops the dietary allowance requirement for extra meals.

title: Governor’s Office of Business and Economic Development: California Competes Grant Program.
summary: Extends the California Competes Grant Program, which provides business investment grants, until January 1, 2031.

title: Used Mattress Recovery and Recycling Act: mattress recycling charge: consumer education.
summary: Lets mattress sellers pay the recycling charge for consumers and requires sellers to educate consumers on mattress recycling and free dropoff options.

title: County road commissioner: Counties of Madera and Tehama.
summary: Authorizes the Madera and Tehama county boards of supervisors to transfer road commissioner duties to the county public works director.

title: Higher education budget trailer bill.
summary: Higher education trailer bill requiring community college food pantry access for classified staff, plus Middle Class Scholarship calculation and institutional agreement changes.

title: Local government: County of Orange.
summary: Requires Orange County officials overseeing the investment fund to meet specified qualifications and publishes an annual public statement of fund assets.

title: Income tax: credit: immigration.
summary: Creates a 2026-2030 personal income tax credit equal to the federal I-130 family petition filing fee for qualified taxpayers.

title: Bowie’s Law: animals: adoption, shelter overcrowding, and breeding.
summary: Tightens dog breeder rules by lowering thresholds and requiring microchips and health checks, and requires shelters to list adoptable animals online.

title: Supervision: violations.
summary: Bars arrest or incarceration for technical supervision violations absent judicial revocation, caps revocation confinement, and prohibits flash incarceration.

title: Energy reliability.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive wording change to the state grid operator's duty to ensure efficient and reliable transmission grid operation.

title: Property tax: documentary transfer tax: exemptions: Native American tribes.
summary: Extends a property tax welfare exemption to tribally owned natural-resource land and exempts tribal land-return transfers from documentary transfer tax through 2031.

title: Climate resiliency: research farms: grant program.
summary: Authorizes advance payments and exempts certain Department of Food and Agriculture research-farm contracts from Director of General Services approval, and designates research farm stations.

title: Public health: Two-Spirit, Transgender, Gender Nonconforming, and Intersex Wellness and Equity Fund.
summary: Renames the trans health fund as the 2TGI Wellness and Equity Fund, expanding grant uses to workforce, immigrant resettlement, youth diversion, and mental health.

title: Self-defense.
summary: Clarifies self-defense standards requiring proportional, imminent-threat resistance, bars consideration of fighting skills, and grants civil immunity for lawful resistance.

title: Peace officers.
summary: Requires law enforcement agencies to adopt policies barring peace officers from carrying firearms with any blood alcohol above 0.00%, on or off duty, except undercover work.

title: Public resources trailer bill.
summary: Expands invasive mussel prohibitions and requires water suppliers and reservoir managers to update prevention plans to cover all known invasive mussel species.

title: Inmate release: notice to victims.
summary: Extends from 15 to 20 days the advance notice victims and witnesses receive before certain inmates are released or parole status changes.

title: Transportation: road safety.
summary: Declares legislative intent to enact future laws improving road safety; makes no substantive changes itself.

title: Elections: vote by mail voters.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to the definitions of vote-by-mail, military, and overseas voters.

title: School district and community college district governing boards: vacancy elections.
summary: Requires special elections for school and community college board vacancies to be consolidated with the next regularly scheduled election when timing allows.

title: General plans.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to Planning and Zoning Law provisions on general plans and conformity reports.

title: Home health aides: training and certification.
summary: Adds training, supervision, and annual in-service requirements for home health aide certification and renewal, and bars state reimbursement for the added local costs.

title: Cannabis task force.
summary: Reinstates the state and local cannabis regulation task force, adds tribal members, and exempts its meetings from open meeting laws.

title: State Contract Act.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive changes to the provision naming the State Contract Act, which governs state agency contracting.

title: Workers’ compensation: medical treatment.
summary: Creates a San Joaquin Valley physician network database for workers' comp, requiring injured workers to seek in-network care first.

title: Vehicles: accident reports.
summary: Makes technical, nonsubstantive changes to existing vehicle accident reporting requirements to the DMV.

title: Budget Act of 2024.
summary: Amends the 2024-25 Budget Act by changing existing appropriations, as provided, and takes effect immediately as a Budget Bill.

title: Early care and education.
summary: Expands state preschool eligibility and reimbursable absences, lengthens fee exemptions, and extends eligibility to children of local education agency employees.

title: Sexual and reproductive health information.
summary: Requires the Department of Public Health to partner with an organization to update a state website with expanded sexual and reproductive health information, including abortion services.

title: Physician assistants and podiatrists.
summary: Extends the physician assistant and podiatry boards to 2030, raises physician assistant supervision limits to 8, and loosens podiatry licensing and fee rules.

title: Veterinary medicine: California Veterinary Medical Board.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Extends the state Veterinary Medical Board to 2030, adds a vet tech member, and tightens vet technician registration and client record access rules.

title: Pharmacy.
summary: Extends California Board of Pharmacy sunset to 2030, expands pharmacist authority to furnish drugs and devices, and waives certain pharmacy fees in underserved areas.

title: California Massage Therapy Council.
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Revises the Massage Therapy Council's board composition and salary cap, and eases certification for applicants from schools under investigation.

title: Food and agriculture: omnibus bill.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Omnibus agriculture bill extending a vertebrate pest program, tightening livestock antimicrobial prescription rules, and adding inspection powers for mobile farmers' markets.

title: Invasive pests: lists.
summary: Requires the Department of Food and Agriculture to post its invasive pests list on its website.

title: Financial institutions.
summary: Changes the contact information required in money transmitter notices and repeals a 2007 reporting requirement for the deferred deposit (payday lending) law.

title: Governor’s Military Council.
summary: Extends the Governor's Military Council's repeal date from January 1, 2026 to January 1, 2031.

title: Veterans: educational assistance.
summary: Creates the CSAAVE within the Department of Veterans Affairs to administer federal and state requirements for organizations seeking to offer veterans education benefits.

title: Early childhood education and childcare.
summary: Extends childcare provider reimbursement and supplemental payments, adds one-time stabilization and retroactive payments tied to a tentative labor agreement.

title: Santa Clara Valley Transportation Authority: employee relations.
summary: Lets parties seek writ review of PERB unfair-practice decisions and lets PERB enforce final orders in court for Santa Clara VTA employee disputes.

title: Political Reform Act of 1974: refunding and transferring contributions: voter information guide.
summary: Allows candidates whose names never reach a primary ballot, and who don't qualify for write-in votes, to keep and transfer general election contributions instead of refunding them, and makes technical conforming fixes.

title: Elections: ballot language.
summary: Requires Yes and No choices on local ballot measures to be printed on separate lines with voting targets, and revises related ballot language rules.

title: Election procedures: certified mail and superior courts.
summary: Changes election notice delivery from registered to certified mail, allows electronic delivery for some official communications, and updates recall court references to superior courts.

title: Worker classification: employees and independent contractors: licensed manicurists: commercial fishers.
summary: Extends until 2029 and 2031 the exemption of licensed manicurists and commercial fishers from the ABC worker-classification test, and adds reporting.

title: Professional employer organizations.
summary: Defines 'professional employer organization' and 'professional employer services' for purposes of the Labor Code.

title: Real property taxation.
topics: Environment and energy; Taxes and budget
summary: Extends the deadline for solar-exclusion property tax claims to three years and expands late-filing penalty relief to public school exemptions.

title: Property taxation: delinquency and penalties: suspension: Counties of Los Angeles and Ventura.
summary: Suspends property tax penalties, interest, and installment defaults in parts of Los Angeles and Ventura counties until April 10, 2026, with exceptions.

title: Income taxes: administration: nonresident aliens: identifying numbers: group filing.
summary: Extends indefinitely tax filing relief for nonresident aliens, including the SSN/ITIN waiver, group filing, and related income exclusion.

title: Taxation: tax liability: collections.
summary: Redefines income and corporate tax liability to exclude interest and penalties, so those amounts lapse with the underlying tax's collection period.

title: Human services.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Allows electronic signatures and payments for human services fees, authorizes General Fund support for home care licensing, and moves home care renewals to annual in 2029.

title: Public resources: conservation.
summary: Conservation omnibus: allows surety bonds for mitigation bank security, applies duck stamp fund rules to the department, and redefines water year.

title: Committee on Judiciary: judiciary omnibus.
summary: Omnibus judiciary bill making technical fixes to real estate, medical debt, commercial debt and mortgage foreclosure-protection provisions.

title: State Bar Act: expedited licensure: federal attorneys.
summary: Lets certain federal attorneys become California lawyers without the bar exam, and bars discipline for actions protecting lawful sensitive services.

title: Court-ordered mediation.
summary: Raises the cap for court-ordered civil mediation to $75,000, adds prerequisites, and has courts select mediators at no cost to parties.

title: Courts: fees.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice
summary: Caps court fees at cost, requires Judicial Council approval for unlisted fees, and lets the public view and copy electronic court records free on premises.

title: Attorneys: discipline: sensitive services.
summary: Bars State Bar discipline or reporting duties for attorneys over out-of-state actions interfering with lawful sensitive services in California.

title: Horse racing: audits of the horsemen’s organizations: license fee deposits: minisatellite wagering facilities.
summary: Removes the horse racing license fee deposit requirement, drops the audit deadline for horsemen's organizations, and clarifies minisatellite wagering race agreements.

title: Tribal gaming: compact ratification.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Environment and energy
summary: Ratifies an amended tribal-state gaming compact with the Picayune Rancheria of Chukchansi Indians and exempts related actions from CEQA.

title: Childcare.
summary: Adds medical and educational appointments to childcare reimbursable absences, allows space-holding during disenrollment appeals, and extends child protective services fee exemptions to 24 months.

title: Housing omnibus.
summary: Housing omnibus: lets just-cause notices appear in leases, requires assisted-housing expiration notices stay posted, and revises purchase-offer notice content.

title: Transportation budget trailer bill.
summary: Transportation trailer bill: authorizes a fee for air-board truck refrigeration rule costs, extends transit allocation ratios, revises charter bus pricing, and allows World Cup charter service.

title: California Disaster Assistance Act.
summary: Expands uses of California Disaster Assistance Act funds to unmet local needs and shifts disaster-program regulations to guidelines, with nonprofit assistance provisions.

title: Office of Emergency Services: comprehensive wildfire mitigation program.
summary: Adds the Department of Insurance as a nonvoting ex officio member of the California Wildfire Mitigation Program Board by July 2026.

title: Public Utilities Commission.
topics: Government and administration; Health care; Transportation
summary: Extends the TNC accessibility program and its $0.05 per-trip charge to 2032, adds commissioner-attendance reporting, and makes an appropriation from the TNC Access for All Fund.

title: Claims against the state: appropriation.
summary: Appropriates $672 from the state to the Department of General Services to pay claims accepted by the Government Claims Program.

title: Federal Workforce Pell Grant program: local workforce development boards: participant training requirement.
summary: Requires California postsecondary institutions to get state commission authorization before receiving federal Workforce Pell Grant funds for short-term programs.

title: Hate crimes: political affiliation.
summary: Allows courts to treat a felony motivated by the victim's political affiliation as an aggravating factor in sentencing.

title: Offshore oil: pipeline safety.
summary: Tightens oil pipeline rules by barring reactivation of spilled idle lines, requiring abandonment, adding public comment and CEQA review.

title: Peace officers: secondary employment.
topics: Criminal justice; Government and administration; Immigration
summary: Bars certain peace officers from secondary employment doing immigration arrests, detention, transport, or deportation, with decertification as a consequence.

title: Crimes: corruption.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice; Government and administration
summary: Makes it a crime for elected or appointed officials to retaliate against people exercising constitutionally protected rights, punishable by forfeiture of office.

title: Presidential elections: qualifications for office.
summary: Requires presidential nominees to certify under penalty of perjury that they are eligible under the Twenty-Second Amendment, or be excluded from the ballot.

title: Greenhouse gases: climate corporate accountability: climate-related financial risk: regulations: California Environmental Quality Act exemption.
summary: Exempts California's climate corporate disclosure and climate financial risk regulations from CEQA environmental review and appropriates $1,000 to CARB.

title: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline: LGBTQ+ youth.
summary: Requires the state to pursue a specialized LGBTQ+ suicide hotline press-3 option under 988 and contract with specialized providers, subject to appropriation.

title: Human trafficking: data.
summary: Requires the OpenJustice portal to include counts of human trafficking arrests, convictions, and victims, with state reimbursement of local mandated costs.

title: Sensitive personal information.
summary: Prohibits businesses, service providers, and contractors from selling or sharing sensitive personal information with third parties, with specified exceptions.

title: Mobilehome parks: rent caps.
summary: Extends the existing cap on mobilehome park rent increases to all mobilehome parks, not only those in multiple cities.

title: Court proceedings: media access.
summary: Bars judicial and law enforcement officers from blocking press or public access to open court proceedings, with civil penalties for violations.

title: Sexually violent predators.
summary: Adds sentence enhancements for targeted attacks on journalists and expands sexually violent predator referrals to indeterminate-sentence inmates before parole hearings.

title: Vehicles: driving under the influence.
summary: Makes repeat driving-under-the-influence convictions wobbler or felony offenses with harsher penalties based on prior violations.

title: University of California: branch campus of a school of medicine in the County of Kern: feasibility study.
summary: Requires UC to complete a feasibility study by 2028 on establishing a Kern County branch medical school campus and report its findings.

title: Conservation: the Monterey Bay Area Stewardship Authority.
summary: Establishes a Monterey Bay regional authority to raise and allocate funds for conservation, with power to levy assessments and issue bonds.

title: Alternative domestic violence program.
summary: Adds Sacramento County to counties authorized to offer an alternative domestic violence program and extends the program's sunset to 2030.

title: Governor’s Office of Business and Economic Development: California Civic Media Program.
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Creates the California Civic Media Program under GO-Biz and appropriates $10 million from the General Fund to support the press corps.

title: Personal income taxes: deductions: tips: overtime compensation.
summary: Conforms state income tax law to federal deductions for qualified tips and overtime pay for 2026 through 2028, allowed in addition to the standard deduction.

title: California Rice Commission: purpose.
summary: Adds a legislative declaration that the California Rice Commission is needed to maintain rice acreage supporting state wildlife habitat goals.

title: Public postsecondary education: civic engagement: recommendations report.
summary: Requires CSU and California Community Colleges chancellors, and requests UC's president, to report recommendations on student civic engagement and knowledge of American democracy by 2028-29.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: notice: direct mailing: electronic mail.
summary: Lets CEQA lead agencies send required direct-mail notices by email to recipients who affirmatively request it.

title: Disasters: data.
summary: Requires the California Earthquake Authority to send its annual report to insurance committees and post its certified audit online, and adds hazard mitigation to a climate risk working group's recommendations.

title: Community colleges: exemption from nonresident tuition fee: College of the Siskiyous.
summary: Authorizes College of the Siskiyous to exempt up to 200 yearly Oregon-resident students from nonresident tuition fees.

title: Recovery housing: funding.
summary: Conditions state homelessness funding for recovery housing on Housing First, no-eviction-for-relapse, overdose response, and return-to-use policy requirements.

title: Vehicles: electric bicycles.
summary: Lowers e-bike speed caps to 16 mph and bans sale of e-bikes with motors above set wattage, enforced by civil penalties.

title: Uniform Emergency Volunteer Health Practitioners Act.
summary: Creates a uniform framework for registering out-of-state volunteer health practitioners and regulating their emergency practice in California.

title: Residential property insurance images.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Consumer protection and business
summary: Requires insurers to notify policyholders about aerial property images, provide them on request, and limit termination decisions based on old images.

title: Labor.
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Appropriates $372 million from the General Fund to supplement state employee pension fund payments for unfunded liabilities.

title: Lobbyist certification.
summary: Bars people convicted of public corruption from serving as lobbyists for 12 years and requires lobbying certifications to disclose such convictions.

title: Medi-Cal: complex rehabilitation technology.
summary: Bars Medi-Cal prior authorization for wheelchair repairs under $1,250 and drops prescription requirements for repair or replacement of approved power wheelchairs.

title: Elections: precinct board members.
summary: Authorizes counties until 2033 to adopt random selection of registered voters to serve as precinct board members, with excusal and disqualification options.

title: Budget Act of 2026.
summary: Makes appropriations to support state government for the 2026-27 fiscal year and takes effect immediately as a Budget Bill.

title: Employer-employee relations: confidential communications.
summary: Bars public employers from questioning or compelling disclosure of confidential employee-union representative communications, with criminal and public safety exceptions.

title: Income and corporation taxes: credits: work opportunity credit.
summary: Creates a 40% income and corporation tax credit for employers hiring recently released felons, for tax years 2027 through 2031.

title: Crimes: mandated reporters: severe neglect.
summary: Recasts the definition of "severe neglect" used in the Child Abuse and Neglect Reporting Act.

title: General plan: annual report: congregate and residential care for the elderly.
summary: Lets cities and counties count elderly congregate and residential care units toward housing needs and expands annual reporting on surplus land disposal.

title: Sex offenses: registration.
summary: Makes it harder to end sex offender registration by adding court considerations, required petitioner presence, and treatment verification.

title: Pupil safety: electric bicycle: safety and training program.
summary: Requires the State Department of Education, with the CHP, to develop a standardized e-bike safety and training program for grades 7-12 by March 2028.

title: Public safety.
summary: Revises prison contracting and community treatment for women with children, exempts State Public Defender contracts from procurement rules, and renames Prison Industry Authority.

title: Health care coverage: diagnostic imaging.
summary: Requires health plans and insurers to cover screening and diagnostic breast imaging without cost sharing starting in 2028.

title: Product safety: recreational water safety: wearable personal flotation devices: infants and children.
summary: Replaces the term "puddle jumper" with "swim vest" in the state's definition of wearable flotation devices for infants and children.

title: California Interscholastic Federation: officials: registration, certification, and eligibility verification.
summary: Requires CIF sports officials to register annually on a platform verifying background screening, certification, training, and liability insurance before officiating.

title: Land use: housing elements: target population.
summary: Allows city and county housing element needs analyses to include victims of domestic violence, sexual assault, and human trafficking as a target population.

title: The Tribal Foster Care Prevention Program.
summary: Creates a state-funded program giving California tribes annual allocations for family preservation services to prevent foster care entry, subject to appropriation.

title: Lanterman Developmental Disabilities Services Act.
summary: Renames "consumer" as "person eligible for regional center services" in the Lanterman Act and updates other terminology and gender language, without changing services.

title: Workers’ compensation: Subsequent injuries payments.
summary: Changes how workers' compensation subsequent-injury permanent disability is measured and adds a prior-disability requirement for certain special additional compensation.

title: Data centers: reporting.
topics: AI and technology; Environment and energy
summary: Requires data center operators to report energy data to the state and provide energy and sound information for local permits.

title: State agency officials: training on responding to hate: local agency officials: anti-hate speech training.
summary: Requires state and local elected officials paid by public agencies to complete anti-hate speech training starting in 2028, with a state online course.

title: Tribal gaming: compact ratification.
summary: Ratifies a 2026 amended tribal-state gaming compact with San Manuel Nation and exempts related actions from CEQA review.

title: Land use.
summary: States legislative intent for housing finance committee recommendations on loan administration, adds a report standard, and defines housing development project under the Permit Streamlining Act.

title: Counties: offices: consolidation.
summary: Authorizes Amador County's board of supervisors to consolidate the Auditor-Controller and Treasurer-Tax Collector offices upon a vacancy.

title: Pupils: data reporting: American Indian and Alaska Native pupils.
summary: Requires the State Department of Education to post annual aggregate educational outcome data for American Indian and Alaska Native pupils starting July 1, 2028.

title: Higher Education Employer-Employee Relations Act: collective bargaining: unfair labor practices.
summary: Makes it an unfair practice for higher education employers to circumvent arbitration decisions on contracting out bargaining unit work, with attorney's fees for violations.

title: Criminal procedure: jurisdiction.
summary: Allows wage theft and labor trafficking prosecutions to be brought in additional counties tied to the victim, work location, or business location.

title: State Air Resources Board: Office of Civil Rights.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Creates an Office of Civil Rights within the Air Resources Board, subject to appropriation, with training duties and annual public reporting on complaints and enforcement.

title: Wine labeling: “American” or “United States” appellation.
summary: Prohibits using 'American' or 'United States' wine appellations unless 100% of the wine comes from US-grown grapes or agricultural products, starting July 2027.

title: Opioid overdose reversal medication: school resource officers.
summary: Requires school resource officers to complete overdose response training and report naloxone use, shields them from liability for good-faith administration, and directs low-cost naloxone guidance.

title: Prescription drug refills: prescriber notifications.
summary: Limits the pharmacist's duty to notify a prescriber of an unauthorized refill to cases where a prescriber is identified.

title: Vehicles: Sideshow Accountability and Community Safety Act.
summary: Expands the sideshow definition and increases penalties, including higher fines, mandatory minimum jail terms, and felony charges when injuries result.

title: Firearms: silencers.
summary: Exempts specified level I reserve peace officers from the state's felony ban on possessing silencers.

title: Personal Income Tax Law: Corporation Tax Law: exemptions: wildfire.
summary: Limits the state income tax exclusion for wildfire settlements to qualified wildfire disasters and appropriates $10,000 to the Franchise Tax Board.

title: California Career Technical Education Incentive Grant Program: revised allocation formula.
summary: Shifts career technical education grant duties to the Department of Education and requires a revised allocation formula that fully distributes appropriated funds.

title: California Podiatric Pipeline Program.
summary: Creates a California Podiatric Pipeline Program to promote podiatric careers and support doctor of podiatric medicine students, subject to appropriation; repeals 2032.

title: California Indian Heritage Center support organization.
summary: Authorizes the Parks Department to partner with a support organization, with a set board and CEO structure, to support the California Indian Heritage Center.

title: State agencies: revenue: report.
summary: Requires state agencies that impose monetary charges to annually post the revenue those charges generate on their websites in machine-readable form.

title: Surplus nonresidential property: sales by the Department of Transportation: net equity.
summary: Lets Caltrans sell surplus property to a qualifying nonprofit tenant without collecting amounts above fair market value or value in use.

title: Criminal procedure: writs of habeas corpus and motions to vacate.
summary: Revises habeas corpus and vacatur standards to ease relief, dropping the materiality requirement for false evidence and changing the new-evidence and stipulation rules.

title: Sales and Use Tax Law: exemptions: infant car seats.
summary: Exempts infant car seats from state sales and use taxes from 2027 through 2031, with no local tax application or state reimbursement.

title: Notary public: service fees.
summary: Raises the maximum fees notaries public may charge for services such as taking acknowledgments or proofs of deeds.

title: Behavioral sciences.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Labor and employment
summary: Exempts religious officials and certain attorneys and physicians from counseling licensure and tightens experience and exam timelines for behavioral science license applicants.

title: Public transit: California Transit Stop Registry: transit datasets.
summary: Requires the state DOT to create a statewide transit stop registry and transit operators to standardize stop names, locations and identifiers.

title: Vote by mail ballots: processing.
summary: Allows election officials to begin processing vote-by-mail return envelopes and ballots on the date ballots are mailed, earlier than 29 days before elections.

title: Background checks.
summary: Requires Medical and Osteopathic boards to fingerprint all license applicants and submit them to DOJ for criminal history checks.

title: Disadvantaged communities: farmworker communities.
summary: Requires CalEPA to assess and report on designating farmworker communities as disadvantaged for environmental investment, and to develop an engagement strategy.

title: County employees’ retirement: cost-of-living adjustments.
summary: Allows Sonoma County's board of supervisors to annually authorize retiree cost-of-living adjustments after specified steps including identifying recipients and funding source.

title: Foster youth: disaster aid assistance.
summary: Creates a state child welfare disaster response program and account, funded upon appropriation, to aid foster youth and caregivers during declared emergencies.

title: Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS): Department of Pesticide Regulation.
summary: Requires the state pesticide department to flag PFAS-containing pesticides in reporting databases and publish and update a list of registered PFAS pesticides.

title: Product safety: proofs of purchase: intentionally added bisphenols.
summary: Bans paper proofs of purchase containing intentionally added bisphenols, starting 2028 for BPA and 2029 for all bisphenols, with state penalties.

title: Driving under the influence: alcohol sales.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice
summary: Requires alcohol sellers to verify ID and lets courts bar DUI offenders from buying alcohol, with sellers refusing service to them.

title: Personal Income Tax Law: Corporation Tax Law: credits: cleanup costs.
summary: Creates a 2027–2031 income and corporate tax credit for 30% of encampment, dumping, and abandoned-property cleanup costs, capped at $20,000 yearly.

title: Emergency medical services.
summary: Extends sunset dates to 2037 for county EMS fund provisions, including pediatric trauma center funding.

title: Office of the Inspector General, High-Speed Rail.
summary: Renames the high-speed rail inspector general's office, lets it set pay and contract for services, and exempts contracts under $1 million from state oversight.

title: Customer service chatbots.
topics: AI and technology; Consumer protection and business
summary: Requires large businesses to offer human customer service agents, limit hold times, and disclose chatbots, with public prosecutors able to enforce penalties.

title: State employment: state bargaining units.
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Approves state bargaining unit agreements, conditions funded provisions on specific appropriation, and adds Units 8 and 18 to fallback budget appropriations.

title: Elections: notice.
summary: Requires county elections officials to add notice and record-update steps when postal data shows a voter's mailing address is invalid, with state reimbursement for mandated costs.

title: Taxation: capital gains and losses: single-family rental homes.
summary: Denies like-kind exchange tax deferral on gains from selling single-family rentals for owners of 50 or more such properties.

title: Disposition of controlled substances.
summary: Lets law enforcement send held controlled substances to the Department of Justice for disposal and requires DOJ disposal guidance, both subject to appropriation.

title: Vehicles: off-highway motor vehicle safety.
summary: Creates an off-highway vehicle safety course and operator card, required for riders aged 16 and older starting July 2029.

title: Vehicles: bicycles.
summary: Extends existing bicycle seat-riding requirements and related infraction to bicycles operated on Class I bikeways.

title: Firearms: unsafe handguns.
summary: Lets county probation officers use unsafe handguns as service weapons after firearm-portion training, with quarterly qualification and expanded storage-crime coverage.

title: Veterans.
summary: Upon appropriation, requires the Veterans Affairs department to fund a study of nonnarcotic PTSD treatments and report findings by 2030.

title: Household hazardous waste: reporting.
summary: Changes household hazardous waste collection reporting to calendar-year data and shifts report submission from DTSC to CalRecycle.

title: Food insecurity survey.
summary: Requires the Department of Social Services to conduct and publish an annual statewide survey of food insecurity, starting by July 2028.

title: Public employees’ retirement: administration.
summary: Raises per-meeting compensation for pension board members in state, teacher, and county retirement systems from $100 to $320.

title: Elections.
topics: Elections and voting; Taxes and budget
summary: Sets a 28-day certification delay for certain November 2025 local elections and appropriates $100,000 for a Secretary of State cost report.

title: Personal Income Tax Law: deductions: homeowners’ insurance premiums.
summary: Creates a state income tax deduction for homeowners' insurance premiums on a primary residence for taxable years 2026 through 2030.

title: Planning and Zoning Law: postentitlement phase permits: Housing Accountability Act.
summary: Limits local and state plan check reviews to two, shortens appeal deadlines, and restricts post-approval inspection changes for building permits.

title: Electrified security fences.
summary: Extends indefinitely the state authorization for electrified security fences and bars cities from prohibiting them, including charter cities.

title: Planning and zoning: regional housing needs allocation and annual report: student housing quarters.
summary: Counts certain student housing quarters toward local RHNA targets and requires annual reports on them, with a state-mandate reimbursement waiver.

title: Public Lands Protection Act.
summary: Subjects federal lands transferred to private or nonfederal owners to conservation zoning and bars inconsistent rezoning or development without a full EIR.

title: Sacramento Regional Transit District: board compensation.
summary: Raises Sacramento Regional Transit board member pay to $200 per noticed meeting, capped at three meetings per month, with state mandate reimbursement provisions.

title: Interscholastic athletics: youth sports: coaches: behavioral and mental health training.
summary: Requires mental health and behavioral training for high school coaches and directs the state to develop or identify a model training for youth sports coaches.

title: Public employment: disqualifications.
summary: Expands the list of disqualifications for peace officers to include out-of-state or federal officers who engage in immigration enforcement.

title: Child protection: safe surrender.
summary: Extends California's safe-surrender law, which shields parents from abandonment prosecution, from infants 72 hours old to those 30 days old or younger.

title: Dental coverage.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Requires insurers to pay noncontracting dental providers directly under assignments of benefits, limits upfront charges, and adds disclosures and certification duties.

title: Developmental services.
summary: Lets the Department of Developmental Services make small direct care purchases for its facilities, allows a separate family teaching home rate model, and removes obsolete reports.

title: Meet and confer: observation.
summary: Allows higher education union representatives to invite bargaining unit members to observe meet-and-confer sessions remotely, without release time or pay absent agreement.

title: Elementary education: kindergarten.
summary: Requires children turning 6 in the 2028-2031 school years to complete one year of kindergarten before first grade, with state mandate reimbursement.

title: Trespass.
summary: Replaces notarization of trespass assistance requests with a signed declaration under penalty of perjury, and lets law enforcement rely on it.

title: Taxation: private detention facilities.
summary: Imposes a 25% annual tax on private detention facility operators' gross income, deposited in a fund for immigration-related services.

title: Child health and safety: “Have a Heart, Be a Star, Help Our Kids” license plate program.
summary: Creates a legacy license plate shape option and raises Have a Heart plate fees, directing revenue to child health and safety programs.

title: Pit dewatering: prohibition.
summary: Prohibits pit dewatering in surface mines where subsurface river flow or groundwater lies shallower than 50 feet.

title: Cerritos Community College District: data sharing.
summary: Authorizes Cerritos Community College District to develop a student data prototype and share personal student information with partner schools for course enrollment, with consent requirements.

title: Physicians and surgeons: medical records.
summary: Makes physicians responsible for their patient notes and bars anyone else from altering them, except as specified.

title: County veterans service officers: additional resources.
summary: Provides a stipend, upon appropriation, to counties hosting active military bases to keep a county veterans service officer at each base.

title: California Drowning Prevention and Rescue Act.
summary: Clarifies CPR instructions for drowning 911 calls, requires CPR public education review, and directs a lifeguard workforce report, with license plate funds usable upon appropriation.

title: Health.
