summary: Conforms Medi-Cal to federal H.R. 1 eligibility changes and extends full-scope state-funded benefits to certain immigrants without satisfactory status.

title: California Restaurant Reservation AntiPiracy Act.
summary: Prohibits reselling restaurant reservations for more than the amount paid, with civil penalties enforced by the Attorney General, local attorneys, and harmed individuals.

title: Postsecondary education: segments: tribal colleges and universities.
summary: Adds tribal colleges and universities operated by Indian tribal governments in California to the state's public higher education segments.

title: Wildfires: contamination standards.
summary: Requires DTSC and the Air Resources Board to create wildfire lead, asbestos, and indoor air contamination testing, remediation, and guidance rules by 2028-2029.

title: Child support.
summary: Requires all child support payments go to the State Disbursement Unit and deems support orders applications for Title IV-D enforcement services.

title: Pupils: use of smartphones: prohibition: report.
summary: Requires schools to prohibit smartphone use for transitional kindergarten through grade 8, adds a 504 plan exception, and requires a state report.

title: Corrections: Humanizing and Uniting Generations Safely Act of 2026.
summary: Requires corrections visitation rules to weigh physical contact and bars the department from unreasonably restricting nonsexual contact during visits.

title: Juvenile facilities: visitation.
summary: Requires juvenile facilities to allow consensual physical contact during visits, limiting restrictions to documented significant safety concerns.

title: Juveniles: transfer to criminal court: criminal procedure.
summary: Codifies existing case law barring use of a minor's transfer-hearing statements or probation-report statements against the minor in later proceedings.

title: Public health: California Epilepsy Program
summary: Requires the state health department to create a California Epilepsy Program to track epilepsy incidence and prevalence, publish reports, and list services for affected individuals.

title: Medi-Cal: monthly maintenance amount: personal and incidental needs.
summary: Raises the Medi-Cal personal and incidental needs allowance for institutionalized patients from $35 to $50 monthly, with annual increases, subject to federal approval.

title: Skilled nursing facilities: reimbursement rates.
summary: Extends the skilled nursing quality assurance fee and Medi-Cal long-term care reimbursement program by one year, to December 31, 2027.

title: Rental vehicles: law enforcement.
summary: Requires privately owned rental vehicles used by law enforcement for detentions or transport to display a temporary decal showing the agency name and logo.

title: State Bar of California: artificial intelligence.
summary: Requires the State Bar to disclose its use of AI-generated content in bar exams and on study material covers, starting in 2028.

title: State agencies: regulations and legislation: nondisclosure agreements.
summary: Bars state agency officers from entering or requesting nondisclosure agreements on proposed regulations or legislation, and voids such agreements made after the effective date.

title: Pupil instruction: health framework: heat illness.
summary: Requires the curriculum commission to consider adding heat illness prevention and response content to the state health framework during its next revision.

title: Vehicles: commercial driver’s licenses.
summary: Requires DMV to verify lawful U.S. presence before issuing or renewing commercial driver's licenses and to revoke licenses held by people later found unlawfully present.

title: CalWORKs: temporary absence: immigration detention.
summary: Keeps CalWORKs aid for children or family members detained in federal immigration facilities, treating them as temporarily absent, starting 2027 or once systems allow.

title: Human trafficking case continuances.
summary: In human trafficking cases, courts must give great weight to a prosecutor's conflicting trial or hearing when deciding continuances, capped at one 10-day continuance.

title: Domestic violence: restraining orders.
summary: Bars courts from requiring advance notice to the restrained party, or an explanation for lacking notice, before accepting or deciding ex parte domestic violence restraining orders.

title: Local Agency Public Construction Act: change orders: County of Los Angeles: County of Santa Clara.
summary: Makes Los Angeles and Santa Clara counties' expanded change-order cap authority permanent by removing the 2027 repeal date and the 7-contract and review-report requirements.

title: Juvenile court school pupils: joint transition planning policy: courses of study.
summary: Requires school districts and charter schools to assign transition liaisons for juvenile court pupils and speeds up transcript transfers for certain students.

title: Public resources trailer bill.
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Public resources trailer bill adjusting fire training fee authority, hazardous waste fee deadlines, and Hazardous Substances Tax Law provisions.

title: Public guardians and public administrators.
summary: Lets public administrators reach decedent property not held in the decedent's sole name, and lets courts sanction institutions that fail to comply.

title: Oil and gas: low-production wells: Baldwin Hills Conservancy: Equitable Community Repair and Reinvestment Account: health impacts.
summary: Directs up to $5 million from oil well penalty account to cash assistance for nearby Los Angeles households with respiratory or reproductive health impacts.

title: Misdemeanor diversion.
summary: Requires courts and prosecutors to report diversion-dismissed misdemeanors to DMV, which would assess violation points on driver records.

title: Western Joshua Tree Conservation Act: removal: trimming.
summary: Lets property owners' agents file Joshua tree removal permit requests, drops the attestation requirement, and allows tribal memoranda to cover sale and purchase of trees.

title: Elections: law enforcement investigations of election records or voting technology.
summary: Requires local elections officials to notify the Secretary of State and Attorney General within one day of any warrant, subpoena, or investigation involving election records or voting technology.

title: School athletics: coaches: youth athletics behavioral and mental health training.
summary: Requires high school coaches to complete recurring mental health training starting in 2027-28, and adds mental health to state coaching education components.

title: Forest management: biomass innovation parks: wood products.
summary: Creates a Biomass Innovation Parks Act and grants and financing program to identify and develop facilities converting California wood waste into carbon-beneficial products.

title: Serious felonies: furnishing fentanyl to a minor.
summary: Adds knowingly furnishing fentanyl or fentanyl analogs to a minor to the list of serious felonies, triggering enhanced penalties.

title: Property tax: welfare exemption.
summary: Extends the property tax welfare exemption for certain natural resource and open-space land until the 2032 lien date.

title: Student health: medical leaves of absence: mental health.
summary: Requires colleges to adopt policies allowing voluntary medical leaves of absence for students, including for mental health, without formal withdrawal, starting 2027-28.

title: Higher education budget trailer bill.
summary: Higher education trailer bill: raises the Transfer Cal Grant age cap to 30 for 2027-28 through 2031-32, extends attorney loan repayment to borrowers, moves CSU reporting, repeals a $49.7M appropriation, and revises community college student housing financing.

title: Medi-Cal: dental care.
summary: Requires extra Medi-Cal dental payments and covers behavior management services for patients needing additional support, subject to federal approval.

title: Rural medical services grant program.
summary: Creates a conditional grant program, funded by future appropriation, for medical services to rural residents, capped at $3 million annually.

title: Medi-Cal: Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly: rates.
summary: Requires the state to notify PACE organizations of proposed capitation rates 60 days before federal submission and respond in writing to their feedback.

title: County fish and wildlife propagation fund: wildlife coexistence: tear gas.
topics: Environment and energy; Guns and weapons
summary: Allows wolf aversive-conditioning permittees to use projectile tear gas weapons with sheriff or police authorization, and lets county wildlife funds pay for coexistence programs.

title: Food Affordability Act.
summary: Creates a state grant program and fund to expand healthy food access in food deserts, and requires local housing approvals to protect grocery store site capacity.

title: Corporation Tax Law: tax expenditures: No Tax Breaks for ICE Contractors Act of 2026.
summary: Denies Corporation Tax Law credits to taxpayers contracting with DHS from 2027 to 2031 and directs the added revenue to a fund for immigration services.

title: Mental health services: assisted outpatient treatment: involuntary medication.
summary: Lets counties petition courts to order involuntary psychotropic medication for people with serious mental disorders, with trial rights and first-responder transport.

title: Public utilities: electrical and gas corporations: return on equity.
summary: Caps utilities' authorized return on equity at 400 basis points above federal long-term debt rates and requires studies for rate-change proposals.

title: Claremontclair Authority: Metro A Line Extension project.
summary: Creates the Claremontclair Authority to build and later hand off the light rail extension from Claremont to Montclair.

title: Local pop-up small business program.
summary: Allows cities and counties to permit pop-up small businesses to operate up to 120 days in eligible commercial spaces without full permanent-occupancy compliance, and brings approved limited food preparation under the food facility definition.

title: Public Resources.
summary: Creates a budget-funded electric vehicle purchase incentive program and exempts the Western Climate Initiative from certain state contracting rules.

title: California FAIR Plan Association.
summary: Requires the FAIR Plan to fix examination-identified violations and sets civil penalties of up to $10,000 to $20,000 for violations.

title: Victim’s and witness’ rights.
summary: Requires prosecutors to give CDCR victims' and next of kin's contact information at sentencing for state prison cases, where reasonably available.

title: Health care coverage: scalp cooling.
summary: Requires large group health plans and Medi-Cal to cover scalp cooling to reduce chemotherapy-induced hair loss, subject to federal approval.

title: Workers’ compensation: prepaid cards.
summary: Extends indefinitely the authorization for employers to deposit workers' compensation disability indemnity payments into prepaid card accounts.

title: Common interest developments: cooling systems.
summary: Voids HOA and deed provisions that restrict cooling systems in common interest developments, and makes association violations unlawful with damages.

title: Driving privilege: points.
summary: Adds 3 driver's license violation points for gross vehicular manslaughter while intoxicated and grossly negligent, and extends DMV disclosure of related records, operative 2031.

title: Vehicles: driving under the influence: felonies.
summary: Makes repeat drunk driving offenses with one or two prior DUI convictions within 10 years punishable as either a misdemeanor or a felony.

title: Driver’s licenses: revocation.
summary: Requires DMV to revoke driving privileges for repeat drunk drivers who cause injury, with a 72-month reinstatement bar starting 2031.

title: Child abuse or neglect: reporting.
summary: Requires county welfare agencies to notify parent and child attorneys when abuse in out-of-home placements is substantiated or a child is removed for abuse or neglect.

title: Juvenile courts: temporary probate guardianship.
summary: Lets juvenile courts end or change temporary probate guardianships at any hearing without further notice when specified conditions, including the minor's best interests, are met.

title: Transportation budget trailer bill.
summary: Transportation trailer bill reserving $30 million in state funds for construction careers, raising an SR-710 account cap, and extending transit penalty suspensions.

title: Personal Income Tax Law: young child tax credit.
topics: Children and families; Taxes and budget
summary: Expands the young child tax credit by raising the qualifying child age limit annually through 2037, then to under 18.

title: Marine resources: copper-based antifouling paint: standards, studies, and best methods.
summary: Requires state regulators to reevaluate copper-based boat paint by 2029, study harbor copper pollution, and post best methods to address it.

title: Energy.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to the provision naming the Warren-Alquist State Energy Resources Conservation and Development Act.

title: Accelerated retailer building plan approval: tenant improvements.
summary: Creates a streamlined permit process for retailer tenant improvements using licensed certifiers, with audits, liability, and a 20-day approval deadline.

title: California Career Technical Education Incentive Grant Program: renewal grants.
summary: Revises the career technical education grant program by removing the award cap and requiring renewal grants for at least three more years.

title: Smoke-free state-subsidized multiunit housing developments.
summary: Prohibits tobacco smoking in state-subsidized multiunit housing developments with certificates of occupancy issued on or after January 1, 2027.

title: Emergency services and care: nurse-midwives.
summary: Removes the requirement for physician supervision of licensed nurse-midwives in labor and delivery, obstetric triage, and emergency obstetric units under certain conditions.

title: Employment contracts: stay-or-pay provisions: contract date.
summary: Delays the stay-or-pay contract ban to 2027 and adds exceptions for retention bonuses, advanced PTO repayments, and certain broker-dealer and insurance affiliation contracts.

title: Personal Income Tax Law: Corporation Tax Law: credits: food handler card.
summary: Creates a temporary tax credit for employers who pay for employees to obtain food handler cards, for 2026 through 2028.

title: Good Fire Act: Prescribed Fire Liability Pilot Program: burn bosses: California Environmental Quality Act.
summary: Makes the prescribed fire liability program permanent, widens who can receive claim coverage, and lets burn bosses approve burn plans without state review.

title: Elections: precinct maps.
summary: Requires county registrars to provide free digital maps of effective precinct boundaries to any member of the public upon request.

title: Governor’s Reorganization Plan No. 1 of 2025: codification.
summary: Codifies statutory changes reflecting Governor's Reorganization Plan No. 1 of 2025 and appropriates $300,000 to HCD for translation contracts.

title: e-Safety Commission: youth online protection.
summary: Creates an e-Safety Commission to develop minimum age compliance guidelines, review age verification technology, and investigate noncompliance for online platforms.

title: Recall and resentencing: school shootings.
summary: Bars juvenile life-without-parole prisoners convicted of school shootings from petitioning for sentence recall and resentencing.

title: State park system: admission: veterans and military personnel.
summary: Expands state park free and discount access for veterans and military personnel, including a 15% discount pass for eligible service members.

title: Osteopathic physicians and surgeons: unauthorized practice: unauthorized use of titles.
summary: Adds osteopathic manipulative treatment to unlicensed-practice exclusions and makes unlicensed use of D.O. or 'doctor of osteopathy' a misdemeanor starting 2028.

title: Greenhouse gases: embodied carbon building materials.
summary: Requires CARB to assess whether low-embodied-carbon building materials are cost effective, and delays embodied carbon rules for 5-10 years if not.

title: Pornographic internet websites.
summary: Requires pornographic websites to take reasonable steps to keep depicted individuals out of uploaded content, and requires uploaders to certify criteria under penalty of perjury.

title: California Interscholastic Federation: flag football pilot program.
summary: Requires the California Interscholastic Federation to run a five-year flag football pilot for high school boys in Orange and Riverside counties.

title: Electricians: certification application, examination, and renewal.
summary: Lets electricians who fail the certification exam immediately reapply to retake it, and shifts electrician certification from the Labor Division to the CSLB if funded.

title: Homeless Housing, Assistance, and Prevention program: round 8: smaller jurisdictions.
summary: Sets rules for round 8 of the homelessness HHAP grant program, letting regions pass funds to smaller jurisdictions that run qualifying programs.

title: Covered platforms: age restriction: e-Safety Advisory Commission.
topics: AI and technology; Children and families; Government and administration
summary: Prohibits addictive features for users under 16 on covered platforms and creates an e-Safety Advisory Commission within the Department of Justice.

title: Labor.
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Appropriates $3.018 billion from the General Fund to supplement state employee pension contributions and removes the workers' compensation director from the standard salary structure.

title: Permit Streamlining Act: housing development projects: conformity with ordinances and standards.
summary: Deems housing projects consistent with local and other agencies' standards when substantial evidence supports it, and declares the change a statewide concern.

title: Fairs: funding.
summary: Redirects Fair and Exposition Fund money to capital outlay for fair safety, code-compliance and maintenance projects, with allocation deadlines and a reserve allowance.

title: City of Santa Fe Springs: sale of water utility property.
summary: Authorizes the City of Santa Fe Springs, through 2031, to sell its water utility to consolidate with another public water system, subject to protest rights.

title: Public postsecondary education: students with disabilities: verification: academic accommodations.
summary: Requires public colleges to accept existing school or regional center disability plans as verification and bars requiring new diagnostic evaluations for accommodations.

title: Personal income tax: credit: first-time homebuyer program: required repairs.
summary: Creates a personal income tax credit for 40% of required repairs when selling to first-time homebuyers, capped at $25,000, for 2028-2032.

title: Public utilities: reporting.
summary: Requires utilities to report large taxpayer funding to the PUC, imposes penalties for noncompliance, and passes financial benefits to ratepayers.

title: California Victim Compensation Board: tuition reimbursement.
summary: Allows the Victim Compensation Board to reimburse up to $10,000 in tuition for student victims of sexual assault or violence.

title: Medi-Cal dental reimbursement: house/extended care facility call.
summary: Requires Medi-Cal to raise reimbursement for dental house and extended care facility calls to cover travel costs, subject to appropriation.

title: Teacher credentialing: professional preparation.
summary: Makes only nonsubstantive wording changes to a provision requiring teacher professional preparation courses at public colleges.

title: Gaming: work permits: suspension.
summary: Allows gambling work permit suspension hearings to occur more than 30 days after service, if both parties mutually agree.

title: State government.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Raises boxing and wrestling commission fees, revises the learning lab program, and changes Food and Agriculture Fund administrative cost-sharing limits.

title: Ticket sellers.
summary: Caps resale ticket prices at 10% above face value, bars hidden mandatory fees, and requires original purchase prices to be printed on tickets.

title: Pupil safety: comprehensive school safety plans.
summary: Requires the Education Commissioner to study and recommend changes to school safety plan development and approval, reporting by July 2028.

title: California Endangered Species Act: take prohibition: self-defense.
summary: Exempts people from endangered-species take penalties when using necessary force against a listed species threatening immediate harm, requiring notice to Fish and Wildlife.

title: Driver’s licenses: revocation.
summary: Clarifies that the three-year driving privilege reinstatement period after a manslaughter-related revocation runs from the DMV revocation date, not the conviction date.

title: Court operations.
summary: Requires the Judicial Council to report every three years on superior court compliance with deadlines for sending conviction abstracts to the DMV.

title: Residential buildings: oil well disclosures: methane mitigation systems.
summary: Requires landlords and sellers near oil wells in two census tracts to disclose well hazards and install methane monitoring and alarm systems.

title: Natural disasters: catastrophe savings accounts: personal income tax.
summary: Creates tax-advantaged catastrophe savings accounts with an income tax deduction and interest exclusion for disaster expenses from 2027 to 2031.

title: Crimes: theft of DNA.
summary: Makes willful sale or transfer of genetic data without consent a misdemeanor and requires law enforcement to report DNA theft cases to the Attorney General.

title: Community colleges: common course numbering system: career technical education public safety courses.
summary: Requires community colleges to plan a common course numbering system for career technical education public safety courses, with implementation contingent on funding.

title: State employment: telework programs.
summary: Replaces 'telecommuting' with 'telework' in state law, requires a telework cost dashboard, and mandates decennial agency telework program evaluations.

title: Health.
summary: Lets Medi-Cal deny or terminate provider enrollment over risky affiliations, broadens fraud-related suspension grounds, and removes some moratorium exceptions.

title: Community colleges: external resolution services for civil rights compliance: managing entity and civil rights coordinator.
summary: Creates a contracted external service to handle civil rights complaints and nondiscrimination policy for community colleges, requires district coordinators, and appropriates $100 million.

title: Office of Farm to Fork: Healthy Food for California Public Institutions Program.
summary: Creates a program, subject to appropriation, to identify California vendors and approved lists for public institutions buying healthy, climate-smart food.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: exemption: affordable housing projects: public university or public college housing projects.
summary: Extends a CEQA exemption for affordable housing to 2037 and adds public university and college housing projects to it.

title: License and registration renewal: continuing education.
summary: Recasts veterinary license renewal rules so both self-study and pro bono spay or neuter services can satisfy continuing education requirements.

title: Count Hunger Act.
summary: Creates a two-year pilot to fund and publish food insecurity survey data for low-income households through the California Health Interview Survey, contingent on appropriation.

title: Park property: City of Cathedral City.
summary: Expresses legislative intent to later authorize Cathedral City to convert part of grant-funded park land to a fire station, with replacement park land required.

title: Political Reform Act of 1974: lobbyist employers: fictitious appearances.
summary: Extends the Political Reform Act's ban on fictitious appearances and fake communications to lobbyist employers, not just lobbyists and lobbying firms.

title: Postrelease community supervision.
summary: Requires state corrections to give county probation earlier written notice of release dates and care manager contacts, and to coordinate reentry plans.

title: State Housing Law: remote inspections.
summary: Requires cities and counties to offer remote inspections for certain one- and two-family dwelling permit work, and bars local opt-outs from the statewide rule.

title: Crimes: sexual exploitation: clergy.
summary: Makes clergy providing therapeutic services who have sexual contact with current or former patients, clients, or congregants guilty of a crime.

title: Courts.
summary: Extends until 2032 the authority for remote court appearances, witness remote testimony, and remote criminal and juvenile proceedings, and narrows when courts may require in-person appearance.

title: Coastal resources: local coastal program: coastal development permits: City of Santa Monica.
summary: Requires Santa Monica to submit a complete local coastal program by 2029, sets Coastal Commission review deadlines, and streamlines coastal amendments for road conversions to bike, transit, or pedestrian use.

title: Sexual battery.
summary: Makes sexual battery committed after entering a dwelling or inhabited building without consent punishable as a felony, not only a misdemeanor.

title: Civil actions: service of summons: commercial buildings.
summary: Allows substituted service of civil summons on commercial building tenants by leaving documents with access-control staff when direct service is blocked.

title: Firearms.
summary: Makes DOJ firearm trace pattern data available on request to California local and state agencies and public and private universities.

title: Environmental advertising: sunscreen.
summary: Bans sunscreen marketing as "reef safe" or similar unless the product is free of chemical UV filters; violations are misdemeanors.

title: Motor Vehicle Fuel Tax Law: suspension of tax.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Taxes and budget
summary: Suspends the motor vehicle fuel tax for one year, requires pass-through of savings to consumers, and transfers General Fund money to the fuel account.

title: CalWORKs: childcare request forms.
summary: Requires CalWORKs applicants and recipients to be told about paid childcare, adds childcare request forms, and sets a 10-day county decision deadline.

title: Crimes involving vehicles.
summary: Makes intoxicated vehicular manslaughter punishable only as a felony, removing the misdemeanor option.

title: License suspension and revocation.
summary: Lengthens mandatory license suspensions and revocations for DUI convictions, including a new 1-year suspension for any DUI conviction and permanent revocation for repeat offenders.

title: Interfering with wildfire suppression and emergency responses with drone.
summary: Prohibits operating drones to knowingly or recklessly interfere with wildfire suppression and emergency responses, with civil enforcement and penalties.

title: Developmental services: community placement plans and community resource development plans.
summary: Renames the community placement plan as a community resource development plan and appropriates $1.5 million in federal funds for early intervention.

title: School employees: absences due to illness or accident.
summary: Requires school employees who exhaust sick leave and remain absent for illness or accident to receive full salary for five months, instead of 50%.

title: Missing Middle Townhome Ownership Act.
summary: Allows ministerial, no-hearing approval of townhome developments and subdivision maps that meet objective standards, easing ownership housing construction.

title: Eminent domain: appraisals.
summary: Requires public entities making eminent domain purchase offers to pay owners' independent appraisal costs up to $8,000.

title: Protective orders: firearms and ammunition: notice and procedures.
summary: Requires restrained persons under firearm-related protective orders to relinquish ammunition as well as firearms, and adds remote-appearance and electronic-filing provisions starting 2028.

title: State general obligation bonds: requirements.
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Requires future state general obligation bond acts and the issuing board to report objectives, project details, and timeliness of spending.

title: CalWORKS.
summary: Removes CalWORKs work-hour and AFDC requirements for child deprivation based on unemployment, using income limits instead, operative later, with state-mandate reimbursement provisions.

title: Off-highway vehicle recreation: City of Needles.
summary: Extends Needles' off-highway vehicle pilot allowing combined-use highway links beyond the 3-mile limit until 2033.

title: Energy: nuclear facilities.
summary: Exempts nuclear microreactors from state restrictions on certifying nuclear powerplants and on nuclear land-use permissions.

title: Sellers of travel.
summary: Raises the maximum annual assessment sellers of travel pay to fund the Travel Consumer Restitution Corporation's operations, to $60 and then $70 in 2031.

title: Prisons: classification.
summary: Requires CDCR to contract an independent study reassessing the prison security classification system, with a report due by 2030.

title: Taxation.
summary: Extends sales and use tax to digital products, limits business tax credits from 2027, and reduces LLC and partnership annual taxes from 2027 to 2030.

title: Dentistry.
summary: Revises dental licensing rules, including removing a patient-injury insurance requirement and changing reexamination and licensure-without-exam criteria.

title: Electricity: calculation methodology: nonbypassable charges: data disclosure.
summary: Requires the PUC and utilities to disclose data underlying nonbypassable electricity charge calculations to load-serving entities and ratepayer advocates.

title: Public employment: retirement benefits.
summary: Authorizes the City of Indio to provide postretirement health contributions for employees hired after 2025 under a collectively bargained agreement.

title: Pupil attendance: excused absences: religious observance.
summary: Requires schools to excuse pupils for religious holiday or ceremony observance without parental written request or principal approval.

title: Elections: voter registration.
summary: Allows the Secretary of State to obtain Social Security death data and requires using it to cancel registrations of deceased voters.

title: Vehicles: fee waivers for disabled veterans.
summary: Raises the unladen weight limit for commercial vehicles eligible for disabled veteran fee exemptions from under 8,001 to under 10,000 pounds.

title: Health curriculum framework: human trafficking and online safety.
summary: Requires the health curriculum framework to consider human trafficking and online safety content for K-12, and the Department of Education to publish related resources.

title: Department of Consumer Affairs: public members of boards: conflicts of interest.
summary: Expands the conflict-of-interest bar for public members of Department of Consumer Affairs boards to cover parents and children, and requires boards to adopt related guidance regulations.

title: Transactions and use taxes: Counties of Contra Costa and Los Angeles.
summary: Authorizes Los Angeles and Contra Costa counties to levy temporary local sales taxes above the 2% cap, subject to voter approval.

title: Student transfer: tribal colleges.
summary: Requires CSU and community college districts to develop transfer agreement and articulation programs for students attending California tribal colleges, and to assess transfer tools.

title: Medi-Cal: Fair Share from Big Corporations Act.
summary: Directs state agencies to develop options and a premium program charging large corporations for employees' Medi-Cal costs, and appropriates $10,000.

title: Arbitration: health care service plans: Lindalee’s Law.
summary: Requires the Attorney General to oversee health plans' compliance with rules on binding arbitration and to notify the Department of Managed Health Care of corrective actions.

title: State Housing Law: apartment houses.
summary: Bars state and local requirements that apartment houses have a resident manager, orders a report on that requirement by 2029, and sunsets in 2031.

title: Fish and wildlife: invasive species: invasive mussels.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Environment and energy
summary: Creates a statewide inspection and decontamination program for boats to prevent invasive mussel spread, with licensed stations and a drying period before launch.

title: Pharmacy benefit managers.
summary: Requires the state to publish a public website listing licensed pharmacy benefit managers, and makes a technical fix to a Medi-Cal inmate provision.

title: Electrical corporations: wildfire mitigation plans: expenditures.
summary: Requires a one-time independent audit of utility wildfire mitigation spending from 2021 to 2027, with recurring audits before future ratepayer-funded recovery requests.

title: Veterans.
summary: Expands veteran licensing expedites to executive-order discharges and creates veteran housing and discharge-upgrade grant programs.

title: Cartwright Act: violations.
summary: Prohibits monopolization and monopsonization under the Cartwright Act, limits enforcement to the Attorney General or district attorneys, and requires proof of substantial market power.

title: Air pollution: indirect sources.
summary: Authorizes the state Air Resources Board to adopt regulations reducing emissions from indirect sources of air pollution when needed to meet air quality standards.

title: Controlled substances: testosterone.
summary: Would automatically reschedule or exempt testosterone under state controlled substances law if federal law reclassifies it to a less restrictive schedule.

title: Alcoholism and drug abuse recovery and treatment programs: inducement of participants.
summary: Bans inducements like stipends and gift cards for substance treatment recruitment, adds transportation conditions and reporting, and requires certified sober housing if discounted housing is offered.

title: Public resources trailer bill.
summary: Creates a contingent farmland acquisition grant program funded by Proposition 4, and adds $60 million for beverage container litter and recycling grants in 2026-27.

title: Beverage containers: redemption payments: exemption.
summary: Exempts beverage distributors from redemption payments on filled containers they donate to California nonprofits, public schools, or first responders.

title: Federal Home Loan Banks.
summary: Protects Federal Home Loan Bank collateral claims against insurers by barring stays on enforcement and limiting insolvency receivers' power to void related transfers.

title: Incarcerated persons: mental health evaluations.
summary: Requires mandated parole treatment for certain prisoners with severe mental disorders when three of five criteria are met, and broadens physical harm.

title: Vehicle miles traveled: local tax and state fund prohibition.
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Prohibits state funding for and local taxes based on vehicle miles traveled, voiding inconsistent local programs; tolls remain allowed.

title: Postsecondary education: nondiscrimination: pregnancy or pregnancy-related issues.
summary: Expands campus nondiscrimination protections to cover pregnancy, marital and familial status, and more characteristics, and requires accommodations and a designated coordinator.

title: California Uniform Controlled Substances Act: online retailer.
summary: Extends California's pseudoephedrine sales limits and related crime to online retailers, and waives state reimbursement for the added local mandate.

title: Public contracts: best value construction contracting for counties, cities, and the San Gabriel Valley Council of Governments.
summary: Extends best value construction contracting to cities and SGVCOG, lowers the threshold to $500,000, and extends the program to 2032.

title: Electrical corporations: rates: smart meter infrastructure: dynamic rate option.
summary: Requires large electrical utilities to offer dynamic rate options after smart meter upgrades and sets cost-recovery conditions for those upgrades.

title: Political Reform Act of 1974: travel expenditures.
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Requires nonprofits that host elected officials' travel to disclose each travel payment and the person it was made for, and keep records five years.

title: Political Reform Act of 1974: candidate trainings.
summary: Requires candidates and committee treasurers to complete Political Reform Act training, or face a ban on receiving contributions, starting in 2029.

title: Housing.
summary: Reorganizes housing agency references, conditions affordable housing awards on local fee waivers, and revises homelessness program reallocation and reporting rules.

title: Corporations Tax Law: water’s-edge election: global intangible low-taxed income.
summary: Requires water's-edge filers to include affiliated corporations' income and factors, ends those elections after 2027, and raises corporate taxes.

title: State Air Resources Board: South Coast Air Quality Management District: regulations: prohibition: costs.
summary: Bars the state air board and South Coast air district from adopting rules that raise gasoline, home, or building costs beyond set thresholds.

title: Pupil instruction: health framework: sexual health.
summary: Requires the Instructional Quality Commission to consider adding sexual health content on dating abuse and digital violence to the state health framework.

title: Cash payments: calculation.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice
summary: Requires merchants to round cash transaction totals to the nearest 5 cents, bars overcharging, and makes violations subject to existing overcharging penalties, operative July 1, 2027.

title: Pharmacy: enteral nutrition supplements or replacements.
summary: Authorizes pharmacists, manufacturers, and wholesalers to deliver enteral nutrition supplements directly to patients' residences under prescriber orders.

title: Smoke Damage Recovery Act.
summary: Creates a presumption that wildfire smoke damage is wildfire-caused and imposes insurer deadlines and coverage duties for smoke damage claims; orders an insurance gap study.

title: Licensed Professional Interior Designer Practice Act.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Labor and employment
summary: Creates state licensure for professional interior designers under the Architects Board, with a new board seat, civil penalties, and a fee-funded fund.

title: Pupil instruction: Open Enrollment Act.
summary: Removes the low-achieving school limit from the Open Enrollment Act and recasts it to allow inter-district transfer applications more generally.

title: Genetic testing for life and disability insurance.
topics: AI and technology; Consumer protection and business
summary: Bans life and disability insurers from using genetic tests or information for coverage decisions and prohibits use or disclosure of full genomes.

title: Integrated health care service plan investment disclosures.
summary: Declares legislative intent to later require public disclosure of material investment holdings by nonprofit integrated health plans.

title: California Secure Borders Act of 2025.
summary: Repeals California limits on sharing immigrant release information and transfers to ICE, bars state-funded services for undocumented immigrants, and requires impact reporting.

title: Taxation trailer bill.
summary: Taxation trailer bill extending the CalCompetes credit to 2035, conforming to federal 530A child savings accounts, and raising manufactured home property tax postponement funding.

title: Portable electronics and optical products insurance.
summary: Extends the portable electronics insurance agent license framework to optical products vendors, who may then sell insurance tied to their products.

title: Public agencies: approval: detention facilities.
summary: Requires public notice, document access, and public meetings before local agencies approve private facilities to detain immigrants, and applies these rules to charter cities.

title: Land use: mitigation lands: endowments.
summary: Makes mitigation land endowment rules permanent and requires Fish and Wildlife to post periodic public status reports on those endowments.

title: Employment: sexual harassment training and education: anti-hate speech training.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Labor and employment
summary: Adds anti-hate speech training to employers' mandatory sexual harassment training starting January 1, 2028.

title: State parks: parks passes: libraries.
summary: Authorizes State Parks to work with the State Library and library systems to provide park passes, and declares a policy of equitable access to state parks.

title: Emergency services: State 911 Advisory Board.
summary: Renames the 911 advisory board, gives Department of Technology oversight of the 911 office, and requires Next Generation 911 reports and a state audit.

title: Department of Justice.
summary: Requires the state prosecutor to investigate fatal shootings of unarmed civilians by immigration enforcement officers, allows prosecution, and requires public posting of reports.

title: Immigration enforcement: use of state-owned property.
summary: Prohibits using state-owned property for immigration enforcement, and requires signage, documentation, and Attorney General notification.

title: Western Joshua Tree Conservation Act: industrial projects and commercial projects: single-family residences: public works projects.
summary: Allows some western Joshua tree removal without mitigation for homeowners and public works, with fees, and lets cities handle commercial and industrial permits.

title: Public contracts: school and community college districts.
summary: Extends school and community college job order contracting authority to 2037, bars it where it raises project costs, and removes some planning and price-comparison requirements.

title: Education governance: State Board of Education: Superintendent of Public Instruction: Education Commissioner: State Department of Education: transfer of duties.
summary: Restructures state education governance by replacing the Superintendent as Director of Education with a Governor-appointed Education Commissioner and transferring duties and employees.

title: Firearms: dealer centralized list.
summary: Requires DOJ to remove noncompliant firearm dealers from its list, levy fines, and inspect top-recovery dealer locations yearly.

title: Health professionals.
summary: Expands health workforce data collection by boards, including inpatient and outpatient hours and sliding fee scales, and shares it monthly; also redefines health professional shortage areas.

title: Solid waste: compostable products.
summary: Bans selling plastic products labeled compostable from 2027, repeals ASTM and compostable bag labeling rules, and exempts non-plastic fiber products.

title: Electricity: customer renewable energy subscription program.
summary: Revises the customer renewable energy subscription program to boost low-income participation and add bill credits, while capping generator size, total capacity, and enrollment.

title: Peace officer training: driving under the influence.
summary: Requires peace officers assigned to traffic enforcement to complete DUI detection and sobriety-testing training, with reimbursement for any state-mandated local costs.

title: Factory-built housing: building standards and local requirements.
summary: Bars cities and counties from enforcing local building standards for factory-built housing that differ from the state code, with limited exceptions for local conditions.

title: Probation: duration.
summary: Allows courts to extend probation by one additional year for sex offenders who have not successfully completed probation and need more programming.

title: Mobilehome parks: termination of tenancy: failure to comply with a rule or regulation.
summary: Requires mobilehome park management to give detailed written notice of alleged rule violations and places the burden of proving violations on management.

title: California State University: employer-employee relations: meeting and conferring.
summary: Assigns the Public Employment Relations Board to decide whether CSU bargaining memoranda need legislative funding or action, and to notify the parties in writing.

title: Automated external defibrillators.
summary: Requires senior centers to have automated external defibrillators, with training and maintenance standards, and limits liability for employees and volunteers using them.

title: November 3, 2026, statewide general election: ballot measures.
summary: Sets the numbering of five specified measures on the November 2026 ballot as Propositions 1 through 5.

title: Electric vehicle charging stations: permit fees.
summary: Caps local permit fees for level 2 EV chargers at multifamily housing at estimated reasonable cost, with statutory maximums, until 2036.

title: California Public Records Act: agency response time.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Extends the time agencies have to respond to Public Records Act requests from 10 to 10 business days, and extensions to 14 business days.

title: School facilities: project priorities: extreme heat and climate change.
summary: Allows the State Allocation Board to prioritize school facility projects that respond efficiently to extreme heat and climate change, applying to applications after 2027.

title: State government: State Government Strategic Planning and Performance and Review Act: strategic plans: equity.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Requires state agencies to advance racial equity in strategic plans and conduct racial equity analyses before budgets or regulations take effect.

title: Indian children: guardianship or conservatorship proceedings.
summary: Adds ICWA-aligned inquiry, notice, placement preference, and expert witness requirements to guardianship and conservatorship proceedings involving Indian children.

title: Health care: state hospitals.
summary: Requires parole exit plans for prisoners with severe mental illness to include Medi-Cal applications and behavioral health referrals, and adds factors for substantial-danger determinations.

title: Cannabis: recall, embargo, and destruction of cannabis and cannabis products.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice
summary: Revises cannabis misbranding and adulteration standards, adds licensee notice and informal-conference rights before recalls, and makes product destruction optional.

title: Small claims court: jurisdiction.
summary: Raises the small claims jurisdiction limit to $15,000 for specified actions and allows up to three small claims filings per calendar year.

title: County recorder: county clerks: bonds.
summary: Moves registrant and notary bond filings from county recorders to county clerks starting 2028, with new retention and fee rules.

title: Community colleges: CalWORKs Recipients Education Program: services.
summary: Expands the CalWORKs community college education program to fund direct basic-needs aid, shifts its goal to economic mobility, and lets programs waive the employer workstudy wage share.

title: Budget Act of 2025.
summary: Expresses legislative intent to enact future statutory changes relating to the Budget Act of 2025.

title: Ignition interlock devices.
summary: Recasts DUI penalties, allowing indefinite license suspension for alcohol-related violations and requiring ignition interlock devices for restricted licenses, beginning 2031.

title: California State University: executive compensation: restrictions.
summary: Requires CSU trustees to replace their November 2025 executive compensation policy and bars raises for top executives in years with tuition increases or no represented-staff raises.

title: 2-1-1 information and referral response system.
summary: Creates a 2-1-1 Fund to finance California's 2-1-1 community information and referral network, subject to legislative appropriation.

title: Consumer Driving Data Protection Act of 2026.
topics: AI and technology; Consumer protection and business
summary: Lets consumers opt into telematics for auto insurance rating, limits telematics data use, and adds consent, privacy, and discount restrictions for insurers.

title: Subdivisions: tentative and final map: exceptions.
summary: Extends the Subdivision Map Act exception so mixed-use zoned land can file a parcel map instead of a tentative and final map.

title: State of emergency: Governor’s powers and termination.
summary: Limits Governor's emergency powers to executive power and requires state emergencies to end automatically after 90 days unless the Legislature extends them.

title: California State Nonprofit Security Grant Program.
summary: Establishes a state grant program for nonprofit security enhancements, extending eligibility to security for events hosted by nonprofits, with a $25,000 cap on offsite event security.

title: Video imaging of parking violations.
summary: Extends San Francisco and transit-operator video enforcement of transit-lane parking violations to 2034, adds warnings and reporting, and restricts use of the footage.

title: Public contracts: local agencies: responsive bidders.
summary: Requires public works contractors to disclose wage and hour violation histories when bidding on local agency projects, allowing disqualification for noncompliance.

title: Privacy: driver’s license information.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive changes to existing rules limiting businesses and organ procurement organizations from scanning and retaining driver's license data.

title: State government.
summary: States legislative intent to develop vehicle license fee shortfall solutions for counties and cities; the corporate fraud fund provision is truncated.

title: Political Reform Act of 1974: prediction market contracts.
summary: Bans specified officials, employees and lobbyists from trading prediction market contracts using material nonpublic information, making violations a misdemeanor.

title: State holidays: Native American Day.
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Makes Native American Day, the fourth Friday in September, a paid state holiday for state employees, subject to appropriation.

title: California Mortgage Relief Act.
summary: Requires mortgage servicers to offer extended forbearance, with no late fees, to borrowers whose homes are uninhabitable after a federally declared disaster.

title: Communicable diseases: hepatitis C.
summary: Bars health plans and insurers from requiring prior authorization for medically necessary hepatitis C direct-acting antiviral drugs.

title: Judges’ Retirement System II: beneficiaries.
summary: Lets judges retiring from 2027 name any beneficiary for retirement payment plans and removes the 20-year service requirement for survivor allowances.

title: Student safety: human trafficking.
summary: Requires college employee human trafficking training, campus crime records on trafficking, and law enforcement agreements covering trafficking investigations.

title: Dependency: placement of child with relative.
summary: Requires courts and social workers to assess relatives seeking placement of dependent children and to state reasons for delayed or denied relative placements.

title: Mortgage forbearance: state of emergency: wildfire.
summary: Extends wildfire mortgage forbearance to 24 months, adds servicer deferral options and late-fee protections, and sets a 2029 request deadline.

title: California Seed Law: annual registration fee: Seed Advisory Board.
summary: Raises the annual seed registration fee from $40 to $100 and lets the secretary raise it further, up to $300.

title: Decarbonized gaseous fuels.
summary: Requires the Air Resources Board to assess future needs for decarbonized gaseous fuels by 2029 and post the assessment publicly.

title: Budget Act of 2025.
summary: Expresses legislative intent to enact future statutory changes relating to the Budget Act of 2025.

title: Real estate: wholesaling.
summary: Requires a real estate license for wholesaling property contracts and mandates written disclosures that wholesalers do not hold title.

title: Pupil health: social-emotional, behavioral, and mental health supports.
summary: Requires the state to contract lead agencies to help schools implement universal social-emotional, behavioral health, and restorative practices, contingent on appropriation.

title: Kern Medical Education Authority.
topics: Government and administration; Health care; Labor and employment
summary: Lets CSU Bakersfield and the Kern Community College District create a Kern County medical school through a new local authority if UC stalls.

title: Voter information guide: candidate statements.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice
summary: Limits candidate statements in voter guides to personal qualifications, bans external links and certain content, and adds a perjury-backed declaration.

title: Legally protected health care activities.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Health care
summary: Extends California's abortion and health care shield protections to apply regardless of patient location, bars arrests on declined extraditions, and extends out-of-state legal process limits to financial services firms.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: exemption: passenger rail service.
summary: Expands the CEQA exemption for passenger rail projects by dropping the zero-emission requirement and allowing new daily service parallel to highways.

title: Age verification signals: software applications.
topics: AI and technology; Children and families
summary: Expands age-signal requirements for operating systems and app stores to more devices, and bars requesting age signals unless legally required.

title: Unlawfully restrictive covenants: grocery stores and supermarkets.
summary: Voids private deed covenants that bar grocery store use on former grocery sites and bars new such covenants starting 2027.

title: California State University: Joint Associate’s Degree Pilot Program.
summary: Creates a contingent CSU pilot letting former students who completed associate-equivalent coursework receive a jointly conferred associate degree at no cost, with a 2032 report.

title: Public works.
summary: Requires public works awarding bodies to give labor-management committee representatives job site access to monitor prevailing wage compliance, with civil penalties for willful denial.

title: Income taxes: film tax credits.
summary: Extends film tax credit carryforwards to 15 years, raises the refundable share for credit 4.0 to 95%, and exempts sold credits from the business credit limit.

title: School facilities: design-build: alternative design-build: county superintendents of schools.
summary: Lets county superintendents of schools procure design-build and alternative design-build contracts for school facility public works, under the same rules as districts.

title: Special education: public complaint database.
summary: Requires the state Department of Education to create and publish an annual online database of special education complaints by district, county office, or charter school.

title: Health care districts: transfers of assets.
summary: Bars public entities and health care districts from giving private parties control over how taxpayer funds are spent, and declares the rule applies to charter cities.

title: Fire protection districts: fees: 911 telephone calls.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Prohibits fire protection districts from charging the public fees for 911 calls or emergency responder responses, with exceptions.

title: Gene synthesis equipment manufacturers and providers.
Text message advertisements.
summary: Bars text message advertisements from being sent between 9 p.m. and 9 a.m., even to consenting recipients, and adds private and public enforcement.

title: California Disaster Assistance Act: minimum damages thresholds.
summary: Directs the state to prioritize disaster aid for local agencies ineligible for federal funding due to damage thresholds, and specifies allowable local cost-share costs.

title: Driving under the influence: alcoholic beverages.
summary: Requires a lifetime alcohol purchase ban for individuals sentenced to prison for a third DUI within 10 years, with a DMV-designated ID enabling sales refusal.

title: Health facilities: cardiac surgery.
summary: Requires the state health department to update hospital cardiac surgery staffing rules to reflect current standards of care by 2030.

title: Real Estate Investment Trusts: management duties.
summary: Lets lodging employees submit evidence to the Labor Commissioner that a REIT operates a lodging facility, and requires a written response forwarded to the Franchise Tax Board.

title: Employment.
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Expands public-employee union access to in-person new-hire orientations, makes that access permanent, and lets state benefit plans use reserve accounts.

title: Private Attorneys General Act: penalties: reduction.
summary: Caps PAGA penalties for employers that cure violations and creates a presumption of reasonable steps when specified compliance is documented and certified.

title: Pupil instruction: dual enrollment: College and Career Access Pathways partnerships.
summary: Relaxes dual enrollment rules for high schoolers in community college partnerships by dropping the principal recommendation, the four-course limit, and changing outcome reporting.

title: False reporting.
summary: Makes repeat false emergency reports and harassing 911 calls punishable as misdemeanors or felonies, and extends cost liability to property damage.

title: County of Ventura: fire suppression: backup energy source.
summary: Lets Ventura County water suppliers use mobile backup power with a 90-minute response, requiring notice to emergency services if slower.

title: Vehicles: driver’s license suspension and revocation.
summary: Delays license reinstatement and court-ordered suspension start for certain convicted drivers until after custody release, adding three years for specified manslaughter convictions.

title: Dissolution of marriage.
summary: Lets courts reduce or waive the six-month waiting period for marriage dissolution on good cause if all material issues are resolved.

title: Health care coverage: nondiscrimination.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Health care
summary: Bans health plans and insurers from discriminating on the basis of race, sex, gender identity and other protected traits in enrollment and coverage.

title: Domestic violence: protective orders.
summary: Makes repeat or felony-linked violations of domestic violence protective orders felonies and requires courts to weigh alleged injury in bail decisions.

title: Data collection: race and ethnicity.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Requires state agencies collecting race and ethnicity data to use detailed categories, publish data, report compliance, and protect personal information from federal sharing.

title: Substance use: treatment or residential data reporting.
summary: Requires licensed substance use treatment facilities and certified programs to report treatment, outcome, and availability data to the state from 2028, excluding personal information.

title: Budget Act of 2025.
summary: Expresses legislative intent to enact future statutory changes relating to the Budget Act of 2025.

title: PINK Alert.
summary: Creates a Pink Alert system letting people report pregnant persons needing shelter or emergency prenatal services via text notification.

title: California Indian Freedom Act of 2026.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Environment and energy
summary: Bars state agencies from substantially burdening Native religious practice on state lands and requires tribal consent before physical changes to sacred sites.

title: Safe Delivery Fund Pilot Program.
summary: Creates a pilot program funding geographically isolated hospitals' standby costs to keep delivery and obstetric services available through 2030.

title: Workplace surveillance tools.
topics: AI and technology; Civil rights and liberties
summary: Prohibits employers from using AI workplace surveillance tools that collect neural data or detect emotional state, with civil penalties up to $500 per violation.

title: Interscholastic athletics: drug testing: suspensions: nicotine use.
summary: Authorizes school districts to adopt athletic drug testing, including nicotine testing, and bars suspension solely for a positive test result.

title: Public contracts: retention proceeds.
summary: Limits state agencies' withholding of retention payments on public works contracts, repealing the older escrow provisions and sunsetting in 2032.

title: Wards: probation.
summary: Applies the 12-month probation limit to wards placed out of home and lets courts extend probation without imposing new conditions.

title: Prescription drug coverage for rare diseases.
summary: Requires health plans and insurers to decide prior authorization within 30 days for certain rare-disease drugs, starting January 1, 2027.

title: California Safe Homes grant program: contractors.
summary: Requires Safe Homes wildfire mitigation contractors to meet wage, apprenticeship-workforce, and licensing requirements, with standardized selection procedures by 2027.

title: Protective orders.
summary: Extends domestic violence and battery protective orders to last one year past release from state prison or county jail, if longer.

title: Budget Act of 2025.
summary: Expresses legislative intent to enact future statutory changes relating to the Budget Act of 2025.

title: County of Napa: farmworker housing: funding.
summary: Doubles annual matching funds for Napa County farmworker housing to $500,000, operative only if the Legislature appropriates funds.

title: Forestry: Beneficial Fire Capacity Program.
summary: Requires the Forestry department to direct at least 10% of eligible grant funding to community-led prescribed and beneficial fire programs, with 25% going to tribes.

title: Common interest developments: associations.
summary: Adjusts Davis-Stirling HOA rules on utility-repair responsibility, electronic ballot notice timing, and acclamation candidate notice deadlines.

title: Wildfire prevention: local assistance grant program: eligible activities.
summary: Expands eligible activities under the wildfire prevention local assistance grant program to include helicopter-accessible firefighting water supply projects.

title: Fish and wildlife: invasive mussels: imported water.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Bars public agencies from blocking imported water for groundwater replenishment over invasive mussels if a control plan is followed.

title: Surplus Land Act: exemptions: land unsuitable for housing.
summary: Broadens the Surplus Land Act exemption to cover public land unsuitable for housing due to slope instability or seismic hazards.

title: Public employment: disqualifications.
summary: Bars people who previously did immigration enforcement from becoming peace officers starting 2028 and adds background and disclosure requirements.

title: Mentally disordered offenders: criteria for commitment.
summary: Requires psychiatrists to consider a prisoner's violence history tied to mental illness when judging danger for state hospital treatment, and allows hearings in the commitment county.

title: Workplace artificial intelligence tools.
topics: AI and technology; Civil rights and liberties
summary: Requires employers to notify workers when workplace AI tools are used for employment decisions or surveillance, maintain a tool list, and face penalties for violations.

title: Office of Youth Homelessness Prevention.
summary: Creates an Office of Youth Homelessness Prevention to set goals, publish a dashboard, and report on progress toward ending youth homelessness.

title: Education expenses: Education Choice and Parental Empowerment Act of 2025.
summary: Creates education savings accounts funded by the General Fund so eligible families can pay for private school and other education expenses.

title: Early care and education.
summary: Adjusts California state preschool reimbursement, staff training rules, and enrollment priorities, adding a final priority to enroll eligible children by income ranking.

title: Guaranteed Health Care for All.
summary: Creates CalCare, a universal single-payer health coverage program for all California residents, governed by a nine-member board.

title: Children’s diapers: intentionally added ingredients: disclosure.
summary: Requires children's diaper makers to publish a web-based list of intentionally added ingredients with CAS numbers and functions, with penalties for noncompliance.

title: Secure youth treatment facilities.
summary: Requires youths in secure treatment facilities deemed dangerous to remain confined through proceedings, speeds trials, and extends continued detention procedures.

title: Construction defects.
summary: Revises construction defect claim rules, allows builder repair-for-release deals, and bars insurers from treating certain repair costs as voluntary payments starting 2027.

title: Teachers: credentialed educator apprenticeship programs.
summary: Creates a partnership to oversee credentialed educator apprenticeship programs and lets uncredentialed employed candidates in approved programs receive certificates or permits.

title: Juveniles: custodial interrogation.
summary: Bars undercover officers and their agents from seeking statements from in-custody people under 26 who were 17 or younger at offense; courts weigh willful violations.

title: Health care coverage: home test kits.
summary: Requires insurers and Medi-Cal to cover cervical cancer screening, including FDA-cleared self-collected home test kits, without cost sharing starting 2027.

title: California Health Benefit Exchange.
summary: Lets Covered California auto-enroll people in plans upon receipt of a complete SWS application and revises enrollment notice and timing rules.

title: Settlement agreements: victims’ compensation funding.
summary: Allows courts to enforce certain settlements of tort claims against local public entities that are eligible for victims' compensation funds, and takes effect immediately.

title: Off-highway vehicle: emergency response situation.
summary: Allows first responders to drive off-highway vehicles on highways for emergency response or official departmental duties.

title: 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games.
topics: Government and administration; Guns and weapons; Housing
summary: Creates temporary exemptions for 2028 Olympic and Paralympic events from boxing licensing, minor firearm possession ban, and local building amendments.

title: Public health: pelvic floor health advisement.
summary: Requires the state health department to post website information advising patients to discuss pelvic floor concerns at postpartum visits.

title: Advertising: environmental marketing claims: carbon credits.
summary: Creates a temporary presumption that carbon-credit environmental marketing claims are valid when disclosure rules and approved carbon-crediting programs are met.

title: Deer: archery season: concealed firearms.
summary: Repeals the ban on hunters carrying firearms during deer archery season, allowing them to carry guns while bow hunting.

title: Licensure: emergency equipment.
summary: Allows law enforcement emergency equipment to be operated under a class C license by personnel who complete a state-approved training program.

title: General plan elements: childcare.
summary: Requires cities and counties to adopt a childcare plan, or integrate one into their general plan, by 2033, including charter cities.

title: Accelerated restaurant equipment permitting approval: retail food safety.
summary: Creates a streamlined 10-business-day permit process, using contractor certification, for like-for-like restaurant equipment installations, and exempts them from CEQA.

title: Courts: court interpreters.
summary: Extends the trial court interpreter employment and labor relations act to sign language interpreters and defines spoken language to include American Sign Language.

title: Criminal procedure: information.
summary: Requires prosecutors to seek court leave before reinstating felony charges dismissed at preliminary hearing and limits defendant review timing.

title: Human trafficking: body art practitioners.
summary: Requires body art facilities to post human trafficking notices and train employees and practitioners by July 2027, with an updated training curriculum option.

title: Santa Cruz Metropolitan Transit District: transactions and use tax: qualified voter initiative.
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Lets Santa Cruz transit district transactions and use taxes be placed on the ballot by voter initiative, consolidated with statewide elections.

title: Energy: transmission infrastructure accelerator: financing.
summary: Lets California's infrastructure bank hold closed sessions on transmission financing plans and confidential data, and adds contractor certification for eligible projects.

title: Community colleges: California College Promise: fee waiver eligibility.
summary: Bill stops certificates earned in an associate-degree course sequence from making a student ineligible for the California College Promise fee waiver.

title: Digital games: ordinary use.
summary: Requires digital game operators to notify buyers and provide alternatives or refunds when they end services needed to play purchased games.

title: Restraint of incarcerated persons.
summary: Prohibits mechanical restraints on incarcerated persons and juveniles admitted to hospitals while receiving advanced medical services, with narrow exceptions.

title: Local ballot measures: County of Fresno.
summary: Requires certified Fresno County initiative petitions from before July 8, 2026 to go to voters unaltered at the November 2026 general election.

title: Statewide homelessness prevention strategy.
summary: Requires the California Interagency Council on Homelessness to develop a statewide homelessness prevention strategy by 2028 and keep it updated.

title: State permanent disability certification program: feasibility study.
summary: Requires a California HHS Agency feasibility study on a state permanent disability certification program, reported by July 2028, with repeal in 2032.

title: Residential construction costs: regulation.
summary: Requires state review of residential construction cost drivers, proposes lowering building standards costs by 2031, and requires DHCD approval for cost-increasing regulations.

title: Bail Consumer Protection Act.
summary: Creates crimes for falsely posing as a licensed bail agent to solicit bail, and for hiring such impersonators.

title: Sex equity: sexual harassment complaints.
summary: Requires college grievance procedures for sexual harassment complaints to let each party bring a support person and an advisor of their choice.

title: Health care coverage: investments: disclosure.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Requires nonprofit health plans in Covered California to annually disclose material investment holdings, publicly posted, with penalties for noncompliance.

title: Public resources: Greenhouse Gas Reduction Fund: programs.
summary: Reallocates Greenhouse Gas Reduction Fund priorities, adds interest income to the fund, and shifts funding toward housing and state operations.

title: Abortion or gender-affirming health care services: subpoenas, discovery requests, or other requests for information.
summary: Requires California entities receiving subpoenas or information requests about abortion or gender-affirming care to notify the Attorney General and delay producing records for 7 business days.

title: Insurance: home protection companies.
summary: Creates a limited lines license for home protection contract agents, adds consumer disclosures and utility-bill fee collection, and requires insurance backing for contracts.

title: Department of Social Services: C.R.I.S.E.S. Grant Pilot Program 2.0.
summary: Reestablishes the C.R.I.S.E.S. Grant Pilot Program through 2032, funding community-based organizations for crisis response, subject to appropriations.

title: Land surveyors: records of survey.
summary: Revises county surveyor review and filing procedures for land survey records and corner records, and removes the county engineer's role.

title: State Fire Marshal: home hardening certification program implementation plan.
summary: Directs the Fire Marshal's advisory committee to plan a voluntary home hardening certification program for wildfire-resistant renovations, with a program to follow by 2029.

title: Cemetery broker: application for license.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive change to the form and filing requirements for cemetery broker license applications.

title: Insurance Commissioner qualifications.
summary: Adds a requirement that the Insurance Commissioner have at least five years of senior or supervisory insurance experience within 10 years before election.

title: Discrimination: business establishments.
topics: Children and families; Civil rights and liberties
summary: Clarifies that the Unruh Civil Rights Act bars discrimination by early childcare and education providers, including licensed and family, friend, and neighbor care.

title: Coastal recreation: designated state surfing reserves.
summary: Creates a process for local governments to apply for state surfing reserve designations of coastline areas, with possible later revocation.

title: Professional fiduciaries: corporate practice.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Labor and employment
summary: Authorizes professional fiduciaries to form professional corporations from 2029, with registration, fees, and expanded licensee reporting and discipline.

title: Transportation.
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget; Transportation
summary: Bars Los Angeles-size cities from cutting cemetery-access street lanes without approvals, expands CHP security for officials' families, and raises CHP appropriation.

title: Unlawful practices: discrimination: menopause.
summary: Expands anti-discrimination protections by defining sex to include menopause-related conditions under FEHA and the Unruh Act, and updates the employment rights poster.

title: Organized metal theft.
summary: Creates a crime of organized metal theft, punishable as a misdemeanor or felony, and bars state reimbursement for local costs.

title: Electric bicycles: registration and special license plates.
summary: Requires class 2 and class 3 electric bicycles to be registered with DMV and display a state-issued special license plate, with violations as infractions.

title: Pupil safety: notifications: firearms.
summary: Requires schools to send parents a Secure Firearm Storage Notification and directs the state to post model notice language and drill-related resources.

title: Zero-emission transit buses: axle weight.
summary: Temporarily allows higher axle weight limits, up to 25,000 pounds, for zero-emission transit buses procured through solicitations issued 2027-2031.

title: Municipal utility districts: prepay option: termination of service.
summary: Lets municipal utility districts offer electronic delinquency notices and, for smaller districts, a residential electricity prepay option with conditions.

title: Reporting mechanism: child sexual abuse material.
topics: AI and technology; Children and families; Criminal justice
summary: Expands the social media CSAM reporting duties, adds platform liability and civil penalties to a depicted-individual damages scheme, and removes the 4-month knowledge threshold.

title: Surplus land.

title: Firearms: concealed carry licenses.

title: Medi-Cal: acupuncture treatments.

title: Income taxes: exclusions: wildfire loss mitigation payments.
summary: Extends and broadens the income tax exclusion for wildfire mitigation grants and rebates through 2030, adding reporting requirements.

title: Civil actions: mediation.
summary: Lets the LA Superior Court send any civil case to mediation regardless of the $75,000 cap, with three hours of free mediation, until 2032.

title: Civil actions: filing fees: refunds.
summary: Extends court filing-fee nonpayment notice and administrative-charge rules to card and electronic payments, and replaces attorney sanctions for unpaid e-filing fees with refunds to providers.

title: Dentistry: dental hygienists: licensure.

title: Short-term rentals: emergencies and special events.

title: Municipal golf courses: reservations.

summary: Bars third-party golf reservation resellers from selling tee times at city-owned courses without operator authorization, applying to charter cities too.

title: Crimes: firearm enhancements.

title: Suicide prevention.

title: Mortgages: foreclosure.
summary: Revises foreclosure trustee-sale rules for eligible tenant and community bidders, redefines eligible bidders, and lets those parties seek civil penalties.

title: Criminal procedure: discrimination.

title: Juvenile justice.

title: School Energy Efficiency Stimulus Program.

title: Wildfire Prevention Grants Program: wildfire mitigation validation.

title: Civil actions: protective orders: workplace violence.
summary: Lets employers seek workplace violence restraining orders covering all employees at a workplace without naming each employee, and requires Judicial Council forms by 2028.

title: California Indigent Defense Commission.

title: Hiring of real property: portable screening reports: disclosure of application materials.

title: State Fire Marshal: home hardening.

title: Cannabis: testing: quality assurance.

title: Sentencing enhancements: crimes against undocumented individuals.

title: Juveniles.
