title: Juveniles: transfer to court of criminal jurisdiction: offense.
summary: Allows prosecutors to transfer juveniles to criminal court for conspiracy to commit mass murder or attacks on schools or places of worship.

title: California Community Schools Partnership Program: Promise Neighborhoods.
summary: Appropriates $1 billion for the California Community Schools Partnership Program and expands allowable uses of retained funds to include Promise Neighborhood network leads.

title: Budget Act of 2025.
summary: Expresses legislative intent to enact future statutory changes relating to the Budget Act of 2025, with no specific provisions stated.

title: Health care coverage: mental health or substance use disorders.

title: Property tax: exclusion from reassessment: home hardening retrofitting improvements.

title: Water right permits and licenses: annual fee: exemption.

title: Abortion: authorized procedures.

title: Firearms: voluntary firearm storage program.
summary: Authorizes local police to run a voluntary temporary firearm storage program and exempts those transfers from carry prohibitions and dealer transfer rules.

title: Electrical corporations: distribution grid utilization metric.
summary: Requires the PUC to develop a grid utilization metric and standard for large electric utilities, with public reporting and optional incentives encouraging electrification.

title: Streets and highways: pedestrian and bicycle facilities.

summary: Limits local reconsideration and cancellation of pedestrian and bike safety projects, eases traffic-calming petitions, and exempts pedestrian malls from CEQA.

title: Notaries public.
summary: Adds a notary reappointment exam, allows electronic signatures, sets a $100 seal vendor permit fee, and requires review of online notary course proposals.

title: California Equal Shared Parenting Act.

title: Health care services: artificial intelligence.

title: Budget Act of 2025.
summary: Expresses legislative intent to enact future statutory changes relating to the Budget Act of 2025.

title: Labor: apprenticeship: Equal Representation in Construction Apprenticeships Grant Program.

title: Continuing care retirement communities: repayable contracts.

title: Student health: athletic coaches and trainers: mental health training.

title: Residential property insurance: home hardening.
summary: Requires insurers, on request, to give a premium quote for a home certified as hardened as well as one for its current state.

title: Department-managed lands: wildlife areas: hunting.

title: Companion chatbots: crisis interruption pauses.

title: Budget Act of 2025.
summary: Expresses legislative intent to enact future statutory changes relating to the Budget Act of 2025.

title: Pharmacy Law: advertising certain compounded medications used for obesity or weight management.

summary: Adds rules for compounded GLP-1 obesity drugs, including bulk ingredient quality, recordkeeping, inspections, fines, and truthful-advertising requirements.

title: Alcoholic beverages: market research study: taste testing.

title: Labor Code Private Attorneys General Act of 2004: notice and cure: filing fees.

title: State Fire Marshal: lithium battery working group: membership: funding.

title: Homelessness: People First Housing Act of 2025.

title: Budget Act of 2025.

title: Housing developments: urban lot split: owner-occupancy.

summary: Authorizes daycare centers in state office buildings, with priority for licensed childcare providers, subject to available funds and building codes.

title: Local educational agencies: planning and reporting requirements: template: repealer.

title: Budget Act of 2025.
summary: Expresses legislative intent to enact future statutory changes relating to the Budget Act of 2025.

summary: Lets the state housing department authorize transfers of residual receipts or excess reserves between rental housing developments under the same owner.

title: California Consumer Privacy Act of 2018: whistleblower complaints.
summary: Creates a whistleblower award program for reporting CCPA privacy violations, funded by collected fines and attorney fee penalties.

summary: Expresses legislative intent to enact future statutory changes relating to the Budget Act of 2025, with no specific provisions.

title: Wildfire Mitigation Aging and Disability Grant Pilot Program.
summary: Creates a pilot program, subject to appropriation, giving grants to seniors and disabled homeowners for wildfire mitigation on their properties.

summary: Extends insurer renewal duties after total losses to 36 months and bars cancellation or nonrenewal near wildfire perimeters for two years after an emergency declaration.

summary: Requires the Secretary of State to identify postal areas where election-day mail may be postmarked late and requires notice to affected voters.

title: Malpractice actions: architects, engineers, or surveyors.

title: Expanded Learning Opportunities Program: offering access: unduplicated pupils.
summary: Requires school districts to prioritize expanded learning program access for low-income, English learner, and foster youth students.

title: Diversion: retail theft.
summary: Requires prosecutors and probation to screen certain theft defendants for diversion, and courts to dismiss charges after successful completion.

title: California bar examination.
summary: Requires the State Bar's examining committee to replace the California bar exam with the Uniform Bar Examination starting January 1, 2029.

title: Budget Act of 2025.
summary: Expresses legislative intent to enact future statutory changes relating to the Budget Act of 2025.

title: Workforce Housing Enhanced Infrastructure Financing Act.

summary: Creates a financing district option letting cities and counties fund workforce housing and infrastructure through tax division and voter-approved bonds, with affordability covenants.

title: Electricity: transmission planning and transmission facilities.
summary: Requires state agencies to update transmission planning documents by 2028 and extends resource and demand projections from 15 to 20 years.

title: Greenhouse gases: soil carbon sequestration.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Environment and energy
summary: Requires a Natural Resources Agency strategy by 2028 linking waste diversion and soil health, including on-farm compost incentives, and adds a soil carbon expert to an advisory committee.

title: Aviation: unmanned aircraft systems: ticketed entertainment events and amusement parks.

title: Public postsecondary education: nonresident tuition fee exemption: educational asylum program.

title: California Native Americans: formal apology.

title: Commercial financing.
summary: Brings commercial financing providers and brokers under California Financing Law licensing and rules starting 2028, and bars confession of judgment before default.

title: State Board of Education: Superintendent of Public Instruction: Education Commissioner.

title: Affordable Housing and High Road Jobs Act of 2022: use by right: objective standards.
summary: Prohibits local objective standards from blocking mixed-use development in streamlined by-right housing projects, and applies these changes to charter cities.

title: Criminal procedure: gender bias in sexual assault and domestic violence investigations.
summary: Establishes victims' right to unbiased sexual assault and domestic violence investigations, adds gender-bias training and DA review, and requires public education.

title: Budget Act of 2025.
summary: Expresses legislative intent to enact future statutory changes relating to the Budget Act of 2025.

title: School district employees: merit system.
summary: Extends LA Unified's authority to fill certain classified jobs outside merit rankings until 2031 and adjusts layoff retention rules.

title: Community colleges: current expense of education: exclusions.
summary: Lets community college districts exclude certain unrestricted student-support spending from the 50% classroom salary calculation during federal funding gaps through 2031.

title: Infractions: warrants and penalties.
summary: Limits arrest warrants, bench warrants and misdemeanor penalties for failure to appear or pay on infraction charges, including Vehicle Code violations.

title: Medical Debt Relief Act of 2026.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Creates a state medical debt relief program that acquires and cancels eligible debt, and requires hospitals to report outstanding debt data.

title: Electricity and natural gas: legislation imposing mandated programs and requirements: third-party review.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Creates a CCST program, subject to appropriation, to analyze bills affecting utility ratepayers and adds conflict-of-interest rules for analysts.

title: Groundwater basin adjudication: notice.
summary: Adds filing requirements for proof of mailed and posted notice in groundwater basin adjudications, and clarifies court authority to order additional notice methods.

title: Community care facilities: criminal background exemptions.
summary: Requires the state to exempt current or former foster youth with certain pre-21 convictions from disqualification when employed in peer support roles, not caregiving.

title: Accessory dwelling units: private sewage disposal systems.
summary: Bars localities from banning accessory dwelling units on septic-served lots and limits health officer septic requirements for ADUs.

title: Housing authorities: term limits and work requirements.
summary: Prohibits housing authorities from imposing term limits or work requirements on eligibility or rent subsidies, with a voluntary job-training exception.

title: State employees: compensation: firefighters.
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Requires the state to bargain in good faith with CAL FIRE firefighters toward salaries within 15% of 20 California fire departments' averages.

title: Budget Act of 2025.
summary: Expresses legislative intent to enact future statutory changes relating to the Budget Act of 2025.

title: State Athletic Commission: boxing and mixed martial arts: sponsorship contracts.
summary: Lets the State Athletic Commission sign sponsorship deals for referee and judge apparel, splitting revenue among funds, and authorizes an assistant inspector position.

title: Hospitals: seismic standards.
summary: Exempts certain freestanding extended-care hospital buildings from California's hospital seismic safety standards if they met pre-2021 requirements.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: exemption: groundwater recharge project.
summary: Exempts groundwater recharge projects that address subsidence from CEQA review, if the Natural Resources Secretary so determines.

title: Inmate release: notice to victims.
summary: Extends the advance notice victims and witnesses receive before a convicted person's release from 15 to 20 days.

title: City council members: absences without permission.
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Excludes council members' parental leave from the absence-based vacancy rule and requires cities to set up a notice process, applying statewide including charter cities.

title: Long-term health care facilities.
summary: Requires long-term care facilities to give residents 30 days' notice before involuntary transfer or discharge, with translated notices and electronic ombudsman copies.

title: Community colleges: baccalaureate degree program: Cerritos Community College District.
summary: Authorizes Cerritos Community College District to offer up to three applied baccalaureate degree programs under Board of Governors approval and monitoring.

title: Occupational safety and health: fabrication activities: slab solid surface products.
summary: Requires slab solid surface fabrication shops to obtain a state certification, with fees, workplace safety criteria, and suspension for violations.

title: Medi-Cal: enhanced care management: peer support specialists.
summary: Requires Medi-Cal enhanced care management providers to include peer support specialists and bars disqualifying them solely over criminal background checks.

title: Surplus lands: exempt surplus land: City of Ontario.
summary: Exempts certain City of Ontario surplus land from state disposal rules if proceeds go to a local housing set-aside account.

title: Budget Act of 2025.
summary: Expresses legislative intent to enact future statutory changes relating to the Budget Act of 2025.

title: Healing arts: reports: claims against licensees.
summary: Raises the minimum fine for licensed health professionals' or claimants' failure to report certain malpractice settlements or awards without liability insurance to $100.

title: Pharmacies: license discipline: stipulated settlement and disciplinary order.
summary: Allows the State Board of Pharmacy and licensees to settle license discipline cases by stipulated order before any formal agency pleading is filed.

title: School districts: community college districts: short-term employees: classified service.
summary: Creates a presumption that school and community college districts must move certain short-term positions into the classified service.

title: Invasive species: noxious weeds: online marketplaces.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Environment and energy
summary: Prohibits online marketplaces from facilitating noxious weed sales or shipments to California addresses, with administrative penalties and remediation cost recovery.

title: The California Youth Cardiac Screening Pilot Program.
summary: Creates a funded pilot for free cardiac screening of grade 5-12 pupils and requires two CPR-certified adults at certain school pool events.

title: Housing finance: barriers to downsizing: study.
summary: Requires a study on senior downsizing barriers and lets retirees transfer mortgage rates to a new home.

title: Coordinated Entry System: study.
summary: Requires the California Interagency Council on Homelessness to study the coordinated entry system's role in connecting people experiencing homelessness to housing, reporting by 2028.

title: Criminal procedure: jurisdiction of public offenses.
summary: Expands venue options for multiple sexual battery, indecent exposure, or child-molestation offenses across jurisdictions, removing the same-defendant-and-victim requirement for sexual battery.

title: Elementary and secondary education: public school employees: contractors: natural persons.
summary: Defines public school employees and contractors providing school services as natural persons for Education Code purposes.

title: Pupil achievement: closing the achievement gap: accountability report.
summary: Requires the Legislative Analyst's Office to annually report on state progress in closing pupil achievement gaps, with recommendations, if AB 2225 is enacted.

title: Budget Act of 2025.
summary: Expresses legislative intent to enact future statutory changes relating to the Budget Act of 2025.

title: Emergencies: personnel: training requirements: opioid overdose reversals.
summary: Requires employers that mandate CPR training to also require employees to complete online naloxone overdose-reversal training.

title: Civil service: disciplinary proceedings: causes for discipline: Department of Corrections and Rehabilitation employee training or diversion program.
summary: Limits state employee discipline to job-related conduct and requires CDCR to offer correctional officers a training or diversion alternative to monetary penalties.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: essential local fire station projects: infrastructure project streamlining.
summary: Allows the Governor to certify essential local fire station projects for CEQA infrastructure streamlining, with applicant-paid litigation and record costs.

title: Voter registration: residency confirmation.
summary: Repeals an obsolete version of county voter registration update and inactivation requirements, a cleanup change with no substantive effect.

title: Mortgage applicants.
summary: Prohibits selling mortgage applicants' personal information, collected during the application process, to third parties.

title: Arbitration: validity of agreements to arbitrate.
summary: Makes arbitration agreements unenforceable where they would not be enforceable under the Federal Arbitration Act.

title: Holidays: Farmworkers Day.
summary: Renames the March 31 state holiday from Cesar Chavez Day to Farmworkers Day and requires the Governor to proclaim it annually.

title: Workforce development: Displaced Oil and Gas Worker Pilot Program: extension.
summary: Removes the 2027 sunset on the Displaced Oil and Gas Worker Pilot Program, making it indefinite but subject to legislative appropriations.

title: Pupil instruction: outdoor learning.
summary: Encourages schools to integrate outdoor learning, creates state resources and a three-year pilot program, all subject to legislative appropriation.

title: Pupil discipline: cyberbullying: parent accountability.
summary: States legislative intent to future law requiring students and parents in cyberbullying cases to complete rehabilitative education or counseling.

title: Budget Act of 2025.
summary: Expresses legislative intent to enact future statutory changes relating to the Budget Act of 2025.

title: Medi-Cal: lactation services.
summary: Requires the Medi-Cal department to issue updated guidance by 2027 clarifying coverage for a continuum of lactation services, after stakeholder input.

title: Medi-Cal eligibility: work or community engagement.
summary: Revises Medi-Cal work or community engagement requirements, adding county notice and verification safeguards before denying or ending coverage.

title: Housing: county funding allocations: nonminor dependents and young adults.
summary: Extends a youth housing navigation program to young adults aged 18 to 28, prioritizes former foster and probation youth, and revises reporting.

title: Energy: Strategic Clean Energy and Critical Mineral Development Zones.
summary: Creates a state process for designating county-requested clean energy and critical mineral development zones, with priority for projects there.

title: Legally protected activities.
summary: Extends California shield protections to reproductive and gender-affirming care aid given in other states lawful there, and bars extradition for such activity.

title: Triggering event: loss of minimum essential coverage.
summary: Makes termination of medically underserved area joint coverage agreements a special enrollment trigger and requires 60-day notice to enrollees.

title: Multifamily housing development: offsite housing factories: backstop financing.
summary: Creates a state-backed credit backstop program, subject to appropriation, enabling surety bonds for offsite multifamily housing factories.

title: Property tax: documentary transfer tax: exemptions: nonprofit corporations chartered under tribal or federal law.
summary: Extends property tax and documentary transfer tax exemptions to tribal-chartered nonprofits and wholly owned tribal entities for land preservation and land return.

title: Active Transportation Program: guidelines.
summary: Revises California Active Transportation Program guidelines from 2028, adding transit-access projects, funding incentives, penalties for unused funds, and transit agency consultation.

title: Social media platforms: artificial intelligence models.
summary: Requires social media companies and AI model deployers to let users export their data and open interoperability interfaces, enforced by the Attorney General.

title: Budget Act of 2025.
summary: Expresses legislative intent to enact future statutory changes relating to the Budget Act of 2025.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: overburdened communities: notices and hearings: translations.
summary: Requires full CEQA review for industrial projects near overburdened communities and mandates translated notices and interpreted public hearings.

title: Nutrition benefits: sweetened drinks and candy.

title: Property taxation: county assessment appeals boards: assessment appeals commissioners.
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Lets large counties opt for single-member assessment appeals commissioners to hear property tax appeals, sunsetting in 2034.

title: Tribal gaming: compact ratification.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Environment and energy
summary: Ratifies a 2026 amendment to the Agua Caliente tribal gaming compact and exempts related actions from CEQA review.

title: Mobilehomes and manufactured housing: registration and titling documentation.
summary: Requires the state housing department to accept verified electronic signatures for releasing legal owners' security interests in manufactured homes by 2028.

title: Renewable electrical generation facilities: multiple meters: aggregation: logistics businesses and manufacturing businesses.
summary: Requires the PUC to ensure logistics and manufacturing businesses can aggregate meters for net energy metering, if it extends that provision.

title: Student housing: intersegmental working group.
summary: Requires the CSU chancellor to convene a student housing working group that must report recommendations to the Legislature and Governor by 2028.

title: Planning and Zoning law: open-space zoning.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive wording change to a legislative finding about open-space zoning and private property compensation.

title: Community colleges: county probation departments: instructional service agreements.
summary: Allows community colleges to offer academic and career technical courses in county juvenile justice facilities, and bars home districts from blocking outside colleges doing so.

title: Workplace violence: restraining orders.
summary: Lets parties and witnesses in workplace violence restraining order hearings appear remotely without a fee, and requires courts to accept electronic filings starting 2028.

title: Budget Act of 2025.
summary: Expresses legislative intent to enact future statutory changes relating to the Budget Act of 2025; no specific provisions.

title: Local government: Proposition 218 Omnibus Implementation Act: proportional cost of service.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Allows local governments to justify property-related fees using any reasonable cost allocation method, including tiered water and sewer rates.

title: Housing development: density bonuses: rent.

title: Energy efficiency: financing options: custom agricultural and industrial efficiency projects.
summary: Creates a ratepayer-funded industrial efficiency grant program and replaces PUC ex ante review of custom efficiency projects with a streamlined process.

title: Pest control.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to the stated purposes of pest control operation provisions.

title: Cap-and-Invest Program: nature-based climate solutions: funding.
summary: Appropriates $250 million yearly from the Greenhouse Gas Reduction Fund through 2046 for nature-based climate solutions, plus $150 million yearly to agriculture.

title: Housing: multifamily affordable housing programs.
summary: Directs state housing agencies to review and revise multifamily affordable housing program guidelines to facilitate factory-built housing by July 1, 2027.

title: Personal Income Tax Law: exclusions: reparations programs.
summary: Excludes reparations benefits or payments from state gross income for taxable years 2028 through 2032.

title: Public contracts: contracts for services.

title: Regional park and open-space districts: Midpeninsula Regional Open Space District.
summary: Authorizes the Midpeninsula Regional Open Space District general manager to approve up to $72,000 in contracts without advertising, through 2032.

title: Statewide Special Education Parent Advocacy Collaborative.
summary: Creates a state-funded parent advocacy collaborative for special education, awarding $800,000 annually for three years to a statewide advocacy grantee, contingent on appropriation.

title: Budget Act of 2025.
summary: Expresses legislative intent to enact statutory changes relating to the Budget Act of 2025.

title: High school graduation requirements: alternate pathways for individuals with exceptional needs: statewide resources.

title: Sales and use taxes: farm equipment and machinery.

title: Autonomous vehicles.

title: Medi-Cal: special commissions.

title: Child support: license suspensions.

summary: Allows DMV to waive the driving test for licensed Japan, Taiwan, and South Korea drivers under reciprocity, issuing only class C licenses.

title: School employees: solicitation: financial services or products.
summary: Restricts financial services solicitation on California school campuses to employees, banning inducements and requiring disclosures and security measures.

title: Title insurance.
summary: Revises title insurance rate filing rules, limits filings to title insurers, lets the commissioner block rates, and requires online rate posting.

title: Statutory form power of attorney.
summary: Revises the statutory form for powers of attorney, adding successor agents, conservator nominations, and digital asset options.

title: Crime.
summary: Repeals Prop 57 juvenile transfer limits and a sex offender registration exemption, and restricts placement of conditionally released sexually violent predators.

title: Medi-Cal: subacute care services.
summary: Prohibits Medi-Cal managed care plans from adding criteria or forms for subacute care authorization and reauthorization, with department sanctions for violations.

title: Controlled environment horticulture space: thermal curtains.
summary: Lets greenhouses use thermal curtains or shade cloths instead of double-paned glazing to comply with energy building standards.

title: Medi-Cal: eligibility redetermination.

title: Pupil achievement: Closing the Achievement Gap Commission.

title: Public postsecondary education: priority registration: veterans and dependents of veterans: federal GI Bill.
summary: Requires CSU and community college districts, and requests UC campuses, to give priority registration to fee-waiver students and students using federal GI Bill benefits starting in 2028-29.

title: Prisons: organized sports programming.
summary: Requires California prisons to formalize an organized sports programming policy and creates a fund to support expanded access through 2036.

title: Personal Income Tax Law: Corporation Tax Law: New Employment Credit.
summary: Extends the employment tax credit for hiring in designated areas through 2030, and moves its repeal date to 2034.

title: Teacher credentialing: community college baccalaureate degrees.
summary: Removes community college baccalaureates from the regionally accredited definition, requires reading, writing and math coursework for them to count toward teaching credentials, and bans integrated community college teacher prep programs.

title: Hunting tags: transfer: youth program.

title: Medi-Cal: cost sharing and accessibility.

title: Developmental services: caregiver succession.

title: Tribal Nation Grant Fund.

summary: Revises Tribal Nation Grant Fund distributions to tribes, adding equal-share grants of at least $600,000 per eligible tribe and specific-purpose grants.

title: Model State Trademark Law: cancellation.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to Model State Trademark Law provisions on canceling trademark registrations.

title: Craft distilled spirits manufacturers: licenses and fees.

title: Postsecondary education: sexual harassment, harassment, intimidation, and bullying policies: student training.
summary: Adds and revises definitions in the Equity in Higher Education Act, including sexual harassment and technology-facilitated harassment, starting August 2027, with state mandate reimbursement for community colleges.

title: California Healthy Food Financing Initiative.

summary: Creates a Healthy Food Financing Initiative council and fund to expand healthy food access in underserved communities.

summary: Creates a $4 billion Community Reinvestment Account in the Pooled Money Investment Account to deposit funds in banks meeting lending performance standards, with reporting.

summary: Extends to December 31, 2046 the deadlines for putting water to beneficial use and completing construction under specific State Water Project permits.

title: Sacramento-San Joaquin Delta Conservancy.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Expands the Sacramento-San Joaquin Delta Conservancy to Valley and Lake areas, renames it, adds board seats, and creates a Valley and Lake fund and program.

title: Criminal procedure: alternatives to arrest.
summary: Renames LEAD as the Alternatives to Arrest pilot, expands eligible offenses and referrals, and directs funding to Los Angeles and other jurisdictions upon appropriation.

title: Water policy: California Native American tribes.
summary: Declares state policy to address inequities toward California tribes in water matters, requires agencies to incorporate it, and mandates tribal consultation and mediation.

title: Veterans.
summary: Requires county veterans service officer vacancies filled within 12 months, mandates accreditation and training, and creates a statewide work queue, funding framework, and reports.

title: Data centers: power usage effectiveness: cost shifts.

summary: Requires data center energy reporting and PUC review to prevent utility costs from shifting onto other ratepayers.

title: School districts: auxiliary organizations.
summary: Authorizes school districts to create auxiliary organizations for supportive services and programs, requiring accounting and reporting systems for their operations.

title: Supervision of Trustees and Fundraisers for Charitable Purposes Act.

title: Personal Income Tax Law and Corporation Tax Law: credits: local news outlets: business expense deduction: excessive employee remuneration.

title: Department of Corrections and Rehabilitation: state contracts.

title: Education governance: Education Commissioner: reporting.

title: Reusable grocery bags.

title: Roman Reed Spinal Cord Injury Research Act of 1999.

title: The California State University Enrollment, Access, and Retention of Noncontinuous Students Program.
summary: Creates a CSU program to boost reenrollment of students who left before degree completion, with funding priority, transcript policy, advisors, priority registration, and a data dashboard.

title: Jury selection: acknowledgment and agreement.
summary: Revises the perjury acknowledgment and agreement forms that jurors sign before voir dire and after trial jury selection.

title: Child daycare facilities.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: hospital projects.
summary: Streamlines environmental review and judicial challenges for a Santa Clara hospital campus project that meets specified conditions.

title: Parole advancement hearings: reporting.
summary: Requires the Board of Parole Hearings to publish annual data and written summaries on requests to advance parole hearing dates, sunsetting in 2032.

title: Behavioral health treatment plans.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: geothermal exploratory projects.
summary: Expands the CEQA definition of geothermal exploratory projects to include interconnectivity equipment and activities, and specifies how the well-distance limit is measured.

title: Postsecondary education: articulation agreements.

title: Probation: term length.

title: Mobilehome Residency Law: civil action: physical improvements.

title: Health care coverage: essential health benefits.

title: Medi-Cal: private duty nursing.

title: School facilities: inclusive school playgrounds.

title: Pupil safety: sextortion informational poster.

title: Non-Ultraprocessed Certified food standard.

title: Lubricants waste: packaging: producer responsibility.

title: Pupil services: educational counseling: California College Guidance Initiative.

title: Cannabis: cannabinoids.

title: Student financial aid: Cal Grant Program: cost of attendance.

title: Early childhood education and childcare: alternative payment programs.

title: Prisons: mental health.

summary: Adjusts how objections to a judge's participation are served, requiring service during business hours at the courthouse and allowing the clerk's designee to accept it.

title: Santa Clara Valley Transportation Authority: employee housing: transit-oriented joint development projects.
summary: Authorizes the Santa Clara VTA to acquire property and build affordable rental and for-sale housing for employees and the public.

title: District agricultural associations: real property: affordable housing.
summary: Lets district agricultural associations build affordable housing on their land, allows 99-year leases, and requires 55-year deed restrictions for low-income units.

title: Emergency services: law enforcement and intelligence: state threat assessment center.
summary: Declares legislative intent for future law requiring the State Threat Assessment Center to create a privacy-respecting intelligence sharing plan.

title: Electricity: load-serving entities.
summary: Directs the PUC to consider consolidating load-serving entities' procurement plans and reliability compliance reporting by 2030.

title: State bridges and overpasses: suicide prevention.
summary: Requires the Department of Transportation to develop preapproved suicide-prevention barrier designs that local governments may optionally use on bridges and overpasses.

title: In-Home Supportive Services program.
summary: Declares legislative intent to enact future legislation on the In-Home Supportive Services program, without changing any current requirements.

title: Vehicles: liens.
summary: Raises the vehicle value threshold for DMV-authorized lien sale procedures from $4,000 to $7,000, with inflation adjustments starting in 2030.

title: Budget Act of 2025.
summary: Budget Act of 2025 making appropriations for state government support for fiscal year 2025-26, effective immediately as a Budget Bill.

title: Low-income housing tax credit: farmworker housing.
summary: Directs CTCAC to consider farmworker housing scoring changes and bars tax credits for housing used to meet H-2A requirements.

title: Immigrant benefits: loss of income: federal DHS enforcement.
summary: Creates a state program paying unemployment-style benefits to immigrants who lose income from federal DHS enforcement, funded subject to appropriation.

title: State contracting: subcontractors: prompt payment.
summary: Lets state subcontractors request invoice payment status and requires prime contractors to confirm subcontractor payments to state agencies on request.

title: Crimes: SCRIVNER Act.
summary: Requires DOJ to charge officeholders within 30 days of investigating certain sex crimes against minors, and requires prosecutors to justify declining diversion-related charges.

title: Crimes: plea deals.
summary: Requires court approval and victim notice before immunity is granted to non-defendants in minor sex trafficking, pimping, or pandering plea deals.

title: Mental health diversion.
topics: Criminal justice; Guns and weapons; Health care
summary: Tightens mental health diversion eligibility, requires victim restitution in diversion, and allows domestic violence restraining orders with firearm relinquishment.

title: Vehicles: active intelligent speed assistance devices.
summary: Creates a pilot program in seven counties requiring speed-assistance devices for drivers convicted of speeding or reckless driving offenses.

title: California State Park Stewardship Act of 2026.
summary: Creates a climate stewardship program and Wildfire Safety and Climate Stewardship Fund for state park system projects.

title: In-home supportive services: Community First Choice Option program: noncompliance penalties.
summary: Requires the state Department of Social Services to report to the Legislature by 2029 on county payments tied to CFCO reassessment noncompliance.

title: California Advanced Services Fund: Rural and Urban Regional Broadband Consortia Grant Account.
summary: Redirects California Advanced Services Fund consortia grants toward broadband deployment assistance, sets minimum base grants, and deletes the consortia audit requirement.

title: Pupil health: epinephrine delivery systems.
summary: Replaces epinephrine auto-injector references with broader 'epinephrine delivery systems' and requires schools to stock at least one FDA-approved type.

title: Vehicle liens.
summary: Clarifies that vehicle lien law does not bar licensed repossession agencies from filing liens, and lets them file liens under specified conditions.

title: Office of Elections Cybersecurity.
summary: Lets the Office of Elections Cybersecurity consult academic researchers and assess whether state funding must replace lost federal election cybersecurity resources.

title: Health facilities: emergency medical services.
summary: Allows a publicly owned hospital to operate a rural emergency stabilization unit in Del Puerto area under a waiver from hospital licensure requirements.

title: State Public Guardian.
summary: Creates a State Public Guardian position within the Department of Social Services, subject to appropriation, to support county public guardians and conservators.

title: Electric bicycles: Attorney General list.
summary: Requires the Attorney General, with biking nonprofits, to compile and post a list of noncompliant electric two-wheeled devices marketed as e-bikes by June 2027.

title: Digital Financial Asset Banking Act.
summary: Requires banks and credit unions offering digital asset custody, staking, and transaction services to meet disclosure, safety, and annual audit requirements.

title: Criminal procedure: attorney visits: medical settings.
summary: Clarifies that existing criminal and civil penalties for officers who refuse attorney visits also apply when a prisoner is in a medical setting.

title: Contractors: disciplinary action.
summary: Exempts licensed contractors from discipline for using new technologies, tools, and equipment in construction work, notwithstanding building-law violation rules.

title: Adaptive reuse: industrial zones.
summary: Narrows the bar on adaptive reuse in industrial zones, excluding only high-hazard Group H buildings, which expands streamlined review eligibility.

title: Public utilities: Public Utilities Commission: telecommunications: broadband internet access service.
summary: Requires diverse PUC appointments, recodifies PUC procedural authority, narrows the telephone line definition, and expands the utility-related crime scope.

title: Criminal procedure: Sexually transmitted disease testing.
summary: Lets courts order testing of defendants for any sexsually transmitted disease by search warrant, extends victim test-result rights to parents, guardians and legal representatives, and adds two crimes to the uncharged-offense testing provision.

title: Civil discovery: oral depositions: transcriptions.
summary: Allows certified deposition transcripts to be sent electronically, encrypted and authenticated, to the noticing attorney on request, and accepted by courts.

title: Pupil safety: nonconsensual artificial intimate images: study.
summary: Requires the State Department of Education to study nonconsensual artificial intimate images involving pupils and submit it by January 2028.

title: Disability benefits: certificates.
summary: Prohibits physicians from charging administrative fees for disability benefit certificates and recertification forms needed for unemployment disability claims.

title: Community colleges: classified employees.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to community college boards' duty to prescribe classified employees' duties.

title: State holidays: Sylvia Mendez Day.
summary: Designates Sylvia Mendez Day as a state holiday and exempts it from being a judicial holiday.

title: Regional housing need: affordable housing.
summary: Authorizes local governments to voluntarily agree that affordable housing projects in one jurisdiction count toward another's regional housing needs allocation.

title: Planning and zoning: housing element: regional housing needs allocation.
summary: Extends deadlines for forming subregional housing-allocation entities and council of governments regional housing need determinations, and shifts methodology and draft allocation timelines earlier.

title: Restitution: diversion.
summary: Requires courts to order restitution to victims during diversion and bars denying diversion or finding noncompliance based on indigence or mental disorder.

title: Pupil instruction: computer science: content standards.
summary: Requires the Instructional Quality Commission to consider adding cybersecurity skills to computer science standards when they are next revised after 2027.

title: California Antihunger Response and Employment Training Act of 2026.
summary: Creates state-funded CARET program providing CalFresh-equivalent food benefits to adults cut off by federal time limits, plus employment training eligibility.

title: The Cost of Living Reduction Act of 2025.
topics: Environment and energy; Taxes and budget
summary: Creates price dashboards and reports, and suspends gas taxes, utility fees, and cap-and-trade obligations for six months when prices exceed national averages by 10%.

title: Pest control: Pierce’s disease.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Extends the Pierce's disease and winegrape pest board programs indefinitely, subject to a referendum-based sunset, and renames the board.

title: Workforce development: applicable law.
summary: Exempts state workforce grants to local boards from state contracting and review rules, adds federal-style financial reporting, and exempts department guidance from APA rulemaking.

title: Community colleges: Baccalaureate Degree in Nursing Pilot Program.
summary: Creates a 10-district pilot letting selected community colleges offer Bachelor of Science in Nursing degrees, sunsetting in 2036.

title: Food safety: infant formula.
summary: Requires infant formula makers to test for heavy metals monthly, requires brand disclosure from 2028, and bans sale of noncompliant formula.

title: School accountability: local educational agencies: required plans and reports.
summary: Requires the Legislative Analyst's Office to report by 2028 with recommendations to reduce redundant school reporting deadlines and requirements.

title: Social workers.
summary: Requires social workers to take reasonable steps to obtain emergency care for children and notify tribes of Indian children, and clarifies county social workers are not officers for records-tampering law.

title: Attorneys: corporate legal funders.
summary: Bans corporate legal funders from controlling litigation functions or contracting in ways that enable unauthorized practice of law, with attorney discipline and damages for violations, applying to contracts from 2027.

title: State government.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive wording change to the duties of the state point of contact for the U.S. Trade Representative.

title: Transportation: traffic signal synchronization pilot program: Western Riverside Council of Governments.
summary: Authorizes a Western Riverside council of governments to run a voluntary traffic signal synchronization pilot through 2032, with an evaluation report due 2028.

title: Redevelopment: successor agency debt: City and County of San Francisco.
summary: Lets San Francisco's redevelopment successor agency extend pledges of sales and tax increments to finance Transbay infrastructure debt.

title: CalFresh Protection Act.
summary: During a federal SNAP funding lapse, requires the state to use General Fund money so CalFresh benefits keep flowing to existing recipients.

title: Income and corporation taxes: credits: work opportunity credit.
summary: Creates a 40% income and corporation tax credit for employers hiring felony-convicted individuals within a year of conviction or release, for 2026 through 2030.

title: Illegal dumping.
summary: Makes transporting waste or construction debris for illegal dumping a crime, raises fines for repeat violations, and adds felony penalties for large commercial quantities.

title: Health care districts: employment.
summary: Allows health care districts and their hospital nonprofits to employ physicians and charge for their services until 2037, with an annual reporting requirement.

title: State property: tidelands transfer: City of Martinez: leases.
summary: Allows the City of Martinez to lease tidelands trust parcels for up to 66 years, or longer with State Lands Commission approval, and requires the city to pay related study costs.

title: Gas corporations: gas distribution service line replacements: alternatives.
summary: Requires gas utilities to offer residential customers incentives to replace gas service lines with alternatives and cease gas service, through 2035.

title: Childcare: alternative payment program.
summary: Lets alternative payment programs in good standing request voluntary temporary fund transfers, with state response deadlines starting in 2027.

title: Microenterprise home kitchen operations.
summary: Requires local permits for home kitchen food businesses on a nondiscretionary basis and bars local caps, geographic limits, and bans on operating in homes.

title: School facilities: Charter School Facilities Program: undue financial burden.
summary: Lets the state reduce charter schools' 50% facilities matching share, with larger grants, when it would cause undue financial burden, starting 2028.

title: Hospitals: seismic standards.
summary: Makes a technical, nonsubstantive change to hospital seismic safety review provisions under the Alquist Act.

title: Law enforcement: facilitating medical care.
summary: Makes it unlawful for officers to deny or delay medical care to people under police control when safe; requires documenting denials.

title: Personal Income Tax Law: Corporation Tax Law: credits: qualified motion picture: post-production.
summary: Creates a 35%-50% state tax credit for California post-production work on qualified motion pictures, with a cap and labor attestation requirements.

title: Natural disasters: catastrophe savings accounts: personal income tax.
summary: Creates optional catastrophe savings accounts for homeowners and gives state income tax deductions and interest exclusions for contributions and earnings through 2030.

title: Multifamily Housing Program: Homekey: adaptive reuse.
summary: Requires HCD to consider allowing Homekey applicants to use funds for substantial adaptive reuse projects for awards made from July 2026.

title: Occupational safety and health: investigations.
summary: Expands workplace safety enforcement by adding misdemeanor penalties for obstructing inspectors and broadening criminal liability and mandatory investigations for serious injuries.

title: Water discharge: commercial, industrial, or institutional sites.
summary: Defines commercial, industrial, or institutional sites for MS4 stormwater permits and shortens the mailed notice period for unprotested water rights hearings from 20 to 15 days.

title: Publication: newspapers of general circulation.
summary: Requires legally mandated public notices to appear online as well as in print, and bars newspapers from charging fees to access them.

title: Vocational education: youth caregivers.
summary: Directs the state to consider adding youth caregiver content to career technical curriculum and to issue guidance on the Personal Care and Services pathway by 2028.

title: Teachers: bilingual teachers: Pathways to Bilingual Teaching Program.
summary: Creates a contingent Pathways to Bilingual Teaching Program offering competitive grants to build bilingual teacher credential pathways with colleges.

title: Noxious weed management: Broomrape Program: extension.
summary: Extends the Broomrape Program and revises noxious weed funding rules, including integrated plan requirements and a higher administrative spending cap.

title: Medi-Cal: subcontractors: rates.
summary: Requires Medi-Cal managed care plans to pay downstream subcontractors actuarially sound rates, with a review process and dispute resolution for subcontracting plans.

title: Vehicles: leaving the scene of an accident.
summary: Raises prison terms for leaving the scene of a fatal accident and requires a 2027 report on a school mental health grant program.

title: Surplus residential property: condition-adjusted price of the fair market value: Cities of Pasadena and South Pasadena.
summary: Revises how state surplus homes in Pasadena-area cities are priced and offered to occupants, adds inspection rules, and provides purchase assistance tied to an affordable housing trust fund.

title: Alcoholic beverages: licensees.
summary: Allows licensed beer manufacturers and wholesalers to sell beer to licensees from trailers, in addition to wagons or trucks.

title: Public health: cold spas and cold plunge tubs.
summary: Subjects cold spas to public pool and spa standards and sets requirements for cold plunge tubs, exempting them from pool sanitation rules.

title: Cemeteries: removal of remains.
summary: Requires a court to grant a petition to remove interred remains from a cemetery plot when the applicant shows good cause.

title: Dual language immersion: Dual Language Immersion Coordinator.
summary: Creates a Dual Language Immersion Coordinator at the state Department of Education, contingent on appropriation, and requires a public directory of immersion programs.

title: Child welfare nongovernmental organizations.
summary: Extends the sunset date for provisions allocating liability between foster family agencies and public entities from 2027 to 2028.

title: Solid waste: methane reduction: working group.
summary: Requires the Department of Resources Recycling and Recovery to create a working group to study alternative methods of methane reduction and report by 2029.

title: Unclaimed property: digital financial assets.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Sets procedures for state handling of escheated digital financial assets, including liquidation, a reserve fund, and a new oversight board.

title: Personal Income Tax Law: exclusions from income: retirement: overtime.
summary: Excludes the first $25,000 of overtime pay from state income tax through 2030, plus the first $25,000 of defined benefit plan proceeds.

title: Peace officers: theft.
summary: Lets POST suspend or revoke certification of peace officers who commit theft under color of authority with intent to permanently deprive.

title: Electrical corporations and gas corporations: rates: inflation-constrained rate case scenario: standard of review.
summary: Requires utilities' rate cases to include a scenario capping expenditure growth at the Social Security COLA, with exceptions for clear, convincing need.

title: Firearms: prohibited persons.
summary: Requires courts and designated facilities to report firearm-prohibition records to DOJ and lets DOJ share sealed juvenile records with affected persons.

title: California FAIR Plan Association governing committee.
summary: Adds the Assembly Speaker and Senate Rules Chair as nonvoting ex officio members of the California FAIR Plan governing committee, with designees allowed.

title: Local transportation authority: Fresno Council of Governments.
summary: Designates the Fresno Council of Governments as the local transportation authority to receive and allocate a Fresno County transactions tax if voters approve it.

title: Local government: emergency response services: use of languages other than English.
summary: Requires local agencies to translate emergency information into each language spoken by at least 5% of residents with limited English.

title: Parole.
summary: Lets the Governor reverse certain parole grants for violent felons and requires the parole board to publish annual reports and record hearings.

title: Alcohol and other drug programs: consumer protection platform.
summary: Requires substance use treatment facilities and programs to join a state consumer protection platform for licensing, subject to funding, and bars using it in publicly funded contracts.

title: Animal abuse: forfeiture.
summary: Extends existing animal seizure cost-liability and abandonment rules to animals seized under any California law.

title: Student loans: medical, nursing, social work, and social welfare students: California Health Care Workforce Supplemental Loan Program.
summary: Creates a state supplemental loan program and fund so medical, nursing, and social work students can receive federal-equivalent graduate loan aid.

title: Vehicles: electric bicycles and speed limits.
summary: Requires e-bike speedometers, lamps, and point-of-sale disclosures, lets local authorities set path speed limits, and sets a 10 mph sidewalk limit.

title: Commission on Peace Officer Standards and Training: hate crime training and guidelines.
summary: Requires POST to review hate crime training for law enforcement, then adopt evidence-based training requirements addressing identified gaps by 2028.

title: Medi-Cal: enhanced care management and community supports.
summary: Revises Medi-Cal enhanced care management and community supports, requiring state guidance, plan policies, provider education, and utilization reporting.

title: State Air Resources Board: regional air quality incident response program.
summary: Requires the state air board to expand a regional network of air quality incident response centers for emergency air monitoring, subject to appropriation.

title: Pupils: use of smartphones.
summary: Expressly authorizes school policies limiting pupil smartphone use, including scheduled-based or full-day restrictions, with state mandate reimbursement if applicable.

title: Consumer loans: residential real property rental payments.
summary: Regulates consumer loans used to pay residential rent, limiting installments, late fees, and 0% APR advertising, with added disclosure requirements.

title: General plan: annual report: shelter beds.
summary: Requires cities and counties to report counts of homeless shelter beds and permanent housing units in their annual general plan reports starting in 2028.

title: Medi-Cal providers: nonprofit public benefit corporations.
summary: Extends Medi-Cal provider enrollment procedures to tax-exempt nonprofit corporations providing nonspecialty mental health services.

title: Health Mandates Review Program.
summary: Creates health mandate and hospital policy impact review programs funded by a new fee on hospitals, with the hospital-related parts repealed in 2033.

title: Pupil instruction: California Serves Program.
summary: Expands the California Serves Program's service-learning access from grade 12 to grades 6-12 and extends the related evidence review and recommendations to 2028.

title: Medi-Cal.
summary: Requires the Medi-Cal department to engage stakeholders and focus its hospital value strategy on rural, critical access, and public hospitals.

title: State parks: Tolowa Dee-ni’ Nation: Tolowa Dunes State Park.
topics: Environment and energy; Taxes and budget
summary: Transfers about 4,301 acres of Tolowa Dunes State Park to the Tolowa Dee-ni' Nation and exempts that land from property tax.

title: Courts: mental health pilot program.
summary: Creates a pilot in three counties offering no-cost mental health services to jurors in violent felony trials, with reporting and a 2036 repeal.

title: The Parent’s Accountability and Child Protection Act.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive change to the Parent's Accountability and Child Protection Act on minors' purchases of age-restricted products.

title: Medi-Cal.
summary: Makes technical, nonsubstantive wording changes to a Medi-Cal provision on program changes and beneficiary claims.

title: Digital financial asset businesses: regulatory fees.
summary: Caps the nonrefundable license application fee for digital financial asset businesses at $5,000.

title: State agencies: governmental linguistics.
summary: Requires state agencies to write their documents in plain language after January 1, 2027, and to designate senior officials to oversee compliance.

title: Insurance: personal vehicle sharing.
summary: Requires personal vehicle sharing programs to assume owners' third-party liability with higher minimum insurance limits.

title: Pupil transportation.
summary: Raises the school employee driving-hour exemption for small and rural districts, authorizes rural activity driver authorizations, and creates a contingent transportation safety grant program.

title: Individual Shared Responsibility Penalty: exemption.
summary: Exempts individuals from the state individual mandate penalty for any month a household member was enrolled in Medi-Cal in 2024 or 2025.

title: Short-Term Rental Facilitator Act of 2025.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive changes to the provision naming the Short-Term Rental Facilitator Act of 2025.

title: Education-related positions: egregious misconduct: previous employment disclosures.
summary: Expands the egregious misconduct definition for school employee dismissals and adds a certificated-employee misconduct section to the statewide data system.

title: Administrative Procedure Act: proposed regulations: cost-of-living impact on residents of the state.
summary: Requires state agencies to assess cost-of-living impacts of proposed regulations, adds LAO review, and creates a Department of Finance regulatory burden tracker.

title: State employment: reporting: health facilities.
summary: Requires state departments to report quarterly, by facility, on positions, vacancies, and registry contracts at state-run health facilities, and publish that data online.

title: Low-income health care: internet website and information.
summary: Requires the state health department to create a public website with information on county safety-net health care services and eligibility, and counties to report changes.

title: Electricity: energy storage: energy-only resources.
summary: Directs the PUC to enable energy-only resources like storage to meet utility procurement requirements and obtain transmission deliverability.

title: Crimes: threats.
summary: Creates a new crime for willfully threatening crimes at locations like daycares and workplaces, a wobbler for adults, with juvenile referrals to services.

title: Public Safety Communications Division.
summary: Centralizes statewide public safety communications under the Office of Emergency Services' Public Safety Communications Division and preempts charter city authority over them.

title: Transportation.
summary: Expresses legislative intent to enact future transportation legislation, without changing any current law.

title: Vehicles: tolls.
summary: Allows emergency vehicles without an exempt license plate to avoid tolls if the California Highway Patrol authorizes them as emergency vehicles.

title: The California Coastal Act: local coastal program: sea level rise plan: neighborhood-scale adaptation approach.
summary: Authorizes coastal local governments to include neighborhood-scale sea level rise adaptation approaches in their local coastal programs or plans.

title: Postsecondary education: Designation of California Asian American- and Native Hawaiian Pacific Islander-Serving Institutions.
summary: Creates a state designation for community colleges and universities that excel at serving Asian American, Native Hawaiian, and Pacific Islander students, valid for five years.

title: Alcoholic beverage control.
summary: Revises the beer definition to allow other grains, shortens the late-payment charge timing, and expands electronic payment rules for alcohol sales.

title: Vehicles: automated enforcement systems.
summary: Expands automated parking enforcement to video cameras for more violations, authorizes enhanced curb management systems, and limits use of image data.

title: Personal Income Tax Law and Corporation Tax Law: deductions: accelerated depreciation for new manufacturing operations.
summary: Creates a temporary accelerated depreciation deduction for qualified taxpayers placing at least $1 million of qualified property into service in California.

title: California Violence Intervention and Prevention Grant Program.
topics: Government and administration; Guns and weapons
summary: Creates an Office of Community Violence Intervention within BSCC to administer the CalVIP grant program and produce biennial reports.

title: Family daycare homes: Fourth Amendment training.
summary: Requires family daycare providers to be notified of and trained on Fourth Amendment rights, with penalties prohibited for violations.

title: Mortgage forbearance: state of emergency: wildfire.
summary: Requires mortgage servicers to offer up to 12 months of forbearance, waive late fees, and pause foreclosures for wildfire-affected borrowers.

title: Pest control: registration fees.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Labor and employment
summary: Raises maximum county registration fees for pest control businesses, pilots, advisers, and structural pest control companies.

title: Local Agency Public Construction Act: municipal water districts: sanitation districts: lowest responsible bidder.
summary: Raises the competitive bidding threshold for municipal water and sanitation district contracts from $35,000 to $220,000, with annual inflation adjustments starting 2028.

title: Electronic death registration system.
summary: Requires the state registrar to upgrade the electronic death registration system and expands who can access and attest deaths within it.

title: Electricity: data centers.
topics: AI and technology; Environment and energy
summary: Requires utilities and community choice aggregators to adopt tariffs for generation and transmission service, including for data centers.

title: Crimes: records: sealing.
summary: Allows people with non-conviction arrests or charges, and certain eligible convictions, to petition to seal those records after four crime-free years.

title: Local reconstruction agencies.
summary: Renames local disaster plans as disaster recovery plans, requires general plan consistency, and directs state offices to prepare model ordinances and guidance by 2029.

title: License to practice medicine: Licensed Physicians from Mexico Program and California Physician Expansion Act.
summary: Creates a provisional licensing pathway for physicians licensed abroad and converts Mexico physician program participants to full licenses after two terms.

title: California Dream for All Program: first-generation homebuyers.
summary: Expands California's Dream for All down payment assistance to first-generation homebuyers, with priority for homes built with state funds and a new credit-enhancement fund.

title: Alcoholic beverages: applications for licenses.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive change to license application content rules for alcohol retail premises under construction.

title: Property taxation: active solar energy systems: customer sited: extension.
topics: Environment and energy; Taxes and budget
summary: Extends the property tax exclusion for small and public-sited solar systems through 2030 and limits owner-builder exclusions to pre-2027 permits.

title: State-led County of Los Angeles disaster housing task force.
summary: Requires HCD to convene a state task force to coordinate and speed rebuilding housing after the January 2025 Los Angeles wildfires, sunsetting in 2028.

title: Streamlined housing approvals: objective standards: review and modifications.
summary: Lets housing developers lock in the objective zoning, subdivision and design standards in effect at first application when seeking modifications to approved multifamily projects.

title: Health care: workforce training programs.
summary: Creates a New Nursing Graduate Support and Placement Program offering grants to community college nursing programs and financial support to recent graduates, contingent on appropriation.

title: Public postsecondary education: generative artificial intelligence systems: procurement standards: training.
summary: Requires California's public colleges to convene a working group on generative AI procurement and training, and to report on AI system contracts.

title: False imprisonment: false arrest: remedies.
summary: Lets plaintiffs in false arrest or imprisonment suits elect $10,000 per specified act, with joint liability and a $250,000 per-incident cap.

title: Personal Income Tax Law: exclusions: real property.
summary: Excludes from state income tax gain from sale of a primary residence by taxpayers aged 55+, for 2027–2031 tax years.

title: Child support: compromise of arrears program.
summary: Raises the local child support compromise-of-arrears authority to $10,000 and requires uniform state rules, forms and a 180-day decision timeline for the program.

title: Community choice aggregators: eligible transmission projects.
summary: Authorizes community choice aggregators to sponsor, develop, finance, build, and own eligible transmission projects, even if lines don't serve their customers.

title: Local government: community facilities districts: financing.
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Prohibits local agencies from abandoning critical housing infrastructure district CFDs without substantial-evidence findings of specific adverse public-interest impact, applying to charter cities.

title: Graduate medical education capacity: report.
summary: Creates a supervised physician graduate license for medical graduates without residency and requires a GME capacity workgroup and 2028 report.

title: Real property tax: welfare exemption: community land trusts.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive wording change to the property tax welfare exemption provision for community land trust-owned housing.

title: San Diego Association of Governments: board of directors.
summary: Changes the San Diego regional transportation board so one county supervisor must come from an unincorporated area, and adds a planning-groups representative.

title: Community colleges: study: Counties of Amador, Alpine, Mariposa, Modoc, and Sierra.
summary: Requires the California Research Bureau to study community college access in five underserved counties and report recommendations by December 31, 2027.

title: General plan: annual report: suite-style student housing quarters.
summary: Requires cities and counties to include the number of suite-style student housing quarters in their annual housing reports to the state.

title: Video imaging of parking violations.
summary: Makes a technical, nonsubstantive change to existing rules on video-imaging enforcement of parking violations in transit lanes.

title: Health studio contracts: fee limits: multiservice health club studio.
summary: Exempts multiservice health club studios from the state's $4,400 cap on prepaid health studio contract payments.

title: Income tax: credits: commercial production.
topics: AI and technology; Taxes and budget
summary: Creates a state income and corporate tax credit, capped at $15 million per year, for qualified commercial production in California, excluding fully AI-generated commercials.

title: State advisory groups, boards, and committees: San Joaquin Valley.
summary: Requires at least one San Joaquin Valley member on the State Board of Education, several state advisory and oversight bodies, and related committees.

title: Mental health.
summary: Requires peace officers to take people held for mental health assessment to the closest appropriate designated facility, and lets the person state a facility preference.

title: Veterans: county and city buildings.
summary: Makes technical, nonsubstantive changes to the law letting cities and counties lease buildings to veterans organizations.

title: High-Speed Rail Authority Office of the Inspector General: contract reviews: audit standards.
summary: Expands the High-Speed Rail Inspector General's duties to review conflicts of interest, conduct standardized audits, and publish audit reports.

title: Energy: billing.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Environment and energy
summary: Requires utility charge disclosure and opt-out for public purpose programs, suspends fees and cap-and-invest collection when energy prices spike, and limits billing adjustments.

title: Digital assets: meme coins.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Bars public officials from issuing meme coins and bars crypto platforms from listing meme coins tied to officials, with enforcement by public attorneys.

title: Wildfire and Vegetation Management Voluntary Tax Contribution Fund.
summary: Creates a voluntary tax checkoff fund for wildfire and vegetation management, continuously appropriated, that taxpayers can designate on their returns.

title: Wildfire safety: fuels reduction projects: California Environmental Quality Act.
summary: Temporarily exempts certain wildfire fuels reduction projects from CEQA through 2030, conditioned on best management practices and reporting.

title: California Olympic and Paralympic Public Safety Command: agreements with state and local agencies.
summary: Lets out-of-state officers be temporarily deployed and deputized in California for 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games security, under conditions and training requirements.

title: State agencies or departments: public communications.
summary: Expands the required AI-generated disclaimer for state agency communications to cover all direct communications with the public, not just government services and benefits.

title: Large-format public advertisements: public expense.
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Bans public-expense large-format ads, such as billboards and bus wraps, that feature an affiliated elected officer's photograph, with joint liability for agencies and officials.

title: Developmental services: direct support professionals.
summary: Renames direct service professionals to direct support professionals and defines the term for developmental services providers funded by regional centers.

title: Transit-oriented housing developments: alternative plans.
summary: Lets local transit-oriented development alternative plans cut capacity in one zone by more than 50%, if specified requirements are met.

title: Privacy: use of a person’s name, voice, signature, photograph, or likeness.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive wording change to existing law on unauthorized commercial use of a person's name, voice, signature, photograph, or likeness.

title: State Teachers’ Retirement System: community colleges: part-time faculty.
summary: Requires STRS to post retirement plan comparison information and requires community college districts to offer temporary part-time employees pension or Social Security options.

title: Local building permits: nonresidential private permitting review.
summary: Lets applicants for nonresidential building permits use private plan checkers when local review is delayed, and shortens the excessive-delay threshold to 30 business days.

title: Probation officers: body-worn cameras: County of Los Angeles.
summary: Requires Los Angeles County to create a probation department body-worn camera program, with policy due June 2027 and implementation starting January 1, 2028.

title: Genetic disease screening.
summary: Requires the state to add Duchenne muscular dystrophy to statewide newborn screening by January 1, 2027, and expands fund uses.

title: Cannabis: donations: seniors.
summary: Allows cannabis retailers to donate free cannabis to people 65 or older and exempts those donations from use tax for five years.

title: Political Reform Act of 1974: committee termination.
summary: Lets the Secretary of State send termination notices to inactive campaign committees and terminate them if no objection is filed within 180 days.

title: Student financial aid: delayed financial aid awards: extensions.
summary: Requires public and participating private colleges to extend enrollment and financial deadlines and avoid punitive actions for students whose financial aid is delayed by factors beyond their control.

title: Agriculture: cotton pests abatement districts: organization and establishment: authorized counties.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Removes authority for Orange, San Diego, and Ventura counties to establish cotton pest abatement districts, and makes nonsubstantive changes to land conveyance provisions.

title: Public Utilities Commission: communications: low-income customers.
summary: Creates a low-income telecommunications advisory board and requires the PUC to administer the Lifeline program in a technologically inclusive way.

title: Department of Financial Protection and Innovation: budget reports.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Requires the financial regulator to report annually to legislative committees on revenues, expenditures, and fee methods starting in 2027.

title: Online platforms: educational children’s content.
topics: AI and technology; Children and families
summary: Requires covered online platforms to maintain an ad-free, account-free section of exclusively educational children's content, with compliance reports and penalties.

title: Personal Income Tax Law: Corporation Tax Law: tax credits: farming.
summary: Creates a 2027–2031 personal income and corporation tax credit for large agricultural businesses, capped at $250 million yearly and administered with the Department of Food and Agriculture.

title: Criminal fees.
summary: Repeals authority to collect many criminal fees, makes most unpaid court costs unenforceable and uncollectible, and relieves incarcerated people of trial court filing fees.

title: Childcare: mental health consultation services.
summary: Changes the requirements for reimbursing early childhood mental health consultation services, replacing screening components with a classroom observation tool requirement.

title: Postsecondary education: student financial aid dependency status: juveniles.
summary: Requires financial aid offices to accept sworn statements verifying foster or probation-involved youth's independent dependency status; allows related records sharing.

title: Expanded learning programs: high school pupils: After School Education and Safety Program Act of 2002.
summary: Creates a high school after-school grant program within ASES, reallocating unused and nonrenewed ASES funds and restricting renewals for schools with fewer low-income pupils.

title: Downcoding medical claims.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Requires insurers and health plans to document clinical review before downcoding claims, provide dispute processes, and bars discriminatory downcoding against high-acuity providers.

title: State Air Resources Board: regulations: analysis of financial impact on drivers.
summary: Requires the Air Resources Board to analyze and consider the financial impact on drivers before adopting rules with direct driver costs.

title: Housing development: density bonus.
summary: Requires cities and counties to grant density bonuses and incentives for qualifying housing developments, including floor area ratio bonuses for applicants who provide base density studies.

title: Inmates: visitation.
summary: Requires prisons to offer at least three visitation days weekly, limits visit denials, and restricts visitor searches without written consent.

title: Professional engineering, geology, geophysics, and land surveying: practice without a license: administrative penalties.
summary: Authorizes administrative fines for unlicensed engineering, geology, or surveying practice and adds tiered criminal penalties for land surveying.

title: Public postsecondary education: tuition and fees: Team USA student athletes.
summary: Removes the 2032 sunset so Team USA athletes training in California keep resident tuition classification indefinitely.

title: Impounded vehicles.
summary: Requires tow yards and storage facilities to accept debit cards for fees and bars requiring extra ownership documents to release impounded vehicles.

title: Imprisonment.
summary: Requires felony sentences totaling more than 6 years to be served in state prison rather than county jail.

title: Common Interest Developments: governing documents: assessments.
summary: Requires HOAs to notify members of payment-recipient changes and adds liability and penalties for failed delinquency-lien notice procedures.

title: Quick-Service Restaurant Young Workforce Apprenticeship Program: tax credits.
summary: Creates a $1,000-per-apprentice tax credit for quick-service restaurant employers and a state apprenticeship funding program, subject to appropriation.

title: Arts and Music in Schools—Funding Guarantee and Accountability Act: allowable uses: pooled funding: certifications.
summary: Expands the arts education funding act to cover curriculum and professional development, allows pooling of school funds, and tightens supplement-not-supplant certification.

title: Community Supporting Innovation Pilot Program.
summary: Creates a pilot program funding 25 community organizations to help families with complex needs access services and reduce unnecessary child welfare involvement.

title: Peptides.
summary: Creates a state program letting approved entities offer investigational peptides and novel compounds under oversight, with liability protections and a study working group.

title: Telephone corporations: carriers of last resort.
summary: Requires the PUC to set a process letting telephone carriers of last resort be relieved of service obligations where other voice options exist.

title: Personal Income Tax Law: qualified tuition program.
summary: Conforms state tax law to a federal Roth IRA rollover exclusion for tuition programs and adds a Scholarshare contribution deduction through 2031.

title: Public infrastructure projects.
summary: Governs State Capitol annex construction and visitor center location, and voids nondisclosure agreements for public infrastructure projects starting 2027.

title: Attorney General: investigations: prediction market wagering.
summary: Requires the Attorney General to investigate prediction market payouts of $5,000 or more tied to national security events.

title: Water: Nitrogen Pollution Reduction Act.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Environment and energy
summary: Requires the state water board to direct regional boards to update agricultural irrigation rules to cut nitrogen discharges by 2028, with crop nitrogen balance reporting.

title: Medical information: confidentiality.
summary: Requires businesses storing sensitive health information to enable access-limiting and segregation security features for gender-affirming, abortion and contraception data.

title: Schoolbuses: stop signal arm enforcement system.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice; Transportation
summary: Lets school districts pilot camera enforcement of stop-arm violations, makes the fines civil instead of criminal, and makes camera records confidential.

title: Property taxation: application of base year value: disaster relief.
