summary: Extends by three years the period to transfer base-year property tax values for property destroyed in specified early-2025 wildfires.

title: Sentencing: dismissal of enhancements.
summary: Makes court dismissal of certain drug-related sentence enhancements discretionary rather than mandatory when in the furtherance of justice.

title: Dependency: victims of human trafficking.
summary: Expands juvenile dependency grounds and the trafficked children program to cover labor trafficking victims, and limits social worker custody removals.

title: Curriculum frameworks: instructional materials evaluation criteria: media literacy.
summary: Specifies that California's media literacy standards for curriculum and instructional materials include social media health, online permanence, personal security, and recognizing cyberbullying and trafficking.

title: Vehicles: off-highway motor vehicles.
summary: Lets peace officers and first responders drive off-highway vehicles on highways for emergencies and patrol access, under local policies that localities must adopt.

title: State highways: report: southeast Los Angeles County.
summary: Requires the Department of Transportation, with the California Transportation Commission, to report on state highway maintenance needs in southeast Los Angeles County by February 2028.

title: Bruce Lee Day.
summary: Requires the Governor to proclaim May 17 as Bruce Lee Day and encourages schools to observe it with commemorative exercises.

title: Courts: Commission on Judicial Performance.
summary: Authorizes courts to post Commission on Judicial Performance information about its mission, complaint process, and Code of Judicial Ethics violations on their websites.

title: Health care provider credentialing.
summary: Extends existing provider credentialing forms and 90-day determination deadlines to Medi-Cal managed care plans, with willful violations made a crime.

title: Energy: appliance standards and cost-effective measures.
summary: Extends appliance energy and water efficiency standards to cover rental, importation, distribution, and leasing of appliances, not just sales.

title: Vehicle charging stations: electrical service connection: certificate of occupancy.
summary: Bars local building authorities from withholding certificates of occupancy from nonprofits solely because required EV charging stations aren't yet operational, if infrastructure is installed.

title: Social Security Tenant Protection Act of 2025.
summary: Lets tenants raise federal Social Security payment interruptions as a defense to nonpayment eviction, with a court stay and repayment, until 2029.

title: Pupil health: mental health: model referral protocols.
summary: Requires schools and the state to update pupil mental health referral protocols with guidance on equity-centered supports during immigration enforcement emergencies.

title: Oil and gas: bonding requirements.
summary: Extends oil and gas well bonding requirements to anyone acquiring control of a well or facility and removes the high-production exemption.

title: Unsafe products: disposal: penalties.
summary: Raises penalties for unsafe product violations, narrows manufacturer definition, and expands the entities that must receive no-cost product return or disposal.

title: Public Utilities Commission: rates: cost of capital proceeding: authorized return on equity.
summary: Requires the PUC, for utility return-on-equity decisions from 2031 on, to document its models, credit-quality analysis, and reasons for methodology changes.

title: Energy: firm zero-carbon resources.
summary: Requires the Energy Commission to submit a 2028 legislative assessment of firm zero-carbon resources and related recommendations.

title: State government: benefits.
summary: Bars businesses tied to private immigration detention from state grants, loans and tax credits, and creates a fund for immigration-related services.

title: Strong Workforce Program: work-based learning opportunities: regional consortia.
summary: Extends by one year the deadline for community college policies on paid work-based learning and lets regional consortia use their funds for paid student and employer support.

title: Elementary and secondary education: omnibus.
summary: Omnibus education bill changing charter oversight notices, teacher credential clearance rules, and credential program candidate data reporting.

title: School accountability: pupils with disabilities: inclusion.
summary: Creates the Supporting Inclusive Practices project to help schools serve pupils with disabilities in general education, and redirects $30 million to the Collaborative.

title: Data centers: water use disclosures.
topics: AI and technology; Environment and energy
summary: Bars local approval of data center construction or water-use expansions unless applicants provide water plans and pay infrastructure costs.

title: Incarcerated individual hand crew members: wages.
summary: Requires hand crew members incarcerated or placed at Pine Grove to receive $7.25 hourly wages during active fire incidents, reviewed annually, with an administrative dispute process.

title: Public social services: domestic violence services.
summary: Expands CalWORKs housing aid for domestic violence survivors and creates a state one-stop program helping survivors obtain records and credit information.

title: Alfred E. Alquist Seismic Safety Commission.
summary: Restructures the Alquist Seismic Safety Commission's membership, quorum, and coordination duties with fire, insurance, and growth agencies.

title: Emergency services: catastrophic plans.
summary: Requires the Office of Emergency Services, with state and local agencies, to develop catastrophic disaster plans.

title: Wildfire Forecast and Threat Intelligence Integration Center: forecasted extreme, life-threatening fire weather conditions.
summary: Requires the wildfire intelligence center to share extreme fire weather forecasts, create reports and a training program, and allows emergency proclamations based on those reports.

title: Office of Emergency Services: public alert and early warning software: master contract.
summary: Requires the Office of Emergency Services to plan a statewide master contract for interoperable public alert software, subject to legislative approval.

title: Standardized emergency management system.
summary: Requires the Office of Emergency Services to produce two after-action reports and annual recovery updates, and local governments to report recovery efforts after emergencies.

title: Electricity: integrated resource plans: Department of Water Resources: procurement.
summary: Removes the requirement that pump hydroelectric facilities receive state funding before 2023 to be eligible for Department of Water Resources procurement.

title: Structural pest control.
summary: Allows unlicensed employees who applied for pest control exams to apply pesticides outdoors under supervision for up to 60 days, starting 2028.

title: Kinship family approval.
summary: Creates a streamlined kinship family approval process for relative caregivers in foster care, with confidentiality and a false-statement misdemeanor.

title: Personal income tax: employment credit.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive change to the personal income tax credit for hiring qualified employees in designated areas.

title: County jails: wages.
summary: Lets county boards of supervisors set the amount credited to jail prisoners for work, replacing the existing $2 per 8 hours cap.

title: Housing development: density bonus: student housing developments.
summary: Expands the state density bonus for student housing, requiring extra density for qualifying developments that set aside affordable units for students.

title: Beverage containers: recycling: glass: quality incentive payments.
summary: Authorizes CalRecycle to pay quality incentive payments from the beverage container fund for clean glass used in new glass products.

title: School districts: reorganization.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to the definition of an action to reorganize school districts.

title: Wildland firefighters: Formerly Incarcerated Firefighter Certification and Employment Program.
summary: Requires CAL FIRE to certify incarcerated firefighter training, grant hiring preference to qualified formerly incarcerated applicants, and count incarcerated crew service toward Forestry Technician qualifications.

title: San Diego Metropolitan Transit System: transactions and use tax: voter initiatives.
summary: Lets voter initiatives impose San Diego MTS transit sales taxes and excludes that 0.5% rate from the state's 2% combined cap.

title: Bureau of Security and Investigative Services: private investigators: client service agreements.
summary: Requires private investigator licensees to give non-English-primary clients copies of service agreements in their preferred language; violations are not crimes.

title: Medi-Cal: Whole Child Model program.
summary: Renames the Whole Child Model advisory group as the CCS advisory group, extends its sunset to 2037, and requires two DHCS progress reports.

title: Artificial intelligence: education and workforce development.
summary: Creates AI education and workforce programs at community colleges and small-business AI resources, contingent on appropriations; requires guidance, pilots and advisory groups.

title: Department of Industrial Relations: occupational safety and health.
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Requires a University of California study of understaffing and vacancies in the state workplace safety division, contingent on appropriation, with recommendations and a report.

title: Controlled substances: research.
summary: Until 2032, lets the Research Advisory Panel seek FDA approval for clinical trials of Schedule I or II drugs in a veterans-only group with suicidality-linked conditions.

title: Housing: Homeless Housing, Assistance, and Prevention program: youth-specific processes and coordinated entry systems.
summary: Requires homelessness continuums of care to certify youth-specific coordinated entry processes, youth assessment tools, youth advisory bodies, and youth housing inventory.

title: Teacher credentialing: emergency career substitute teaching permit: alternative qualifications.
summary: Allows substitute teachers to qualify for an emergency career permit through alternative training instead of 90 days of substitute teaching, and permits up to 70 days in one classroom.

title: The Every Kid Counts (EKC) College Savings Program.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive changes to the Every Kid Counts College Savings Program grant provisions for children's savings accounts.

title: Public safety: mega sporting events.
summary: Requires the Office of Emergency Services to plan safety and security for mega sporting events and official watch parties.

title: Electrical corporations: interconnection: Public Utilities Commission: transmission development monitor.
summary: Creates a PUC transmission development monitor to track utility interconnection and transmission project schedules, requiring reports and remedial actions for deficiencies.

title: State forests: forest management.
summary: Redefines state forest management around public benefits like watershed health and wildfire resilience, allows tribal co-management, and adds timber plan reporting.

title: Unlawful immigration-related practices.
summary: Expands bans on immigration-related retaliation against employees and adds civil penalties up to $10,000 per violation for conduct that deters exercise of legal workplace rights.

title: Local educational agencies: reports: school accountability report card: California School Dashboard: local control accountability plan: local control funding formula budget overview.
summary: Removes the February 28 LCAP budget report deadline, requires a 2027 duplication report, and repeals annual school safety plan status reporting.

title: Physical therapists.
summary: Expands physical therapist scope of practice, raises the assistant supervision limit to three, and removes direct-treatment notice requirements.

title: Exempt surplus land: surplus land subject to a valid legal restriction.
summary: Adds option agreements to the contractual restrictions that let local agencies skip surplus land disposal requirements.

title: Health care coverage: claims payments.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Requires health plans and insurers to accept electronic medical records for claims starting 2028 and bars denying claims due to system limits.

title: California Voter ID and Election Integrity Act of 2025.
summary: Requires documentation of citizenship to register, photo-style ID to vote in person, and ID digits on mail ballots, plus state audits.

title: Sexual assault: statute of limitations.
summary: Extends the window for reviving time-barred sexual assault claims to 2026, revives claims against perpetrators, and exempts public entities.

title: Immigration services: immigration bonds.
summary: Expands the state immigration legal services grant program's definition of immigration benefits to include assistance with immigration bonds.

title: Local government.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to the provision allowing local legislative bodies to withdraw from associations.

title: Vehicles: driving under the influence: driving automation.
summary: Clarifies that DUI "drive" includes volitional movement of a vehicle with driver support features engaged, so impaired drivers using them can be charged.

title: California Interscholastic Federation: pupil health: heat illness: guidelines.
summary: Requires the California Interscholastic Federation to review and update its heat illness guidelines, procedures, and safety standards annually, starting 2027.

title: Community colleges: artificial intelligence: pilot program.
summary: Creates a contingent pilot program at up to 10 community colleges on AI in creative industries, with a legislative evaluation report and a 2033 repeal.

title: Electrical corporations: hydrogen refueling stations.
summary: Requires electric utilities to create tariffs letting them build and own utility-side power service for hydrogen refueling stations, sunsetting in 2033.

title: Cannabis: tribal-state agreements.
summary: Authorizes the Governor to enter cannabis commercial agreements with federally recognized tribes, contingent on federal approval of interstate cannabis activity.

title: Office of Tribal Affairs.
summary: Replaces the Governor's Tribal Advisor office with a new Office of Tribal Affairs, advised by a Tribal Advisory Committee, and requires state agencies to designate tribal liaisons.

title: Public Utilities Public Purpose Programs Fund.
topics: Environment and energy; Taxes and budget
summary: Creates a Public Utilities Public Purpose Programs Fund, shifting program funding from electricity charges to Greenhouse Gas Reduction Fund transfers subject to appropriation.

title: Education finance: average daily attendance: apportionments.
summary: Lets school districts use a five-year average daily attendance figure for local control funding formula calculations when that average is higher.

title: Elders and dependent adults: abuse or neglect.
summary: Allows courts to use a lower preponderance-of-evidence standard in elder abuse suits against care facilities that commit evidence spoliation.

title: CalWORKs.
summary: Expands CalWORKs eligibility for families reunifying with removed children, exempts them from immunization documentation, and ends certain sanctions.

title: Behavioral Health Provider Comparable Worth Study.
summary: Requires a state comparable worth study of behavioral health versus medical-surgical provider pay, plus insurer and provider data reporting with penalties for noncompliance.

title: Surplus Land Act: exemption: Angel Stadium.
summary: Exempts a possible Angel Stadium sale or lease from Surplus Land Act procedures and requires materials to call the team the Anaheim Angels.

title: Wildfire: Regional Forest and Fire Capacity Program: local assistance grant program: regional landscape grants.
summary: Lets the state directly award regional landscape grants for wildfire resilience and requires forest landscape funds to support ecosystem health projects and those grants.

title: Pupil achievement: State of the Achievement Gap Dashboard.
summary: Requires recommendations for an annually updated State of the Achievement Gap Dashboard tracking progress on closing pupil academic achievement gaps.

title: Childcare.
summary: Makes technical, nonsubstantive changes to a provision on staffing rules for state-contracted child care centers.

title: California Grid Manufacturing Initiative.
summary: Creates a state grid manufacturing initiative to support domestic production of electricity grid components and lets the PUC require utilities to jointly procure them.

title: Fire safety: fire hazard severity zones.
summary: Revises fire hazard severity zone designation process for local responsibility areas, adds public comment and review steps, and lets localities raise parcel hazard levels.

title: San Diego Gas and Electric Company: energization pilot program.
summary: Requires SDG&E, until 2030, to energize construction-ready projects within set timeframes and report on them.

title: State Teachers’ Retirement System: positions subject to membership.
summary: Expands State Teachers' Retirement System membership to include permitholders and certain charter school positions, operative July 1, 2027.

title: Wildfire protection: Department of Forestry and Fire Protection: staffing.
summary: Requires CAL FIRE to reach and maintain full year-round staffing at fire stations by 2028, subject to legislative appropriations.

title: Business records: disclosure.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to the existing ban on bookkeeping firms disclosing client records without consent.

title: California Council on Science and Technology: water availability study: Central Valley.
summary: Requires a study of water availability in two Central Valley watersheds, subject to legislative appropriation, with completion within two years.

title: Sales and Use Tax Law: exemption: over-the-counter medication.
summary: Exempts over-the-counter medications from state sales and use taxes until January 1, 2032, excluding local and Local Revenue Fund 2011 rates.

title: Public postsecondary education: governing bodies: biography and contact information.
summary: Requires CSU and California Community Colleges to post governing board members' contact information and biographies online, and encourages consideration of public input.

title: Pupils: work permits: issuance.
summary: Authorizes county probation departments and child welfare agencies to issue work permits to certain minors under juvenile court jurisdiction.

title: Surplus lands: Mission Bay Park.
summary: Exempts Mission Bay Park lands in San Diego from surplus land disposal requirements, with conditions including housing set-aside deposits from sales.

title: Special education local plan areas: apportionments: alternate assessments.
summary: Contingent on appropriation, extends special education low-incidence per-pupil funding to pupils eligible for alternate assessments.

title: Hospital applications: coordinated processing.
summary: Requires the state health departments to coordinate and concurrently process hospital applications, limiting automatic waiting periods before review.

title: Community colleges: governing board member compensation.
summary: Raises the cap on community college governing board member pay and requires 30 days' public notice before a vote to increase it.

title: Civil claims: public entities and employees: declaration.
summary: Requires claims against public entities or employees to include a declaration that the claim's contents are true and correct, upon information and belief.

title: California Residential Private Permitting Review Act: residential building permits.
summary: Allows applicants to hire private professional providers for residential building plan checks when county or city review is delayed, and requires fee schedule posting.

title: Employment: Cal/WARN Act: plant closings and mass layoffs.
summary: Expands Cal/WARN Act mass layoff and plant closing notice requirements, adds public agencies as covered employers, and sets backpay and civil penalties for violations.

title: Public health: abortion services.
summary: Expands eligibility for state abortion and contraception grants to Medi-Cal providers serving uninsured veterans, and requires VA to link to abortion information.

title: Cannabis: labels, packaging, and advertising.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice
summary: Adds cannabis label, container, and advertising requirements, including poison line numbers, serving markers, and a ban on marketing multi-serving beverages as single servings.

title: Personal income taxes: unemployment insurance: fitness benefit.
summary: Allows a deduction for employer-provided fitness benefits and excludes up to $600 per year from unemployment insurance wages.

title: Domestic Violence Prevention Act: forced marriage.
summary: Adds forced marriage to the Domestic Violence Prevention Act, letting courts issue protective orders against those who arrange or facilitate it.

title: School meals: State Healthy Food Access Policy.
summary: Revises the state food-access policy to include locally grown food and directs agencies and public universities to pursue farm-to-fork and local procurement strategies.

title: Horse racing: satellite wagering facilities: authorizations.
summary: Expands horse racing satellite wagering statewide, deletes a pre-licensing impact test, and limits joint San Francisco-area facilities to two.

title: Cannabis Enforcement Accountability and Public Health Prioritization Act of 2026.
summary: Requires the cannabis regulator to prioritize MAUCRSA enforcement by risk of harm, adopt a policy, and report enforcement data from 2028.

title: Medi-Cal: hospice providers: forms.
summary: Codifies a Medi-Cal hospice election notification form, requiring fee-for-service providers to submit it within five days of election.

title: Tribal-state gaming: compact ratification.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Environment and energy
summary: Ratifies a 2026 California gaming compact with the Yurok Tribe and exempts certain related actions from CEQA review.

title: California-Ireland Trade Commission.
summary: Creates a California-Ireland Trade Commission within the Governor's Office of Business and Economic Development, contingent on funding, to advise on bilateral trade.

title: Public health: public postsecondary education: student health centers: abortion by medication techniques.
summary: Requires community college student health centers, upon appropriation, to offer abortion by medication from 2029, and requires CSU and UC centers to promote those services.

title: Specialized license plates: The Lowrider.
summary: Creates a Lowrider specialized license plate sponsored by the Arts Council, with revenue funding lowrider arts and cultural preservation projects.

title: Human remains: disposition.
summary: Shifts control of a decedent's remains away from a person with a domestic violence restraining order or contrary to the decedent's best interests, with liability protection for funeral directors.

title: Emergency preparedness: fuel and transportation resources: assessment.
summary: Requires the Office of Emergency Services to submit a 2028 assessment of fuel and transportation access during emergencies, with recommendations.

title: Education for Filmmakers Pilot Program.
summary: Creates a GO-Biz pilot program to develop AI literacy training tied to entertainment-industry jobs, with a 2029 report and a 2034 repeal.

title: Report: labor force impact: artificial intelligence.
summary: Creates a 14-member advisory panel in the EDD to assess AI's labor force impact and report policy recommendations to the Legislature by 2028.

title: Director of Consumer Affairs: duties.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to the Department of Consumer Affairs and Director of Consumer Affairs duties provisions.

title: Life and disability insurance.
summary: Makes technical, nonsubstantive wording changes to existing life and disability insurance provisions on applicant statements and insurer liability.

title: Wages.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive changes to the statutory definitions of 'wages' and 'labor' used in wage payment provisions.

title: Electronic Waste Recycling Act of 2003: manufacturer notices.
summary: Requires manufacturers to send CalRecycle notices with UPCs for e-waste battery products, creates a database, and changes retailer duties for marketplace facilitators, discount stores and thrift stores.

title: The Supportive-Recovery Residence Program.
summary: Authorizes state funding for abstinence-focused supportive-recovery residences within Housing First rules, with anti-eviction and medication access protections.

title: Women in the construction industry: report.
summary: Requires the EDD to collect and report data on women in construction training and apprenticeship programs every three years.

title: Equity in Higher Education Act: time, place, and manner policies: student code of conduct violations: open forum.
summary: Adds protest-related student conduct violations and resulting discipline to required CSU reports, and requires a 2027 open forum on campus protest time, place, and manner rules.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: Transit-Oriented Development Implementation Fund: contributions.
summary: Allows CEQA lead agencies to require land use project applicants to contribute to the Transit-Oriented Development Implementation Fund, under cost and VMT conditions.

title: Real estate crimes: probation.
summary: Allows courts to extend probation by up to one year for certain real estate-related felonies, with state mandate reimbursement.

title: Railroad crossings: permit applications: review: public notice.
summary: Requires PUC proposed resolutions for exempt railroad crossing applications to also be publicly noticed on a publicly accessible website.

title: English learners: reclassification.
summary: Repeals multi-criteria English learner reclassification rules and shifts to a state test-score standard, while requiring schools to notify parents of EL classification.

title: Evidence: credibility of witnesses and evidence affected or excluded by extrinsic policies.
summary: Extends existing rape-shield limits on victim sexual-history evidence to sex offenses alleged to occur in local detention facilities or state prisons.

title: Legislative information system: bill position letters.
summary: Requires the Legislative Counsel to make public electronically all position letters submitted through the Legislature's portal on each bill.

title: Financial institutions: loans: interest rates.
summary: Caps annual percentage rates on small consumer loans under $2,500 and deferred deposit transactions at federal limits as of January 1, 2026.

title: Solid waste: construction debris: diversion: deposits.
summary: Requires cities and counties to fully refund construction debris deposits when permit holders document compliance with diversion requirements.

title: Crimes: intoxication and firearms.
summary: Creates a one-year enhancement for felons armed with a firearm while under the influence of a prohibited controlled substance, and authorizes blood-sample search warrants for it.

title: Climate Action Plan for Transportation Infrastructure: goals.
summary: Establishes Climate Action Plan for Transportation Infrastructure goals and requires funded transportation projects to apply them where feasible.

title: Operating systems and applications: privacy settings.
summary: Prohibits operating systems and applications from overriding users' privacy settings without the user's consent, with exceptions.

title: Alcohol or other drug recovery and treatment programs and facilities: suicide prevention.
summary: Requires licensed alcohol and drug treatment facilities and certified programs to adopt suicide prevention plans, with regulations due by 2031.

title: Sex discrimination: scope.
summary: Requires state laws barring sex discrimination to cover broad sex and gender characteristics, expanding Unruh and FEHA definitions of sex.

title: Surveillance pricing.
topics: AI and technology; Consumer protection and business
summary: Prohibits retailers from setting personalized or randomized prices for consumers using personal data or algorithms, subject to exceptions.

title: Medi-Cal: pharmacist services: reporting.
summary: Requires DHCS to clarify Medi-Cal managed care coverage of pharmacist services, update model coverage documents, and enforce compliance through guidance.

title: Huron Hawk Conservancy.
summary: Establishes the Huron Hawk Conservancy to acquire and manage public lands and conserve open space and habitat, contingent on appropriation or bond approval.

title: CalWORKs: immediate assistance.
summary: Requires counties to determine CalWORKs immediate and homeless assistance eligibility without first requiring applicants to claim unconditionally available income.

title: Water district directors: compensation.
summary: Lets large water districts pay board members for up to 15 days monthly until 2032, requiring an annual written justification for over 10 days.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: natural hazards and adverse environmental conditions.
summary: Expands CEQA environmental review to cover impacts on people and significant effects from locating projects near natural hazards or adverse conditions.

title: Specialty care networks: telehealth and other virtual services.
summary: Creates a subject-to-appropriation telehealth specialty care network demonstration and grant program to improve Medi-Cal specialty access for safety-net patients.

title: Elderly Parole Program.
summary: Raises the minimum age for the Elderly Parole Program from 50 to 65, narrowing which inmates can seek parole review.

title: Reimbursement for pharmacist services.
summary: Raises Medi-Cal reimbursement for advanced pharmacist services and requires private plans to pay enrolled pharmacists, including at health centers.

title: California State University: joint degrees.
summary: Authorizes CSU to jointly award doctoral, undergraduate and graduate degrees with independent and international institutions, without certain existing approval requirements.

title: Voter registration information: confidentiality.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Elections and voting
summary: Expands confidentiality of voter registration records, including elected officials and candidates, and requires a process for confidential voters to vote at polls.

title: Potentially dangerous and vicious dogs: notice of owner’s or keeper’s rights.
summary: Requires cities and counties to follow state dangerous-dog hearing, notice, and appeal rules, and requires courts to post hearing notices online and admit all relevant evidence.

title: Health care services: artificial intelligence.
summary: Protects health care workers from retaliation for using professional judgment on patient care and bars AI developers from using clinician override failures as a liability defense.

title: Transit-oriented development: exclusions: historic sites.
summary: Excludes certain historic district contributing sites and individually listed historical resources from the transit-oriented development housing provisions.

title: Safe Drinking Water and Toxic Enforcement Act of 1986: settlements: attorney’s fees.
summary: Adds court findings and attorney's fee limits for Proposition 65 settlements brought by private enforcers in the public interest.

title: Outdoor recreation: outdoor economy: strategic initiatives: support organizations.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Authorizes the Natural Resources Agency to contract with a support organization to advance outdoor recreation and park strategic initiatives.

title: Common interest developments: discipline.
summary: Allows HOA boards to impose fines above $100 for violations on a state-published list, and bars curing habitual violations by stopping them before hearings.

title: Fairs: allocation of revenues: gross receipts for sales and use tax.
summary: Raises the share of fair-related sales tax gross receipts sent to the Fair and Exposition Fund from 3/4 of 1% to 2%.

title: Teacher credentialing: programs of professional preparation: California State University and community college partnerships.
summary: Requires community college and CSU chancellors to develop, by 2027, a plan expanding teacher preparation partnerships, with implementation contingent on appropriation.

title: Housing: affordable housing tenants: home ownership.
summary: Requires state housing agencies to develop strategies by 2028 helping affordable housing tenants move into homeownership through existing programs.

title: Crimes: prostitution.
summary: Requires that people charged with a first or second prostitution offense for compensation be offered a diversion program, and reimburses local costs if mandated.

title: Office of Small Business Advocate: artificial intelligence.
summary: Requires the Small Business Advocate to help small businesses evaluate artificial intelligence through information, guidance, training, and outreach.

title: Self-defense.
summary: Clarifies self-defense rules for imminent threats, requires proportional resistance, bars considering fighting skill, and shields lawful resisters from civil liability.

title: California Guaranteed Income Pilot Program.
summary: Directs the guaranteed income pilot program to prioritize parents of young children and domestic violence victims, and removes proportional grant distribution.

title: Fire prevention: air quality and smoke monitoring.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive change to existing fire prevention provisions on air quality and smoke monitoring programs.

title: Food and agriculture: pesticide residue monitoring program.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to the reporting provision of the state pesticide residue monitoring program.

title: District agricultural associations: board of directors: vacancies.
summary: Lets a district agricultural association board temporarily appoint a director to fill vacancies when the Governor delays and quorum is lacking.

title: Public utilities: rates: changes to federal law.
summary: Requires the PUC to evaluate federal tax law changes and adjust utility rates when those changes materially affect authorized tax expenses.

title: Open meetings: local agencies: teleconferences.
summary: Extends until 2030 the Brown Act alternative teleconferencing rules and emergency remote-participation authority for local agency members.

title: Resource conservation: sentinel landscapes.
summary: Creates the California Sentinel Landscapes Act to coordinate the federal partnership and fund habitat projects in designated sentinel landscapes, contingent on non-General Fund resources.

title: Personal income tax: standard deduction: federal poverty level.
summary: Lets taxpayers claim a standard deduction equal to the federal poverty level starting in 2027.

title: Lobbyist ethics.
summary: Creates a state ethics and harassment training course for lobbyists and bars lobbyists convicted of public corruption from lobbying for 12 years.

title: Corrections: treatment of prisoners.
summary: Prohibits corrections staff from interfering with or refusing prescribed health care for incarcerated people that causes serious harm.

title: Voluntary employees’ beneficiary association pilot program.
summary: Extends a southern California health plan risk-bearing pilot to 2030, adds department termination power, and requires an interim report by 2029.

title: San Mateo Electric Bicycle Safety Pilot Program.
summary: Lets San Mateo localities ban under-12s from riding class 1 or 2 e-bikes via a pilot with warnings, then $25 fines.

title: Mobilehome parks: federally approved housing programs: compliance with state and local laws.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration; Housing
summary: Requires mobilehome park operators to keep complying with state law even if they opt out of federal housing requirements, and lets local agencies verify residents' age.

title: Claims against the state: appropriation.
summary: Appropriates $7.39 million from the General Fund to pay specified claims, settlements, and judgments against the state, effective immediately.

title: Health care facilities: notification of next of kin.
summary: Requires hospitals and skilled nursing facilities to notify known next of kin of a death, with daily civil penalties for failure.

title: Slavery: corporate disclosures.
summary: Upon appropriation, requires large pre-1965 businesses to file sworn affidavits on records of slavery-related transactions and creates a public disclosure platform.

title: Eliminate the Politicians’ Perks Act of 2025.
summary: Declares legislative intent to enact ethics rules: gift and stock-trading bans, a lifetime lobbying ban, and ending local official pensions.

title: Sexual and reproductive health care.
summary: Repeals unconstitutional abortion restrictions and lets pharmacists dispense medication abortion drugs without standard patient and prescriber labeling, with protections from discipline.

title: Immigration: access to legal counsel.
summary: Creates a subject-to-funding right to counsel for certain unrepresented immigrants in immigration proceedings, run by a new office within the Department of Social Services.

title: Planning and zoning: housing development: streamlined approval and subdivisions.
summary: Allows concurrent processing of small housing and urban lot split applications and lets localities condition permits on recording parcel maps.

title: Housing.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive wording change to the Manufactured Housing Act provision on local ordinances conflicting with federal-standard homes.

title: Hiring of real property: dwellings: untenantability.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive wording change to habitability standards for floors, stairways, and railings in dwelling units.

title: Elections: ballot curing.
summary: Requires the Secretary of State to create an electronic system letting voters cure mismatched vote-by-mail ballot signatures, and publish usage data.

title: State Public Defender: county public defenders: data collection.
summary: Requires counties to collect and report public defense data to the State Public Defender every two years starting 2029, subject to appropriation.

title: Oil and gas: subsurface energy transition research and demonstration projects: California State University, Bakersfield.
summary: Directs the state oil and gas regulator to prioritize approvals for low-carbon technologies and authorizes research programs with Cal State Bakersfield on subsurface and CO2 enhanced oil recovery demonstrations.

title: California Americans with Disabilities Act Small Business Capital Access Loan Program.
summary: Raises the ADA small business loan cap to $250,000, extends loan terms to 15 years, and transfers seismic fund money to it.

title: Energy: transportation fuels assessment.
summary: Requires the state energy commission's next transportation fuels assessment to also review human rights in oil-importing countries and domestic oil production barriers.

title: Tenancy: additional rents and securities: common household pets.
summary: Caps extra rent landlords may charge for tenants' pets at 1% of monthly rent and pet security at 15% of one month's rent, for agreements from 2027.

title: Fire safety: fire hazard severity zones: State Fire Marshal.
summary: Bars fire hazard zone designations from considering risk mitigation, and lets the State Fire Marshal confer with entities, post responses, and charge fees.

title: Patient access to health records.
summary: Makes technical, nonsubstantive changes to legislative findings about patients' access to their health records.

title: Electrical rates: credits: hot climate zones.
summary: Requires the PUC to ensure electric rates don't unreasonably burden schools or vulnerable customers in hot climates, and to provide extra residential credits there.

title: Building standards: qualified plug-in photovoltaic systems.
summary: Authorizes state building standards enabling plug-in solar systems to feed power into new homes and nonresidential buildings' electrical circuits starting 2031.

title: Health care service plans: provider contract termination: notice.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Requires health plans to give enrollees added email or text notice, and new post-agreement notices, when provider contracts terminate.

title: Public health: Body Brokering and Patient Referral Integrity Act.
summary: Prohibits paying or receiving referral kickbacks for residential treatment facilities, including sober living homes, and makes violations a misdemeanor.

title: Educational equity: discrimination.
summary: Removes a professional-responsibility standard for instructional materials, requires omitting discriminatory portions of materials, and revises discrimination complaint procedures.

title: Hiring of real property: indoor temperature.
summary: Requires landlords to keep dwellings at or below 82°F via cooling methods, allows tenant portable cooling devices, and creates a DHCD technical assistance website.

title: Protecting Kids from Online Gambling Act.
topics: AI and technology; Children and families; Consumer protection and business
summary: Bars online gambling and prediction market wagering to minors, requires age assurance, and allows AG and city attorney enforcement.

title: Public Utilities Commission: commissioners: employment.
summary: Bars Public Utilities Commission commissioners from working for regulated entities for two years after their terms end.

title: Water resources: data centers.
topics: AI and technology; Environment and energy
summary: Requires data centers to report water use under penalty of perjury when seeking local licenses; adds data centers to water supply assessments.

title: California Housing and Homelessness Agency: PINK Alert.
summary: Requires the housing agency to study pregnant people experiencing homelessness and recommend a PINK Alert notification system by 2028.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: exemption: wireless telecommunications facility: broadband internet access projects.
topics: AI and technology; Environment and energy
summary: Exempts wireless telecommunications and broadband internet access projects, other than small wireless facilities, from CEQA environmental review requirements.

title: Banking Law.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive wording change to Banking Law's requirement that bank articles of incorporation be submitted to the commissioner for approval.

title: Nurse Practitioner Advisory Committee.
summary: Changes the membership makeup of the Board of Registered Nursing's Nurse Practitioner Advisory Committee.

title: Public utilities: rate changes: notifications.
summary: Extends the advance notice public utilities must give before changing rates or services from 30 to 60 days.

title: Privacy for immigration support services providers.
topics: AI and technology; Civil rights and liberties
summary: Extends address confidentiality and anti-doxxing protections to immigration support services providers, staff, and volunteers, and bars online posting or sale of their personal information.

title: Dental Practice Act: foreign dental schools.
summary: Extends licensure eligibility for graduates of foreign dental schools approved before 2020, with conditional approval tied to accreditation applications and status updates.

title: Housing programs: financing.
summary: Allows the housing department to waive certain loan payments covering monitoring costs for affordable housing projects based on ability to pay.

title: California Rangeland, Grazing Land, and Grassland Protection Program.
summary: Appropriates $90 million in bond funds for grants to acquire conservation easements on privately owned rangeland and grazing land.

title: County Fire Service Retirement Law: benefits.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to the County Fire Service Retirement Law's pension benefit provision, without changing benefit amounts.

title: Vehicles: registration services.
summary: Caps the additional fee registration services may charge for DMV-provided services at 5% above the department's fee.

title: Scott River: Shasta River: watersheds.
summary: Extends emergency water-flow regulations for Scott and Shasta River watersheds until 2031 or permanent instream flow rules, requiring annual public updates.

title: Water diversion and use: adoption of regulations.
summary: Requires the State Water Board to adopt further water diversion reporting regulations as emergency rules exempt from CEQA through 2031.

title: Criminal procedure: prohibited violations.
summary: Adds exercise of First Amendment rights to "prohibited violation" and extends bans on records production under out-of-state warrants to federal court orders.

title: Education and workforce development: statewide framework.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Creates a statewide education vision framework by 2028 and bars franchisors from misusing segregated franchise fees, capping overhead at 10%.

title: Secondhand dealers.
summary: Expands secondhand dealer regulation to all businesses dealing in used goods, adds reporting duties, and bars local licensing without a state license.

title: Workforce development: High road training partnerships: scoring preference.
summary: Requires the state workforce board to give grant scoring preference to applicants partnering with labor-management cooperation committees in high road training programs.

title: Air pollution: small off-road engines: voucher programs: local regulation.
topics: Criminal justice; Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Requires air districts to run zero-emission equipment voucher programs if funded, and bars criminal penalties for local landscaping-equipment ordinance violations.

title: Juveniles.
summary: Requires courts to consider whether a juvenile is charged with carrying a loaded firearm when evaluating deferred entry of judgment suitability.

title: Residential property insurance.
summary: Makes technical, nonsubstantive changes to an existing insurer notice requirement about statutes of limitation for corrosive-soil property claims.

title: Gasoline prices.
summary: Raises the Energy Commission's civil penalty for refusing to provide gasoline price records to the Department of Tax and Fee Administration from $10,000 to $15,000.

title: Merced County Flood Control District: assessment.
summary: Requires the Legislative Analyst's Office to assess the Merced County Flood Control District's efficacy and requires the district to coordinate with local agencies.

title: Veterans: benefits.
summary: Repeals the rule barring dependents of veterans from receiving state educational benefits while they receive federal education benefits or other duplicate aid.

title: Commission on State Mandates: state mandates.
summary: Requires the Controller to notify local agencies and school districts in writing within 30 days of audit or review adjustments, and lets them choose an offset or payment adjustment.

title: Sales and use taxes: exclusion: pawnbrokers: transfer of vested property.
summary: Extends a sales and use tax exclusion for pawnbroker transfers of pledged property to pledgors until 2032, without state reimbursement to local agencies.

title: Prisons: employment of inmates.
summary: Makes technical, nonsubstantive wording changes to the existing requirement that able-bodied state prisoners perform faithful labor.

title: Insurance: health coverage.
summary: Makes technical, nonsubstantive changes to existing rules on health coverage providers under Department of Insurance jurisdiction.

title: Gambling Control Act.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Requires the Governor to notify the Legislature when a Gambling Control Commission member is removed, and makes technical, nonsubstantive changes to gambling licensing provisions.

title: Veterans: registration and identification services.
summary: Requires DMV, with Veterans Affairs, to provide annual mobile license, ID and Real ID services to residents of California veterans' homes.

title: Employment: minimum wages: agricultural workers.
summary: Sets a $19.75 minimum hourly wage for agricultural workers, with annual cost-of-living adjustments starting in 2027.

title: Energy: nuclear powerplants: assessment.
summary: Requires the Energy Commission to assess advanced nuclear technologies' role and potential for new in-state nuclear plants by 2028.

title: Crimes: alternatives to incarceration.
summary: Makes a technical, nonsubstantive change to a provision on courts considering alternatives to incarceration and least restrictive dispositions.

title: Youth service organizations: parent volunteers.
summary: Exempts parent volunteers at youth service organizations from child abuse training, while requiring them to undergo background checks.

title: Small Business Recovery Fund Act.
summary: Creates a Small Business Recovery Fund, upon appropriation, for disaster-affected small business grants, technical assistance, and a repeal date of 2032.

title: CalSavers: retirement savings.
summary: Expands the CalSavers retirement program to household employers, eliminates the myRA investment option, and adds Saver's Match outreach.

title: Informed Parents, Healthy Schools Act.
summary: Requires the state to set immunization rate levels and notify schools and parents when rates fall below them, with school distribution duties.

title: Teacher credentialing: world languages: subject matter examinations: language proficiency assessments.
summary: Allows teacher credential candidates to meet world language exam requirements through comparable postsecondary language proficiency assessments.

title: State contracts: report: modern foundation models and associated artificial intelligence systems.
topics: AI and technology; Labor and employment
summary: Creates a labor working group on foundation model development and requires forced-labor certifications for state procurement of AI products needing data enrichment services.

title: Vehicles: equipment.
summary: Makes a technical, nonsubstantive change to the Vehicle Code provision banning sale or installation of nonconforming vehicle parts.

title: Campaign funds: security expenses: security personnel.
summary: Limits campaign-fund payments for security personnel to those holding a license from the Bureau of Security and Investigative Services.

title: Public employees: notice: artificial intelligence performing service within scope of work.
topics: AI and technology; Government and administration
summary: Requires public employers to give unions 45 days' written notice before developing, buying, or requiring GenAI to perform work within represented job classifications.

title: Prescriptions.
summary: Makes only nonsubstantive wording changes to the rule requiring pharmacist or authorized receipt of Schedule II-IV controlled substance deliveries.

title: Community property in trust.
summary: Clarifies spouses can fund trusts with community property interests and requires a state study on elder theft in long-term care facilities.

title: Vehicles: commercial driver’s license.
summary: Requires DMV to give 180 days' notice before revoking or downgrading a commercial driver's license for administrative errors, and allows a one-time extension.

title: Freeway Service Patrol Act: sponsorship agreement.
summary: Allows freeway service patrol operators to sell sponsor name and logo displays on tow trucks, with guidelines for those sponsorship agreements.

title: Public postsecondary education: intersegmental partnerships: STEM education.
summary: Creates the Cal-Bridge and ENLACE STEM programs to support public college students pursuing STEM PhDs and high school and undergraduate STEM pathways.

title: Search warrants: newborn screening program.
summary: Allows the state to release newborn blood specimens to coroners or police for missing-person DNA cases and adds related reporting requirements.

title: Working Group on Civil Rights Accountability.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Creates a DOJ working group to build a dashboard documenting alleged civil rights violations from federal immigration enforcement, and exempts its reports from the Public Records Act.

title: Alcoholic beverages: retail on-sale license: off-sale privileges.
summary: Extends until December 31, 2029, the authority for restaurant on-sale licensees and certain manufacturers to sell alcohol for off-sale consumption.

title: Places of religious worship: unlawful activities.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice
summary: Creates a 100-foot buffer zone around houses of worship barring leafleting, signs, or protest within 8 feet of people entering or exiting, with fines or jail.

title: Medi-Cal funding: County of Inyo.
summary: Appropriates $5.5 million from the General Fund for Medi-Cal supplemental payments to two Inyo County healthcare districts to prevent hospital closures.

title: Public postsecondary education.
summary: States legislative intent to enact future legislation on public postsecondary education, without changing current law.

title: Vape products: household hazardous waste: advertising.
summary: Bans vape marketing that imitates non-vape products or includes videogame features, with civil penalties; also studies school vape pen disposal.

title: Acupuncture: license requirements and title protection.
summary: Raises acupuncture doctoral-degree education requirements from 2032 and restricts use of the licensed acupuncturist and Doctor titles to licensed practitioners.

title: Pleas: immigration.
summary: Requires prosecutors to meet and confer to avoid immigration consequences of pleas, with a presumed violation and hearing when alternative pleas are declined.

title: Greenhouse Gas Reduction Fund: high-speed rail: water infrastructure and wildfire prevention.
summary: Suspends two years of high-speed rail funding from the Greenhouse Gas Reduction Fund and redirects it to the General Fund for water and wildfire programs.

title: Medi-Cal: fraud assessment task force.
summary: Creates a Medi-Cal fraud assessment task force, contingent on appropriation, to review fraud risks and recommend improvements by 2028.

title: The Director of Motor Vehicles.
summary: Makes a technical, nonsubstantive change to a provision on how the Director of Motor Vehicles organizes the DMV.

title: Transportation fuels: gasoline specifications: air pollution.
summary: Allows alternative gasoline specifications in refinery turnaround plans, moves the state fuels assessment deadline, and redirects variance fee revenue.

title: Personal Income Tax Law: Corporation Tax Law: credit: childcare.
topics: Children and families; Taxes and budget
summary: Creates a 50% tax credit for contributions to promote childcare, for tax years 2027 through 2031, capped at $100,000.

title: State Air Resources Board: internet website: methane emissions data.
summary: Requires the Air Resources Board to publicly post landfill methane temperature and monitoring data on its website.

title: School accountability: local control and accountability plans: education technology: best practices.
summary: Directs the Department of Education to compile edtech best practices and a model LCAP policy, hold webinars, and identify ways to encourage adoption.

title: Housing Crisis Act of 2019.
summary: Expands the Housing Crisis Act's ban on local housing moratoria to sphere-of-influence areas and subjects voter-initiated moratoria to state approval.

title: Essential services buildings.
summary: Makes technical, nonsubstantive changes to the Essential Services Buildings Seismic Safety Act's review and inspection provisions.

title: Preschool programs: QRIS block grant.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive changes to existing law on the early learning QRIS block grant for preschool quality programs.

title: State highways: public parking: traffic control.
summary: Authorizes Caltrans to contract for Tahoe corridor parking fees and enforcement, with fee and penalty revenue dedicated to Tahoe highway and enforcement funds.

title: State holidays: Diwali.
summary: Adds Diwali as a state holiday, allowing optional time off and school closures, plus optional celebratory exercises in schools.

title: Deaf and Disabled Telecommunications Program: certification.
summary: Removes professional certification requirements for subscribers to state deaf, disability, and speech-device telecommunications programs.

title: Write-in candidates: fees.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive wording change to existing law on fees charged to write-in candidates.

title: Transportation network company drivers: labor relations: appeals.
summary: Lets parties aggrieved by Public Employment Relations Board unfair practice decisions under the TNC driver labor act seek writ review, and sets filing and enforcement procedures.

title: Crimes: child endangerment.
summary: Adds sentence enhancements for adults who recruit minors into felonies and for murders of minors where other minors are present.

title: Juveniles: nonminor dependents: out-of-state placement: visitation.
summary: Allows out-of-state nonminor dependents in foster care to have some monthly visits virtually, with required quarterly in-person visits and consent.

title: Food and agriculture: omnibus bill.
summary: Lets the California Walnut Commission recommend, and the Secretary adopt, walnut quality standards and labeling requirements, plus other omnibus food and agriculture changes.

title: Financial institutions.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to the Financial Code's name provision, with no change to financial institution regulation.

title: Educational outcomes.
summary: Declares legislative intent to enact future laws improving K-12 educational outcomes, without changing any current requirement.

title: Energy: offshore wind infrastructure.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive change to the state's existing offshore wind infrastructure support program requirement.

title: Low-income housing tax credits: lease nonrenewal: good cause.
summary: Allows owners of fully low-income tax-credit housing to nonrenew leases for households over 140% of area median income, with 90-day notice.

title: Dam Safety and Climate Resilience Local Assistance Program.
summary: Adds removal of project facilities as projects eligible for state dam safety funding under the existing Local Assistance Program.

title: Civil actions: provisional remedies: injunctions.
summary: Expands taxpayer standing so a person can sue the state or a state entity to stop illegal expenditures or waste of funds.

title: Elections: elective office: felony conviction.
summary: Bars candidates convicted of felonies involving sexual assault or human trafficking from being considered for or elected to state or local office.

title: Common interest developments: reinstatement of terminated declarations: County of Los Angeles.
summary: Creates a Los Angeles County-only process to reinstate and extend terminated common interest development declarations, sunsetting in 2028.

title: California State University: California Maritime Academy.
summary: Adds 'Cal Poly Maritime' names to state-protected CSU names, extending misdemeanor penalties, and requires a 2028 report on the Maritime Academy's integration.

title: Public postsecondary education: community colleges: statewide baccalaureate degree program.
summary: Adds workforce-need and non-displacement requirements and caps applications for community college baccalaureate programs, starting in 2028.

title: Public Utilities Commission: reports.
summary: Changes the Public Utilities Commission's required legislative report on case timeliness and hearing attendance from annual to biannual.

title: Coastal protection: findings and declarations.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to the Coastal Act's findings and declarations, with no change to coastal protection rules.

title: Cannabis: drive-throughs.
summary: Authorizes local governments to allow licensed cannabis retailers and microbusinesses to sell cannabis through drive-through windows.

title: Juveniles: diversion.
summary: Creates a county youth court diversion pilot with student juries for first-time misdemeanants, and raises the carjacking prison term to 4, 6, or 10 years.

title: Public utilities.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to the provision naming the Public Utilities Act, with no substantive effect.

title: Personal Income Tax Law: Corporation Tax Law: Chiquita Canyon elevated temperature landfill event: exclusions.
summary: Excludes Chiquita Canyon landfill event compensation from state income tax and bars counting it as income for means-tested programs.

title: Department of Forestry and Fire Protection: autonomous firefighting pilot project.
summary: Creates a California pilot project to assess autonomous firefighting helicopters for possible operational wildfire use, with operator reporting to the state.

title: Public Utilities Commission: electrical corporations: wildfire victim restitution shortfalls: report: restitution mechanisms.
summary: Requires the Public Utilities Commission to report by 2028 on wildfire victim restitution shortfalls and recommend utility payment mechanisms.

title: Domestic Violence Offender Registration Act.
summary: Creates a domestic violence offender registry with up to 20-year registration, a removal petition process, and new penalties for misuse and noncompliance.

title: Residential Care Facilities for the Elderly on Faith-Based Lands Act of 2026.
topics: Government and administration; Health care; Housing
summary: Allows residential care facilities for the elderly on religious-owned land by right, with density bonuses and capped parking, overriding local zoning.

title: Postsecondary education: access to higher education.
summary: Makes only a nonsubstantive change to existing legislative findings and declarations on access to higher education.

title: Fee Schedule Intensive Technical Support for Onboarding Program.
summary: Creates a program, contingent on appropriation, providing technical assistance to schoolsite behavioral health providers to increase youth reimbursements under the statewide fee schedule.

title: Property taxation: tax-defaulted property sales: excess proceeds claims.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Taxes and budget
summary: Adds written, signed, disclosure conditions on agreements with agents who file excess-proceeds claims on tax-defaulted property, and lets counties accept minor claim corrections.

title: Acidified foods and low-acid foods.
summary: Requires registration and state-approved scheduled processes for commercial acidified and low-acid food makers, adds a $350 annual fee, and repeals cannery licensing provisions.

title: Department of Parks and Recreation.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to the statute establishing the Department of Parks and Recreation and its director.

title: Grand juries.
summary: Makes a technical, nonsubstantive change to the statute setting grand juror fees at $15 per day.

title: Health facilities: limited liability companies.
summary: Makes technical, nonsubstantive changes to health facility licensing provisions applying corporate requirements to limited liability companies.

title: Crimes: looting.
summary: Makes looting from burglary or grand theft a felony, and makes emergency-zone petty theft looting with felony or jail penalties plus an impersonation enhancement.

title: Public utilities: electrical and gas corporations: financial distress: reporting.
summary: Restricts utilities receiving public aid during financial distress unless shareholders contribute equity, and requires quarterly and legislative financial reporting.

title: Oil and gas: notice of intention.
summary: Sets 10- and 30-working-day deadlines for oil and gas well drilling and abandonment notices, with deemed completeness and deemed approval if the state misses them.

title: Oil and gas: notices of intention: health protection zones: new wells.
summary: Limits the health protection zone approval ban to new wells and repeals the ban on new production facilities there.

title: California AI Transparency Act: system provenance data.
summary: Revises large online platform duties on AI provenance data, exempting data and signatures that do not comply with standards-body specifications.

title: Unemployment compensation.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive wording change to the existing ban on employers deducting unemployment contributions from employee wages.

title: School districts: local authority.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to the statute describing school district governing boards' authority to act.

title: Oil and gas: bonding requirements.
summary: Tightens financial assurance for oil and gas operators, requiring enforceable plugging schedules and penalties for failing to report inability to meet financial criteria.

title: Outdoor advertising displays: arenas: exemptions.
summary: Extends and modifies a Department of Transportation outdoor advertising exemption for arena displays, adding approval, federal-consistency, count, and spacing conditions.

title: City streets: change of grade.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to the Change of Grade Act that lets city councils modify city street grades.

title: Vehicles: certificates of title.
summary: Adds statutory definitions of title, certificate of title, and certificate of ownership for vehicles, and makes technical, nonsubstantive changes.

title: Heavy-Duty Vehicle Inspection and Maintenance Program.
summary: Requires the Air Resources Board to give the first heavy-duty vehicle inspection program report by December 31, 2026.

title: Human trafficking victim support coordinator.
summary: Requires law enforcement agencies to designate human trafficking victim support coordinators, who complete training and liaise with victims and community organizations.

title: Unfair Competition Law: hotels.
summary: Requires hotels aware of CBP or ICE reservations to post worker notices and disclose possible agent presence to guests on request; sunsets 2029.

title: Motor Vehicle Fuel Tax Law: suspension of tax.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Suspends the one-year motor vehicle fuel tax, requires savings be passed to consumers, and mandates machine-readable environmental data publication.

title: The California American Freedmen Affairs Division: resident registry.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Creates a Secretary of State division to verify American Freedmen status and keep a resident registry, with limits on sharing personal data.

title: Insurance: distressed areas.
summary: Requires annual updates of insurance distressed areas to match wildfire WUI maps and raises penalties for insurers that fail to file fire-risk reports.

title: Crimes: schools.
summary: Makes technical, nonsubstantive changes to the crime of trespassing on school campuses by suspended or dismissed students.

title: School facilities: disposal of surplus technology property.
summary: Lets school and community college districts and county offices sell, trade in, or donate surplus technology under new disposal procedures.

title: Corrections: parole and prerelease treatment.
summary: Restricts elderly parole eligibility for certain sex offenders, requires sexual dangerousness screenings and SVP referrals for indeterminate-sentenced prisoners, and adds board training.

title: Groundwater: de minimis extractors: fees: exemption.
summary: Allows local agencies to exempt de minimis groundwater extractors from groundwater management fees after making specified findings.

title: Medi-Cal: Employer Responsibility for Medi-Cal Trust Fund.
summary: Creates a Medi-Cal trust fund from employer penalties and new taxes, continuously appropriated to prevent loss of Medi-Cal coverage after federal changes.

title: Greenhouse Gas Reduction Fund: high-speed rail: infrastructure improvements.
summary: Redirects 25% of Greenhouse Gas Reduction Fund proceeds from High-Speed Rail Authority to General Fund for local infrastructure starting 2026-27.

title: City building disposal.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive, procedural changes to the process by which cities may sell public buildings and sites.

title: Alcoholic beverage control: neighborhood-restricted on-sale general licenses.
summary: Authorizes the state to issue up to 12 new neighborhood-restricted on-sale liquor licenses to eating places in specified Santa Cruz County census tracts.

title: Educational outcomes.
summary: Declares legislative intent to later enact laws improving K-12 educational outcomes, without substantive changes now.

title: Local agencies.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive wording change to the definition of 'local agency' in the common powers of cities and counties.

title: Vehicles: special interest license plates.
summary: Redirects specialty license plate fee revenue, starting in 2027, toward coastal programs, coastal access grants, and Outdoor Equity Grants.

title: Reproductive health care.
summary: Makes a technical, nonsubstantive change to the California Reproductive Health Equity Program provision.

title: California Environmental Quality Act.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to CEQA's legislative findings and statement of intent, with no change to requirements.

title: California Early Intervention Services Act.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive, technical change to California's early intervention services act for infants and toddlers.

title: Construction guidelines for straw-bale structures.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive wording change to interim provisions governing straw-bale construction standards and their operation.

title: Water: affordability and system stabilization.
summary: Creates a water affordability trust, funded by legislative transfers, to support water rate assistance and community water system infrastructure grants.

title: Abandoned and derelict vessels: inventory.
summary: Requires the State Lands Commission to inventory abandoned and derelict vessels in the Sacramento-San Joaquin Delta by 2027, subject to appropriation.

title: Enforcement of money judgments: exemptions.
summary: Clarifies that the existing exemption for materials used to repair or improve a residence applies to a judgment debtor's principal residence or domicile.

title: Housing element: inventory of land: substantial compliance.
summary: Lets cities and counties meet housing element rezoning requirements with overlay or mixed-use zones permitting multifamily housing, and applies only to the 6th cycle.

title: Property ownership.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to existing provisions on public and private property ownership.

title: Buy California Program: task forces: events drawing significant world attention.
summary: Authorizes the Department of Food and Agriculture to create a task force advising on marketing California farm products during a major world event.

title: Oil and gas: chief deputy.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive wording change to the qualifications required for oil and gas chief deputies.

title: International trade and investment: Global Partnership Advisory Body.
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Expands California's international trade and investment program, creates an advisory body, allows regional trade hubs, and raises the trade promotion spending cap to $500,000.

title: Consumer debt: medical credit cards and medical debt.
summary: Requires medical credit card offers to disclose they are credit cards with signed consent, broadens medical debt definition, and limits credit reporting of medical card purchases.

title: Vehicles: manufacturers: engine labeling.
summary: Makes technical, nonsubstantive changes to existing vehicle engine-manufacturer labeling requirements.

title: Building standards: affordable housing developments: electric vehicle charging.
summary: Lets affordable housing projects permitted 2025-2028 comply with either the 2025 or 2024 supplemental EV charging building standards, repealing in 2030.

title: Crimes: loitering.
summary: Narrows the loitering-for-commercial-sex offense so it requires a direct act showing definite intent to purchase commercial sex.

title: Office of Emergency Services: wildfire aerial response program.
summary: Creates a working group to study and recommend a year-round wildfire aerial response program, reporting findings by December 31, 2027.

title: Development projects.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive wording change to existing rules on preliminary applications for housing development projects.

title: Alcoholic beverages: imports: personal or household use: reasonable amounts.
summary: Raises the personal-use limit for alcohol brought into California from abroad to 6 liters every 31 days, replacing the federal duty-free amount.

title: Bay Area Air Quality Management District and South Coast Air Quality Management District: policies: oil refineries.
summary: Requires Bay Area and South Coast air districts to analyze and weigh cost, tax, and gasoline supply impacts before adopting refinery rules.

title: Elective office: sex offenders.
summary: Bans anyone who has ever been required to register as a sex offender from running for or holding state or local elective office.

title: School safety.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive change to the statute allowing school districts to establish school police departments.

title: Unlawful detainer defined.
summary: Makes a technical, nonsubstantive change to the definition of unlawful detainer in tenant eviction law.

title: Medi-Cal: vision services: performance measures.
summary: Requires the Medi-Cal department to create vision service performance measures, benchmarks, and an annual complaints report by 2028.

title: Affordability and cost of living.
summary: Declares legislative intent to enact future legislation addressing affordability and cost of living in California.

title: Criminal procedure: statute of limitations.
summary: Makes a technical, nonsubstantive change to existing statute of limitations provisions for certain sex offenses against minors.

title: Agricultural pest control advisers: refusal, revocation, or suspension of licenses.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to the grounds for refusing, revoking, or suspending agricultural pest control adviser licenses.

title: Background checks.
summary: Allows community care licensees to approve caregivers before out-of-state abuse registry checks finish, and requires removal and notice if disqualifying information arises.

title: Law enforcement: wearable electroshock devices.
summary: Bans law enforcement agencies from using wearable electroshock devices in California until 2030, and bars state funds for purchasing them.

title: Vehicles: crash data.
summary: Requires crash investigation reports to be submitted electronically to the CHP, with free electronic copies available to requestors.

title: Electrical corporations and gas corporations: rates.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to the PUC requirement to disallow costs from unreasonable utility plant errors in rate-setting.

title: Taxation.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive change to the Revenue and Taxation Code provisions governing various taxes.

title: Extended foster care.
summary: Bars denying or ending extended foster care benefits to nonminor dependents for failing education or work requirements beyond existing law.

title: CalFresh and CalWORKs: childhood hunger and foster youth.
summary: Adjusts CalFresh work requirements after federal changes, keeping existing exemptions in place and protecting foster youth from discontinuation.

title: Public postsecondary education: student housing: foster youth and homeless youth.
summary: Requires community college campuses, and CSU and UC campuses subject to the Regents' agreement, to prioritize foster and homeless youth for student housing and to ask applicants about foster youth eligibility; extends foster youth enrollment priority to older NextUp participants.

title: Juveniles: family finding.
summary: Requires county social workers to conduct family finding and relative outreach within set timelines, with disclosure rules and mandatory staff training.

title: Student financial aid: waiver or deferment of fees and costs: foster youth.
summary: Requires public and state-aided private colleges to waive or defer unpaid enrollment fees and costs for foster and former foster youth at initial enrollment.

title: Adoption Assistance Program: eligibility.
summary: Expands Adoption Assistance Program eligibility to 18-year-old nonminors in high school or equivalent training until age 19, with state-backed funding if federal match is unavailable.

title: Behavioral health centers, facilities, and programs: background checks.
summary: Requires people who provide behavioral health treatment at centers, facilities, or programs to undergo a criminal background check.

title: State Property: San Pasqual Battlefield State Park.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Requires the state to quitclaim San Pasqual Battlefield State Park land parcels to the San Pasqual Band and exempts them from property tax.

title: California Private Postsecondary Education Act of 2009.
summary: Tightens oversight of private postsecondary institutions by adding reporting duties, citation and revocation penalties, and grounds to deny approval, while removing some flight-training exemption conditions.

title: Interior designers.
summary: Extends interior designer certification program to 2031 and requires designers and insurers to report large judgments and settlements.

title: California Board of Occupational Therapy: licensing: fees.
summary: Extends the Occupational Therapy Board to 2031, adds email and fee requirements, requires ACOTE-accredited programs, and exempts doctoral capstones.

title: Physical Therapy Board of California.
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Extends the Physical Therapy Board through 2031, raises license fees, and bars reinstatement petitions by sex offenders and certain sexual misconduct convicts.

title: Chiropractic Act.
summary: Extends the Chiropractic Act's review date to 2031, revises board fees, lets the board create temporary licenses for unlicensed practitioners, and changes directory distribution.

title: Hazardous materials.
summary: Exempts certain small hazardous waste generators from storage facility permits and excludes waste compaction from the definition of treatment.
