title: State Water Pollution Control Revolving Fund program: loans: outdoor eating areas: water reuse.
summary: Revises State Water Pollution Control Revolving Fund loan and fee terms, removing interest-rate caps and the budget-act revenue tie, and allowing fees in place of annual charges.

title: Food and agriculture.
summary: Makes existing meat, poultry and inspector licensing fee provisions permanent and requires the nutrition incentive program to align with federal grant programs.

title: Food labeling: quality dates, safety dates, and sell-by dates.
summary: Excludes dietary supplements from the definition of food items, so state date-label rules no longer apply to them; the bill takes effect immediately.

title: Health care affordability.
summary: Requires the Health Care Affordability Board to create a patient advocate advisory committee that meets publicly at least four times yearly.

title: Public employees’ retirement.
summary: Revises CalSTRS rules on retired member activities, sick day calculation, investment duties, and membership notice timing for part-time and substitute employees.

title: Civil cases: filing fees.
summary: Raises the civil case dollar thresholds for small claims and limited civil filing fee tiers, so more cases qualify for lower fees.

title: Judiciary omnibus.
summary: Removes auto cancellation option agreement disclosures and price rules, and raises the homestead exemption amount with annual inflation adjustments.

title: Court reporting.
summary: Lets RPR certification satisfy the court reporter exam's dictation portion and extends the remote court reporting pilot through 2028.

title: State Bar of California.
summary: Revises State Bar governance provisions, expands closed-session grounds, extends CLA fee collection to 2030, and adds attorney subpoena power.

title: Elections: redistricting information.
summary: Requires county election officials to provide precinct-level returns and a street index to the Legislature via a secure electronic process, and makes unredacted precinct returns confidential.

title: Elections.
summary: Revises election code references and requires lead counties to coordinate measure text, analysis, and argument deadlines and transmittals for multi-county special district measures.

title: Water, parks, and wildlife: omnibus bill.
summary: Omnibus bill exempting Nevada-registered vessels at Lake Tahoe and Topaz Lake from California mussel sticker citations, and requiring periodic groundwater basin reprioritization reviews.

title: Transportation: omnibus bill.
summary: Omnibus transportation bill that lets Alameda County revise a Route 238 local transportation program, extends pilotage insurance rules to the Sacramento and Stockton ports, and makes related changes.

title: Mediation: child custody and visitation.
summary: Requires written notice of custody mediation to all parties, creates a mediation notice form on confidentiality, and separate sessions where domestic violence is alleged.

title: School libraries: model library standards.
summary: Requires periodic review and possible revision of state school library services standards, with expert input and public hearings, subject to appropriation.

title: California Teleconnect Fund Administrative Committee Fund program.
summary: Expands California Teleconnect Fund discounts to more schools, school districts, libraries, and affiliated noninstructional facilities, and shifts E-rate ordering to providers.

title: Public resources.
summary: Removes a forest-harvest exemption condition requiring forester marking, and limits Coastal Commission permit review exemptions to state universities.

title: Horse racing: out-of-state thoroughbred races: New York Stakes.
summary: Exempts New York Stakes races from the 75-per-day limit on imported out-of-state thoroughbred races that California tracks may simulcast and take wagers on.

title: California Gambling Control Commission.
summary: Broadens the experience qualification for one California Gambling Control Commission member to include gaming law, plus technical changes.

title: Postsecondary education: nonresident tuition: exemption: federal GI Bill.
summary: Adds Montgomery GI Bill-Selected Reserve recipients to the programs that exempt eligible veterans from California community college and CSU nonresident tuition.

title: Financial regulation.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Repeals a small-business financing act, tightens credit ratings for state investments while loosening maturity limits, and allows electronic fee notices by the financial regulator.

title: Criminal history information: background checks.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Labor and employment
summary: Requires fingerprint-based criminal background checks for registered nurse applicants and expands state criminal history information access to local governments and tribal peace officers.

title: Solid waste landfills: subsurface temperatures.
summary: Requires landfill operators to report subsurface elevated temperature events, authorizes corrective plans and $100,000-per-day penalties, and creates a county mitigation fund.

title: Health care coverage: provider directories.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Requires plans and insurers to use a central utility and uniform standards for provider directories, plus coverage and billing protections for reliance on errors.

title: Comprehensive sexual health education and human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) prevention education: outside consultants.
summary: Requires school districts to let parents inspect sexual health and HIV education materials, copy non-copyrighted handouts, and disclose outside instructors' affiliations and training.

title: Elections: seizure of election materials.
summary: Makes seizing ballots, election records, or voting technology before certification a felony, with enhanced penalties for supervisors who direct it.

title: In-Home Supportive Services Employer-Employee Relations Act.
summary: Creates a collective bargaining act for in-home supportive services providers, making the state their employer of record for bargaining.

title: Law enforcement: Racial and Identity Profiling Advisory Board (RIPA).
summary: Narrows which police interactions count as reportable stops, adds a district attorney association president to the RIPA board, and allows dissenting opinions in its reports.

title: Criminal procedure: protective orders.
summary: Requires courts to issue a temporary protective order for victims when a defendant sentenced to state prison is released, lasting up to 180 days.

title: Electricity: mandatory rate reduction.
summary: Requires the Public Utilities Commission to report recommendations for cutting electricity rates by at least 30% by 2027.

title: Elections: polling places and vote centers.
summary: Requires districts to provide polling sites with adequate space for voting and supply storage, and to offer accessible and curbside parking when requested.

title: Employment: labor organization and unfair practices.
summary: Lets workers under NLRB-ceded jurisdiction petition California's PERB to enforce labor rights, with civil penalties and a new enforcement fund.

title: State highway work zone speed safety program.
summary: Authorizes Caltrans to use up to 35 speed safety cameras in state highway work zones through 2032, with citation revenue going to a new account.

title: Medi-Cal: Adverse Childhood Experiences trauma screenings: providers.
summary: Adds community-based organizations, local health jurisdictions and doulas as Medi-Cal providers eligible for payment for ACEs trauma screenings.

title: California FAIR Plan Association: automatic payments.
summary: Requires the FAIR Plan to create an automatic premium payment system and bars canceling or nonrenewing policies solely for not enrolling.

title: Teachers: credentialed educator apprenticeship programs.
summary: Creates credentialed educator apprenticeship programs, letting unlicensed employed candidates get permits while training under state-approved oversight.

title: Domestic violence.
summary: Increases penalties for felony domestic violence, requires jail as a probation condition for repeat offenders, and adds it to three strikes violent felonies.

title: Groundwater sustainability agency: transparency.
summary: Requires groundwater sustainability agencies to publish board membership and links to officials' economic interest statements online.

title: Recovery from disaster or emergency: funding priority.
summary: Authorizes the Office of Emergency Services to prioritize recovery funding and technical assistance for communities that lost population after disasters.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: environmental leadership development projects: water storage, water conveyance, and groundwater recharge projects: streamlined review.
summary: Extends CEQA streamlining for environmental leadership projects to water storage, conveyance, and groundwater recharge projects providing public benefits.

title: Career technical education: sale of equipment: registry.
summary: Creates a state registry for surplus career technical education equipment and requires schools to host apprenticeship fairs and offer community service credit for fair attendance.

title: Arson: penalties.
summary: Adds a 3-, 4-, or 5-year sentence enhancement for causing 500 or more acres of forest land to burn in arson cases.

title: Health care coverage cost sharing.
summary: Bans cost-sharing for in-network care for enrollees under 21 in large group plans and policies from 2027, and bars billing those patients.

title: Motels, hotels, and short-term lodging: disasters.
summary: Delays tenant status for disaster-displaced hotel and motel guests for 270 days, limiting unlawful detainer protections until then; sunsets 2031.

title: Personal Income Tax: tax credits: fire-resistant home improvements.
summary: Creates a personal income tax credit for 2025 through 2029 covering 40% of fire-resistant home improvement costs, capped at $400 yearly.

title: State Air Resources Board: gasoline specifications: ethanol blends.
summary: Temporarily allows sale of 10.5% to 15% ethanol gasoline blends, overriding the state's fuel-specification review requirement until regulatory conditions are met.

title: Fire hazard severity zones: State Fire Marshal.
summary: Requires the State Fire Marshal to review fire hazard severity zones at least every five years and re-review areas not currently zoned.

title: Planning and zoning: housing development projects: postentitlement phase permits: state agencies.
summary: Requires state agencies to follow local housing permit rules, posting permit materials and deeming permits approved when they miss review deadlines.

title: Pupil and parental communication: extracurricular activities: addictive feeds.
summary: Bars schools from excluding pupils from extracurriculars over addictive feeds and from using those feeds as their only way to contact students or parents, starting 2027-28.

title: Battery energy storage facilities.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration; Housing
summary: Removes large battery storage from state siting certification, denies pending applications, and bars approval of large battery projects near sensitive receptors.

title: Training programs: clinical laboratories and personnel: grants.
summary: Creates a state grant program, subject to appropriation, to fund clinical laboratory training programs approved by the State Department of Public Health.

title: Energy: nuclear facilities.
summary: Exempts small modular reactors from nuclear siting limits and directs the PUC to plan more nuclear and phase out gas power procurement.

title: California Building Standards Commission: appeals: code interpretations.
summary: Expands appeals to the State Building Standards Commission, allows alternate-material requests, requires posting of local code interpretations and commission decisions online.

title: Safe Drinking Water, Wildfire Prevention, Drought Preparedness, and Clean Air Bond Act of 2024: Department of Forestry and Fire Protection: fire camera mapping system.
summary: Requires $10 million of the Proposition 4 wildfire bond funds to be allocated to the ALERTCalifornia fire camera mapping system.

title: Developmental services: safety training.
summary: Requires DDS to evaluate regional centers' safety training and report recommendations by 2028, and lets counties set mobile crisis procedures for emergencies involving disabilities.

title: Hypodermic needles and syringes.
summary: Removes the 2026 sunset, permanently allowing pharmacists and physicians to furnish syringes without a prescription.

title: Peace officers: tribal police.
summary: Renames the Tribal Police Pilot Program and its fund, and extends the program indefinitely beyond its 2029 sunset.

title: Nevaeh Youth Sports Safety Act.
summary: Delays youth sports AED access to 2028, drops the medical-professional administration rule, and adds coach certification, emergency plans, and maintenance duties.

title: Consumer Driving Data Protection Act of 2026.
topics: AI and technology; Consumer protection and business
summary: Lets drivers opt into insurer telematics for driving records, with strict data privacy, deletion, consent rules and penalties; amends Prop 103.

title: Agricultural theft prevention: retention and sale of agricultural commodity: holding and deposit of proceeds.
summary: Shortens from 6 to 3 months the period a county must hold sale proceeds from unclaimed seized agricultural commodities before depositing them into the county general fund.

title: Student financial aid: application deadlines: extension.
summary: Lets the Student Aid Commission postpone financial aid application deadlines without a formal request when the federal FAFSA opening was delayed.

title: Affordable Housing and Sustainable Communities Program: project eligibility.
summary: Adds certain transit capital and transit-oriented development projects near planned high-speed rail stations as eligible for Affordable Housing and Sustainable Communities funding.

title: Medi-Cal: Home and Community-Based Alternatives Waiver.
summary: Requires Medi-Cal's HCBA Waiver to enroll all eligible applicants, removing the 5,000-slot expansion cap and seeking waitlist capacity, plus a rate study.

title: Artificial intelligence: defenses.
summary: Bars defendants who developed, modified, or used AI from claiming the AI autonomously caused the harm as a legal defense.

title: California First Time Homeowner Dream Act.
topics: Environment and energy; Housing; Taxes and budget
summary: Exempts certain small new single-family homes for first-time buyers from CEQA review and defers their property taxes until a change in ownership.

title: Child daycare: application: fees.
summary: Lets child daycare facilities pay initial application fees by check and requires the state to accept credit cards and electronic license applications starting 2028.

title: Foster youth: trauma-informed services.
summary: Requires counties to submit trauma-informed service plans for foster youth to a state resolution team, starting January 2027, with updates every two years.

title: Tribal judges.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice
summary: Makes assaulting tribal court judges a crime and lets tribal judges keep their records confidential, like other protected officials.

title: Public social services: eligibility: income exclusions.
summary: Excludes pupil board member compensation from income when determining eligibility for means-tested programs and public college scholarships, where federal law allows.

title: Misdemeanors.
summary: Lets courts reduce wobbler offenses to misdemeanors any time before trial, and limits repeat reduction motions to changed circumstances.

title: Precise geolocation information.
summary: Requires businesses collecting precise geolocation to post notices at collection and limits how long they may retain that data.

title: Strong Workforce Program: work-based learning opportunities.
summary: Requires the chancellor's office to revise work-based learning policies by 2026 and lets community college districts use existing Strong Workforce funds for paid student work-based learning support.

title: California Values Act: exception.
summary: Adds an exception to the California Values Act allowing law enforcement to cooperate on immigration matters involving sex trafficking suspects or convicts.

title: Cartwright Act: violations.
topics: AI and technology; Consumer protection and business
summary: Eases pleading requirements for Cartwright Act antitrust complaints and bans using or distributing common pricing algorithms to coordinate prices.

title: California State University: audits.
summary: Requires external financial audits of each Cal State campus every three years and makes all CSU audits available to the public.

title: Crimes: false reporting.
summary: Makes repeat false emergency reports that cause unnecessary responses punishable as a misdemeanor or felony, and extends liability to property damage.

title: Indemnity.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive wording change to a civil provision on joint and several liability of indemnitors for injuries caused by indemnified acts.

title: California Healthy Youth Act: adoption.
summary: Requires sex education on pregnancy outcomes to explain adoption types, birth parent rights, and local adoption resources.

title: Autonomous vehicles.
summary: Bans driverless autonomous vehicles from delivering commercial goods on California highways, with fines and permit suspension for violations.

title: Local Prepaid Mobile Telephony Services Collection Act.
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Extends to 2031 the state-set collection of local taxes on prepaid mobile phone service, limiting local taxing authority.

title: Elections: duties of election officials: voter information guides.
summary: Makes election officials' certification duties ministerial, lets the Secretary of State certify results for late counties at county cost, and requires voter guides for county jails.

title: Employment: agricultural workers.
summary: Expands farm labor contractor successor liability for predecessors' unpaid wages, shortens the licensing-history defense to one year, and broadens the immediate family definition.

title: Recycling: waste glass product: market development payments.
summary: Authorizes state market development payments for buyers of hard-to-recycle waste glass, plus transportation support, through 2030.

title: Operators of toll facilities: interoperability programs: vehicle information.
topics: AI and technology; Civil rights and liberties
summary: Limits toll operators to sharing only nationally required vehicle data with out-of-state agencies, bars selling other data, and allows lawsuits for violations.

title: The Designation of California Black-Serving Institutions Grant Program.
summary: Creates a competitive grant program for Black-serving campuses to expand academic and student support services, appropriating $75 million from the General Fund.

title: Criminal penalties: wildfires.
summary: Makes certain reckless fire-setting violations punishable only as felonies, with fines up to $10,000.

title: Greenhouse Gas Reduction Fund: grant program: edible food.
summary: Expands a state grant program funded by Greenhouse Gas Reduction Fund moneys to cover edible food recovery infrastructure and projects.

title: Workforce development: the Counties of Los Angeles and Ventura: 2025 wildfires.
topics: Labor and employment; Taxes and budget
summary: Directs $5 million in existing wildfire-area funds to Los Angeles County for workforce training, stipends, and expedited licensing for rebuilding jobs.

title: Local public employee organizations: notice requirements.
summary: Requires local agencies to give employee unions 45 days' written notice before contracting out work within represented job classifications.

title: California Renewables Portfolio Standard Program: local publicly owned electric utilities: large hydroelectric generation.
summary: Extends an exemption from renewable procurement requirements for certain utilities with large hydroelectric power to post-2030 compliance periods.

title: Employer-employee relations: confidential communications.
summary: Prohibits public employers from questioning or compelling disclosure of confidential communications between employees and their employee representatives.

title: Oral Health for People with Disabilities Technical Assistance Center Program.
summary: Subject to appropriation, creates a program through a dental school to improve dental care for people with developmental disabilities, reducing sedation need.

title: Alcoholic beverages: hours of sale: hospitality zones.
summary: Allows on-sale alcohol service until 4 a.m. on Fridays, Saturdays and certain holidays in designated hospitality zones, with local ordinances and a new license.

title: California Public Records Act: elected or appointed officials.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Expands the Public Records Act exemption and related disclosure crime to cover retired judges, State Bar Court judges, and children's counsel appointees.

title: Alcoholic beverages: beer price posting and marketing regulations: definitions.
summary: Expands the definition of successor beer manufacturer to include any licensed or unlicensed person who acquires beer manufacturing, import, or distribution rights.

title: Apprenticeship programs: approval process.
summary: Sets deadlines for state approval of new apprenticeship programs and grants conditional approval if the state misses the six-month mark.

title: In-home supportive services: licensed health care professional certification.
summary: Clarifies that IHSS certifications must come from licensed professionals who diagnose or treat the impairments causing functional limitations.

title: Pupil instruction: animal dissection.
summary: Requires teachers to offer alternative assignments to students who refuse animal dissection, bars grade penalties, and provides sourcing and chemical information on request.

title: Full-service partnerships.
summary: Creates presumptive eligibility for full-service partnership mental health services for people leaving prison or jail and bars excluding those with substance use primary diagnoses.

title: Foster care supplement.
summary: Requires the monthly foster care parent supplement to be adjusted for inflation starting July 1, 2026, subject to appropriation.

title: Safe Drinking Water, Wildfire Prevention, Drought Preparedness, and Clean Air Bond Act of 2024: Administrative Procedure Act: exemption: program guidelines and selection criteria.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Exempts state adoption of bond-program guidelines and selection criteria from the Administrative Procedure Act, while requiring public meetings and online posting of the guidelines.

title: Health care coverage: fluoride treatments.
summary: Requires private plans to cover fluoride varnish without cost sharing and makes fluoride treatments a Medi-Cal benefit for children under 21.

title: Campaign contributions: agency officers.
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Raises the campaign contribution thresholds that limit agency officers from accepting or soliciting contributions from parties in pending proceedings, from $500 to $1,500.

title: Crimes: criminal threats.
summary: Allows courts to treat threats against state constitutional officers, legislators, or judges as an aggravating factor in felony criminal threat sentencing.

title: Public Utilities Commission: Inspector General.
summary: Replaces the CPUC chief internal auditor with a Governor-appointed, Senate-confirmed Inspector General with expanded audit and records-access powers.

title: Commission on Peace Officer Standards and Training.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice
summary: Lets the state peace officer standards commission and its accountability division access sensitive criminal records, and requires background checks for commission employees with such access.

title: Crimes: extortion.
summary: Adds threats to post or create AI-generated images or videos of a person to the conduct that can constitute extortion.

title: Health care districts: County of San Diego.
summary: Requires a state health department working group to study northern San Diego health care services and report recommendations to the Legislature by 2026.

title: Coastal resources: coastal development permit application: higher education housing project.
summary: Lets universities set parking for campus housing, streamlines Coastal Commission review of minor plan amendments, and requires public posting of university development plans.

title: Criminal procedure: privacy.
summary: Lets government entities access device data with consent of anyone who finds a tracking device, adds court review, and broadens challenges to unlawful access.

title: Fair Political Practices Commission.
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Extends indefinitely the FPPC's authority to enforce local campaign finance and ethics laws, adds audit power, and repeals San Bernardino County provisions.

title: Housing elements: prohousing designation.
summary: Makes HCD's prohousing designation rules permanent and limits renewal requirements and evaluation for small rural jurisdictions.

title: Menopause.
summary: Requires medical boards to administer anonymous menopause training surveys during license renewal and directs a 2027 report on menopause education gaps.

title: Best value procurement: school districts.
summary: Extends LAUSD's best value procurement pilot indefinitely and lets other school districts use the method for projects over $1 million until 2030.

title: Water policy: California tribal communities.
summary: Adds tribal water uses to state water quality protections, requiring tribal consultation, new standards, and impact disclosures for covered projects.

title: Community colleges: CalWORKs Recipients Education Program: eligibility and services.
summary: Expands the CalWORKs college education program to students past the 60-month limit, adds basic-needs aid, and removes the childcare limit.

title: Personal information: maintenance.
summary: Requires businesses to disclose and generally prohibit storing consumers' personal information outside the U.S., and bars foreign-government access to certain sensitive data.

title: The Justin Kropp Safety Act: electrical utilities: AED availability at worksites.
summary: Requires electric utilities and their contractors to keep AEDs at worksites with two or more workers on high-voltage lines, plus written policies and maintenance rules.

title: Ignition interlock devices.
summary: Extends California's ignition interlock device provisions for DUI offenders to January 1, 2033, delaying their scheduled reversion to prior law.

title: Water: County of Ventura: fire suppression.
summary: Requires Ventura County water suppliers to have 24-hour backup power or water for fire suppression infrastructure in high fire-risk zones, starting 2030.

title: Energy: building standards: passive house standards.
summary: Requires the Energy Commission to evaluate passive house building standards' cost-effectiveness and report findings to the Legislature by 2028.

title: Emergency services: liability.
summary: Shields unlicensed people from liability and prosecution for giving anti-seizure rescue medication at emergency scenes, if done in good faith without gross negligence.

title: Furnishing hypodermic needles and syringes.
summary: Allows physician or pharmacist delegees to furnish needles and syringes to adults, and requires a workforce study on mental health providers serving homeless persons.

title: California Public Records Act: cyberattacks.
summary: Narrows state-of-emergency extensions for public records requests but adds a cyberattack-based extension for agencies unable to access electronic records.

title: Dental coverage.
summary: Requires dental plans and insurers to meet shorter appointment timelines, pay noncontracting dentists directly on assignment, and report network adequacy.

title: Office of Emergency Services: state matching funds: water system infrastructure improvements.
summary: Creates a contingent Office of Emergency Services program distributing state matching funds to wildfire-zone communities to improve water infrastructure.

title: Dependency proceedings: counsel.
summary: Removes the duty of appointed counsel to advocate for nonminor dependents' safety and well-being, and removes the exception for wishes that conflict with safety.

title: K–14 classified employees: payment of wages: itemized statements.
summary: Requires K-14 public employers to give classified employees itemized wage statements and keep deduction records for three years.

title: Medical Practice Act: health care providers: qualified autism service paraprofessionals.
summary: Adds qualified autism service paraprofessionals to the Medical Practice Act's definition of health care provider, extending the act's coverage and crime provisions to them.

title: Personal Income Tax Law: Corporation Tax Law: wildfires: exclusions.
summary: Excludes from state income tax certain wildfire-related insurance proceeds, costs and losses for qualified taxpayers in specified tax years.

title: High-Speed Rail Authority: business plan: Merced to Bakersfield segment.
summary: Requires the High-Speed Rail Authority's 2026 business plan to include a detailed funding plan and strategy for closing the Merced-Bakersfield funding gap.

title: Education finance: Classified School Employee Summer Assistance Program.
summary: Adds school district and county office joint powers authorities to the classified employee summer assistance program's eligible local agencies.

title: Crimes: prostitution.
summary: Expands prostitution-related penalties, creates a loitering misdemeanor and survivor fund, and creates a victim services grant program.

title: Crimes: serious and violent felonies.
summary: Adds rape or sexual assault of a minor with a developmental disability to the violent felony list, expanding sentencing enhancements.

title: Price gouging.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice; Housing
summary: Extends price gouging bans to 60 days, raises entity fines to $25,000, and applies rent-increase and eviction limits to all rentals and commercial property.

title: State contracts: certification process: forced labor and human trafficking.
summary: Requires state contractors to certify compliance with forced labor and human trafficking prohibitions, and broadens the forced labor definition.

title: Pedestrian safety: school zones: speed limits.
summary: Lowers school zone speed limits to 20 mph, allowing local authorities now and setting a statewide 20 mph default starting 2031.

title: Firearms: prohibition: minors.
summary: Extends firearm relinquishment procedures and search warrant authority to juveniles barred from owning firearms until age 30.

title: Health care coverage: mental health and substance use disorders: inpatient admissions.
summary: Bans prior authorization for inpatient mental health and substance use treatment admissions and related care under private plans and Medi-Cal.

title: Regional park property: County of San Bernardino: Glen Helen Regional Park.
summary: Authorizes San Bernardino County to dispose of up to 4.2 acres of Glen Helen Regional Park, including grant-funded land, if replacement park property is acquired.

title: Personal Income Tax Law: Corporation Tax Law: credits: student loan payments.
summary: Creates a 2027-2031 income and corporate tax credit and income exclusion for employer-paid student loan payments, capped at $25 million a year.

title: Nevaeh Youth Sports Safety Act.
summary: Requires public and private sports facilities to provide, maintain and test AEDs accessible to youth sports organizations starting January 2028.

title: Electricity.
summary: Exempts certain private solar or wind power lines serving hydrogen or process-heat facilities from utility regulation, adds wildfire plan duties, and creates a self-generation tariff.

title: Personal Income Tax: tax credits: fire-resistant home improvements.
summary: Creates a personal income tax credit for fire-resistant home improvement expenses, capped at $400 per year and $2,000 total, for 2025 through 2029.

title: General plans: Local Electrification Planning Act.
summary: Requires cities and counties over 75,000 residents to adopt local electrification plans covering EV charging and zero-emission infrastructure by 2030.

title: Vehicles: highway safety.
summary: Expands the move-over requirement for drivers passing stationary highway maintenance vehicles and any vehicle showing hazard lights or warning devices.

title: Mobilehome parks: notices to homeowners and residents.
summary: Requires mobilehome park notices to go to both homeowners and residents and allows electronic delivery with revocable written consent.

title: Pornographic internet websites: consent.
topics: AI and technology; Children and families
summary: Requires pornographic websites to verify uploaders' email and consent and confirm depicted people are adults, with civil and infraction penalties for violations.

title: Personal services contracts: state employees: physician and psychologist positions.
summary: Requires state corrections and state hospitals to analyze costs and report annually before using contractors for physician or psychologist positions.

title: Public transportation providers.
summary: Expands battery penalties and workplace violence restraining orders to cover transit employees, contractors, and certain transit agency employers.

title: Holidays.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Requires schools, colleges and state agencies to make reasonable efforts to avoid scheduling key events on major religious or cultural holidays.

title: Needle and syringe exchange services.
summary: Requires needle exchange programs to serial-number and track every syringe, report quarterly, and face penalties for violations.

title: Personal Income Tax Law: young child tax credit.
topics: Children and families; Taxes and budget
summary: Expands the young child tax credit by raising the age limit for a qualifying child, starting with tax year 2025.

title: Personal income tax: Earned Income Tax Credit.
summary: Sets a $355 minimum state earned income tax credit for eligible workers starting in 2025, with payments from a continuously appropriated account.

title: Coastal resources: coastal development permits: blue carbon demonstration projects.
summary: Lets the Coastal Commission, upon appropriation, authorize blue carbon demonstration projects and require mitigation for coastal habitat impacts from nonresidential projects.

title: Budget Act of 2024.
summary: Amends the 2024 Budget Act by adding appropriations and making other changes, effective immediately as a budget bill.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: environmental impact reports: coal handling, storage, and export.
summary: Requires full environmental impact reports for large coal handling, storage, or export facilities and bars reliance on existing EIRs for them.

title: Commission on Peace Officer Standards and Training: police canines.
summary: Requires the state police training commission to study police canine use and report recommendations to the Legislature by 2028.

title: California Career Technical Education Incentive Grant Program: annual adjustment: renewal grants.
summary: Continues the career technical education grant program with multi-year renewals, a 90/10 renewal-to-new split, and a funding base adjusted from the prior year.

title: Student financial aid: Cal Grant Program and the California Community College Expanded Entitlement Program.
summary: Raises Cal Grant tuition awards at independent colleges to $9,708 from 2026-27 if transfer targets are met, and eases Expanded Entitlement transfer conditions.

title: Medi-Cal: community health worker services.
summary: Requires the Department of Health Care Services to annually analyze Medi-Cal community health worker benefit use, outreach, and reimbursements, starting July 2027.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: exemption: prescribed fire, reforestation, habitat restoration, thinning, or fuel reduction projects.
summary: Extends indefinitely the CEQA exemption for federal-land prescribed fire, reforestation, habitat restoration, and fuel reduction projects.

title: Fashion Environmental Accountability Act of 2025.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Environment and energy
summary: Requires large fashion sellers to perform environmental due diligence, report emissions, set reduction targets, and limit regulated chemicals in covered products.

title: Employment: unlawful discrimination: victims of violence.
summary: Reinstates former Labor Code protections for employees who take time off for violence-related matters, applying to actions before December 31, 2024, and moves enforcement to the Civil Rights Department.

title: California Pollution Control Financing Authority.
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Removes CPCFA bond review duties and routes small business loan program moneys into continuously appropriated funds, expanding allowed fund expenditures.

title: Physician Health and Wellness Program.
summary: Replaces the physician substance-abuse program with a broader Physician Health and Wellness Program, exempts its records from public disclosure, and requires impairment reporting.

title: Open meetings: teleconferences: community college student body associations and student-run organizations.
summary: Extends and broadens Brown Act alternate teleconferencing rules for community college student governments, exempting the California Online Community College from location requirements.

title: State Air Resources Board: regulations: impact estimates: retail gasoline prices: public disclosure.
summary: Requires CARB to publish retail gasoline price impact estimates before adopting regulations that impose costs on fuel industry.

title: Bots: disclosure.
summary: Requires bots that could be mistaken for humans to disclose they are bots and not mislead people about their identity.

title: Livestock carcasses: disposal: composting.
summary: Allows livestock carcasses from routine mortality events or on-farm processing to be composted, notwithstanding existing composting prohibitions, if conditions are met.

title: Generative artificial intelligence: training data: copyrighted materials.
summary: Requires generative AI developers to let copyright owners check whether their works were used in training, provide lists within 30 days, and face civil enforcement.

title: Department of Housing and Community Development: guidelines: translation.
summary: Requires the Department of Housing and Community Development to translate its guidelines that explain public rights or services into substantial non-English languages.

title: Residential tenancies: return of security.
summary: Revises how landlords must return tenant security deposits and deliver itemized statements, adding notice and payment-method requirements.

title: Office of Small Business Advocate: internet website: information.
summary: Requires the Office of Small Business Advocate to post website information helping individuals start a small business in California.

title: Involuntary commitment.
summary: Adds emergency physicians to the professionals a county may designate for involuntary mental health holds and exempts them from certain civil and criminal liability.

title: Local finance: enhanced infrastructure financing districts: community revitalization and investment authorities.
summary: Revises enhanced infrastructure financing district rules, expanding small business and community revitalization financing and changing amendment, hearing, and annual report procedures.

title: Property taxation: tax-defaulted property.
summary: Requires a public hearing with notice and findings before boards of supervisors approve sales of tax-defaulted property, with judicial review available.

title: Educational equity: immigration enforcement.
summary: Requires school districts and charter schools to post immigration enforcement information at administrative buildings and school websites.

title: CalWORKs: CalFresh: eligibility: income and resource exclusions.
summary: Exempts higher education grants and scholarships from income and resource counts for CalWORKs and CalFresh eligibility.

title: Public utilities: property, franchises, and permits: exemption.
summary: Exempts small utility easement transactions from Commission approval and requires annual reporting of those exempt transactions.

title: Immigration enforcement: prohibitions on access, sharing information, and law enforcement collaboration.
summary: Bars California law enforcement from aiding immigration enforcement actions within one mile of childcare facilities, places of worship, hospitals, or medical offices.

title: State Seal of Civic Engagement.
summary: Requires revised State Seal of Civic Engagement criteria to include understanding the importance of preserving democracy and its institutions.

title: Alcoholism or drug abuse recovery or treatment programs and facilities: disclosures.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Requires business-operated recovery residences to register with the state and mandates discharge planning and a 7-day follow-up meeting for substance use treatment licensees.

title: Alcohol and other drug programs: complaints.
summary: Requires the state to notify complainants within 10 days of receiving and closing complaints against substance use treatment facilities.

title: Certification of alcohol or other drug programs.
summary: Requires the state to set ASAM treatment criteria as the minimum standard of care for certified alcohol and drug programs, with regulations due by 2027.

title: Impeding emergency response with drone.
summary: Prohibits operating drones at emergency scenes in ways that impede firefighters, police, or medical personnel, absent a federal waiver; allows civil enforcement.

title: Social workers: interstate compact.
summary: Joins the Social Work Licensure Compact, letting clinical social workers hold multistate licenses to practice in other member states once the board votes to join.

title: Joint powers agreements: water corporations.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Environment and energy
summary: Authorizes water corporations and mutual water companies to join joint powers agreements for insurance and risk pooling, with PUC conditions and annual reporting.

title: Personal Income Tax Law: Corporation Tax Law: exclusions: wildfires.
summary: Excludes from state income tax settlement payments to qualified taxpayers for losses from the 2021 Dixie and 2022 Mill fires.

title: Wild and scenic rivers.
summary: Indefinitely extends the Secretary of Natural Resources' authority to add rivers to the state wild and scenic rivers system, and extends when those actions remain in effect.

title: State Water Resources Control Board: emergency regulations.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Requires the State Water Board to conduct and publish an economic study of drought emergency regulations after they are no longer needed.

title: Advanced Air Mobility Infrastructure Act.
summary: Requires Caltrans to include advanced air mobility in the next California Transportation Plan and create a statewide working group on it.

title: Menopause.
summary: Requires insurance plans covering outpatient prescription drugs to cover perimenopause and menopause treatment, and doubles CME credit for menopause coursework.

title: Mental health diversion.
summary: Expands exclusions from mental health diversion for defendants charged with child abuse, child trafficking, and crimes causing great bodily injury.

title: Battery energy storage facilities.
summary: Pauses public approval of battery energy storage facilities until 2028 and requires State Fire Marshal fire-safety construction standards.

title: Vehicles: child passenger restraints.
summary: Redefines proper safety belt restraint for children and passengers under 16 to a 5-Step test starting 2027, expanding infraction scope.

title: Composting facilities: zoning.
summary: Requires the state planning office to publish a composting facility siting advisory and asks cities and counties to consider identifying compost sites in their land use plans.

title: Interscholastic athletics: California Interscholastic Federation: sports-related injuries.
summary: Adds sports-related head injuries, concussions, and medical clearance requirements to the California Interscholastic Federation's required health and safety reporting.

title: Authorized emergency vehicles.
summary: Allows the CHP commissioner to issue emergency vehicle permits to county and city emergency services office vehicles used in disaster response.

title: California Coastal Act of 1976: local planning and reporting.
summary: Makes minor Coastal Act plan amendments effective sooner and changes Coastal Commission enforcement reporting from annual to every five years.

title: Energy: electrical demand forecasts.
summary: Requires the energy commission to define methodologies letting utilities reduce electricity demand forecasts for behind-the-meter load-modifying technologies by December 2026.

title: State bridges and overpasses: suicide prevention.
summary: Requires Caltrans to identify best practices for suicide countermeasures on bridges and overpasses by July 2028.

title: Wildfire prevention: wildfire mitigation program.
summary: Extends the repeal dates for the state wildfire technology research office and the wildfire mitigation financial assistance program.

title: Z’berg-Nejedly Forest Practice Act of 1973: working forest management plans: nonindustrial timber management plans.
summary: Raises acreage caps for nonindustrial timber and working forest management plans, drops the single-hydrological-area harvest limit, and ends a Southern Subdistrict exemption.

title: Energy Commission: integrated energy policy report: curtailed solar and wind generation: hydrogen production.
summary: Requires the Energy Commission to assess hydrogen production potential from curtailed solar and wind power in the 2027 energy report; repeals January 1, 2029.

title: General plan: circulation element.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to state planning law on city and county general plan circulation elements.

title: Alcoholic beverages.
summary: Allows up to 10 additional on-sale liquor licenses in Colusa County for eating places and extends the beer glassware gifting authorization to 2029.

title: Surveillance pricing.
topics: AI and technology; Consumer protection and business
summary: Prohibits grocery establishments from using personal data collected through electronic surveillance to set customized price increases for consumers.

title: Emergency room patient prescriptions.
summary: Allows ER prescribers to dispense unused non-controlled drugs at discharge and exempts certain emergency room dispensing systems from pharmacy licensure.

title: California Health Facilities Financing Authority Act: nondesignated hospitals: loan repayment.
summary: Extends repayment deadlines for certain nondesignated public hospital COVID loans and imposes new parent-contact, footwear, website-posting, and penalty requirements on short-term residential therapeutic programs.

title: Civil Rights Department: antidiscrimination campaigns.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Upon appropriation, requires the Civil Rights Department to run anti-discrimination media campaigns and exempts its planning working group from open meeting law.

title: Privacy: health data: location and research.
summary: Bans collecting location data near family planning centers and geofencing health care providers, with penalties funding reproductive health education.

title: Public social services: support for older and aging immigrants.
summary: Creates a stakeholder panel, subject to appropriation, to recommend ways to support older immigrants regardless of immigration status, reporting to the Legislature by December 2028.

title: Law enforcement policies: restraining orders.
summary: Requires police and sheriff agencies to adopt written policies for serving and enforcing protective orders, including firearm access restrictions, by January 2027.

title: Coastal recreation: designated state surfing reserves.
summary: Requires the State Coastal Conservancy to create a process for designating state surfing reserves, which local governments may apply for, and to link approved reserves to the 30x30 conservation goal.

title: Pupil safety: comprehensive school safety plans.
summary: Requires a statewide workgroup to review school safety plans and report recommendations to the Legislature by 2027.

title: Migratory birds: California Migratory Bird Protection Act.
summary: Indefinitely prohibits taking or possessing federally protected migratory birds, including newly designated species, and repeals the separate nongame bird provision.

title: Real estate: environmental hazards: thirdhand smoke.
summary: Requires sellers with knowledge of tobacco residue to disclose it in writing, and adds a thirdhand smoke section to the state environmental hazards booklet.

title: Mobilehome parks: sales or transfers: prospective purchasers of mobilehomes.
summary: Strengthens mobilehome park homeowners' sale and transfer protections by setting management deadlines, deeming approval or waiver, and requiring disclosure copies.

title: Farmworker housing: streamlined, ministerial approval: Counties of Fresno, Madera, and Merced.
summary: Expands streamlined, ministerial approval for farmworker housing in Fresno, Madera, and Merced counties and raises the unit cap to 150.

title: Public contracts: firearms, ammunition, and firearm accessories.
summary: Requires the Department of General Services to develop model state procurement guidelines for firearms, ammunition, and firearm accessories by 2027.

title: Initiatives: qualification: electronic signatures.
summary: Requires the Secretary of State to build an online system where voters can electronically sign state and local initiative, referendum, and recall petitions.

title: Diversion.
summary: Revises mental health diversion eligibility, adding a 5-year diagnosis requirement, a new dangerousness standard, expert opinion content rules, and required reasons for denial.

title: Radiologic technologists: venipuncture: direct supervision.
summary: Allows radiologic technologists to perform upper-extremity venipuncture under remote audio-video physician supervision, with added facility safety protocols.

title: Truancy.
summary: Repeals the misdemeanor that made parents of chronic truants subject to a fine of up to $2,000 and up to one year in county jail.

title: Land use: accessory dwelling units.
summary: Allows accessory dwelling units in disaster-affected counties to receive certificates of occupancy before primary dwellings and sets 60-day deemed-approval for coastal permits.

title: Emergency medical services: dogs and cats.
summary: Allows ambulances and emergency responders to transport and give first aid to injured police and search-and-rescue dogs, with approved operator transport policies.

title: Sexual assault in prison.
summary: Extends time to sue public entities for prison sexual assault, exempts claims from presentation rules, and adds staff-abuse protections for incarcerated people.

title: Local public employees: memoranda of understanding.
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Requires public agency labor agreements to include progressive discipline with due process on union request, and refusing them counts as bad-faith bargaining.

title: Public postsecondary education: Donate Life California: educational information.
summary: Requires public colleges and universities to give incoming students educational information about the Donate Life California organ and tissue donor registry.

title: Los Angeles Community College District: California Center for Climate Change Education.
summary: Codifies the California Center for Climate Change Education at West LA College and extends neighborhood council alternate teleconferencing authority until 2030.

title: Crimes: looting.
summary: Expands looting to burglary, theft, trespass and vehicle theft in evacuation zones, with increased penalties for those offenses.

title: Crimes: impersonation of first responders.
summary: States legislative intent to enact future legislation on impersonating first responders during a state of emergency, without changing current law.

title: Elderly Parole Program.
summary: Requires persons convicted of certain sexual offenses to be 60 or older with 25 years served before they are suitable for Elderly Parole.

title: Telephone corporations: carriers of last resort.
summary: Lets telephone carriers seek relief from carrier-of-last-resort obligations in unpopulated or well-served census blocks and creates a public safety technology grant fund.

title: County air pollution control districts: Antelope Valley Air Quality Management District: board members: compensation.
summary: Allows Antelope Valley and other county air district board members to receive compensation and expense reimbursement upon board resolution, with reporting requirements.

title: Energy: integrated energy policy report: port infrastructure for offshore wind energy development.
summary: Requires the Energy Commission to assess funding needs for offshore wind port infrastructure in future integrated energy policy reports, contingent on appropriation.

title: Environmental advertising: recyclability.
summary: Changes when packaging from producers in approved stewardship programs may be labeled recyclable, replacing an existing program-compliance pathway with producer responsibility organization criteria.

title: Housing discrimination: nonprofit home-sharing program: eligibility for public social services.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Health care
summary: Exempts home-sharing landlords from certain housing discrimination rules and excludes their rental income from public benefit eligibility calculations.

title: Prisons and jails: employment of inmates.
summary: Makes inmate work voluntary, creates a CDCR voluntary work program, bars required inmate work from 2027, and sets local jail wages by ordinance.

title: Metal theft.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice
summary: Expands metal theft rules for junk dealers, requiring more detailed transaction records and covering street lights, with fines up to $5,000.

title: Fair Pay for Educators Act: local control funding formula: base grants: funding targets.
summary: Raises state LCFF base grant, county office operations, and add-on amounts starting in the 2036-37 fiscal year, increasing K-12 school funding.

title: Accessibility to emergency information and services: evacuations: pets.
summary: Requires cities and counties to add pet rescue, reentry and pet-information procedures to emergency plans, and holds rescued evacuation pets for 30 days.

title: Criminal procedure: vacatur relief.
summary: Adds court findings and licensing-entity review before vacating convictions for licensed petitioners whose offenses relate to their license duties.

title: Education finance: postsecondary education facilities: College Health and Safety Bond Act of 2026.
summary: Creates a 2026 college health and safety bond to fund postsecondary facilities and raises community college local bond debt limits.

title: Personal Income Tax Law: Corporation Tax Law: insurance tax law: low-income housing tax credit:
summary: Allows taxpayers to elect to sell low-income housing tax credits in the manner the CTCAC prescribes, instead of the application process.

title: Healing arts: clinical laboratories: personnel.
summary: Authorizes unlicensed laboratory personnel to assist with moderate or high complexity testing under direct supervision and defined training requirements.

title: California Table Grape Commission.
summary: Revises the California Table Grape Commission's structure and powers and raises the maximum grape producer assessment to two cents per pound.

title: Fixed term installment contracts: early termination fees.
summary: Bans early termination fees on installment contracts unless disclosed upfront, and caps such fees at 30% of the total contract amount.

title: California bar examination.
summary: Requires a State Bar committee report on whether a uniform bar exam would cut administration costs and improve efficiency; repeals the provisions in 2030.

title: Labor Commissioner: unsatisfied judgments: nonpayment of wages.
summary: Requires state agencies to deny or renew-block licenses and permits for employers with unpaid wage judgments, and repeals the long-term care-specific version.

title: Crimes: burglary tools.
summary: Adds key programming devices, key duplicating devices, and signal extenders to the burglary-tools instruments covered by existing misdemeanor offenses.

title: Insurance.
summary: Makes technical updates to insurance licensing, including removing fingerprint submission and expanding background-information disclosure and blanket coverage for volunteers.

title: Insurance: the California FAIR Plan Association.
summary: Repeals the FAIR Plan's requirement to file a new rate application with the Insurance Commissioner and drops directory publication of its toll-free number.

title: Health care professions: deceptive terms or letters: artificial intelligence.
summary: Prohibits AI and generative AI tools from using terms implying they are licensed health professionals, enforceable by licensing boards.

title: Schoolsites: immigration enforcement.
summary: Bars schools from letting immigration agents enter nonpublic areas or get student information without a judicial warrant or court order, and updates model policies.

title: Personal Income Tax Law: deduction from gross income: car loan interest payments.
summary: Allows a personal income tax deduction for interest paid on one qualified car loan per taxpayer, for tax years 2026 through 2030.

title: California Global Warming Solutions Act of 2006: climate goals: natural and working lands.
summary: Declares it a state goal to meet natural carbon sequestration targets by set dates, prioritizing activities that increase carbon stocks and reduce emissions.

title: Alcohol and drug programs: licensing.
summary: Requires the state to notify a facility's city or county in writing whenever it issues an alcohol or drug treatment facility license.

title: Mortgages: hazard insurance proceeds.
summary: Requires lenders holding hazard insurance proceeds in loss draft accounts to pay at least 2% interest, and bars fees that would cut that return.

title: Nonminor dependents: transfer of county of residence.
summary: Adds a pathway for nonminor foster dependents to transfer juvenile court jurisdiction to a new county based on significant connection, with 30-day deadlines.

title: Family Preparedness Plan Act of 2025.
summary: Expands who can sign caregiver authorization affidavits for minors and lets courts appoint joint guardians when a parent is temporarily unavailable, including immigration action.

title: Unemployment and disability insurance: quality of services: reporting.
summary: Requires the Legislative Analyst's Office to annually report on the Employment Development Department's quality of unemployment and disability insurance services, repealing the requirement in 2031.

title: San Francisco Bay/Sacramento-San Joaquin Delta Estuary Water Quality Control Plan: update: substitute environmental document: exemption.
summary: Requires the State Water Board to update the Bay-Delta Plan by August 2026 and exempts it from certain CEQA document requirements.

title: Self-service storage facilities: lien notices: email.
summary: Lets self-storage owners prove delivery of lien notices sent by email by showing the occupant downloaded, opened, or otherwise acknowledged the email.

title: Robert F. Kennedy Farm Workers Medical Plan.
summary: Lowers the claim threshold for state reimbursement to the Robert F. Kennedy Farm Workers Medical Plan from $70,000 to $50,000 per episode of care.

title: Budget Act of 2024.
summary: Amends the 2024 Budget Act by changing and adding appropriations, effective immediately as a Budget Bill.

title: Pharmacists: furnishing contraceptives.
summary: Lets pharmacists furnish over-the-counter contraceptives without standardized protocols, including up to a 12-month supply at patient request.

title: University of California: admissions changes.
summary: Requests UC complete consultation steps before changing undergraduate admissions conditions, and requires the State Board of Education and trustees to discuss such proposals.

title: Lawsuits, liens, and other encumbrances.
summary: Raises penalties for false liens and financing statements, requires debtor notice, and creates an affidavit process to challenge improper UCC filings.

title: Elections: deceptive media in advertisements.
topics: AI and technology; Civil rights and liberties
summary: Narrows California's ban on deceptive election deepfakes with a shorter 30-day window, a satire exemption, and suits limited to the depicted individual.

title: School facilities: Civic Center Act: direct costs.
summary: Restores indefinitely the expanded direct-cost definition schools may charge civic users, and requires maintenance fees go to a special fund.

title: Worker classification: employees and independent contractors: licensed manicurists.
summary: Removes the January 1, 2025 sunset, keeping licensed manicurists exempt from the ABC worker classification test indefinitely.

title: Multifamily Housing Program: Homekey: report.
summary: Requires the Legislative Analyst's Office to evaluate Homekey's effectiveness and timeliness and report recommendations to the Legislature by 2027.

title: Pets: sales of dogs, cats, and rabbits.
summary: Voids pet sale contracts with nonrefundable deposits, requires disclosure of dog, cat, and rabbit sources and medical history, and allows enforcement and refunds.

title: Adaptive reuse: streamlining: incentives.
summary: Makes adaptive reuse projects by-right in all zones with streamlined approval, parking relief, and affordability and prevailing wage conditions.

title: Residential care facilities for the elderly: direct care ratios.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Requires residential care facilities for the elderly to calculate, record, disclose and publicly post daily direct care ratios, with enforcement through existing penalties.

title: Alcoholic beverages: minors.
summary: Makes licensees' use of age verification software or devices evidence of compliance in prosecutions for selling alcohol to minors.

title: Education finance: General Fund cashflow loans: Inglewood Unified School District: interest waivers.
summary: Waives interest on Inglewood Unified's General Fund cashflow loans once it repays a decade of loans and meets solvency conditions.

title: Health care coverage: utilization review: peer-to-peer review.
summary: Requires health plans and insurers to provide prompt peer-to-peer review of medical-necessity denials, and deems requests approved if deadlines are missed.

title: Radiologist assistants.
summary: Creates a radiologist assistant credential requiring an exam and registration, limits work to radiologist supervision, and removes misdemeanor penalties for violations.

title: Health care coverage: prior authorization.
summary: Shortens prior authorization decision deadlines for private health plans and insurers, excluding Medi-Cal, with faster 24-to-48-hour timelines for urgent requests.

title: California Global Warming Solutions Act of 2006: scoping plan.
summary: Requires the Air Resources Board to include greenhouse gas emissions from wildlands and forest fires in its climate scoping plan.

title: Water: emergency water supplies.
summary: Declares state policy to encourage, but not mandate, local and regional water suppliers to develop emergency water supplies for drought or supply disruptions.

title: Trial: statement of decision.
summary: Revises civil trial procedure for statements of decision, including request timing, service, objections, and extending the deadline for judgment entry.

title: Registered veterinary technicians and veterinary assistants: scope of practice.
summary: Expands the animal health care tasks that veterinary technicians and assistants may perform, including dental procedures and work in animal shelters.

title: Medi-Cal: complex rehabilitation technology: wheelchairs.
summary: Bars Medi-Cal prior authorization for low-cost wheelchair repairs and drops prescription requirements for repairing or replacing approved complex rehab wheelchairs.

title: Low-impact camping areas.
summary: Exempts county-authorized low-impact private campsites from special occupancy park rules, with registry, host, and platform requirements.

title: Pet broker sales.
summary: Prohibits pet brokers from selling, adopting out, or offering dogs under one year, cats, or rabbits, with specified exemptions.

title: Farmer equity: advisory committees.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Authorizes the Secretary of Food and Agriculture to create two advisory committees on socially disadvantaged and small-scale farmers and ranchers.

title: Homelessness and mental health: state funding information.
summary: Requires the Controller to create a public online portal showing state homelessness and mental health program funding over ten years.

title: Contractors State License Board: bond deposits: liability for legal fees and costs.
summary: Exempts the Contractors State License Board from liability for legal fees or costs in actions against bond deposits held by the registrar.

title: Private employment: labor unions.
summary: States legislative intent to streamline state labor law requirements and curb abuses by labor unions, without enacting specific changes.

title: Metropolitan water districts: proxy vote authorizations.
summary: Temporarily lets single-representative member agencies assign proxy votes to other agencies' representatives on the Metropolitan Water District board, capped at six meetings yearly.

title: Farmland Access and Conservation for Thriving Communities Act.
summary: Creates a state farmland acquisition program, contingent on appropriation, to help qualified entities buy farmland for transfer or long-term leases to farmers.

title: Basic Inspection of Terminals program: agricultural vehicles.
summary: Extends the exemption of agricultural vehicles from the Basic Inspection of Terminals program until January 1, 2031, and deletes an obsolete CHP report requirement.

title: Energy: in-state geothermal energy generation.
summary: Directs the Energy Commission to plan for new in-state geothermal energy, including siting, leasing goals, transmission assessment, and a permitting roadmap.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: geothermal exploratory projects: geothermal field development projects: enhanced geothermal system wells.
summary: Expands geothermal exploratory project definitions, exempts qualifying projects from CEQA review, and adds well-log disclosure requirements.

title: Criminal procedure: child pornography.
summary: Bars defendants and attorneys from copying child pornography evidence, requires it stay in government custody, and makes it available to victims.

title: Pharmacy: declared state of emergency.
summary: Extends from 90 to 120 days the period after a declared emergency ends during which the Board of Pharmacy may keep waiving Pharmacy Law provisions.

title: Native American tribes: fish and wildlife: conservation and mitigation lands.
summary: Allows federally recognized tribes to receive riparian and wetland conservation grants, enter land-management agreements, and take conservation land transfers.

title: California State University: fiscal transparency.
summary: Requires CSU to post searchable online information about state-funded expenditures over $10,000 by July 2027, with a public feedback feature.

title: Geothermal powerplants and projects: certification and environmental review.
summary: Expands eligibility for state CEQA streamlining certification to geothermal powerplants and multi-plant geothermal projects on a single site.

title: Water rate assistance program.
summary: Authorizes urban water suppliers to offer low-income water rate assistance, requires reporting from 2028, and repeals expired federal-linked assistance program rules.

title: Health care districts: design-build process.
summary: Lets all health care districts use design-build contracting for hospital and health facility construction, and declares no state reimbursement is required.

title: Transitional housing placement providers.
summary: Sets contract term lengths and renewals for foster youth transitional housing providers and lets counties terminate contracts on 90 days' notice.

title: Threatening a witness: assisting a prosecution.
summary: Clarifies that preventing or dissuading a witness or victim from assisting a prosecution is a crime, expanding the offense's scope.

title: Health care coverage: colorectal cancer screening.
summary: Requires health plans and insurers to cover colorectal cancer screening tests that FDA-approved and meet federal CMS or American Cancer Society criteria, without cost sharing.

title: Community colleges: California College Promise.
summary: Lowers the California College Promise fee-waiver enrollment threshold from 12 to 9 units and adds notice and naming requirements for community colleges.

title: Public works: payroll records.
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Requires awarding bodies to obtain and release public works payroll records from contractors on request, with DLSE penalty enforcement for noncompliance.

title: Health care coverage: prior authorizations.
summary: Requires approved prior authorizations for in-network providers to remain valid for at least one year.

title: Access to Safe Abortion Care Act.
summary: Reaffirms legality of mailing and receiving abortion medication and shields patients and providers from civil, criminal, and professional liability for medication abortion.

title: Civil actions and attorneys.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Labor and employment
summary: Exempts attorneys who refer clients within their own representation from lawyer referral service rules, and lets parties screen sensitive records before subpoena disclosure.

title: California Public Records Act Ombudsperson.
summary: Creates a temporary state Public Records Act Ombudsperson to review improperly denied public record requests, subject to appropriation.

title: Continuation schools and classes: youth workforce development programs.
summary: Lets continuation schools offer youth workforce programs on one or two weekdays if pupils keep 15 weekly class hours, and requires attendance tracking.

title: Medi-Cal: field medicine.
summary: Lets Medi-Cal managed care plans offer covered services through field medicine providers, letting homeless members access them directly, with conditions on federal approval.

title: Electric bicycles: required equipment.
summary: Requires electric bicycles to carry rear red reflectors or lights at all hours and sets a helmet-fee exemption for minors who complete an e-bike safety course.

title: Vehicles: electric bicycles.
summary: Bans selling applications that can modify an electric bicycle's speed capability, extending existing product restrictions to apps.

title: Health care coverage: portable HEPA purifiers.
summary: Requires large group health plans and insurers to cover a prescribed HEPA air purifier for pregnant or asthmatic/COPD enrollees in wildfire emergency areas.

title: Personal Income Tax Law: credits: in vitro fertilization.
summary: Creates a temporary state income tax credit of up to $5,000 for in vitro fertilization expenses, for tax years 2026 through 2030.

title: Enhanced Services for Asylees and Vulnerable Noncitizens program.
summary: Expands the asylee and vulnerable noncitizen resettlement program to cover persons screened by DHS in 2024-2025, lowers provider experience requirements, and requires outcome data posting.

title: Emergency services: human trafficking.
summary: Requires the Office of Emergency Services to plan safety and security, including anti-trafficking measures, for major 2026-2028 sporting events in California.

title: Alternative birth centers: licensing and Medi-Cal reimbursement.
summary: Removes the perinatal-services certification and proximity requirements for alternative birth centers and requires a written hospital transfer policy instead.

title: The California Endangered Species Act: take of species proposed for listing: renewable electrical generation facilities.
summary: Allows take permits for species proposed for listing and waives later authorization for renewable energy facilities' incidental take; requires reporting through 2032.

title: Reproductive Health Emergency Preparedness Program.
summary: Creates a conditional grant program to expand reproductive and sexual health care access in California emergency departments, repealed in 2030.

title: Agricultural Labor Relations Board: office.
summary: Temporarily removes the requirement that the Agricultural Labor Relations Board's principal office be in Sacramento, through January 1, 2028.

title: CalFresh: food access.
summary: Requires the state to maximize all available food choices for CalFresh recipients, including hot foods, under federal law.

title: Health care coverage: antiretroviral drugs, drug devices, and drug products.
summary: Requires most private health plans and insurers to cover HIV prevention drugs without prior authorization, step therapy, or cost sharing, excluding Medi-Cal plans.

title: Air resources: regulatory impacts: transportation fuel costs.
summary: Requires the state air board to report quarterly to the Legislature on how its transportation fuel regulations affect California consumer fuel prices.

title: Public postsecondary education: waiver of campus-based fees: veterans.
summary: Extends existing tuition fee waivers for certain veterans' children and Medal of Honor recipients to cover mandatory campus-based fees at public colleges and universities.

title: California Factory-Built Housing Law.
summary: Allows approved factory-built housing plans to be reused across later projects and limits state and agency review to unapproved portions.

title: Alarm companies.
summary: Expands the Alarm Company Act's definition of alarm system to include video systems, bringing video monitoring under licensing rules.

title: Professions and vocations: contractors: home improvement contracts: prohibited business practices.
summary: Expands contractor home-improvement rules to cover accessory dwelling units and adds revocation and at least $10,000 civil penalties for downpayment and payment violations.

title: Social media: warning labels.
summary: Requires social media platforms to display black box warnings to users on initial daily access and periodically during active use, starting 2027.

title: Special education: resource specialists: special classes.
summary: Requires districts to evenly distribute initial assessment workload among resource specialists and directs the Superintendent to recommend special class staffing ratios.

title: Restraining orders.
summary: Starting 2027, allows electronic filing and remote hearing appearances for restraining orders and bars court fees for those filings and appearances.

title: Foster care: placement: family finding.
summary: Requires counties to compare their relative-placement rates with statewide averages and consult a family-finding center on best practices if they fall short.

title: Childcare: Early Childhood Policy Council.
summary: Expands the Early Childhood Policy Council's required annual report and directs it to develop policy and budget proposals for the Legislature.

title: Cannabis: excise tax: rate increase suspension: report.
summary: Temporarily lowers California's cannabis excise tax from 19% to 15% from October 2025 through June 2028, then resumes adjustments capped at 19%.

title: Representation of trust beneficiaries.
summary: Revises trust notice rules so notice to an authorized representative counts, and sets written consent and representation rules for trust beneficiaries.

title: California Consumer Privacy Act of 2018: opt-out preference signal.
summary: Requires browsers sold in California to include a consumer-configurable opt-out preference signal starting 2027, and grants browser makers immunity for downstream violations.

title: Insurance: residential and commercial.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Taxes and budget
summary: Would have the state pay residential insurance rate increases above a cap, set residential premium tax to 0% until 2030, and order a report on cutting insurance regulations.

title: Tule East Groundwater Sustainability Agency Act.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Creates the Tule East Groundwater Sustainability Agency, setting its boundaries and board, and requires it to develop and implement a groundwater sustainability plan.

title: California Public Employees’ Pension Reform Act of 2013: exceptions: supplemental defined benefit plans.
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Authorizes public employers to bargain over contributions to supplemental retirement benefits for employee bargaining units, subject to PEPRA limits.

title: California Dream for All Program: descendants of formerly enslaved people.
summary: Reserves at least 10% of California Dream for All homebuyer loan funds for certified descendants of formerly enslaved people, once certification exists.

title: Insurance: policy documents.
summary: Requires insurers to give insureds a free fire insurance policy copy within 15 days of request, shortening the current 30-day deadline.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: exemption: Gypsum Canyon Veterans Cemetery.
summary: Exempts activities and approvals needed to complete the Gypsum Canyon Veterans Cemetery in Orange County from CEQA, repealing the exemption in 2030.

title: Criminal procedure: interrogations.
summary: Requires police and prosecutors to identify themselves, disclose rights, and allow support persons when interviewing families of people killed or seriously injured by officers.

title: Cigarette and tobacco products: licensing and enforcement.
