summary: Raises tobacco retailer license fees to $450 per location from July 2026, allows fee adjustments up to $600, and requires legislative analyst reports on enforcement.

title: Prior authorization: physical therapy.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Bars prior authorization for the first 12 physical therapy visits for new conditions and requires providers to disclose out-of-pocket cost estimates.

title: Obesity Prevention Treatment Parity Act.
summary: Requires most private health plans and insurers issued or renewed from 2026 to cover anti-obesity medication and intensive behavioral therapy without prior authorization.

title: Charitable giving: online fundraising.
summary: Lets charitable fundraising platforms rely on an application programming interface to check charity good standing, and directs the Attorney General to set API rules.

title: Health care coverage: antisteering.
summary: Bans health plans and PBMs from steering enrollees to specific pharmacies or settings; requires provider consent and cost estimates for some infused drugs.

title: Food delivery platforms: customer service.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Labor and employment
summary: Requires food delivery platforms to offer human customer service, provide full refunds for failed deliveries, and bar using tips to offset driver base pay.

title: Yaeli’s Law.
summary: Declares refusing gender-affirming care and using sex-at-birth pronouns not child abuse, lets parents sue investigators, and alters custody best-interest standards.

title: University of California, Merced: medical school.
summary: Requests a UC report by August 31, 2026 on costs and timeline for expanding UCSF-UC Merced medical education toward an independent UC Merced medical school.

title: Surface mining: Metropolitan Water District of Southern California.
summary: Extends until 2041 the authority for the Metropolitan Water District to use a master reclamation plan covering its surface mining operations.

title: State shrub.
summary: Establishes the bigberry manzanita as California's official state shrub.

title: Administrative Procedure Act.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive change to code sections that define the Administrative Procedure Act governing state agency rulemaking.

title: Death certificates.
summary: Allows nurse practitioners to attest death certificates, fetal death certificates, and record amendments, and to notify coroners of certain deaths.

title: Firearms dealers and manufacturers: secure facilities.
summary: Expands the legal definition of a firearms secure storage facility to allow steel doors with panic hardware and multipoint locks.

title: Electronic death registration system.
summary: Requires the State Registrar to upgrade the electronic death registration system and gives physicians, medical examiners, and local registrars access to it.

title: Professional fiduciaries.
summary: Authorizes professional fiduciary corporations and adds licensing disclosure, discipline, and court-appointment requirements for professional fiduciaries.

title: Student Aid Commission: membership.
summary: Requires one Student Aid Commission public member seat to be filled by someone with expertise in veterans' educational benefits when a term expires.

title: State Fire Marshal: lithium battery working group: membership: funding.
summary: Creates a State Fire Marshal lithium battery working group to study building safety and recommend solutions, funded from the Building Standards Administration fund.

title: Firefighters: personal protective equipment.
summary: Bars Cal/OSHA's board from requiring firefighter protective gear replacement more often than every 15 years, with safety exceptions.

title: Reclamation District No. 108: hydroelectric power.
summary: Extends Reclamation District No. 108's hydroelectric power authority beyond January 1, 2026, and requires reporting to legislative committees in 2031 and 2035-2036.

title: Social Housing Bond Act of 2026.
summary: Creates a $950 million social housing bond for voter approval and a new California Housing Authority to build low-income housing.

title: Emergency services: mutual aid: public works.
summary: Adds public works personnel, equipment, and materials to emergency mutual aid and requires OES to create a Public Works Emergency Mutual Aid Plan.

title: Business: retail food.
summary: Extends COVID-era alcohol catering relief to 2029, bars new catering authorizations from 2027, and makes outdoor dining parking relief permanent.

title: CalFresh: data sharing.
summary: Removes state authorization for public entities to share data with the Department of Social Services for CalFresh administration, participation, and impact measurement.

title: Student health insurance.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Lets students end student health insurance mid-year and waive it with other coverage, while adding insurer rate-filing enforcement and penalties.

title: Housing: Building Home Ownership for All Program.
summary: Creates the Building Home Ownership for All Program, subject to appropriation, to make home purchases affordable for lower and moderate-income Californians.

title: Elections: ballot disclosures.
topics: Elections and voting; Labor and employment
summary: Prints the three largest contributors to statewide initiative committees on ballots and bars employers from preventing employees from wearing face coverings.

title: Public insurance adjusters.
summary: Tightens public insurance adjuster contract requirements, limits fees, restricts solicitation, and expands insured cancellation and rescission rights.

title: School safety: School Mapping Data Grant Program.
summary: Creates a contingent one-time grant program for schools to contract with vendors providing school mapping data for emergency response, with data-protection requirements.

title: Short-Line Railroad Improvement Program.
summary: Extends short-line railroad funding availability by one year and eases matching requirements for publicly owned railroads.

title: Forestry: timber operations: maintenance of timberlands for fuels reduction.
summary: Allows publicly funded noncommercial wildfire fuels reduction on timberland to use a timber harvesting plan instead of CEQA review.

title: Cosmetic safety.
summary: Bans four more musk ingredients in cosmetics and limits musk ketone levels, including in fine fragrances, starting January 1, 2027.

title: Pupil instruction: transgender concepts: opt out.
topics: Children and families; Civil rights and liberties; Education
summary: Lets parents opt students out of instruction, activities, and surveys referencing transgender concepts, with alternatives and a private right of action.

title: Child abuse: reporting.
summary: Requires mandated reporter training by 2027 and employer completion, creates an advisory committee, and adds county resource plans for families.

title: Public postsecondary education: student behavior: drug and alcohol use: rehabilitation programs.
summary: Requires UC and CSU to bar discipline for students who get medical treatment for drug or alcohol use and complete rehabilitation, and to offer rehab to such students, starting July 2026.

title: Asset forfeiture: human trafficking.
summary: Renames the forfeiture act and lets the state seize property and proceeds from human trafficking without proving a pattern of criminal profiteering.

title: Redistricting: congressional districts.
summary: Specifies congressional district elements if ACA 8 is adopted, operative only until the Citizens Redistricting Commission certifies a new map; takes effect immediately.

title: Employment: refineries: task force.
summary: Creates a Refinery Safe Staffing Task Force to study worker retention and transition strategies, reporting to the Legislature by 2029, and repeals in 2030.

title: Certificated employees: professional services credential: out-of-state applicants.
summary: Expands pupil personnel services credential pathways, including preliminary credentials for out-of-state applicants and university-partnered programs in any service area.

title: CalWORKs: Home Visiting Program.
summary: Modifies the CalWORKs Home Visiting Program, capping participation at the model's duration and allowing services for exited participants up to 12 months.

title: Coastal resources: local coastal program: submission.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to the rule governing how local coastal programs are submitted for approval.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: exemption: housing development projects.
summary: Exempts qualifying housing development projects from CEQA review and adds hazardous-substance assessment conditions for approval.

title: Electricity and natural gas: legislation imposing mandated programs and requirements: third-party review.
summary: Requires the Public Advocate's Office to create a program analyzing legislation affecting electricity and gas ratepayers, with conflict-of-interest rules.

title: Housing element: governmental constraints: disclosure statement.
summary: Requires cities and counties to disclose new or stricter local housing constraints in future housing element revisions.

title: Voluntary tax contribution funds: spinal cord injury research.
summary: Creates a voluntary tax-return checkoff letting taxpayers direct excess contributions to a new spinal cord injury research fund, 2027–2034.

title: Transportation: Highway Design Manual: emergency response times.
summary: Requires state highway design manual updates directing local governments to consult fire departments so road improvements do not slow emergency response times.

title: Property taxation: assessment: affordable commercial property.
summary: Adds certain nonprofit renewable leases on community-owned commercial land to property tax valuation restrictions, reducing assessed value; state reimbursement of local losses is barred.

title: Claims against public entities.
summary: Extends the deadline to present claims against public entities for death or injury from 6 months to one year, aligning all causes of action at one year.

title: Power facilities: emergency response and action plans.
summary: Requires energy facility siting applications to include paid emergency response plans and storage systems to meet NFPA 855 setbacks, while dropping the environmental description requirement.

title: Department of Parks and Recreation: state parks: California State Library Parks Pass Program.
summary: Authorizes State Parks to issue free vehicle day-use annual passes to the State Library for its Parks Pass Program, subject to appropriation.

title: Developmental services: personal care or assistance and in-home respite services.
summary: Requires home care organizations serving Lanterman Act consumers to be licensed and their aides listed on the home care aide registry.

title: Medi-Cal: behavioral health: data sharing.
summary: Requires Medi-Cal managed care and behavioral health programs to electronically share member data, with DHCS setting standards and guidance by 2027.

title: California Conservation Corps: training programs: formerly incarcerated individuals: reporting.
summary: Requires CalFire and CDCR to jointly evaluate the Ventura Training Center and report on reentry firefighter pipelines by 2026.

title: Civil Rights Department: racially motivated eminent domain.
summary: Creates a Civil Rights Department process for owners whose property was taken through racially motivated eminent domain, allowing return of property or compensation.

title: Medium- and Heavy-Duty Zero-Emission Vehicle Fleet Purchasing Assistance Program: rental vehicles.
summary: Requires the state air board to consider zero-emission truck rental options when adopting fleet purchasing program or procurement regulations.

title: Deepfake pornography.
summary: Expands civil liability for sexually explicit deepfakes, including those of minors, raises statutory damages, and targets service providers that enable deepfake pornography sites.

title: Parole: minimum eligible date.
summary: Requires applying good-behavior and rehabilitation credits to reduce minimum terms for life-sentenced prisoners, and parole board must consider probation reports.

title: Fire prevention: fuel modification or reduction projects: reports.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Requires state environmental agencies and the Coastal Commission to report by 2028 on fuel reduction projects and the 2025 wildfire emergency proclamation.

title: Office of Emergency Services: federal grant funding; Community Relief Act.
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Directs Office of Emergency Services to pass federal emergency grant funds to locals and creates a Community Relief Act disaster financial assistance program.

title: Barbering and cosmetology.
summary: Removes the hairstylist license and strips hairstyling from barbering and cosmetology scope, while requiring licensure-status notice to consumers.

title: Underground storage tanks: design and construction requirements: exemption.
summary: Exempts single-walled underground storage tank operators acting in good faith to upgrade from the required permanent closure, with local review of requests.

title: California Health Facilities Financing Authority Act.
summary: Expands hospital financing authority loans for working capital, removing the interest cap and 24-month repayment rule while barring financially distressed institutions.

title: Hiring of real property: dwellings: untenantability.
summary: Adds working stove and refrigerator to required habitability standards for rental units and requires recalled appliances be repaired or replaced within 30 days.

title: School districts: equipment inventory.
summary: Raises the school district equipment inventory threshold from $500 to $1,500 and requires biennial inflation adjustments.

title: Loitering with intent to commit prostitution.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice
summary: Reinstates misdemeanor loitering with intent to commit prostitution, bars arrests based solely on gender identity or sexual orientation, requires documenting service offers first.

title: Abandoned recreational vehicles.
summary: Lets Alameda and Los Angeles counties dispose of abandoned recreational vehicles valued at $4,000 or less until 2030, with conditions and annual reporting.

title: Animals: animal shelters: transparency.
summary: Requires animal shelters to record and publicly post intake and outcome data for animals, updated quarterly and kept available for five years.

title: Local ordinances: administrative fines or penalties.
summary: Lets local agencies enforce administrative fines by filing orders as superior court judgments and by placing liens on parcels.

title: Human trafficking: vacatur relief for victims.
summary: Extends human trafficking vacatur relief to people convicted or arrested for offenses committed as minors while they were trafficking victims.

title: Tianeptine.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice
summary: Prohibits manufacturing, distributing, or selling tianeptine products in California, with civil penalties enforced by the Attorney General or local attorneys.

title: Mobilehome Residency Law Protection Program: Attorney General.
summary: Directs the Department of Housing and Community Development to refer mobilehome tenant violations to legal services providers through a grant process, and makes Dispute Resolution Fund money available to the department and Attorney General.

title: Medi-Cal: diapers.
summary: Establishes diapers as a covered Medi-Cal benefit for certain children and under-21 beneficiaries, subject to federal approval and appropriation.

title: False or misleading commercial disaster communication.
summary: Makes false or misleading commercial disaster communications unlawful and increases penalties for insurance-related violations during states of emergency.

title: Stormwater: uses: irrigation.
summary: Requires the State Water Resources Control Board to develop stormwater capture and irrigation recommendations for urban public lands by December 2026, with public comment.

title: Dams: exceptions.
summary: Exempts specified named weirs from the state's dam definition, removing state dam safety supervision for those barriers.

title: Vital records.
summary: Requires state vital records to accept diacritical marks in names and lets people amend records lacking them, contingent on appropriation.

title: Local educational agencies: governance training.
summary: Requires school and charter board members to complete K-12 school finance training, with a state-mandate reimbursement clause and recordkeeping.

title: Drug-Induced Movement Disorder Awareness Program.
summary: Directs CDPH, upon appropriation, to develop a drug-induced movement disorder awareness program by 2028, repealed in 2032.

title: Emergencies proclaimed by the Governor: school employee catastrophic leave.
summary: Allows school and charter school employees to donate leave credits to colleagues affected by a governor-proclaimed state of emergency.

title: Climate change: short-lived climate pollutants: organic waste reduction.
summary: Expands the materials and compost operations local governments can count toward organic waste procurement targets under methane reduction law.

title: Exposition Park: Holocaust memorial.
summary: Authorizes a noncompetitive grant to a nonprofit to build and maintain a Holocaust memorial at Exposition Park, subject to appropriation.

title: Emergency medical services: dispatcher training.
summary: Requires 911 public safety agencies to give approved prearrival medical instructions, including choking and naloxone guidance, by January 1, 2027.

title: Insurance: warranty: catalytic converter.
summary: Expands vehicle protection products covering catalytic converters, limits warranty benefits, and requires seller disclosure for body part marking products.

title: Abandoned recreational vehicles.
summary: Lets more public agencies and a state agency run abandoned recreational vehicle disposal programs in Alameda and Los Angeles counties, extending the authority to 2032.

title: Community colleges: housing: local zoning regulations: exemption.
summary: Exempts community college districts from local zoning for qualifying university housing projects, requiring some units be affordable to faculty and staff.

title: Disability access: construction-related accessibility claim.
summary: Creates a program shielding qualifying small businesses from minimum statutory damages for disability access claims for six years after a CASp inspection.

title: School and community college employees: paid disability and parental leave.
summary: Requires school and community college employers to provide up to 14 weeks of paid leave for pregnancy, childbirth and related conditions, with health coverage maintained.

title: Planning and zoning: housing element: regional housing needs allocation.
summary: Extends timelines for state housing-need determinations and regional housing allocation processes, and sets a deadline for a fair housing reporting format.

title: Juveniles: dependency: incarcerated parent.
summary: Expands incarcerated parents' notice and presence rights in dependency hearings, extends minor-hearing rights to nonminor dependents, and provides mandate reimbursement.

title: San Diego County Air Pollution Control District: governing board: alternate members.
summary: Adds alternate members to the San Diego County Air Pollution Control District board and changes how some members are selected and assigned to liaison roles.

title: Child abuse: mandated reporters: talent agents, managers, and coaches.
summary: Adds talent agents, managers, and coaches who serve minors to the list of mandated child abuse reporters.

title: Homelessness resource telephone system.
summary: Requires Los Angeles County to establish a telephone system that receives calls about homeless individuals and connects them to resources.

title: California-Mexico Border Relations Council.
summary: Lets the Assembly Speaker and Senate President pro Tempore appoint border-district legislators as nonvoting members of the California-Mexico Border Relations Council.

title: Account cancellation.
summary: Requires social media platforms to offer a clear account-deletion button, bars obstructing deletion, and treats account deletion requests as CCPA deletion requests.

title: Otay Mesa East Toll Facility Act: public-private partnership agreements: toll revenues.
summary: Revises the Otay Mesa East Toll Facility Act to allow public-private partnerships, expand tolling authority, and use toll revenue for private partner payments.

title: Vehicles: registration fees.
summary: Requires DMV to post an affordability impact analysis within six months after any vehicle registration fee increase.

title: Master of Divinity: physician and surgeon: title.
summary: Prohibits Master of Divinity holders from displaying 'MDiv' in ways confusable with 'MD,' with no criminal penalties for violations.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: exemption: egress route projects: fire safety.
summary: Temporarily exempts certain public egress route projects in fire-prone subdivisions from CEQA review, with public meeting and exemption notice requirements.

title: Planning and Zoning Law: postentitlement phase permits: Housing Accountability Act.
summary: Limits local agencies to two plan check reviews for building permits, adds tolling notice rules, and bars post-approval inspection changes that deviate from approved plans.

title: The California Guaranteed Income Statewide Feasibility Study Act.
summary: Requires DSS to contract for recommendations on a permanent statewide guaranteed income program and report on expanding the pilot by 2028.

title: Postsecondary education: mixed-use intersegmental educational facility in the City of Chula Vista: South County Higher Education Planning Task Force.
summary: Creates a task force to study the feasibility of a mixed-use intersegmental higher education facility in Chula Vista, reporting by 2027.

title: Hydrofluorocarbon gases: sale and distribution prohibition: exemptions.
summary: Removes the reclaimed hydrofluorocarbon exemption from the HFC sale ban, adds new refrigerant exemptions, and expands the related crime.

title: Community colleges: baccalaureate degree program: Southwestern Community College District.
summary: Authorizes Southwestern Community College District to offer up to four workforce-aligned bachelor's degree programs, with a legislative evaluation and a 2037 repeal.

title: Commissioner of Financial Protection and Innovation: report: Office of the Ombuds.
summary: Adds the Office of the Ombuds to the content required in the Commissioner's annual consumer financial protection report.

title: State cryptid.
summary: Establishes Bigfoot as California's official state cryptid, along with related findings and declarations.

title: Professions and vocations: license examinations: interpreters.
summary: Requires licensing boards to collect applicants' language preferences and report on non-English-speaking applicants who need interpreters.

title: Alcoholic beverage control: large outdoor events: drink spiking.
summary: Requires alcohol licensees at large outdoor events to offer drink-spiking test devices and drink lids, with warnings for first violations.

title: Substance use disorder coverage.
summary: Bars insurers from concurrent or retrospective medical-necessity review of the first 28 days of certain substance use disorder treatment starting 2027.

title: Attorney General: Reproductive Privacy Act: enforcement.
summary: Lets the Attorney General sue to enforce the Reproductive Privacy Act, with up to $25,000 civil penalties and subpoena power.

title: Planning and zoning: housing element: converted affordable housing units.
summary: Adds replacement-unit and demolition data to annual housing reports and lets agencies count 55-year affordable conversions of existing units.

title: Accelerated restaurant building plan approval: California Retail Food Code: tenant improvements.
summary: Creates a streamlined restaurant tenant-improvement permit process using licensed private certifiers, with deemed approval if local departments miss a 20-business-day deadline.

title: Real property tax: welfare exemption: community land trusts.
summary: Extends the property tax welfare exemption for community land trust housing by five years, to January 1, 2032, and bars state reimbursement of lost local revenue.

title: Unaccompanied homeless pupils: Unaccompanied Youth Support Grant Program.
summary: Creates a five-year pilot grant program so school districts, county offices and charter schools can support unaccompanied 16- and 17-year-old youth, subject to appropriation.

title: Clean Cars 4 All Program.
summary: Requires Clean Cars 4 All regulations to make vehicle replacement incentives available statewide, prioritize retirements, and boost incentives for low-income residents.

title: Office of Farm to Fork: California Farm to School Program.
topics: Children and families; Consumer protection and business
summary: Creates the California Farm to School Program to boost California-grown food procurement and hands-on food education in schools, with a funding account subject to appropriation.

title: Medi-Cal: unrecovered payments: interest rate.
summary: Requires Medi-Cal to waive interest on certain old provider overpayments under repayment agreements when specified fiscal and error factors apply.

title: Pupil records and health: pupils experiencing homelessness: directory information and reporting.
summary: Allows schools to share homeless pupils' directory information for eye exams and oral health assessments unless parents opt out, with limited use and alternative reporting channels.

title: Interagency Council on Homelessness.
summary: Requires the Interagency Council on Homelessness to develop recommendations on serving LGBTQ+ people experiencing homelessness and report to the Legislature by July 2027.

title: Department of Parks and Recreation: Big Basin Redwoods, Año Nuevo, and Butano State Parks.
summary: Exempts Parks Department land acquisitions for three state parks from State Public Works Board review until 2033, with periodic reporting to the Legislature.

title: School safety: armed school resource officers.
summary: Requires rural school districts and charter schools to have armed school resource officers present at qualifying schools, with a good-cause exception for lack of funding or qualified personnel.

title: Public social services: foster care benefits.
summary: Requires counties to review foster children's benefit eligibility more often, transfer benefits to other programs when eligible, and set initial benefit amounts within 30 days of detention.

title: California DREAM Loan Program: limits.
summary: Raises DREAM loan borrowing limits for graduate students, setting a $20,500 annual cap and $118,500 aggregate limit.

title: Health care coverage reporting.
summary: Requires health plans and insurers that use prior authorization to report related claims data annually, which regulators would publish online.

title: Business entities: limited liability companies.
summary: Lets LLCs give escrow agents, real estate brokers and title insurers a certified declaration of their existence and signing authority, with liability protection for good-faith reliance.

title: University of California: meetings of the Regents.
summary: Subjects the UC Academic Senate and Board of Admissions and Relations with Schools to Bagley-Keene open meeting requirements.

title: Small Business Development Technical Assistance.
summary: Revises eligibility and administration rules for small business technical assistance grants, adding standardized performance metrics and grantee monitoring by the Small Business Advocate.

title: Elections: deceptive audio or visual media.
summary: Extends the sunset date for California's ban on deceptive audio or visual media of candidates near elections until 2031.

title: Health care coverage: colorectal cancer screening.
summary: Requires coverage of FDA-approved colorectal cancer screening tests meeting federal or cancer society criteria; lets 35 wildfire fuel projects satisfy CEQA via timber plans.

title: Telehealth for All Act of 2025.
summary: Requires the state Medi-Cal department to produce public reports from 2028 on telehealth utilization and access, disaggregated to identify disparities.

title: Foster youth: disaster aid assistance.
summary: Creates a Child Welfare Disaster Response Program and account, funded by appropriation, to meet foster youth and caregiver needs after emergencies.

title: FAIR Plan policy notices and renewals.
summary: Requires FAIR Plan policyholder notices, insurer reporting on clearinghouse policies, and agent training and information duties, with information sharing from 2028.

title: Criminal procedure: indigent defense compensation.
summary: Bars flat-fee contracts and per-case contracts in death-penalty and life-without-parole cases, and requires indigent defense contracts to ensure adequate attorney resources and time.

title: Personal Income Tax Law: credits: pet adoption and medical expenses.
summary: Creates a temporary personal income tax credit for pet adoption costs up to $250 and pet medical expenses up to $500, limited to one pet per taxpayer.

title: Employment: contracts in restraint of trade.
summary: Bans employment contracts requiring workers to repay employers or training providers for debts when employment ends, with civil penalties and private enforcement.

title: Broadband: state oversight.
topics: AI and technology; Government and administration
summary: Creates a Broadband and Digital Equity Commission and a Department of Broadband and Digital Equity to expand broadband deployment and adoption, and makes the department the sole state authority for broadband rules.

title: Department of Industrial Relations: advisory committee: occupational safety and health.
summary: Requires a UC-led study of Cal/OSHA understaffing and vacancies, with an advisory committee and a report, subject to appropriation.

title: California Community Colleges Access and Continuity for Deported Students Act.
summary: Exempts deported community college students from nonresident tuition and lets them retain resident tuition status when they return, through 2030.

title: Lithium-ion vehicle batteries: emergencies: advisory group.
summary: Creates a State Fire Marshal advisory group to review lithium-ion vehicle battery emergency safety and develop first-responder standards by 2028.

title: Protected species: authorized take: State Route 37 project.
summary: Allows the state to authorize incidental take of specified fully protected species from a State Route 37 project, if conditions are met.

title: Local taxation: real property transfers.
summary: Requires cities to analyze and post online the effects of any proposed real property transfer tax, including on affordable housing, and applies this to charter cities.

title: Elections: local tax measures.
summary: Lets local governments direct voters to county voter guides for local tax rate details and allows electronic delivery of tax measure information.

title: Budget Act of 2024.
topics: Environment and energy; Taxes and budget
summary: Amends the Budget Act of 2024 to exempt wildfire prevention projects from the California Environmental Quality Act.

title: Solid waste: organic waste: diversion: biomethane.
summary: Defines pyrolysis under solid waste law and requires CalRecycle to count pipeline biomethane from organic waste toward local procurement targets by 2027.

title: Student loans: public service educational loan forgiveness program.
summary: Creates a state student loan forgiveness program of up to $10,000 for public service workers with 10 years of service, contingent on appropriation.

title: Corrections: solitary confinement.
summary: Requires a one-time state study of solitary confinement in California detention facilities, with facilities reporting specified data, subject to appropriation.

title: Personal income tax: exclusions: interest income: theft.
summary: Excludes from state income tax interest income an investment generates that is stolen or transferred without the taxpayer's consent.

title: California Pediatric Cancer Research Voluntary Tax Contribution Fund.
summary: Creates a pediatric cancer research fund that taxpayers can support by designating excess tax contributions on their state return, through 2030-era sunset.

title: Criminal records: destruction.
summary: Allows people arrested or convicted before age 26 of certain non-serious offenses to petition for sealing and destruction of records after four years crime-free.

title: Public Utilities Commission: Independent Office of Audits and Investigations.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Creates an Independent Office of Audits and Investigations within the PUC led by an Inspector General, and removes the exception that let the PUC extend the 18-month scoping memo deadline.

title: Forest Organic Residue, Energy, and Safety Transformation (FOREST) and Wildfire Prevention Fund Act.
summary: Creates a FOREST program using Timber Fund or GGRF money to reimburse biomass power facilities that use high-hazard forest waste as feedstock.

title: San Luis and Delta-Mendota Water Authority: B.F. Sisk Dam Raise and Reservoir Expansion Project.
summary: Appropriates $455.5 million from the General Fund to a water authority to fund Highway 152 improvements for the Sisk Dam project.

title: California Youth Football Act: safety equipment.
summary: Requires youth football programs to allow soft-shell helmet add-ons and bars manufacturers from voiding helmet warranties for their use.

title: Sustainable Groundwater Management Act: groundwater sustainability plans.
summary: Clarifies that groundwater agencies with multiple plans in a basin may amend their coordination agreement after the state issues its plan assessment.

title: Ignition interlock devices.
summary: Extends California's ignition interlock device requirements for DUI offenders from 2026 to 2033, and extends DMV reporting to 2031.

title: Electrical corporations: resiliency planning: microgrid projects.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Requires large electric utilities to collaborate with local and tribal governments and share grid data to support microgrid and resiliency planning.

title: Civil Actions: shorthand reporters.
summary: Requires meet-and-confer notices on certain civil motions to state whether parties discussed hiring a certified shorthand reporter, and allows electronic meet-and-confer.

title: Housing reform laws: enforcement actions: fines and penalties.
summary: Lets housing applicants recover attorney's fees when enforcing housing reform laws against local agencies, requires court-imposed fines on those agencies, and bars indemnification demands.

title: Public postsecondary education: student employment.
summary: Bars public colleges from refusing student hires for lacking federal work authorization proof and treats a federal hiring ban as inapplicable.

title: California Private Postsecondary Education Act of 2009: exemptions: commercial driving licenses.
summary: Removes the private postsecondary exemption for schools offering commercial driver's license training, subjecting them to state oversight under the Bureau for Private Postsecondary Education.

title: Educational equity: discrimination: antisemitism prevention.
summary: Bars school districts from adopting professional development materials that would subject pupils to unlawful discrimination, and creates a state Office of Civil Rights to address antisemitism and bias.

title: Fire safety standards: hydrogen facilities.
summary: Requires the State Fire Marshal to appoint a hydrogen fire expert and train local fire and building officials on hydrogen safety protocols.

title: Water rights: appropriation: small restoration use.
summary: Creates a small restoration water-use registration and permit option, while barring registrations on certain stream segments until instream flow requirements are set.

title: Public postsecondary education: admission: labor market outcome and student loan information.
summary: Requires CSU, and requests UC, to include in admission notices a link to graduate labor market outcome data and information on student loans.

title: County emergency plans.
summary: Requires each county to review and update its emergency plan at least every two years and removes the 2022 review date.

title: Electric Vehicle Economic Opportunity Zone: County of Riverside.
summary: Creates a Riverside EV manufacturing jobs zone if funded, and requires Bengali-language election materials on voter request.

title: Beverages: alcohol permits: container labeling.
summary: Allows winegrowers and brandy manufacturers expanded storage, tasting and sales privileges, and creates a fee-based estate tasting event permit.

title: Huron Hawk Conservancy.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Creates the Huron Hawk Conservancy within the Natural Resources Agency to acquire and manage public lands, subject to future appropriation or bond approval.

title: Reentry Housing and Workforce Development Program.
summary: Creates a grant program, subject to appropriation, for housing and employment services helping people with incarceration histories exit homelessness.

title: Real estate: digitally altered images: disclosure.
summary: Requires real estate licensees to disclose digitally altered images in property advertisements and include unaltered images online.

title: Fur-bearing and nongame mammals: trapping licenses.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive wording change to trapping license fee provisions administered by the Department of Fish and Wildlife.

title: Source plasma donation.
summary: Creates a state licensing framework for source plasma donation centers, allowing donor payments and making violations misdemeanors.

title: Planning and zoning: annual report: rehabilitated units.
summary: Allows local agencies to report rehabilitated affordable housing units in annual housing reports, excluding them from streamlined-approval affordability counts.

title: Pupil and student safety: identification cards.
summary: Requires public schools and colleges to print an LGBTQ+ suicide hotline number and text line on student ID cards starting in 2026.

title: Skin care product sales: age verification.
summary: Requires sellers to verify age and identity before selling anti-aging skin products containing vitamin A or alpha hydroxy acids to minors.

title: Public utilities: climate credits.
summary: Requires electric and natural gas climate credits to appear on customer bills in specified months, unless the commission directs otherwise.

title: Mental Health: Black Mental Health Navigator Certification.
summary: Creates a Black Mental Health Navigator Certification with specialized training criteria, requires annual data publication on certified community health workers, subject to appropriation.

title: Public postsecondary education: University of California, Merced: medical education.
summary: Appropriates $15 million annually to UC Merced's Medical Education Collaborative to help medical residents apply for physician retention programs.

title: Pupil instruction: dual enrollment: College and Career Access Pathways partnerships.
summary: Revises CCAP dual enrollment rules by dropping the principal recommendation requirement and the four-course limit, and allowing synchronous or asynchronous online courses.

title: Agriculture: neglected or abandoned crops: public nuisances: pests.
summary: Lets county agricultural commissioners impose civil penalties for pest-related neglected crop nuisances, with a 30-day good-faith safe harbor and exempts beneficial organisms from the pest definition.

title: Agency reports.
summary: Requires state agencies to report annually on overdue legislative reports and allows the Legislature to withhold appropriations from late agencies.

title: Environmental protection: biological resources data: State Energy Resources Conservation and Development Commission: powerplants: power lines: applications.
summary: Makes biological resources data in state power plant and transmission applications public, except species location data posing significant risk.

title: Planning and zoning: logistics use developments: truck routes.
summary: Revises statewide warehouse standards and defines logistics use developments, requiring truck routing plans and local ordinances setting truck travel routes by 2028.

title: Transfer taxes: limitation.
summary: Caps local transfer taxes at 1.5%, exempts some disaster-rebuild sales, and places a $10 billion affordable housing bond on the 2026 ballot.

title: Energy: building decarbonization: notice and recordation of a decarbonization charge.
summary: Adds gas corporations to the energy suppliers required to record decarbonization charge notices against properties with county recorders.

title: Energy: building standards: photovoltaic requirements.
summary: Until 2028, rebuilding disaster-damaged homes in governor-declared emergency areas would only need to meet the photovoltaic rules in effect when they were originally built.

title: Common interest developments: managing agent fees.
summary: Requires HOA boards to review an annual statement of managing agent fees, which becomes an association record available to members.

title: Vehicles: financial responsibility.
summary: States legislative intent to later change financial responsibility limits for personal vehicle sharing programs; makes no substantive change now.

title: Virtual power plants: load shifting: integrated energy policy report.
summary: Requires the Energy Commission to adopt a virtual power plant deployment plan and requires electric utilities to report annually on their load-shift contributions.

title: Department of Justice: child abuse reporting.
summary: Requires CASA programs to run state and federal criminal background checks on candidates and get notified of child abuse index entries involving staff or volunteers.

title: Department of Consumer Affairs: licensing: applicants who are descendants of slaves.
summary: Requires licensing boards to expedite applications from certified descendants of American slavery, contingent on SB 518 enactment.

title: California Financing Law: lawsuit financiers.
summary: Requires lawsuit financiers to obtain a state license, maintain a surety bond, and face civil penalties for willful violations.

title: Alcoholic beverage control: tied-house restrictions: exceptions: off-sale retail services.
summary: Expands the tied-house exception for alcohol brand services to wine and spirits in containers up to 500 milliliters.

title: School districts: reorganization: state board approval: qualified special taxes.
summary: Temporarily lets the state board approve school district reorganizations backed by enforceable local agreements, even when standard criteria are not literally met.

title: Inmate Cooperative Program.
summary: Creates an Inmate Cooperative Program in state prisons, letting inmate groups form worker cooperatives under warden approval and certification.

title: Service of Process Accountability, Reform and Equity (SPARE) Act.
summary: Tightens process-server proof and service rules, defines reasonable diligence, and lets defendants challenge defaults for improper service.

title: Single-family and multifamily housing units: preapproved plans.
summary: Requires local agencies to create preapproved housing plan programs and ministerially approve or deny qualifying housing applications within 30 days.

title: Youth Sports for All Act.
topics: Children and families; Government and administration
summary: Creates a Blue Ribbon Commission to study a centralized youth sports department, with a contingent funding fund, repealing in 2033.

title: Residential property insurance images.
summary: Requires insurers to notify homeowners about aerial imaging, provide images on request, and bars termination based on images over 180 days old.

title: Department of Housing and Community Development.
summary: Expands state loans and grants to preserve affordability of expired-restriction and challenged housing projects, with set-asides and priority.

title: Rest periods: petroleum facilities: safety-sensitive positions.
summary: Makes indefinite an exemption from rest period rules for certain petroleum and alternative-feedstock refinery safety-sensitive workers.

title: Child daycare facilities.
summary: Treats daycare centers colocated with multifamily housing as by-right residential uses and bars local business license fees for them.

title: Childcare: facility licensure: teacher requirements.
topics: Children and families; Labor and employment
summary: Creates a temporary assistant teacher permit for child care staff with lower credential requirements, supervision rules, and staffing caps.

title: Floating home marinas: rent caps: County of Marin.
summary: Caps Marin floating home marina rent increases at cost-of-living change through 2038, requires cost-based fees, and bars enforcement fees.

title: Income tax: exclusion: disasters.
summary: Excludes up to $300,000 yearly income from state taxes for taxpayers whose property or business burned or became uninhabitable in a disaster, 2025–2034.

title: State public employment: memorandum of understanding: State Bargaining Unit 6.
summary: Approves a state employer and Bargaining Unit 6 agreement, making its spending provisions effective only if the Legislature specifically appropriates funds.

title: School finance: budget reports.
summary: Extends the deadline for school boards to approve the October 31 budget report to December 20 in years with regular board elections.

title: Wildfire: vegetation management.
summary: Requires state and local agencies to assess undeveloped public land for fire hazard, install 200-foot firebreaks by 2028, and plan management of newly acquired land.

title: Architects: architects-in-training.
summary: Creates an architect-in-training title for exam-passing candidates under licensed supervision, with use limits, a four-year cap, and a 2033 application sunset.

title: Surplus land: exempt surplus land: sectional planning area.
summary: Changes the affordability and density requirements for surplus land exempt under sectional planning area documents, including student housing treatment and a 500-unit minimum.

title: Income taxes: exclusions: 2026 Garden Grove chemical leak.
summary: Excludes from state income tax, for 2027-2031, amounts qualified taxpayers receive for costs and losses from the 2026 Garden Grove chemical leak.

title: Monterey-Salinas Transit District: sales and special taxes.
summary: Lets Monterey-Salinas Transit raise a transactions and use tax for transit with voter approval, while barring its separate sales tax ballot route after 2025.

title: Disposable, battery-embedded vapor inhalation device: prohibition and penalties.
summary: Bans manufacturing, importing, selling, and distributing disposable battery-embedded vapor devices in California starting 2027-2028, with civil penalties and infraction fines.

title: Timber harvesting: waste discharge requirements.
summary: Requires faster Fish and Wildlife agreements after timber plan approval and requires regional water boards to act on timber coverage requests.

title: Birds and mammals: nongame birds: mute swans.
summary: Allows mute swans to be taken or possessed like other listed nongame birds until 2031, and asks the department to track enforcement.

title: Employment Training Fund: federal loan interest payments.
topics: Labor and employment; Taxes and budget
summary: Bars Employment Training Fund money from paying federal loan interest on the Unemployment Fund unless the Legislature approves by statute with a public justification report.

title: State agencies and departments: strategic plans: diversity, equity, and inclusion.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Requires state agencies to develop strategic plans and, where feasible, incorporate data analysis and inclusive practices to advance racial equity.

title: Sexually violent predators: schools.
summary: Adds day care centers to the existing quarter-mile buffer that bars sexually violent predators on conditional release from being placed near schools.

title: Mobilehome parks: rent protections: local rent control.
summary: Narrows exemptions so more rented mobilehome spaces fall under local rent control, limiting exemptions to units not used as permanent housing and actively for sale.

title: Regional park and open-space districts.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Modifies park district governance, lowers voter-consent and board-vote thresholds for land conveyances and exchanges, and raises exchange and contracting limits.

title: Gaming Policy Advisory Committee.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Expands the Gaming Policy Advisory Committee from 10 to 12 members, adds academia and bureau representatives, and requires at least two meetings yearly.

title: Advertising displays: City of Los Angeles: exemption: ordinance.
summary: Lets Los Angeles adopt an ordinance framework for allowable outdoor advertising displays, with phased authorization, under an existing exemption from the Outdoor Advertising Act.

title: Financing statements: mortgages.
summary: Lets mortgage financing records name an individual debtor by surname and first personal name, even if the debtor holds an unexpired driver's license or ID.

title: Cyberbullying: off-campus acts: model policy.
summary: Requires the state to develop a model policy and schools to adopt policies on addressing off-campus cyberbullying, while making such action optional.

title: Marine resources: copper-based antifouling paint: standards, studies, and best methods.
summary: Suspends enforcement of copper-based antifouling paint water and pesticide rules, deems approved paint compliant, and requires reevaluations, studies, and best-method guidelines.

title: Civil actions: enforcement of judgments.
summary: Changes court judgment-enforcement procedures for personal debts, including verification, filing deadlines, exemption claim timing, and fund release.

title: Behested payments: reporting.
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Tightens behested payment reporting for officials: quarterly deadlines, lower thresholds, added relationship and proceeding disclosures, and electronic filing.

title: School administration: school districts.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to the rules for naming new school districts.

title: Food assistance: disasters: utilities.
summary: Requires utilities to share outage data with the Department of Social Services to help maximize disaster food assistance, and requires a 2026 report.

title: Local Agency Public Construction Act: internet website posting.
summary: Requires local agencies with websites to post construction payment details, exempts contracts under $25,000, and bars withholding retention for noncompliance.

title: Child welfare services: domestic violence consultant pilot program.
summary: Authorizes counties to run a three-year pilot pairing child welfare social workers with domestic violence consultants, with a 2031 evaluation report.

title: Attorney’s fees: book accounts.
summary: Raises the maximum attorney's fees recoverable in book account contract lawsuits to $1,200 for personal accounts and $1,600 for others.

title: Disability access: construction-related accessibility claims: notice of violation and opportunity to correct.
summary: Requires a notice and 120-day chance to correct before disability construction-accessibility damage suits against small employers, and bars avoiding those rules via ADA claims.

title: Charges: health savings accounts: electricity.
topics: Environment and energy; Taxes and budget
summary: Repeals electricity fixed-charge and rate-increase phase-in rules and creates a 2026–2030 income tax deduction for health savings account contributions.

title: Unlawfully restrictive covenants: redevelopment of commercial property for residential uses.
summary: Excludes certain charter-city redevelopment projects from the process that lifts covenants restricting residential use on commercial property.

title: Public contracts: construction materials: disaster relief.
summary: Authorizes the Department of General Services to negotiate discounted construction materials for disaster-affected homeowners and local governments until 2031.

title: Special education: specialized deaf and hard-of-hearing services.
summary: Allows individualized education programs to include specialized deaf and hard-of-hearing related services as the only special education services.

title: Community Violence Interdiction Grant Program.
topics: Children and families; Guns and weapons
summary: Creates a state grant program, funded from prison-closure savings subject to appropriation, for community violence prevention and youth intervention programs.

title: California Pollution Control Financing Authority: name change.
summary: Renames the California Pollution Control Financing Authority as the Capital Programs and Climate Financing Authority, with no change to its functions.

title: Provider directory disclosures.
summary: Requires health plans and insurers to add out-of-network rights statements to provider directories and respond quickly to in-network provider requests.

title: Prisons: facilities for female offenders.
summary: Creates a women's prison division and Gender Responsive Strategies Commission, and requires reports on female offender reform plan implementation.

title: Political Reform Act of 1974: security expenses.
summary: Temporarily removes the $10,000 lifetime cap on campaign funds for candidates' security expenses, replacing it with an annual cap from 2029.

title: Public social services: higher education.
summary: Requires county human services agencies and the state Department of Social Services to coordinate with colleges on benefits, training, a workgroup, and reporting for student basic needs.

title: Homelessness: single women with children.
summary: Adds women with children to the vulnerable populations that local homelessness plans must address, and requires those plans to be reported to and posted by the state council.

title: Student financial aid: Cal Grant Program: cost of attendance.
summary: Requires colleges to adopt a cost of attendance policy and adjustment process, consistent with federal standards, to qualify for Cal Grant programs.

title: Court interpreters.
summary: Allows court interpreter unions to request multiregional bargaining when multiple regions bargain in a year, with committee mutual consent.

title: Potentially dangerous and vicious dogs: designation and disposition: burden of proof.
summary: Raises the proof standard for declaring dogs dangerous or vicious, makes provocation a factor, and adds requirements for city and county dog programs.

title: California Safe Drinking Water Act: emergency regulations.
summary: Lets the state water board adopt stricter emergency drinking water rules and requires a PFAS drinking water standard by end of 2026.

title: California Commission on the United States Semiquincentennial.
summary: Establishes a temporary commission to plan California's 250th anniversary commemorations, funded only by private contributions, dissolving if funds are insufficient.

title: Social media platforms: advertising: tax.
topics: AI and technology; Taxes and budget
summary: Imposes a tax on social media platforms' programmatic advertising receipts, depositing revenue into a Social Media Safety Trust Fund for education and mental health.

title: Community Stabilization Act: Counties of Los Angeles and Ventura.
summary: Creates an I-Bank security program funding investors who buy and resell residential land damaged by the 2025 Los Angeles and Ventura wildfires.

title: State Emergency Food Bank Reserve Program: diapers and wipes.
summary: Adds children's diapers and wipes to the State Emergency Food Bank Reserve Program's eligible supplies, allowing funds to be used for them.

title: Prisons: death benefit for incarcerated firefighters.
summary: Requires the Department of Corrections and Rehabilitation to pay a death benefit when an incarcerated hand crew member in the conservation camp program dies.

title: Budget Act of 2024.
summary: Amends the 2024 Budget Act to exempt designated agencies' wildland vegetation management burns from air permitting and require agency oversight designation.

title: Carpet recycling.
summary: Revises carpet stewardship enforcement with administrative penalties up to $25,000 per day, requires a stewardship governing board, and adds reporting and transport exemptions.

title: State prisons: food.
summary: Requires California prison vending machine food to be priced at local market rates and considers nutrition research in prison food.

title: Nondiscrimination.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Consumer protection and business
summary: Requires DFPI to examine mortgage lenders for fair lending and nondiscrimination compliance, and makes violations enforceable under state financial laws.

title: Juvenile justice commission: hunger survey.
summary: Requires juvenile justice commissions to survey confined youth about hunger and food access, and to post results and county remedial actions publicly.

title: Urban forestry: school greening.
topics: Children and families; Environment and energy
summary: Expands California's urban forestry program to cover school greening, adding school grounds technical assistance and grant funding for tree canopy and nature-based learning.

title: Medi-Cal: housing support services.
summary: Makes housing support services a covered Medi-Cal benefit for homeless or at-risk beneficiaries, once the Legislature appropriates funds.

title: Career Apprenticeship Bridge Program.
summary: Creates a Career Apprenticeship Bridge Program under the Division of Apprenticeship Standards to support youth apprenticeships with education partners.

title: Mobilehomes: cooling systems.
summary: Voids mobilehome park restrictions on cooling systems, bars tenancy termination for installing them, and creates liability and civil penalties for violations.

title: Conservation and mitigation bank: marine artificial reefs.
summary: Allows marine artificial reefs to serve as conservation or mitigation banks, after environmental review and with State Lands Commission leases on state land.

title: Campaign statements and registrations: filing online or electronically.
summary: Modernizes campaign disclosure filing, renames report terms, removes the cap on candidates' personal campaign loans, and repeals the short reporting form.

title: Corrections: rehabilitation space.
summary: Requires the corrections department to report annually to the Legislature on academic and vocational education space at each prison.

title: Veterans: mental health.
summary: Requires the Veterans Affairs department to fund an academic study of women veterans' mental health, subject to appropriation, and report findings by 2029.

title: Local government: internet websites and email addresses.
summary: Requires cities, counties, and special districts to use .gov or .ca.gov web domains and email addresses by set deadlines.

title: Teacher credentialing: computer science instruction: workgroup.
summary: Extends computer science teacher workgroup deadlines two years and creates prior field experience as an alternative pathway for teaching credentials.

title: Recall and resentencing: incarcerated firefighters.
summary: Requires CDCR to adopt regulations by July 2027 on referring incarcerated firefighters and conservation camp participants for resentencing.

title: Mobilehome parks: termination of tenancy.
summary: Expands the grounds on which mobilehome park management may terminate a tenancy, covering substantial annoyance to staff and contractors as well as residents.

title: Personal Income Tax Law: exclusions: law enforcement retirement.
summary: Excludes certain peace officer pension and survivor annuity payments from state gross income for tax years 2025 through 2029.

title: Vehicle insurance: vehicle classification.
summary: Bars insurers from classifying vehicles used for public social services or social service transportation as commercial, for-hire, or livery solely for that reason.

title: Employment: employees and independent contractors: merchandisers.
summary: Exempts in-store merchandisers contracting with businesses from the ABC worker-classification test, applying the Borello test instead.

title: Cold storage facilities.
topics: Government and administration; Housing; Taxes and budget
summary: Requires Boyle Heights cold storage facilities to fund emergency contingency funds before building permits, and excludes certain 2026 fire settlement income from taxes.

title: Permit Streamlining Act: local emergencies.
summary: After local emergencies, requires cities and counties to approve or deny complete rebuilding permit applications within 10 business days.

title: Electric vehicle charging stations: exempt entities: building standards.
summary: Exempts church and nonprofit parking lots from mandatory EV charger building standards and clarifies that chargers don't affect their zoning or tax exemptions.

title: Health care: legally protected health care activity.
summary: Extends address confidentiality and anti-doxxing protections to gender-affirming health care providers, employees, volunteers, and patients.

title: Homelessness: transport.
summary: Prohibits local governments and law enforcement from transporting homeless individuals to drop-off locations without first coordinating shelter or housing, with $10,000 penalties.

title: Pupil instruction: high school graduation requirements: career technical education.
summary: Indefinitely extends the option for career technical education courses to count toward the high school graduation requirement.

title: Commission on the State of Hate.
summary: Extends the Commission on the State of Hate's repeal date from January 1, 2027 to January 1, 2031.

title: Solid waste: plastic microbeads: plastic glitter.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Environment and energy
summary: Bans sale of personal care products with plastic glitter from 2029 and non-rinse-off or cleaning products with microbeads, with civil penalties.

title: Protective orders: firearms and ammunition.
summary: Requires restrained persons under protective orders to relinquish ammunition as well as firearms, expands officers' duty to seize ammunition, and allows free remote hearing appearances.

title: Independent System Operator: independent regional organization.
summary: Deletes the ISO regional-transition provisions and lets the ISO and utilities join voluntary regional energy markets once PUC-certified conditions are met, with annual reporting.

title: Deceptive practices: service members and veterans.
summary: Bars unaccredited persons from charging fees to help veterans file VA benefit claims, expands deceptive-advertising rules to veterans' services, and adds $2,000 fines.

title: Voting: signature verification.
summary: Shortens deadlines for voters to cure mail-ballot signature mismatches, lets drop boxes receive cure forms, and allows shorter canvass hours.

title: Alcoholic beverage control: neighborhood-restricted special on-sale general licenses.
summary: Authorizes up to 40 new neighborhood-restricted on-sale alcohol licenses for eating places in specified Los Angeles County census tracts, with resale price limits.

title: Richard Paul Hemann Parkinson’s Disease Program: Parkinson’s Disease Research Voluntary Tax Contribution Fund.
summary: Creates a voluntary tax-return contribution fund for Parkinson's disease research, continuously appropriated to the State Department of Public Health.

title: The California Elder Financial Abuse Prevention Act.
summary: Lets banks delay suspicious transactions and notify third parties about suspected elder financial abuse, exempt from state privacy laws.

title: State highways: encroachment permits: relocating or removing encroachments: public utility districts: County of Mendocino.
summary: Exempts small Mendocino County public utility districts from paying to relocate highway encroachments until 2031, shifting that cost to the state Department of Transportation.

title: Gambling: operation of a contest or sweepstakes.
summary: Bans online sweepstakes games and simulated gambling that award cash prizes, with misdemeanor penalties for operators and facilitators.

title: School Energy Efficiency Stimulus Program.
summary: Directs the State Department of Education to develop school indoor air quality standards, guidelines and recommendations by July 2027.

title: Teachers: exchange programs: local educational agencies: sponsors.
summary: Expands California's teacher exchange program to cover Mexico and allows additional federally designated visa sponsors to place Mexican teachers in California schools.

title: Personal Income Tax Law: deduction: teachers.
summary: Conforms California's income tax deduction for K-12 teacher expenses to federal law for tax years 2026 through 2030.

title: Medi-Cal: skilled nursing facility services.
summary: Removes the Medi-Cal network-provider requirement for skilled nursing directed payments, applying them retroactively to facilities serving Medi-Cal beneficiaries since July 2024.

title: Midwifery Workforce Training Act.
summary: Requires the state health department, if funded, to administer a statewide study on midwifery education and report findings to the Legislature.

title: Ketamine.
summary: Adds ketamine to the list of controlled substances whose transport, sale, furnishing, or administration is a crime, with 3-5 year jail terms.

title: Taxation: renter’s credit.
summary: Expands the renter's tax credit and income limits for several years, contingent on budget act funding, with refundable amounts.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: expedited judicial review: sustainable aviation fuel projects.
summary: Lets the Governor certify up to three sustainable aviation fuel projects as infrastructure projects, granting CEQA streamlining and faster court review.

title: School accountability: Office of the Education Inspector General: school financial and performance audits: charter school authorization, oversight, funding, operations, networks, and contracting: data systems: local educational agency contractor background checks and contracting.
summary: Tightens audit, posting and notification requirements for school districts, charter schools and other local educational agencies, and expands Controller and chartering authority oversight.

title: Outdoor advertising displays: redevelopment agency project areas.
summary: Extends by two years, to January 1, 2028, the authorization for certain off-premises billboards in former redevelopment project areas to remain.

title: State Fire Marshal: personal protective equipment: battery fires.
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Creates a temporary State Fire Marshal working group to recommend firefighter protective equipment for lithium-ion battery fires, reporting to the Legislature by 2026.

title: Paradise Unified School District: school construction funding.
summary: Appropriates $21.5 million from the General Fund to Paradise Unified to finish rebuilding schools damaged by the 2018 Camp Fire.

title: Health care coverage: language access.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Requires health plans and insurers to provide meaningful language access, qualified interpreters, and translated materials, with administrative penalties for violations.

title: Educational equity: sex-segregated school and athletic programs and activities: use of facilities.
summary: Requires pupil and student participation in sex-segregated sports, programs and facilities to be based on sex rather than gender identity, in schools and colleges.

title: Employment: complaints: agricultural employees.
summary: Requires state labor agencies to collaborate and forward agricultural employee complaints to the proper entity, protecting complainant identity, subject to appropriation.

title: Endangered species: incidental take: wildfire preparedness activities.
summary: Lets local agencies submit wildfire preparedness plans for fire hazard zones; the state reviews them, notifies permit needs, and provides wildlife-protection guidance.

title: Peace officers: confidentiality of records.
summary: Grants civilian police oversight boards and county inspectors general access to confidential peace officer personnel records during investigations, subject to confidentiality duties.

title: Sexual battery.
summary: Requires a felony sexual battery conviction involving a hospital employee and a patient or someone seeking care to count as an aggravating sentencing factor.

title: Health providers: medical chaperones.
summary: Requires providers offering sensitive ultrasound exams to notify patients that a medical chaperone is available on request, with staff training and documentation.

title: Law enforcement: cooperation with immigration authorities.
summary: Requires law enforcement to detain and transfer people convicted of any felony to immigration authorities, replacing limited discretion.

title: Institutional Debt Transparency Act.
summary: Bars colleges from raising tuition or blocking reenrollment over institutional debt without conditions, requires collection policies, and mandates debt reporting.

title: Real property transactions: Counties of Los Angeles and Ventura wildfires: unsolicited offers.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice; Housing
summary: Bans unsolicited offers to buy residential property in specified wildfire-affected ZIP codes, with attestations, civil penalties, misdemeanors, and a sunset in 2027.

title: Air pollution: oxides of nitrogen: furnaces and water heaters.
summary: Exempts gas-fired furnaces and water heaters installed with propane conversion kits from air district NOx-based sale and use restrictions.

title: California AI Transparency Act.
summary: Delays California AI Transparency Act to August 2026 and adds provenance detection duties for large platforms, capture device disclosure options, and GenAI hosting platform restrictions.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: exemptions.
summary: Exempts transmission line maintenance and renewable energy permit issuance from CEQA review, requiring notices of exemption for certain projects.

title: Vehicles: commercial electric vehicle safety.
summary: Requires the Office of Emergency Services to develop and post by 2027 an action plan for responding to electric commercial vehicle battery fires.

title: Sales and Use Tax: exemptions: manufacturing.
summary: Extends the manufacturing sales and use tax exemption to 2031, removes a CDTFA reporting requirement, and repeals the provisions in 2036.

title: School employees: cultural competency training.
summary: Requires school employees to complete annual cultural competency training for supporting pupils of color, developed by the state Department of Education, from 2027-28 through 2031-32.

title: Employment: rehiring and retention: displaced workers.
summary: Extends the COVID-era rehiring preference and recall requirements for laid-off employees until January 1, 2027.

title: Civil Procedure: recovery of defense costs.
summary: Extends existing defense-cost recovery for bad-faith or unreasonable proceedings to cases where a defendant or cross-defendant files a demurrer.

title: Instructional materials: health education.
summary: Requires the State Board of Education to adopt health education instructional materials by July 1, 2028.

title: Local control and accountability plans: technical assistance: county superintendent of schools’ recommendations.
summary: Requires county superintendents to submit written recommendations for amendments to LCAPs of districts identified for certain technical assistance.

title: Community colleges: students: public transportation: Los Angeles Community College District.
summary: Requires LA community college district and LA Metro to provide free transit passes to students, creates a student ambassador program, and appropriates $2.5 million.

title: California School Dashboard: local control and accountability plans: college and career pathway data.
summary: Adds college-intent and apprenticeship-pathway measures to the California School Dashboard college/career indicator and county LCAP school climate measures.

title: Residential rental properties: language requirements.
summary: Requires the Judicial Council to create and publish a multilingual summons form for residential unlawful detainer actions by January 1, 2027.

title: Hazardous waste: solar photovoltaic modules.
summary: Requires DTSC workshops and an evaluation of federal hazardous-waste exclusions for end-of-life solar panels, and authorizes possible adoption of those federal rules.

title: Dual language immersion programs: instructional materials: grants.
summary: Creates a grant program giving districts and charter schools $100,000 one-time to buy dual language immersion materials in partner languages, contingent on appropriation.

title: Student loan servicing.
summary: Subjects student loan servicers to the Unfair Competition Law and makes student loans subject to the Rosenthal Fair Debt Collection Practices Act.

title: Veterinary medicine: cat declawing.
summary: Restricts cat declawing and tendonectomy to therapeutic purposes only, enforced through veterinary licensing penalties.

title: Primary elections: county officers: top two candidates.
summary: Ends automatic election of county nonpartisan candidates who win a majority in the primary; the top two advance to the general election.

title: State agencies: information security: Zero Trust architecture.
summary: Requires state agencies to implement Zero Trust cybersecurity architecture, meeting CISA maturity levels by set dates under Department of Technology standards.

title: Housing development: density bonuses.
summary: Bars density bonus law from requiring local approval of transient lodging within housing developments, except as specified.

title: California Children’s Services Program: county designation.
summary: Lets counties under 2,000 population have another county administer the California Children's Services program, if standards are met.

title: Mandated reporters of suspected financial abuse of an elder or dependent adult.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Requires financial institutions to also report suspected elder financial abuse to the FBI's IC3, notify affected adults, and provide annual staff training.

title: Environmental health: product safety: perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances.
summary: Starting 2028, bans selling or distributing covered products containing intentionally added PFAS unless the state issues a regulatory response under the Green Chemistry program.

title: Dentistry: dental assistants.
summary: Revises dental assistant infection control and bloodborne pathogen training timing, allows alternative courses, and caps certain course approval fees at $300.

title: Mitigation Fee Act: development impact fees: qualified residential ownership and qualified rental projects.
summary: Requires local agencies to waive or defer development impact fees for qualified affordable residential rental and ownership projects.

title: Vehicle removal.
summary: Allows police to impound unlicensed high-speed e-vehicles and class 3 e-bikes ridden by minors, with cost recovery and release conditions.

title: Nurse anesthetists: scope of practice.
summary: Expressly authorizes nurse anesthetists to perform anesthesia services and select anesthesia modality under physician, dentist, or podiatrist orders.

title: Health care coverage: substance use disorder: residential facilities.
summary: Requires state departments to send insurers a one-time letter stating substance use disorder residential treatment is almost exclusively nonmedical; repeals January 2027.

title: Victims of abuse or violence: reasonable accommodations.
summary: Requires landlords to make reasonable accommodations for tenants who are victims of abuse or violence, with response deadlines, confidentiality, and anti-retaliation protections.

title: Firearms: unsafe handguns.
summary: Lets county probation peace officers meet unsafe-handgun training requirements through the POST firearm course, and extends the unattended-vehicle storage crime to additional persons.

title: Student financial aid: Cal Grants: Middle Class Scholarship Program: eligibility: dependents of members of the armed services stationed outside of California.
summary: Extends Cal Grant and Middle Class Scholarship eligibility to certain dependents of California-resident military members stationed outside the state.

title: State government grants and contracts: payment of claims and grantees’ indirect costs.
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Extends prompt-payment rules to nonprofit grants and requires state agencies to reimburse grantee indirect costs up to 35%.

title: Public resources: transportation of carbon dioxide.
summary: Extends pipeline safety law to carbon dioxide pipelines, requiring state regulations, restricting repurposed pipe, and limiting construction near sensitive receptors.

title: Electronic court reporting.
summary: Temporarily allows courts to use electronic recording instead of reporters in civil proceedings under specified conditions, with grievance, reporting, and form requirements through 2028.

title: Data brokers: accessible deletion mechanism: deletion of personal information of elected officials and judges.
summary: Shortens data brokers' deletion-request processing cycle to 30 days, requires notice to elected officials and judges, and allows public enforcement suits.

title: Campaign contributions: investor-owned utilities.
summary: Bans investor-owned utilities from contributing to state election candidates, and bars those candidates from accepting such contributions.

title: Public postsecondary education: College Access for All Fund.
summary: Creates a State Treasury fund, available upon appropriation, to lower undergraduate costs at UC and CSU through tuition reductions or loan repayment.

title: Nicotine: cessation.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Creates youth nicotine cessation pilot programs, community education plans, and research grants, subject to legislative appropriation.

title: Pupil instruction: high schools: computer science courses: California Computer Science Demonstration Grant Program: reporting.
