title: Sales and Use Tax Law: exemptions: infant formula.
summary: Clarifies that the sales tax exemption for food products includes infant formula, so infant formula sales are exempt from sales tax.

title: Fish and wildlife.
summary: Declares legislative intent to enact future fish and wildlife legislation, without making any substantive change now.

title: Disaster preparedness: urban retail water suppliers and public water systems: wildfire.
summary: Requires large water suppliers in high fire-risk areas to add wildfire response procedures to disaster plans; limits water systems' wildfire liability.

title: Public contracts: best value procurement: community college districts.
summary: Authorizes community college districts to use best value procurement for public projects over $1 million until 2030, with a required report and a 2031 sunset.

title: Nonpayment of rent: federal employees: government shutdown.
summary: Bars landlords from evicting or charging late fees to federal employees or contractors whose pay is hit by a government shutdown, with penalties for violations.

title: Vehicles: driving under the influence.
summary: Requires DMV, if the Legislature appropriates funds, to summarize DUI penalties and their financial consequences on registration materials and driver's licenses.

title: Juveniles: secure youth treatment facilities: less restrictive programs.
summary: Requires courts to consider specified information, including insurance policies, and state reasons on record when placing wards in less restrictive congregate care programs.

title: Energy: reliability planning assessment.
summary: Expands the joint energy reliability assessment to report transmission upgrades, grid capacity, and PUC project approvals.

title: Artificial intelligence: transparency and governance.
summary: Excludes AI from 'person' definitions in public records, meeting, APA, CEQA and Coastal Act laws; bans AI falsely representing humans engaging agencies.

title: Health omnibus trailer.
summary: Extends the Enhanced Treatment Program sunset to 2030 and requires emergency staffing regulations for non-state acute psychiatric hospitals.

title: Judicial Council: eviction data reporting.
summary: Requires courts to report quarterly, ZIP-code-aggregated unlawful detainer data to the Judicial Council and post it publicly, subject to appropriation.

title: Administrative regulations: economic impact analysis and standardized regulatory impact assessments: State Air Resources Board.
summary: Requires CARB to assess regulations' impacts on low- and middle-income households, transmit assessments to the Legislature six months before taking effect, and hold joint hearings.

title: Wildfire and Forest Resilience Task Force: FAIR Plan policies: wildland-urban interface.
summary: Directs CAL FIRE to recommend wildfire risk reduction measures for high-risk ZIP codes with rising FAIR Plan policies to the Wildfire Task Force.

title: Agriculture.
summary: Declares legislative intent to enact future agriculture legislation without making any substantive changes itself.

title: Elections.
summary: Prohibits election policies causing voter suppression and at-large methods diluting protected-class votes, and expands CVRA enforcement via lawsuits and notice letters.

title: Contractor licenses: outstanding liabilities assessed by the California Department of Tax and Fee Administration.
summary: Updates contractor license tax-liability provisions to reference the California Department of Tax and Fee Administration, requires written installment agreements, and adds a tax disclosure authorization.

title: Alameda-Contra Costa Transit District: employee relations.
summary: Extends PERB unfair-practice enforcement and bargaining protections to AC Transit employees represented by an exclusive representative, and requires notice before changes to bargaining matters.

title: Vehicles: electric bicycles.
summary: Expands e-bike labeling prohibitions to mopeds and motor-driven cycles, redefines those vehicles to include electric motors, and requires disclosures in advertising.

title: Data centers: rate structures.
topics: AI and technology; Environment and energy
summary: Directs the PUC to assess rate structures so data centers pay a fair share of grid costs and residential rates are protected.

title: Subdivision Map Act: tentative maps: expiration dates.
summary: Extends subdivision tentative map expiration periods to 48 months initially and 36 months per extension, applying to unexpired maps as of 2026.

title: Transit and Intercity Rail Capital Program: loans: transit operating purposes: San Francisco Bay area.
summary: Requires a $590 million state loan to Bay Area transit agencies' operations via MTC, repaid with state transit assistance funds.

title: Joint powers agreements: nonprofit housing developers.
summary: Lets nonprofit housing developers join joint powers agreements for risk pooling and insurance, with indemnity and revenue-use requirements.

title: State funds: grant programs: loan programs: eligibility.
summary: Bars state grant and loan awards to private entities that contract with ICE, and requires applicants to certify their subcontractors do not.

title: Bradley-Burns Uniform Local Sales and Use Tax Law: tax sharing agreements.
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Caps consultant pay on local sales tax sharing agreements at the lower of 5% of shared revenue or $250,000, and applies to charter cities.

title: Jury instructions: lesser related offenses.
summary: Requires courts, on a defendant's request, to instruct juries on closely related lesser offenses when the evidence supports it, and lets judges convict of the lesser offense in bench trials.

title: Public contracts: Department of Transportation: bid preferences: employee stock ownership plans.
summary: Requires Caltrans to give bid preferences to ESOP-owned contractors on state-funded construction, with penalties for fraudulently obtaining them.

title: Lobbyist registration and termination.
summary: Requires lobbyists to file amended certifications and termination notices directly with the Secretary of State instead of through their firm or employer.

title: Agricultural land: prohibited foreign actors.
summary: Prohibits foreign actors from buying, leasing, or controlling California agricultural land, with divestiture for violations, operative upon appropriation.

title: Wage statements: airline cabin crew employees.
summary: Lets airline cabin and flight deck crew wage statements show hourly rates and hours in place of total hours, and bars new wage-statement lawsuits by crew after June 11, 2026.

title: California State Library: study: state wasp.
summary: Directs the State Library to study the best candidate for official state wasp and report recommendations by 2028.

title: Doctors from El Salvador Program.
summary: Creates a program letting licensed Salvadoran physicians practice in California for up to three years, tied to a community health center with quality oversight.

title: Human services.
summary: Requires evaluation of CalFresh fruit and vegetable EBT pilots, codifies disaster administration funding, and amends CalWORKs reporting rules.

title: Plastic Pollution Prevention and Packaging Producer Responsibility Act: California Plastic Pollution Mitigation Fund.
summary: Sets spending rules and permitted purposes for the plastic pollution mitigation fund, and requires an annual public list of expenditures.

title: Violence Prevention, Pupil Wellness, and School Safety Grant Program.
summary: Creates a school violence prevention, pupil wellness, and safety grant program, subject to appropriation, with a 2029 legislative evaluation report.

title: General plan: safety element: very high fire hazard severity zones: insurance.
summary: Requires developers in fire hazard zones to seek insurance quotes before approvals, adds insurance to safety elements, and sets fire-building standards for developers who cannot obtain quotes.

title: Large-scale solar: Central Valley: study.
summary: Requires a study, subject to appropriation, on large-scale solar's land use, environmental and economic impacts in the Central Valley, with mitigation recommendations.

title: California Environmental Quality Act.
summary: Expresses legislative intent to enact future environmental quality legislation, without changing CEQA's current requirements.

title: Pharmaceutical facilities: skilled and trained workforce.
summary: Requires pharmaceutical facility owners to use a skilled and trained workforce on construction work, with monthly reporting and civil penalties for contractors who fail to comply.

title: Expedited birth certificates upon adoption.
summary: Requires the State Registrar to issue new birth certificates within 11 weeks of adoption reports, with deadlines for incomplete filings.

title: Open meetings.
summary: Removes local legislative body duties to offer electronic agenda request systems, translate agendas, and assist with translation or interpretation at public meetings.

title: Junior Reserve Officers’ Training Corps: establishment and eligibility.
summary: Lets districts, county offices and charter schools offer JROTC courses, and requires districts with JROTC to admit eligible homeschooled pupils from their attendance area.

title: Advance health care directive of a skilled nursing facility patient.
summary: Removes patient advocates as valid witnesses for skilled nursing facility patients' advance health care directives, requiring an ombudsman instead.

title: Public social services trailer bill.
summary: Trailer bill modifying child abuse mandated reporters: exempts adult-only care facility staff, creates reporter training, and a reporting advisory committee.

title: Child welfare: transport escort services.
summary: Expands regulation of transport escort services moving minors, adding safety policies, restraint limits, parental disclosures, and AG enforcement.

title: Communications: universal service programs.
summary: Extends the California high-cost telephone universal service support programs for rural and high-cost areas to January 1, 2033.

title: Domestic violence: Reclaim Act.
summary: Lets domestic violence victims in any pending case request prefiling orders barring abusive litigants from filing or conducting discovery without court permission.

title: Discretionary funds: County of Alameda.
summary: Requires Alameda County supervisors to approve and publicly log discretionary fund awards, with limits on awards near elections and at special meetings.

title: Immigration Legal Fellowship Project.
summary: Establishes a contingent Immigration Legal Fellowship Project to fund legal fellowships expanding immigration legal services access.

title: Tied-house exceptions: advertising: Counties of Los Angeles, San Bernardino, and San Diego.
summary: Expands alcohol tied-house advertising exception to certain facilities in three counties and bars supplier agreements prioritizing specific brands.

title: Small energization projects: electrical service connections.
summary: Requires the PUC to set timelines for utilities to process requests to energize small electrical projects.

title: Permanent standard time.
summary: Repeals daylight saving time and requires California and its political subdivisions to observe year-round standard time.

title: Vehicles: reckless driving: impoundment.
summary: Increases license suspensions for repeat reckless driving and tightens conditions for owners to reclaim impounded vehicles, while barring towing and storage fees when charges are dismissed.

title: Prescription drug cost sharing.
summary: Requires health plans and insurers to count drug payments made on enrollees' behalf toward cost-sharing limits, with penalties for insurer violations.

title: State government: Immigrant and Refugee Affairs Agency: Office of Immigrant and Refugee Affairs.
summary: Establishes an Immigrant and Refugee Affairs Agency and office to promote immigrant inclusion, barring use of resources for immigration enforcement.

title: Early childhood education and childcare.
summary: Extends childcare eligibility and cost-of-care payments, lowers the daily-rate hour threshold, and appropriates added funds for subsidized childcare providers.

title: Family daycare homes.
summary: Narrows the definition of infant in family daycare homes from under 2 years to under 18 months, which affects capacity limits.

title: CalFresh: veteran eligibility.
summary: Directs the state to seek federal waivers so certain veterans can get CalFresh without job-search costs counted as income or work-time limits.

title: Medi-Cal: dashboard and outreach.
summary: Requires a Medi-Cal eligibility data dashboard and outreach on federal work requirements and more frequent redeterminations, starting 2028.

title: Security services.
summary: Expands required security officer training from 2029, adding deescalation and workers' rights hours, paid training time, and higher employer fines.

title: Administrative regulations.
summary: Requires the Office of Administrative Law to report regulation disapprovals and their reasons to the Legislature within 60 days.

title: Public contracts: retention: architecture or engineering services.
summary: Caps retention payments at 5% and requires release within 60 days for certain public architecture and engineering contracts entered on or after 2027.

title: Insurance: omnibus.
summary: Omnibus insurance bill: deactivates licenses of dissolved entities, extends insurer investment limits, and tightens producer licensing and response requirements.

title: California Conservation Corps.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Revises California Conservation Corps duties, project scope, tribal contracting, and reporting, and lets PERS members buy service credit for corps service.

title: Money laundering: digital assets.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice
summary: Expands money laundering to cover digital assets and lets prosecutors seize and forfeit crypto through warrants and special proceedings, until 2032.

title: Insurance: examination of insurers.
summary: Requires insurers to fix violations found in examinations, with penalties for noncompliance and commissioner enforcement orders.

title: Education finance: education omnibus budget trailer bill.
summary: Expands state oversight of county offices of education's budgets and fiscal intervention, adding earlier notice and changed cost-sharing for fiscal distress.

title: Gang databases.
summary: Extends state oversight and regulation under the gang database provisions to all gang databases, not only shared ones, starting 2027.

title: Criminal procedure: postconviction investigation.
summary: Lets district attorneys open postconviction investigations of factual innocence claims, using subpoena power, with materials shared with petitioners under a protective order.

title: Endangered wildlife: kangaroos.
summary: Exempts commercial import and sale of kangaroo products from the state's wildlife trade ban if harvested under specified laws.

title: Zero- and near-zero-emission medium- and heavy-duty vehicles: incentives: transparency.
summary: Conditions zero-emission medium- and heavy-duty truck incentives on manufacturer price and purchase transparency, and changes voucher caps for the vehicle voucher program.

title: California State Library: study: state butterfly.
summary: Requires the California State Library to study state butterfly candidates and report recommendations to the Legislature by 2028.

title: Electrical corporations: electric vehicle charging stations: multifamily housing properties.
summary: Requires the PUC to set targets for utilities to install EV charging stations at multifamily housing, with annual progress reports and ratepayer cost protections.

title: Budget Act of 2026.
summary: Creates housing leadership designations letting qualifying cities exempt themselves from specified Planning and Zoning Law provisions and deems their housing elements in compliance.

title: Nonconsensual Intimate Image Clearinghouse.
summary: Creates a DOJ clearinghouse so victims can seek removal of nonconsensual intimate images, requiring platforms to remove verified matches within 48 hours.

title: Vehicle immobilization: illegal dumping violation penalties.
summary: Allows vehicle immobilization for owners with delinquent illegal dumping violation notices or unpaid or unanswered dumping citations.

title: Energy efficiency programs: discontinuance of administration.
summary: Requires the PUC to approve utility applications to discontinue energy efficiency programs that are not cost-effective, reliable, or needed.

title: Taxation.
summary: Taxes digital products as tangible property, extends business credit limits to 2030, and appropriates $750,000 to CDTFA for administration.

title: Firearms: prohibited persons.
summary: Bars people convicted on or after 2027 of certain serial-number tampering misdemeanors from owning or possessing firearms for 10 years.

title: Lanterman-Petris-Short Act: conservatorships.
summary: Bars courts from finding a person unable to meet basic needs solely because of temporary incarceration-provided access, and lets DAs participate in grave disability hearings.

title: Career Technical Education Technical Assistance and Equity Pilot Program Act.
summary: Creates a three-year pilot program providing technical assistance for equitable career technical education, appropriating $4 million from the General Fund.

title: Fairs: contracting.
summary: Prohibits California fairs from issuing bids or proposals that limit contract bidding to one bidder, and voids contracts awarded in violation.

title: The California Emerging Therapies Research Partnership Act.
summary: Creates a state fund to support federally registered clinical trials of psilocybin, ibogaine, MDMA, DMT and ketamine, anchored at a UC campus.

title: Initiative and referendum measures: title and summary.
summary: Shifts responsibility for initiative and referendum circulating and ballot titles and summaries from the Attorney General to the Legislative Analyst, contingent on voter approval of SCA 3.

title: Pupil health: individuals with exceptional needs: respiratory services.
summary: Replaces licensed vocational nurse authority to provide basic respiratory services to students with exceptional needs with authorization for qualified individuals.

title: Department of Industrial Relations: apprenticeship pilot program.
summary: Requires DIR and the Department of Human Resources to design a state employee apprenticeship pilot program by 2029, with pay set through collective bargaining.

title: Advertising displays: exemptions: arenas and redevelopment agency projects.
summary: Extends state outdoor advertising exemptions for arena displays from 2028, limits eligible arenas to those built or under construction by 2027, and caps displays at two per arena.

title: Coastal resources: coastal development permits: disaster exemption.
summary: Removes the coastal permit exemption for disaster-destroyed structure replacement by new owners when it would encroach on recorded open space easements or deed restrictions.

title: Higher education budget trailer bill.
summary: Budget trailer bill funding two UC student housing projects, requiring KIDS savings program information for pupils, and delaying admissions course standards work.

title: Solid waste: illegal dumping: penalties: resources.
summary: Raises illegal dumping fines, ends per-day violation counting, and makes the Department of Resources Recycling and Recovery the lead state resource for local dumping efforts.

title: Claims against the state: appropriation.
summary: Appropriates an unspecified amount from the General Fund to the Attorney General to pay an unspecified court judgment, effective immediately.

title: Mountain lions.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive change to the existing authorization allowing property owners to immediately take mountain lions attacking livestock or domestic animals.

title: Public utilities: rates.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Requires utilities seeking rate changes to submit more information and weighs wildfire risk reduction, and makes the commission's cost report data public.

title: Dependency: fentanyl use.
summary: Requires social workers to document fentanyl exposure risk assessments and requires courts to order parental fentanyl testing and specified case plan resources in dependency cases.

title: Tribal gaming: compact ratification.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Environment and energy
summary: Ratifies three tribal-state gaming compacts and exempts related actions from CEQA review as tribal sovereignty deference.

title: State Records Management Act.
summary: Revises and recasts state agency and Secretary of State duties for determining and transferring records with archival value.

title: Civil Rights Department.
summary: Raises the penalty for repeat failures to file employer pay data reports to up to $1,000 per employee and requires annual publication of report counts.

title: Common interest developments: management.
summary: Revises HOA management definitions and manager duties, and requires associations to provide budgets and inspection documents to owners on request for property sales.

title: State Air Resources Board: regulations: supplemental impact analysis.
summary: Requires the Air Resources Board to publish a supplemental regulatory impact analysis when major regulations are materially changed before adoption.

title: Public resources trailer bill.
summary: Trailer bill authorizing a Holocaust memorial at Exposition Park, expanding Bay Fill Clean-Up fund uses to enforcement, and amending underground storage tank loan program.

title: Office of Nonprofit Empowerment.
summary: Creates a Government Operations Agency office to support nonprofits and a related fund, subject to appropriation, repealed in 2037.

title: Skilled and trained workforce requirements.
summary: Expands skilled and trained workforce requirements for public projects, adding job-site notices, developer penalties, and stricter Labor Commissioner enforcement.

title: Community Assistance, Recovery, and Empowerment (CARE) Court Program.
summary: Allows CARE petitioners to submit information about a respondent's condition, treatment history, and housing, which the CARE team must review and the court may consider.

title: Unlawful detainer: Tenant Protections for Immigrant Families Act of 2026.
summary: Bars landlords from evicting tenants whose income was hit by immigration enforcement, pausing evictions and barring late fees until hardship ends, through 2030.

title: Public Agency Benefits Intermediary Compensation Disclosure Act.
summary: Requires brokers and consultants advising public agencies on health benefits to disclose compensation before contracts and prohibits undisclosed payments.

title: Sale of gasoline: petroleum: branded and unbranded: report.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Environment and energy
summary: Requires the state to implement a strategy facilitating alternative-spec gasoline sales, moves reports earlier, and adds a branded/unbranded price analysis.

title: Autonomous vehicles.
summary: Requires driverless vehicle makers to add remote-operator, communications, emergency response, and staffing requirements, with DMV guidelines on technician response times.

title: Social media platforms: child influencers.
topics: AI and technology; Children and families
summary: Requires social media platforms to offer child influencers a way to request removal of paid content featuring them, and lets them sue vloggers who don't comply.

title: State agencies: automated decision systems.
summary: Restricts state agencies' use of automated decision systems for licenses and benefits, bars sole-basis adverse decisions, and lets GovOps issue guidance.

title: Personal income taxes: deductions: elderly seniors.
summary: Creates a temporary income tax deduction of up to $3,000 per qualifying senior for tax years 2027 through 2031, phased out at higher incomes.

title: Medi-Cal: managed care organization provider tax.
summary: Imposes a per-enrollee MCO tax for 2027–2029 and deposits proceeds in a new Medi-Cal Stability Fund for Medi-Cal costs.

title: State highway system: wildlife connectivity.
summary: Requires Caltrans to assess wildlife barriers, publish wildlife connectivity improvement lists, and include wildlife connectivity in its highway management plan.

title: Elementary and secondary education.
summary: Expresses legislative intent to enact future legislation relating to elementary and secondary education.

title: California resident taxpayer health care coverage.
summary: Declares low-income taxpaying residents (at or below 138% FPL) entitled to public health coverage and requires DHCS to ensure access, including Medi-Cal.

title: Salinas Reservoir: recreational use.
summary: Allows bodily-contact recreation at Salinas Reservoir if water receives full treatment and monitoring, with reporting; repeals January 1, 2032.

title: Local government: land use: general plans.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive technical changes to state law on county and city general plans for land use.

title: Postsecondary education: Designation of California Hispanic-Serving Institutions.
summary: Creates a contingent state designation recognizing California colleges that excel at serving Latino students, administered by the CSU Chancellor's office, valid for five years.

title: Subdivision Map Act: action or proceeding.
summary: Bars certain Subdivision Map Act enforcement suits that duplicate CEQA claims against the same defendant, sunsetting in 2032.

title: Federal immigration enforcement: report.
summary: Requires the Attorney General to annually report on reported immigration enforcement incidents at designated locations like schools and courthouses, with civil penalties for noncompliance.

title: Hazardous waste: site remediation: residential suitability guidelines.
summary: Sets contamination thresholds that bar residential use above limits, and lets multifamily housing proceed on hazardous sites after suitability determinations.

title: Refineries: decommissioning and remediation: cost estimates.
summary: Requires refiners to submit public decommissioning and site remediation retirement plans to CalEPA, with review, public comment, and a remediation cost overview.

title: Education finance: education omnibus trailer bill.
summary: Requires state intervention when county education offices get negative financial certifications, and replaces differentiated-assistance add-ons with a new county office funding grant from 2026-27.

title: California Environmental Quality Act.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to CEQA's legislative findings, declarations, and statement of intent, with no substantive effect.

title: Aging and Disability Resource Connection program.
summary: Prevents the state from revoking Aging and Disability Resource Connection designations due to partner changes and sets continuity and dissolution rules.

title: Education finance: community colleges: general fund balance.
summary: Caps community college districts' unrestricted general fund balances at 50% of expenditures and limits transfers, requiring excess funds go to staff.

title: Contractors: debris removal.
summary: Bars contractors without specified licenses from hazardous-material debris removal after declared disasters, and requires certification and hazardous waste training.

title: Probate: notice of death for child support obligations.
summary: Delays and narrows probate notice to the child support agency to estates with actual knowledge of a child support obligation, and sets a 4-month claim window.

title: California Alternative Energy and Advanced Transportation Financing Authority: GoGreen Program.
summary: Requires the state financing authority to run the GoGreen Program, financing residents' energy efficiency and decarbonization measures, and creates a fund for it.

title: Crimes: theft.
summary: Requires copper theft value to include the victim's repair and replacement costs, so more thefts reach the grand theft felony threshold.

title: Common interest developments: electric vehicle charging stations owned by members in common areas.
summary: Shifts liability for damage from member-owned EV chargers in HOA common areas to owners and installers, and gives associations civil liability protection.

title: Outdoor public recreation spaces: equitable access.
summary: Establishes the Outdoors for All initiative under the Natural Resources Agency to expand equitable outdoor recreation access and requires annual progress reports.

title: Chiropractors: animal chiropractic practitioners.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Creates a state registration scheme letting licensed chiropractors practice animal chiropractic, exempt from veterinary law, with premises registration and fees.

title: Climate change.
summary: Extends Energy Commission EPIC follow-on funding to 2028, gives the chairperson 5% annual raises, and changes certification application fees to a deposit.

title: Wildfire mitigation program: financial assistance to counties.
summary: Directs the wildfire mitigation joint powers authority to fund home hardening in counties with the greatest wildfire and social vulnerability risk, upon appropriation.

title: Midwifery: workforce data: availability to be a clinical preceptorship.
summary: Requires the Medical Board to collect midwives' preceptor availability data and report it to the state health data department, sunsetting in 2030.

title: Local ordinances: administrative fines or penalties.
summary: Requires local agencies to give owner-occupied small residential property owners at least six months to fix certain code violations before fines, applying to charter cities.

title: Alcoholic beverages: tied-house restrictions: instructional events and promotional lectures: advertisements.
summary: Loosens alcohol tied-house advertising rules for instructional and wine tasting events, allowing videos and graphics and removing the inconspicuousness requirement.

title: Industrial cities.
summary: Defines the term "industrial city" for use in state and local governmental entity identification law.

title: Sales and use tax exemption: vehicle license fee imposition: motor vehicles.
summary: Temporarily exempts certain new and used vehicle sales from sales tax while imposing a 3.9375% vehicle license fee deposited in the General Fund, 2027-2032.

title: Crimes: sexual exploitation of a child.
summary: Expands child sexual exploitation crimes to downloading or streaming and covers AI-generated or digitally altered depictions of minors.

title: Taxation: Personal Income Tax Law: cost-of-living refundable tax credit.
summary: Creates a refundable cost-of-living income tax credit for 2027 to 2031, refunded from the Tax Relief and Refund Account, and excludes it from gross income.

title: Elderly Parole Program.
summary: Excludes people with certain sex-offense sentence enhancements from the Elderly Parole Program, applying to everyone incarcerated as of 2027.

title: Speed safety systems.
summary: Requires speed cameras to blur images of non-violating drivers and pedestrians, and lets Long Beach add two cameras on Pacific Coast Highway.

title: Transportation.
summary: Lets Finance shift transportation capital funds with zero net change, reinstates a DMV partner fee through 2028, and expands towing licenses.

title: Health care coverage for mental health and substance use disorders.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Requires insurers to pay out-of-network mental health professionals at the greater of average contracted rates or 125% of Medicare, and bars balance billing beyond in-network cost sharing.

title: Public resources: certified community conservation corps.
summary: Makes only nonsubstantive wording changes to existing law on certified community conservation corps in large cities.

title: Transportation electrification: grid-integrated vehicle technologies: standards.
summary: Requires the Energy Commission to set standards making new on-road vehicles sold in California include grid-integrated vehicle and charging technology, with exemptions and waivers.

title: Electric vehicle charging stations: installation: permits.
summary: Streamlines local permitting for EV charging stations, extending approval to canopy and onsite storage systems and requiring GO-Biz standard forms.

title: Medi-Cal benefits: employer reports.
summary: Requires DHCS to report to the Legislature on large employers whose workers receive Medi-Cal, and keeps individual data confidential.

title: Juvenile court: procedure.
summary: Deems juvenile adjudications dismissed under existing authority as never occurred and bars adverse consequences from them, including setting aside findings.

title: California State Library: study: state pinniped.
summary: Designates the California sea lion as the official state pinniped and requires a State Library study and 2028 report on the choice.

title: Personal Income Tax Law: Corporation Tax Law: credits: shortline railroad expenditures and railroad infrastructure.
summary: Creates income and corporation tax credits for 50% of shortline railroad and new rail infrastructure expenditures through 2032-2033.

title: Property: nonprobate transfer of ownership.
summary: Requires securities holders to notify beneficiaries and pay designated shares within 60 days after nonprobate owner deaths, with special documentation rules for nonprofits and charities.

title: Hazardous materials: non-RCRA hazardous waste: landfill disposal.
summary: Requires non-RCRA hazardous waste destined for land disposal to go to RCRA-regulated landfills, and expands hazardous waste crimes.

title: Labor.
summary: Adds career executive assignment employees to state nonindustrial disability benefit eligibility and sets a claim filing deadline.

title: Cartwright Act: public procurement of goods and services: Department of Justice: examination of public entity records.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Lets the Attorney General examine public contract records in bid-rigging probes and bars that information from Public Records Act release.

title: Mutual water companies.
summary: Expands mutual water company open-meeting access and document availability, requiring website posting, electronic notice, and eliminating the 24-hour attendance notice.

title: Enhanced curb management system.
summary: Authorizes six California cities to use curb cameras for parking enforcement and automated payments, with confidentiality, policy, and reporting requirements.

title: State highways: projects: notice.
summary: Requires the state transportation department to give written notice and post online about certain highway projects in small counties to nearby residents and businesses.

title: Horse racing: out-of-state thoroughbred races: Japan Cup.
summary: Exempts Japan Cup races from the daily cap on imported out-of-state thoroughbred races that California wagering operators may carry.

title: Electrical corporations: distributed energy storage systems.
summary: Requires utilities to evaluate distributed energy storage as a reliability solution and run transparent solicitations for third-party alternatives.

title: Real property: rentals: pet policy.
summary: Requires landlords to disclose written pet policies in listings and applications, and refund application fees when undisclosed policies cost applicants the unit.

title: Regional wildfire partnerships.
topics: Environment and energy; Taxes and budget
summary: Revises the Regional Forest and Fire Capacity Program, authorizes regional wildfire partnerships, and creates an I-Bank-financed revolving fund for wildfire mitigation.

title: Real property tax: exemptions: religious services: parking.
summary: Removes the congregation-size limit on the property tax exemption for land used by religious organizations for parking.

title: State Fire Marshal Fire Sprinkler Fitter Certification Act.
summary: Creates certification and registration requirements for fire sprinkler fitters, requiring State Fire Marshal licensing before working on fire suppression systems, with enforcement and misdemeanor penalties.

title: Oil and gas.
summary: Requires state agencies to publish reports on oil imports' emissions, air quality, and shipping costs, and to monitor foreign oil producers.

title: Housing.
summary: Removes local ministerial approval and objective design standards for certain ADUs and bars fees in ADU-related deed restrictions.

title: Natural Resources Agency: Secretariat for International Climate Coordination and Cooperation.
summary: Authorizes a Natural Resources Agency secretariat on international climate coordination and requires air board reports to discuss international climate agreements.

title: Residential property insurance: nonrenewals.
summary: Requires insurers to give longer nonrenewal notices, explain denials, allow remediation time, and report residential property nonrenewal data starting 2028.

title: Nursing.
summary: Extends the Board of Registered Nursing's sunset to 2031, changes meeting locations, posts approved nursing schools online, and sets school inspection and simulation standards.

title: Naturopathic Doctors Act.
summary: Extends the Naturopathic Doctors Act sunset to 2031, loosens school accreditation rules, adjusts fees and board terms, and criminalizes unlicensed practice.

title: Respiratory Care Practice Act.
summary: Extends the Respiratory Care Board to 2031, raises license renewal fees, changes the required exam, and mandates license suspension or revocation for certain felony convictions.

title: Wildlife: bears.
summary: Excludes grizzly bears from bear hunting and trapping rules, bars reintroduction until conditions are met, and requires a reintroduction roadmap.

title: Controlled substances: gamma-butyrolactone.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice
summary: Exempts GBL-containing chemical mixtures from state permit, reporting, and bill-of-sale requirements for controlled chemical sales.

title: False or forged instruments.
summary: Lets defendants granted diversion stipulate to voiding a false or forged instrument, and bars that stipulation's use in later proceedings without consent.

title: Legislature: constitutional course.
summary: Requires legislators and designated employees to take an orientation course on the US and California Constitutions, with opt-outs for proficiency or California lawyers.

title: Health care coverage: lung cancer.
summary: Requires private health plans and insurers to cover lung cancer follow-up screening and diagnostic services with no cost sharing starting in 2027.

title: Public Resources.
summary: Establishes round 7 of the homelessness grant program with $500 million appropriated, and exempts housing-element rezoning from CEQA.

title: Voter registration: prospective jurors.
summary: Requires jury commissioners to flag jurors attesting non-citizenship or non-residency, prompting voter registration inactivation and updates for ineligible registrants.

title: Licensed professions.
topics: Government and administration; Health care; Labor and employment
summary: Revises dental assistant infection control training options, extends the Licensed Physicians from Mexico application window, and adds a veterinary technician board member.

title: Cemeteries.
summary: Exempts a nonprofit managing an abandoned endowment care cemetery from cemetery regulation and requires annual audit reports for each year in the reporting period.

title: Drinking water: perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances.
summary: Allows the Safe Drinking Water State Revolving Fund to finance projects that address PFAS in drinking water.

title: Cigarette or tobacco product retailers: new retail locations and sale of nitrous oxide.
summary: Bars new tobacco retail locations within 600 feet of schools or daycare centers and bans tobacco retailers from selling nitrous oxide.

title: Advanced driver assistance systems.
summary: Requires manufacturers of driver-assistance systems to let drivers disable them where manual driving was previously available, with civil penalties up to $25,000 per violation.

title: Employment.
summary: Extends Labor Commissioner wage-judgment liens and limits employers' use of unproduced records in wage and public works proceedings.

title: Exempt surplus land: locally owned land
summary: Exempts surplus local agency land within a property and business improvement district and a disadvantaged community from surplus land disposal requirements.

title: Coastal resources: local coastal program: coastal development permit: non-owner-occupied short-term rentals.
summary: Requires the Coastal Commission to approve local coastal permits or LCP amendments that restrict or prohibit non-owner-occupied short-term rentals, if housing needs are shown.

title: California Public Records Act: public investment funds.
summary: Requires public disclosure of general partners, managers, and interested persons for alternative investment vehicles, overriding a Public Records Act exemption for portfolio information.

title: Taxation.
summary: Revises sales tax collection for dealer vehicle sales through DMV, and extends marketplace facilitator duties to electronic waste recycling fees.

title: Financing statements: residential real property.
summary: Prohibits filing financing statements that encumber owner-occupied residential property title and makes knowing violators liable to the owner.

title: Public postsecondary education: remedial classes and supports: audit.
summary: Requires the State Auditor to report by September 1, 2027 on CSU and UC use of remedial instruction and supports.

title: Community Care Expansion Program.
summary: Extends the Community Care Expansion program to tribes, with tribal consultation and a waiver of the real property match where federal law limits tribal land ownership.

title: Health care providers: patient access: immigration enforcement.
summary: Requires health care providers to post notices and adopt procedures limiting immigration enforcement access to nonpublic areas until 2030.

title: Passenger and freight rail: LOSSAN Rail Corridor: working group report.
summary: Extends the deadline for a LOSSAN Rail Corridor working group to report to the Legislature from February 2026 to February 2027.

title: CalFood Program.
summary: Requires the CalFood Program to also provide emergency food and funding to qualifying Feeding America member food banks in large California counties.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: tribal cultural resources: mitigation measures.
summary: Requires CEQA lead agencies to adopt mitigation for tribal cultural resources, considering avoidance and preservation in place when a consulting tribe requests it.

title: Weights and measures: electric vehicle supply equipment: state authority.
summary: Shifts accuracy oversight of EV chargers from state weights and measures rules to Energy Commission regulations, with county sealer testing requirements.

title: Public postsecondary education: Equity in Higher Education Act: campus contact.
summary: Requires community colleges and CSU, and requests UC, to designate LGBTQ support contacts at branch campuses and satellite locations too.

title: Real property tax: valuation: active solar energy system.
topics: Environment and energy; Taxes and budget
summary: Sets uniform valuation rules for active solar energy systems, limiting value to tangible property, with no state reimbursement of lost local property tax.

title: Education finance: education omnibus trailer bill.
summary: Education trailer bill extends math-training and prekindergarten grant funding deadlines and lets unused prekindergarten funds go to teacher grants.

title: Assault and battery: utility workers.
summary: Makes assault or battery against utility workers performing their duties punishable by county jail time, a fine up to $2,000, or both.

title: Community care facilities.
summary: Makes technical, nonsubstantive changes to a provision of the California Community Care Facilities Act.

title: State civil service: employment disqualification: disclosure.
summary: Bars people who worked for ICE from 2025 to 2029 from state employment, and requires state job forms to disclose any DHS employment, if the ban survives legal challenge.

title: Naturopathic doctors: scope of practice.
summary: Expands naturopathic doctors' scope to minor procedures and Schedule II–V controlled substances prescribing, removing physician supervision, and extends the act's sunset.

title: Route 59: adoption.
summary: Requires the state to seek adoption of county road J59 as a state highway by 2030 and redefines Route 59's southern endpoint.

title: Tenancy: disposition of personal property abandoned in common areas.
summary: Lets landlords dispose of personal property abandoned in common areas during a tenancy, after written notice, with tenant storage-cost protections.

title: Gambling licenses.
summary: Makes technical, nonsubstantive changes to California gambling license and work permit provisions under the Gambling Control Act.

title: State Energy Resources Conservation and Development Commission: air districts and local governments: transportation fuels refining facilities: memoranda of understanding.
summary: Directs the state energy commission to seek coordination agreements with air districts and local governments hosting refineries by 2029.

title: Vehicles: repossession.
summary: Doubles the fines for interfering with the transport of a repossessed vehicle by licensed or employed repossession agency personnel.

title: Diversion.
summary: Declares legislative intent to later strengthen diversion statutes to protect the public, support victims, and maintain accountability; makes no change now.

title: Public Safety.
topics: Criminal justice; Government and administration; Health care
summary: Repeals the Rehabilitation Oversight Board and the Council on Criminal Justice and Behavioral Health, and removes related Inspector General oversight duties and mental health diversion consultation.

title: Small business liaison: contract information: small business procurement participation.
summary: Requires prime contractors to certify small business subcontracting payments and requires agencies to publish annual payment reports on small business contracts.

title: Beverage containers: wine and distilled spirits: processing fees.
summary: Caps the recycling processing fee on bag-in-box wine and spirits containers at $0.12, allows fund expenditures and 2027 fee credits, and sunsets in 2031.

title: Criminal records: relief.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice
summary: Expands criminal record relief from 2029, covering dismissed felony arrests and tightening how courts may disclose relieved convictions.

title: Income tax credit: sales and use tax paid: natural disasters.
summary: Creates a temporary income tax credit for sales and use taxes paid to replace property destroyed in natural disasters, 2027–2031.

title: Civil actions: housing development projects.
summary: Raises the plaintiff undertaking cap to $1,000,000 for challenges to housing projects and extends these protections to behavioral health supportive housing developments.

title: Foster children: rights of foster youth.
summary: Adds a foster youth right to dignified transport of personal belongings during placement moves and to maintain access to them.

title: California Coastal Commission: powers and duties.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to the Coastal Commission's duty to periodically review its procedures to simplify permit review.

title: Pupil health: emergency stock albuterol inhalers.
summary: Expands who may fill and supply emergency stock albuterol inhalers for schools and childcare programs, adding wholesalers and distributors as sources.

title: Life and disability insurance contracts.
summary: Makes technical, nonsubstantive changes to the insurable interest provision for life and disability insurance.

title: Taxation: tax expenditures: Legislative Analyst’s Office: assessment, report, and recommendation.
summary: Requires the Legislative Analyst's Office to assess and report on major state tax expenditures, with legislative hearings, through 2032 and repeals in 2033.

title: Higher education budget trailer bill.
summary: Higher education trailer bill changing student housing report deadlines, requiring education data-sharing agreements, and setting intent for basic needs funds.

title: Energy: renewable electrical generation facilities: definition.
summary: Expands the renewable electrical generation facility definition to include qualifying hydrogen-fired turbine facilities, with resource-shuffling safeguards.

title: California Private Postsecondary Education Act of 2009: exemptions: Alameda County campus closures.
summary: Exempts certain nonprofit out-of-state institutions that take over closing Alameda County private college campuses from state registration rules, and authorizes 24-month closure notice rules.

title: Property taxation: newly constructed: reconstructed property.
summary: Lets owners of property damaged in a governor-proclaimed disaster keep its base-year tax value on rebuilt property, with temporary size limits, until 2036.

title: Alcohol or other drug recovery or treatment facilities: residential use of property.
summary: Makes a technical, nonsubstantive change to rules treating small alcohol and drug recovery facilities as residential use of property.

title: The military: defense of the state.
summary: Bars out-of-state military personnel from entering California for military or law enforcement duty without the Governor's permission.

title: School safety: school security departments: contracted private licensed security agencies.
summary: Requires school districts and contracted security agencies to set weapon-use parameters and define roles, with administrators primarily responsible for deescalation.

title: Proprietary security services.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to registration rules for proprietary private security officers.

title: Recall elections: notice of intention.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Elections and voting
summary: Requires redacting recall proponents' signatures and street addresses from public recall notices and adds internet posting when no local newspaper exists.

title: News outlets: state expenditures on ethnic and community media outlets.
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Indefinitely extends state ad-spending rules favoring ethnic and community media, and extends the newspaper distributor and carrier ABC-test exemption.

title: Natural Gas Ratepayer Protection Act.
summary: Requires gas utilities to report infrastructure spending annually and lets the PUC adopt a depreciation framework limiting stranded-asset costs to ratepayers.

title: Courts.
summary: Makes housekeeping changes to court administration reporting and repeals a juror pilot, and appropriates $4.69 million to the State Court Facilities Construction Fund.

title: Elections: translation of election materials.
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Requires election officials in identified jurisdictions to translate ballots and election materials and provide bilingual workers for voters needing language help.

title: Transit-oriented housing developments: local governments: transit agencies and projects.
summary: Bill prohibits local governments with transit-oriented stops from taking specified actions against transit agencies and transit projects.

title: DREAM grant program.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive wording change to the provision establishing the DREAM grant program for UC and CSU students.

title: Barbering and cosmetology.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Labor and employment
summary: Extends the barbering and cosmetology board to 2031, requires partnerships and LLCs to obtain establishment licenses, and adds good-standing requirements.

title: Child custody.
summary: Bars custody and visitation for parents convicted of sexual assault resulting in conception, and presumes custody detrimental in such cases.

title: Price gouging.
summary: Expands California's emergency price gouging ban to all rental housing and converts several exemptions into affirmative defenses for landlords.

title: Public Utilities Commission: report.
summary: Requires the Public Utilities Commission to submit an annual report to the Legislature on invoice payments.

title: Planning and zoning: detention facilities.
summary: Prohibits cities and counties from approving new land uses or building conversions that allow detention facilities, declaring it a statewide concern.

title: Speech-language pathologists, audiologists, and hearing aid dispensers.
summary: Extends the speech-language pathology and audiology board to 2031, adds registrations, restricts aides, and revises licensing exam and supervision rules.

title: Recall petitions.
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Requires paid petition circulators to orally disclose they are paid, and sets a 120-day submission deadline for large-county judge recall petitions.

title: State government.
summary: Restructures the Consumer Privacy Fund into subfunds and directs how privacy fines and penalties are split and spent.

title: Covered wildfire mitigation projects: consolidated and expedited review.
summary: Consolidates state environmental permit reviews for wildfire mitigation projects into one 60-day decision and waives conflicting requirements through 2029.

title: Solid waste handling services: labor dispute.
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Bars local solid waste franchise contracts from excusing service providers' performance during labor-dispute work stoppages, applying to charter cities too.

title: Behavioral Health Services Oversight and Accountability Commission.
summary: Makes a technical, nonsubstantive change to the Behavioral Health Commission's biennial reporting requirement on mental health services.

title: Diversion.
summary: Narrows mental health diversion eligibility by excluding more offenses, requiring recent diagnosis, and tightening public-safety suitability standards.

title: Restraining orders: educational institutions.
summary: Lets college administrators seek restraining orders against threats of violence toward the institution and expands conduct covered by course-of-conduct orders.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: exemption: urban intermodal rail station project.
summary: Exempts certain urban intermodal rail station projects from CEQA review if specified conditions are met and notices are filed before 2032.

title: Physician assistants.
summary: Removes the requirement that the Physician Assistant Board get the Director of Consumer Affairs' permission to meet more than six times a year.

title: Immunizations: medical exemptions.
summary: Expands child immunization medical exemptions, bars state revocation of physician-issued exemptions, and limits discipline of physicians for issuing them.

title: California Excellence in Service Learning Designation Program.
summary: Requires the State Department of Education to create a recognition program designating K-12 schoolsites for excellence in service learning, valid three years.

title: County of Riverside: separation of county offices: in-custody reports.
summary: Requires Riverside County to separate the sheriff and coroner offices, replace the coroner with a medical examiner, and publish in-custody person information online.

title: State employment: state bargaining units.
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Approves specified state employee bargaining agreements and makes contingent appropriations for their costs if the budget is not enacted.

title: Mortgage brokers.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to existing mortgage broker fiduciary duty and licensing provisions.

title: State special schools: information.
summary: Requires schools to inform parents of deaf, hard-of-hearing, blind, and visually impaired students about the option to attend California state special schools.

title: Department of Transportation: mountain passes: openings.
summary: Requires the Department of Transportation to open mountain passes by May 1 each year, publish notices of any it cannot open, and notify local officials and the public.

title: Housing development: density bonus: incentives or concessions: labor standards.
summary: Excludes labor-standard-related density bonus concessions for buildings over 85 feet from the definition of incentives or concessions.

title: Certificates of public convenience and necessity.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive wording change to existing rules requiring utilities to obtain Public Utilities Commission certificates before construction.

title: Employment Development Department.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to the Employment Development Department's property possession provision.

title: Administrative adjudication: governing procedure.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive change to the rule requiring agencies to designate and index precedent decisions in administrative adjudication.

title: State agencies: collection and reporting of demographic data: Jewish identity.
summary: Adds Jewish identity to the state's definition of ethnicity and requires state agencies to collect and report separate Jewish ancestry data with privacy protections.

title: Affordable Housing Risk Reduction Program.
summary: Creates a state program offering technical assistance to affordable housing providers to reduce risk and secure cheaper insurance.

title: The Political Reform Act of 1974: late filing of reports.
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Caps late-filing penalties for campaign and economic interest statements, removes the $10 late-copy penalty, and ends a candidate exception for late economic interest statements.

title: State Bargaining Unit 9 and State Bargaining Unit 12.
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Approves state employee bargaining agreements for Units 9 and 12, with pay-related spending taking effect only if appropriated; extends continuous appropriation.

title: Online dating services: background checks.
topics: AI and technology; Consumer protection and business
summary: Requires online dating providers to run criminal background checks on California users and flag profiles of registered sex offenders or people with specified convictions.

title: Department of Consumer Affairs: retired category licenses.
summary: Requires Department of Consumer Affairs boards that offer retired-category licenses to disclose that option on their websites.

title: Smog check: exemption: collector motor vehicles.
summary: Expands the collector vehicle definition and exempts older collector cars from smog certification, starting with pre-1981 models in 2028.

title: Commercial fishing: steelhead trout: Dungeness crab.
summary: Extends Dungeness crab entanglement rules and steelhead report-restoration card program to 2037 and 2032, adds late-return fees, and lets vessels transit closed waters under conditions.

title: State holidays: Cesar Chavez Day: Farmworkers Day.
summary: Moves the state Farmworkers Day holiday from March 31 to April 10, repeals California Farmworker Day, and adjusts school and state employee holiday provisions.

title: Criminal procedure: protective orders.
summary: Allows courts to issue longer no-contact protective orders against people convicted of registerable sex offenses involving minor victims, starting 2027.

title: Illegal dumping.
summary: Makes technical, nonsubstantive changes to existing California illegal dumping provisions, without altering penalties or prohibited conduct.

title: Mountain Lions: human-mountain lion conflicts program: scientific research.
summary: Requires CDFW, subject to appropriation, to expand its human-mountain lion conflict program and deter-lion research through 2033, with a report to the Legislature.

title: State agencies: building and renovation projects: Green Globes certification.
summary: Allows state building projects to use Green Globes certification as an alternative to the LEED Gold and Silver green-building requirements, starting in 2027.

title: Locked detention facilities: civil immigration: reviews.
summary: Indefinitely extends Attorney General reviews of locked detention facilities holding civil immigration detainees and removes the apprehension and transfer review requirement.

title: State agencies: solid waste diversion: single-use plastic bottles.
summary: Requires state agencies to plan source reduction of solid waste and restricts purchases of single-use plastic bottles starting in 2026.

title: State Bargaining Unit 6.
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Approves State Bargaining Unit 6 labor agreement for 2025–2028, with pay provisions effective only if the Legislature appropriates funds.

title: Alameda Health System: hospital authority.
summary: Lets Alameda County supervisors reshape the Alameda Health System authority's board and lets the authority acquire or affiliate with more hospitals.

title: Criminal procedure: competence to stand trial.
summary: Lets counties report confidential medical information for behavioral health eligibility, allows conservatorship referral on the court's opinion, and exempts some cases from mandatory charge dismissal.

title: Property taxation: imposition and assessment: appeals.
summary: Strengthens property tax appeals: taxpayer-favoring presumption, no fees for homes under $2.5 million, and six-month review deadlines.

title: Employee classification.
summary: Exempts door-to-door, telephone, and online direct sellers from the unemployment insurance definition of employment, expanding the existing direct-sales exemption.

title: Wildfire prevention: state responsibility areas: fire prevention fee.
topics: Environment and energy; Taxes and budget
summary: Reinstates a fire prevention fee on habitable structures in state responsibility areas from 2027 and removes the program's repeal date.

title: Unclaimed personal property: employee benefit plan distributions.
summary: Adds a forfeiture condition to an unclaimed employee benefit plan distribution exception and lets the Controller use multistate agreements to comply with federal law.

title: Sales and Use Tax Law: vehicles: shell companies.
summary: Treats partnerships and shell companies as California residents for the vehicle use tax presumption and makes their owners personally liable for unpaid taxes.

title: Personal Income Tax Law: exclusions: military retirement pay: survivor benefit pay.
summary: Expands the state income tax exclusion for military retirement and survivor benefit pay, raising the cap to $40,000, indexing income limits, and extending it to 2037.

title: Contra Costa Transportation Authority: transactions and use tax.
summary: Authorizes Contra Costa Transportation Authority to impose a 1% transactions and use tax for countywide transportation through 2045, subject to voter approval.

title: Horse racing: charity days.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Lowers the racing-weeks threshold from 14 to 12 for required charity racing days and adds a legislative bill-numbering requirement.

title: California Cannabis Tax Fund: Department of Cannabis Control: Board of State and Community Corrections grants.
summary: Directs cannabis tax fund money to enforcement and track-and-trace, and lets state grants go to localities that ban cannabis if they allow retail sales or delivery.

title: Adult community care facilities: email address of record.
summary: Extends from 10 to 12 business days the time adult community care facility licensees have to notify the state of changes to their email address of record.

title: Greenhouse Gas Reduction Fund: funding conditions: high-speed rail.
summary: Lets the high-speed rail authority commit Greenhouse Gas Reduction Fund money outside Merced-Bakersfield in any amount for early works and public-private projects.

title: Parental communication: teacher meetings.
summary: Lets parents reach teachers by phone or approved web platform when they cannot attend in person, and bans recording or transcribing those meetings.

title: State vehicle fleet: zero-emission vehicles.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to the existing requirement that state fleet light-duty purchases be at least 50% zero-emission.

title: County of San Bernardino Citizens Redistricting Commission.
summary: Establishes a 14-member Citizens Redistricting Commission in San Bernardino County to adjust its supervisorial district boundaries, upon appropriation.

title: Real property tax: welfare exemption: moderate-income housing.
summary: Extends the partial welfare property tax exemption to rental housing serving low- and moderate-income households, with state reimbursement waived.

title: Physicians and surgeons: dentists: unprofessional conduct.
summary: Shortens from 30 to 21 days the time physicians and dentists have to refund duplicate third-party payments to patients.

title: Mutual water companies: assessments and water charges: notice.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Requires mutual water companies to give notice, hold public meetings, and record board votes before raising assessments or water charges, and bars charging tenants.

title: Preservation of election materials.
summary: Bars destroying election records and voting data during pending contests or prosecutions, requires sealed storage of electronic media, and extends theft penalties to election materials.

title: Farmer Equity Act of 2017: socially disadvantaged farmers and ranchers: definition.
summary: Redefines socially disadvantaged farmers and ranchers around economic or structural barriers to agricultural viability instead of identity-based prejudice, with conforming changes.

title: Deaf and Disabled Telecommunications Program.
summary: Extends the Deaf and Disabled Telecommunications Program surcharge through 2034 and repeals the commission's surcharge adjustment authority.

title: Vote by mail ballots and early voting.

summary: Expands local agencies' permitted investments, including bank commercial paper and Inter-American Investment Corporation obligations, and removes 2031 sunset limits.

title: Health.

title: Oil spill prevention: gasoline specifications: suspension: California Environmental Quality Act: exemptions: County of Kern: transportation fuels assessment: coastal resources.
summary: Requires public posting of oil spill financial responsibility applications, reviews spill-volume criteria, and bars restarting long-idle oil pipelines without hydrostatic testing.

summary: Requires employers to annually report workplace surveillance tools to the state and notify employees and unions, with penalties for violations.

title: Crimes: criminal threats.

title: Public utilities: review of accounts: electrical and gas corporations: rates: political influence activities.
summary: Bars utilities from recovering ratepayer-funded costs of opposing municipalization and expands Public Advocate's authority to review utility accounts.

title: San Diego Association of Governments: board of directors: County of San Diego.

title: Community colleges: personnel: qualifications.
summary: Requires community college instructors and other personnel to meet minimum qualifications or approved alternative qualifications for their positions.

title: Medicare supplement coverage: open enrollment periods.
summary: Requires Medigap issuers to guarantee coverage during a 90-day January open enrollment for Medicare Part B enrollees, and extends eligibility to applicants with end stage renal disease.

title: Companion chatbots.

summary: Requires companion chatbot operators to disclose AI status, protect minors, maintain suicide-prevention protocols, and report annually to the Office of Suicide Prevention.

title: Public postsecondary education: disabled student services: assessments.
summary: Beginning July 2027, subject to appropriation, requires CSU to cover learning-disability diagnostic assessments for financially aided students lacking insurance coverage, with state reimbursement.

title: Medi-Cal: graduate medical education payments.

title: State agency contracts: bid preference: equity metrics.

title: Firearms: information to new owners.

title: County boards of education: elections: consolidation.
summary: Requires county board of education elections to be consolidated with the statewide general election starting January 2026, extending incumbent terms.

title: Antitrust: premerger notification.
summary: Requires merging parties with California ties to file copies of federal premerger antitrust notifications with the Attorney General, with civil penalties for violations.

title: Medi-Cal: provider directory: skilled nursing facilities.
summary: Requires the Medi-Cal managed care provider directory to include skilled nursing facilities as a searchable provider type and be updated annually.

title: Claims against the state: appropriation.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: exemption: undergrounding powerlines.

title: State Bar of California.

title: Energy.

title: County recorders: notification.
summary: Requires every county to set up a recorder program that mails notices to parties executing deeds, quitclaims, mortgages, or deeds of trust.

title: Electricity: electrical infrastructure: wildfire mitigation.
summary: Requires utilities to remove abandoned facilities, expand wildfire mitigation plans, and consider undergrounding and notification changes for deenergization events.

title: PARENT Act.

title: Crimes: rape.
summary: Removes the spousal exception from the rape definition for victims incapable of consent due to mental or physical disability.

title: Elections: vote by mail ballots.
summary: Adds misdemeanor coverage for interfering with vote-by-mail ballot delivery and creates a felony for supervisors who direct such interference.

title: Civil actions: restitution for or replacement of a new motor vehicle.
summary: Delays lemon-law procedures to July 2025, lets manufacturers opt in, and requires consumers who sell a vehicle after a restitution demand to give written notice before seeking civil penalties.

title: Unmanned aircraft.

summary: Requires insurers to give notice before drone inspections and limits drone evidence use; makes flying drones near critical infrastructure and the Capitol an infraction.

title: Division of Labor Standards Enforcement: orders, decisions, and awards.

title: Housing element: prohousing designations: prohousing local policies.

title: International trade: tariffs: impact study.

title: Crimes: looting.

title: Elections: language accessibility.

title: Community Assistance, Recovery, and Empowerment (CARE) Court Program.

title: Energy storage systems.
summary: Requires fire-authority consultation and pre-operation inspection for energy storage systems, and directs review of code provisions restricting their location.

title: Property taxation: change in ownership: family homes and farms.
summary: Expands the family home and family farm change-in-ownership exclusion to transfers between eligible transferees, with no state reimbursement of lost local property tax revenue.

title: Net zero greenhouse gas emissions goal: carbon dioxide removal: regulations.
summary: Limits net-zero counterbalancing to qualified carbon dioxide removal that meets specified requirements, and indefinitely authorizes CARB to adopt removed-carbon utilization and storage protocols.

title: Elderly Parole Program.
summary: Excludes people with certain sex-offense sentence enhancements from elderly parole review, applying the exclusions to everyone incarcerated as of January 1, 2026.

title: California Trails Conservancy Program.
summary: Creates a California Trails Conservancy Program in the Natural Resources Agency to promote greenways and trail networks, operative only if the Legislature appropriates funds.

title: Property taxation: change in ownership: family homes and farms.
summary: Extends the family home and farm property tax change-in-ownership exclusion deadline when probate prevents transferee occupancy; state reimbursement for lost local revenue waived.

title: Postsecondary education: Gender and Sex Discrimination Educational Oversight Office.
summary: Creates a statewide Attorney General office to receive student complaints about campus sexual harassment and assault handling and requires annual campus incident reports.

title: Civil actions: decedent’s cause of action.
summary: Extends to 2027 the window for decedents' successors to recover pain and suffering damages, and extends related Judicial Council reporting.

title: CalWORKs.
summary: Repeals CalWORKs requirement that children not required to attend school be immunized, and the grant-consideration penalty for missing documentation.

title: Contractors: workers’ compensation insurance.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Labor and employment
summary: Tightens contractor workers' compensation insurance rules by requiring exemption verification and imposing higher penalties on uninsured sole owners who employ workers.

title: Electricity: wildfire mitigation: deenergization events and reliability.
summary: Requires utilities to create access-needs support plans and post-deenergization reports, and local utilities to file annual reliability reports.

title: Real property tax: transfer of base year value: generational transfers: wildfire.
summary: Extends property tax filing deadlines for certain family transfers and homeowner exemptions for properties damaged by 2025 wildfires.

title: The Workplace Know Your Rights Act.
summary: Requires employers to give employees written notice of workplace rights, including law enforcement rights, and to notify designated emergency contacts of arrests at worksites.

title: California Preventing Algorithmic Collusion Act of 2025.
topics: AI and technology; Consumer protection and business
summary: Prohibits using or recommending pricing algorithms that process competitor data, with civil penalties up to $25,000 per violation.

title: Property taxation: exemption: disabled veteran homeowners.
summary: Exempts half of up to $1 million in home value from property tax for 100% disabled veterans and some surviving spouses, starting 2027.

title: Valley Fever Screening and Prevention Act of 2025.
summary: Requires screening and outreach for valley fever in high-incidence regions, and requires primary care providers to screen adult patients starting 2028.

title: State Energy Resources Conservation and Development Commission: seaports: plan: alternative fuels.
summary: Requires the Energy Commission to develop a 2030 plan for alternative fuels for oceangoing vessels at California seaports.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: exemption: day care center: zoning.
topics: Children and families; Environment and energy
summary: Exempts day care centers located in residential areas from California Environmental Quality Act review requirements.

title: Budget Act of 2024.
summary: Amends the 2024-25 Budget Act by amending and adding appropriations, and takes effect immediately as a budget bill.

title: Diesel-powered on-track equipment: decommissioning: resale and transfer restrictions.
summary: Bars public entities from selling or transferring decommissioned diesel on-track equipment for continued use, with exemptions for lower-emission or engine-removed equipment.

title: Companion chatbots.
topics: AI and technology; Children and families; Government and administration
summary: Tightens companion chatbot rules for minors and suicide protocols; adds a conflict-of-interest exception for nonprofit dues.

title: County Employees Retirement Law of 1937: employees.
summary: Requires counties and districts in CERL retirement systems to enroll all employees, excluding only defined excludable employees, and declares this a statewide concern binding charter jurisdictions.

title: Personal Income Tax Law and Corporation Tax Law: exclusions: environmental credits.
topics: Environment and energy; Taxes and budget
summary: Excludes federal environmental credit refunds and transfer payments from state gross income for 2026–2030, and bars transferees from deducting transfer costs.

title: Employment: bias mitigation training: unlawful discrimination.
summary: Provides that an employee's good-faith admission of personal bias made in required or solicited bias mitigation training is not unlawful discrimination.

title: Public lands: City of Oakland: Port of Oakland: uses of after-acquired lands.
topics: Environment and energy; Labor and employment
summary: Temporarily lifts public trust use restrictions on Jack London Square after-acquired lands until 2066, letting the Port of Oakland lease them for any purpose.

title: Seymour-Campbell Student Success Act of 2012: Free Application for Federal Student Aid and California Dream Act application.
summary: Requires community colleges to inform students about the FAFSA and California Dream Act applications, and to confirm completion or opt-out starting 2027-28.

title: Health care coverage: prior authorizations.
summary: Requires insurers and health plans to report prior authorization approval statistics and stop requiring prior authorization for frequently approved services by 2028.

title: Public postsecondary education: immigration enforcement.
summary: Requires CSU to adopt added campus protections, including a systemwide policy on grades, withdrawal and reenrollment for undocumented students disrupted by immigration enforcement.

title: Community colleges: audits: reports.
summary: Shifts community college fiscal oversight reporting to the Chancellor's office and adds reporting to the Joint Legislative Audit Committee and other legislative and executive bodies.

title: In-Home Supportive Services program: provider wages.
summary: Makes a technical, nonsubstantive change to the county funding rule for locally negotiated IHSS provider wage increases.

title: Water quality: recycled water.
summary: Expands recycled water uses and exempts certain decorative pond discharges and common-area irrigation from existing unauthorized-discharge and dual-plumbing rules.

title: Failure to pay wages: penalties.
summary: Lets employees recover the $200 penalty for repeat or willful wage nonpayment through an independent civil action.

title: Correctional facilities: women’s prisons.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice
summary: Requires a secure housing facility for transgender women at each women's prison and bars certain sex offenders from women's prisons.

title: Dog importation: health certificates.
