summary: Requires sellers and importers of dogs for resale to obtain and submit veterinarian health certificates to the state agriculture department and buyers.

title: Vital records: birth certificates.
summary: Moves parental birthplace on birth certificates into the confidential medical and social portion, effective July 2027, and adds legislative findings on limiting public access to records.

title: Weights and measures: electric vehicle supply equipment.
summary: Eases retesting rules for electric vehicle chargers after maintenance and lets manufacturer-audited chargers be used after sealing, with new state guidance due by 2027.

title: Quimby Act.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration; Housing
summary: Caps Quimby park dedication and fees for infill housing at 25% of acreage, bars them near existing parks, and requires fee accounting.

title: High school pupils: voter registration.
summary: Requires schools to inform grade 11 pupils how to preregister and register to vote, and where to get paper voter registration cards.

title: Wastewater surveillance.
summary: Requires the state health department to maintain the Cal-SuWers wastewater surveillance network, with voluntary local participation, and allows external funding and public data reporting.

title: Air pollution: stationary sources: best available control technology.
summary: Authorizes state air board indirect-source rules and emissions fees, reporting, and sets statewide best available control technology requirements for stationary sources.

title: Criminal justice statistics: reporting.
summary: Requires state and county reporting of monthly drug and theft conviction statistics and local criminal justice spending, with public posting starting in 2027.

title: Health care coverage: timely access to care.
summary: Requires state health departments to adopt geographic accessibility standards for perinatal units, enforceable against health plans, through 2034.

title: Firearms: California Do Not Sell List.
summary: Creates a voluntary California Do Not Sell List letting residents bar themselves from purchasing firearms, administered by DOJ by 2027.

title: Late signature curing expenditure reports.
summary: Requires committees to report within 24 hours any spending on late signature curing of mail ballots after election day.

title: Urban equestrian inclusion zones.
summary: Authorizes local voluntary urban equestrian inclusion zones with land-use contracts, and counts those contracts as reducing land-use intensity under the Housing Crisis Act.

title: Student Aid Commission: California Dream Act application.
summary: Requires the Student Aid Commission to amend the California Dream Act application so any state-aid-eligible student can use it, regardless of federal eligibility.

title: Medi-Cal: enhanced care management and community supports.
summary: Requires Medi-Cal managed care plans to contract with capable community providers for ECM and community supports, and to honor member provider preferences.

title: Cellular telephones: communications interceptions.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive, technical wording changes to the penalty provision for manufacturing or possessing eavesdropping devices.

title: Wildfire safety: fire protection building standards: defensible space requirements: The California Wildfire Mitigation Strategic Planning Act.
summary: Requires state fire officials to produce wildfire risk frameworks, forecasts, and scenario reports, and creates a contingent local grant program for wildfire risk reduction.

title: Public utilities: review of accounts: electrical and gas corporations: rates: political influence activities.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Bars utilities from recovering costs of opposing municipalization and expands the Public Advocate's authority to obtain information and review utility accounts.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: exempt surplus land.
summary: Expands the surplus land exemption to cover multi-parcel disposals to any persons or entities and exempts Concord Naval Weapons Station land tied to affordable housing.

title: Alcohol and drug recovery: licensed treatment facilities and certified programs: investigations.
summary: Requires the state to assign and investigate complaints about licensed addiction treatment facilities and certified programs on set timelines, post annual reports, and raise licensing fees.

title: Public contracts: claim resolution.
summary: Repeals the January 2027 sunset, making the public works contract claim resolution process permanent and applicable to charter cities.

title: Budgets: multiyear financial commitments.
summary: Limits school district and county budget multiyear commitments and fiscal certifications to the current and next fiscal year, and updates reporting requirements.

title: Health care coverage: hearing aids.
summary: Requires large group health plans and insurers to cover medically necessary hearing aids and related services for enrollees under 21, starting in 2028.

title: Investor-Owned Utilities Accountability Act.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Environment and energy
summary: Requires utilities to report nonpayment terminations, submit executive pay structures to the PUC, and commissions a $5M study on public ownership.

title: Transactions and use taxes: San Luis Obispo Council of Governments.
summary: Authorizes San Luis Obispo Council of Governments to levy a voter-approved transactions and use tax up to 1%, exceeding the 2% county cap.

title: Pupil instruction: sexual harassment, sexual assault, and sexual abuse prevention: safety.
summary: Creates Sexual Harassment Safety Week, requires schools to emphasize prevention, adds survey questions, and directs curriculum framework consideration of sexual harassment reporting procedures.

title: Elections: voting by mail.
summary: Repeals automatic mailing of ballots to all voters, letting voters request mail ballots and creating a permanent vote-by-mail option.

title: Real property tax: welfare exemption: moderate-income housing.
summary: Expands the partial welfare property tax exemption to rental housing serving low- and moderate-income households, with no state reimbursement to local agencies.

title: Prisons.
summary: Requires CDCR to set body camera activation and deactivation rules, nonroutine search protocols with supervisor approval, a sexual violence policy, and a scanner pilot.

title: Virtual Health Hub for Rural Communities Pilot Program.
summary: Creates a conditional pilot program with grants to community groups to set up virtual health hubs serving rural farmworkers, funded by a new fund.

title: Medi-Cal: laboratory rates.
summary: Caps Medi-Cal lab reimbursement at the lowest-of metrics, carves out STI testing, deletes the 10% lab payment reduction, and publishes deidentified lab data.

title: Air pollution: South Coast Air Quality Management District: mobile sources: Ports of Long Beach and Los Angeles.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Conditions South Coast air district emissions rules affecting Long Beach and Los Angeles ports, requiring assessments and barring cargo or cruise passenger caps, until 2031.

title: General plans: housing element: emergency shelter.
summary: Requires emergency shelters to provide all services onsite and redefines them as offering supportive services rather than minimal services.

title: Instructional School Gardens Program: reestablishment: Department of Food and Agriculture.
summary: Reestablishes the school garden grant program under the Department of Food and Agriculture, creates a dedicated fund, and requires a competitive grant process contingent on funding.

title: Contractors: unlicensed work.
summary: Lets contractors collect payment on certain public and commercial projects if they were licensed at signing and during the disputed work.

title: Career technical education: high school graduation requirements: apprenticeship and preapprenticeship programs.
summary: Allows apprenticeship coursework to satisfy a high school graduation elective and waives minimum credential requirements for certified CTE teachers in designated trades.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: City of San Diego: mixed-use development project.
summary: Deems an existing San Diego environmental impact report sufficient for CEQA for the Midway Rising project, requiring its mitigation measures as approval conditions.

title: California Fire Service Training and Education Program: California Fire and Arson Training Act: fees.
summary: Limits the State Fire Marshal's fire training fee authority to cases where state appropriations and other funding are insufficient.

title: Local agencies: transient occupancy taxes: short-term rental facilitator.
summary: Authorizes local ordinances requiring short-term rental platforms to report addresses, display local license numbers, and face fines or audits.

title: Annual tax: partnerships and LLCs.
summary: Reduces the annual tax on limited partnerships, LLPs, and LLCs from $800 to $600 for tax years 2026 through 2030.

title: State Air Resources Board: Low Carbon Fuel Standard.
summary: Requires CARB to analyze driver financial impacts of rules and revise the Low Carbon Fuel Standard to reduce drivers' costs.

title: Emergency vehicles: blue warning lights.
summary: Authorizes parole officers to display blue warning lights on emergency vehicles after completing a certified 4-hour emergency vehicle operation course.

title: Alcohol and drug programs.
summary: Tightens enforcement against unlicensed alcohol and drug recovery facilities with investigation deadlines, follow-up visits, and a new annual reporting requirement for licensed and certified programs.

title: Water Rate Assistance Program.
summary: Creates a state Water Rate Assistance Program and fund to help low-income residents pay water and wastewater bills, contingent on appropriation.

title: Health facilities.
summary: Bans private equity and hedge funds from controlling physician or dental practices' clinical and billing decisions, and voids noncompete and nondisparagement clauses in their contracts.

title: Environmental justice: Department of Justice: Bureau of Environmental Justice: community air monitoring.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Requires state-selected community air monitors to stay active at least five years, updates the monitoring plan every five years, adds annual reporting, and continues the DOJ environmental justice bureau.

title: Income tax: credits: food banks.
summary: Extends the California tax credit for food donated to food banks through 2031 and extends the related FTB reporting requirement to 2035.

title: Insurance Information and Privacy Protection Act.
topics: AI and technology; Consumer protection and business
summary: Creates new privacy standards for insurers and their service providers on personal information sharing, notices, consent, and consumer access and deletion rights, starting 2028.

title: Judgment debtor employers: Employment Development Department.
summary: Requires employers with unpaid wage judgments to document satisfaction or a payment plan within 60 days, with civil penalties and possible tax-fraud referral for noncompliance.

title: Elderly Parole Program.
summary: Raises age and time-served requirements for elderly parole eligibility for inmates convicted of certain sexual offenses.

title: Juveniles: delinquency.
topics: Children and families; Civil rights and liberties
summary: Allows large counties to delegate juvenile probation duties to a youth development official and lets that official inspect juvenile case files.

title: Mitigation Fee Act: mitigating vehicular traffic impacts.
summary: Revises traffic impact fee rules for housing developments, easing criteria for lower trip-based fees and requiring stronger evidence for local findings.

title: Use Fuel Tax Law: Diesel Fuel Tax Law: exempt bus operation.
summary: Exempts county-owned transit systems from state diesel and use fuel taxes and updates references to the Department of Tax and Fee Administration.

title: Price gouging: state of emergency.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration; Housing
summary: Expands price gouging prohibitions during emergencies, adds civil penalties, requires housing platforms to remove violating listings, and lets the Legislature end gubernatorial extensions.

title: Land conservation: California Wildlife, Coastal, and Park Land Conservation Act: County of San Bernardino.
summary: Allows San Bernardino County to use conservation lands and sale revenue for parks, recreation, and historic preservation, and streamlines the land plan process.

title: Data brokers: data collection and deletion.
summary: Requires data brokers to report expanded personal data collection and certain sharing to the privacy agency, and to process deletion requests.

title: Commercial financing: disclosures.
summary: Requires commercial financing providers to avoid deceptive use of 'interest' or 'rate' and use APR disclosures, enforced under state financing or consumer protection law.

title: Health care coverage: independent medical review.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Requires health plans and insurers to report claim denial data and penalizes those with excessive independent medical review overturns.

title: Outdoor advertising displays: permits: new alignments.
summary: Bars the Transportation Department from delaying outdoor advertising permit applications on new highway alignments already open to traffic nearby.

title: Fire insurance: reporting on cancellation and nonrenewal.
summary: Requires the Department of Insurance to report annually to the Legislature on the effects of the one-year post-wildfire nonrenewal ban.

title: Employment: artificial intelligence.
summary: Requires the Department of General Services to contract with UCLA's Labor Center for a study of AI's impact on workers and state revenues, reported to the Legislature by June 2027.

title: Mental health.
summary: Expands involuntary mental health assessment and LPS conservatorship recommendations, while adding optional voluntary aftercare planning for individuals under the LPS Act.

title: Price gouging.
summary: Requires the Department of Justice and local prosecutors to form partnerships to enforce existing emergency price gouging limits.

title: Salton Sea: restoration projects: skilled and trained workforce.
summary: Requires state contracts over $1 million for Salton Sea restoration to mandate a skilled and trained workforce for apprenticeable construction work.

title: Attorneys: unlawful solicitations and advertisements.
summary: Allows any person to sue attorneys for unlawful solicitation, adds statutory damages, and makes attorneys liable for joint advertising content.

title: California Music Festival Preservation Grant Program.
summary: Creates a music festival grant program within the Office of Small Business Advocate, allocating $20 million to eligible independent live music promoters, subject to appropriation.

title: Transportation network companies: insurance coverage.
summary: Lowers required rideshare uninsured and underinsured motorist coverage from $1 million to $60,000/$300,000, shifts the duty to companies, and requires a study.

title: California Private Postsecondary Education Act of 2009: exemptions.
summary: Exempts one merged 1877 nonprofit institution from the private postsecondary act and lets it contract with the bureau for complaint review.

title: Special education: nonpublic, nonsectarian schools or agencies.
summary: Adds oversight for out-of-state nonpublic special education schools, including restraint and seclusion policy review, pupil interviews, and behavioral-intervention compliance assurances.

title: Local educational agencies: annual reporting requirements: IDEA Addendum.
summary: Extends the school reporting requirements' repeal date to 2027 and eliminates the IDEA Addendum special education improvement requirements for districts.

title: Wildfire prevention activities: Endangered Species Act: California Environmental Quality Act: California Coastal Act of 1973.
summary: Authorizes local agencies to submit wildfire preparedness plans; state wildlife agency must advise on endangered species permits within 90 days.

title: Incomplete gift nongrantor trusts: Personal Income Tax Law.
summary: Excludes charitable remainder trusts from the definition of incomplete gift nongrantor trusts, so their income is not included in the grantor's income.

title: Biomethane procurement targets.
summary: Revises biomethane procurement rules for common carrier pipelines, adds emissions displacement as a qualifying benefit, and requires cost recovery in rates for biomethane interconnection infrastructure.

title: Online marketplaces: illicit cannabis: reporting and liability.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice
summary: Requires online cannabis marketplaces to disclose unlicensed sellers, warn consumers, and provide a reporting mechanism for unlicensed listings.

title: Sexually violent predators.
summary: Requires the State Department of State Hospitals to weigh public safety and approve placements before leasing housing for conditionally released sexually violent predators.

title: Second Chance Program.
summary: Expands Second Chance grant eligibility to mental health, behavioral health and drug court programs, expanding a continuously appropriated fund's purpose.

title: Sexually violent predators: transitional housing facilities: report.
summary: Requires the State Department of State Hospitals to study and report on transitional housing facilities for sexually violent predators on conditional release.

title: Vital records: adoptees’ birth certificates.
summary: Lets adoptees and descendants obtain original birth certificates from 2028, adds birth parent contact preferences, and ends adoptive parents' options to omit birth details.

title: Vehicle repossessions.
summary: Bars repossession agencies from fee collusion and hold-harmless deals for personal effects, and bars tow yards from demanding extra documents to release vehicles.

title: Driver’s licenses and identification cards.
summary: Accelerates the deadline for DMV to issue identification cards to undocumented eligible applicants from July 1, 2027 to January 15, 2026.

title: Preventing Algorithmic Price Fixing Act: prohibition on certain price-setting algorithm uses.
topics: AI and technology; Consumer protection and business; Housing
summary: Prohibits selling or using pricing algorithms that process nonpublic data to set prices, supply, or rents among competitors, with civil penalties.

title: Peace officers.
summary: Repeals the requirement that the Peace Officer Standards and Training commission adopt education criteria for peace officers based on a community college report.

title: Dental providers: fee-based payments.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Requires health plans and insurers to default dental providers to non-fee-based payment, with fee-based payment only by affirmative provider opt-in.

title: Physicians and surgeons: special faculty permits: academic medical centers.
summary: Lowers resident training threshold for NCI cancer centers seeking academic medical center status, and allows five special faculty permits per center yearly.

title: California Latino Commission.
summary: Creates a nine-member California Latino Commission to collect data, make recommendations, and monitor programs affecting Latinos, sunsetting in 2036.

title: Pupil health: individuals with exceptional needs: respiratory services: licensed vocational nurses.
summary: Allows licensed vocational nurses, under credentialed school nurse supervision, to perform suctioning and basic respiratory tasks for students with exceptional needs.

title: Cosmetic safety: vaginal suppositories.
summary: Extends California's ban on boric acid in vaginal suppositories to 2035 and requires pregnancy warning labels starting 2027.

title: Community facilities district: inclusion or annexation of territory: County of San Mateo.
topics: Environment and energy; Taxes and budget
summary: Allows open-space or agricultural land within San Mateo's regional shoreline to join a Mello-Roos community facilities district without landowner consent, if conditions are met.

title: Community colleges: Chancellor of the California Community Colleges: data request fee policy.
summary: Authorizes the Community Colleges chancellor to set a data request fee policy for researchers, subject to board approval, public posting, and privacy-law compliance, while barring fees for state entities, students, and faculty.

title: Regional park districts: East Bay Regional Park District: East Bay Hills Conservation Program.
summary: Authorizes the East Bay Regional Park District to create a conservation program for the East Bay Hills and requires local land use documents to acknowledge the area's statewide significance.

title: Pupil health: school nutrition.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive wording change to a legislative declaration about school meal nutrition quality.

title: Water theft: fire hydrants.
summary: Expands water theft rules to cover fire hydrant tampering and lets local water agencies fine unauthorized hydrant connections.

title: Alcoholic beverages: additional licenses: hospitality zone.
summary: Authorizes up to 20 additional on-sale alcohol licenses for eating places in a San Francisco hospitality zone, sunsetting July 1, 2033.

title: Corrections: supervision.
summary: Bars supervision authorities from imposing family-contact bans, except for victims when necessary for public safety, and tightens a 30-day competency diversion hearing deadline to 29 days.

title: Horse racing: thoroughbred racing.
summary: Expands horse racing options by letting thoroughbreds run in quarter horse races at any distance and raising the thoroughbred claiming price cap to $6,000.

title: Election crimes: payment based on voting or voter registration.
summary: Makes it a crime to pay or offer money to induce voting or voter registration, or to pay based on voting or registration status.

title: School districts: interdistrict transfers.
summary: Requires school districts to record interdistrict transfer requests and their outcomes, and report them annually to the state for public posting.

title: Budget Act of 2024.
summary: Amends the Budget Act of 2024 by adding appropriations and making other changes, effective immediately as a Budget Bill.

title: Health care coverage: insulin.
summary: Caps insulin copays at $35 per 30-day supply, bans step therapy for insulin, and requires formulary coverage of insulin for large group plans.

title: Labor: elective compensation under the Inflation Reduction Act of 2022.
summary: Allows employers of workers on certain clean energy facilities to make elective retroactive wage payments under the Inflation Reduction Act through 2029.

title: Political Reform Act of 1974: filing deadlines: emergency situations.
summary: Lets the FPPC extend campaign filing deadlines up to 60 days for people in emergency areas, except within 90 days before an election.

title: Health care coverage: autism.
summary: Moves definitions for autism behavioral health treatment providers from the Health and Safety and Insurance Codes to the Business and Professions Code, with conforming changes.

title: End of Life Option Act: sunset.
summary: Repeals the January 1, 2031 sunset, extending California's End of Life Option Act indefinitely and imposing a state-mandated local program.

title: Hazardous materials: metal shredding facilities.
summary: Creates a DTSC permit program for metal shredding facilities, with inspections, closure requirements, and criminal penalties for false certified reports.

title: Elections: voter identification.
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Repeals the state ban on local governments requiring voters to show identification at polling places or when submitting ballots.

title: Elections: ballot submission deadline.
summary: Requires vote-by-mail ballots to arrive by the close of polls on election day, ending the 7-day grace period except for military and overseas voters.

title: Elections: official canvass.
summary: Shortens California's election canvass and certification deadlines, requiring counties to count ballots and certify results within 10 days.

title: Voter registration: residency confirmation.
summary: Requires state or county officials to obtain postal change-of-address data to confirm voter residency, with state reimbursement for mandated local costs.

title: Public contracts: county-owned buildings.
summary: Raises the contract-exemption threshold for county building repairs in counties of 9 million or more, effectively covering Los Angeles County.

title: Pharmacy benefits.
summary: Regulates pharmacy benefit managers: bans affiliated-pharmacy steering, limits income to fees, requires passthrough pricing and licensing, and caps enrollee cost sharing.

title: Common interest developments: association records: exterior elevated elements inspection.
summary: Requires condo associations' exterior elevated element inspection reports to include unit counts and sampling certification, disclosed to buyers and kept in records.

title: Stop Child Hunger Act of 2025.
summary: Creates a statewide Summer EBT application website for families, contingent on appropriation, and requires schools to link to it.

title: Home care aides.
summary: Requires home care organizations to ensure aides complete dementia-specific training before providing care and annually thereafter, starting January 1, 2027.

title: Juveniles: case file inspection.
summary: Expands which attorneys may access confidential juvenile case files, including in civil suits against child welfare agencies and probation departments.

title: School accountability: Office of the Education Inspector General: school financial and performance audits: charter school authorization, oversight, funding, operations, and networks: flex-based instruction: local educational agency contracting.
summary: Requires school audits to meet filing deadlines, applies audit rules to charter schools, and requires local educational agencies to post audits online.

title: Planning and zoning: logistics use developments: truck routes.
summary: Revises warehouse standards and defines logistics use developments, and requires truck routing plans and local ordinances setting truck routes that avoid residential areas.

title: Student financial aid: Cal Grants: qualifying institutions: financial aid offer letter template.
summary: Creates a workgroup to develop a standard financial aid offer letter template, which institutions must use to qualify for Cal Grant participation by 2028-29.

title: The Veterans and Affordable Housing Bond Act of 2026.
summary: Places an $11.25 billion housing and veterans bond on the November 2026 ballot, funding affordable rental housing, homeownership, and veterans' home loans.

title: Health care coverage: prescription hormone therapy and nondiscrimination.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Health care
summary: Requires health plans and insurers to cover up to a 12-month supply of hormone therapy, adds it to Medi-Cal, and bars sex and other discrimination by plans.

title: Hydrogen fuel.
summary: Exempts hydrogen fuel from state sales and use taxes starting July 1, 2026, while keeping local and Local Revenue Fund 2011 rates in place.

title: Political Reform Act of 1974: public campaign financing: California Fair Elections Act of 2026.
summary: Lifts the ban on using public funds for campaigns, adds expenditure limits and qualification rules, and bars public money for legal fees or loan repayment.

title: Property tax: welfare exemption: detention facilities.
summary: Excludes property operated as a detention facility from the welfare property tax exemption, declaring this a clarification of existing law.

title: Criminal procedure: protective orders.
summary: Allows courts to issue permanent protective orders against defendants convicted of serious, violent, or sex-offense felonies, and extend certain existing orders.

title: California Workforce Development Board: developmental services.
summary: Requires the Workforce Development Board to report by 2027 on strategies to address developmental services workforce shortages.

title: California Public Records Act: private detention facilities.
summary: Makes recordings and communications about private detention facility incidents public records, disclosable to any member of the public on request.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: expired regional habitat conservation plan: exemption.
summary: Exempts urgent public health or housing projects within expired habitat conservation plan areas from CEQA review.

title: Bonds: public entities as beneficiaries.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Requires public-entity bond beneficiaries to agree to payment and performance obligations, and extends auto cancellation notice from 20 to 30 days.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: defensible space.
summary: Exempts public agency projects that maintain defensible space around structures from California Environmental Quality Act review.

title: Habitat Conservation Fund.
summary: Extends the annual $30 million General Fund transfer to the Habitat Conservation Fund and its continuous appropriations through 2035.

title: State Auditor: permanent office.
summary: Allows the State Auditor's permanent office to be located within two miles of the State Capitol, including West Sacramento, and expands State Audit Fund uses.

title: Wildfire Safety and Risk Mitigation Program.
summary: Creates a wildfire safety program, account, and state insurance department framework for a public wildfire catastrophe model, subject to appropriation.

title: Substance use disorder: addiction treatment referral agencies.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Requires addiction treatment referral agencies to obtain a state certificate of compliance, bars their financial interests in providers, and requires money-transfer reporting.

title: Local agencies: automated decision systems.
summary: Restricts local agencies' use of automated decision systems for benefits, permits, and licenses, requiring accuracy checks, nondiscrimination, and audits, with optional state guidance.

title: Assault and battery: utility workers.
summary: Makes assault or battery against utility workers performing their duties punishable by up to one year in county jail, a fine up to $2,000, or both.

title: Serious felonies: furnishing fentanyl to a minor.
summary: Adds knowingly furnishing fentanyl to a minor to the list of serious felonies, triggering longer enhancements and plea-bargaining limits.

title: Residential care facilities for the elderly: assisted living waiver rental rate protection.
summary: Caps room and board charges at certain Medi-Cal-contracted elderly care facilities, excludes the retained amount from Medi-Cal income, and allows a rent-control waiver for an assisted living test.

title: Residential care facilities for the elderly: housing protections.
summary: Extends eviction notice periods for elder care facility residents, requires safe discharge plans, and bars removal before the eviction process concludes.

title: California Consumer Privacy Act of 2018: personal information: exemptions.
summary: Removes CCPA exemptions for publicly available personal and sensitive personal information, expanding privacy protections.

title: Unlawful detainer: notice to terminate tenancy.
summary: Extends the notice period before a landlord can terminate a tenancy for unpaid rent from 3 to 14 days, excluding weekends and judicial holidays.

title: California State University: claim eligibility: genealogy and descendancy.
summary: Authorizes up to $6 million for CSU reparations-related research and requires CSU to develop a genealogical process for confirming descendancy of enslaved persons.

title: School attendance: College and Career Access Pathways partnerships.
summary: Lets high school pupils in College and Career Access Pathways partnerships who also attend community college count 180 minutes as a full schoolday, not 240.

title: California Health Benefit Review Program: extension.
summary: Extends the California Health Benefit Review Program and its funding fund to 2033, and raises the insurer assessment cap to $3.2 million.

title: Brain-computer interfaces: neural data.
summary: Requires businesses offering brain-computer interfaces to use neural data only for its collected purpose and delete it once that purpose is met.

title: Private Works Change Order Fair Payment Act.
summary: Creates a temporary claim resolution process for private construction contract claims by contractors and subcontractors on contracts from 2026.

title: State Air Resources Board: membership: removal: regulations: review.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Lets the Legislature remove Air Resources Board members and adds economic analysis and publication requirements before board regulation votes.

title: Grocery retail store and retail drug establishment employees: self-service checkout.
summary: Requires grocery and retail drug stores offering self-checkout to keep a staffed manual lane, include self-checkout in worker safety plans, and give 60 days' notice.

title: Retirement: joint powers authorities.
summary: Authorizes the Pajaro Regional Flood Management Agency and other joint powers authorities to offer certain legacy defined benefit pension formulas to specified employees.

title: State Healthy Food Access Policy.
summary: Revises the state food access policy to include locally grown and raised food and requires agencies to report on implementing it by 2027.

title: High-speed rail: third-party agreements, permits, and approvals: regulations.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration; Transportation
summary: Requires the High-Speed Rail Authority to adopt internal rules and local permit regulations for utility relocation and agreements, delayed until the office certifies the process.

title: Data breaches: customer notification.
summary: Requires businesses to notify California residents of data breaches within 30 days and to report sample notices to the Attorney General within 15 days.

title: Workers’ compensation: death benefits.
summary: Extends employer-paid health benefit continuation for minor dependents of fallen firefighters and peace officers from age 21 to 26.

title: Trespassing: removal of trespassers on residential property.
summary: Creates a procedure for police to remove squatters from residential property, with penalties for fraudulent removal requests and a civil cause of action, while excluding tenants.

title: Health care service plan requirements.
summary: Makes technical, nonsubstantive changes to existing health care service plan requirements under the Knox-Keene Act.

title: Recycling: beverage containers: tethered plastic caps.
summary: Requires beverage manufacturers to use tethered caps on plastic beverage containers from 2027, with several exemptions, and removes a recycler incentive payment.

title: Adoption.
summary: Expands California court jurisdiction over certain adoptions, requires adoption orders to name parents, and places documentation duties on out-of-state home study petitioners.

title: Gambling.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Allows major league sports raffles at championship games and clarifies Justice Department investigation authority over illegal gambling outside licensed establishments.

title: Child welfare services: prevention legal services.
summary: Creates a subject-to-appropriation three-year pilot funding legal and team-based services to keep at-risk families out of juvenile dependency.

title: Microgrid incentive program.
summary: Requires utilities to report on Microgrid Incentive Program funds, directs unallocated funds toward outage-prone areas, and returns leftover funds to ratepayers after 2027.

title: State Water Resources Control Board: PFAS Mitigation Program.
summary: Creates a contingent PFAS Mitigation Fund and grant program to help water and sewer providers treat PFAS contamination in drinking water.

title: Electric bicycles.
summary: Creates low-power moped rules, adds e-bike labeling and prohibitions, exempts mopeds from registration, and requires helmets and licensing.

title: Contractors: exemptions: muralists.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Labor and employment
summary: Exempts artists who create, restore, or conserve murals under agreement from the Contractors State License Law's licensing requirements.

title: Housing element compliance: committed assistance: in-kind services: realistic capacity formula.
summary: Requires HCD to create realistic-capacity formulas for housing element inventories and makes sites' allowed unit counts explicit, with the formulas exempt from judicial review.

title: Initiative and referendum measures: title and summary.
summary: Shifts preparation of initiative and ballot titles and summaries from the Attorney General to the Legislative Analyst, contingent on voter approval of SCA 3.

title: Peace officers: confidential communications: exceptions: group peer support services.
summary: Expands confidentiality protections for law enforcement group peer support communications, and allows disclosure of such communications in juvenile delinquency proceedings.

title: Presidential elections: qualifications for office.
summary: Bars Secretary of State from placing presidential or vice presidential candidates on the ballot unless they swear to qualifications and are determined eligible.

title: Joint Sunset Review Committee.
summary: Requires the legislative sunset committee to conduct comprehensive reviews of scheduled-for-repeal state agencies and publish recommendations on their continuation.

title: State real property: City of Imperial.
summary: Authorizes the state to sell, exchange, or lease the former CHP El Centro office to the City of Imperial, exempt from CEQA.

title: California Farmland Conservancy Program: conservation easements: funding.
summary: Requires an annual $20 million General Fund transfer to a new account funding agricultural conservation easements under the Farmland Conservancy Program.

title: Drought planning: resiliency measures.
summary: Exempts small water suppliers and certain school water systems from drought metering and leak-monitoring requirements if they lack feasible state or local funding.

title: Employer pay data.
summary: Expands employer pay data reporting by adding job categories in 2027 and requiring court-imposed penalties for non-filing when the department requests them.

title: Governor’s Office of Emergency Services: California Alert.
summary: Requires the Office of Emergency Services to establish California Alert, a statewide emergency alert system using wireless alerts and a private vendor.

title: Drinking water: primary standard for hexavalent chromium: exemption.
summary: Exempts water systems meeting the total chromium standard from hexavalent chromium violations while implementing or awaiting state approval of a compliance plan.

title: Highways: Highway Signage Fund.
summary: Creates a Highway Signage Fund, available upon appropriation, for signs on previously approved highway designations honoring individuals who promoted racial and gender equity.

title: High-risk artificial intelligence systems: duty to protect personal information.
summary: Requires businesses deploying high-risk AI that processes personal information to maintain a comprehensive information security program, with violations treated as deceptive practices.

title: Department of Industrial Relations: task force: public infrastructure: employment: underrepresented communities.
summary: Creates a task force under the Department of Industrial Relations to promote public infrastructure employment for underrepresented communities and assist contractors with nondiscrimination compliance.

title: February 2025 bar exam: audit.
summary: Requires the State Auditor to audit the February 2025 bar exam and report to the State Bar board, Chief Justice, and Judiciary committees, funded by the State Bar.

title: Bagley-Keene Open Meeting Act: teleconferencing.
summary: Extends Bagley-Keene teleconferencing provisions for state bodies from 2026 to 2030 and adds legislative findings for access limits.

title: Office of the Developmental Services Ombudsperson.
summary: Replaces the Self-Determination Program Ombudsperson office with a Developmental Services Ombudsperson office that monitors regional center services and handles complaints.

title: Pupil instruction: Holocaust and genocide education: notice, survey, and grant program.
summary: Creates a state Holocaust and genocide education grant program with a dedicated fund, requires a notice to grades 7-12 schools, and authorizes a status survey.

title: Water corporations: demand elasticity: rates and surcharges.
summary: Requires the PUC to prevent material over- or undercollection of water utility revenue from demand-elasticity errors, and bars water rate changes or surcharges that exceed approved revenues.

title: State Air Resources Board: regulatory authority: revocation.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Revokes the Air Resources Board's authority to adopt, revise or repeal regulations, limiting it to advising the Legislature; existing regulations stay.

title: Small Business Advocate.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to the statutory duties and functions of the Small Business Advocate.

title: Short-term residential therapeutic programs.
summary: Makes technical, nonsubstantive changes to licensing and operating provisions for short-term residential therapeutic programs for children.

title: California Fair Employment and Housing Act: enforcement procedures.
summary: Revises FEHA enforcement procedures, adding tolling rules and right-to-sue timing for group, class and director-initiated complaints.

title: School accountability: Statewide School Library Lead.
summary: Creates a contingent Statewide School Library Lead, selected through a county office of education, to build school library and literacy services statewide.

title: Homeless adult and family multidisciplinary personnel teams.
summary: Lets cities that are local health jurisdictions create homeless adult and family multidisciplinary personnel teams, like counties already can, to link people to housing and services.

title: Educational equity: discrimination prevention coordinators.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Requires the Office of Civil Rights to employ four discrimination prevention coordinators, Governor-appointed and Senate-confirmed, contingent on AB 715.

title: Autonomous vehicles.
summary: Authorizes autonomous vehicles to be equipped with ADS marker lamps that show when automated driving is engaged, under specified standards, starting 2026.

title: In-home supportive services.
summary: Makes technical, nonsubstantive changes to the In-Home Supportive Services program provisions.

title: Roster of public officials: local government.
summary: Requires local governments to submit updated lists of their officials to the Secretary of State after each general election for a state roster.

title: Mental health diversion.
summary: Adds requirements for mental health diversion eligibility and lets courts deny diversion when a defendant poses a physical safety risk to others.

title: Coastal resources: coastal development permits: infill area categorical exclusion.
summary: Exempts deed-restricted affordable housing projects in identified coastal infill areas from coastal development permits until 2037.

title: County public defender: appointment.
summary: Bars county boards from removing an appointed public defender except by a 4/5-type vote for cause, replacing at-will removal.

title: Regional housing: public postsecondary education: changes in enrollment levels: California Environmental Quality Act.
summary: Requires regional housing-need planning and allocation to consider university enrollment changes and student distribution, affecting how housing needs are calculated.

title: Workers’ compensation.
summary: Limits employers' workers' compensation reimbursement and lien rights against third-party recoveries for injured peace officers and firefighters employed by local entities.

title: Safety element: local hazard mitigation plan.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to the provision letting cities and counties adopt a local hazard mitigation plan within their safety element.

title: Local agency formation commissions: written policies and procedures: Permit Streamlining Act: housing development projects.
summary: Requires LAFCOs to publish application forms and policies online, and housing permit agencies to publish completeness criteria and required application lists.

title: Tribal gaming: compact and amendment ratification.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Environment and energy
summary: Ratifies extensions of an existing tribal gaming compact and a new compact with Big Sandy Rancheria, and exempts related actions from CEQA.

title: Alcohol and drug programs.
summary: Sets deadlines and site-visit requirements for investigating unlicensed alcohol and drug recovery facilities and recovery residences.

title: State Energy Resources Conservation and Development Commission: chair: report to the Legislature.
summary: Requires the State Energy Commission chair to appear annually before legislative policy committees to report on the commission's activities.

title: Wildfire.
summary: Lets the Insurance Department share confidential insurer wildfire data with researchers and agencies, with anonymization rules, and revises state wildfire reporting.

title: Unlawful business practices: price gouging.
summary: Extends California's price gouging ban to emergencies caused by war, when the Attorney General finds war-driven price increases for essential goods.

title: Charter schools: establishment prohibition and renewal procedures.
summary: Extends the ban on approving new nonclassroom-based charter schools through 2027 and delays new charter renewal standards by one year.

title: Insurance.
summary: Requires large admitted insurers to submit annual reinsurance and catastrophe model reports, with civil penalties for noncompliance.

title: Advanced Clean Fleets Regulation: appeals advisory committee: exemptions.
summary: Creates an appeals committee for denied Advanced Clean Fleets exemptions, exempts emergency-response vehicles, and eases documentation for postponing zero-emission fleet transitions.

title: Legally protected health care activity.
summary: Bars health providers, insurers and employers from disclosing gender-affirming care information to other states' investigators or in response to out-of-state subpoenas.

title: Incarcerated persons: communications.
summary: Requires electronic messaging for incarcerated people, bars call cutoffs based on duration, and mandates free hygiene products for indigent youth in juvenile facilities.

title: Residential projects: fees and charges.
summary: Lets local agencies collect utility connection charges at application and collect certain water, sewer, and emergency-service fees on residential projects before occupancy.

title: Enhanced infrastructure financing districts and community revitalization and investment areas: allocation of taxes: agricultural land exclusion.
summary: Excludes Williamson Act and farmland security zone land from property tax increment allocations to enhanced infrastructure financing districts and community revitalization areas.

title: Connected devices: device protection requests.
summary: Lets domestic violence survivors ask account managers to cut off a perpetrator's access to connected devices, with confidentiality and enforcement requirements.

title: Energy: usage data.
summary: Allows utilities to meet building energy usage data requirements by providing data through alternative tools approved by the Energy Commission.

title: Responsible Battery Recycling Act of 2022: covered batteries.
summary: Expands California's battery stewardship law to cover more battery sizes, removes weight-based exclusions, and revises producer collection-site requirements.

title: Local education agency-owned land: development of affordable housing.
summary: Lets school districts submit surplus land to HCD for affordable housing suitability review, and requires right of first refusal for school employees and local tenants.

title: Health care services: artificial intelligence.
summary: Requires developers and deployers of clinical decision support AI to identify, document, and mitigate risks of biased impacts in health programs.

title: Communicable diseases: HIV reporting.
summary: Allows health care providers to share identifying information about patients with reported HIV infections with public health agencies for case reporting and care linkage.

title: Money Transmission Act: authentication.
topics: AI and technology; Consumer protection and business
summary: Requires money transmission licensees to use two-factor or multifactor authentication or equivalent access controls before allowing user logins, operative 2028.

title: Transportation: omnibus bill.
summary: Omnibus transportation bill: adds City of Mountain House to rail authority, removes SFCTA from Treasure Island congestion pricing, allows duplicate licenses after address change.

title: Planning and zoning: regional housing needs allocation.
summary: Lets localities and tribes voluntarily count new tribal housing toward a locality's regional housing needs allocation, without requiring sovereign immunity waivers.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: transportation impact mitigation.
summary: Makes contributions to the Transit-Oriented Development Implementation Fund full CEQA mitigation for transportation impacts, and allows deposits starting at initial guidance.

title: Office of Emergency Services: training: transnational repression.
summary: Requires the Office of Emergency Services to develop transnational repression recognition and response training by January 1, 2027.

title: Permanent standard time.
summary: Requires California and its political subdivisions to observe permanent standard time, repealing daylight saving time and exempting the state from federal time-advancement law.

title: Pupil instruction: treatment of African Americans.
summary: Requires the curriculum commission to consider adding African American historical contributions to history-social science frameworks and instructional materials starting in 2026.

title: Pupil nutrition: nutrition assistance: community program information.
summary: Brings Level 2 driver-assistance systems under autonomous vehicle rules, moves zero-emission requirements to 2028, and adds cost-recovery fees.

title: District elections: initiatives.
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Lets voters in transportation-taxing districts impose a retail transactions and use tax by initiative, subject to existing tax limits and accountability standards.

title: Personnel records.
summary: Adds education and training records to employee personnel records and requires employers to ensure those records include specified information.

title: Wildfire prevention: qualified entities: assessments: California Fire Service Training and Education Program Act.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Labor and employment
summary: Extends the wildfire defensible space assessment program indefinitely, adds nonprofit qualified entities, and makes voluntary homeowner data confidential.

title: Local government: collection of demographic data.
summary: Requires cities, counties, and charter cities to add specified Black ancestry categories when collecting hiring demographic data, starting 2027.

title: Enhanced infrastructure financing districts: California Capital City Downtown Revitalization Act.
summary: Authorizes Sacramento to create a downtown enhanced infrastructure financing district, with optional taxing entity participation and state funds use.

title: Home improvement contract requirements: subcontractors.
summary: Requires home improvement contracts to disclose whether subcontractors will be used, and clarifies prime contractor responsibility for discipline.

title: Descendants of enslaved persons: reparations.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Creates a Bureau for Descendants of American Slavery in the Civil Rights Department to verify descendant status, subject to appropriation.

title: Veterans.
summary: Creates a Veteran Task Force to study and recommend ways to keep veterans and military families living and working in California.

title: Housing rental terms: algorithmic devices.
summary: Bans selling or using rental pricing algorithms to set residential rents, enforceable through civil actions by government and private parties.

title: Nurse-midwifery education program.
summary: Creates a fund to establish master's-level nurse-midwifery education programs at California State University and University of California campuses, financed by General Fund appropriations.

title: Public employment: disqualification.
summary: Expands public employee disqualification after felony convictions to conflicts of interest and applies city manager and attorney bans to all cities.

title: Housing: tenant protections.
summary: Removes the just-cause eviction exemption for post-disaster replacement housing built on units previously covered by the Tenant Protection Act.

title: Fire insurance.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Lets homeowners' insurers differentiate internal and external fire risk for coverage, and creates a CEA commission to study a disaster insurance program.

title: Law enforcement agencies: artificial intelligence.
summary: Requires police reports generated wholly or partly by AI to carry a disclosure statement and officer signature, with retained drafts and audit trails.

title: California FAIR Plan: manufactured homes.
summary: Extends California FAIR Plan basic property insurance to manufactured homes and mobilehomes on the same terms as other residential dwellings.

title: Health facilities: clinics.
summary: Lets clinic corporations open affiliate primary care clinics and change locations with license approval, skipping onsite surveys.

title: Worker classification: employees and independent contractors: athletic coaches.
summary: Exempts sports coaches at private elementary and secondary schools and local educational agencies from the ABC worker classification test, applying the Borello test instead.

title: Health care: maintenance and expansion.
summary: Subject to appropriation, creates state-funded backfill for Medi-Cal services lost to federal cuts, including abortion and gender-affirming care.

title: Personal income taxes: deduction: California qualified tuition program.
summary: Creates a state income tax deduction for contributions to the California 529 college savings program, capped at $5,000 or $10,000.

title: Artificial intelligence models: large developers.
summary: Requires large frontier AI developers to publish safety frameworks and report critical incidents, and creates CalCompute public computing cluster framework.

title: Medi-Cal: time and distance standards.
summary: Extends Medi-Cal managed care time, distance and appointment standards to 2029 and adds subcontractor compliance, telehealth and enrollee notice requirements.

title: Course of study: mental health education.
summary: Requires mental health education in the adopted course of study for grades 1 to 12, with state reimbursement for mandated local costs.

title: Air basins.
summary: Declares legislative intent to enact future legislation on clean air basins, without making substantive changes now.

title: Electric vehicle charging stations: arenas: payments: internet-based applications.
summary: Allows EV chargers at 15,000-plus-seat arenas to require payment only through an internet-based app, creating an exception to existing payment rules.

title: Dependent children: information related to family.
summary: Requires county welfare departments to give dependent minors and nonminors the last known whereabouts and contact information of their parents and siblings, with an option to decline.

title: Obesity Care Access Act.
summary: Requires health plans and insurers that cover outpatient prescriptions to also cover bariatric surgery and at least one FDA-approved antiobesity medication starting in 2026.

title: Workers’ compensation insurance fraud reporting.
topics: AI and technology; Consumer protection and business
summary: Requires insurers to report premium fraud to EDD and lets insurers obtain employer payroll data to check workers' compensation premiums.

title: Parole: revocation.
summary: Allows courts to return paroled murderers to state prison for parole violations, or otherwise impose county jail confinement.

title: Public Employees’ Retirement System: teaching service.
summary: Allows PERS members who work as substitute teachers, under certain circumstances, to elect to keep PERS coverage.

title: School facilities.
summary: Extends school facility health-and-safety funding and expedited approval to wildfire, flood, and emergency-damaged schools, and allows machine learning in permitting and reviews.

title: Court fee waivers: veterans.
summary: Excludes veterans' service-connected disability compensation from income when determining eligibility for court fee waivers.

title: Independent System Operator: independent regional organization: California Renewables Portfolio Standard Program.
summary: Deletes the ISO's regional transformation mandate, allows voluntary regional energy markets, and creates a state council to approve or withdraw utility participation.

title: Electricity: load shifting.
summary: Requires the Energy Commission to analyze load-shifting cost-effectiveness and publish each retail supplier's load-shifting results.

title: Tribal gaming: compact ratification.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Environment and energy
summary: Ratifies a 2026 amendment to the Santa Ynez Chumash tribal gaming compact and exempts related actions from CEQA.

title: Accessory dwelling units and junior accessory dwelling units.
summary: Revises junior ADU rules: sets a 500 sq ft interior limit, requires JADU ordinance review, and makes state JADU standards override conflicting local ordinances.

title: Railroad crossings: permit applications: review.
summary: Requires railroad crossing permit applications to include specified information and creates an expedited PUC review and approval process for exempt crossings.

title: High-speed rail: economic opportunities.
summary: Requires a state economic development study on high-speed rail corridor opportunities and directs certain infrastructure districts to spend most revenue locally.

title: Collection Licensing Act: exceptions: billing agents.
summary: Exempts billing agents from the Debt Collection Licensing Act and repeals California Financial Literacy Fund provisions.

title: Commercial property insurance cancellation and nonrenewal.
summary: Extends the ban on insurers canceling or refusing to renew wildfire-area property policies to commercial property insurance.

title: California Overdose Death and Addiction Reduction Act of 2025.
summary: Directs the state health agency to use a task force to develop recommendations aimed at cutting alcohol and drug addiction deaths by 50% by 2033, then report on results.

title: Heritage schools: enrollment and notice.
summary: Expands the heritage school definition to cover younger children and requires enrollment notice that the Department of Education does not regulate or monitor these schools.

title: State parks: facilities pass: Gold Star Family members.
summary: Requires State Parks to issue free all-facility passes, including boat launch access, to eligible Gold Star Family members who show proof.

title: California State University, San Jose: legal partnership pilot program.
summary: Authorizes a six-year CSU San Jose pilot with a nonprofit law school to jointly award JD degrees, with LAO evaluations.

title: Corrections and rehabilitation: state policy.
summary: Declares corrections policy goals of normalization, dynamic security, and personal growth, and requires community-based program access and staff training.

title: Juveniles: wards: case plans.
summary: Requires case plans and progress reviews every six months for juvenile wards in certain wardship recommendations, and imposes state-mandated county costs.

title: Prisons: clearances.
summary: Allows legal professionals and attorney support staff to seek prison program-provider clearances and gives listed officials short-term gate clearance on request.

title: Law enforcement: immigration enforcement.
summary: Makes California law enforcement responses to immigration release-date requests mandatory and removes local policy limits on cooperating with immigration authorities.

title: Workers’ compensation: average annual earnings.
summary: Raises the average weekly earnings bounds used to compute permanent partial disability indemnity for workers' compensation injuries occurring on or after January 1, 2027.

title: Habitat enhancement and restoration: floodplains.
summary: Requires $21.5 million, upon appropriation, for floodplain habitat acquisition and restoration in Kern, Kings, and Tulare counties.

title: Child abuse: family resource centers.
summary: Broadens the statutory definition of "family resource center" to emphasize low-cost, community-based, peer-support and multigenerational services.

title: Imperial Valley Healthcare District: voting districts.
summary: Allows initial Imperial Valley Healthcare District board members to run for and win the first elected seats in voting districts.

title: Electricity: deenergization events: communications.
summary: Requires utilities to notify public safety partners, publish weather data and restoration updates, and report annually to the PUC during power shutoffs, with penalties for noncompliance.

title: Property taxation: disabled veterans’ exemption: household income.
summary: Excludes service-connected disability payments from household income for the disabled veterans' property tax exemption until 2036.

title: Public social services.
summary: Raises the welfare fraud threshold to $25,000, deletes attempt penalties, and bars prosecution for certain benefit overpayments.

title: Appointment of public guardians.
summary: Requires county public guardians to acknowledge conservatorship referrals within 2 business days, conclude investigations in reasonable time, and report status on request.

title: Bail.
summary: Requires bail sureties to refund part of premiums when charges are dropped or bond terms change within 21 days, with a 30-day cutoff.

title: State parks: Off-highway Motor Vehicle Recreation: grants: eligible applicants.
summary: Expands eligible applicants for off-highway motor vehicle recreation grants to include special districts that employ sworn personnel.

title: Crimes: human trafficking.
summary: Makes technical, nonsubstantive changes to existing human trafficking crime provisions covering forced labor, extortion, and sex offenses.

title: Employee housing: H-2A agricultural workers: inspections.
summary: Requires in-person annual inspections of H-2A worker employee housing, posts results online, and bars permits for operators who fail inspection.

title: Real property tax: Personal Income Tax Law: homeowners’ exemption: renter’s credit.
summary: Raises the homeowners' property tax exemption to $50,000 for certain owners and increases the renter's income tax credit.

title: Gravity-Based Energy Storage Well Pilot Program.
summary: Creates a sunset pilot letting up to 250 oil and gas wells be converted for gravity-based energy storage, with integrity testing, leak monitoring and annual fees.

title: Pupil health: epinephrine delivery systems: schoolsites and childcare programs.
summary: Requires schools and childcare programs to stock emergency epinephrine delivery systems and expands staff authorized to administer them.

title: Bikeways: reversions and modifications.
summary: Bars local governments from converting or reducing the safety of state-funded bikeways for 20 years, overriding charter city powers.

title: Electrical corporations: data centers: report.
topics: AI and technology; Environment and energy
summary: Authorizes the PUC to assess whether data center electricity costs shift to other customers, and requires a public report by 2027.

title: Common interest developments.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive change to the title provision of the Davis-Stirling Common Interest Development Act.

title: Emergencies: crimes.
summary: Adds an aggravating factor for looting while impersonating emergency personnel and creates new crimes for impersonating first responders during evacuations.

title: Vehicles: advanced driver assistance system: crash reports.
summary: Requires manufacturers to report Level 2 driver-assistance crashes to the DMV within 5 days, with DMV posting data and a civil penalty for noncompliance.

title: Personal Income Tax Law: exclusions: guaranteed income pilot programs.
summary: Extends the guaranteed income pilot tax exclusion to 2031 and raises corporate tax rates for publicly held corporations based on pay ratios.

title: Attorneys, arbitrators, judicial officers, and alternative resolution providers.
summary: Restricts attorneys and arbitrators from delegating legal work to generative AI and requires verification of AI-sourced citations in court filings.

title: California Sea Otter Voluntary Tax Contribution Fund.
summary: Creates a voluntary income tax checkoff letting taxpayers direct amounts above their tax liability to a California sea otter fund through 2033.

title: Video streaming services: commercial advertisements.
summary: Prohibits video streaming services from transmitting commercial advertisements at a louder audio volume than the accompanying content, starting July 1, 2026.

title: Public entities.
summary: Shortens filing deadlines for pre-2024 childhood sexual assault claims, adds heightened proof for suits against public entities, and tightens certificate-of-merit filing rules.

title: California Workplace Outreach Program.
summary: Creates a state workplace outreach program, funded upon appropriation, that educates workers about their rights through contracted nonprofit organizations until 2031.

title: Mental health and artificial intelligence working group.
summary: Creates a working group to study artificial intelligence's role in mental health settings and report to the Legislature by 2028 and 2030.

title: Air quality: standard: hydrogen sulfide.
summary: Requires the Air Resources Board to develop a hydrogen sulfide response framework, hold public workshops, and possibly update health exposure guidance values.

title: Attorney General: immigration enforcement policies.
summary: Requires the Attorney General to publish model policies limiting local and state agency cooperation with immigration enforcement, which agencies must implement by 2027.

title: Department of Forestry and Fire Protection: employment: firefighters.
summary: Requires state agencies to transition CAL FIRE's Firefighter I classification to a permanent firefighter employment classification.

title: Health and care facilities: licensing during emergencies or disasters.
summary: Lets disaster-damaged care facilities request inactive licenses and possibly waive fees, while requiring skilled nursing facilities to annually review emergency plans.

title: Insurer financial statements.
summary: Raises late filing fees insurers must pay for failing to timely file required financial statements with the Insurance Commissioner.

title: Pupil instruction: civic engagement.
summary: Requires K-12 social science instruction to include civic engagement with governmental institutions and expands the California Serves service-learning program to grades 1-12.

title: Agriculture: meat and poultry products: misbranding.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive wording change to the state's livestock and poultry product misbranding provision.

title: Off-highway electric motorcycles.
summary: Classifies off-highway electric motorcycles as off-highway motor vehicles, subjecting them to existing off-highway rules, identification requirements, and related penalties.

title: Personal income taxes: credit: manufacturing: sales and use taxes.
summary: Creates a 2026-2030 income and corporate tax credit covering local and transactions sales taxes on purchases otherwise exempt for qualified businesses.

title: Health facilities: freestanding emergency center study.
summary: Requires a state feasibility study on freestanding emergency departments in underserved areas, with a report to the Legislature and a General Fund appropriation.

title: Spousal support: factors.
summary: Bars spousal support and fee awards and awards retirement community property interests when a family court finds a violent sexual felony without conviction.

title: Change of name or gender and sex identifier.
summary: Expands confidentiality for name and gender change court records to all petitioners and bars public posting, with civil remedies for violations.

title: Paid family leave: eligibility: care for designated persons.
summary: Expands paid family leave eligibility to cover caring for a seriously ill designated person, not just relatives, starting July 2028.

title: Taxation: electronic payments: penalties.
summary: Waives the 1% penalty for an individual's first violation of the requirement to pay Franchise Tax Board amounts electronically, for payments on or after January 1, 2026.

title: Property tax: change in ownership: residential rental property.
summary: Excludes certain tenant purchases of rental buildings by limited-equity cooperatives or community land trusts from property tax reassessment.

title: Electrical corporations: significant voltage-related incidents: studies.
summary: Requires the PUC to have large electric utilities study voltage-related incidents that damage customer property, then publish and report the studies.

title: Short-Term Rental Facilitator Act of 2026.
summary: Extends the Short-Term Rental Facilitator Act's local powers, including reporting and tax collection, to Indian tribes, which may impose tribal transient occupancy taxes.

title: Local government: investments and financial reports.
summary: Extends local agencies' commercial paper maturity limit to 397 days, postpones investment sunsets to 2031, and changes the deadline that triggers forfeiture for late financial reports.

title: Health facilities: administrative penalties.
summary: Tightens penalties for hospitals violating nurse-to-patient ratios by narrowing the on-call exemption and counting separate-day violations separately.

title: Labor-related liabilities: direct contractor and subcontractor.
summary: Makes direct contractors liable for subcontractors' unpaid labor debts on contracts from 2026, broadening who counts as a direct contractor.

title: Public contracts: local water infrastructure projects: Construction Manager/General Contractor project delivery method.
summary: Extends the construction manager/general contractor delivery method to local agencies for certain water infrastructure projects through 2031, capped at 15 projects each.

title: Atmospheric rivers: research: forecasting methods: experimental tools.
summary: Requires the Department of Water Resources' atmospheric river forecasting research to include experimental seasonal and subseasonal forecast tools.

title: Controlled substances: xylazine.
summary: Adds xylazine to Schedule III controlled substances, creates a new crime, and exempts xylazine testing equipment from paraphernalia bans.

title: Public postsecondary education: waiver of tuition and fees: California Military Department GI Bill Award Program: extended education courses.
summary: Waives tuition and fees for specified veterans' family members in UC and CSU extended education courses counting toward undergraduate degrees.

title: Public Employment Relations Board: powers and duties.
summary: Authorizes the Public Employment Relations Board to study how net-zero carbon initiatives affect public employees.

title: Water: waste discharge.
summary: Extends state water quality authority to non-navigable waters, requires federal Clean Water Act compliance in discharge permits, and annually raises water pollution penalties.

title: Veterinarians: veterinarian-client-patient relationship.
summary: Allows registered veterinary technicians to give preventive vaccines or parasite medications at animal shelters when a veterinarian is nearby or reachable by phone.

title: Property taxation: transfer of base year value: disaster relief.
summary: Lets counties extend the window for transferring disaster-damaged property's base year value by three years, with no state reimbursement of lost local revenue.

title: Veterans’ benefits: farm and home purchase.
summary: Makes technical, nonsubstantive changes to the CalVet farm and home purchase loan provisions for veterans.

title: State attorneys and administrative law judges: compensation.
summary: Requires state attorney and administrative law judge salaries to reach parity with public sector attorneys, phased in over three years subject to appropriation.

title: Homeless Housing, Assistance, and Prevention program: reporting requirements: functional zero unsheltered.
summary: Requires HHAP grant applicants to report on efforts and assessments toward functional zero homelessness and unsheltered homelessness, including housing needs and funding analysis.

title: Golden Gate Bridge, Highway and Transportation District: contributions and loans.
summary: Authorizes the Golden Gate Bridge District to accept state and federal contributions and loans for seismic safety capital improvements.

title: Sexual health.
summary: Bars retailers from refusing nonprescription contraception based on age and lets school health centers make condoms available to students in grades 7-12.

title: Fish: commercial fishing.
summary: Makes certain commercial fishing landing receipts and activity records confidential, and removes marine aquaria receivers from electronic fish ticket reporting.

title: Private works of improvement: retention payments.
summary: Caps construction retention payments withheld on private works of improvement at 5% and awards attorney's fees to the prevailing party in enforcement actions.

title: Disaster assistance: tenants, mobilehome parks, and mortgages.
summary: After a disaster, requires landlords to remediate damage and keep tenants' right to return at the same rent, and requires impact reports for disaster-related mobilehome park closures.

title: Planning and zoning: community plans: review under the California Environmental Quality Act.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration; Housing
summary: Reenacts and extends limits on CEQA challenges to development projects consistent with community plan updates, applying statewide including charter cities, as an urgency measure.

title: Pupil instruction: high school graduation requirements: career technical education.
summary: Requires a stand-alone one-semester career technical education course for high school graduation starting 2031-32, subject to appropriation.

title: Methane emissions: petroleum and natural gas producing low methane emissions.
summary: Requires state agencies to prioritize methane emission reductions and encourages procurement of certified low-methane natural gas, using verification protocols.

title: Public resources: transportation of carbon dioxide.
summary: Extends pipeline safety law to carbon dioxide pipelines, requires State Fire Marshal regulations, and bars construction near sensitive receptors.

title: Vehicle traction batteries.
summary: Requires battery suppliers and remanufacturers to label, register and pay fees for traction batteries, funding a state recovery program contingent on appropriation.

title: Community Hardening Commission: wildfire mitigation program.
summary: Creates a Community Hardening Commission within the Department of Insurance to develop wildfire home-hardening standards and recommendations by July 2027.

title: California Worker Adjustment and Retraining Act.
summary: Adds required content to mass layoff notices, including workforce board service coordination plans and CalFresh food assistance information.

title: Electricity: deenergization events: report: compensation.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Environment and energy
summary: Requires utilities to report on power shutoffs and their customer costs, allows fines for protocol violations, and directs fine revenue to customer credits.

title: Public postsecondary education.
summary: Requires CSU transfer eligibility to be based on the new California General Education Transfer Curriculum instead of IGETC or CSU GE-Breadth, and renames the foster parent education program to cover resource families.

title: Health care coverage: essential health benefits.
summary: Requires health plans to cover fertility services and durable medical equipment starting 2027 if federal approval of a new benchmark plan occurs.

title: Energy utility data.
topics: AI and technology; Environment and energy
summary: Creates a customer energy data bill of rights and an advisory committee, and directs the PUC to prioritize verifying utility data in rate cases.

title: Voter registration: military and overseas voters.
summary: Repeals an obsolete provision allowing certain military and overseas voters to register after the deadline, since they are now covered by general conditional registration.

title: Educational equity: sex-segregated school programs and activities: sex at birth.
summary: Requires public school pupils to participate in sex-segregated programs, including athletics and facilities, consistent with their sex at birth rather than gender identity.

title: Automobile accidents: civil actions: transportation network companies.
summary: Caps recoverable medical damages in auto-accident suits against rideshare companies and drivers, limits lien sales, and bans attorney referral and fee-splitting arrangements.

title: Nonminor dependents: tax guidance.
topics: Children and families; Taxes and budget
summary: Requires state guidance and annual mailed notices to nonminor dependents on filing taxes and claiming the foster youth tax credit.

title: Housing developments: disasters: reconstruction of destroyed or damaged structures.
summary: Voids HOA and deed restrictions that block rebuilding disaster-damaged homes and sets deadlines for approval reviews.

title: Perinatal health screenings and treatment.
