summary: Requires perinatal providers to screen for maternal mental health conditions, evaluate positive screens, and offer treatment, and requires health plans to run screening programs.

title: Law enforcement: masks.
summary: Bans law enforcement officers from wearing facial coverings on duty, with an exemption for agencies adopting mask policies.

title: Employment: employer contributions: employee withholdings: credit: agricultural employees.
summary: Lets employers claim a state payroll-withholding credit equal to overtime wages paid to covered agricultural employees, capped at the quarter's withholding remittance.

title: Wildfires: fire hazard severity zones: post-wildfire safety areas.
summary: Requires the State Fire Marshal to map post-wildfire safety areas after major fires and triggers state fire protection standards there, with local notice requirements.

title: San Francisco Bay area: local revenue measure: public transit funding.
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget; Transportation
summary: Creates a Bay Area transit revenue district and authorizes a 14-year regional sales tax, subject to November 2026 voter approval, to fund transit agencies.

title: State parks: real property: acquisitions and leases.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Lets state officials waive certain approvals for park land acquisitions and leases, and temporarily exempts some Parks Department purchases from review through 2033.

title: Charter School Revolving Loan Fund.
summary: Raises charter school revolving loan limits to $500,000, changes loan interest rates and repayment terms, and adds reporting requirements.

title: Community colleges: California College Promise.
summary: Lowers the California College Promise fee-waiver enrollment threshold from 12 to 9 units and requires written notice to recipients about eligibility.

title: Plastic beverage containers: recycling.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Environment and energy
summary: Raises the penalty for beverage makers missing recycled-plastic content targets and adds third-party validation and public compliance reporting.

title: Local government: homelessness.
summary: Bars local governments from adopting or enforcing ordinances that prohibit providing support services to homeless people or aiding basic survival acts.

title: Food vendors and facilities: enforcement activities.
topics: AI and technology; Consumer protection and business; Immigration
summary: Bars local sidewalk vendor data sharing without a subpoena or warrant, limits immigration-status and background checks for permits, and bars local resources for immigration enforcement.

title: Electrical or gas corporations: deferment of payments: hardship.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Environment and energy
summary: Requires electric and gas utilities to defer payments and bar disconnection for three months for qualifying hardship customers, then enroll them in payment plans.

title: Consumer review platforms.
topics: AI and technology; Consumer protection and business
summary: Requires consumer review platforms offered in California to let businesses opt out of being reviewed or featured in testimonials.

title: California Education Interagency Council: California Career Technical Education Incentive Grant Program.
summary: Revises California career technical education grant eligibility and shifts grant consultation to a new interagency council, which would also get advisory duties and support.

title: Zoning: Sacramento-San Joaquin Valley.
summary: Gives certain Marysville, Sacramento, Sutter and Yuba areas until 2030 to reach urban flood protection before flood-zone development limits apply.

title: Education expenses: School Choice Flex Account Act of 2025.
summary: Creates state-funded school choice accounts for K-12 families to pay private school tuition and expenses, phased in from 2027-28 with universal eligibility by 2031-32.

title: Public postsecondary education: admission, transfer, and enrollment.
summary: Creates a CSU direct admission program, extends the dual admission program to 2035-36, and gives community colleges 3 years to complete transfer requirements.

title: Department of Consumer Affairs and Department of Real Estate: states of emergency: waivers and exemptions.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Allows licensing boards to waive license requirements and fees for disaster-affected licensees, and requires licensed debris-removal contractors to pass hazardous substance certification.

title: Employment: payment of wages.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Labor and employment
summary: Revises California equal pay law: extends wage claim deadlines to three years, allows six years of relief, and covers all sexes.

title: Carbon Dioxide Removal Purchase Program.
summary: Creates a $50 million competitive grant program at the Air Resources Board to purchase carbon dioxide removal projects, contingent on appropriation.

title: Political Reform Act of 1974: contribution limits.
summary: Applies state campaign contribution limits to judicial, school district, and community college candidates starting January 1, 2027.

title: Juries: peremptory challenges.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice
summary: Indefinitely exempts most civil cases from rules barring discriminatory peremptory jury challenges, and limits past-strike review to public-entity counsel.

title: Prenatal multivitamins.
summary: Requires prenatal multivitamin makers to test for heavy metals, disclose results publicly, and bans sale of noncompliant products starting 2027.

title: Energy: Equitable Building Decarbonization Program: Low-Income Oversight Board: membership.
summary: Requires the Energy Commission to notify building decarbonization applicants about utility incentives and adds an Energy Commission appointee to the Low-Income Oversight Board.

title: Employment: gratuities: enforcement.
summary: Authorizes the Labor Commissioner to investigate gratuity violations and issue citations or file civil actions against employers who take or withhold tips.

title: Firearms: silencers.
summary: Renames "silencer" to "suppressor" in California firearm law provisions and makes technical nonsubstantive changes to a related victims' rights provision.

title: Budget Act of 2025.
summary: Enacts the 2025-26 state budget, making appropriations for state government support, effective immediately as a Budget Bill.

title: The Sacramento-San Joaquin Delta Reform Act of 2009.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Makes Delta Plan provisions severable, sets legal action deadlines for council decisions, and lets state and local agencies appeal consistency certifications.

title: Food and agriculture.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to how Food and Agricultural Code provisions are construed in civil and criminal actions.

title: Private security services: security guards: training.
summary: Requires security guard use-of-force and arrest training to come from a single provider and be completed within six months of application.

title: Wildfire prevention: environmentally sensitive vegetation management.
summary: Defines environmentally sensitive vegetation management and requires state entities to consider wildlife-supporting criteria in grant program funding guidelines.

title: California Environmental Protection Agency: contract: registry: greenhouse gas emissions that result from the water-energy nexus.
summary: Requires CalEPA to oversee a voluntary water-energy greenhouse gas registry and authorizes a $2 million, three-year contract to recruit participants.

title: Dwelling units: indoor temperature.
summary: Declares it state policy that dwelling units can maintain a safe maximum indoor temperature, and requires agencies to consider this in their policies and, from 2027, their regulations.

title: Small business: small business liaison.
summary: Requires all state agencies to designate small business liaisons who report contract data to the Small Business Advocate, and raises procurement participation goals for disabled veteran and minority businesses.

title: Personal Income Tax Law: deferred compensation: exclusions: long-term qualified tuition program.
summary: Exempts certain 529 long-term qualified tuition program distributions rolled into Roth IRAs from state gross income for 2025-2029 taxable years.

title: Real property impacted by the 2025 Eaton or Palisades Fires: notification of owner’s intent to sell.
summary: Requires notice and sale certification for fire-damaged Eaton and Palisades properties, plus tenant retention and affordability conditions for qualified buyers.

title: The Parent’s Accountability and Child Protection Act: remedies.
summary: Adds higher civil penalties for online businesses that sell age-restricted products to minors, enforceable by prosecutors or parents.

title: Civil discovery.
summary: Removes the 2027 sunset, making existing civil discovery initial-disclosure requirements permanent.

title: California Health and Human Services Data Exchange Framework.
summary: Shifts oversight of the state health data exchange framework from the Health and Human Services Agency to the Department of Health Care Access and Information, and expands the stakeholder group.

title: Airports: financial assistance.
summary: Directs jet fuel sales tax revenue to airports via the Aeronautics Account and requires airports to report fuel flowage statistics.

title: Wildfires: defensible space: education efforts.
summary: Extends the CalFire defensible space assessment and home hardening training and volunteer programs from 2026 to 2031.

title: Winter Fires of 2025: real property tax: exemptions and reassessment.
summary: Extends by three years the deadline to replace property damaged in specified 2024–2025 fires while keeping its base-year property tax value.

title: Vehicles: public safety: Blue Envelope Program.
summary: Requires DMV to create a Blue Envelope Program so drivers and passengers with disabilities can carry information for interactions with law enforcement.

title: Personal Income Tax Law: Corporation Tax Law: credits: retail security measures.
summary: Creates a state income and corporate tax credit, capped at $10,000 per year, for retail theft prevention measures from 2025 through 2029.

title: Personal income tax: credit: home security surveillance.
summary: Creates a temporary personal income tax credit up to $250 for buying and installing home security surveillance systems, 2026-2030.

title: Railroads: safety: report.
summary: Requires the PUC, by July 1, 2029, to review hazardous railroad sites and evaluate whether each should be removed, modified, or added in its annual report.

title: Workers’ compensation: medical-legal expenses: fee schedule.
summary: Lets the workers' compensation administrative director adjust the medical-legal fee schedule every two years and requires updating drug and pharmacy fees alongside it.

title: Rural hospitals: standby perinatal services.
summary: Creates a 10-year pilot letting up to five rural critical access hospitals establish standby perinatal services, with standards, reporting, and licensing enforcement.

title: Student financial aid: Cal Grants: Middle Class Scholarship Program: eligibility: dependents of members of the armed services stationed outside of California.
summary: Extends Cal Grant and Middle Class Scholarship eligibility to dependents of California-resident military members stationed outside California.

title: Adult Education Program: immigrant integration.
summary: Defines immigrant integration for purposes of the state Adult Education Program, without changing funding or services.

title: Pedestrian crossing signals.
summary: Requires state signals to add accessible pedestrian signals, leading pedestrian intervals, and inventory tracking, with local reimbursement if mandated.

title: The Youth Rehabilitation and Opportunity Act.
summary: Makes people sentenced to life without parole for crimes committed at 25 or younger eligible for parole after 25 years; sets a hearing deadline.

title: Courthouse construction: filing fee surcharges.
summary: Extends San Bernardino County's authority to impose courthouse construction filing-fee surcharges until January 1, 2039.

title: Beverage containers: recycling: redemption payment and refund value.
summary: Cuts the recycling redemption payment and refund for small wine and spirits boxes, bladders, and pouches from $0.25 to $0.10 starting 2026.

title: Imperial County Air Pollution Control District: members and duties.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Sets Imperial County air district board membership and San Diego-style duties, requiring public website, permit postings, and monitoring data.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: judicial streamlining: state of emergency: wildfire.
summary: Speeds CEQA review and court challenges for rebuilding wildfire-damaged property in declared emergency areas, with applicants paying court costs.

title: Housing financing: joint powers agreements: bond approvals: subdivisions: tentative and final maps: appeals.
summary: Lets the state join joint powers authorities to issue bonds financing certain residential rental projects when local approval is missing.

title: Fire prevention activities: challenges: undertaking.
summary: Lets defendants in lawsuits challenging fire prevention projects seek a bond of up to $500,000 from plaintiffs whose suits would delay the project.

title: Health care facilities: physicians and surgeons: terminations and revocation of staff privileges: data reporting by race and gender.
summary: Requires hospitals and peer review bodies to report physician privilege and termination data by race and gender to the Civil Rights Department annually.

title: Major food allergens.
summary: Adds sesame to major food allergens and requires chain restaurants to disclose allergens in each menu item starting July 2026.

title: Sex offender registration: unlawful sexual intercourse with a minor.
summary: Requires 10-year tier one sex offender registration for certain unlawful sexual intercourse with a minor convictions for offenses on or after January 1, 2026.

title: Housing.
summary: Bans landlord fees not in the rental agreement, caps total fees at 5% of rent, bars parking fees, and lets ADU fees be excluded from reasonable restrictions.

title: Environmental health: product safety: perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Environment and energy
summary: Bans sale of cleaning products, dental floss, juvenile products, food packaging, ski wax, and cookware containing intentionally added PFAS, starting 2028 and 2030.

title: Privacy: use of a person’s name, voice, signature, photograph, or likeness: injunctive relief.
summary: Lets people seeking relief for unauthorized use of their name or likeness also seek injunctions or temporary restraining orders, with a 2-day compliance deadline.

title: Polluters Pay Climate Superfund Act of 2025.
topics: Environment and energy; Taxes and budget
summary: Creates a Climate Superfund requiring major fossil fuel producers to pay cost recovery demands for California's share of past and future climate damages.

title: Special education: nonpublic schools and agencies.
summary: Removes the nonsectarian requirement for private special education schools contracting with districts, while barring public funds for religious instruction.

title: Housing programs: financing.
summary: Allows owners of department-regulated affordable housing to take on additional debt when extracted equity reimburses predevelopment, capital, and operating costs.

title: Chiropractors: animal chiropractic practitioners.
summary: Creates a state registration pathway letting chiropractors practice animal chiropractic, exempting them from the Veterinary Medicine Practice Act.

title: Office of Regulatory Counsel.
summary: Creates a temporary Office of Regulatory Counsel in the Governor's office to draft and help prepare state agency regulations before OAL publication.

title: Local jurisdictions: district-based elections.
summary: Creates a small-city exception to CVRA at-large election rules, extends the pre-suit notice period, and requires public release of district boundary data.

title: Artificial intelligence program: Attorney General.
summary: Creates an Attorney General AI expertise program with annual legislative reporting, and lets air districts request faster Clean Cars 4 All disbursements.

title: Crimes: invasion of privacy.
summary: Limits private lawsuits under California's pen register privacy law for online conduct, letting only the Attorney General sue, retroactively to pending claims.

title: Body-worn cameras: policies.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice
summary: Requires law enforcement agencies with body-worn camera policies to add a procedure for redacting recordings of patients receiving emergency medical or psychological care, while keeping an unredacted copy.

title: Vehicles: homelessness.
summary: Lets cities and counties dismantle abandoned, immobile vehicles declared a hazard, after notice and a hearing opportunity.

title: Employees: meal periods.
summary: Exempts water corporation employees covered by qualifying collective bargaining agreements from the required 30-minute meal period rule.

title: Deceptive practices: service members and veterans.
summary: Bans excessive fees for helping veterans with federal benefit claims and extends computer-credential restrictions to Department of Veterans Affairs systems.

title: Transportation: climate resiliency: projects of statewide and regional significance.
summary: Requires Caltrans to create an annual prioritized list of statewide and regional climate-resilience transportation projects and report it to the Legislature.

title: Sales and Use Tax Law: exemptions: firefighting equipment.
summary: Exempts firefighting apparatus and equipment bought by fire departments and fire protection districts from sales and use tax from 2026 to 2031.

title: Determination of water rights: stream system.
summary: Revises State Water Board stream-system adjudication procedures, letting it order claimants to report water use and extending review procedures to those orders.

title: California Solar Initiative: distributed energy resource equipment lists.
summary: Authorizes the Energy Commission to set equipment lists and rating standards for solar, storage, and EV charging equipment, and to adopt related guidelines.

title: Legislature: constitutional course.
summary: Requires all legislators and legislative employees to take a course on the U.S. and California Constitutions within six months of each regular session.

title: Employment: automated decision systems.
summary: Regulates employer use of automated decision systems in employment, requiring notice, limiting uses, and giving workers data access and anti-retaliation protections.

title: Public contracts: Small Business Procurement and Contract Act.
summary: Raises the maximum value of small business contracts that state agencies can award without competitive bidding, from $250,000 to $350,000.

title: Capital Programs and Climate Financing Authority Act: California Investment and Innovation Program.
summary: Lets the state's capital financing authority fund grants to community development financial institutions that provide capital access to disadvantaged communities.

title: Signal jammers.
summary: Makes it a crime to make, sell, or operate signal jammers without FCC authorization, with added penalties for jamming public safety communications.

title: Legislative and gubernatorial appointments: report.
summary: Requires the Governor and legislative leaders to publish board membership lists, vacancies, and aggregate demographic data of appointments online.

title: Ports: truck drivers.
summary: Requires trucking companies and port truck drivers to report classification and tax withholding information to the Long Beach and Los Angeles ports, which would be made public.

title: Firearms: firearm barrels.
summary: Requires firearm barrel sales and transfers to occur in person through licensed dealers, with eligibility checks and misdemeanor penalties.

title: Small businesses: certification.
summary: Declares legislative intent to enact a small business certification process that streamlines steps to open and operate a business.

title: Consumer debt: charged-off debts.
summary: Prohibits selling or suing over charged-off consumer debts after one year, and requires creditors to notify consumers of debt sales.

title: Open meetings: meeting and teleconference requirements.
summary: Requires local legislative bodies to offer remote public attendance, adopt disruption policies, and meet expanded agenda and compensation-report requirements through 2030.

title: Public Utilities Commission: quorum for the transaction of business.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to the Public Utilities Commission's quorum provision, with no change to its substance.

title: Self-service storage facilities: rental agreement disclosures.
summary: Requires self-storage rental agreements to disclose whether fees are promotional or subject to change, and the maximum first-year rent.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: exemptions: transit projects.
summary: Extends and expands California Environmental Quality Act exemptions for transit service changes, bus and rail projects, and active transportation plans.

title: Property taxation: active solar energy systems.
summary: Makes a technical change so the solar energy system property tax exclusion becomes inoperative on January 1, 2027, rather than being repealed on that date.

title: Taxation: federal conformity.
summary: Updates California's federal tax conformity date to 2025, adopting many later federal income tax changes for personal and corporate taxes.

title: Smog check: motor vehicles: exemption.
summary: Exempts historical collector vehicles manufactured before 1981 from smog checks, expanding the exemption by one model year annually from 2028.

title: Employee stock ownership plans: contractors: certification: bid preferences.
summary: Creates an ESOP contractor certificate and gives certified employee-owned contractors bid preferences on state-funded construction contracts starting 2027.

title: Zero-emission vehicles: workforce development: Clean Energy Workforce Training Council.
summary: States legislative intent to later establish a zero-emission vehicle workforce pilot and a Clean Energy Workforce Training Council.

title: Elections.
summary: Moves candidate notification and certification deadlines earlier and requires candidates to certify ballot designation worksheets under penalty of perjury.

title: Local government: ordinances: penalties for violation: nonresidential structures.
summary: Lets counties set fines and imprisonment for ordinance violations and sets higher fine caps for threatening violations at large nonresidential structures.

title: Ken Maddy California Cancer Registry.
summary: Requires the state to maintain its cancer registry system, delete outdated deadlines, and submit a funding schedule by 2027.

title: Hunting and sport fishing licenses: reduced fees.
summary: Requires reduced-fee hunting and sport fishing licenses for eligible state residents through 2032, with a 2029 report evaluating the program.

title: Access to connected vehicle service.
summary: Requires vehicles with connected location access to show occupants when outsiders are tracking, and sets compliance dates by model year.

title: The California Water Plan: long-term supply targets.
summary: Revises the California Water Plan update process, expands its advisory committee, sets a 2050 interim water supply target, and adds cost and reporting requirements.

title: Automated traffic enforcement system programs.
summary: Allows cities and counties to use automated cameras to enforce red-light violations, with escalating penalties, hearings, appeals, and a $25 appeal fee.

title: Pupil attendance: excused absences: career technical education.
summary: Adds career technical education enhancement as a required excused absence for middle and high school pupils, capped at one full-day absence per year plus discretionary extras.

title: Transit-oriented housing development: excluded parcels and sites.
summary: Bars transit-oriented housing development by right on sites governed by mobilehome, recreational vehicle, and special occupancy park laws.

title: Property taxation: exemption: low-value properties.
summary: Raises the low-value property tax exemption ceiling from $10,000 to $20,000 for 2026-2030 and bars state reimbursement of local revenue lost.

title: Public housing: lead testing.
summary: Requires public housing owners to inform residents about existing free water lead testing programs, with any resulting local mandated costs reimbursable by the state.

title: Recycling: organic byproducts.
summary: Expresses legislative intent to enact future legislation promoting recycling of organic byproducts into livestock feed.

title: Public resources: state parks: Outdoor Equity Grants Program: applicants.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive wording change to the Outdoor Equity Grants Program's evaluation provision for state parks outdoor education.

title: The Great Redwood Trail Agency.
summary: Makes the Great Redwood Trail Agency a state subdivision, exempts it from local building and zoning rules, and lets it receive state funds and contract for enforcement.

title: California Consumer Financial Protection Law: commercial financing.
summary: Requires registration for commercial financing providers and brokers, imposes duties on them, and bans confessions of judgment before default to protect small businesses.

title: State of emergency: nonprofit liaison.
summary: Requires certain state agencies to designate a nonprofit liaison to coordinate resources and grant access during emergencies.

title: Elections.
summary: Bars peace officers from interfering with elections, restricts police access to voter rolls and ballots, and expands election crimes and civil enforcement.

title: Product safety: consumer products: perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Bans selling certain consumer products, such as cookware and carpets, that contain intentionally added PFAS, starting 2027, enforced by DTSC.

title: Trash receptacles and storage containers: reflective markings.
summary: Revises reflective marking rules for roadside trash containers, extending an exemption to older units and specifying tape color and material for truck-transported containers.

title: Emergency backup generators: critical facilities: exemptions.
summary: Lets critical facilities exceed emergency backup generator runtime and testing limits under certain air district rules, if conditions are met.

title: Sexual assault forensic evidence: testing.
summary: Lets adult sexual assault survivors undecided about reporting defer testing of their collected medical evidence, requiring agencies to retain kits until requested.

title: Criminal procedure: discrimination.
summary: Bars discipline, promotion denials, or certification revocation of officers based on Racial Justice Act court findings, and requires serving related motions on employing agencies.

title: Validations.
summary: Enacts the First Validating Act of 2025 to validate the organization, boundaries, acts, and bonds of state, local, and district entities, effective immediately.

title: Validations.
summary: Enacts the Second Validating Act of 2025 to validate past organization, boundaries, acts, and bonds of state, local, and district entities, effective immediately.

title: Validations.
summary: Enacts the Third Validating Act of 2025, validating organization, boundaries, acts, proceedings and bonds of state, counties, cities and districts.

title: The Reclaim Act.
summary: Removes the requirement that a domestic violence restraining order be still in effect before a person can be declared a vexatious litigant.

title: Transportation network companies: California Clean Miles Standard and Incentive Program.
summary: Updates rideshare emissions reduction targets from 2029, bars penalties for pre-2029 targets, and requires zero-emission passenger-mile targets for 2027-2028.

title: Office of Land Use and Climate Innovation: Infrastructure Gap-Fund Program.
summary: Creates a state grant program, subject to appropriation, covering up to 20% of unforeseen cost overruns for local infrastructure projects starting construction.

title: Municipal wastewater agency: new agreement or amendment.
summary: Extends from 30 to 40 days the deadline for municipal wastewater agencies to file stormwater agreements with local LAFCos.

title: Low Carbon Transit Operations Program.
summary: Revises the Low Carbon Transit Operations Program so its funds go only to transit service maintenance or expansion, fare subsidies, and fare integration technology.

title: Electricity: electrical infrastructure: permanently abandoned transmission facilities: emergency response: liaisons.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Requires utilities to remove permanently abandoned transmission lines by 2028, add wildfire plan accounting, and assign emergency coordination liaisons.

title: Education finance: Education Equalization Act: Equalization Reserve Account.
summary: Creates an Equalization Reserve Account funded by transfers tied to Prop 98 increases, with interest boosting per-pupil funding in non-basic aid districts if voters approve a constitutional amendment.

title: Accrediting agencies.
summary: Keeps accreditors recognized by the U.S. Education Department as of January 2025 recognized for state law purposes until July 2029, then repeals the provision.

title: American government and civics: curriculum guide: State Seal of Civic Engagement.
summary: Funds a curriculum guide for a one-year civics course, which can satisfy State Seal of Civic Engagement criteria.

title: Water: Urban Water Community Drought Relief program: Small Community Drought Relief program: high fire hazard and very high fire hazard severity zones.
summary: Creates state drought relief grant programs for urban and small communities, extending funding to wildfire-risk water system projects in high-hazard zones, subject to appropriation.

title: Civil rights: deprivation of federal constitutional rights, privileges, and immunities.
summary: Creates a state civil cause of action against persons who violate federal constitutional rights under color of law, with attorney's fees, limited immunity defenses, and retroactive application.

title: Encampment Resolution Funding program: safe parking sites: reporting.
summary: Adds safe parking reporting to encampment grant applications and moves encampment program reporting into the department's annual housing report.

title: Mobilehome parks: closure, cessation, or change of use.
summary: Requires mobilehome park management to give tenants and public entities 12 and 6 months' notice before closure or change of use, and bars rent during wildfire displacement.

title: Employment: Preapprenticeship Pathways to Employment Pilot Program.
summary: Creates a pilot program giving incarcerated people preapprenticeship training in construction and building trades at one men's and one women's facility.

title: California Housing Finance Agency: credit enhancement mechanisms study.
summary: Requires the California Housing Finance Agency to assess credit enhancement mechanisms to lower borrowing costs for state-assisted housing, with interim and final reports due 2028.

title: Veterans and Former First Responders Research Pilot Program.
summary: Requests UC to run up to five psilocybin pilot programs for veterans and former first responders, funded through a new special fund.

title: Sales and use taxes: exemptions: California Hybrid and Zero-Emission Truck and Bus Voucher Incentive Project: transit buses.
summary: Extends the sales and use tax exemption for zero-emission transit buses bought by specified public agencies through January 1, 2028.

title: Special business regulations: shopping carts.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Lets cities retrieve abandoned shopping carts by ordinance, recover costs up to $100 per cart, and raises the owner fine cap to $100.

title: Menstrual products: disposable tampons and pad products: concerning chemicals.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Requires tampon and pad manufacturers to track and disclose chemical concentrations, pay for department testing, and lets the department publish results.

title: California Contractor Climate Transparency Act.
summary: Requires large and significant contractors to annually report greenhouse gas emissions and, for large contractors, climate-related financial risk.

title: California Film Commission: motion picture tax credits: tracking and compliance program.
summary: Requires the California Film Commission to collect additional data on film tax credit recipients and publish annual compliance reports, subject to appropriation.

title: Local government: nuisance abatement.
summary: Lets cities and counties collect nuisance fines through liens or assessments until 2035, with hardship waivers and a 60-day cure period.

title: Public health: nitrous oxide.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Prohibits retailers from selling nitrous oxide in any retail location, with exceptions, and lets cities and counties impose stricter local restrictions.

title: Crimes: supervised release.
summary: Expands state and county information-sharing on released inmates and requires petitions to revoke supervision after a third violation involving a new offense.

title: Vehicles: registration fees and penalties.
summary: Requires DMV to waive pre-purchase delinquent vehicle registration fees and penalties for buyers, and collect them from sellers starting 2030.

title: Behested payments: public appeal for payment.
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Exempts officials from reporting behested payments when they make a public appeal for payment, absent certain organizational ties.

title: CalFresh: student eligibility.
summary: Makes students in public college campus-based programs eligible for CalFresh by deeming those programs qualifying employment and training programs.

title: Transactions and use taxes: various jurisdictions.
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Authorizes various cities and counties to levy transactions and use taxes at specified rates through 2030 or 2031, above the usual 2% combined cap.

title: Conspiracy against trade: punishment.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice
summary: Raises Cartwright Act criminal fines for corporations and individuals and adds a $1,000,000 civil penalty for violations.

title: Chain restaurants: children’s meals.
summary: Requires chain restaurants selling children's meals to offer at least one meal meeting nutrition standards and label it with an icon.

title: State snake.
summary: Designates the giant garter snake as California's official state snake.

title: California Combating Auto Retail Scams (CARS) Act.
summary: Creates the CARS Act regulating auto dealers' pricing disclosures, add-on charges, and misrepresentations, and replaces used-car cancellation options with a 3-day right to cancel.

title: Energy: transportation fuels: supply: reportable pipelines.
summary: Requires pipeline operators of reportable pipelines to submit monthly operating data to the state energy commission, with confidentiality and penalty provisions extended.

title: Courts: data reporting.
summary: Requires courts to report monthly unlawful detainer data by ZIP Code to the Judicial Council, which must publish it online and report to the Legislature.

title: The Golden State Infrastructure Corporation Act.
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget; Transportation
summary: Creates the Golden State Infrastructure Corporation within the State Treasurer's Office to finance infrastructure projects through revenue bonds and loans.

title: State vehicle fleet: light-duty vehicles: raw materials: child labor.
summary: Requires suppliers of state fleet light-duty vehicles to certify raw materials are free of child labor and disclose mining locations and wages.

title: Common interest developments: EV charging stations.
summary: Removes the requirement that EV charger owners in common interest developments name the association as an additional insured, and fixes a cross-reference.

title: Personal rights: liability: social media platforms.
summary: Makes social media platforms liable for civil penalties when their algorithms or conduct violate state personal-rights and hate-violence laws, operative 2027.

title: Infill Infrastructure Grant Program of 2019: applications: eligibility.
summary: Expands eligibility and ranking criteria for state infill infrastructure grants to cover previously developed adjacent parcels, transit access, and walkability.

title: Board of Registered Nursing: advisory committees.
summary: Removes the requirement that the Board of Registered Nursing get the director's permission to form advisory committees.

title: Department of Real Estate and the Bureau of Real Estate Appraisers: Bureau of Automotive Repair.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Extends sunset dates for the Bureau of Automotive Repair and real estate regulators, and adds military licensing inquiries and reporting for real estate applicants.

title: Board of Psychology and Board of Behavioral Sciences.
summary: Extends the Board of Psychology to 2030, tightens out-of-state practice conditions, and changes registration, testing technician, and license suspension rules.

title: Optometry.
summary: Extends the Board of Optometry to 2030, raises its reserve cap and licensing fees, and shrinks the dispensing optician committee from five members to three.

title: Abandoned cemeteries: report.
summary: Moves up the deadline for a Cemetery and Funeral Bureau workgroup on abandoned cemetery care, adds county maintenance topics, and shortens the report deadline and sunset.

title: Migrant childcare and development programs.
summary: Lowers the migrant agricultural worker income threshold for child care eligibility from 50% to 40% and aligns income self-certification.

title: Contractors: civil penalties.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Labor and employment
summary: Raises minimum civil penalties for contractor licensing violations, lets the board adjust them for inflation, and doubles the board's reserve fund cap.

title: Department of Transportation: report: state highway system: safety enhancements.
summary: Requires the Department of Transportation to report to the Legislature by January 1, 2027, on streamlining safety enhancement project delivery on state highways.

title: Cyberbullying Protection Act: liability.
summary: Raises the per-violation liability for social media platforms that fail to address cyberbullying reporting duties from $10,000 to $50,000.

title: Small business.
summary: Authorizes local agencies to create small business procurement programs with a 25% participation goal and requires state data collection and reporting on them.

title: Enhanced infrastructure financing district: climate resilience districts.
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Lets cities and counties create climate resilience districts financed by property tax increments, limits revenue to disaster repair, mitigation and recovery, and takes effect immediately.

title: Outdoor advertising displays: redevelopment agency project areas.
summary: Extends by three years, to January 1, 2029, the period in which certain off-premises billboards in former redevelopment project areas may remain.

title: Home improvement loans: right to cancel contracts.
summary: Regulates home improvement loans with new lender duties and extends home improvement contract cancellation periods to 5 and 7 days.

title: Personal income tax: credit: durable medical equipment.
summary: Creates a 2026-2030 income tax credit for 50% of unreimbursed durable medical equipment costs for qualifying dependents, capped at $5,000 per dependent.

title: Planning and zoning: general plan: judicial challenges.
summary: Limits court continuances in general plan challenges to 60 days, requires temporary relief whenever a continuance is ordered, and applies the process to charter cities.

title: Energy: equitable clean energy supply chains and industrial policy in California.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Creates a Senior Counselor position, an interagency memorandum of understanding, an annual report, and a fund on clean energy supply chains and industrial policy.

title: Tax preparers: exemptions.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Labor and employment
summary: Exempts licensed accountants and their firms from the Tax Preparation Act's tax preparer registration and disclosure requirements, for returns from 2025 on.

title: Taxation: information returns: vacant commercial real property.
summary: Requires commercial property owners to register and file annual vacancy information returns, with penalties and public ZIP Code data posting, sunsetting in 2031.

title: Housing development: transit-oriented development.
summary: Requires transit-oriented housing of at least five units be allowed near TOD stops on residential, mixed, and commercial sites, overriding local zoning limits.

title: Postsecondary education: interstate reciprocity agreements for distance education: out-of-state postsecondary educational institutions.
summary: Authorizes the Governor to join interstate distance-education reciprocity agreements and subjects certain institutions to the private postsecondary act unless approved under them.

title: Vehicle dealers: document processing charge.
summary: Allows vehicle dealers to charge document processing fees above current caps, up to 1% of vehicle price or $260, through 2031.

title: Childcare.
summary: Raises CalWORKs Stage 3 childcare income eligibility to 85% of state median income, extends family fee exemptions to 24 months, and expands reimbursable absences.

title: Public safety: lighters: standards: prohibition.
summary: Bans selling or distributing lighters, lighting rods, or gas matches that fail specified ASTM safety standards or infringe certain intellectual property rights.

title: Juveniles: access and use of juvenile case files.
summary: Expands who may access juvenile case files and child welfare records, adds use limits and sealing rules, and sets a hearing deadline for privileged records.

title: Air pollution: gasoline vapor control systems: ethanol blends.
summary: Allows gasoline vapor control equipment certified for E10 to also be used with E15 blends until 2029, if the manufacturer submits a compatibility statement.

title: Emergency medical services: state-employed public safety personnel: optional first aid skills.
summary: Makes the state EMS Authority, rather than local medical directors, authorize optional first aid and CPR skills for state-employed public safety personnel.

title: Electric utility distribution and transmission system facilities: undergrounding and insulation.
summary: Temporarily exempts electric utility undergrounding and insulation projects from CEQA outside environmentally sensitive areas, and directs the PUC to study and plan.

title: Veterans.
summary: Raises the cap on county-funded burial or cremation assistance for indigent veterans from $350 to $1,000.

title: Joint powers authorities: South Bay Regional Housing Trust.
summary: Expands South Bay housing trust's authority to fund preservation and moderate-income housing, and changes its governance and conflict rules.

title: Peace officers: injury or illness: leaves of absence.
summary: Extends paid injury or illness leave without loss of salary to specified full-time peace officers employed by counties of the eighth class.

title: Energy: Fusion Research and Development Innovation Initiative.
summary: Creates a Fusion Research and Development Innovation Initiative at the Energy Commission offering financial incentives for fusion projects, contingent on appropriation, repealed 2028.

title: State bridges and overpasses: suicide prevention.
summary: Requires the Department of Transportation to add suicide deterrent considerations to updated bridge and overpass guidance by July 2028.

title: Agricultural workers: wages, hours, and working conditions: definitions.
topics: Environment and energy; Labor and employment
summary: Exempts sheepherders and goat herders from the agricultural overtime act's definition and states legislative intent on considering climate cost burdens.

title: Housing finance and development: Sacramento Regional Housing and Homelessness Joint Powers Authority Act.
summary: Requires Sacramento County and five cities to form a regional joint powers authority overseeing homelessness and housing services by 2028.

title: California Conservation Corps: Green Collar Certification Program.
summary: Creates a Green Collar Certification Program for Conservation Corps members, with a dedicated fund for grants and donations.

title: Hydrogen Pipeline Safety Act.
summary: Creates a State Fire Marshal safety regulatory program for hydrogen pipelines, with operator fees and new penalties for violations.

title: Crimes.
summary: Requires non-uniformed officers to display identification, mandates agency ID policies, and expands impersonation crimes and bail-recovery limits.

title: Department of Consumer Affairs.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive change to provisions governing the Department of Consumer Affairs and its licensing boards.

title: California Community Colleges: board of governors.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive, technical changes to statutes governing the California Community Colleges and their Board of Governors.

title: Civil Actions: writs: housing development projects.
summary: Creates expedited court review of local denials of housing development permits, with fast record certification and hearing deadlines for local agencies.

title: Employees and independent contractors: construction trucking.
summary: Declares vehicle ownership alone doesn't make drivers independent contractors and creates a penalty-relief amnesty program for construction trucking misclassification.

title: Health and care facilities: information sharing.
topics: AI and technology; Health care; Immigration
summary: Bars health providers and insurers from sharing patient medical information, including immigration status, for immigration enforcement, and adds facility visitor and access procedures.

title: Electricity: ratepayer-funded programs: reports.
summary: Requires the Energy Commission and PUC to report to the Legislature by July 2025 on ratepayer-funded programs that may unduly raise electricity rates.

title: Hazardous materials: metal shredding facilities.
summary: Creates a DTSC permit and regulatory scheme for metal shredding facilities, with inspections, closure plans, and criminal penalties for certified reports.

title: Qualified youth drop-in center health care coverage.
summary: Extends existing youth mental health and substance use coverage requirements to services delivered at qualified youth drop-in centers, including Medi-Cal.

title: Independent verification organizations.
summary: Creates a state process to designate and regulate independent verification organizations that assess AI system risks, with annual reporting and working groups.

title: Homelessness.
summary: Requires the state homelessness council to evaluate its prevention goals yearly instead of every two years.

title: Planning and zoning: very high fire hazard areas.
summary: Requires local general plans in wildfire-prone areas to add retrofit strategies and wildfire-focused land use elements, with periodic reviews and state clearinghouse submission.

title: Property taxation: exemptions: Chiquita Canyon elevated temperature landfill event.
summary: Exempts property affected by the Chiquita Canyon landfill event from property tax through 2030, and exempts microbusinesses from minimum franchise and LLC taxes.

title: Political Reform Act of 1974.
summary: Declares legislative intent to enact future legislation relating to the Political Reform Act of 1974; makes no substantive changes.

title: Mountain Lions: human-mountain lion conflicts program: scientific research: County of El Dorado.
summary: Creates a 5-year El Dorado County pilot allowing permitted private houndspersons to haze mountain lions, plus expanded conflict programs, grants, and research.

title: Geothermal waste: exemption from generation and handling fees: study.
summary: Requires DTSC to study the issues of exempting non-exempt geothermal waste from generation and handling fees, due by July 1, 2026.

title: Contracts: consumer goods and services: dispute resolution provisions.
summary: Limits dispute resolution terms in consumer use agreements to the good, service, or payment involved, and voids waivers of these protections.

title: Inmates: mental health.
summary: Allows involuntary antipsychotic medication for incompetent misdemeanor defendants in emergencies and by court order, with 60-day reviews.

title: Criminal procedure: arraignment.
summary: Requires courts to review warrantless arrests and juvenile custody within 48 hours for probable cause, and expands probation review of juvenile detention.

title: Unclaimed property: digital financial assets.
summary: Clarifies that digital financial assets are subject to unclaimed property escheat and sets notice, transfer, custody, and claim procedures for them.

title: Mental health: the CARE Act.
summary: Adds bipolar I disorder to CARE Act eligibility criteria for court-ordered behavioral health services, with state reimbursement for resulting local costs.

title: Secure youth treatment facilities.
summary: Requires secure youth treatment facility wards' rehabilitation plans to prepare for transfer to less restrictive programs, with court hearings and mandatory transfer when criteria are met.

title: Consumers: financial protection.
summary: Clarifies that licensees exempt from California's consumer financial law remain subject to the commissioner's enforcement of deceptive and abusive practice prohibitions.

title: California Workforce Development Board: port automation.
summary: Reinstates and extends a port automation stakeholder process and industry panel through 2029, with recommendations due by 2027, contingent on appropriation.

title: Local agency officials: training.
summary: Expands ethics training for local officials, adds fiscal training, requires posted training records, and applies to charter cities.

title: Fireworks licenses and permits: disqualifying conditions: local jurisdictions.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice
summary: Tightens fireworks licensing by requiring storage-address disclosure and notice, adds a $10,000 minimum fine, and expands the dangerous-fireworks possession offense.

title: California Institute for Scientific Research: CalRx Initiative: vaccines.
summary: Creates the California Institute for Scientific Research and requires CalRx to pursue vaccine development, production and distribution partnerships, subject to appropriation.

title: State Department of Health Care Services: substance abuse treatment: disclosures.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Requires DHCS to post online summaries of violations by substance use treatment facilities and programs, and flag that recovery residence notices are excluded.

title: Public Transit Revenue Measure District: revenue measure: election procedures.
summary: Revises November 2026 election procedures for a Bay Area transit tax measure, including its ballot designation and voter guide arguments.

title: Geologic hazards: California Geological Survey.
summary: Expands California Geological Survey duties to cover climate-related geologic hazards and makes related changes to maps, publications, and reporting.

title: Upper Los Angeles River and Tributaries Working Group: membership: revitalization plan.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Adds a member to the Upper LA River working group, requires annual meetings, and has it propose plan amendments to the Santa Monica Mountains Conservancy.

title: Critical infrastructure: artificial intelligence systems: human oversight.
summary: Requires state agencies running critical infrastructure AI to add human oversight, and requires AI adverse event reporting with civil penalties.

title: Criminal records: relief.
summary: Expands automatic conviction record relief by treating records with three years of inactivity as having no pending charges, and requires court notes and certificates.

title: Pupil instruction: Cambridge International Education programs.
summary: Adds Cambridge International exams to principal evaluation measures, expands counseling to promote Cambridge programs, and lets districts help pay pupils' test fees.

title: Electricity: transmission planning and permitting.
summary: Shortens the required review cycle for the PUC, Energy Commission and ISO transmission planning memorandum from every 5 years to every 3 years.

title: Disaster and emergency preparedness.
summary: Requires aging and disability resource programs to provide disaster preparedness education for older adults and people with disabilities.

title: Housing Accountability Act: housing development projects.
summary: Excludes hotel, motel, and other transient lodging from mixed-use projects that qualify as protected housing development projects under the Housing Accountability Act.

title: Oil spills: fishing: water closure: grants: liability.
summary: Makes fishing closures after oil spills discretionary unless a public health threat exists, and creates a new crime for taking fish from closed waters.

title: Disability access: construction-related accessibility claims: notice of violation and opportunity to correct.
summary: Requires a notice and 120-day cure period before small-business construction accessibility damage claims, and bars evading those rules via ADA claims.

title: Greenhouse gases: Greenhouse Gas Reduction Fund: studies.
topics: Environment and energy; Taxes and budget
summary: Restructures Greenhouse Gas Reduction Fund spending, requires offset studies, and updates offset protocols to reflect best available science.

title: Immigration enforcement.
summary: Bars shelters, rape crisis centers, domestic violence shelters, and similar providers from allowing immigration enforcement access to nonpublic areas without specified criteria, including a judicial warrant.

title: Energy: firm zero-carbon resources.
summary: Requires the Public Utilities Commission to report by 2026 on opportunities and barriers for firm zero-carbon electricity resources.

title: Vehicles: school pupil transportation: advisory committee.
summary: Expands the state school pupil transportation advisory committee from 11 to 13 members by adding two members from low-income communities.

title: Horse racing: out-of-state thoroughbred races.
summary: Raises the daily cap on imported out-of-state thoroughbred races that can be simulcast and wagered on from 75 to 80.

title: Pupil instruction: career technical education, career education, work-based learning, work experience education, and apprenticeships.
summary: Extends work-based learning, work experience and student enterprise authorizations to county offices, charter schools and state special schools, and adds related credit and program changes.

title: Liens: harvested crops.
summary: Removes the limited-partnership ownership condition, so wage liens on harvested crops would apply to more growers.

title: Workers’ compensation: uninsured employer: transfer of real property.
summary: Lets the workers' comp director treat certain property transfers by uninsured employers as trusts subject to liens.

title: Pupil safety: school employee misconduct: child abuse prevention.
summary: Requires school safety plans to address child abuse and sex offenses and expands sex offense definitions for school employee rules.

title: Physicians and surgeons: sexual misconduct and offenses: reinstatement of surrendered certificate.
summary: Bars the Medical Board from reinstating physician certificates surrendered during pending sexual misconduct accusations.

title: Civil actions: service of summons.
summary: Allows courts to authorize alternative service of civil summons, including electronic service, when statutory methods fail after reasonable diligence.

title: Prisons.
summary: Requires pension forfeiture for prison staff convicted of sexually assaulting inmates, and orders new women's prison housing, cameras and staffing changes.

title: Elections.
summary: Makes election certification duties ministerial, adds Secretary of State notice and intervention, and extends polling-place armed-officer penalties to federal officers.

title: Political Reform Act of 1974: Citizens Redistricting Commission.
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Expands Political Reform Act ethics filing to public investment officials and broadens contribution delivery bans to local government offices.

title: Public employees’ retirement.
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Clarifies the teachers' retirement board's authority over employer and membership definitions, revises part-time workload termination, and adjusts appropriation transfer timing for weekends and holidays.

title: Unemployment insurance.
summary: Defines "mail" and related terms in the Unemployment Insurance Code to include electronic transmission of writings.

title: Sale of armories.
summary: Authorizes the state to transfer, exchange, or sell specified National Guard armories, subject to existing legislative approval and Armory Fund rules.

title: California Coastal Act of 1976: filing fee waiver: Marine Invasive Species Act: biennial reports: semiannual updates.
summary: Authorizes Coastal Commission fee waivers for permit amendments and shifts invasive-species ballast reporting to triennial, with semiannual public website updates.

title: Public safety omnibus.
summary: Omnibus public safety bill making technical renames, changing a board quorum, clarifying juvenile ward supervision, and removing driver's license holds from fine collection.

title: Local Government Omnibus Act of 2025.
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Omnibus local government bill allowing electronic signatures for county documents, reproduced-record authentication, and a registrar of voters appointment in Kern and Nevada counties.

title: California State Lottery: prize money: immediate payment.
summary: Raises the amount the California State Lottery may pay winners immediately from its revolving fund, from $1,000 to $100,000.

title: California Alternative Energy and Advanced Transportation Financing Authority Act: sales and use tax exclusion.
topics: Environment and energy; Taxes and budget
summary: Extends the sales and use tax exclusion for authority-approved projects to 2028 and adds nuclear fusion power generation facilities as qualifying projects.

title: Gaming: bingo.
summary: Repeals obsolete remote caller bingo provisions and removes state inspection, approval, and use prohibitions for card-minding devices.

title: Consumer affairs.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Omnibus consumer affairs bill making technical licensing changes, adding chiropractic fingerprinting, and lowering dental hygiene fee caps.

title: Health.
summary: Renames the mental health oversight commission, lengthens patient safety plan reporting to biennial, and adds dementia content to nurse assistant training.

title: Taxation.
summary: Clarifies property tax remittance deadlines and redemption pricing, sets local sales tax operative dates, and addresses motion picture credit assignment.

title: Tribal gaming: compact ratification.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Environment and energy
summary: Ratifies three tribal-state gaming compacts and amendments, and exempts related actions from CEQA review.

title: California Music Festival Preservation Grant Program.
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Creates a $20 million grant program within the Small Business Advocate's office to help independent live music promoters preserve large music festivals, subject to appropriation.

title: Planning and zoning: annual report: emergency shelter.
summary: Requires local housing reports and housing element assessments to include data on emergency shelter needs, unhoused populations, and homelessness funding and outreach.

title: Toys: companion chatbots.
topics: AI and technology; Children and families
summary: Temporarily bans manufacture and sale of toys that include companion chatbots until 2031, with civil liability for violations.

title: Electricity: portable solar generation devices.
summary: Temporarily exempts plug-in portable solar devices from interconnection rules and bars utilities from fees, and bans sales of noncompliant devices from 2030.

title: Restaurant menus: added sugar warnings.
summary: Requires chain restaurants to display added sugar warning icons next to high-sugar beverages on menus, drive-through menus, and digital menus by 2029.

title: Sales and Use Tax Law: consumer designation: all-volunteer fire departments.
summary: Extends the sales tax exemption for all-volunteer fire departments from 2026 to 2031 and bars state reimbursement of local revenue losses.

title: Fuel-burning portable devices.
summary: Bans selling or distributing fuel-burning portable devices made after 2027 that lack a specified ASTM child-resistance safety standard.

title: Domestic Violence Prevention Act.
summary: Establishes a continuous electronic monitoring system and requires courts to order GPS monitoring for people accused of certain domestic violence, including strangulation, with costs charged to the accused.

title: Delta Levees and Canal Subsidence Fund.
summary: Creates a Delta Levees and Canal Subsidence Fund and raises levee reimbursement to 100% for hardship-affected local agencies on threat projects.

title: Courthouses: privilege from civil arrest.
summary: Bars civil arrests of people traveling to, present at, or leaving courthouses for lawful activity, creates damages liability, and requires court security to vet law enforcement entries and warrants.

title: Medi-Cal: behavioral health treatment: stakeholder feedback.
summary: Requires Medi-Cal behavioral health treatment providers to undergo criminal background checks, mandates stakeholder input on BHT billing and coverage, and requires public utilization reporting.

title: Public utilities: eminent domain: just compensation.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Eases public takeover of PG&E electric and gas property by removing presumptions and limiting PUC review to employee fairness.

title: Fire and residential property insurance.
summary: Requires insurers to offer at least 50% extended replacement cost coverage and expands cost estimates and additional living expense coverage for fire and residential policies.

title: Residential property insurance: loss estimate transparency.
summary: Expands insurers' required disclosure of claim documents to include preliminary and final valuation and loss calculations for residential property claims.

title: Insurance business practices.
summary: Requires insurers to pay total-loss residential property claims within 30 days, with interest on late payments, and codifies claim-handling deadlines.

title: Budget Act of 2026.
summary: Makes general appropriations to support state government for fiscal year 2026-27 and takes effect immediately as a Budget Bill.

title: Air resources: carbon emissions: biomass.
summary: Requires CARB to publish biomass life-cycle emissions and biochar strategy reports, and forest health projects to include a biomass disposal component.

title: Residential property: transfers: institutional investors.
summary: Requires institutional investors to give tenants 90 days' notice before selling, limits early offers to owner-occupants, and adds enforcement and penalties, contingent on federal law.

title: Income taxation: credits: voluntary contributions: food bank donations.
summary: Extends the food bank donation tax credit to 2032 and the Emergency Food for Families voluntary contribution fund to 2033.

title: Remote court appearances.
summary: Extends California's temporary authority for remote court appearances to January 31, 2029, and lets non-party witnesses appear remotely.

title: Hazardous materials: reactive chemicals: methyl methacrylate: facilities.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration; Housing
summary: Bars cities and counties from permitting new reactive chemical storage facilities without backup cooling or adequate separation from homes, and removes a CEQA exemption for them.

title: Elections in 2026 through 2029.
summary: Requires ballot dropoff sites open 30 days before elections, bars arrests near polls on election day, and expands electioneering buffers.

title: Restoring Accountability Act: major regulations.
summary: Bars state agencies from adopting major regulations until the Legislature expressly authorizes them, with limited emergency exceptions.

title: California Technology Innovation and Ratepayer Protection Act.
topics: AI and technology; Environment and energy
summary: Requires the PUC to set tariffs for data center interconnection and service by 2028, protecting nonparticipating ratepayers from stranded costs and cost shifts.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: environmental leadership development projects: data centers: geothermal powerplant projects.
topics: AI and technology; Environment and energy
summary: Bars CEQA categorical exemptions for data centers while letting the Governor certify data center and geothermal projects for CEQA streamlining.

title: Property taxation: disabled veterans’ exemption: household income.
summary: Excludes service-connected disability payments from household income for the disabled veterans' property tax exemption through 2037, with no state reimbursement of lost local revenue.

title: Public social services.
summary: Makes technical, nonsubstantive changes to public social services provisions covering CalWORKs and aged, blind and disabled programs.

title: Glyphosate: prohibition on sale.
summary: Bans retail sale of glyphosate-containing products from 2028 except to licensed persons, with a $100 civil penalty per violation.

title: Public social services.
summary: Makes technical, nonsubstantive wording changes to the purpose statement for public social services.

title: Missing and Murdered Indigenous Persons Justice Program.
summary: Establishes a Missing and Murdered Indigenous Persons Justice Program in the Department of Justice to liaise on cases and report annually through 2033.

title: Public postsecondary education: priority registration: members and former members of the Armed Forces of the United States and State Guard.
summary: Removes the time limit on priority registration at public colleges for veterans and State Guard members who left active duty.

title: State parks: facilities pass: Gold Star Family members.
summary: Requires State Parks to issue free facility passes to eligible Gold Star Family members who present proof, covering all state park units.

title: Wildfire resiliency: financial assistance.
summary: Establishes a wildfire resilience loan program, subject to appropriation, to finance home hardening and defensible space projects.

title: California Science and Health Research Bond Act.
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Creates a California science and health research foundation, council, and bond-funded innovation funds to award research grants and loans.

title: State Capitol: 250th Anniversary of the United States.
summary: Authorizes a Sons of the American Revolution nonprofit to build and maintain a 250th anniversary monument at the State Capitol, privately funded and approved by Joint Rules.

title: Vehicles: abandoned vehicles.
summary: Allows the City of Laguna Woods to use abandoned vehicle abatement fee funds for enforcing vehicle code on public highways.

title: Connected consumer products.
topics: AI and technology; Consumer protection and business
summary: Requires connected product makers to disclose support timelines and end-of-life notices, and requires lessors to keep updates applied.

title: Fire prevention: Wildfire and Forest Resilience Task Force: wildfire smoke.
summary: Requires the Wildfire and Forest Resilience Task Force to assess wildfire smoke health costs by 2028 and include health actions in its action plan update.

title: Accessory Dwelling Units: ordinances.
summary: Invalidates local accessory dwelling unit ordinances if agencies fail to timely submit them to HCD or respond to compliance findings.

title: Safe Drinking Water, Wildfire Prevention, Drought Preparedness, and Clean Air Bond Act of 2024: grants: improvements to public evacuation routes: mobile rigid water storage: electrical generators.
summary: Adds evacuation routes, mobile water storage, and backup generators to eligible wildfire projects funded by the 2024 Proposition 4 bond.

title: Political Reform Act of 1974: top contributors: disclosures.
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Revises campaign ad disclosure rules for top contributors and shortens independent expenditure disclaimers, while adding formatting and ordering requirements.

title: California Poet Laureate.
summary: Makes nonsubstantive wording changes to the process for nominating and appointing the California Poet Laureate.

title: Early childhood education and childcare: electronic signatures.
summary: Allows electronic signatures and electronic records under childcare and early education programs, in compliance with the UETA.

title: Mental health professionals: artificial intelligence.
summary: Regulates AI use in psychotherapy, limiting it to administrative support and requiring consent, licensed review, and no companion-chatbot therapy claims.

title: Recovery from a state of emergency.
summary: Requires HCD to identify permitting and building code provisions that could be suspended to speed wildfire rebuilding, and mandates electronic submission of recovery applications.

title: Electricity.
summary: Requires utility regulators to consider reduced returns on equity for certain capital costs, study alternative financing, and publish grid utilization data.

title: Parole: closed session.
summary: Requires all parole commissioners to join en banc reviews with public votes, bars closed sessions for those reviews, and lets defendants extend probation to finish collaborative justice programs.

title: Driving under the influence and other driving offenses: comprehensive reform.
summary: Increases penalties for hit-and-run and related driving offenses, including felony enhancements for prior DUI, reckless driving, or manslaughter, and expands court advisements.

title: Residential windows: retrofitting: residential window replacement projects: California Building Code compliance.
summary: Voids HOA and deed restrictions on window replacement, requires administrative approval of projects, and bars local discretionary review or denial.

title: Public works.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Raises the public works contractor registration fee cap to $1,000, increases labor law penalties, and expands State Public Works Enforcement Fund uses.

title: All-mailed ballot elections: vote centers.
summary: Shortens the vote center window for all-mailed elections to 5 days before election and lets the Secretary of State summon tie-vote candidates to any of its offices.

title: Municipal water districts: water service: Indian lands.
summary: Extends until January 1, 2032, the authority for municipal water districts to apply to provide water service to Indian lands outside the district.

title: Transfer of real property: fire hazard severity zones: compliance documentation.
summary: Requires fire inspections for property transfers in fire hazard zones lacking compliance documentation and lets fire agencies recover inspection costs.

title: Comprehensive perinatal services.
summary: Shifts comprehensive perinatal services oversight to DHCS for Medi-Cal, has DHCS enroll providers, and requires materials and reports.

title: Resource adequacy: aggregated distributed energy resources.
summary: Directs the PUC to let aggregated distributed energy resources count toward resource adequacy, with conditions to prevent duplicate compensation.

title: School accountability: audits: annual review.
summary: Requires school boards to review annual audits within 45 days of issuance and accept or reject the audit report at a public meeting.

title: Health care provider entities: patients accompanied by immigration enforcement officers.
summary: Requires health care providers to document accompanying immigration officers, remove them from patient care discussions, and bars blackout policies for patients they accompany.

title: Civil actions: housing development projects.
summary: Extends existing bond requirements for challenges to housing projects so they also cover student housing developments.

title: Alcoholic beverages: certified farmers’ market sales permit.
summary: Lets farmers' market wine permittees sell wine from non-owned grapes, allows up to three instructional tastings, and requires RBS training for tasting servers.

title: Food facilities: retail food safety.
summary: Revises retail food passthrough window rules, changing self-closing and air curtain equipment requirements and limiting openings to food delivery use.

title: Biomethane monetary incentive program.
summary: Extends California's biomethane incentive program to 2030 and authorizes $50 million in additional funding from greenhouse gas allowance revenues.

title: Housing development: density bonuses.
summary: Limits density bonus concessions so they cannot yield commercial floor area ratios above a set level or require approval of transient lodging in housing projects.

title: The Gambling Control Act: regulatory fees.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Requires the gambling commission and DOJ to post public statements justifying the need, purpose and use of new or amended gambling fees.

title: Employment: employer contributions: employee withholdings: credit: agricultural employees.
topics: Labor and employment; Taxes and budget
summary: Creates an employer tax credit for overtime paid to certain agricultural workers and adjusts farm labor contractor payroll disclosures to reflect it.

title: Vehicles: local agency charges: use of streets or highways.
summary: Clarifies that local agencies may impose fees on public service providers or ratepayers to recover street maintenance and use costs, outside the Vehicle Code's charge prohibition.

title: Consumer privacy requests: deletion request records and request submission methods.
summary: Expands CCPA deletion rights to all personal information collected about consumers and requires online request methods for online-only businesses.

title: Low-income energy assistance.
summary: Requires utilities' low-income weatherization programs to prioritize whole-home health and efficiency upgrades, report affordability outcomes, and avoid undue ratepayer costs.

title: Fusion energy: State Energy Resources Conservation and Development Commission: strategic plan: certification and environmental review.
summary: Requires the energy commission to develop a fusion energy strategic plan and expands CEQA streamlining eligibility to fusion-related manufacturing projects.

title: Public safety: Funding of Proposition 36 Act.
summary: Creates a California Public Safety Services Support Fund to pay for implementing Proposition 36, with ongoing General Fund transfers starting in 2027-28.

title: Intercountry adoption finalized in a foreign country.
summary: Lets adoptees file their own readoption petitions when parents and agencies fail to, and allows court flexibility on missing documents.

title: California State University: faculty employees.
summary: Explicitly requires CSU faculty and instructors of record to meet the trustees' rule-based qualifications for their positions.

title: State Energy Resources Conservation and Development Commission: chair: report to the Legislature.
summary: Requires the energy commission's chair to report annually to legislative policy committees on the commission's activities and plans.

title: Weapons: robotic devices.
summary: Prohibits operating robotic devices equipped or mounted with a weapon, making violations an infraction with a $100 to $2,000 fine, with exemptions for government and research uses.

title: Student Test Taker Privacy Protection Act: end-to-end encryption.
summary: Requires proctoring services used for school classroom or course exams to use end-to-end encryption for student data starting July 2027.

title: Dolly Parton Day.
summary: Requires the Governor to annually proclaim September 25 as Dolly Parton Day, effective immediately as an urgency statute.

title: Civil proceedings: real party in interest.
summary: Requires an assignee to name the original assignor, the real party in interest, in the case title on its first filing.

title: California Financing Law: mortgage trigger lead information.
summary: Prohibits financial institutions from unfair or deceptive use of mortgage trigger lead information and creates enforcement and a private right of action.

title: Sexual orientation or gender identity change efforts.
summary: Extends the ban on minors' conversion therapy by licensed mental health providers to cover gender identity as well as sexual orientation.

title: Local agency design-build projects: authorization.
summary: Removes the 2031 sunset, indefinitely extending local agencies' authority to use design-build procurement for public works projects.

title: Nitrous oxide: sales.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice
summary: Prohibits sale of large or inhalable nitrous oxide containers, flavored nitrous oxide, and inhalation devices, with infraction penalties and tobacco-retailer license consequences.

title: Law enforcement: flash-bang grenades and explosive breaching charges.
summary: Restricts police use of flash-bang grenades in protests, bans flash-bangs and explosive breaching charges for immigration enforcement, and requires reporting.

title: Peace officers: training requirements.
