summary: Prevents federal immigration officer service alone from qualifying for a POST Regular Basic Course Waiver for peace officer training.

title: Public employees’ retirement: service credit: payments.
summary: Requires PERS service-credit balance payments within 90 days of retirement for elections from 2028, reducing credit or allowance if unpaid.

title: Transportation funding: Greenhouse Gas Reduction Fund: Motor Vehicle Fuel Account.
summary: Redirects 25% of Greenhouse Gas Reduction Fund proceeds from high-speed rail to the motor fuel account and cuts fuel tax rates correspondingly through 2030.

title: Geologic Energy Management Division: New Technology Program: oil and gas wells: geothermal wells.
summary: Creates a program letting operators repurpose oil, gas, or geothermal wells for renewable energy storage or generation, with approval and an annual charge.

title: Private detention facilities: canteens.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice
summary: Caps commissary markups at 35% above vendor cost at privately operated detention facilities.

title: Civil detainees.
summary: Grants detention rights to people held for civil immigration proceedings in California and lets the Attorney General sue and seek penalties of up to $2,500 per violation.

title: Public utilities: electricity: retail transmission rates: industrial transition usage.
summary: Requires PUC approval of electric utilities' retail transmission rates and lets the commission cap surcharges on new industrial heating loads to encourage electrification.

title: Medi-Cal: acupuncture.
summary: Makes acupuncture a covered Medi-Cal benefit, subject to utilization controls and federal funding availability or an appropriation.

title: School curriculum: physical education framework: cardiopulmonary resuscitation: automated external defibrillators.
summary: Directs the Instructional Quality Commission to consider adding CPR and AED content to the physical education framework at its next revision.

title: Consumer Credit Reporting Agencies Act: escrow agent rating services and escrow agents.
summary: Extends indefinitely the Consumer Credit Reporting Agencies Act provisions covering escrow agent rating services and escrow agents, which would otherwise sunset January 1, 2027.

title: Employment: automated decision systems.
topics: AI and technology; Labor and employment
summary: Prohibits employers from using automated decision systems for certain functions from 2027, limits other uses, and requires notice for discipline or termination decisions.

title: Firearms: safety certificates.
summary: Requires firearm safety certificates for gun importers and adds a 4-hour live-fire training course for certificate applicants starting 2029.

title: Environmental protection: Natural Resources Agency: resource of statewide significance: Santa Cruz Mountains.
summary: Designates the Santa Cruz Mountains as a resource of statewide significance and directs agencies to encourage collaborative stewardship, subject to resource availability.

title: Sellers of travel: travel consolidators: fraud.
summary: Extends seller-of-travel rules to travel consolidators, requires air carriers to refund defrauded ticket buyers, and makes unregistered sales voidable.

title: Health care coverage: dementia.
summary: Requires health plans and insurers to cover FDA-approved Alzheimer's and memory-condition treatments without step therapy, starting 2027.

title: Employment: technological displacement: notice.
summary: Requires WARN Act layoff notices to disclose AI- or automation-caused job displacements and affected job functions, and publishes related state summaries and a report.

title: State Water Project: renewable energy resources and zero-carbon resources.
summary: Lets the State Water Project bank excess clean-energy procurement toward later years and extends a deferral for an older fossil contract.

title: Driving record: points: vehicular manslaughter.
summary: Adds 2 driver's record violation points for misdemeanor vehicular manslaughter cases dismissed after completed diversion.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: advanced manufacturing facilities: exemption.
summary: Expands CEQA exemptions for family day care homes and advanced manufacturing, adds labor and community benefit conditions, and repeals an oil and gas rezoning exception.

title: Beverage containers: supermarkets: reverse vending machines.
summary: Revises beverage container recycling rules, including the supermarket definition, convenience zones, reverse vending machines, and handling fees, and extends handling fee regulations to 2032.

title: Vehicles: Electric Bicycle Special License Plate Pilot Program.
summary: Lets cities and counties regulate e-bikes locally and lets Orange County pilot a special license plate requirement through 2032.

title: Civil detention facilities.
summary: Requires the Attorney General to report to the Legislature by 2027 with a proposed oversight plan for private civil detention facilities.

title: California Environmental Quality Act: environmental impacts: building height.
summary: Bars building height alone from being treated as a significant environmental impact under CEQA for projects that meet specified conditions.

title: Average daily attendance: emergencies: major safety hazard.
summary: Lets local fire agencies, not just law enforcement, determine major safety hazards that preserve school attendance funding during emergencies.

title: Streaming services: commercial advertisements.
summary: Extends the ban on streaming services airing commercial ads louder than the content to user-generated, music, and podcast streaming services.

title: Public postsecondary education: community colleges: statewide baccalaureate degree program.
summary: Lets community colleges offer baccalaureate degrees in workforce-need areas from 2028, while barring programs already offered by UC or overlapping CSU campuses.

title: CalFresh: student eligibility.
summary: Automatically qualifies public college and adult education programs as CalFresh student-exemption employability programs, expanding student eligibility for food benefits.

title: Emergency vehicles: blue warning lights.
summary: Lets Corrections authorize parole officers to use blue warning lights on emergency vehicles, conditioned on completing a 4-hour certified training course.

title: California Coastal Act of 1976: coastal development permits: appeal: de novo review.
summary: Sets appeal filing rules for local coastal permit decisions and requires full de novo commission review when a substantial issue is found.

title: Prescription drug coverage: dose adjustments.
summary: Lets providers request dose or frequency drug adjustments without prior authorization, requiring plans to respond within 72 hours.

title: Public libraries: library cards.
topics: Children and families; Government and administration
summary: Bars public libraries from requiring parental presence to issue library cards to 16- and 17-year-old California residents starting 2028.

title: Refinery and chemical plants.
summary: Requires refinery and chemical plant employers to adopt written plans for employee participation, stop-work and hazard-reporting procedures, and documentation of shutdowns.

title: Planning and zoning: housing element: interim housing units: acutely low income households.
summary: Lets cities and counties count approved interim housing units toward up to half of their acutely low income housing need, and requires related state guidance.

title: Community colleges: San Mateo County Community College District.
summary: Removes the sunset date so San Mateo County Community College District can keep using local funds for student fee waivers and cost assistance indefinitely.

title: Weights and measures: electric vehicle fueling systems.
summary: Requires inspections and reporting for commercial EV fueling systems and exempts certified factory-tested systems from field placement-in-service rules.

title: Digital financial assets: stablecoins.
summary: Revises California's digital financial asset law by narrowing its scope, adding exclusions, and repealing stablecoin restrictions.

title: Military or overseas voters.
summary: Requires the Secretary of State to adopt regulations facilitating secure return of ballots from military and overseas voters.

title: Healthy Aging Community Partnership Program.
summary: Authorizes local agencies and partners to create a Healthy Aging Community Partnership Program promoting social engagement and independent living for older adults.

title: California Financing Law: commercial loans: investment advisers.
summary: Lets SEC-registered investment advisers obtain California finance lender licenses for commercial loans, subject to bonding, background checks, and reporting conditions.

title: Wildfire County Coordinator Program.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Creates a California Wildfire Preparedness Program under the Department of Forestry and Fire Protection, with guidance, risk assessment support, and county coordinator oversight.

title: Property taxation: change in ownership: generational transfers: special needs trusts.
summary: Requires special needs trusts to count as an eligible transfer medium, so parent-child property transfers through them can qualify for the property tax change-in-ownership exclusion.

title: Nursing schools and programs: faculty members, directors, and assistant directors.
summary: Lets the Board of Registered Nursing approve nursing faculty and directors who use a remediation plan, including mentorship-based approval for community college applicants.

title: Courtesy signs: Adopt-A-Riverway Program.
summary: Makes a nonsubstantive wording change to the provision allowing courtesy signs recognizing Adopt-A-Riverway program sponsors.

title: Chain restaurants: children’s meals.
summary: Requires chain restaurants that sell children's meals to offer at least one meal meeting set nutrition standards, such as a 550-calorie cap.

title: Data centers: labor: electricity rates.
topics: AI and technology; Environment and energy
summary: Requires PUC to create special electricity rate structure for large data centers, shifting infrastructure upgrade costs to them, plus construction labor rules.

title: Planning and zoning: housing element: regional housing needs allocation: judicial review.
summary: Makes council of governments and delegate subregion final determinations on housing allocation appeals subject to judicial review.

title: Elementary, secondary, and postsecondary education: immigration enforcement: notification.
summary: Requires school safety plans to include procedures for notifying parents and staff when immigration enforcement is confirmed on campus, through 2031.

title: Access to medical records.
summary: Prohibits health care providers from charging patients fees for health forms required by schools or childcare for participation.

title: Administrative regulations: standardized regulatory impact analysis: State Air Resources Board.
summary: Requires CARB's regulatory impact analyses to also assess cost-of-living impacts on Californians, including gasoline, electricity, food and housing costs.

title: Climate disasters: civil actions.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Environment and energy
summary: Lets the Attorney General sue fossil fuel companies for climate-attributable damages, bars passing those costs to consumers at the pump, and creates a recovery fund.

title: San Diego Unified Port District: job order contracting: pilot program.
summary: Creates a 2037-sunsetting pilot letting the San Diego Unified Port District use job order contracting notwithstanding port contracting rules, with dollar caps and a 2035 report.

title: Personal Income Tax Law: deductions: tips.
summary: Conforms California income tax to the federal tip deduction for tax years 2026 through 2028 and adds tax expenditure reporting requirements.

title: 911 emergency system.
summary: Requires the Office of Emergency Services to submit quarterly legislative reports on the Next Generation 911 system's development and spending.

title: Major regulations.
summary: Requires major state regulations to face a 60-day legislative review and possible rejection before taking effect, and expands agency reporting to the Legislature.

title: California Health Access Fund.
summary: Creates a California Health Access Fund to backfill Medi-Cal coverage and provider reimbursement for residents losing care due to federal changes, subject to appropriation.

title: California Motor Vehicle Glass Act.
summary: Requires glass repair shops to give ADAS calibration notices, written results and itemized invoices, and bars insureds from assigning auto glass policy benefits to shops.

title: Community Assistance, Recovery, and Empowerment (CARE) Court Program.
summary: Lets first responders ask county behavioral health agencies to petition for CARE Court services, requiring agency review within 30 business days and notice to the responder.

title: Military protective orders.
summary: Lets courts weigh military protective orders in domestic violence cases and requires officers to verify and report them.

title: Highways: exit information.
summary: Requires Caltrans to allow business information signs at two specified State Route 395 exits until January 1, 2037.

title: Residential care facilities for the elderly: categorization of citations.
summary: Starting 2029, the state must categorize abuse citations against elder care facilities and list those categories on a public database.

title: County auditors: special districts: annual audit exceptions.
summary: Extends until 2037 the option for small special districts to replace annual audits with cheaper reviews or compilations, and raises the revenue cap to $250,000.

title: Board of Behavioral Sciences: licensees: notices.
summary: Allows behavioral health licensees to withhold some licensing information from client complaint notices based on individual safety concerns.

title: Local agencies: nondisclosure agreements.
summary: Bars local agency officials and employees from signing nondisclosure agreements that prevent sharing public business information with colleagues or their governing body.

title: Involuntary residential facilities: health and safety inspections.
summary: Authorizes state public health inspections of involuntary residential facilities housing over 50 people, with penalties for sanitary and safety violations.

title: Manufactured housing: conformity.
summary: Directs HCD to adopt regulations allowing manufactured homes without permanent chassis to be built, sold, and occupied on parity with chassis-equipped homes, plus reports.

title: North Fork Kings Groundwater Sustainability Agency: lien authority.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Authorizes the North Fork Kings groundwater agency to impose civil penalties for excess pumping and lien unpaid charges on property.

title: Educational equity: discrimination prevention coordinators.
summary: Adds a disability discrimination coordinator, creates anti-racism deputy coordinators, renames the LGBTQ coordinator, and requires discrimination education and prevention resources in schools.

title: Franchise Tax Board: reporting requirements.
summary: Moves the Franchise Tax Board's annual health coverage penalty report deadline from March 1 to April 1.

title: Educational expenses: school choice flex accounts and special education flex accounts.
summary: Constitutional amendment letting the state and localities fund private school tuition through school choice flex accounts, overriding existing constitutional limits.

title: Governor: pardons and commutations.
summary: Bars the Governor from granting pardons or commutations to specified relatives.

title: Elections: initiatives and referenda.
summary: Moves the duty to write initiative and referendum titles and summaries from the Attorney General to the Legislative Analyst, who would also write statewide ballot labels.

title: Property taxation: veterans’ exemption.
summary: Constitutional amendment letting the Legislature exempt veterans' property up to full value, adds Space Force, and allows homeowner exemption stacking.

title: Education finance: Education Equalization Act: Equalization Reserve Account.
summary: Creates an Equalization Reserve Account funded by transfers matching Prop 98 Stabilization Account transfers, with interest directed to non-basic aid districts.

title: 2025–26 First Extraordinary Session: Joint Rules.
summary: Adopts the 2025–26 Regular Session Joint Rules of the Senate and Assembly as the rules for the First Extraordinary Session.

summary: Creates a public records exemption for personal identifying and location information of state attorney and statewide prosecution nonlegal support staff and their families, with legislative review and retroactive application.

title: Adult Day Care Services and Centers
summary: Creates a tiered Medicaid reimbursement system and transportation rates for adult day care, and adds continuing education requirements for center operators as a license condition.

title: Assisted Living Facilities
summary: Bars AHCA from imposing limited nursing staffing requirements on assisted living facilities without limited nursing services, expands medication self-administration tasks, and adjusts reporting deadlines and disclosures.

title: Proration of or Not Requiring Continuing Education
summary: Revises when provisions on prorating or waiving continuing education requirements apply; the text does not say whom or how.

title: Speech and Debate Education
summary: Designates Florida Speech & Debate Week each February and, subject to appropriation, creates a statewide debate organization supporting a Department of Education civics and debate initiative.

title: Restrictive Housing in Prisons
summary: Requires OPPAGA to conduct and report findings annually on restrictive housing in prisons, without changing current rules.

title: Parental Rights of Qualified Patients
summary: Bars courts from denying or restricting parental rights, or presuming neglect, based solely on a parent being a medical marijuana patient.

title: Carbon Sequestration
summary: Creates a DEP carbon sequestration task force to report on the subject and requires explicit legislative approval for certain sequestration frameworks or enforcement mechanisms.

title: Gubernatorial Transition
summary: Requires the governor and agencies to designate transition liaisons and provides governor-elect staff with office space, IT services, agency access, and records access, with penalties.

title: Alzheimer's Disease Awareness Initiative
summary: Requires the Department of Elder Affairs to contract for an Alzheimer's disease awareness initiative and has its advisory committee report recommendations annually.

title: Public Employee Housing Benefits
summary: Creates requirements for the Heroes Reward housing benefit for public employees, including how leave balances are combined, counted and paid at current base pay.

title: Portable Benefits Accounts for Independent Contractors and Sole Proprietors
summary: Authorizes anyone, including hiring parties, to voluntarily contribute to portable benefit accounts for independent contractors and sole proprietors, subject to contribution requirements.

title: Battery Collection and Disposal
topics: Consumer protection and business; Environment and energy
summary: Repeals existing battery rules and replaces them with producer and retailer sale conditions, stewardship duties for battery collection and disposal, and a ban on certain point-of-sale fees.

title: Occupational Injury Benefit Plans
topics: Consumer protection and business; Labor and employment
summary: Lets employers opt out of standard workers' compensation by adopting their own occupational injury benefit plans, which they may self-fund or insure.

title: Background Screenings
summary: Lets independent sanctioning authorities join the care provider background screening clearinghouse and bars denying or failing to acknowledge expunged or sealed criminal records.

title: Transportation Facility Designations
summary: Designates the Chanda Cheeseborough Ribault River Bridge in Duval County and directs DOT to erect markers.

title: Termination of Rental Agreement by Victim of Domestic Violence, Dating Violence, Sexual Violence, or Stalking
summary: Bars landlords from evicting violence or stalking victims, lets victims end leases and change locks, and allows civil suits for violations.

title: Alternative Plans Reviews and Inspections
summary: Lets private providers perform single-trade inspections and plan reviews for certain dwellings, and sets timeframes for local building officials on certain permits.

title: Education
summary: Omnibus education bill revising K-12 spending, schools, VPK and school readiness, required instruction, parental opt-outs, and educator certification.

title: Coverage by Citizens Property Insurance Corporation
summary: Revises Citizens Property Insurance eligibility in certain counties, requires annual rate increases for some policies, and allows certain policies without mandatory flood insurance.

title: Public Education
summary: Gives school board members specified rights, makes certain board meeting documents public records, and bars requiring school employees to sign nondisclosure agreements.

title: Department of Highway Safety and Motor Vehicles Operations
summary: Replaces motor carrier registration with licensure, adds fuel use decal and reporting rules, and creates penalties for certain fuel tax offenses.

title: Utilities
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Requires municipal utilities to serve customers outside city limits on specified terms, limits denial of service, and lets rural electric cooperatives hold electronic member voting.

title: Pub. Rec./E-mail Addresses/DHSMV
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Exempts DHSMV-collected email addresses for renewal and vessel notices from public records requirements, expanding the exemption and applying it retroactively.

title: Funding for Body Cameras
summary: Revises the definition of infrastructure to include body cameras in certain circumstances, enabling funding for them.

title: Students Enrolled in Dropout Retrieval Programs
summary: Revises accountability rules for virtual instruction providers, exempts dropout retrieval-only providers from specified requirements, and applies certain accountability requirements to dropout retrieval programs.

title: Small Employer Health Carrier Reinsurance Program
summary: Removes statutory provisions creating the Florida Small Employer Carrier Reinsurance Program for small-group health insurers.

title: Voluntary Nonopioid Advance Directive Forms
summary: Requires health care facilities to create a voluntary nonopioid advance directive form, which patients may revoke at any time, with liability immunity for practitioners.

title: Cybersecurity Experiential Learning
summary: Requires Cyber Florida to develop a cybersecurity experiential learning program, subject to appropriation, with reporting on participation and improvement.

title: Patient Access to Records
summary: Requires certain licensed health facilities, providers, and practitioners to furnish patient records within specified timeframes after a request.

title: Private Insurance Coverage for Credit Union Accounts
summary: Creates a private insurance option for credit union accounts and lets the Office of Financial Regulation bar qualified private providers in certain circumstances.

title: Children's Medical Services Program
summary: Moves the Children's Medical Services managed care plan to AHCA and requires a Medicaid waiver redesign to cover children receiving private duty nursing.

title: Local Government Cyber Security
topics: AI and technology; Government and administration
summary: Creates a Florida Digital Service program to fund and provide cybersecurity services and IT commodities to local governments, with data-sharing and reporting duties.

title: Property Insurance Claims
summary: Makes a mandatory dispute-resolution procedure for property insurance claims, requires insurer notice, lets administrative judges dismiss some petitions, and makes homeowner insurers primary.

title: Pub. Rec./Office of Financial Regulation
summary: Expands a public records exemption for Office of Financial Regulation investigation and examination information, adding virtual currency, stablecoin and gold/silver custodian documents, with future review and repeal.

title: Newborn Screenings
summary: Beginning on a specified date, subject to appropriation, requires DOH rules to mandate newborn screening for Duchenne muscular dystrophy.

title: Waste Facilities
summary: Prohibits local governments and DEP from issuing construction permits for certain solid waste disposal and waste-to-energy facilities under certain circumstances.

title: Photography In Polling Rooms and Early Voting Sites
summary: Authorizes photography in polling rooms and early voting areas during specified times.

title: Corporal Punishment
summary: Prohibits school district employees from using corporal punishment on public school students.

title: Substance Abuse and Mental Health Care
summary: Expands mental health crisis services to include 988, ends guardian advocate role at outpatient discharge, sets psychologist experience rules for involuntary placement, and lets facilities retain patients longer.

title: Dental Screenings For K-12 Students
summary: Authorizes school dental screenings with written notice and a parent opt-out, clarifies notification duties, and exempts these screenings from certain parental consent requirements.

title: Coverage of Prescription Drugs for Pain
summary: Requires Medicaid and its managed care plans to cover nonopioid pain drugs without disadvantaging them relative to opioids, and bars practices that discourage them.

title: Vertiports
summary: Authorizes the Department of Transportation to fund up to specified percentages of public vertiport project costs.

title: Criminal Offender Substance Abuse Program
summary: Creates a Hillsborough County pilot program for substance abuse accountability among criminal offenders, with eligibility rules and a required report.

title: Salaries of Clerks of Circuit Court, County Comptrollers, and Supervisors of Elections
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Increases base salaries for clerks of circuit court, county comptrollers, and supervisors of elections.

title: Insurance Research
summary: Renames the Florida Catastrophic Storm Risk Management Center, revises its provisions, and requires it to manage the public hurricane loss projection model.

title: Health Insurer Accountability
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Requires health plans to respond to claim disputes, pay providers on time, disclose ownership affiliations, and imposes penalties for noncompliance.

title: Arrest and Detention of Individuals with Significant Medical Conditions
summary: Lets officers use discretion on whether to make an immediate arrest of people with significant medical conditions.

title: Guardianship
summary: Revises guardianship rules: court orders may name persons entitled to information, notice and visits; guardians may restrict certain ward contacts and must give notice.

title: Municipal Water and Sewer Utility Rates
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Requires municipalities to charge out-of-city utility customers the same rates, fees and charges as in-city customers under certain circumstances.

title: Designation of the State Birds
summary: Designates the American flamingo as Florida's official state bird and the Florida scrub-jay as its state songbird.

title: Combatting Illegal Immigration
summary: Requires law enforcement agencies to join ICE immigration agreements and staff officers for immigration duties, creates an unauthorized alien transport program, and appropriates $3 million.

title: Out-of-network Providers
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Requires practitioners to notify patients in writing when referring them to certain out-of-network providers, and requires certain insurers to credit nonpreferred provider payments toward deductibles and out-of-pocket maximums.

title: Stalking
summary: Creates aggravated stalking and sexually aggravated stalking offenses with new severity rankings under the Criminal Punishment Code, and revises the definition of qualifying offense.

title: Services for Individuals with Developmental Disabilities
summary: Adds reporting, council and transition-planning duties for the developmental disabilities agency, and revises the pilot program's eligibility and enrollment rules.

title: Local Administration of Vessel Restrictions
summary: Lets counties and cities enforce derelict-vessel and anchoring rules locally, extend boating-restricted areas, and revise an anchoring-limit exemption, subject to FWC approval.

title: Education
summary: Moves the Council on the Social Status of Black Men and Boys from the Attorney General's Department of Legal Affairs to Florida Memorial University, with revised quorum and remote-attendance rules.

title: Interpersonal Violence Injunctions
summary: Revises interpersonal violence injunction procedures, including clerk-provided forms and information, service rules, and renaming the statewide verification system to the Statewide Injunction Verification System.

title: Florida Bright Futures Scholarship Program
summary: Revises Bright Futures scholarship eligibility for students who earn a high school diploma from a non-Florida school.

title: Firearm Hold Agreements
summary: Gives federal firearms licensees immunity from civil liability for acts or omissions relating to firearm hold agreements, with an exception.

title: Health Care Provider Participation in Medicaid Managed Care Organizations
summary: Requires providers seeking Medicaid managed care participation to enroll with AHCA and be credentialed, sets enrollment timelines, and bars certain MCO clean-claims requirements.

title: Services During a State of Emergency
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Lets the Department of Management Services enter state term contracts for specified services during an emergency and lets qualifying individuals work in specified positions.

title: Sales Tax Exemption for Disabled Veterans
summary: Creates a sales tax exemption for sales to certain disabled veterans, who must apply to the Department of Revenue.

title: Antisemitism Task Force
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Creates an Antisemitism Task Force within the Department of Legal Affairs' Office of Civil Rights to study the issue and report to the Governor and Legislature.

title: Certificates of Completion
summary: Limits certificates of completion to students with disabilities and revises learning opportunities for certain students.

title: Recording of Instruments Conveying Real Property
summary: Requires watermarked electronic notarial signatures, bars recording certain property instruments without specified identification, and lets clerks return instruments for correction.

title: Mathematics Education Requirements
summary: Adds specified mathematics content requirements to uniform core curricula for teacher preparation programs and competency-based professional learning certification programs.

title: Pub. Rec./Crime Victims
summary: Expands the public records exemption protecting crime victims' names, IDs, and locating details, and extends it to family members and next of kin.

title: Education
summary: Requires school districts' shared surtax revenue to also go to charter schools proportionately, adds district reporting, and revises charter and Schools of Hope rules.

title: Grants for Genetic Counseling Education
summary: Creates a grant program so the Board of Governors can award state universities funds to enhance genetic counseling education.

title: Notification Of Anti-harassment Policies and Supportive Measures
summary: Requires schools to adopt anti-harassment policies and supportive measures, with specified requirements for those policies and measures.

title: Offenses Evidencing Prejudice
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice
summary: Adds gender, gender identity and disability as bias grounds for mandatory offense reclassification and expands hate-crime data collection.

title: Health Care Patient Protection
summary: Requires hospital emergency departments to adopt pediatric care policies, training, a pediatric coordinator, and assessments, with state minimum standards and published results.

title: Materials Harmful to Minors
summary: Defines "harmful to minors" and revises the list of classroom materials subject to parent or resident objection.

title: Unmanned Aircraft and Unmanned Aircraft Systems
summary: Revises critical infrastructure drone rules, adds an exception, increases criminal penalties for certain prohibited drone actions, and defines unmanned aircraft terms.

title: Aging and Disability Services
summary: Revises Medicaid long-term care enrollment offers, creates a statewide pre-enrollment list, and adds procurement rules and salary limits for area agencies on aging.

title: Sewer Collection Systems
summary: Lets municipalities use certain funds for a specified purpose related to sewer collection systems; the text does not name the funds or purpose.

title: Pilot Program for Students with Reading Deficiencies
summary: Creates a first-grade summer reading immersion pilot program for students with reading deficiencies; the text does not specify funding.

title: Regional Planning and Economic Development
summary: Omnibus economic development bill reorganizing Commerce and related boards, creating a Rural Accelerator Program and Office of Secure Florida, and authorizing local regional planning agreements.

title: Local Government Salaries and Benefits
summary: Requires local governing bodies to hold a referendum before raising their members' pay or retirement benefits, with the local government paying election costs.

title: Child Welfare
topics: Children and families; Government and administration
summary: Omnibus child welfare bill creating DCF pilot and recruitment programs, a workforce workgroup, and a study, and easing lead agency bonding and subcontractor liability.

title: Victims of Violence
summary: Creates rebuttable presumption that victims using force against known abusers reasonably feared death or great bodily harm; adds training and a review panel.

title: Pub. Rec./Crime Victims
summary: Expands public records exemptions to shield crime victims' identifying information and makes certain officers' use-of-force identities confidential for a set period.

title: First Responders
summary: Expands a firefighter recruitment bonus program, creates grant review and funding processes, and establishes a subject-to-appropriation PTSD institute within the Department of Financial Services.

title: Fleeing or Attempting to Elude a Law Enforcement Officer
summary: Revises law enforcement vehicle marking rules for fleeing offenses, reclassifies them on the offense severity chart, and adds a sentencing multiplier.

title: Redesignations of State University and Florida College System Institution Roads
summary: Requires state university and college boards to rename specified roads after Charlie Kirk, with state funds withheld for noncompliance.

title: Affordable Housing and Supportive Services for Persons with Developmental Disabilities
topics: Health care; Housing; Taxes and budget
summary: Creates incentives and rent subsidies for affordable housing and supportive services for people with developmental disabilities, funded by a $1,000,000 appropriation and tax benefits.

title: Ad Valorem Tax Exemption for Nonprofit Homes for the Aged
summary: Revises eligibility rules for Florida limited partnerships seeking an ad valorem tax exemption for nonprofit homes for the aged.

title: Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission
summary: Revises Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission membership and terms, adds regional representation, and sets conditions for officers entering private property.

title: Pediatric Behavioral and Mental Health Screenings
summary: Requires the state Medicaid agency to set pediatric behavioral screening protocols and report outcome data, and requires DOH to provide parent information on sleep, screen time, and nutrition.

title: Electrocardiograms for Student Athletes
summary: Requires certain students to get an electrocardiogram before interscholastic athletic competition, allows out-of-state licensed practitioners to perform evaluations, and grants liability immunity.

title: Specialty License Plates/Florida Film Legacy License Plate
summary: Directs DHSMV to create a Florida Film Legacy license plate and sets how plate sale fees are distributed and used, with an annual financial report.

title: Utility Service Restrictions
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration; Housing
summary: Bars local governments and rural electric co-ops from restricting fuel sources or appliances, and bars state building and fire officials from restricting certain materials.

title: Deductions for Certain Losses of Alcoholic Beverages
summary: Lets alcohol distributors deduct excise tax on beverages lost to breakage, spoilage, expiration, or unfitness, with rules for multi-product distributors and extraordinary losses.

title: Termination of Pregnancies
summary: Prohibits physicians from knowingly performing or inducing a pregnancy termination once the fetus is sustainable outside the womb, with revised exceptions.

title: Impact Fees
summary: Limits local impact fee increases, requires plan-based methodology, and entitles prevailing petitioners to refunds with interest and attorney fees.

title: Insurance Regulations
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Adds oversight rules for reciprocal insurers and continuing care retirement communities, including documentation, resident representatives, insolvency standards, lien recording, and a management-company certificate requirement.

title: Military Installations and Ranges
summary: Revises local government and military installation information-sharing, adds a prioritized scoring adjustment, and requires DEM coordination and an annual report.

title: Permits for Drilling, Exploration, and Extraction of Oil and Gas Resources
summary: Bans oil and gas drilling, exploration, and production near certain estuarine research reserves in listed counties, and requires DEP to weigh blowout risk factors.

title: Local Government Land Development Regulations and Orders
summary: Creates the Florida Starter Homes Act, limiting local zoning rules such as lot size, parking, historic and compatibility standards, and lot-split criteria for homes on water and sewer.

title: Workforce Education
summary: Makes charter schools eligible for a workforce grant and changes which districts and colleges must offer money-back tuition guarantee programs, with reporting and eligibility rules.

title: Electric Utility Ten-year Site Plans
summary: Revises utility ten-year site plan contents and PSC review, requires revised plans, bars certain power plant site certification filings, and raises the review fee cap.

title: Country of Origin for Wild and Farm-Raised Fish
summary: Requires country-of-origin disclosure when selling imported wild or farm-raised fish and creates a voluntary Florida Wild Fish & Seafood Certification Program.

title: School District Unimproved Real Property
summary: Requires school districts to annually submit complete inventories of unimproved real property to DOE, which will compile and publish them in a statewide report.

title: Vessel Accountability
topics: Criminal justice; Environment and energy; Housing
summary: Tightens rules on anchored and derelict vessels, adds penalties and permits, bans dwelling on derelict vessels, and shifts removal costs to owners.

title: Recess Requirements for Middle School Students
summary: Requires district school boards to provide a specified amount of free-play recess weekly to students in grades 6 through 8.

title: Clinical Laboratory Personnel
summary: Deems certain applicants for clinical laboratory technologist or technician licensure to have met minimum qualifications, and deems those who qualify and pay fees eligible.

title: Property Damage Caused by Limestone Mining Operations
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Creates a right for property owners damaged by limestone mining to file compensation claims, adjudicated by DOAH and paid from an annual appropriation.

title: Classroom Teacher Mental Health Care
summary: Requires district school boards to give classroom teachers access to mental health services, under requirements the bill sets out.

title: Health Care Autonomy
summary: Establishes a fundamental state right to reproductive health care, bars state and local interference or penalties, grants civil immunity, and preempts stricter local rules.

title: Governmental Entity Access to and Use of Vendor Background Information
summary: Lets DMS give state agencies access to vendor background systems and lets agencies reject vendors whose competitive-solicitation affidavits prove untrue, without that decision being protestable.

title: Juvenile Justice
summary: Creates medal awards for juvenile detention and probation officers, expands the officer definition, and lets DOR deduct amounts owed to DJJ from county distributions.

title: Pub.Rec./Electronic Systems
summary: Creates a public records exemption for electronic systems holding background information on vendors seeking to do business with the state, with future repeal review.

title: Malt Beverages
summary: Lets certain malt beverage manufacturers sell and deliver directly to vendors, end certain distributor contracts, and get division-set production amounts.

title: Verification of Reemployment Assistance Benefit Eligibility
summary: Revises when claimants are disqualified from reemployment assistance benefits and requires the Department of Commerce to verify identities and cross-check information before paying.

title: Litigation Financing
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice
summary: Regulates litigation financing by requiring disclosure notices, barring financier practices and foreign funder actions, voiding certain agreements, and enabling FDUTPA enforcement and sanctions.

title: Agriculture
summary: Expands and renames agriculture disaster loans, allows loan use for labor and replanting, and creates a silviculture grant program for timber landowners.

title: Sexual Offenses
summary: Increases penalties and mandatory minimums for child sexual abuse material and related sexual offenses, and reclassifies certain offenses under the sentencing code.

title: Removal of Altered Sexual Depictions Posted without Consent
summary: Requires covered online platforms to set up a process for removing non-consensual altered sexual depictions of identifiable people, with notice rules and liability protections for good-faith compliance.

title: Big Cypress Basin
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Revises the Big Cypress Basin governing board membership, requires SFWMD to revise basin boundaries after a study, and directs basin ad valorem tax use to specified projects and flood control.

title: Certified Recovery Residences
summary: Allows certified recovery residences in certain zoned districts and multifamily buildings, limits local bans, lets localities deny some Level IV homes near specified uses, and revises staffing ratios.

title: Risk Retention Groups
summary: Clarifies that risk retention groups registered to do business in Florida are insurance companies authorized to do business in the state.

title: Mobile Cranes and Accessory Support Vehicles
summary: Authorizes FDOT to issue special blanket permits letting mobile cranes and accessory support vehicles exceed certain dimension and weight limits on and off Interstate highways.

title: Certified Recovery Residences
summary: Makes Department of Children and Families certification mandatory for recovery residences and their administrators, with conditional operation allowed while applications are pending.

title: Mental Health Services for First Responders
summary: Creates a Fire Marshal-run statewide behavioral health program for first responders with no copayments, LPC training rules, and a plan due to the Legislature.

title: Advanced Wastewater Treatment
summary: Requires certain sewage disposal facilities to report to DEP, and DEP to report on advanced wastewater treatment to the Governor and Legislature.

title: Water Management Districts
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Sets ethics, reporting, voting and procurement rules for water management districts, and caps their property tax millage and budgets.

title: Enforcement of the Florida Building Code
summary: Revises how local governments must spend excess building permit funds related to enforcing the Florida Building Code.

title: Consumer Protection
summary: Requires unlicensed home repair vendors to act within a set time after payment, puts the burden of proving just cause on them, and adds criminal penalties.

title: Residential Swimming Pool Requirements
summary: Requires residential pools to meet safety and barrier standards when the property is sold, and home inspectors must report violations to local enforcement.

title: Statute of Limitations Period for Violations Involving Required Reports Concerning Children
summary: Delays the start of the limitations period for violations of required child-related reports until a law enforcement agency learns of the violation.

title: Endangered or Threatened Marine Animals
summary: Prohibits collecting and transporting endangered or threatened marine animals from state waters and bars the wildlife commission from issuing related licenses.

title: Florida Trust Code
summary: Gives the Attorney General exclusive authority over certain charitable trust interests and bars other states' public officers from asserting those rights.

title: Boating-restricted Areas
summary: Lets cities and counties extend boating-restricted areas by ordinance, with boundaries marked by specified markers.

title: Mitigation Banks
summary: Revises wetland mitigation bank credit rules and lets water management districts release conservation easements so released land can be developed under zoning.

title: Safety Design Standards for Office Surgery Suites
summary: Requires the Florida Building Commission and State Fire Marshal to create safety design standards for office surgical suites by a set date.

title: Labor Regulations
summary: Requires heat-exposure safety programs for certain employers, expands union dues deduction and recertification rules, and mandates contracting agents fund worker benefit providers.

title: Spaceport Operations and Space Florida
summary: Revises Space Florida's governance and board membership, exempts it from certain agency bidding rules, and requires a full-time business development director.

title: Legal Representation Contracts
summary: Bars the Department of Legal Affairs from hiring outside attorneys until the Attorney General makes a written determination, then requires proposals, records, and public reporting.

title: Pub. Rec. and Meetings/Space Florida
summary: Exempts Space Florida from public records and public meetings requirements, with future legislative review and repeal of the exemption.

title: Motor Vehicle Insurance
summary: Repeals parts of the Florida no-fault auto insurance law and revises various motor vehicle insurance coverage, self-insurer, and for-hire vehicle requirements, with a $83,651 appropriation.

title: Enforcement of School Attendance
summary: Requires district school boards to implement a mandatory alert system that notifies specified persons when a student reaches the truancy absence threshold.

title: Cybersecurity Incident Liability
summary: Shields governments and covered entities that comply with cybersecurity frameworks from liability for cybersecurity incidents, and bars related negligence-based evidence.

title: Transportation Infrastructure Land Development Regulations
summary: Requires local governments to create transit-oriented and rural village zones allowing mixed-use development, bars certain building rules there, and allows private lawsuits to enforce.

title: Department of Management Services
summary: Revises Department of Management Services rules on state employment, recruitment, procurement, and employee benefits, including equal employment opportunity provisions.

title: Health Care Services Jurisdiction and Reimbursement
summary: Subjects health insurers and HMOs to Florida court jurisdiction, bars providers from billing patients for insurer-owed emergency services, and lets nonparticipating providers sue in quantum meruit.

title: Service Lateral Assessment and Rehabilitation
summary: Requires utility systems to create and maintain condition assessment programs for service laterals, report annually to DEP, and provides enforcement and funding.

title: Public School Personnel Compensation
summary: Limits cost-of-living pay adjustments to staff with direct student contact, removes related limits, and revises how advanced degrees factor into teacher and administrator salary schedules.

title: Elections of County Commissioners, District School Board Members, and District School Superintendents
summary: Restructures county commission and school board elections into population-based single-member districts with staggered terms and district-residency requirements, and revises district superintendent election terms.

title: Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion and Affirmative Action
summary: Removes diversity-related requirements for appointments and lottery retailers, and bars hiring managers from certain employment practices, with complaints filed with the Attorney General.

title: Universal Free School Breakfast and Lunch Program
summary: Creates a universal free school breakfast and lunch program in public schools, run by the Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services, subject to appropriations.

title: Shari'a and Other Foreign Law
summary: Declares court rulings and contract provisions void and unenforceable if they apply Shari'a or certain foreign laws, and bars transferring related civil actions to other courts.

title: Supervision of Children
summary: Revises Florida's definitions of child harm and neglect and specifies that certain supervised child activities are not restricted.

title: Elections During Emergencies
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Lets county election supervisors request Secretary of State approval for specified actions during emergencies, with set review timeframes and published decisions.

title: Prohibition of Guaranteed Income Programs
summary: Bars local governments from adopting or enforcing rules on guaranteed income programs and gives the Attorney General enforcement powers.

title: Residential Living Arrangements
summary: Sets licensing and siting rules for community and recovery residences, adding spacing limits and local revocation powers while requiring reasonable accommodation for some proposed residences.

title: Fentanyl Testing
summary: Requires hospitals and hospital-based off-campus emergency departments to test urine for fentanyl, confirm positives, and keep results in the clinical record.

title: Protection of Specified Persons Against the Fraudulent and Exploitative Conveyance of Property Interests
summary: Requires a cooling-off period before recording quitclaim deeds, adds witness and clerk notice duties, and routes suspected fraud on vulnerable adults to legal aid and prosecutors.

title: Anaphylaxis in Public Schools
summary: Requires school boards to ensure anaphylaxis emergency plans are effective and that staff and contracted program personnel receive allergy training, with trained staff on campus.

title: Information Technology Procurement and Contracting
summary: Revises Florida Digital Services duties, creates an oversight bureau, and sets new procurement, contract, and records-repository requirements for state information technology.

title: Solid Waste Facilities
summary: Bans state and local governments from applying for or approving permits for specified solid waste facilities.

title: Transportation
summary: Transfers the Florida Highway Patrol and commercial vehicle enforcement offices from DHSMV to FDLE and requires Senate confirmation of the DHSMV executive director.

title: Requirements for Battery Manufacturers
summary: Bans cell manufacturers and marketers from selling certain battery-powered products unless specified requirements are met.

title: Student Health and Safety
summary: Revises Department of Health epilepsy education duties, school seizure action plan requirements, and which employees must complete seizure training, which would be valid for five years.

title: Elections
summary: Revises various Florida election provisions, including vote-by-mail, poll watchers, identification, early voting, and election crimes, without specifying direction in the summary.

title: Education on Congenital Cytomegalovirus
summary: Requires DOH to develop congenital cytomegalovirus education materials, mandates hospitals and practices distribute them, and requires practitioners to complete a CMV course for licensure.

title: Amendments to the State Constitution
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Revises the constitutional amendment initiative process, including petition circulator registration, signature verification and revocation, record retention, election officials' duties, and criminal penalties.

title: Kratom
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice; Education
summary: Regulates kratom: requires lab certification and sale criteria, bans retail sale and delivery, restricts sales to minors, and bars ingestion near schools, while authorizing certain businesses to sell.

title: Mental Health
summary: Expands mental health diversion and training programs through grants, requires mental health evaluations as probation conditions, and creates a behavioral health data repository.

title: Ambulatory Surgical Centers
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Adds a penalty for ambulatory surgical centers that fail to timely provide good faith cost estimates, and requires AHCA to notify the Division of Law Revision when adopting certain federal rules.

title: Land Use and Development Regulations
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration; Housing
summary: Lets agricultural enclave owners seek administrative development approval, limits local plan conflicts, adds comprehensive plan supermajority votes, and restricts recreational amenity fees and dues.

title: Pharmacy Audits
summary: Revises rules for pharmacy benefit plan audits of pharmacies, adds recoupment limits and appeal rights, and lets OIR fine or suspend PBM registrations.

title: Grandparent Visitation
summary: Revises the criteria a grandparent of a minor child must meet to petition a court for visitation.

title: Nursing Education Programs
summary: Tightens oversight of nursing education programs: adds inspections, evidence collection, and easier revocation of program approval and director discipline.

title: Public Safety
topics: Criminal justice; Government and administration; Health care
summary: Omnibus public safety bill creating an FDLE counterterrorism unit, expanding first-responder peer support, adding officer resilience training, and creating valor medals.

title: Military Affairs
summary: Expands military leave for state employees to include Coast Guard service and revises DMA class requirements and Soldiers & Airmen Assistance Program eligibility and oversight.

title: K-12 School Route Optimization Pilot Program
summary: Creates a pilot program in selected county school districts to optimize K-12 school bus routes, with DOE assistance, reporting, and an expiration date.

title: Interstate Podiatric Medical Licensure Compact
summary: Enacts an interstate compact letting licensed podiatrists in member states obtain licensure across states, creating a commission and a licensure database.

title: Pub. Rec./Interstate Podiatric Medical Licensure Compact
summary: Exempts certain podiatric licensure compact information and related commission meetings and records from public records and open meeting requirements, with future review and repeal.

title: Public Employee Collective Bargaining
summary: Revises public employee union certification, recertification and decertification rules, removes revocation provisions, adds employer prohibitions, and creates exceptions for certain bargaining units.

title: Prohibited Governmental Policies Regulating Greenhouse Gas Emissions
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Bars governmental entities from adopting or funding net zero greenhouse gas policies or imposing related charges, and requires annual affidavits to the Department of Revenue.

title: Employment Agreements
summary: Declares certain covered noncompete and garden leave agreements not restraints of trade, and requires courts to preliminarily enjoin alleged breaches.

title: Waterbody Designations
summary: Designates a spoil island as the Andrew "Red" Harris Spoil Island and directs DEP to erect markers.

title: Local Option Taxes
summary: Revises unspecified provisions of local option taxes, including the tourist development tax, local food and beverage tax, and discretionary sales surtax.

title: Department of Financial Services
summary: Omnibus DFS bill revising agency provisions across many areas, including licensing, fire codes, insurance programs, bail bonds, and unclaimed property.

title: Student Online Personal Information Protection
topics: AI and technology; Children and families
summary: Bars online operators and schools from collecting or sharing student personal information without parental written consent, requires contract disclosures, and adds penalties.

title: Sexually Transmissible Diseases
summary: Creates the HIV Prevention Justice Act, reducing criminal penalties for HIV-positive donors, narrowing intentional-transmission prohibitions, and revising HIV testing rules in transmission cases.

title: Employment
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Bars cities and counties from setting their own minimum wage or using wage and benefit rules in contracts, and revises minor employment restrictions and DBPR waiver authority.

title: Grand Jury Testimony and Materials
summary: Requires clerks and prosecutors to preserve grand jury materials under chain-of-custody and access rules, and penalizes intentional destruction or alteration.

title: Medicaid Enrollment for Permanently Disabled Individuals
summary: Keeps permanently disabled Medicaid enrollees covered during redetermination, lets DCF run redeterminations, and seeks federal approval to exempt them from annual checks.

title: Preemption to the State
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration; Housing
summary: Preempts local governments from burdening religious exercise, restricts local permit and landscaping rules for certain homes and fences, and changes home-based business parking criteria.

title: Financing Qualifying Improvements to Residential Property
summary: Revises how certain non-ad valorem assessments used to finance residential property improvements are collected.

title: Residential Homes for Medically or Technologically Dependent Children
summary: Creates licensure, background screening, inspection, and safety standards for residential homes serving medically or technologically dependent children, with provisional and conditional licenses and penalties.

title: Education
summary: Revises conversion school rules, lets a municipality apply for a job engine charter, bars districts from certain fees, and keeps specified property at conversion schools.

title: Special Districts
summary: Abolishes certain soil and water conservation districts, shifts their assets and liabilities to DACS, and limits special district liability for public recreational access.

title: Insurance Claims Payments to Physicians
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Bars insurers and HMOs from requiring credit-card-only payments to physicians, from charging electronic transfer fees, and from denying prior-authorized procedure claims.

title: Final Disposition, Funeral, and Cemetery Services
summary: Revises funeral, cemetery and preneed rules, creates licensure for natural organic reduction facilities, and adds purchaser notice requirements for unfulfilled preneed contracts.

title: Political Activities on School Grounds
summary: Allows candidates to speak on school grounds under certain conditions, while prohibiting some political activities there and barring employees from using work resources for political advocacy.

title: Transportation
summary: Omnibus transportation bill: raises certain speed limits, changes vehicle registration and drone, airport and multiuse path rules, and adds penalties for harming autonomous vehicles.

title: Gay and Transgender Panic Legal Defenses
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice
summary: Prohibits criminal defendants from using a nonviolent sexual advance or certain perceptions about another person as a defense or mitigation.

title: Respiratory Care Interstate Compact
summary: Creates the Respiratory Care Interstate Compact, letting licensed respiratory care practitioners practice across member states and setting up a commission, database and enforcement.

title: Human Trafficking Awareness
summary: Requires the Department of Education to identify a human trafficking awareness curriculum and requires public schools to ensure certain personnel receive related training.

title: Pub. Rec./Respiratory Care Interstate Compact
summary: Exempts portions of Respiratory Care Interstate Compact Commission meetings and related recordings and records from public meeting and public records requirements, with future review and repeal.

title: Energy Infrastructure Investment
summary: Authorizes the Public Service Commission to create an experimental rate mechanism to facilitate certain gas infrastructure investments, with rules and required rate contents.

title: Sexual Assault Education and Support
summary: Requires districts to appoint sexual assault response liaisons, creates a grant program, and adds sexual assault prevention and consent to grades 7-12 health instruction.

title: Veterans
summary: Revises statutes on Florida is for Veterans, Inc., veterans employment programs, grants, veteran fees, and veteran courts; the summary gives no specific changes.

title: Hands-free Driving
summary: Adds penalties and an EMS Trust Fund fine for careless driving while holding a phone, and limits officers' phone searches without a warrant or consent.

title: Florida Museum of Black History
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Establishes the Florida Museum of Black History with a governing board, a temporary exhibit location, a required report, and a $1.5 million appropriation.

title: Workers’ Compensation Insurance
summary: Lets workers' compensation insurers charge excess rates on a set share of policies, narrows the policy exclusions, and revises the guaranty association board.

title: Hunger-Free Campus Pilot Program
summary: Creates a Hunger-Free Campus Pilot Program within DACS for campus food insecurity and requires an OPPAGA study of food insecurity at Florida colleges and universities.

title: Biosolids Management
summary: Limits land application of Class AA biosolids to agronomic rates, requires application records, and restricts marketing of certain biosolids products unless requirements are met.

title: Organ and Tissue Donation
summary: Lets minors under 18 become organ and tissue donors with informed parental consent, requires DHSMV donor education, and revises the donor registry criteria.

title: Commercial Motor Vehicles Operated by Unauthorized Aliens
summary: Requires officers to detain unauthorized aliens driving commercial vehicles, impounds those vehicles, and imposes out-of-service orders and civil penalties on motor carriers, with penalty revenue funding FHP training and technology.

title: Elections
summary: Revises Florida election provisions on candidate qualifications, challenges to qualifications, party names and symbols, secure ballot intake stations, party committees, and voter guides.

title: Police Powers of the Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission
summary: Specifies conditions under which Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission officers and personnel may enter private property.

title: Nonpublic Religious Postsecondary Educational Institutions
summary: Removes religious colleges from the Commission for Independent Education's exemption, requiring unlicensed religious postsecondary institutions to meet new requirements, with criminal penalties for violators.

title: Charlie Kirk Day of Remembrance
summary: Designates October 14 each year as Charlie Kirk Day of Remembrance.

title: Home Inspectors
summary: Revises home inspector examination and disclosure requirements and requires inspectors to carry a specified errors and omissions insurance policy.

title: Expenditure of Public Funds by Local Governments
summary: Bars local governments from spending public funds on specified purposes and from funding lobbying, with Ethics Commission complaints and investigations enforcing it.

title: Activities of Special Districts
summary: Lets certain special districts jointly enter into, establish, or control specified joint relationships if they determine it is appropriate.

title: Athletics in Public K-12 Schools
summary: Requires the FHSAA to let coaches use personal funds for student welfare, presumes such use is not an impermissible benefit, and requires reporting and caps on amounts.

title: Education
summary: Revises assorted education laws on teacher shortages, military children, corporal punishment, private school screening, prekindergarten, K-12 standards, and educator certification.

title: Portable Wireless Device Repair
summary: Requires device and agricultural equipment manufacturers to share repair information and parts with owners and independent repair providers, with violations treated as unfair trade practices.

title: Tax/Documentary Stamp Tax to Fund Down Payment Assistance
summary: Adds a documentary stamp tax on residential purchases by investors who already own several properties, and uses the revenue to fund a first-time homebuyer assistance program.

title: Property Tax Benefits for Residential Properties
summary: Creates property tax exemptions and an assessment limit for certain long-term leased residential property, and a homestead exemption for first-time Florida homesteaders.

title: Trust Funds/Creation/First-time Homebuyer Assistance Program Trust Fund
summary: Creates a First-time Homebuyer Assistance Program Trust Fund, requires the Department of Revenue to transfer funds into it, and requires it to fund a homebuyer assistance program.

title: Personal Financial Literacy
summary: Revises the required one-half credit in personal financial literacy to add specified instruction content.

title: Medicaid Reimbursement for Private Duty Nursing Services
summary: Requires Medicaid managed care plans to reimburse home health agencies for private duty nursing in group homes at a set rate and bars rate cuts.

title: Office of Insurance Regulation
summary: Consolidates Office of Insurance Regulation responsibilities, adds cease-and-desist and injunction enforcement, requires fingerprint background checks, and mandates group capital reports for certain foreign-based insurance holding companies.

title: Elections of County Commissioners, District School Board Members, and District School Superintendents
summary: Sets county commission district rules by population, makes school boards mirror county commission membership, and revises school superintendent election terms.

title: Pub. Rec./Office of Insurance Regulation
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Consumer protection and business
summary: Creates privilege and public-records exemptions shielding insurance examination materials, proprietary insurer information, and certain biographical affidavits held by the Office of Insurance Regulation.

title: Education
summary: Revises various education provisions, including postsecondary governance, instructional materials, school grades, and reading interventions, and creates a rural teacher incentive program.

title: Temporary Cash Assistance Eligibility
summary: Bars denying Temporary Cash Assistance to certain individuals solely because of a drug trafficking conviction.

title: Electric Vehicle Battery Management
summary: Sets end-of-life requirements for EV propulsion batteries, bans landfilling of specified batteries, and imposes duties on haulers, facilities and other entities.

title: Awards of Attorney Fees in Insurance Claims
summary: Revises procedures and guidelines for attorney fee awards in insurance coverage declaratory actions and damages claims against insurers and surplus lines insurers.

title: Exceptional Student Education
summary: Requires the Department of Education to develop and implement a workforce credential program for students with autism or on modified curriculum, with reporting.

title: Required Instruction in Cursive Writing
summary: Requires students in specified grades to receive cursive writing instruction and demonstrate proficiency in cursive by the end of a set grade.

title: Campaign Communications
summary: Prohibits campaign-related calls and texts to specified voters, requires immediate cessation of such communications, and lets voters sue to enforce it.

title: Medical Debt
summary: Revises the definition of "extraordinary collection action" and defines "prohibited collection actions" in medical debt rules; the title alone does not show the substantive change.

title: Autism Spectrum Disorder Training for Law Enforcement Officers
summary: Shifts responsibility for establishing law enforcement employment training on autism spectrum disorder from FDLE to the Criminal Justice Standards and Training Commission, with set training requirements.

title: Fee Waivers
summary: Specifies that the existing requirement for certain colleges and career centers to waive out-of-state fees applies to undocumented students.

title: Traffic Infraction Enforcement
summary: Authorizes automated camera enforcement of railroad crossing safety and work-zone speed limits, with citations, notice requirements, penalties and hearings.

title: Nicotine Products
summary: Tightens retail nicotine dealer rules: permit inspection consent, fines for selling single-use nicotine devices, advertising limits, and location restrictions with relocation requirements.

title: Prohibition on Levying Ad Valorem Taxes on Tangible Personal Property
summary: Prohibits counties, school districts and municipalities from levying ad valorem taxes on tangible personal property and repeals related assessment and exemption provisions.

title: Services to Noncitizens
summary: Restricts state housing aid and down payment assistance to lawfully present people, requires all private employers to use E-Verify, and mandates status verification for certain remittances.

title: Education
summary: Omnibus education bill: adds written disclosure for fee-based blind services, lets students carry FDA-approved epinephrine delivery devices, and makes many technical revisions.

title: Department of Financial Services
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Omnibus bill making technical revisions to DFS and CFO duties, including insurance, funeral, boiler, bail bond and trust fund provisions.

title: Prohibitions Against Discriminatory Practices relating to 340B Entities and 340B Drugs
summary: Bars drug manufacturers, insurers, PBMs and other payors from discriminating against 340B entities and pharmacies on drug acquisition, delivery and reimbursement, enforceable under FDUTPA.

title: Capital Human Trafficking of Vulnerable Persons for Sexual Exploitation
summary: Creates a capital offense for adults who organize or profit from trafficking children under 12 or incapacitated persons for sexual exploitation, allowing life or death sentences.

title: Complaints Against Law Enforcement and Correctional Officers
summary: Requires officers under investigation to receive signed, sworn complaints before interrogation or discipline, and requires written, sworn complaints with penalties for false ones.

title: Disposition of Migrant Vessels
summary: Defines "migrant vessel" and adds such vessels to existing vessel relocation or removal rules, with procedures for law enforcement officers.

title: Biosolids Management
summary: Bars the DEP from issuing or renewing permits for certain biosolids land application sites where a nearby treatment facility accepts septage for higher-level treatment.

title: School District Personnel and Volunteers
summary: Requires school boards to adopt policies removing instructional staff from classrooms and requires staff to self-report certain arrests and judgments within set deadlines.

title: Labor Pool Act
summary: Bars labor pools from charging certain fees to third-party users who directly hire laborers, requires annual state registration, and revises court remedies.

title: Special Risk Class
summary: Expands Special Risk Class pension membership to certain prosecutors and special investigators and sets years of service for full retirement eligibility.

title: Products Liability Actions under the Florida Pesticide Law
summary: Bars products liability suits claiming failure to warn about a pesticide when its label meets specified conditions, with an exception.

title: The Florida Virtual School
summary: Revises Florida Virtual School governance, including board duties, admissions priorities, accountability measures, reporting, and new supplemental revenue sources.

title: Pub. Rec./Florida Is For Veterans, Inc.
summary: Creates a public records exemption for materials Florida Is For Veterans, Inc. receives or generates while administering the Veterans Florida Opportunity Program, with future review and repeal.

title: Florida Birth-Related Neurological Injury Compensation Association
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Revises the birth-injury compensation plan: removes time limits, expands covered expenses, requires insurer casualty coverage and assessments, and allows Insurance Trust Fund transfers.

title: Cybersecurity
topics: AI and technology; Government and administration
summary: Requires state agencies and local governments to report ransomware and cybersecurity incidents within set time periods, and revises Florida Digital Service duties and officer designations.

title: Fraudulent Entry of Residential Dwellings
summary: Creates a crime of fraudulent entry into a residential dwelling unit with criminal penalties, and lets landlords terminate rental agreements for such entry.

title: Construction Defects
summary: Limits construction defect claims, adds pre-suit notice, mediation and escrow requirements, and deems projects that pass permitting and inspections compliant with the Florida Building Code.

title: Memory Care
summary: Requires memory care providers to meet set operating standards and contract requirements, restricts who may advertise as memory care, and removes older Alzheimer's special-care provisions.

title: Electronic Prescribing
summary: Revises which health care practitioners must electronically transmit prescriptions for certain drugs, and revises the related exceptions.

title: Beach Management
summary: Changes how DEP designates critically eroded beaches and lets the Secretary require coastal local governments to develop specified plans.

title: Department of Health
summary: Revises the repeal date of the mRNA vaccine definition, requires medical marijuana centers to report theft or loss, and revises MOBILE Act licensure eligibility.

title: Caller Identification Information
topics: AI and technology; Consumer protection and business
summary: Prohibits misleading caller ID spoofing and requires telecom companies to verify caller identification, block manipulated calls and texts, and certify compliance with the FCC.

title: Windstorm Coverage by Citizens Property Insurance Corporation
summary: Requires Citizens Property Insurance to offer windstorm coverage to homeowners and commercial residential lines, with new underwriting, claims, and agent-sales requirements.

title: Social Work Licensure Interstate Compact
summary: Creates a multistate compact so social workers licensed in member states can provide services, including via telehealth, while following the host state's laws.

title: Combatting Illegal Immigration
summary: Creates a presumption that no release conditions will ensure an unauthorized alien's trial appearance, requiring prosecutors or courts to seek pretrial detention.

title: Child Welfare
summary: Omnibus child welfare bill: expands prosecution and custody powers, adds penalties for unaccompanied immigrant children, revises licensing exemptions, and waives sprinkler requirements for certain child-caring agencies.

title: Coverage for Orthotics and Prosthetics Services
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Requires Medicaid and private health insurers to cover specified orthotics and prosthetics services, bars claim denials, and requires annual insurer reports to OIR.

title: Revenue Administration
summary: Revises various property tax and assessment provisions, including terminology, valuation, agricultural land, millage, delinquencies, collection and interest, as described in a short summary.

title: Department of Financial Services
summary: Creates a fiscal oversight agency within DFS to audit local governments, bars certain local contracts, and adds reporting, hotline, training, and whistle-blower provisions.

title: Intestate Succession Involving a Person Born Out of Wedlock
summary: Revises the circumstances used to determine inheritance rights under intestate succession for persons born out of wedlock.

title: Resilient Buildings
summary: Authorizes tax credits for owners of resilient buildings, sets credit application and eligibility rules, and creates a Florida Resilient Building Advisory Council.

title: Education
summary: Revises unspecified provisions on the Department of Education, Florida College System institutions, state universities, and the K-20 system.

title: Unauthorized Aliens
summary: Bars unauthorized immigrants from certain licenses and state financial aid, requires employer and licensee verification of status, and adds penalties and driver presumptions.

title: Reading Interventions and Instruction
