summary: Revises reading requirements for Just Read, Florida!, the Florida Center for Reading Research, district reading plans and professional learning, and creates a reading coach allocation.

title: Patient Access to Records
summary: Requires licensed facilities, providers, and practitioners to give patients access to their records and reports within set timeframes after a request.

title: Dense Breast Tissue Screenings
summary: Allows certain patients to get ultrasound or other additional breast screenings without first getting a conventional mammogram.

title: Curators of Estates
summary: Revises probate rules for curators of estates, including bond requirements, removal and surcharge, and more frequent court reporting.

title: Licensing and Regulating Locksmith Services Businesses
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Creates state licensing for locksmith businesses and locksmiths, with background checks, insurance, training, and preemption of local locksmith regulation.

title: Legal Tender
summary: Ratifies specified legal tender rules solely to satisfy conditions on effectiveness of provisions, and repeals other legal tender provisions.

title: Trust Funds/Re-creation/Resilient Florida Trust Fund/DEP
summary: Re-creates the Resilient Florida Trust Fund within the Department of Environmental Protection.

title: Surrendering to Law Enforcement
summary: Requires law enforcement agencies to adopt a procedure for interviewing people who try to surrender on criminal charges without a warrant, and sets related detention and arrest authority.

title: Heavy Equipment Rental Recovery Fee
summary: Authorizes heavy equipment rental dealers to charge and keep a recovery fee, bars it from certain entities, and excludes it from taxable sales prices.

title: Behavioral Health Intervention Services
summary: Authorizes, if funded, a Medicaid demonstration pilot for behavioral health intervention services in specified counties, with a report to the Legislature and an expiration date.

title: Elections Impacted by Emergencies
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Sets election procedures for counties under emergency or FEMA aid, including voter rights, equipment reserves, public contingency plans, and limits on certain penalties and application requirements.

title: Protection of the Eastern Gulf Test and Training Range
summary: Prohibits building, operating, or expanding specified oil and gas facilities in certain Gulf waters and sovereignty lands, and bars related permits, leases, and state grants.

title: Jurisdiction of the Public Service Commission Relating to Water and Wastewater Systems
summary: Revises which nonprofit water and wastewater organizations are exempt from PSC jurisdiction, adds determination standards, and sets a waiting period before regaining exempt status.

title: Surface Waters
summary: Requires DEP to add habitat equivalency analysis to mitigation assessment, adds dredge-and-fill permit requirements, and makes permitted entities fully liable for resulting damage.

title: Higher Education
summary: Revises Florida higher education governance rules for boards, university presidents, postsecondary textbooks and instructional materials, and the Institute for Freedom in the Americas.

title: Educational Facilities
summary: Revises state rules for public educational facilities, including DOE duties, district facilities plans, building code requirements, inspections, and the Special Facility Construction Committee.

title: Opticianry
summary: Bill removes an optician's ability to delegate certain acts to unlicensed staff and ends the licensure exception for supervised employees.

title: Railroad Crossing Safety
summary: Requires the Department of Transportation to study advanced detection and monitoring systems at railroad crossings and report findings to the Governor and Legislature.

title: Linking Industry to Nursing Education Fund
summary: Revises the Linking Industry to Nursing Education Fund to allow nonmonetary contributions, change award uses and review rules, and authorize multiyear awards.

title: Community Services for Needy Individuals and Families
topics: Children and families; Government and administration
summary: Creates a voluntary Hope Florida Office within the Executive Office of the Governor to coordinate services, navigators, and care plans for needy individuals and families.

title: Veteran Benefit Payments to Minor Clients
summary: Requires DCF to receive, deposit and conserve certain veteran benefit payments for minor clients, and bars using those funds for certain purposes.

title: Pub. Rec./Hope Florida Participants
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Exempts personal identifying information that Hope Florida participants give the Hope Florida Office or Hope Navigators from public records law, with confidentiality duties and criminal penalties.

title: Local Government Finances
summary: Requires counties to post budget timelines, budget reduction exercises and development calendars online, and hold a budget workshop.

title: Public Accountancy
summary: Revises CPA licensing education and experience rules, adds international applicant criteria, changes ethics CE provider approval, and alters out-of-state CPA practice requirements.

title: Minimum Age for Firearm Purchase or Transfer
summary: Lowers the minimum age to buy a firearm and removes an exception limiting licensed sellers from transferring firearms to younger purchasers.

title: Tax Rebates for Low- to Moderate-income Residents
summary: Creates the Working Floridians Tax Rebate Program at DOR, granting state-funded rebates to low- to moderate-income residents who receive a specified tax credit and meet criteria.

title: Child Welfare
summary: Requires child-serving organizations to provide DCF-approved annual abuse training, creates accreditation, data collection, insurance discount plans, and an OPPAGA liability study.

title: Individualized Investigational Treatments
summary: Authorizes eligible facilities, manufacturers and patients to use individualized investigational treatments, limits liability, and bars licensing actions against providers and interference with access.

title: Testing of Cosmetics on Animals
summary: Prohibits making, selling, or offering cosmetics tested on animals, requires manufacturer permits with DBPR inspections, and sets criminal and administrative penalties.

title: Biomarker Testing
summary: Requires Medicaid managed care plans to cover certain colorectal cancer tests and lets Medicaid cover them, and requires AHCA to set biomarker testing reimbursement codes.

title: Newborn Screenings
summary: Requires newborns to be screened for biliary atresia starting on a set date, with DOH rule consultation and an education campaign.

title: Emergencies
summary: Revises Florida emergency provisions covering powers, duties and funding for emergency management agencies, medical care, special needs registries, shelters and debris management.

title: Estates
summary: Revises probate procedures for personal representatives, attorney fee awards, summary administration eligibility, and bank payments to a decedent's family.

title: Assessment of Property Used for Residential Purposes
summary: Bars property appraisers from counting value added by wind-resistance improvements when assessing residential property, which lowers assessed values.

title: Required Coverage for Imaging and Genetic Testing for Cancer Risk
summary: Requires private health plans to cover evidence-based cancer imaging and hereditary cancer genetic testing with no cost-sharing for specified individuals.

title: Health Care Practitioner Identification
summary: Bars non-physicians from using specified physician titles and specialist designations, making such use unlicensed practice of medicine, and revises HMO adverse-determination notice rules.

title: Department of Business and Professional Regulation
topics: Consumer protection and business; Immigration; Labor and employment
summary: Expands DBPR licensing and enforcement, adding work-authorization checks and license suspension, a nitrous oxide sales ban for dealers, and new board standards.

title: Fines for Public Nuisance Abatement
summary: Removes the cap on the total amount of fines that may be imposed for public nuisances, and revises how those fines are assessed and collected.

title: Insurance Customer Representative Licensing Qualifications
summary: Revises the methods by which applicants can qualify for an insurance customer representative license.

title: Infrastructure and Resiliency
summary: Gives the Department of Environmental Protection exclusive authority over coastal resiliency projects built through public-private partnerships, and requires it to post related information online.

title: Statewide Data Sharing of Secondhand Dealer, Secondary Metals Recycler, and Pawnbroker Transactions
summary: Requires secondhand dealers, secondary metals recyclers, and pawnbrokers to transmit specified transaction records to FDLE for statewide data sharing.

title: Cancer Treatment and Research
summary: Authorizes DOH to create a Florida Cancer Research Network with grant funding, provider data reporting requirements, and an online best-practices repository overseen by a collaborative.

title: Clinical Laboratory Personnel
summary: Lets applicants who meet specified criteria be deemed to satisfy minimum qualifications for clinical lab technologist or technician licensure, after providing proof and paying fees.

title: Education on Abusive Head Trauma
summary: Requires the Department of Health to adopt evidence-based parent education materials on abusive head trauma and phase in their distribution over several years.

title: Florida Hurricane Catastrophe Fund
summary: Revises Florida Hurricane Catastrophe Fund provisions on retention multiples, reimbursement contracts, and reinsurance; the summary does not state the specific changes.

title: Educational Dollars for Duty Program
summary: Requires the Educational Dollars for Duty Program to set aside funds for tuition assistance to spouses and children of active Florida National Guard members.

title: Self-storage Spaces
summary: Revises self-storage lien notice rules and requires rental agreements, entered on or after a set date, to include specified information.

title: Registration of Sexual Predators and Sexual Offenders
summary: Revises reporting and verification requirements for sexual predators and sexual offenders and the online reporting system they use.

title: Presumptive Medicaid Eligibility for Pregnant Women
summary: Expands Medicaid presumptive eligibility for pregnant women, extends their coverage period, and directs the state to seek federal approval for a longer period.

title: Home Health Care Services
summary: Revises home health agency administrator rules, lets contracted individuals provide specified home health services, and changes Excellence in Home Health Program criteria.

title: Harassment and Cyberstalking
summary: Revises the statutory definitions of "harass" and "cyberstalk"; the summary does not state how the changes affect penalties or conduct.

title: Mental Health and Substance Abuse
summary: Revises Florida provisions on mental health and substance abuse court hearings, guardian advocates, involuntary admissions, treatment, and patient records and data disclosure.

title: Rent Reporting to Credit Reporting Agencies
summary: Allows landlords to report tenants' rent payments to credit bureaus only with written consent, with opt-out rights, notice, and anti-retaliation protections.

title: Pub. Rec. and Meetings/Mental Health and Substance Abuse
summary: Closes mental health and substance abuse hearings to the public and expands public records exemptions for related petitions, applications and documents.

title: Task Force to Study Private Sector Retirement
summary: Creates a Retirement Savings Task Force within the Department of Commerce to study private sector retirement and report to specified persons.

title: Feasibility Study Relating to Statewide Pawn Data Database
summary: Requires FDLE to study the feasibility of a statewide pawn data database and report findings, contingent on a specific appropriation.

title: My Safe Florida Home Program
summary: Revises inspection requirements, grant eligibility, permitted grant uses, and a reporting requirement for the My Safe Florida Home hurricane-retrofit program.

title: Veterans' Assistance
summary: Directs the Department of Veterans' Affairs, subject to appropriation, to expand programs connecting veterans and families to services and benefits, host public events, and report.

title: Public Records Requests Pertaining to Law Enforcement Officers
summary: Requires people requesting public records about law enforcement officers to show certain identification, and requires custodians to keep a copy of it.

title: Expedited Service Fees
summary: Lets persons request expedited services from the Department of State for a fee, in a specified manner.

title: Towing Undrivable Vehicles
summary: Requires officers or wrecker operators to give drivers specified information after crash-related undrivable vehicles, and requires storage facilities to notify owners at set intervals.

title: Fees/Expedited Service Fees
summary: Creates filing fees for expedited services, specifies accepted payment methods, and makes those expedited service fees nonrefundable.

title: Right Turns at Intersections Using Traffic Infraction Detectors
summary: Prohibits certain right turns at intersections that use traffic infraction detectors and requires related signage.

title: School Attendance
summary: Revises unspecified provisions relating to school attendance; the summary gives no detail on the changes.

title: Florida Commission on Human Relations
summary: Removes a requirement that the Florida Commission on Human Relations send certain information by registered mail, plus technical changes.

title: Agency Agreements Providing Financial Assistance to Special Districts
summary: Authorizes certain special districts to include a specified provision in agency agreements that provide financial assistance; the provision is not described.

title: Penalties For Late-filed Disclosures or Statements of Financial Interests
summary: Bars fining officials for their first late financial disclosure or statement of financial interests when specified conditions are met.

title: Homeowners' Association Ombudsman
summary: Creates a state Homeowners' Association Ombudsman office within DBPR's condominium division, funded by the state, with powers including monitoring HOA election processes.

title: Coverage for Mammograms and Supplemental Breast Cancer Screenings
summary: Requires AHCA to cover yearly mammograms and supplemental breast cancer screenings for certain women, and requires private plans to cover supplemental screenings in certain circumstances.

title: Law Enforcement Officers and Other Personnel
topics: Criminal justice; Health care; Labor and employment
summary: Omnibus bill: allows amputee first responders to serve, creates police medals, bars kill switches, mandates prison minimums for attempted murder of justice personnel, and adds inmate infectious-disease testing and a grant program.

title: Provisional Licensure of Anesthesiologist Assistants
summary: Creates a provisional license for anesthesiologist assistants who meet criteria, under direct anesthesiologist supervision, expiring and nonrenewable.

title: Medical Coverage Assistance Program for Working Individuals with Disabilities
summary: Requires AHCA to create and run a Medicaid buy-in program for specified working individuals with disabilities, seeking federal approval first.

title: Pub. Rec./Judicial Qualifications Commission Employees
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Exempts personal identifying and location information of Judicial Qualifications Commission employees and their spouses and children from public records requirements, with retroactive application and repeal review.

title: Judicial Sales Procedures
summary: Sets court procedures for judicial and foreclosure sales of property, adds transparency requirements, and creates an alternate sale procedure for certain circumstances.

title: Florida Museum of History
summary: Creates a Florida Museum of History framework with state-local partnerships, advisory and operating boards, marketing plans, feasibility studies, and designated funding sources.

title: Research and Development Tax Credit
summary: Raises the annual combined cap on research and development tax credits that businesses may receive.

title: Water Safety for Cooling Towers, Domestic Water Holding Tanks, and Supplemental Disinfection Systems
summary: Creates registration, reporting, inspection and maintenance requirements for cooling towers, domestic water tanks, and supplemental disinfection systems, with civil and criminal penalties.

title: Cybersecurity Risks from Unmanned Aircraft Systems
summary: Requires the Florida Cybersecurity Advisory Council to assess cybersecurity risks from unmanned aircraft systems and develop recommendations.

title: Specialty License Plates
summary: Directs the DHSMV to create an Outsider specialty license plate and sets how the plate's sale fees are distributed and used.

title: Elections
summary: Revises Florida election laws on voter registration, citizenship verification, voter rolls, ballots, vote validation, and canvassing boards; the title gives no specifics.

title: Experimental Treatments for Terminal Conditions and Life-threatening Rare Diseases
summary: Lets licensed physicians prescribe and eligible facilities administer experimental treatments for terminal conditions and rare diseases, with DOH registry, reporting, and manufacturer price-concession duties.

title: Pub.Rec./Voter Registration Record Maintenance
summary: Exempts certain voter registration information received from federal agencies or other states under an MOU from public records requirements.

title: Pub. Rec./Experimental Treatments for Terminal Conditions and Life-threatening Rare Diseases
summary: Exempts certain information in a DOH report on experimental treatment outcomes and safety signals from public records disclosure.

title: Civil Remedy for Parental Abduction
summary: Creates civil cause of action for parents whose child is unlawfully abducted, with damages, attorney fees, and a statute of limitations.

title: Trust Funds/Creation/Experimental Treatments for Terminal Conditions and Life-threatening Rare Diseases
summary: Creates an Experimental Treatment Access Trust Fund and authorizes licensed experimental treatment centers to contribute to it or provide no-cost care for terminal and rare diseases.

title: Public Employees Relations Commisson
summary: Revises public employee union rules, including membership, dues, registration and certification, and increases fines for certain violations.

title: State Economic Development Contracts
summary: Requires employers to sign a Commerce agreement before receiving economic development incentives, with Attorney General recovery of funds if violations are found.

title: Pub. Rec./Public Employees Relations Commission
summary: Exempts PERC preliminary communications and personal identifying information of commissioners, hearing officers, and their families from public records requirements, with future repeal review.

title: Affordable Housing
summary: Requires counties and cities to allow multifamily and mixed-use housing on specified property, bars certain height and setback limits, and authorizes density bonuses for military-family housing donations.

title: Pawnbroker Transaction Forms
summary: Allows pawnbroker transaction forms to be kept in either digital or printed format.

title: Adverse Personnel Actions and Ethics Complaints
summary: Bars agencies and contractors from retaliating against employees who report ethics violations to the Commission on Ethics, and lets them seek remedies and file complaints.

title: Earned Wage Access Services
summary: Requires earned wage access providers to register with the Financial Services Commission, follow compliance rules, and face penalties for prohibited acts.

title: Family Court Report Cards
topics: Children and families; Government and administration
summary: Creates a family court pilot program and requires annual published report cards on each family law judge, with a public online database and a funded appropriation.

title: Nurse Registries
summary: Deems certain nurse registry practitioners independent contractors for Medicaid reimbursement and makes them ineligible for overtime and holiday pay.

title: Charter Schools
summary: Authorizes state universities and Florida College System institutions to sponsor job engine charter schools and requires annual tax funding to those sponsors.

title: Animal Cruelty Offenses
summary: Bans specified animal cruelty acts done in a child's presence or involving a child, and raises the severity ranking of animal fighting or baiting offenses.

title: Artificial Intelligence
topics: AI and technology; Children and families
summary: Restricts government AI contracts with certain entities, requires minor consent and safeguards for companion chatbots, and bars unconsented AI-generated likeness use in commerce.

title: Transportation
summary: Reworks Florida transportation law: removes disadvantaged business enterprise programs and the EV charging plan, revises project funding rules, and creates transportation research and academy bodies.

title: Local Business Tax Receipts
summary: Requires local business tax receipt applicants and renewers in certain transaction-based businesses to show an active OFAC license or authorization, with online renewals allowed by electronic certification.

title: Emergency Powers During a Declared Public Health Emergency
summary: Revises the requirements for declaring a public health emergency; the summary does not specify the changes.

title: Property Insurance Affiliates
summary: Requires property insurers to justify affiliate payments as fair and reasonable, structures affiliate compensation as fees for service, and gives OIR oversight, fund-transfer restriction, and registration powers.

title: Residential Property Appraisal
summary: Requires certain insurers' appraisal processes to make specified residential property valuations to provide specified coverage.

title: State Lotteries
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice
summary: Revises lottery procurement, retailer bond and remittance rules, and ticket-fraud rules, adding new false-claim and retailer-theft prohibitions with criminal penalties.

title: Safety of Students
summary: Revises Florida's school safety requirements, safe-school officer requirements, and the Chris Hixon, Coach Aaron Feis, and Coach Scott Beigel Guardian Program.

title: Deferred Compensation Plans for Public Employees
summary: Lets local governments and the state adopt automatic enrollment, with default contribution rates and default investments, in public employee deferred compensation plans.

title: Juvenile Justice
summary: Revises numerous juvenile justice provisions, including early truancy intervention, appointment of counsel, and use of detention.

title: Statewide Project for Missing Persons with Special Needs
summary: Revives and amends a statewide project for missing persons with special needs, run through autism and disability centers, with a $1,000,000 appropriation.

title: Compounding Pharmacies
summary: Lets certain patients choose individual treatment courses with provider guidance and lets compounding pharmacies access certain ingredients.

title: Commencement of Civil Actions
summary: Removes the registered-mail requirement for Human Relations Commission notices and sets specified time periods for commencing certain civil actions.

title: Elections
summary: Revises Florida election provisions covering elected positions, election administration, voter rights, registration, vote-by-mail, ballot types, and Election Day holiday.

title: THC
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice
summary: Tightens hemp extract and THC product rules: bans unpermitted, street and festival sales, restricts business locations, adds under-21 beverage limits, and sets penalties.

title: State Group Insurance Program Coverage for Diagnostic and Supplemental Breast Examinations
summary: Bars the state group insurance program from charging enrollees cost-sharing for diagnostic and supplemental breast examinations.

title: Florida Health Choices Program
summary: Renames the Florida Health Choices Program as an employee program, changes vendor and product rules, removes risk pooling, and drops some Insurance Code exemptions.

title: Lifetime Disabled Parking Permits
summary: Creates lifetime disabled parking permits for certain permanently disabled persons and lets older disability certificates be used to replace permits.

title: Florida Museum of History at the Town of Eatonville
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Creates a partnership-run Florida Museum of History in Eatonville with an advisory board, governing and operating boards, a marketing plan, an endowment, and specified construction and operating funding.

title: Assessment of Property with Decreasing Just Valuation
summary: Prohibits increasing assessed property valuations in years when the property's just value has decreased.

title: Structural Integrity Reserve Studies
summary: Limits structural integrity reserve studies to taller condo and co-op buildings and lets associations vote to waive or reduce reserve contributions.

title: Use of Digital Currency by the Department of Financial Services
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Creates a voluntary DFS stablecoin pilot allowing state acceptance of approved payment stablecoins, with issuer examinations, reporting, and rulemaking.

title: First in Your Family Florida Medical School Scholarship and Grant Program
summary: Creates a Department of Education scholarship and grant program to help first-generation students fund medical school.

title: Department of Environmental Protection
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Removes the Environmental Regulation Commission, requires solar permit applicants to add protections to erosion and sediment control plans, and ratifies specified Santa Fe and Ichetucknee minimum-flow rules.

title: Applicants for President of a State University or Florida College System Institution
summary: Defines the term "final group of applicants" for selecting presidents of state universities and Florida College System institutions.

title: Elections
topics: Elections and voting; Labor and employment
summary: Makes driver license and ID transactions count as voter registration, creates a Voting Rights Act commission, makes General Election Day a paid state holiday, and changes several election enforcement rules.

title: Improving Screening for and Treatment of Blood Clots
summary: Requires hospitals with emergency departments to adopt clot-risk policies and training, adds regular VTE data reporting and a registry, and revises nursing home and assisted living rules.

title: Cattle Grazing on State Land
summary: Requires state land managers to identify grazable lands and allow cattle grazing leases, while barring leases that convert native wildlife habitat to improved pasture.

title: Flood Zone Disclosures for Dwelling Units
summary: Requires landlords to disclose flood zone information before a tenancy begins and to notify current tenants when a unit's flood zone designation changes.

title: Presumption Against Liability for Owners and Principal Operators of Multifamily Residential Properties
summary: Bars multifamily property owners and operators from the liability presumption if a specified number of crimes were reported at the property within a set timeframe.

title: Resale-restricted Affordable Housing
summary: Requires property appraisers to consider resale restrictions on affordable housing when setting just valuation for property tax, and requires owners to file an application.

title: Consultant Pharmacists
summary: Lets consultant pharmacists provide medication management services in clinics owned by hospitals or by physicians employed by or contracted with hospitals.

title: Nursing Education Programs
summary: Tightens Board of Nursing oversight of nursing education programs, adding denial, revocation, reporting, probation, and termination rules tied to graduate passage rates.

title: Public Safety
summary: Requires counties and their agencies to route 911 and dispatch services through centralized call centers, redirects state emergency funds, and sets penalties for noncompliance.

title: Insurance Regulations
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Tightens reciprocal insurer affiliate-payment documentation and continuing care provider rules, while loosening some reserve and subscriber-contribution limits.

title: Licensure of Medical Spas
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Requires medical spas to be licensed, restricts their prescription drug acquisition and storage, mandates security controls and inspections, and adds adverse-incident reporting and penalties.

title: Resilient Buildings
summary: Creates a state tax credit for owners of resilient buildings and establishes a Florida Resilient Building Advisory Council.

title: Offenses Evidencing Prejudice
summary: Requires reclassifying offenses that show prejudice against a victim's political ideology as higher-level crimes, with added penalties.

title: Pub. Rec./Uniform Mitigation Verification Inspection Forms
summary: Creates public records exemptions for insureds' uniform mitigation verification inspection forms and related insurer database data, with future legislative review and repeal.

title: Portable Benefits Accounts for Independent Contractors and Sole Proprietors
summary: Authorizes certain parties to make voluntary contributions to portable benefits accounts for independent contractors and sole proprietors, subject to stated requirements.

title: Hurricane Mitigation Grants and Insurers' Regulations
summary: Tightens insurer rules: higher surplus requirements, bans on certain officers of insolvent insurers, and human review of claim denials; also conditions My Safe Florida Home grants.

title: Medical Coverage Assistance Program for Working Individuals with Disabilities
summary: Requires AHCA to seek federal approval for, then run, a Medicaid buy-in program letting working people with disabilities obtain Medicaid coverage.

title: Immigration and State-issued Identification
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice; Government and administration
summary: Creates an Office for New Americans, bars discrimination based on immigration status, removes sanctuary-policy limits and some immigration-based penalties, and bars enforcement near schools, child care and religious sites.

title: Structure and Legislative Oversight of Executive Agencies
summary: Restructures executive agencies: new offices require statute, certain appointments and reorganizations need legislative approval, some offices are dissolved, and the state CIO gets IT decision authority.

title: Attorney Fees and Costs for Motor Vehicle Personal Injury Protection Benefits
summary: Makes prevailing parties in health care provider suits over overdue motor vehicle PIP medical benefits entitled to reasonable attorney fees and costs.

title: Conversion Charter Schools
summary: Makes mediation apply to district-conversion charter school disputes over management plans and makes qualifying conversion charters eligible for capital outlay funding.

title: Mental Health and Substance Use Disorders
summary: Omnibus mental health bill revising crisis, treatment-plan, discharge and telehealth rules, plus reviews and behavioral health workforce provisions.

title: Tax Referendums
summary: Defines "local government spending analysis" and requires it be included on certain tax referendums.

title: Continuing Education for Building Code Administrators and Inspectors
summary: Removes an exemption so building code administrators and inspectors must meet certain continuing education requirements.

title: Optional Retirement Programs for Public Postsecondary Employees
summary: Revises contribution amounts and payment methods for specified optional retirement programs for public postsecondary employees.

title: Pub. Rec./Victims of Crime
summary: Expands public records exemptions to shield crime victims' names and identifying records, and makes certain records of officers who become victims confidential for limited periods.

title: Parkinson's Disease Registry
summary: Requires physicians and advanced practice nurses to report Parkinson's data to a statewide registry run by USF's institute, subject to appropriation, and revises a research board.

title: Public Officers and Employees
summary: Requires state agency heads, licensing board members, and state university trustees to be U.S. citizens and Florida residents, with trustees also allowed to be university graduates, starting on a specified date.

title: Pub. Rec./Parkinson's Disease Registry
summary: Creates a public records exemption for specified patient information in the Parkinson's disease registry, allowing certain disclosures, with future repeal review.

title: Trespass
summary: Creates enhanced criminal penalties for trespassing on law enforcement-maintained or secured property where specified notice is posted.

title: Boating Safety
summary: Expands boating ID requirements to all vessel operators, mandates ignition interlocks and a minimum prison term for BUI manslaughter, and revises boating education and penalties.

title: Agency Contracting with Media Reliability and Bias Monitors
summary: Bars state agencies from contracting with or supporting media reliability and bias monitors, and requires advertising contractors to certify compliance before contract renewals.

title: Statewide Provider and Health Plan Claim Dispute Resolution Program
summary: Creates a statewide program for resolving payment disputes between providers and health plans, and exempts certain disputed claims from review.

title: Pregnant Women in Custody
summary: Requires pregnancy tests on request for arrested women held over 72 hours, lets courts stay incarceration for pregnant women, and mandates services and data reporting.

title: Claims Against the Government
summary: Raises statutory liability caps for the state and its agencies and subdivisions on tort claims and revises related claim-filing and limitation rules.

title: Sexual Cyberharassment
summary: Revises penalties for sexual cyberharassment, adds a financial-gain prohibition, allows punitive damages in civil suits, and sets a prosecution statute of limitations.

title: Utility Services
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Adds public meeting conditions and annual PSC reporting for municipal utility service agreements, and preempts regional utilities authorities to the state.

title: Disclosure of Public Servants' Personal Information
summary: Lets certain public employees and officials notify data brokers in writing to stop releasing their personal data, and allows suits against brokers that fail to comply.

title: State Medicaid Program
summary: Requires work or community engagement for able-bodied Medicaid adults, revises drug spending controls with preferred drug lists, expands audits, and creates a managed care pilot.

title: Sexual Offenses by Persons Previously Convicted of Sexual Offenses
summary: Imposes mandatory minimum sentences for specified sexual offenses committed by people previously convicted of specified sexual offenses.

title: Representation by Counsel in Hearings on Petitions for Risk Protection Orders
summary: Gives respondents in risk protection order proceedings a right to an attorney, with appointed counsel for indigent respondents and specified compensation limits.

title: Aging and Disability Services
summary: Revises long-term care enrollment offers and DOEA duties, adds food and nutritional supplements to subsidies, and changes guardianship and property-sale rules.

title: Stormwater Treatment
summary: Restricts certain stormwater treatment activities while letting permit applicants buy pollution reduction credits and creating provisional permits for water quality enhancement.

title: My Safe Florida Home Program
summary: Creates grant provisions for wind and flood mitigation under My Safe Florida Home Program and sets inspection eligibility and state contribution limits.

title: Serving as Personal Representative After a Felony Conviction
summary: Creates an exception letting a non-incarcerated person with a felony conviction serve as a decedent's personal representative, subject to court criteria.

title: Industries and Professional Activities
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Reorganizes DBPR boards and office locations, requires a statutory-changes summary, revises retail nicotine dealer penalties, and expands division enforcement authority.

title: Advanced Nuclear Reactors
summary: Creates a state framework for advanced nuclear reactors and nuclear materials, with PSC, DOH and DEP permits, and revises utility planning and power plant review criteria.

title: Diabetes Management
summary: Creates a diabetes task force, lets pharmacists dispense 30-day supplies of diabetes drugs and devices, caps patient costs, and requires insurers to cover diabetes testing.

title: Financial Fraud
summary: Creates a Financial Crimes Intelligence Center within the Department of Legal Affairs to address financial fraud, with an annual report and department rulemaking.

title: Continuous Glucose Monitors
summary: Requires Florida Medicaid to seek any needed federal approval and cover continuous glucose monitors and supplies as a durable medical equipment benefit, with reimbursement.

title: Restrictions on Local Government Regulations After a Hurricane
summary: Limits local governments' ability to enforce certain land use regulations after a hurricane and requires pending applications to be processed in a specified manner.

title: Gambling
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Revises Florida gaming laws: bans betting on rigged athletic contests and slot machine trafficking, sets fantasy sports rules, restricts former commission employment, and preempts local gambling regulation.

title: Penalties for Prostitution and Related Acts
summary: Revises penalties for prostitution and related offenses; the summary does not say whether penalties increase or decrease.

title: Sudden Cardiac Arrest Informational Posters
summary: Requires the Department of Health to create an informational poster on treating sudden cardiac arrest and make it available electronically.

title: Autonomous Vehicle Safety
summary: Requires registered autonomous vehicles to meet specified standards and laws, and bars certain operations unless a licensed human operator is physically present.

title: Prohibited Practices in Consumer Debt Collection
summary: Addresses which prohibited practices in consumer debt collection apply; the text gives no specifics on the change.

title: Oaths of Classroom Teachers
summary: Requires classroom teachers to take a specified oath before beginning their teaching duties.

title: Housing
summary: Creates a housing department, adds tenant protections and landlord limits, and creates affordable housing tax credit and loan programs, plus land bank authority.

title: Systems of Law and Terrorist Organizations
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice; Education
summary: Creates new crimes for material support, military training, and membership in designated domestic terrorist organizations, and bars students who promote designated groups from certain public funds and fee waivers.

title: Voting Opportunities on Florida College System Institution and State University Campuses
summary: Requires early voting sites and polling places on Florida college and university campuses, exempts them from certain parking rules, and requires publicizing voting opportunities.

title: Pub. Rec./Terrorist Organizations
summary: Creates a public records exemption for information about Chief of Domestic Security designations of domestic or foreign terrorist organizations, with future review and repeal.

title: Pub Rec/Code Inspector Body Camera Recordings
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Exempts code inspector body camera recordings from public records requirements, with exceptions, and requires local governments to retain them for a specified period.

title: Charitable Giving
summary: Requires charities to honor donor-imposed restrictions, lets donors file enforcement complaints, and requires notice and alternatives if a restriction can't be met.

title: Enforcement of the Florida Building Code
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration; Housing
summary: Requires local governments to spend excess building-code fee revenue on stormwater system repairs, and bars state funds to noncompliant or audited localities.

title: Use of Driver License Information for Fraud Prevention
topics: AI and technology; Civil rights and liberties; Transportation
summary: Lets DHSMV share driver license data with consent for fraud prevention, while barring identity verifiers from retaining it and third parties from storing or selling it without consent.

title: Pub. Rec./Lethality Assessment Forms
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice
summary: Creates a public records exemption for domestic violence lethality assessment forms and allows their sharing with domestic violence centers and state attorneys.

title: Abandoned and Historic Cemeteries
summary: Authorizes Florida Forever funds to buy lands preserving historic cemeteries, requires access easements to abandoned private cemeteries, and lists them in the Master Site File.

title: Dog Breeding
summary: Requires dog breeders to register and facilities to be inspected, adds microchipping duties, creates a public database and whistleblower program, and sets civil and criminal penalties.

title: Housing for Veterans
summary: Creates a veterans housing pilot program in certain counties that funds landlord property-management incentives through a trust fund, subject to appropriation.

title: Education
summary: Revises Florida education provisions on early warning systems, reading and math deficiencies, report cards, the New Worlds Reading Initiative, and school grades; details are not given.

title: Trust Fund/Creation/Vacancy Relief and Risk Mitigation Trust Fund/Florida Housing Finance Corporation
summary: Creates a Vacancy Relief and Risk Mitigation Trust Fund within the Florida Housing Finance Corporation, with unexpended balances reverting and future review or termination provided.

title: Tax On Aviation Fuel
summary: Repeals Florida's aviation fuel tax provisions, including related refunds, administration, distribution of proceeds, and carrier registration and reporting.

title: Trust Funds/Creation/Historic Cemeteries Trust Fund/Department of State
summary: Creates a Historic Cemeteries Trust Fund within the Department of State's Division of Historical Resources, with moneys disbursed by the division for historic cemetery purposes.

title: Emergency Services
summary: Removes limits on warning lights for certain emergency vehicles, changes ambulance license exemptions, and bars volunteer ambulance services from certain state grant programs.

title: Surrogacy and Assisted Reproduction
summary: Regulates surrogacy and assisted reproduction by licensing clinics, donor banks and agencies, requiring inspections, background checks, escrow accounts, and court validation of surrogacy contracts.

title: Kratom Products
summary: Revises Florida's kratom consumer protection law to allow mail-order, internet and remote kratom sales, authorize specified businesses to sell it, and ban ingestion near schools.

title: Medical Debt Protection and Comprehensive Health Care for Residents
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Creates a state Florida Health Plan, bars sales of certain health insurance policies after a set date, and adds medical debt billing and credit-reporting protections.

title: Claims for Adverse Reactions to Vaccines and Drugs under the Medicaid and Medically Needy Programs
summary: Requires AHCA to expedite review and payment of Medicaid and medically needy claims for adverse reactions to vaccines, immunizing agents, and emergency countermeasure drugs.

title: Maximum Millage Rates for the 2027-2028 Fiscal Year
summary: Sets the method for determining maximum county and school millage rates for fiscal year 2027-2028, with a future repeal provision.

title: Violation of State Immigration Law
summary: Requires FDLE to fine certain violations of state immigration law, creates a compensation program for certain residents, and allows suits against local governments and law enforcement agencies.

title: Trust Funds/Creation/Florida Health Plan
summary: Creates a Florida Health Fund and a state Florida Health Plan that provides health care coverage, with an appropriation and retiree eligibility.

title: Housing
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration; Housing
summary: Omnibus housing bill: removes rent-control preemption, creates land bank, tax credit and loan programs, insurance pilot and rate limits, and limits certain entities' purchases of homes.

title: Gender Identity Employment Practices
summary: Bars employers from requiring staff to use pronouns that don't match their sex, restricts sex-related form options, bans mandatory gender training, and protects employees' religious and belief-based views.

title: Workforce Notice Requirements
summary: Authorizes employers to post required workplace notices on the Internet, accessible to employees or to employees and the general public.

title: Division of Labor Standards
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Creates a Division of Labor Standards and an advisory board, and revises state minimum wage provisions on worker rights, contracts, complaints, liability and recordkeeping.

title: My Safe Florida Condominium Pilot Program
summary: Revises the My Safe Florida Condominium hurricane mitigation grant pilot, adding household income verification, allowing mixed-income condos, and requiring a share of opening protection work.

title: Reproductive Health Care
summary: Establishes specified reproductive rights for individuals and bars local governments from regulating individual reproductive freedom.

title: Pricing Based on Collection of Consumer Information
topics: AI and technology; Consumer protection and business
summary: Makes surveillance pricing, which is pricing based on consumer data, unlawful, requires clear disclosures for such offers, and sets penalties; waivers of these rights are void.

title: Storage of Handguns in Private Conveyances and Vessels
summary: Requires safe storage of handguns in private vehicles and vessels, a law enforcement awareness campaign, and county ordinances on parents of children who steal handguns from them.

title: Pub. Rec. and Meetings/Social Work Licensure Interstate Compact
summary: Creates public records and public meetings exemptions for the Social Work Licensure Interstate Compact and its committees, with future legislative review and repeal.

title: Combatting Illegal Immigration
summary: Revises the voter registration oath and creates criminal penalties for unauthorized aliens who register or vote, and for those who aid them.

title: Availability of Marijuana for Adult Use
summary: Authorizes adult purchase of marijuana products and home cultivation rules, sets facility requirements, and lets people petition to expunge certain marijuana convictions.

title: K-12 School Lunches and Breakfasts
summary: Requires K-12 public schools to join federal school lunch and breakfast programs, sets meal service rules, limits debt collection for meals, and provides state breakfast reimbursement.

title: Harm to Minors
summary: Requires tablet and smartphone makers to enable content filters on activation in Florida, adds civil and criminal liability, and raises penalties for certain offenses involving minors.

title: Computer Science Education and Certification
summary: Adds AI instruction to high school computer science courses and requires new computer science subject area certification coverages and related competency recommendations and exams.

title: Parental Rights
summary: Requires parental consent and notice for minors' health services, school surveys, and biofeedback devices, and expands parents' rights to review student surveys.

title: Prosecution of Defendants
summary: Removes the insanity affirmative defense, limits mental-disease defenses to lack of culpable mental state, narrows sentencing mitigation, and allows court-ordered mental health treatment as part of sentences.

title: Medicaid Eligibility for Medical Assistance and Related Services
summary: Extends Medicaid eligibility to specified low-income adults, expanding who qualifies for medical assistance.

title: Medicaid Dental Pilot Program
summary: Creates a three-year Medicaid dental pilot in Region B for persons with disabilities, with covered benefits, reimbursement rules, managed care participation, and a later report.

title: Veterinarian Licensure by Endorsement
summary: Revises the requirements for licensing veterinarians by endorsement; the summary does not state the direction of the change.

title: Interscholastic Activities
summary: Revises rules for private school students in FHSAA sports, FHSAA board and appeals committees, and certain appeals, and requires specified information be posted online.

title: Licensure by Endorsement to Practice Dentistry and Dental Hygiene
summary: Bill addresses dentistry and dental hygiene licensure by endorsement and bars specified persons from licensure through the interstate mobility act.

title: Panelized Construction
summary: Authorizes local governments to approve panelized construction, treating it as open construction subject only to local permitting and exempting certain units from dwelling-unit code rules.

title: Corporations
topics: Consumer protection and business; Taxes and budget
summary: Reduces filing fees for certain corporate documents, requires a refund of certain taxes paid in a specified year, and recommends creating a statewide business court.

title: Refund of Overpayments Made by Patients
summary: Requires certain licensed health care providers to refund patient overpayments on time, with AHCA able to fine noncompliance and disciplinary grounds revised.

title: Specialty License Plates/Italian-American Culture License Plate
summary: Directs the DHSMV to develop an Italian-American culture license plate and sets how the plate's sale fees are distributed and used.

title: Criminal Justice Accountability
summary: Expands the Attorney General's authority over prosecutions and the commission, and requires state attorneys to collect data on unassigned law enforcement referrals.

title: Pub. Rec./Uterine Fibroid Research Database
summary: Creates a public records exemption for certain records and personal identifying information submitted to DOH for a uterine fibroid research database.

title: Civil Liability for the Wrongful Death of an Unborn Child
summary: Creates civil liability for wrongful death of an unborn child, shielding mothers and providers for lawful care while letting parents recover certain damages.

title: Approval of Data Center Facilities
topics: AI and technology; Environment and energy
summary: Requires data centers to disclose specified information, including in approval applications, with DEP publishing it online and penalties for noncompliance; DEP must adopt rules.

title: Entities that Boycott Israel
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Expands state bans on investments and contracts with entities that boycott Israel, and bars arts and cultural grants to entities that boycott or discriminate.

title: Use of Substances Affecting Cognitive Function
summary: Requires medical examiners to report substance findings for violent-offender autopsies, lets law enforcement obtain certain patient records without consent, and mandates substance-effects training for school safety staff.

title: Criminal Justice
topics: Children and families; Criminal justice; Elections and voting
summary: Omnibus criminal justice bill: limits landlord criminal-record checks, drops full-payment rule for voting rights restoration, narrows incarceration-cost liability, revises juvenile direct file, and allows retroactive resentencing.

title: Domestic Animals
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice
summary: Requires pet dealers to disclose financing terms and provide medical records, expands consumer remedies, and posts animal cruelty offender information online.

title: Utility Services
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Limits municipal utility revenue use and outside-customer rates, adds PSC reporting, and bars local limits on fuel sources and appliances.

title: Food Waste Reduction
summary: Requires the Department of Education to develop a food waste reduction policy for K-12 schools, with adoption rates and district requirements.

title: Prearranged Transportation Services
summary: Bans impersonating rideshare drivers with criminal penalties, exempts TNC-purchased trips from bus transit rules, and lets the transportation disadvantaged commission contract with alternative providers.

title: Lewd or Lascivious Acts
summary: Repeals the unnatural and lascivious acts statute and creates a new criminal prohibition on lewd sexual conduct while observing children under 16, with penalties.

title: Prohibitions Against Discriminatory Practices Relating to 340B Entities and 340B Drugs
summary: Bars drug manufacturers and insurers or PBMs from discriminating against 340B entities and contract pharmacies, with violations treated as deceptive trade practices.

title: Home Health Aide for Medically Fragile Children Program
summary: Revises Florida's Medicaid home health aide program for medically fragile children, including training, certification, a utilization cap, hour justifications, and federal waiver requirements.

title: Assisting Self-murder
summary: Creates criminal penalties for specified acts involving self-murder, which is the assisting-suicide conduct the bill targets.

title: Aiding Unmarried Minors
summary: Increases criminal penalties for knowingly sheltering or aiding unmarried minor runaways and creates a presumption about knowledge of the minor's age, with a defense.

title: Reports of Child Abuse, Abandonment, or Neglect
summary: Requires child abuse reports to be transferred to law enforcement, creates a rebuttable presumption, and bars DCF from returning children to parents without court determinations.

title: Emergency Preparedness for Life-sustaining Medical Services
summary: Requires specified health entities, plans and programs to adopt flexibilities and waivers during emergencies, effective upon triggering conditions, with extensions by OIR or AHCA.

title: Government-facilitated Purchases and Sales of Individual and Small Employer Health and Dental Plans
summary: Creates a Florida Health Insurance Exchange within OIR to facilitate individual and small employer plan purchases, certify health and dental plans, and contract with vendors.

title: Siblings Placed in Out-of-home Care
summary: Lets separated foster siblings seek court-ordered visitation or contact, limits court denials, and extends sibling contact rights to postadoption and permanent guardianship cases.

title: Fees/Government-Facilitated Purchases and Sales of Individual and Small Employer Health and Dental Plans
summary: Lets the Florida Health Insurance Exchange charge assessments and user fees to health carriers to generate funding, and requires it to publish financial information online.

title: Emergencies
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Revises Florida emergency provisions covering tenant rights, post-emergency elections, emergency plans, shelters, funding, and debris management.

title: Crimes Evidencing Prejudice Against Disabled Adults
summary: Requires higher penalty classification for crimes shown to be motivated by prejudice against disabled adult victims.

title: Contracts for Postadoption Contact
summary: Lets adoption parties sign enforceable written contracts for a child's postadoption contact with legal relatives, with court filing, enforcement, and termination rules.

title: Beverage Law
summary: Authorizes contract and alternating-proprietorship brewing with new notice, reporting, and separation requirements, and bars manufacturers or vendors from certain brewing arrangements.

title: Materials Harmful to Minors
summary: Defines "harmful to minors" and revises the list of classroom materials subject to parent or resident objection.

title: Blood Testing Required Following Civilian-involved Shootings
summary: Requires civilians who discharge a firearm causing injury or death to submit to a blood test, with penalties for refusal and confidentiality rules.

title: Property Insurance Policies
summary: Lets insurers offer roof coverage on reimbursement schedules or stated-value limits, with requirements, and bars stated-value sublimits from applying to roofs in certain cases.

title: Use of Audioconferencing by Community Associations
summary: Lets condominium, cooperative and homeowners' associations hold meetings and elections by audioconference, and requires audio recordings to be kept as official records.

title: Contracting with Foreign Countries of Concern
topics: AI and technology; Government and administration
summary: Bars state and local governments from certain contracts with foreign-concern-linked entities, requires bidder affidavits, and prohibits labs from using specified foreign-made software.

title: Schools of Hope
summary: Authorizes mutual management plans so districts and Schools of Hope can share specified costs for district facilities Schools of Hope use.

title: Parkinson's Disease
summary: Creates a Parkinson's disease research consortium at USF and a board that directs it and adopts an annual research plan.

title: Homestead Tax Exemptions
summary: Clarifies that certain repair and maintenance is not an improvement for homestead assessments and revises the penalty and interest for unlawfully received homestead exemptions.

title: Pub. Rec./Parkinson's Disease Research Program Registry
summary: Creates a public records exemption for a Parkinson's Disease Registry holding background information on people served by the research program, with future repeal review.

title: Conditional Geriatric Release
summary: Creates a conditional geriatric release program letting eligible elderly prisoners apply for early release, at the Commission on Offender Review's sole discretion.

title: Financial Services
summary: Revises assessment payment schedules, credit union officer expense reimbursement, and timeframes for bank and trust company formation and opening.

title: Penalties for Driving Under the Influence
summary: Increases penalties and driver license or driving privilege revocation periods for driving under the influence.

title: Pub. Rec./Judicial Qualifications Commission Employees
summary: Exempts personal identifying and location information of current or former Judicial Qualifications Commission employees and their families from public records disclosure.

title: Mental Health Programs for Gun Violence Prevention
topics: Children and families; Guns and weapons; Health care
summary: Creates a $500,000 Gainesville gun violence prevention pilot offering mental health referrals and alternatives to incarceration for specified youth, with reporting and a future repeal.

title: Attorney Fee Awards in Insurance Actions
summary: Requires courts to award attorney fees to prevailing parties in suits by insureds or beneficiaries against insurers and surplus lines insurers.

title: Products Liability for Firearms
summary: Shields firearm manufacturers from liability for certain torts based on product features or standards not required by federal law.

title: Uterine Fibroid Research Database
summary: Requires the Department of Health to add uterine fibroids to a specified list of diseases for a research database.

title: Admissibility of Evidence in Civil Cases
summary: Revises which evidence may be used to prove past and future medical expenses in personal injury and wrongful death lawsuits.

title: Insurers' Liabilities and Responsibilities
topics: AI and technology; Consumer protection and business
summary: Requires human review of insurer claim denials, bars AI and automated systems as the basis for denials, and lets OIR audit denials.

title: Postsecondary Education
summary: Requires Florida College System institutions and state universities to report, train on, and publish specified enrollment and course information.

title: Central Service Technician Services
summary: Limits hospitals and surgical centers to employing central service technicians who meet set criteria, requires certification and continuing education, and requires employment verification on request.

title: Motor Vehicle Data Privacy and Autonomy
topics: AI and technology; Consumer protection and business
summary: Restricts vehicle manufacturers' use of operator data, requires owner access and control via a standardized interface, and makes violations unfair trade practices.

title: Vexatious Litigants
summary: Expands the vexatious litigant law to more actions, widens designation criteria, adds sanctions, and bars clerks from accepting certain filings from designated litigants.

title: Coconut Grove Playhouse, Miami-Dade County
summary: Requires Miami-Dade County to transfer its property interest in the Coconut Grove Playhouse to the Town of Bay Harbor Islands and sets the town's duties.

title: Adoption of Comprehensive Plan Amendments
summary: Revises the expedited state review process for local comprehensive plan amendments; the summary does not state the direction of change.

title: Parity for Nonnursing Services Under Long-term Managed Care Plans
summary: Requires Florida's Medicaid agency to reimburse licensed providers of nonnursing long-term care services at the same or higher rate as unlicensed providers, adjusted annually.

title: Educational Choice
summary: Expands the permitted uses of Family Empowerment Scholarship and Florida Tax Credit Scholarship funds to cover specified tuition and fees, and defines related terms.

title: Insulin Administration by Direct Support Professionals and Relatives
summary: Lets unlicensed direct-support professionals and client relatives in group homes administer prescribed insulin, with immunity from liability and penalties.

title: Pub. Rec./Stricken Matters
summary: Creates a public records exemption for matters stricken by a court in noncriminal cases, if the court makes specific findings.

title: Service of Process
summary: Expands the hours registered agents must keep their office open and revises service-of-process rules for businesses, receivers and substituted service on the Secretary of State.

title: School Teacher Training and Mentoring Program
summary: Establishes a teacher training and mentoring program within DOE, sets requirements for DOE, mentors and mentees, and authorizes stipends.

title: Official Actions of Local Governments with Respect to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Prohibits counties and municipalities from taking official action related to diversity, equity, and inclusion, with a penalty and a cause of action against violators.

title: Exceptions to the Limitation on Termination of Pregnancies
summary: Revises the definition of fatal fetal abnormality and the medical exception criteria for abortion limits, and requires one physician rather than two to make the determinations.

title: Water Quality Improvements
summary: Orders studies on lead in drinking water and algal blooms, requires water quality plans and project prioritization, and directs actions to keep reducing Lake Okeechobee nitrogen.

title: Abandoned Cemeteries
summary: Requires the state to obtain an easement for access to abandoned cemeteries located on private property.

title: Farming Community High-speed Broadband Development Incentives
topics: AI and technology; Taxes and budget
summary: Creates a state grant program for broadband infrastructure in underserved farming communities, plus farmer tax credits and public outreach and training.

title: Local Government Salaries and Benefits
summary: Requires voter referendums before local county, municipal, and special district governing bodies can raise their members' pay or benefits, with local governments paying election costs.

title: Fees/Dog Breeders
summary: Requires dog breeders to pay DACS registration and renewal fees, with a cap on fee amounts and an annual renewal notice to certificateholders.

title: Dog Breeding Trust Fund
summary: Creates a Dog Breeding Trust Fund within DACS with a stated purpose and source of funds, and provides for future review or termination.

title: Historical Records Concerning Enslaved Individuals
summary: Prohibits certain sale and trade acts involving enslaved individuals, sets penalties, and has the Attorney General enforce civilly through DOS oversight and an online reporting system.

title: Family Law Proceedings
summary: Requires court reporters or audio recording for certain family proceedings, allows jury trials in dissolutions, requires judge findings on certain allegations, and creates a pilot project.

title: Statewide, Standardized Assessments
summary: Requires statewide standardized assessments and parts of a screening system in specified languages, and lets parents bar non-English versions.

title: Storage of Handguns in Private Conveyances and Vessels
summary: Creates storage requirements for handguns in private vehicles and vessels, requires a law enforcement promotional campaign, and revises firearm transfer warnings.

title: First Responders
summary: Renames the EMS Trust Fund as the First Responders Trust Fund, allows its money for first responder mental health grants, and raises certain traffic fines to boost it.

title: Ownership of Single-family Residential Property by Business Entities
summary: Prohibits certain business entities from buying single-family homes and then leasing or renting them; the Attorney General may sue violators.

title: Solar Facilities
summary: Lets counties require decommissioning of certain solar facilities, presume end of useful life, demand financial assurance, and complete decommissioning if owners fail to act.

title: Food and Hemp Products
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice; Taxes and budget
summary: Restricts hemp and hemp extract sales, advertising and distribution, bans child-appealing products and THC beverage sales at certain locations, and appropriates $2 million.

title: Protection of Historic Monuments and Memorials
summary: Prohibits removing or altering historic monuments on public property, allows civil suits and penalties against officials, and withholds state funds from noncompliant localities.

title: Labor Regulations
summary: Narrows Florida's private-sector whistleblower protections by requiring employees to give written notice and a chance to correct, and to prove employer reasons false.

title: Comprehensive Health Care for Residents
summary: Creates a Florida Health Plan covering all state residents, with no cost-sharing, and bans certain private health insurance policies from sale after a set date.

title: Trust Funds/Comprehensive Health Care for Residents
summary: Creates a Florida Health Fund to finance a Florida Health Plan for residents, with an indeterminate appropriation and claims paid from the fund.

title: Cardiac Emergencies
summary: Requires school districts to provide basic first aid training to certain students and requires each public school to adopt a cardiac emergency plan with defibrillator rules.

title: Waste Incineration
summary: Prohibits local governments and DEP from issuing construction permits for certain new solid waste or waste-to-energy incineration facilities in specified areas.

title: Wine Container Size Limitations
summary: Revises the exception to the maximum allowable capacity for individual wine containers sold in Florida.

title: Impact of Perimenopause and Menopause on Women's Health
summary: Creates a DOH perimenopause and menopause policy workgroup and requires public information on perimenopause and menopause.

title: Rebuttable Presumption for Certain Deaths
summary: Creates a rebuttable legal presumption that an alleged victim's death resulted from a controlled substance when that substance is found present.

title: Prohibition of Considering Race or Ethnicity in Government Contracting
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Bars government awarding bodies from considering race or ethnicity in contracts and grants, reduces procurement goals, and voids conflicting state and local policies.

title: Criminal Offenses
summary: Creates criminal penalties for willfully or maliciously harassing or cyberstalking justice system personnel, revises aggravated stalking elements, and changes when courts may issue arrest warrants.

title: Stem Cell Therapy
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Authorizes physicians to perform FDA-unapproved stem cell therapies, with requirements for cell sourcing, manufacturing, advertising notice, and signed patient consent.

title: Employee Wages and Salary
summary: Prohibits employers and employment agencies from certain wage and salary practices, such as seeking salary history, with recordkeeping, civil penalties and enforcement.

title: Offenses Involving Firearms with Bump Stocks
summary: Revises the statutory definition of "machine gun" for firearm statutes, with offenses involving firearms with bump stocks; details are not in the text provided.

title: Early Education Workforce Support
summary: Creates a DOE pilot program to support the early education workforce, with program requirements to be set by the bill.

title: Warehouse Distribution Centers
summary: Requires certain warehouse employers to create safety committees and sets rules on quotas, notices, employee protections, recordkeeping, and inspections.

title: Ownership Interests of Licensed Alcoholic Beverage Vendors
summary: Allows retail alcoholic beverage vendors to hold ownership interests in alcohol production in certain instances, relaxing existing separation between tiers.

title: Access to Medicaid Providers
summary: Requires AHCA to include specified access requirements in Medicaid managed care plan contracts and defines 'outside of regular business hours.'

title: Tax Exemptions for Surviving Spouses of Quadriplegics
summary: Lets surviving spouses of certain quadriplegics carry over a tax exemption under specified circumstances.

title: Law Enforcement, Correctional, and Institutional Security Specialist Officers
summary: Sets a salary floor for correctional staff relative to sworn officers, requires annual raises and a DMS compensation report, and lets the Governor deploy correctional officers in emergencies.

title: Florida Bright Futures Scholarship Program
summary: Requires public high schools to establish a Bright Futures Scholarship mentorship program for students, with program requirements set out in the bill.

title: Former Phosphate Mining Lands
summary: Sets conditions for lawsuits against former phosphate mine sites, lets landowners record notice of them, and has DOH survey radiation on petition.

title: Community Violence Task Force
summary: Creates a Community Violence Task Force within FDLE, requires state agency assistance and a report, and protects confidential information the task force receives.

title: Acupuncture
summary: Revises acupuncture licensure requirements and exempts certain persons from regulations governing the practice of acupuncture.

title: Florida Bright Futures Scholarship Program
summary: Requires public middle schools to administer the PSAT/NMSQT to eligible students, funds the assessments and test prep, and revises Bright Futures award eligibility.

title: Criminal Offenses Against Law Enforcement Officers and Other Personnel
summary: Increases penalties for resisting arrest, battery, assault, and manslaughter against law enforcement and other specified personnel, and raises battery's offense severity ranking.

title: Combatting Illegal Immigration
summary: Creates state criminal penalties for certain illegal entries and reentries by aliens, requires notifications after arrests, and allows civil suits against those who aid illegal entry.

title: Youth Conflict Resolution and Peer Mediation Pilot Program
summary: Creates a pilot program for youth conflict resolution and peer mediation within the Community School Grant Program, with program requirements.

title: Responsible Firearm Safety Awareness Month
summary: Designates June as Responsible Firearm Safety Awareness Month and encourages agencies and organizations to sponsor related events.

title: Interest on Trust Accounts Program Interest Rates
summary: Requires the CFO to set quarterly interest rate alternatives for IOTA accounts, which participating banks must choose from to pay interest to Funding Florida Legal Aid.

title: Parental Rights
summary: Expands parental consent and review rights over minors' treatment, school surveys, and biofeedback devices, and adds parental consent requirements for certain substance abuse services.

title: Criminal Offenses Against Law Enforcement Officers and Other Personnel
summary: Revises assault, battery, resisting arrest and resisting-officer offenses and adds enhanced punishment for other offenses committed against specified officers.

title: Payment Stablecoin
summary: Brings payment stablecoin issuers under Florida's money services law, requiring licensure or exemption and state or federal supervision, and clarifies that these stablecoins are not securities.

title: Transportation Facility Designations
summary: Creates honorary designations for certain transportation facilities in specified counties and directs DOT to erect markers.

title: Offices of Criminal Conflict and Civil Regional Counsel
summary: Lets courts appoint conflict counsel from another region or private counsel in certain cases, and requires the Justice Administrative Commission to pay appointed counsel, subject to appropriation.

title: Florida Institute for Human and Machine Cognition, Inc.
summary: Shifts subsidiary-authorization power to the institute's board and makes the institute, not UWF's trustees, certify annual information; allows subsidiaries to enter affiliation agreements.

title: Pub. Rec./Current Appellate Court Clerks
summary: Exempts personal identifying and location information of current appellate court clerks and their families from public records requirements, with future legislative review and repeal.

title: Parole
summary: Requires the Florida Commission on Offender Review to give the Legislature statistical analysis, and requires DOC to share information with the commission for review.

title: Pub. Rec./ Pawnbroker Transactions
summary: Creates a public records exemption for pawnbroker transaction records delivered to FDLE, with future legislative review and repeal.

title: Criminal Rehabilitation
summary: Reduces the share of sentence defendants must serve from 85% to 72% and expands gain-time and rehabilitation credits.

title: Investments and Deposits of Public Funds
topics: Consumer protection and business; Taxes and budget
summary: Allows state funds and the SBA pension trust fund to invest in digital assets and ETPs, permits lending of digital assets, and sets custody limits.

title: Treatment of Inmates
summary: Specifies rights of state prison inmates, requires a written copy of those rights be given to each inmate, and authorizes relief for deprivation of rights.

title: Home Hardening Products
summary: Creates a sales tax exemption for certain home hardening products, provided as a refund, and sets Department of Revenue procedures for issuing those refunds.

title: Coverage for Mammograms and Supplemental Breast Cancer Screenings
summary: Requires Medicaid and private health plans to cover yearly mammograms and supplemental breast cancer screenings for certain women.

title: Florida Public Service Commission
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Revises Public Service Commission membership and requires settlement orders to include specified information, return-on-equity limits, rate-request schedules, and an annual report.

title: Comprehensive Waste Reduction and Recycling Plan
summary: Directs DEP to develop a comprehensive waste reduction and recycling plan and publish a report, and lets businesses voluntarily report recycling amounts.

title: Gambling
summary: Revises many Florida gambling laws, including gaming machines, sports betting, internet gambling, and criminal penalties, without stating the direction of change.

title: Victims of Domestic Violence and Dating Violence
summary: Extends domestic violence victim protections to dating violence victims, including address confidentiality program eligibility, and requires a feasibility study of a victim alert system.

title: Educational Dollars for Duty Program
summary: Requires the Educational Dollars for Duty program to set aside funds for tuition aid to spouses and children of active Florida National Guard members, with DMA overseeing implementation.

title: Postsecondary Out-of-State Fee Waivers
summary: Removes state provisions that waive out-of-state fees for certain students, including students who are undocumented for federal immigration purposes.

title: Instructional Hours for the Voluntary Prekindergarten Education Program
summary: Revises the required instructional hours for school-year and summer Voluntary Prekindergarten programs; the summary does not say whether hours increase or decrease.

title: Verification of Reemployment Assistance Benefit Eligibility
summary: Requires Florida's reemployment assistance agency to verify claimants' identities and eligibility before paying benefits, revising disqualification circumstances.

title: Child Welfare
summary: Revises child protection investigations, custody and parenting-plan enforcement, school duties, domestic violence responses, and criminal penalties for custody interference.

title: Utilities
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Lets counties adopt solar decommissioning ordinances and requires DEP best management practices for solar construction that operators must follow.

title: Education in Correctional Facilities for Licensed Professions
