summary: Requires the correctional education program to develop a plan letting inmates take classes for credit toward professional licensure requirements.

title: Payment Scam Task Force
summary: Creates a Task Force on Payment Scams within the Department of Financial Services to study the issue and report back, with no change to existing rules.

title: Council on Social Status of Black Men and Boys
summary: Revises the Council on Social Status of Black Men and Boys' quorum rules and lets members attend and count toward quorum by communications technology.

title: Employment Eligibility
summary: Requires all private employers, not just larger ones, to use E-Verify to check new employees' work eligibility starting on a specified date.

title: Tax of Electric Vertical Takeoff and Landing Aircraft
summary: Exempts from state sales tax the lease, sale, or transfer of electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft from manufacturer to operator.

title: Veterans Affairs
summary: Revises veterans treatment court admissions, letting courts decide eligibility with a multidisciplinary team, considering prosecutors' recommendations, and allowing certain diversions.

title: Candidate Qualification
summary: Sets eligibility requirements for candidates seeking qualification, lets certain entities sue for injunctive relief, and bars ineligible candidates from the ballot.

title: Transportation Concurrency
summary: Revises which facilities small counties must identify in the capital improvements element of comprehensive plans that impose transportation concurrency.

title: Abandoning Restrained Dogs During Natural Disasters
summary: Prohibits restraining a dog outside during a natural disaster and then abandoning the dog.

title: Door Alarms for Multifamily Residential Properties
summary: Requires certain multifamily properties to install, inspect annually, and maintain door alarms that meet the Florida Building Code, enforced by DBPR with administrative fines.

title: State Land Management
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Requires public hearings and electronic plan access for state land management plans, and bars lodging establishments and certain uses or construction in state parks.

title: Dental Therapy
summary: Creates a dental therapist license with defined services and limits, lets Medicaid reimburse mobile dental units, and creates a council and reporting requirements.

title: Pub. Rec./Agency Employees
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Creates a public records exemption for identifying and location information of current or former agency employees and their spouses and children, applied retroactively, with future repeal review.

title: Petition Process
summary: Revises Florida petition rules covering constitutional amendments, citizen initiatives, signature verification, filing fees, candidate petitions, fiscal impact, and petition forms.

title: Farm Products
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Bars local governments from prohibiting or restricting collection, storage, processing, and distribution of farm products as part of bona fide farm operations.

title: Property Rights
summary: Lets owners and agents seek faster sheriff removal of unauthorized occupants, creates penalties for unlawful occupation of commercial property, and bars listing or renting such property under certain conditions.

title: Construction Disruption Assistance
summary: Creates a Department of Commerce program giving financial aid to small businesses in construction zones, with a public campaign, hotline, and annual reporting.

title: Ad Valorem Taxation
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Revises Save-Our-Homes portability for married couples, requires a specified vote before a higher millage rate takes effect, and lets DOR adopt emergency rules.

title: Property Tax Exemption for Surviving Spouses of Veterans
summary: Lets surviving spouses of veterans who died before a federal letter was issued use an alternative proof to qualify for a property tax exemption.

title: Land Use Regulations
summary: Defines "impacted local government" in land use regulations and applies them retroactively; the summary gives no substantive detail.

title: Health Screenings For K-12 Students
summary: Authorizes specified health screenings for K-12 students after written parental notice and parental opportunities to participate or decline.

title: Parity for Nonnursing Services Under Long-term Managed Care Plans
summary: Requires Florida Medicaid to pay licensed providers of long-term managed care nonnursing services at least what it pays unlicensed providers, adjusted annually.

title: Utility Terrain Vehicles
summary: Allows utility terrain vehicles to operate at all hours and on certain roads and state highways, with licensing, compliance and local restriction provisions, and requires license plates.

title: Minimum Wage Requirements
summary: Exempts employers from state minimum wage for specified workers, lets employees opt out by signed waiver, and limits work-based learning length.

title: Electronic Monitoring Devices in Long-term Care Facilities
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Health care
summary: Lets nursing home and assisted living residents install electronic monitoring devices in their rooms with consent conditions, bars retaliation, and penalizes tampering.

title: Naturopathic Medicine
summary: Creates a Board of Naturopathic Medicine in DOH and a licensure system for naturopathic doctors, including exams, endorsement and financial responsibility requirements.

title: Subsidy Payments for the Home Care for the Elderly Program
summary: Ends state-funded Home Care for the Elderly subsidy payments for certain people once they enroll in Medicaid long-term care managed care.

title: Consumer Fairness in Utility Rates
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Requires certain municipal utilities to charge uniform rates inside and outside city limits, limits extra surcharges, requires hearings and PSC reports, and has PSC resolve disputes.

title: Ad Valorem Taxation
summary: Lets taxpayers rescind homestead exemption applications, requires property appraisers to adjust tax rolls, and revises conditions for certain exemptions.

title: Eligibility of Leasehold Interests for Homestead Exemptions
summary: Revises when people may be treated as holding legal or equitable title to property for homestead exemption eligibility, including leasehold interests.

title: Health Facilities
summary: Expands health facility financing authority to make and refinance loans and bonds, sets not-for-profit hospital closure requirements, and adds hospital tax exemption criteria.

title: Violation of State Immigration Law
topics: Criminal justice; Government and administration; Immigration
summary: Creates state fines, a cause of action against local governments and law enforcement over immigration violations, and a compensation program for certain victims.

title: Prescriptive Authority Certification for Psychologists
summary: Lets qualified psychologists be certified by the Board of Psychology to prescribe, sets up an interim panel to recommend rules and a formulary, and then expires the panel.

title: Educator Certifications and Training
summary: Requires teacher preparation programs and certified and adjunct educators to receive training on mass casualty incidents.

title: Pub. Rec./Medical Examiners
summary: Creates a public records exemption for personal identifying and location information of current and former medical examiners and their spouses and children, with future repeal review and retroactive application.

title: Specialty License Plates
summary: Directs the DHSMV to create a UFC specialty license plate and sets how fees from its sale are distributed and used.

title: Generated Child Pornography
summary: Prohibits creating, downloading, or possessing images of a person intended to be used to generate child pornography.

title: Child Restraint Requirements
summary: Requires certain children to be restrained in booster seats, with listed exceptions and penalties for violations.

title: Digital Right to Repair
summary: Requires certain wireless device manufacturers to make parts and repair items available to owners and independent repairers, and bars proprietary-format restrictions.

title: Prohibited Discrimination Based on Hairstyle
summary: Prohibits discrimination based on protected hairstyles in the K-20 public education system and specified private schools.

title: Fees for the Recordkeeping System for Ephedrine and Related Compounds
summary: Requires manufacturers of ephedrine and related compounds to pay a fee to operate an electronic recordkeeping system, with the fee schedule set by administrative action.

title: Use of Professional Nursing Titles
summary: Lets holders of specified degrees use certain nursing titles and abbreviations, and requires certain doctoral holders to name their profession when using them.

title: School Mental Health
summary: Requires minimum staffing ratios of school psychologists, counselors, social workers and other licensed mental health professionals to students, starting in a specified school year.

title: Standards for Storm Water Systems
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Requires local storm water systems to meet specified DOT standards and undergo inspections, superseding certain local standards.

title: Operating Vehicles and Vessels
summary: Prohibits operating vehicles or vessels at unlawful street speeds or at speeds that create excessive wake.

title: Landlord Obligations and Construction Contracting
summary: Requires landlords to provide, maintain, and timely repair or replace tenant cooling equipment, and expands the services air-conditioning and mechanical contractors may perform.

title: Withholding Funds from the Return of Cash Bonds
summary: Requires clerks to withhold funds from cash bond refunds when the defendant or spouse posted the bond, and requires a notice on cash bond forms.

title: Electric Bicycles
summary: Sets operating requirements and penalties for electric bicycles and creates a task force under DHSMV to study electric bicycle safety, with reports to the Governor and Legislature.

title: Immigration Enforcement Assistance Agreements
summary: Requires local law enforcement agencies that run detention facilities to sign agreements with ICE and report related information quarterly to FDLE.

title: Child Pornography Terminology
summary: Replaces the term "child pornography" with "child sexual abuse material" in Florida statutes, with no substantive change in penalties.

title: Housing
summary: Lets landlords accept reusable tenant screening reports, bars certain applicant fees, and requires local ADU ordinances in certain areas, with a critical-state-concern carve-out.

title: Pub. Rec./Municipal Clerks
summary: Creates a public records exemption for personal identifying and location information of municipal clerks, their staff, spouses, and children, with future review and repeal.

title: Prohibition of Pyramid Promotional Schemes
summary: Prohibits establishing, promoting, operating, or participating in pyramid promotional schemes, with cease-and-desist orders, restitution, injunctions, and receiverships.

title: Designation of Official State Flagship
summary: Redesignates Florida's official state flagship as the S.S. American Victory, a naming change with no policy effect.

title: Damages Recoverable in Wrongful Death Actions
summary: Removes a provision barring adult children and parents of adult children from recovering certain wrongful death damages in medical negligence suits.

title: Transportation Facility Designations
summary: Designates certain transportation facilities in specified counties with honorary names and directs DOT to erect markers.

title: Holocaust Remembrance Day
summary: Requires the Governor to annually proclaim Holocaust Remembrance Day and authorizes its observance in public schools and by public exercise.

title: Pub. Rec./Emergency Department Physicians
summary: Exempts personal identifying and location information of current emergency department physicians and their spouses and certain children from public records requirements, with future repeal review.

title: Offenses Involving Motor Vehicles
summary: Raises penalties for lighting, plate-altering, and plate-obscuring offenses, including a third-degree felony and new bans on license plate obscuring devices.

title: Veterans Dental Care Grant Program
summary: Revises the stated purpose of the existing Veterans Dental Care Grant Program; no funding amount or rule change is stated.

title: Aggravated Animal Cruelty
summary: Creates a sentencing multiplier for specified aggravated animal cruelty offenses and requires FDLE to post names of certain violators on its website.

title: Condominium Associations
summary: Requires condo associations to file turnover certificates with the state division, keep them in official records, and the division to maintain a searchable public online database of them.

title: Exceptional Students and Video Cameras in Public Schools
summary: Requires certain school boards to adopt policies providing video cameras in self-contained exceptional student classrooms on parent request, with audio and no concealing employee identity.

title: Penalties for Prostitution and Related Acts
summary: Increases criminal penalties for certain prostitution-related offenses.

title: Special Observances
summary: Designates August 21 each year as Fentanyl Awareness & Education Day and encourages schools and entities to hold awareness events.

title: Patient Funds Held in Trust by Chiropractic Physicians
summary: Removes the cap on how much patient money a chiropractic physician may hold in trust for specified purposes.

title: Middle School and High School Start Times
summary: Lets school districts and charter schools be deemed compliant with middle and high school start-time provisions by submitting a report to DOE.

title: Restrictions on Employer-owned Life Insurance Policies
topics: Consumer protection and business; Taxes and budget
summary: Restricts employer-owned life insurance to key persons, bans policies on certain employees, adds OIR registry and reporting, and makes employer death benefits taxable.

title: Animal Cruelty
summary: Prohibits leaving an animal confined in an unattended motor vehicle under certain circumstances.

title: Public Records
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Exempts personal identifying and location information of county and city administrators and their families from public records requirements, with future review and repeal.

title: Postjudgment Execution Proceedings Relating to Terrorism
summary: Adds procedural requirements for enforcing judgments against terrorist parties and applies them retroactively.

title: Prohibition of Pyramid Promotional Schemes
summary: Prohibits establishing, promoting, operating, or participating in pyramid promotional schemes, with penalties and restitution for violations.

title: Motorcycle Specialty License Plates
summary: Requires the DHSMV to develop an Endless Summer motorcycle specialty license plate with a specified design and counts Endless Summer plates together for a determination.

title: Local Housing Assistance Plans
summary: Expands how local housing trust funds can be spent, allowing lot rent assistance and repairs for mobile home owners and removing a manufactured-housing spending cap.

title: Disability Provisions for Firefighters and Law Enforcement and Correctional Officers
summary: Revises definitions for disabilities of firefighters, law enforcement and correctional officers, which likely affects their disability benefit eligibility.

title: Victims of Domestic Violence and Dating Violence
summary: Extends the Attorney General's address confidentiality program to dating violence victims and requires a feasibility study of a victim alert system.

title: Social Work Licensure Interstate Compact
summary: Creates an interstate compact letting licensed social workers practice across member states, including via telehealth, while following each remote state's laws.

title: Crimes Evidencing Prejudice
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice
summary: Expands hate-crime reclassification to cover gender, gender identity and disability, makes reclassification mandatory for specified bias-based crimes, and expands Governor's data collection.

title: Foreign and Alien Bail Bond Insurers
summary: Requires foreign and alien bail bond insurers to report bail bond premiums to OIR, keep records of bail bond considerations, and disclose certain financial statement information.

title: Pharmacy
summary: Lets pharmacy technicians handle sales and delivery, creates a permit for remote-site pharmacies, and sets supervision and Schedule II dispensing conditions.

title: Special District Funding
summary: Lets state agencies pay invoices directly to special districts under certain agreements and requires expedited payment requests from counties, municipalities and special districts.

title: Annexing State-owned Lands
summary: Requires a municipality proposing to annex state-owned lands to notify each member of the county's legislative delegation at a set time.

title: Rates for Citizens Property Insurance Corporation Coverage
summary: Exempts new Citizens Property Insurance policies, and their renewals, from annual rate-increase limits, starting on a specified date, with an exception.

title: Veterans' Benefits Assistance
topics: AI and technology; Consumer protection and business
summary: Regulates paid veterans' benefits advisers: bans referral pay and certain fees and interest, requires disclosures, data security, background checks, and deceptive-practice penalties.

title: Domestic Violence and Protective Injunctions
summary: Raises penalties for repeat domestic violence offenders, creates an electronic monitoring pilot, and adds dating and sexual violence injunctions to a statewide system.

title: False Reporting
summary: Increases criminal penalties for false emergency-call misuse causing serious injury or death, and requires convicted offenders to pay prosecution costs and restitution.

title: Luggage for Children Placed in Out-of-home Care
summary: Requires DCF to give children in out-of-home care a piece of luggage, funded through specified sources and a direct-support organization, with an annual report.

title: Local Government Code Enforcement
summary: Expands local code enforcement tools, requires body-camera policies for code inspectors, and increases criminal penalties for crimes against inspectors.

title: Use of Artificial Intelligence in Psychological, Clinical, Counseling, and Therapy Services
summary: Prohibits the use of artificial intelligence in the practice of psychology, clinical social work, marriage and family therapy, and mental health counseling, with exceptions.

title: Storage and Disposal of Prescription Drugs and Sharps
summary: Requires DOH and DEP to study sharps collection and disposal, appropriates $200,000, and sets requirements for facilities that store prescription drugs solely for destruction.

title: School Zone and Pedestrian Safety
summary: Requires crosswalk design and construction plans in school zones and on certain roads to include specified traffic control devices.

title: Injunctions for Protection in Cases of Repeat or Serious Violence
summary: Expands the grounds for protective injunctions to cover serious violence, not only repeat violence.

title: Required Notice of Intent to Contact a Victim
summary: Requires defense-side persons to file a notice on a standard form before contacting a crime victim in criminal proceedings.

title: Building and Plumbing Permits for the Use of Onsite Sewage Treatment and Disposal Systems
summary: Revises the conditions under which local governments are barred from issuing certain septic system building and plumbing permits.

title: Pub. Rec./Applicants, Owners, and Operators of Family Foster Homes and References of Such Persons
topics: Children and families; Government and administration
summary: Exempts personal identifying and location information of foster home applicants, owners, operators, their household members, and references from public records requirements, with future repeal review.

title: Boating Safety
summary: Adds penalties for vessel collisions, reckless operation and false reports, sets a minimum mandatory prison term for BUI manslaughter, and revises certain vessel operation rules.

title: Civil Liability for the Wrongful Death of an Unborn Child
summary: Creates wrongful-death recovery for parents of an unborn child against third parties, while barring suits against the mother and against providers for lawful care.

title: Pub. Rec. and Meetings/Social Work Licensure Interstate Compact
summary: Creates public records and public meetings exemptions for the Social Work Licensure Interstate Compact and its committees, with future legislative review and repeal.

title: Sale and Purchase of Ivermectin
summary: Authorizes sale and purchase of specified ivermectin as an over-the-counter medication without a prescription or provider consultation.

title: Personal Mobility Device Battery Safety Standards
summary: Bans sale of personal mobility devices whose batteries lack certification to a specified ingress protection standard, with penalties.

title: Common Entities of Motor Vehicle Distributors and Manufacturers
summary: Revises the statutory definition of "common entity" in motor vehicle distributor and manufacturer law; the summary gives no further detail.

title: Office of Faith and Community
summary: Creates an Office of Faith and Community within the Governor's office, with a liaison, to support the faith-based advisory council.

title: Continuous Glucose Monitors
summary: Requires AHCA to seek federal approval and cover continuous glucose monitors and supplies as a Medicaid durable medical equipment benefit, with reimbursement.

title: Comprehensive Waste Reduction and Recycling Plan
summary: Directs DEP to develop a comprehensive waste reduction and recycling plan, convene a technical assistance group, and report to the Legislature.

title: Prosecuting Children as Adults
summary: Requires a judicial due-process hearing before a child directed to adult court can be held in adult jail, and revises state attorney direct-file discretion and criteria.

title: Ticket Sales and Resales
summary: Requires ticket operators, resellers and online marketplaces to disclose specified information, bans certain practices, and lets the Commerce Secretary enforce the rules.

title: Criminal Rehabilitation
summary: Cuts the minimum share of sentence served from 85% to 72% and expands gain-time and rehabilitation credits, making rehabilitation a primary sentencing purpose.

title: Elevator Accessibility Requirements
summary: Requires elevator car interiors to include at least one support rail meeting specified standards.

title: Blue Ribbon Projects
summary: Creates blue ribbon development projects that may be sited on any land use or zoning designation, governed by an approved plan with local review and appeals.

title: Combatting Illegal Immigration
summary: Creates an Office of Secure Florida within the Department of Corrections, sets its duties, and appropriates $1,725,423.

title: Immigration
summary: Revises Florida immigration provisions covering unauthorized aliens who entered without inspection, were removed or denied admission, or were convicted of capital offenses.

title: Property Tax Administration
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Revises local millage rate caps, conforms a related provision, and lets a proposed constitutional amendment's ballot summary exceed the word limit.

title: Suits Against the Government
summary: Raises statutory caps on government tort liability, changes claim deadlines and exceptions, and lets local subdivisions settle claims above caps without legislative action.

title: Advanced Practice Registered Nurse Autonomous Practice
summary: Authorizes certain advanced practice registered nurses to practice autonomously and provide mental health services without the usual physician oversight.

title: Property Damage Caused by Limestone Mining Operations
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Creates a right for property owners damaged by limestone mining to claim compensation, adjudicated by DOAH and paid from an annual state appropriation.

title: Human Trafficking Education For Initial Nurse Licensure
summary: Requires registered and licensed practical nurses to complete a human trafficking course before initial licensure, starting on a specified date.

title: Administrative Procedure
summary: Makes guidance documents invalid without statutory delegation, requires cost estimates and retrospective analyses, and sets rule expiration unless readopted.

title: Statewide, Standardized Assessments
topics: Children and families; Government and administration
summary: Requires the Department of Education to develop statewide assessments and screening portions in other languages, and lets parents opt out of those versions.

title: Bonuses for Employees of Property Appraisers
summary: Authorizes certain property appraisers to budget for and pay employee bonuses, subject to specified approval.

title: Public Postsecondary Tuition and Fee Waivers for Sheriff's Office Employees
summary: Requires state universities and Florida College System institutions to waive tuition and fees for sheriff's office employees, with eligibility requirements.

title: Office Surgery Standards of Practice
summary: Requires registration for offices performing specified surgeries, revises office surgery practice standards for providers, and adds liability requirements.

title: Controlled Substances
summary: Removes certain FDA-approved veterinary xylazine products from Schedule I while creating xylazine trafficking offenses with mandatory minimum prison terms and quantity-based fines.

title: Carrying and Possession of Weapons and Firearms
summary: Allows open carry of any otherwise legal firearm, revises restricted carry locations, and repeals Florida's risk protection order provisions.

title: Recognizing Judea and Samaria
summary: Bans the term "West Bank" in official government materials and in certain instructional materials and library collections, requiring "Judea & Samaria" instead.

title: Repair of Motorized Wheelchairs
summary: Requires manufacturers of motorized wheelchairs to provide repair documentation, parts, tools, and lock-reset access, enforceable under Florida's deceptive trade practices act.

title: Tax Credits for Contributions to Assist Homebuyers
summary: Creates a tax credit for taxpayers who contribute to homebuyer assistance, with an application process, a credit cap, carryforward, and a ban on selling or transferring credits.

title: Toll Exemptions for Purple Heart Medal Recipients
summary: Expands toll exemption eligibility to operators displaying Purple Heart specialty or special motorcycle license plates.

title: Housing
summary: Requires local governments to adopt accessory dwelling unit ordinances, bars certain ordinance requirements, changes homestead and rental ADU tax treatment, and orders an OPPAGA study.

title: Transportation Network Company and Driver Insurance Requirements
summary: Revises automobile insurance requirements for transportation network companies and their drivers; the summary does not specify whether requirements are added or relaxed.

title: Immigration, Law Enforcement, and State-issued Identification
summary: Creates an immigrant services office, bars immigration-status discrimination, removes sanctuary and detainer duties, limits enforcement near schools, and restricts officers' face coverings.

title: Complaints Against Law Enforcement and Correctional Officers
summary: Requires complaints against officers to be sworn in writing, limits how investigations affect officers' personnel files and promotions, and penalizes false complaints.

title: Gay and Transgender Panic Legal Defenses
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice
summary: Prohibits defendants from using nonviolent sexual advances or certain perceptions about a person's sexual orientation or gender identity as a criminal defense or mitigation.

title: Virtual Currency Kiosk Businesses
summary: Requires the Office of Financial Regulation to supervise virtual currency kiosk businesses, mandating registration, renewal, and required consumer disclosures and attestations.

title: Property Insurance Interstate Compact
summary: Directs the Insurance Commissioner to join an interstate compact creating a national property insurance risk pool for natural disasters.

title: Ad Valorem Tax Exemption for Nonprofit Homes for the Aged
summary: Revises eligibility rules so Florida limited partnerships can qualify for an ad valorem tax exemption for nonprofit homes for the aged.

title: Carrying Weapons and Firearms
summary: Prohibits carrying weapons or firearms into certain locations and creates a criminal penalty for violations.

title: Bail Bonds
summary: Revises bail bond rules on sureties, forfeiture notices, extradition, bond cancellation and appeal bonds, and adds bail agents to public safety councils.

title: Parking on Public Property
summary: Requires local refunds and carryover of unused paid parking time on public property, bars towing or citations for a set period, and bars private paid parking on public property.

title: Court-ordered Sealing of Criminal History Records
summary: Revises eligibility for court-ordered sealing of criminal history records and lets courts seal additional adjudications of guilt in certain circumstances.

title: Education and Workforce Development for Inmates
summary: Expands inmate education and workforce training, including commercial driver license programs and limited supervised vehicle operation by inmates, and authorizes DOT workforce funds for these programs.

title: Interstate Compact for School Psychologists
summary: Creates an interstate compact so member states recognize school psychologist licenses and share licensing information through a commission.

title: Uterine Fibroid Research Database
summary: Deletes the ban on putting personal identifying information into the uterine fibroid research database and amends related database provisions.

title: Pub. Rec. and Meetings/Interstate Compact for School Psychologists
summary: Exempts the Interstate Compact for School Psychologists Commission and its executive committee from public meetings and records requirements, with future legislative review and repeal.

title: Specialty License Plates
summary: Directs the DHSMV to develop a Miami Northwestern Alumni Association specialty license plate and sets how its fees are distributed.

title: Agreement Among the States to Elect the President by National Popular Vote
summary: Enacts an interstate compact under which member states award presidential electors to the national popular vote winner, taking effect once enough states join.

title: Transportation Facility Designations
summary: Honorary designations of certain transportation facilities in specified counties, with DOT directed to erect markers.

title: Temporary Cash Assistance Eligibility
summary: Removes the ban on Temporary Cash Assistance for people with felony drug trafficking convictions and drops related conditions for drug felons to receive benefits.

title: Reproductive Health and Instructional Materials
summary: Requires instructional materials on reproductive health and specified diseases to be approved annually at a district school board meeting.

title: Sickle Cell Care Management and Treatment Education
summary: Requires health care professionals to complete a sickle cell care continuing education course for first licensure and certification renewal.

title: Public Accountancy
summary: Revises CPA licensing education, experience, and international and out-of-state practice rules, and lets the board contract out certain duties to nonprofits.

title: Instructional Personnel and School Administrator Salaries
summary: Revises school district salary schedules and FEFP funding for instructional personnel salary increases, plus district, charter school, and DOE responsibilities.

title: Spaceport Operations
summary: Requires Space Florida to promote quintimodal transportation hubs and sets powers and duties for spaceport operators.

title: Cardiac Emergencies on School Grounds
summary: Requires each public school to develop a cardiac emergency response plan and revises the CPR and AED instruction requirement.

title: Food Insecure Areas
summary: Lets local governments allow small-footprint grocery stores in food insecure areas through zoning and comprehensive plans, and require reporting from those stores.

title: Licensure Requirements for Surveyors and Mappers
summary: Creates a temporary alternative pathway to surveyor and mapper licensure, with eligibility rules for taking the licensing exam under it.

title: Advertisement of a Harmful Vaccine
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Creates manufacturer liability for advertising a harmful vaccine and lets individuals sue, with the prevailing party recovering damages, costs and attorney fees.

title: Identification Cards for Public Works Employees
summary: Requires OPPAGA to report on how the state could issue identification cards identifying public works employees as first responders.

title: Resolution of Disputed Property Insurance Claims
summary: Requires property insurance claim disputes to go through mediation before litigation, with an appropriation of $1,000,000 for the process.

title: Middle School and High School Start Times
summary: Deletes existing state requirements governing middle and high school start times.

title: Insurance Solutions Advisory Council
summary: Creates a temporary advisory council within the Office of Insurance Regulation to study Florida's property and auto insurance markets and report annually.

title: Student Elopement
summary: Requires public schools to create SAFE Teams and student elopement plans, with set requirements for each.

title: Funding for the Voluntary Prekindergarten Education Program
summary: Revises how the base student allocation for the Voluntary Prekindergarten program is calculated, requires annual data publication, and authorizes extra legislative funding.

title: Specialty License Plates
summary: Directs DHSMV to create a Miami Dade College specialty license plate and sets how the plate sale fees are distributed and used.

title: Adoption and Display of Flags by Governmental Entities
summary: Bars governmental entities from displaying certain flags on property, and voids local ordinances regulating local government flags.

title: Delivery of Patient Protection
summary: Requires hospitals and health care facilities to meet minimum direct-care nurse staffing levels, bans video monitoring as a substitute for observation, and adds whistle-blower protections.

title: Cardiac Service Providers
summary: Revises licensure requirements for Level I and II adult cardiovascular programs and requires AHCA to update rules as new industry standards are published.

title: Heat Illness Prevention
summary: Requires certain employers to adopt an approved outdoor heat exposure safety program and provide annual heat illness training to workers.

title: Habitual Traffic Offender Designation
summary: Revises the statutory definition of "habitual traffic offender"; the summary does not say how the definition changes.

title: Dangerous Excessive Speeding
summary: Defines dangerous excessive speeding, lets officers choose whether to note civil penalties on certain citations, and requires cited drivers to appear at a hearing.

title: Concurrent Legislative Jurisdiction over United States Military Installations
summary: Authorizes Florida to accept relinquished exclusive federal jurisdiction over military installations, establishing concurrent legislative jurisdiction with procedures.

title: Patient-directed Medical Orders
summary: Sets requirements for patient-directed medical orders, authorizes telehealth use, and requires certain services continue regardless of decisions to withhold or withdraw life-prolonging procedures.

title: Sickle Cell Disease Treatment of Pain Continuing Education
summary: Revises continuing education requirements for a course on prescribing controlled substances, covering treatment of pain in sickle cell disease.

title: Emergency Opioid Antagonists in Public K-12 Schools and Postsecondary Educational Institutions
summary: Authorizes public K-12 schools and postsecondary institutions to buy, use and stock emergency opioid antagonists meeting set criteria, not only naloxone.

title: Health Care Patient Protection
summary: Requires Florida hospital emergency departments to meet pediatric readiness policies, training, assessments, and public reporting of assessment scores.

title: Motor Vehicle Operator Privacy
summary: Prohibits selling or sharing certain motor vehicle operators' personal information and email addresses with third parties or foreign entities, with retroactive application and penalties.

title: Property Tax Exemptions
summary: Creates an exemption from all taxation for certain real property; the bill's specifics are not described in the text provided.

title: Search Warrants
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice
summary: Expands police search-warrant procedures, including remote appearances, longer device-review windows, body recovery warrants, and drone searches under specified circumstances.

title: Mental Health Professionals
summary: Renames mental health intern registrations as associate registrations and drops the requirement that a licensed professional be on premises for private-practice services.

title: Use of Campaign Funds for Campaign-related Child Care Expenses
summary: Lets candidates use campaign account funds for campaign-related child care costs, with recordkeeping and disclosure requirements.

title: Community Redevelopment Plans
summary: Lets community redevelopment agencies use a specified percentage of tax increment financing funds for certain business support services.

title: Dental Therapy
summary: Authorizes Medicaid reimbursement for certain mobile dental units, creates a Council on Dental Therapy, and sets licensure rules for dental therapists.

title: Rent of Affordable Housing Dwelling Units
summary: Prohibits certain landlords of specified affordable housing units from raising rent during the term of a rental agreement.

title: Law Enforcement Officer Interactions with Individuals with Autism Spectrum Disorder
summary: Creates a DHSMV communication program and optional envelope and card for people with autism, and requires police autism-interaction training.

title: Home and Service Warranty Association Financial Requirements
summary: Revises when home and service warranty associations must hold unearned premium reserves or contractual liability insurance, and requires certain accidental-damage coverage to be backed by liability policies.

title: Cost-sharing Requirements for Insulin and Diabetes Supplies
summary: Caps insurance cost-sharing for insulin and diabetes supplies at a set amount for a 30-day supply.

title: Provenance of Digital Content
summary: Requires certain AI developers and social media platforms to make digital content provenance data and readers available; violations are unfair or deceptive practices.

title: Patient-directed Medical Orders
summary: Authorizes patient-directed medical orders limiting life-prolonging procedures, lets providers withhold or withdraw them without penalty, and creates an AHCA order database.

title: Educator Certifications and Training
summary: Requires certified educators to receive training on mass casualty incidents, and revises educator preparation and certification requirements to include it.

title: Removal, Storage, and Cleanup of Electric Vehicles
summary: Lets counties and municipalities set daily storage fees for certain electric vehicles and exempts motor vehicle insurers from paying some related costs.

title: Nature-based Methods for Improving Coastal Resilience
summary: Directs USF's Flood Hub and DEP to develop nature-based coastal resilience guidelines and standards, and encourages local governments to join restoration efforts.

title: Patriotic Displays at Public Schools
summary: Requires school boards to adopt rules displaying George Washington and Abraham Lincoln portraits in each public school, subject to appropriation; DOE selects and supplies the portraits.

title: Pub. Rec/Appellate Court Clerks
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Exempts personal identifying and location information of current appellate court clerks and their spouses and children from public records requirements, with future review and retroactive application.

title: Statute of Limitations Period for Violations Involving Required Reports Concerning Children
summary: Delays the start of the statute of limitations for violations of required child-related reports until law enforcement becomes aware of the violation.

title: Telephone Solicitation
summary: Revises the definitions of telephone solicitor and telephonic sales call and changes when attorney fees may be awarded in telephone solicitation suits.

title: Autonomous Practice by a Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist
summary: Lets certain nurse anesthetists and advanced practice nurses practice autonomously and perform specified acts, and revises their hospital privileges.

title: Health Insurance Coverage for Individuals with Developmental Disabilities
summary: Revises definitions of autism spectrum disorder and eligible individual, extending health coverage requirements to people of any age with developmental disabilities, including under Medicaid.

title: Heated Tobacco Products
summary: Revises the definitions of cigarette and tobacco products to exclude certain tobacco-containing products and defines heated tobacco products.

title: Securities
summary: Revises securities registration exemptions, filing and fingerprint rules, guaranty fund eligibility, and adds a ban on certain securities misrepresentations.

title: Rural Electric Cooperatives
summary: Bars rural electric cooperatives selling retail power from adopting or enforcing certain fees, and revises which energy types or fuel sources the ban covers.

title: Platting
summary: Requires certain plat and replat submittals to be administratively approved without governing body action, sets review deadlines, and bars requiring applicants to extend review timelines.

title: Office of Financial Regulation
topics: AI and technology; Consumer protection and business
summary: Requires lenders, brokers and money services businesses to adopt written data security and breach response programs, and loosens credit union investment limits.

title: Purchase and Possession of Firearms by Law Enforcement Officers, Correctional Officers, Correctional Probation Officers, and Servicemembers
summary: Gives off-duty correctional probation officers a right to carry concealed firearms, lets agencies limit it, and revises the purchase waiting-period exemptions.

title: Trusts
summary: Revises Florida trust and community property rules, including trustee claims, principal invasion, property transfers to donees, and community property trusts.

title: Economic Hardship Grant Program
summary: Creates the People's Relief Program within DCF to provide hardship grants to eligible residents and requires DCF to adopt rules.

title: Prohibited Discrimination Based on Hairstyle
summary: Prohibits discrimination based on protected hairstyle in K-20 public schools and specified private schools.

title: Automatic Dependent Surveillance Broadcasts
summary: Prohibits airports from using ADS-B broadcast or collected information for specified purposes under certain conditions.

title: Managed Care Plan Network Access
summary: Requires Medicaid managed care contracts to let enrollees see out-of-network Medicaid providers, with plans reimbursing those providers at applicable rates.

title: Smoking in Public Places
summary: Bill expands the ban on smoking and vaping in public places, with exceptions, and bars marijuana smoking and vaping in customs smoking rooms.

title: Tax Exemption for Disabled Ex-servicemembers
summary: Increases the value of the property tax exemption for certain disabled ex-servicemembers.

title: Assessments Levied on Recreational Vehicle Parks
summary: Bars certain local special assessments on RV park space or campsites that are not occupied and requires local governments to consider park occupancy rates.

title: Faith-based Content in Batterer's Intervention Program
summary: Allows batterers' intervention programs to include faith-based activities, but bars requiring participation in them.

title: Public Postsecondary Reports on Pell Grant Eligibility and Food Insecurity
summary: Requires the Agriculture Commissioner to report on Pell-eligible students at public universities and colleges, and OPPAGA to study campus food insecurity.

title: My Safe Florida Condominium Pilot Program
summary: Narrows the My Safe Florida Condominium grant pilot: limits eligible buildings, requires all openings be upgraded, and ties grants to inspection-confirmed improvements that earn insurance credits.

title: Ad Valorem Tax Exemption for Disabled Veterans
summary: Removes the cap on the disabled-veteran property tax exemption a surviving spouse can transfer to a new home, and changes when the exemption is considered granted.

title: Deferred Retirement Option Program Eligibility for School Employees and Personnel
summary: Removes the time limit on Deferred Retirement Option Program (DROP) eligibility for certain school employees and personnel.

title: Dependent Children
summary: Requires DCF and community-based care lead agencies to coordinate quarterly, post meeting agendas and information online, and publish biannual reports on dependent children.

title: Public Records/Crime Stoppers Organizations
summary: Exempts personal identifying and location information of crime stoppers organization employees, board members, and volunteers from public records requirements, with future review and retroactive application.

title: Violations of Pretrial Release Conditions for Violent Crimes
summary: Makes willful violation of pretrial release conditions a separate crime for people charged with specified violent offenses, with enhanced penalties for repeat violations and mandatory custody until first appearance.

title: Ethics
summary: Bans public officials and employees from falsely claiming military service records or wearing unauthorized uniforms or medals, with civil penalties and salary withholding for unpaid fines.

title: Land Use and Development Regulations
summary: Land-use omnibus: limits local permit fees and rules, allows off-site homes as of right, and bars denying permits for manufactured buildings on certain lots.

title: Lee County
summary: Amends the Lee County Home Rule Charter to set requirements for single-member districts, subject to a referendum.

title: Jefferson County
summary: Limits payment to non-contracted health care providers and emergency transport entities serving inmates in the Jefferson County detention center.

title: City of Marco Island, Collier County
summary: Requires special elections to fill Marco Island council vacancies by council resolution, with an exception for vacancies within one year of a general election.

title: City of Naples Airport Authority, Collier County
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Changes the Naples Airport Authority so members are elected rather than appointed, drops bans on city officers and employees serving, and allows member compensation.

title: Compensation for Health Care Services for Inmates in Martin County
summary: Limits county compensation for inmate medical care to certain providers and requires compensation for specified hospitals that lack county contracts.

title: Martin County
summary: Requires Martin County to set by ordinance how County Health Care Fund money goes to licensed hospitals, defines indigent residents eligible for county hospital-care payments, and removes the County Health Care Review Board provisions.

title: St. Augustine-St. Johns County Airport Authority, St. Johns County
summary: Renames Northeast Florida Regional Airport under the St. Augustine-St. Johns County Airport Authority, a naming change with no policy effect.

title: Residential Land Use Development Regulations
summary: Lets counties and cities zone land for single-family housing and bars single-family hybrid housing use on that land.

title: Security for Nominees and Officers-elect to the Offices of Governor and Lieutenant Governor
summary: Requires the Florida Department of Law Enforcement to provide protective security details to certain gubernatorial and lieutenant governor nominees and officers-elect for a specified period.

title: Palm Beach County
summary: Revises the legal definition of 'building official' for Palm Beach County; the text gives no substantive change.

title: St. Lucie County Mosquito Control District, St. Lucie County
summary: Revises the St. Lucie County Mosquito Control District's boundaries and requires a referendum.

title: Citrus County
summary: Repeals local provisions setting rights for certain Citrus County Sheriff employees and appointees; the text does not specify the rights affected.

title: Lee County
summary: Merges the Fort Myers Beach Fire Control District into the Iona-McGregor fire district, revises its boundaries, transfers assets, and requires a referendum.

title: Broward County Narcotics and Dangerous Drug Intelligence and Enforcement Unit, Broward County
summary: Repeals the 1971 local law that created Broward County's narcotics and dangerous drug intelligence and enforcement unit.

title: Melbourne-Tillman Water Control District, Brevard County
summary: Revises Melbourne-Tillman Water Control District stormwater user fees and provides for annual fee adjustments for residential, agricultural, and commercial parcels.

title: Bermont Drainage District, Charlotte County
summary: Creates the Bermont Drainage District in Charlotte County as a public corporation, sets its charter, boundaries, and applicable laws, and ratifies prior proceedings.

title: Nassau County
summary: Abolishes Nassau County's recreation and water conservation district and transfers its assets and liabilities to the county commission.

title: Central Broward Water Control District, Broward County
summary: Revises how the Central Broward Water Control District may levy taxes; the summary gives no details of the change.

title: Compensation for Health Care Services for Inmates in Lake County
summary: Limits county compensation for inmate health care in Lake County to providers, trauma-center hospitals, and transport entities that have a contract with the county.

title: North River Ranch Improvement Stewardship District, Manatee County
summary: Revises the boundaries of the North River Ranch Improvement Stewardship District in Manatee County.

title: Melbourne-Tillman Water Control District, Brevard County
summary: Revises the boundaries of the Melbourne-Tillman Water Control District in Brevard County.

title: Officers and Employees of North Springs Improvement District, Broward County
summary: Adds a charter prohibition on conflicting employment or contractual relationships for officers and employees of North Springs Improvement District.

title: Ave Maria Stewardship Community District, Collier County
summary: Revises the Ave Maria Stewardship Community District's boundaries and its provisions on revenue collection and on systems, facilities and services.

title: Lee County
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Creates the Duke Farm Stewardship District in Lee County with its own governing board, power to borrow through bonds, and future property taxes and assessments subject to referendum.

title: Martin and Palm Beach Counties
summary: Transfers specified state-owned real property and improvements from the Internal Improvement Trust Fund to the Village of Tequesta, with use, sale and conveyance requirements.

title: Osceola County
summary: Adds a county career service position, sets promotional procedures, and changes the career service appeals board's membership and duties.

title: Hillsborough County Public Schools, Hillsborough County
summary: Changes Hillsborough County's school superintendent to an elected office, subject to a voter referendum.

title: Greater Naples Fire Rescue District, Collier County
summary: Changes Greater Naples Fire Rescue District commissioner elections to district-wide voting, subject to a referendum.

title: Hillsborough County Charter
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Revises Hillsborough County's commission size and district boundaries, changes vote thresholds and appointment processes, and requires a referendum.

title: Limited Liability Companies
summary: Creates and revises Florida rules for domestic and foreign LLCs, including series and protected series, including registered series.

title: Transportation Facility Designations/Warrior Sacrifice Way
summary: Gives an honorary name to a transportation facility in a specified county and directs DOT to erect markers.

title: City of Oviedo, Seminole County
summary: Lets the state alcohol division issue special or modified licenses so Oviedo entertainment-district licensees can sell certain alcoholic beverages for off-premises consumption.

title: San Carlos Estates Water Control District, Lee County
summary: Makes the San Carlos Estates Water Control District a dependent district of Bonita Springs, transfers board seats to city council members, and requires a referendum.

title: Palm Beach County
summary: Revises Palm Beach County definitions of family day care home and large family child care home to specify the maximum number of children allowed.

title: Lee County
summary: Redraws Lee County Mosquito Control District boundaries, merges the Fort Myers Beach district into it, transfers assets and liabilities, and requires a referendum.

title: Palm Beach County
summary: Revises examination requirements and the applicant review process for Palm Beach County's construction industry licensing board certificates of competency.

title: The Downtown Development Authority of the City of Fort Lauderdale, Broward County
summary: Removes the expiration date for the Fort Lauderdale Downtown Development Authority and provides for transferring its assets upon any future dissolution.

title: Pasco County Mosquito Control District, Pasco County
summary: Revises term limits for the Pasco County Mosquito Control District's governing body and sets rules for designating geographic subdistricts.

title: Broward County
summary: Exempts special alcoholic beverage licenses for premises in identified Broward County areas from specified alcohol-related provisions.

title: Solid Waste Disposal Facility in Broward County
summary: Requires a feasibility study and public hearing before any expansion of the Monarch Hill Landfill in Broward County.

title: Collier County
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Creates the Corkscrew Grove Stewardship District in Collier County with a board, bonding and assessment powers, and a transition to resident control.

title: Compensation for Health Care Services for Inmates in Indian River County
summary: Limits county payment for inmate medical care to certain providers, and requires payment to specified hospitals and EMS without county contracts.

title: Osceola County
summary: Creates the Waterlin Stewardship District in Osceola County and provides its charter, establishing a new local special district.

title: Citrus County Hospital Board, Citrus County
summary: Dissolves the Citrus County Hospital Board on a set date, transfers its assets and liabilities to the county commission, and continues an irrevocable community trust or foundation.

title: City Pension Fund for Firefighters and Police Officers in the City of Tampa, Hillsborough County
summary: Amends the Tampa firefighters and police pension fund to extend DROP participation from 5 to 8 years and remove the full-scale contribution rate.

title: Jacksonville Aviation Authority, Consolidated City of Jacksonville, Duval County
summary: Makes the Jacksonville Aviation Authority responsible for economic development at Cecil Airport, requires an annual plan presentation to city council, and revises purchase thresholds.

title: Fort Pierce Farms Water Control District, St. Lucie County
summary: Raises the maximum annual maintenance tax for the Fort Pierce Farms Water Control District, limits annual assessment increases, and requires a referendum.

title: Lee County Tourist Development Council, Lee County
summary: Revises the membership composition of the Lee County Tourist Development Council.

title: North St. Lucie River Water Control District, St. Lucie County
summary: Revises a St. Lucie County water district's maintenance tax assessments, raises the maximum annual levy, caps assessment increases, and requires a referendum.

title: Office of General Counsel of City of Jacksonville, Duval County
summary: Lets the Duval County School Board hire its own general counsel, independent of the City of Jacksonville's general counsel office.

title: Certified Recovery Residences
summary: Revises the definition of certified recovery residence, requires revoking certificates for knowingly false information, and changes which referral provisions apply.

title: Commercial Construction
summary: Standardizes commercial permit forms statewide, caps local permit fees at actual costs, and requires fee cuts when private providers are used.

title: Pasco County Mosquito Control District, Pasco County
summary: Applies term-limit laws to Pasco County Mosquito Control District board members, requires geographic subdistricts drawn by the county commission, and sets board candidate qualifications.

title: Pace Fire Rescue District, Santa Rosa County
summary: Exempts churches and certain religious institutions from Pace Fire Rescue District non-ad valorem assessments and revises how those assessments are calculated for residential and large industrial properties.

title: Duval County
summary: Sets space and seating requirements for special alcoholic beverage licenses issued to Duval County event centers and creates an exception to general law.

title: Avalon Beach-Mulat Fire Protection District, Santa Rosa County
summary: Exempts churches and specified religious institutions from Avalon Beach-Mulat fire district non-ad valorem assessments and revises how those assessments are calculated.

title: Manatee County
summary: Requires the Manatee County clerk of court and comptroller to provide certain services to historic museums and parks, and authorizes the clerk to provide funding.

title: City of Lake Wales, Polk County
summary: Exempts licensed alcoholic beverage vendors in a specified Lake Wales area from a general law, while requiring compliance with local ordinances and rules.

title: Tohopekaliga Water Authority, Osceola County
summary: Makes the Central Florida Tourism Oversight District the successor to Reedy Creek Improvement District and revises its boundaries.

title: City of DeFuniak Springs, Walton County
summary: Transfers specified state-owned real property in Walton County to the City of DeFuniak Springs, with required use and disposition terms and a conveyance deadline.

title: Sunbridge Stewardship District, Osceola County
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Expands the Sunbridge Stewardship District into City of Orlando areas, adds Orange County involvement in elections, bonds and taxes, and requires a referendum.

title: Compensation for Health Care Services for Inmates in Polk County
summary: Limits who may be compensated for health care and emergency medical transport for inmates housed in the Polk County detention center, under specified conditions.

title: West Villages Improvement District, Sarasota County
summary: Revises how board members of the West Villages Improvement District in Sarasota County are elected.

title: Hillsborough County
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Creates the Hillsborough County Land Reserve Stewardship District, a new independent special district with authority to plan and finance infrastructure through bonds, assessments and future property taxes.

title: West Palm Beach Police Pension Fund - Special Act Amendment
summary: Amends the West Palm Beach Police Pension Fund special act, revising membership, retirement age and service rules, benefit calculations, DROP, death benefits, and investments.

title: City of Auburndale, Polk County
summary: Transfers state-owned real property from the Board of Trustees to the City of Auburndale, with use and sale requirements and a conveyance deadline.

title: West Palm Beach Firefighters Pension Fund, Palm Beach County
summary: Revises the West Palm Beach Firefighters Pension Fund's definitions, benefits, DROP and disability provisions, and related plan administration rules.

title: Special Beverage Licenses for Equestrian Sport Facilities in Marion County
summary: Creates special beverage licenses letting certain Marion County equestrian facilities sell wine, malt and alcoholic beverages on and off premises, subject to conditions.

title: Plantation Acres Improvement District, Broward County
summary: Converts the Plantation Acres Improvement District from an independent special district into a dependent district of the City of Plantation, subject to a referendum.

title: Central Broward Water Control District, Broward County
summary: Revises the maximum ad valorem tax rate the Central Broward Water Control District may levy, and the manner of levying it.

title: Guardianship of Property
topics: Children and families; Government and administration
summary: Requires property guardians to file quarterly accountings, mail them to next of kin, retain appraisal records, and refer certain guardians to FDLE for criminal investigation.

title: Administration of Medications
summary: Authorizes pharmacists to administer certain medications, expanding what pharmacists may do under state law.

title: City of Coral Springs and City of Parkland, Broward County
summary: Shrinks Coral Springs' corporate limits and expands Parkland's by about 8.7 acres of contiguous land, with boundaries specified.

title: Palm Beach County
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Keeps county fire-rescue taxing unit serving annexed properties for a set time, bars county ad valorem taxes there, and sets annexation service-transfer and negotiation rules.

title: Leon County
summary: Revises Leon County Sheriff employee status, dismissal cause, and Career Service Appeals Board procedures, including representation and evidence rules, during the transition to a new Sheriff.

title: Manatee County Port Authority, Manatee County
summary: Redefines the Manatee County Port Authority as an independent special district and revises its definitions, powers, functions, and duties.

title: Leon County
summary: Limits county payments for inmate medical and emergency transport services to providers that have a contract with Leon County, overriding general law.

title: Town of Davie, Broward County
summary: Lets the Town of Davie permit a sign on specified agriculturally zoned property, as an exception to general law.

title: Charlotte County
summary: Creates the Bocilla Islands Chain Conservation District in Charlotte County, limiting density, commercial use, building height, and infrastructure expansion within its boundaries.

title: City of Punta Gorda, Charlotte County
summary: Redraws Punta Gorda Utility District boundaries and shifts some utility functions to Charlotte County, requiring interlocal agreements and continued water and wastewater service.

title: Town of White Springs, Hamilton County
summary: Abolishes the Town of White Springs and transfers its assets and legitimate liabilities to other entities.

title: Marion County
topics: Government and administration; Housing; Taxes and budget
summary: Creates the Uplands Steward District in Marion County, giving it bonding, special assessment, and future tax powers, and requiring notices to residential purchasers.

title: Eastpoint Water and Sewer District, Franklin County
summary: Expands the Eastpoint Water and Sewer District's boundaries and gives its board additional powers, subject to referenda.

title: City of Winter Springs, Seminole County
summary: Restructures Winter Springs' city commission to five members with a voting mayor, revises mayoral duties, and requires a referendum.

title: Okeechobee Utility Authority, Okeechobee County
summary: Provides for conveying specified lands to the Okeechobee Utility Authority in Okeechobee County.

title: Highlands County Hospital District
summary: Adds requirements the Highlands County hospital district board must meet before leasing, managing or selling hospital assets, including filing sale agreements with the state and judicial review.

title: City of Trenton, Gilchrist County
summary: Transfers state-held real property in Trenton to the city, with conditions on its use and sale and a cultural resource review.

title: Adaptive Reuse of Land
summary: Lets counties and municipalities adopt transitional housing ordinances for adaptive reuse of land, and creates a public-private council to oversee such projects.

title: Observance of Veterans' Day by K-12 Schools
summary: Requires school districts to observe Veterans' Day as a school holiday.

title: Sarasota and Manatee Counties
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Creates the University Town Center Improvement District in Sarasota and Manatee Counties, an independent special taxing district with assessment and bond-issuance powers.

title: Fellsmere Water Control District, Indian River County
summary: Makes the Fellsmere Water Control District a dependent district of Indian River County, with the county commission as its governing board, and revises its boundaries.

title: Headwaters Water Control District, Indian River County
summary: Creates the Headwaters Water Control District in Indian River County as a public corporation, with a charter, boundaries, and rules for canal maintenance.

title: Manatee County
summary: Removes provisions of the Manatee County Free Public Library Act; the summary does not say what replaces them.

title: South Indian River Water Control District, Palm Beach County
summary: Restructures the South Indian River Water Control District's board: more members, staggered terms, residency and election changes, and a limit on a one-time special assessment.

title: Pub. Rec./Victims of Domestic Violence and Dating Violence
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice
summary: Exempts names, addresses, phone numbers and Social Security numbers of dating violence victims in the Address Confidentiality Program from public records, applied retroactively.

title: Sales of Ammunition
summary: Requires background checks for sales or transfers of ammunition, with listed exceptions.

title: Town of Loxahatchee Groves, Palm Beach County
summary: Lets the Town of Loxahatchee Groves ban fireworks sale and use in its agricultural residential zoning district, overriding general state law.

title: Apalachicola Water and Sewer District, Franklin County
summary: Creates the Apalachicola Water & Sewer District, transfers city water and sewer service and assets to it, and bars the city from taking on certain new debt.

title: Port St. Joe Port Authority, Franklin, Gadsden, Gulf, and Liberty Counties
summary: Expands the Port St. Joe Port Authority's territory to add Franklin, Gadsden, and Liberty Counties and revises its governing board membership with staggered terms.

title: Affordable Property Ad Valorem Tax Exemption on Leased Land
summary: Authorizes certain leased land to qualify for a specified ad valorem property tax exemption and lets the Department of Revenue adopt emergency rules.

title: Developmental Disabilities
summary: Revises the statutory definition of "developmental disability" and defines Tatton-Brown-Rahman syndrome, which may affect who qualifies for disability services.

title: Swimming Safety
summary: Requires pools and public bathing places to collect information and provide flotation devices for certain children, allows refusal of access, and creates drowning-prevention pilot programs.

title: Attorney Fees, Suit Money, and Costs
summary: Expands court authority to award, deny, or reduce attorney fees and costs as sanctions, including in appellate and criminal contempt proceedings.

title: Community-based Care Lead Agency and Subcontractor Liability
summary: Lowers the damages cap for community-based care lead agencies and subcontractors in foster care tort suits and limits attorney fees on those judgments.

title: Discrimination in Education
summary: Requires school districts, Florida College System institutions, and state universities to designate Title VI coordinators and establishes a complaint process for Title VI discrimination violations.

title: Curators of Estates
summary: Revises Florida rules for court-appointed estate curators, covering court reporting, duties, bonding, removal, and reporting.

title: Career and Academic Planning For Middle and High School Students
summary: Requires districts to annually inform students and parents about career and technical education, and requires middle school career and academic planning meetings and annual plan reviews.

title: Residential Utility Disconnections
topics: Consumer protection and business; Environment and energy
summary: Prohibits residential utility disconnections for nonpayment under certain conditions, requires certain fee waivers, adds notice requirements, and sets penalties for violations.

title: Law Enforcement and Immigration Officer Identifying Information and Face Coverings
summary: Requires immigration officers to display visible identification and bans face coverings for immigration and law enforcement officers, with criminal penalties.

title: Peer Support for First Responders
summary: Expands the definition of "first responder" to include specified support personnel for peer support purposes.

title: Performance Reports of Circuit and County Court Judges
summary: Requires clerks of circuit court to publish annual performance reports on each circuit and county judge, with optional judge explanatory statements posted alongside.

title: Family Empowerment Scholarship Program
summary: Requires private schools that take Family Empowerment Scholarship students to give parents specified information in writing before enrollment.

title: Student Elopement
summary: Requires public schools to create SAFE Teams and school elopement plans, with set requirements for both.

title: Coverage for Out-of-network Ground Ambulance Emergency Services
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Requires health insurers and HMOs to pay out-of-network ambulance providers at a specified rate and caps insured cost-sharing for those services.

title: Historic Cemeteries Program
summary: Requires local governments to approve rezoning applications from historic African-American cemeteries to develop excess vacant land compatible with adjacent uses.

title: Rules for Adult Cardiovascular Services
summary: Revises the criteria and procedures the state uses to set rules for adult cardiovascular services; the summary does not say whether the rules become looser or stricter.

title: Public Adjuster Contracts
summary: Lets certain persons rescind public adjuster contracts and clarifies conduct that can lead to discipline of public adjusters and apprentices.

title: Motor Vehicle Manufacturers and Franchised Motor Vehicle Dealers
summary: Revises rules governing manufacturer-dealer relations, adding prohibitions on certain performance metrics and retaliation and defining when franchise agreements are unfair.

title: Criteria for Determining Criminal Gang Membership
summary: Revises the legal definition of "criminal gang member" and defines "gang-related language," with no stated effect on penalties or procedure.

title: Reusable Tenant Screening Reports
summary: Lets landlords accept reusable tenant screening reports, sets required report contents, and bars landlords from charging certain fees to applicants who use one.

title: Pub. Rec./Sales of Ammunition
topics: Government and administration; Guns and weapons
summary: Exempts certain buyer or transferee information for ammunition sales from public records requirements, with future legislative review and repeal.

title: Background Screening of Athletic Coaches
summary: Changes the date by which certain athletic coaches must complete background screenings.

title: Air-conditioning and Mechanical Contractors
summary: Expands the definitions of class A air-conditioning and mechanical contractor to cover additional services those contractors may perform.

title: Administrative Procedures
summary: Revises Florida administrative procedure rules on rulemaking, notices, hearings, publication, emergency rules, and annual regulatory plans.

title: Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration; Guns and weapons
summary: Preempts local gas-equipment limits, lets DEP surplus conservation lands suitable for farming, and bans misleading concealed-weapon-permit displays, plus other items.

title: Telecommunications Access System Act of 1991
summary: Revises the Public Service Commission's powers over the telecommunications access system, device distribution procedures, and advisory committee composition.

title: Placement of Child in Certified Domestic Violence Center
summary: Lets courts and DCF place children and their proposed legal custodians in certified domestic violence centers, waiving some home study requirements.

title: Tampering with an Electronic Monitoring Device
summary: Revises the electronic monitoring tampering offense, sets a penalty for minors, and requires pretrial release revocation for tampering while on release, with new bond allowed under conditions.

title: Public Records
summary: Requires agencies to promptly acknowledge and respond in good faith to public records requests, provide detailed cost estimates, and faces court-assessed costs and penalties for violations.

title: K-12 Instructional Personnel Salary Compression
summary: Requires school district and charter school salary distribution plans to address salary compression for specified instructional personnel.

title: Practice of Chiropractic Medicine
summary: Expands chiropractors' scope to possess emergency oxygen and inject certain vitamins and supplements, subject to board certification and minimum standards.

title: Gun Violence Prevention Pilot Program
summary: Creates a Gainesville gun violence prevention pilot program with alternatives to incarceration for specified youth, funded by a $500,000 appropriation, with reporting to the Governor and Legislature.

title: Conservation Lands
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Adds public website disclosure before land sale and exchange reviews, changes appraisal and council review steps for conservation land transactions, and removes some existing council review requirements.

title: Education
summary: Lets charter schools count as public facilities for concurrency, lets charter boards set their own student conduct codes, and lets virtual students join public school athletic teams.

title: Products Liability Actions Under the Florida Pesticide Law
summary: Bars product liability lawsuits over pesticide failure-to-warn claims when the pesticide label meets specified conditions.

title: Toll Exemptions for Veterans
summary: Exempts certain disabled veterans from paying tolls on state toll facilities.

title: Dangerous Crimes
summary: Requires courts to immediately remand people who plead guilty or are found guilty of dangerous crimes, denying bond until sentencing, and revises the definition of dangerous crime.

title: Disability History and Awareness Instruction
summary: Requires that disability history and awareness instruction include specified materials.

title: Pub. Rec. and Meetings/Mental Health and Substance Abuse
summary: Closes mental health and substance abuse hearings to the public and exempts related records and petitions from public records requirements.

title: Optometry
summary: Expands optometrists' scope to include certified ophthalmic procedures and surgery, revises the Board of Optometry, and adds a financial responsibility requirement for licensure.

title: Department of Transportation Contractor Liability
summary: Makes DOT contractors agents of the state in certain circumstances and requires contracts to indemnify DOT for contractor negligence.

title: Resident Status for Tuition Purposes
summary: Prevents a person from losing Florida resident tuition status solely because they are incarcerated in specified correctional facilities.

title: Sexual Offenders and Sexual Predators
summary: Revises sex offender residency, loitering, contact, notice, and supervision rules, and authorizes warrantless arrests for specified offenses.

title: Court Judgment Interest Rates and Insurance Reports and Practices
summary: Revises insurance rules: property insurers must give written loss estimates, disclose arbitration credits, and join mandatory mediation; OIR gets new reports and rate-review factors.

title: 911 Public Safety Telecommunicator Employment-related Mental or Nervous Injuries
summary: Extends existing workers' compensation medical benefit provisions for first responders' mental or nervous injuries to 911 public safety telecommunicators.

title: Pool/Spa Contractors
summary: Revises the definitions of commercial, residential, and servicing pool/spa contractor terms; the summary does not state any change in obligations.

title: Requirements for a Standard High School Diploma
summary: Lets two years of marching band satisfy both the PE and performing arts diploma requirements, and lets students with disabilities use Special Olympics to meet PE.

title: Database of Animal Cruelty Violators
summary: Requires FDLE to post on its website the names of certain individuals who have violated specified animal cruelty provisions.

title: Protection of Historic Monuments and Memorials
summary: Preempts local removal or damage of historic Florida monuments, voids contrary local rules, penalizes officials, and withholds state funds from noncompliant local governments.

title: Unlawful Distribution of Controlled Substances Resulting in Death
summary: Creates a third-degree murder offense for unlawfully distributing controlled substances, including dangerous fentanyl, that results in death, and defines key terms.

title: Alternative Sources of Weather Information
