summary: Requires the state emergency plan to evaluate supplemental weather data and advanced forecasting products, and directs the Division of Emergency Management to integrate and promote them.

title: Resolution of Disputed Property Insurance Claims
summary: Makes property insurance claim mediation mandatory and a precondition to litigation, requires insureds to attend in person and provide documents, and appropriates $1 million.

title: Property Insurance Claims
summary: Creates a mandatory administrative procedure for resolving disputed property insurance claims, with petitions to DOAH and deadlines requiring insurers to pay or respond.

title: Insurance Solutions Advisory Council
summary: Creates a temporary advisory council within the Office of Insurance Regulation that reports annually, then expires.

title: Volunteering at Polling Locations
summary: Exempts specified high school students who volunteer to assist poll workers from rules limiting election-related use of private funds or personal services.

title: Medical Malpractice Review Committees
summary: Revises the statutory definition of "medical review committee" in Florida's medical malpractice law; the summary gives no detail on the change.

title: Certificate of Title Application Requirements
summary: Adds proof of identification and residency to the requirements for certificate of title applications.

title: Admission To Practice Law by Unauthorized Alien
summary: Requires revoking certain Florida law licenses held by unauthorized aliens on a specified date under certain circumstances.

title: Community Association Management
topics: Consumer protection and business; Labor and employment
summary: Requires community association managers and firms to carry specified insurance and be licensed, allows license revocation, and limits timeshare firms to certain licensing rules.

title: Dual Enrollment Student Eligibility
summary: Makes certain students enrolled in adult education centers eligible for dual enrollment in college courses.

title: Notice of Restoration of Voting Rights Information on Sentencing Scoresheets
summary: Requires sentencing scoresheets to include information on restoring voting rights and to be provided to the defendant before sentencing.

title: Decreasing Racial and Ethnic Disparities in Mental Health and Substance Abuse Services
summary: Revises Closing the Gap grant program project requirements and review criteria to include mental health and substance abuse services.

title: Specialty License Plates
summary: Directs DHSMV to create a Miami Carol City Senior High School Alumni license plate and sets how plate fees are distributed and used.

title: Child Care and Early Learning Providers
topics: Children and families; Government and administration
summary: Revises child care licensing, personnel screening, sanitation and safety standards, and inspection rules; exempts preschools from municipal special assessments.

title: Specific Medical Diagnoses in Child Protective Investigations
summary: Changes child protective investigation procedures, including law enforcement referral timing, physician consultation and written medical reports for Child Protection Teams.

title: End-of-life Options
summary: Creates a procedure letting mentally capable terminally ill adults obtain medication to end their lives, with requirements for providers, facilities and DOH.

title: Recruitment and Retention of Speech-language Pathologists
summary: Requires the Department of Education to develop and maintain a statewide plan to recruit and retain speech-language pathologists and ensure quality services.

title: Transportation Facility Designations
summary: Designates a Miami-Dade County boulevard as Congresswoman Frederica S. Wilson Boulevard and directs DOT to erect markers.

title: Pub. Rec./Civilian Contractors and Government Employees
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Exempts certain current and former civilian contractors, government employees, and their spouses and dependents from public records requirements, with retroactive application and future review.

title: Ambulatory Surgical Centers
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Adds a penalty for ambulatory surgical centers that fail to timely provide good faith estimates; requires AHCA to notify DLR of certain federal rule adoptions.

title: Out-of-home Placement Providers and Treatment Facilities
summary: Requires state agencies to share placement data with community-based care lead agencies and directs OPPAGA to analyze capacity for high-acuity children and report findings.

title: Geoengineering and Weather Modification Activities
summary: Revises Florida's weather modification law, adding DEP duties, prohibited activities, civil penalties, and violation reporting and investigation.

title: Drug Paraphernalia
summary: Revises the definition of drug paraphernalia so certain narcotic-drug-testing products are no longer covered.

title: Leaving the Scene of a Crash Involving Only Damage to Vehicle or Property
summary: Lets courts order drivers convicted of leaving the scene of a property-damage-only crash to pay restitution for the damage.

title: Land and Water Management
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Bars local governments from restricting upland activities outside certain wetland buffers and repeals land management review team provisions.

title: Anchoring Limitation Areas
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Limits local governments' power to regulate anchored vessels outside mooring field boundaries, extends anchoring restrictions near mooring fields, and designates Biscayne Bay areas as anchoring limitation zones.

title: Public Nuisance Abatement
summary: Removes the cap on the total amount of fines that may be imposed for public nuisances and revises how those fines are assessed and collected.

title: Emergency Communications State Plan
summary: Creates or updates a state emergency communications plan and defines the term "first responder."

title: Manufacturing
summary: Creates a Chief Manufacturing Officer in the Department of Commerce and a manufacturers' workforce development grant program, with state and local entities required to assist.

title: Invalid Restrictive Covenants with Physicians
summary: Makes restrictive covenants that bar physicians from practicing medicine in an area for a period void and unenforceable.

title: Petitions for Injunction for Protection Against Domestic Violence Containing Allegations of Marriage Fraud
summary: Requires clerks to send domestic violence injunction petitions alleging marriage fraud to the State Board of Immigration Enforcement, which must contact the petitioner.

title: Investments of Public Funds in Bitcoin
topics: Consumer protection and business; Taxes and budget
summary: Authorizes the CFO and State Board of Administration to invest public funds in Bitcoin, allows Bitcoin loans, and exempts these investments from certain security requirements.

title: Repair of Mobility Devices
summary: Requires manufacturers of mobility devices to make repair documentation, software, parts and tools available, with liability limits for manufacturers and repair providers.

title: Restoration of Voting Rights Database
summary: Creates a public database of restored voting rights and shields people who reasonably rely on it from certain criminal charges.

title: Terminology Associated with Florida Housing Finance Corporation
summary: Revises and adds definitions for terms used in Florida Housing Finance Corporation provisions; the summary describes no change to substantive rules or funding.

title: Specialty License Plates
summary: Directs the DHSMV to develop a United States Naval Academy specialty license plate and provides for distribution and use of its fees.

title: Political Activities on School Grounds
summary: Allows candidates to speak on school grounds under conditions, prohibits certain political activities there, and bars employees from using work resources for political advocacy, with criminal penalties.

title: Use of Artificial Intelligence by Governmental Agencies to Detect Concealed Firearms
topics: AI and technology; Civil rights and liberties
summary: Prohibits government agencies and their contractors from using AI to detect concealed firearms in public places, with listed exceptions and a civil remedy.

title: Faith-based Content in Batterers' Intervention Programs
summary: Allows batterers' intervention programs to include faith-based activities while barring any requirement that participants take part in them.

title: Memory Care
summary: Sets operating standards, contract requirements, and advertising limits for memory care providers, and defines duties for an Alzheimer's center.

title: Leave for Living Organ Donation
summary: Requires state agencies and certain employers to provide leave for employees who serve as living organ donors, with optional longer leave.

title: Adverse Personnel Actions Against Employees
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Bars agencies and contractors from retaliating against employees who report ethics violations to the Commission on Ethics, and creates remedies including civil actions.

title: Golf Course Best Management Practices Certification
summary: Adds legislative findings on golf course best management practices certification and transfers the program from DEP to the Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services.

title: Nonprofit Agricultural Organization Medical Benefit Plans
summary: Sets authority, duties, and prohibited acts for nonprofit agricultural organizations that offer medical benefit plans to their members.

title: Neurofibromatosis Research Grants
summary: Creates a Department of Health neurofibromatosis grant program, subject to appropriation, with application requirements and council and peer-review guidelines.

title: Malt Beverages
summary: Lets certain malt beverage manufacturers end vendor contracts under set conditions without violating unlawful-practice rules, and sets yearly production amounts on request.

title: Dependent Children
summary: Expands dependency grounds for presuming detriment to children in parricide cases, adds special training, supervised contact, records access, and hearing requirements.

title: Combatting Illegal Immigration
summary: Bars licensed money transmitters from foreign remittances unless they verify the sender is not an unauthorized alien, with record-keeping, complaints, and license-suspension penalties.

title: General Appropriations Act
summary: Provides $112.95 billion in state appropriations for fiscal year 2025-26 and supplemental 2024-25 funding for agency salaries, expenses, and capital outlay.

title: General Appropriations Act
summary: General appropriations act providing about $113.6 billion for state agencies for fiscal year 2026-27 and supplemental 2025-26 funding.

title: General Appropriations Act
summary: Appropriates about $113.6 billion for state agency operations and capital outlay for fiscal year 2026-27, plus supplemental funds for 2025-26.

title: Implementing the 2025-2026 General Appropriations Act
summary: Implements specified appropriations from the 2025-2026 General Appropriations Act for the 2025-2026 fiscal year.

title: Implementing the 2026-2027 General Appropriations Act
summary: Implements specified appropriations of the 2026-2027 General Appropriations Act for the fiscal year.

title: Implementing the 2026-2027 General Appropriations Act
summary: Implements specified appropriations from the 2026-2027 General Appropriations Act for the fiscal year.

title: Collective Bargaining
summary: Provides a procedure for resolving collective bargaining impasses between the state and certified representatives of state employee bargaining units.

title: State-administered Retirement System
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Requires certain elected officials to join the Senior Management Service Class and revises required employer retirement contribution rates across Florida Retirement System classes.

title: Government Administration
summary: Revises state government administration rules on audits, reviews, investigations, budgeting, estimating conferences, and budget requests.

title: Hands-free Driving
summary: Prohibits drivers from using wireless devices in a handheld manner, requires hands-free use for sustained calls, and revises related penalties.

title: Construction Disruption Assistance
summary: Creates a revolving loan program for construction-impact relief, with reporting duties for the Department of Commerce and liability protections for the state.

title: Funding for Environmental Resource Management
summary: Removes wildlife corridor landowner agreement authority and repeals dedicated funding for conservation lands, resiliency, clean water, and a trail grant program.

title: State-funded Property Reinsurance Programs
summary: Reduces authorized General Revenue transfers to the state reinsurance backstop for hurricane losses and removes the FORA reinsurance program.

title: State Group Insurance
summary: Requires DMS to recommend prescription drug formulary management changes for a plan year, implementing only those the Legislative Budget Commission approves.

title: Debt Reduction
summary: Creates a State Board of Administration debt reduction program, requires annual fund transfers to it, and reverts unused money to General Revenue.

title: Local Business Taxes
summary: Revises conditions on local governments' business taxes, including levy limits, ordinance changes, business reclassification, revenue caps and audits.

title: Drowning Prevention Education
summary: Requires DOH to develop drowning prevention education materials and requires hospitals, birth centers, and childbirth educators to give them to new parents.

title: Location of Equipment Owned by Amusement Business Owner
summary: Bars counties and cities from requiring payment for placing, parking, or storing amusement equipment on certain agricultural lands beyond a set time.

title: Virtual Currency Kiosks
summary: Requires virtual currency kiosk businesses to register with the state, collect customer attestations, display disclosures, give receipts, and issue refunds in certain cases.

title: Pub. Rec./ Sexual Assault Counselors
summary: Exempts personal identifying and location information of sexual assault counselors from public records requirements, with future review and repeal and retroactive application.

title: Special Protections in Judicial Proceedings
summary: Lets courts require pro se defendants to question certain victims and witnesses through standby counsel, upon specified findings.

title: Licensure by Endorsement to Practice Dentistry and Dental Hygiene
summary: Bill bars specified persons from obtaining dental or dental hygiene licenses through the interstate mobile licensure endorsement pathway.

title: Code Inspector Body Cameras
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Requires governments that let code inspectors wear body cameras to adopt policies, training, records retention and periodic reviews, and exempts those recordings from interception laws.

title: Elections
summary: Requires write-in candidates to pay fees, bars write-ins from counting as opponents, mandates no-internet voting system security rules, and allows hand counts at precincts.

title: Tax Credits for Housing for Homeless Employees
summary: Creates state tax credits for businesses that provide housing to homeless employees, with requirements, annual caps, and approval rules.

title: Education
summary: Revises provisions on the Education Estimating Conference, two scholarship programs, the FEFP, and K-12 funding; the summary gives no specific changes.

title: Specific Medical Diagnoses in Child Protective Investigations
summary: Adjusts child protective investigations involving medical diagnoses, requires physician consultation, and lets removed parents request child exams at their own cost.

title: Pub. Rec./Code Inspector Body Cameras
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Exempts code inspector body camera recordings from public records law, requires local governments to retain them for a set period, and sets future repeal review.

title: Electronic Transmittal of Court Orders
summary: Requires clerks to electronically transmit involuntary commitment orders, summonses, and risk protection orders to law enforcement or sheriffs within set timeframes.

title: Alzheimer's Disease Awareness Initiative
summary: Requires the Department of Elder Affairs to contract for an Alzheimer's disease awareness initiative and has an advisory committee make annual recommendations.

title: Uniform Commercial Code
summary: Adopts UCC rules for controllable electronic records, defining qualifying purchasers, their rights, and limits on claims against them.

title: Doula Support for Healthy Births Pilot Program
summary: Creates a doula services pilot program in Broward, Miami-Dade and Palm Beach counties under DOH, plus a task force on doula certification that reports to the Governor and Legislature.

title: Pub. Rec./ Municipal Clerks And Staff
summary: Creates a public records exemption shielding personal information of municipal clerks, their staff, and their families, and schools or day cares their children attend.

title: Medicaid Provider Networks
summary: Requires AHCA to set network adequacy standards for Medicaid prepaid dental plans and requires provider directories to show which providers accept new patients.

title: Administration of Controlled Substances by Paramedics
summary: Authorizes a practitioner to cause a certified paramedic to administer controlled substances, expanding paramedic scope of practice.

title: Golf Cart Crossings
summary: Allows golf carts to cross certain streets and highways under specified conditions, with penalties for violations.

title: State Financial Accounting
summary: Renames a state financial management subsystem, replaces certain warrants, deletes semimonthly salary payment authority, and sets rules for records requests and agency interest payments.

title: Collective Bargaining
summary: Sets a procedure for resolving unresolved collective bargaining issues between the state and certified unions representing state employees.

title: Collective Bargaining
summary: Sets a process for resolving collective bargaining impasses between the state and certified unions representing state employees.

title: Capitol Center
summary: Makes the Governor, Cabinet, and Legislature permanent Capitol Complex tenants, with consent rights over space, parking, utilities, and projects.

title: Government Administration
summary: Revises state government administration rules covering audits, program reviews, investigations, budgeting, estimating conferences, and budget requests.

title: Government Administration
summary: Revises state government administration rules on audits, reviews, investigations, budgeting, estimating conferences, and budget requests.

summary: Revises DMS administrative provisions on state agency health insurance assessments, Capitol Complex, minority business certification, small business procurement, and related programs.

summary: Appropriates funds to the Department of Corrections for facility construction, authorizes bond issuance, requires planning, and creates a financing oversight committee.

title: Transportation

summary: Exempts from public records requirements injunction petitions for protection against serious violence by a known person, and information identifying the petitioner or respondent.

summary: Exempts from public records disclosure certain information about ammunition buyers or transferees not found prohibited, with future legislative review and repeal.

title: Medical Conscience
summary: Authorizes health care providers and payors to bring civil lawsuits for certain damages and relief; the specific subject is not stated.

title: Florida State Guard
summary: Gives Florida State Guard members leave entitlements and park pass discounts, creates a gold sportsman's license, and establishes a scholarship program within DOE.

title: Temporary Door Locking Devices
summary: Defines temporary door locking devices, lets them be installed at any height, and requires Building Code standards and integration into school safety plans and drills.

title: Medical Marijuana Use Registry Identification Cards
summary: Requires medical marijuana registry ID cards to renew every two years and bars DOH fees for honorably discharged veterans' cards.

title: Local Licensing of Home Caregivers

summary: Authorizes counties and municipalities to license home caregivers within their own jurisdictions.

title: Persons Authorized to Solemnize Matrimony
summary: Authorizes members of the Legislature to solemnize marriages, adding them to the persons who may perform wedding ceremonies.

title: Intelligent Speed Assistance Devices
summary: Requires offenders convicted of certain driving offenses to install intelligent speed assistance devices before operating a vehicle, with DHSMV oversight and reinstatement terms.

title: Designation of the Official State Flagship
summary: Redesignates Florida's official state flagship as the S.S. American Victory, a naming change with no policy effect.

title: Higher Education

title: Transportation

summary: Revises continuing education requirements for podiatric medicine, extending them to certain persons; the summary does not say how.

title: Transportation Network Company, Driver, and Vehicle Owner Insurance

title: Medical Review Committees

title: Performance Measures and Standards of Special Districts

title: Risk Protection Orders

title: Tourist Development Taxes

title: Individual Education Plans

title: Pub. Rec./County and City Administrators and Managers

title: Felony Battery

title: Medical Spa Facilities

title: Justice Administrative Commission

title: Preventing the Spread of Avian Influenza

title: Pub. Rec./Law Enforcement Officers Actively Engaged in Official Duty

title: Criminal Conflict and Civil Regional Counsel Membership in the Senior Management Service Class

title: Local Government Official Salaries

title: Specialty License Plates

title: Food Additives

title: Gender Identity Employment Practices

title: Insurance
