summary: Revises disability provisions for firefighters, law enforcement and correctional officers, and lets a prior medical exam showing no tuberculosis, heart disease, or hypertension satisfy the preemployment physical.

title: Termination of Pregnancies
summary: Revises the legal criteria for terminating a pregnancy during viability; the summary does not specify the changes.

title: Department of Commerce
summary: Designates Commerce to receive and administer federal HUD Community Development Block Grant funds, repeals the state small cities CDBG program, and makes technical changes.

title: Social Media Use by Minors
topics: AI and technology; Children and families
summary: Requires social media platforms to delete certain data, give parents access to minors' information, share data with law enforcement, and restrict minors' messaging.

title: Prohibited Sex-reassignment Prescriptions and Procedures
summary: Prohibits sex-reassignment prescriptions and procedures and aiding such violations, with Attorney General civil enforcement, damages, injunctions and civil penalties.

title: Tax Exemption on Sales of Indigenous Arts and Crafts
summary: Creates a sales tax exemption for sales of indigenous arts and crafts and requires the Department of Commerce to maintain a registry.

title: Sealing of Criminal History Records
summary: Expands eligibility to petition courts to seal criminal history records for certain misdemeanor and other adjudications, including subsequent sealing and multiple related adjudications.

title: Doula Services in Maternal Health Initiatives
summary: Creates a DOH doula support pilot program for maternal health, targeting specified populations, subject to funding, with possible later expansion into existing programs.

title: Pub. Rec./Sealing of Criminal History Records
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice
summary: Expands the public records exemption to cover sealed criminal history records of people adjudicated guilty of certain nonviolent misdemeanors, with future review and repeal.

title: Benefits for Firefighters Injured During Training Exercises
summary: Makes firefighters totally and permanently disabled during official training exercises, and their spouses and dependent children, eligible for certain insurance coverage.

title: Criminal Warrants
summary: Revises misdemeanor arrest-warrant conditions, letting judges issue summonses or notices to appear instead of arrest warrants in certain circumstances.

title: Display of Flags by Governmental Entities
summary: Bars governmental entities from displaying certain flags, requires neutrality in some cases, sets US flag placement, and lets veterans use reasonable force to protect it.

title: Public Works Employee Identification Cards
summary: Defines "public works employee" and requires political subdivisions to issue identification cards to certain public works employees.

title: Law Enforcement, Correctional, and Correctional Probation Officer Benefits
summary: Makes injured law enforcement, correctional and correctional probation officers, and their spouses and dependent children, eligible for certain insurance coverage.

title: Infrastructure and Resiliency
summary: Gives DEP exclusive authority to run coastal resiliency projects through public-private partnerships, lets it encourage private investment, and requires website publication of related information.

title: State Lotteries
summary: Lets lottery courier services store and redeem winning tickets for customers, raises retailer bonds, and adds false-claim and theft prohibitions.

title: School Counselors
summary: Exempts people seeking school counselor jobs from specified educator certification rules, lets districts set conditions, and ties counselor evaluations to specified standards.

title: Construction Contracting
topics: Consumer protection and business; Education; Housing
summary: Tightens contractor licensing and deposit rules with disciplinary and criminal penalties, and adds construction consumer-protection content to financial literacy standards.

title: Areas of Critical State Concern
summary: Exempts specified entities from certain payment and performance bond requirements and extends Florida Forever funds for Florida Keys land purchases.

title: Sexual Images
summary: Creates or expands prohibitions on possessing, soliciting, or generating lewd, child pornography, and nonconsensual altered sexual images of identifiable people.

title: School Safety
topics: Criminal justice; Education; Guns and weapons
summary: Expands school guardian programs to colleges, creates a weapon-discharge offense near schools, and requires certain arrestees to be held until a bail hearing.

title: Minimum Age for Firearm Purchase or Transfer
summary: Lowers the minimum age to purchase a firearm and the age below which licensed dealers may not sell or transfer firearms.

title: Court Fees
summary: Raises clerk of court filing fees and service charges in probate, trial, appellate and county civil cases, and requires an EDR report to the Legislature.

title: Deferred and Unpaid Taxes
summary: Limits a specified tax deferral to properties valued at $1 million or less and raises the minimum value of tax certificates sold at auction or electronically.

title: Consumer Guide to Homeowner's Insurance
summary: Requires the Office of Insurance Regulation to publish a consumer guide on homeowner's insurance on a public website.

title: Child Welfare
summary: Modifies child welfare requirements for foster children, including psychotropic medication reports, weekly allowances, coordination duties, and public reporting by DCF and community-based care agencies.

title: Celia Cruz Day
summary: Designates October 21 of each year as Celia Cruz Day in Florida.

title: Child Care and Early Learning Services
topics: Children and families; Consumer protection and business; Education
summary: Creates a Florida Child Care Fund, revises child care licensing and prekindergarten curriculum rules, and bars insurers from refusing large family child care home operators.

title: Practice of Veterinary Medicine
summary: Revises the Board of Veterinary Medicine, sets vet technician application criteria, and lets licensed technicians perform specified services under veterinarian supervision.

title: Residential Property Insurance
summary: Requires OIR to create a homeowner insurance resource center, mandates insurer notices of it, bars counting land value in coverage and claims, and expands hurricane discount disclosures.

title: Pub Rec./Practice of Veterinary Medicine
summary: Creates a public records exemption for records relating to licensed veterinary technicians until specified criteria are met.

title: Motor Vehicle Insurance
summary: Repeals parts of Florida's no-fault auto insurance law and revises required motor vehicle coverages, dealer, for-hire, and rideshare driver requirements, with an $83,651 appropriation.

title: Public Postsecondary Safety Policies and Procedures
summary: Requires state universities and Florida College System institutions to adopt, implement and annually review safety policies and procedures.

title: Local Government Assessments
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Removes special assessments as a local funding tool for certain municipal and county facilities and services, and shifts certain conservation easement fees to local governments.

title: Interception and Disclosure of Oral Communications
summary: Lets a person who is party to a conversation intercept and record it under set conditions, with use limited to evidencing domestic violence.

title: Municipal Utilities
summary: Limits municipal transfers of public utility earnings to the general fund, requiring referendum or supermajority action, with exceptions, repayment, and required budget disclosure.

title: Assessment of Homestead Property
summary: Revises how homestead property is assessed, tying assessments to recent purchase price or construction cost, and lets the Department of Revenue create a grant program.

title: Homeowner's Insurance Premium Reductions
summary: Requires homeowners' insurers to give premium reductions for claim-free periods and mitigation upgrades, keeps storm-claim filers eligible, and bars certain claim treatment.

title: Offenses Involving Children
summary: Bars ignorance, misrepresentation, or good-faith belief about a child victim's age as defenses, revises luring offense age limits, and prohibits luring children out of structures.

title: Pub. Rec./Office of Financial Regulation
summary: Exempts certain OFR-received information on cybersecurity events, financial institutions, and investigations from public records requirements, with future review and repeal.

title: Impounding Motor Vehicles
summary: Creates impoundment procedures for vehicles involved in fleeing or eluding police, sets release conditions, and requires payment of impoundment costs and fees.

title: Juvenile Justice
summary: Requires juveniles to remain in commitment programs until completion, sets minimum commitment periods, and lowers the age for maximum-risk residential commitment for murder or manslaughter.

title: Cyberintimidation by Publication
summary: Expands cyberintimidation by publication to cover electronically published information shared without consent, drops the reasonable-fear intent element, raises penalties, and creates a civil cause of action.

title: Medicaid Coverage of Blood Pressure Monitors and Cuffs
summary: Requires Medicaid to cover blood pressure monitors and cuffs under the pharmacy benefit for qualifying recipients, pending federal approval, with rate impacts included.

title: Sentencing of Military Veterans with Mental Health Conditions
summary: Lets courts impose a modified sentence instead of a set term or mandatory minimum for veterans with mental health conditions, with some offense exceptions.

title: Coordinated Access Model Pilot Program
summary: Creates a DCF pilot in Clay, Duval and St. Johns counties to build a coordinated access model, with a state university subcontract and reports to the Governor and Legislature.

title: Heated Tobacco Products
summary: Revises the definitions of "cigarette" and "tobacco products" to exclude certain tobacco-containing products and defines "heated tobacco product."

title: Coverage for the Treatment of Stuttering
summary: Requires private health plans to cover stuttering treatment, and lets Medicaid pay for stuttering services and devices, including telehealth speech therapy.

title: Revenues from Ad Valorem Taxes
summary: Revises the rolled-back rate calculation and caps the maximum millage rate, barring higher rates and requiring excess revenue to be disposed of in a specified way.

title: Pub. Rec./Public Officers
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Exempts home addresses, phone numbers, and minor children's information of current congressional members and public officers from public records requirements.

title: Ad Valorem Tax Levies
summary: Removes statutory references to county and school district ad valorem tax levies, according to a one-line summary.

title: Animal Cruelty During a Declared State of Emergency
summary: Increases criminal penalties for animal cruelty offenses committed during a declared state of emergency.

title: Water Safety Requirements for the Rental of Residential Property
summary: Requires vacation rental licensees to equip certain rental units with specified water safety features, creates civil liability, and provides an exception.

title: Surrendered Infants
summary: Authorizes hospitals, EMS stations and fire stations to use infant safety devices for surrendered infants, with required monitoring and testing.

title: Tax/Sales Taxes
summary: Raises specified sales and use tax rates, dedicates a share of the revenue to a specified purpose, and requires a surtax when property is transferred.

title: Aerospace Innovation Funding
summary: Creates an International Aerospace Innovation Fund that Space Florida must administer, with requirements for the agency and the fund.

title: Anchoring and Mooring at Seaports
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Lets certain seaports seek state approval to create no-anchoring or no-mooring zones, with public hearings, boundary reviews and security-plan reporting.

title: Transfer of Homestead Property by Inheritance
summary: Provides that certain homestead property transferred by inheritance is not a change in ownership, so it avoids property tax reassessment.

title: Veteran and Spouse Nursing Home Beds
summary: Lets certain nursing homes designate beds for veterans and spouses, and exempts some from certificate of need review.

title: Nonprofit Corporations
summary: Updates Florida nonprofit corporation law to conform terminology, align with the business corporation act, and revise governance, membership, meeting, and officer-duty rules.

title: Special Alcoholic Beverage Licenses Issued to Residential Condominiums
summary: Exempts certain residential condominiums from license quota limits, while limiting licenses to food and beverage managers and barring off-premises and late sales.

title: Ad Valorem Tax Revenue in Fiscally Constrained Counties
summary: Requires the Legislature to appropriate funds distributed to fiscally constrained counties that apply, with calculations and reversion if funds go unused.

title: Air-Conditioning and Mechanical Contractors
summary: Expands the defined services that air-conditioning and mechanical contractors may perform, broadening their licensed scope of work.

title: Sale of THC-infused Beverages
summary: Creates a state special license letting retailers sell THC-infused beverages, and bars such sales without that license.

title: Acupuncture
summary: Revises acupuncture licensure requirements and exempts certain persons from some regulations governing the practice of acupuncture.

title: Building Permits and Inspections
summary: Loosens Florida building permit and inspection rules, including permit exemptions for temporary hurricane walls and limits on local zoning that disfavors offsite-built homes.

title: Authorized Brokerage Relationships and Required Disclosures
summary: Revises transaction broker and single agent duties in Florida real estate brokerage, including the content of required single agent notice and consent forms.

title: Veterinary Medicine
summary: Creates a registered veterinary professional associate category that may practice veterinary medicine, with DBPR registration, public listing, and discipline; also extends telehealth prescription periods.

title: Motor Vehicle Repair Work
summary: Requires repair shops to record crash-report transaction details, deliver them to law enforcement, face criminal penalties, and risk registration revocation; revises repair estimate items.

title: Noncriminal Traffic Infractions Resulting in Vehicle Crashes
summary: Adds penalties and a required hearing for certain noncriminal traffic infractions that cause crashes, and requires convicted drivers to carry higher injury coverage limits temporarily.

title: School Social Workers
summary: Exempts persons employed as school social workers from specified educator certification requirements.

title: Temporary Certificates for Practice in Areas of Critical Need
summary: Revises when medical, osteopathic and nursing boards may issue temporary practice certificates in critical-need areas, and lets holders keep providing primary care after designation ends.

title: Designation of the State Birds
summary: Designates the American flamingo as Florida's official state bird and the Florida scrub-jay as state songbird, replacing the mockingbird designation.

title: Postsurgical Recovery Homes
summary: Creates state licensure requirements, minimum standards, and prohibited acts for postsurgical recovery homes, with rulemaking procedures.

title: Education
summary: Revises school and university rules on instruction, parental notification, instructional materials, DEI programs, educator preparation, and core courses; the summary gives no detail on direction.

title: Rental Agreements for Residential Tenancies
summary: Lengthens the nonpayment-of-rent notice period from 3 to 5 days and bars landlords from charging fees or surcharges during that period.

title: Courts
summary: Requires each judicial circuit to keep a judge available for hearings on limited notice, adds reimbursement submission rules, and changes arbitrator pay and oath authentication.

title: Firefighter Cancer Benefits
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Requires former employers to provide death benefits to certain beneficiaries of firefighters who die of cancer, for a specified period.

title: Patient Referrals by Medicaid Managed Care Organizations and Managed Care Plans
summary: Requires AHCA to contract for an analysis of Medicaid managed care plan referrals to affiliated organizations and report the findings.

title: Roofing Requirements for Property Insurance
summary: Bars insurers from refusing or nonrenewing property policies solely over roof age, requires differentiating low- and steep-slope roofs, and allows inspection before replacement is required.

title: Taxes on the Rental of Real Property
summary: Repeals the state tax on rental or license fees for the use of real property.

title: Reporting Lost or Stolen Firearms
summary: Requires individuals to report lost or stolen firearms to local law enforcement within a set timeframe, and to report recovery of those firearms.

title: Relative Caregiver Program Payments
summary: Lets relative and nonrelative caregivers of children in out-of-home care start receiving monthly payments at placement rather than at dependency finding.

title: Medical Examiners' Duties
summary: Requires medical examiners to perform specified autopsies and report sudden unexpected youth deaths to a national registry, with penalties for late reporting and privacy-law disclosure protection.

title: Business Development Incentives for Veterans and Military Spouses
summary: Requires the Department of State to waive specified fees for businesses established by veterans or military spouses, with eligibility, registration and reporting rules.

title: Pub. Rec./Autopsy Reports of Sudden and Expected Deaths
summary: Creates a public records exemption for autopsy reports of certain sudden and unexpected deaths, with limited disclosure circumstances and future repeal review.

title: Health Care
summary: Repeals Florida's restrictions on sex-reassignment prescriptions and procedures, requires Medicaid to cover gender dysphoria treatment, and bars gender-identity-based reimbursement discrimination.

title: Dietetics and Nutrition
summary: Revises dietitian and nutritionist licensing, exemptions, permits, and title use, and prohibits certain dietetic services by unlicensed persons.

title: Exemption of Assets
summary: Exempts certain moneys from specified legal process and defines a homeowner savings plan.

title: Paid Parental Leave
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Requires the state to provide paid parental leave to certain state employees, without forcing use of annual or sick leave.

title: Statewide Study on Automation and Workforce Impact
summary: Requires a Department of Commerce bureau to study automation and AI's economic impact on state employment and report periodically to the Governor and Legislature.

title: Disclosure of Estimated Ad Valorem Taxes
summary: Requires certain real estate listings to show estimated property taxes, bars displaying the current owner's taxes, and adds duties for platforms, DOR and appraisers.

title: Toll Discounts for Veteran-owned Businesses
summary: Creates a two-year pilot giving toll discounts to qualifying veteran-owned businesses, administered by the Florida Turnpike Enterprise with veterans' affairs and management services agencies.

title: Music Therapy
summary: Creates a state license for professional music therapists, restricts unlicensed use of related titles, creates an advisory committee, and sets discipline and supervised-practice provisions.

title: Protections for Public Employees who use Medical Marijuana as Qualified Patients
summary: Bars public employers from taking adverse action against employees or applicants who are qualified medical marijuana patients, and sets notice and testing procedures.

title: Booking Officer Duties Related to Minor Children of Arrested Persons
summary: Requires booking officers to ask arrested persons questions about their minor children and take certain actions regarding those children.

title: Elections and State-issued Identification
summary: Requires citizenship verification and identification from certain voter registration applicants before voting, adds provisional ballots, and marks noncitizen IDs and licenses.

title: Problem-solving Court Reports
summary: Requires specified data in problem-solving court reports and changes how often mental health and treatment-based drug court reports go to the Office of State Courts Administrator.

title: Rapid Rail Transit Compact
summary: Authorizes the Governor to execute a rapid rail transit compact with specified states and join the Southern Rail Commission.

title: Private School Facilities
summary: Makes certain private schools a permitted use in some zoning districts, lets localities require traffic measures, and requires schools in such facilities to meet fire code standards.

title: Tax Credits for Providing Housing for Homeless Employees
summary: Creates state tax credits for businesses that provide housing to homeless employees, capped at a maximum total amount and requiring department approval before use.

title: Freedom of Speech and Religious Expression in Public Schools
summary: Expands K-12 students' rights to political and religious expression, bars viewpoint discrimination, gives equal facility access, and creates a private right to sue.

title: Tax Credits for Investment in Rural Communities
summary: Creates a state tax credit for investments made through approved rural funds, with application, reporting and certificate requirements.

title: Affordable Housing
summary: Revises land use definitions for residential development authorization, excluding certain farms and industrial-use facilities; the text is brief and its effect is unclear.

title: Insurance Overpayment Claims Submitted to Psychologists
summary: Requires insurers to submit overpayment claims against psychologists within a specified timeframe.

title: Unlicensed Practice of Engineering
summary: Adds penalties for people found to have repeatedly practiced engineering without a license.

title: Residential Property Insurance Policy Cancellations, Nonrenewals, and Rate Changes
summary: Bars insurers from canceling or nonrenewing hurricane- or wind-damaged residential and commercial property policies within set timeframes, until repairs are made or renewal expires.

title: Motor Vehicle Registration Renewal
summary: Requires motor vehicle registration renewals to be recorded electronically and removes provisions for validation stickers.

title: Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission Trust Funds
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Revises Fish and Wildlife Commission trust fund rules, allowing trust fund proceeds to be used for law enforcement and authorizing private landowner agreements.

title: Nicotine Products
summary: Requires regular state inspections of retail nicotine dealers, adds fines for certain device sales and advertising, and restricts advertising by dealers who allow under-21 patrons.

title: Veterans Affairs
summary: Revises veterans treatment court admissions, letting courts determine eligibility and divert defendants, with notice requirements and rules for probation violations by participants.

title: Employee Child Care Assistance Programs Study
summary: Directs OPPAGA to study public and private employee child care assistance programs and report to the Governor and Legislature, with a future repeal date.

title: Expedited DNA Testing Grant Program
summary: Creates a state grant program within FDLE to fund expedited DNA testing, with annual awards and recipient reporting.

title: Research and Development Tax Credit
summary: Raises the annual combined cap on research and development tax credits that businesses may receive.

title: Chiropractic Medicine
summary: Expands chiropractors' scope to prescribe and administer natural-origin articles, lets pharmacists fill their orders, and loosens continuing-education rules, including distance learning.

title: Department of Law Enforcement
summary: Bill authorizes FDLE to share immigration detainer records and allows administrative expunction applications, along with several procedural and medal-program changes.

title: Hazardous Walking Conditions
summary: Revises the criteria used to determine whether public school students face hazardous walking conditions. The summary gives no detail on the new criteria.

title: Swimming Lesson Voucher Program
summary: Revises the age requirements for children who receive vouchers under the Swimming Lesson Voucher Program.

title: Trust Funds/My Safe Florida Home Trust Fund/Department of Financial Services
summary: Creates the My Safe Florida Home Trust Fund within DFS and requires a share of a specified sales tax to be distributed into it.

title: Professional Learning for Instructional and School Administrative Personnel
summary: Requires certain professional learning systems to offer at least one autism-specific professional learning opportunity for instructional and administrative staff.

title: Home Hardening
summary: Creates a sales and use tax exemption for impact-resistant doors, garage doors, and windows during a specified month, and specifies distribution of the lost tax revenue.

title: Mobile Home Park Regulations
summary: Lets counties and cities adopt and enforce local mobile home park codes, lets code officers cite park owners or residents, and shifts some owner and resident obligations.

title: Postsecondary Education
summary: Bars Florida College System institutions and state universities from admitting undocumented individuals and removes out-of-state fee waiver provisions for certain students.

title: Perfluoroalkyl and Polyfluoroalkyl Substances
summary: Sets PFAS cleanup standards with Legislative ratification, shields prospective purchasers of contaminated sites from liability, and bans certain Class B firefighting foam after a date.

title: Assault or Battery on a Utility Worker
summary: Creates enhanced penalties by reclassifying assault or battery offenses committed against utility workers, defining the term utility worker.

title: Student Support Services for K-12 Schools
summary: Lets school boards recommend or refer students to outside student support organizations, with background screening requirements for specified persons.

title: School Readiness Program
summary: Revises School Readiness Program data reporting, uniform waiting list, and allocation determination requirements; the text does not specify the direction of change.

title: Exceptional Students and Video Cameras in Public Schools
summary: Requires school boards to adopt policies on video cameras in self-contained classrooms, bars hiding employee identities in recordings, and requires audio with recordings provided on request.

title: Advanced Wastewater Treatment
summary: Requires DEP, with water management districts and sewage facilities, to report to the Governor and Legislature on certain sewage disposal facilities.

title: Grandparent Visitation Rights
summary: Lets a grandparent of a minor child petition a court for court-ordered visitation in certain circumstances; makes technical changes.

title: Florida Commission on Human Relations
summary: Removes the requirement that the Florida Commission on Human Relations send certain information by registered mail.

title: Arbitration for Disputes with Citizens Property Insurance Corporation
summary: Adds arbitration as an option for resolving disputes with Citizens Property Insurance, requiring notice of arbitration to the Division of Administrative Hearings.

title: Review of Compensation for Legislators and Cabinet Members
summary: Requires OPPAGA to research legislator and Cabinet compensation and deliver reports to the Governor and Legislature by a set date.

title: Local Regulation of Drinking Straws and Stirrers
summary: Bans local governments from regulating drinking straws or stirrers unless their rules meet state-specified requirements.

title: Indemnification and Insurance Obligations of Commuter Rail Transportation Providers
summary: Authorizes agencies to assume certain indemnification and insurance obligations tied to operating certain commuter rail services.

title: Dry Needling by Occupational Therapists
summary: Lets occupational therapists perform dry needling, requires the board to set practice standards, supervision and training rules, and requires a DOH report to the Legislature.

title: Underground Utility and Excavation Contractors
summary: Revises the definition of underground utility and excavation contractor and revises the definition of Contractor V; the summary gives no operative change.

title: Physical Therapy Treatment Plans
summary: Exempts specified physical therapy services from the requirement that the practitioner of record review and sign the treatment plan.

title: Firefighter Benefits
summary: Adds acute myeloid leukemia to the statutory definition of cancer, expanding cancer treatment benefits for firefighters.

title: Issuance of Special Beverage Licenses
summary: Revises the service area square footage and capacity limits for food service establishments eligible for special beverage licenses.

title: Virtual Instruction
summary: Lets high-performing charter schools offer part-time virtual courses to certain students, excludes some students from capacity calculations, and revises allowed uses of tax credit scholarship funds.

title: Practice of Veterinary Medicine
summary: Revises veterinary technician licensure, continuing education, discipline and title rules, and expands the services technicians may perform under supervision.

title: Vacating Premises After Rental Agreement Termination
summary: Requires landlords to give certain tenants a specified time to vacate after a termination notice before starting an eviction action.

title: Health Care Practitioner Maternal Mental Health Continuing Education Requirements
summary: Requires maternal mental health curriculum hours within health care practitioner continuing education for licensure renewal, with boards updating the curriculum and accepting completion as credit.

title: Educator Preparation
summary: Creates a Department of Education workgroup to revise teacher Accomplished Practices, develops a teacher exam, and requires a teacher preparation implementation plan.

title: Eyewitness Identification
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice
summary: Revises police eyewitness identification procedures, adding lineup, instruction, documentation, recording, and facial recognition limits, plus attorney presence rights.

title: School Readiness Program
summary: Revises which children get priority for School Readiness Program slots and sets requirements providers must meet to receive specified funding.

title: Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients
summary: Authorizes sale, transfer and distribution of certain compounded drugs, with new recordkeeping, advertising limits, penalties and Attorney General rulemaking.

title: Young Adults who are Homeless or were in the Child Welfare System
summary: Requires Florida colleges and universities to prioritize housing and work-study for homeless or former foster youth, bars cosigner requirements, and administers federal vouchers.

title: Professional Licensure Reciprocity for the Practice of Surveying and Mapping
summary: Expands eligibility for surveying and mapping licensure by endorsement to qualifying out-of-state applicants and lets the board verify their documents.

title: Insurance
summary: Omnibus insurance bill adding claims procedures, affiliate and compensation oversight, rate transparency, and reciprocal insurer rules, which both loosen and tighten regulation.

title: Pari-mutuel Wagering
summary: Lets thoroughbred permitholders choose not to conduct live racing while keeping their permits, licenses, and slot or cardroom privileges.

title: Advanced Practice Registered Nurse Autonomous Practice
summary: Authorizes certain advanced practice registered nurses to practice autonomously, without physician supervision, when providing mental health services.

title: Protected Cell Captive Insurance Companies
summary: Creates a protected cell captive insurance company structure, limits the risks it may insure, revises capital rules, and requires filings with the Office of Insurance Regulation.

title: Florida Virtual School
summary: Revises Florida Virtual School's students served, priority enrollment, funding sources, board governance, reporting and assessments; the summary gives no specific mechanics.

title: Transportation Facility Designations
summary: Gives honorary designations to certain transportation facilities in specified counties and directs DOT to erect markers.

title: Transportation Facility Contractors
summary: Authorizes DOT to enter construction, maintenance and operation agreements with transportation contractors, and states those contractors do not act on behalf of DOT for public records purposes.

title: Medical Marijuana Use Registry Identification Cards for Veterans
summary: Lets the Department of Health charge honorably discharged veterans a reduced fee for medical marijuana registry ID cards, including replacements and renewals.

title: Driver License Education Requirements
summary: Sets the age by which license applicants must complete a traffic law and substance abuse course, and requires learner's license applicants to complete a DHSMV-approved driver education course.

title: Office of the Corrections Ombudsman
summary: Creates a legislative Corrections Ombudsman office and oversight committee with unannounced facility access, confidential communications for incarcerated persons, and a $250,000 appropriation.

title: Food Insecure Areas
summary: Lets local governments permit small-footprint grocery stores in food-insecure areas through zoning and comprehensive plans, and require reporting from those stores.

title: Veterinary Prescription Disclosure
summary: Requires veterinarians to tell clients of their right to a written prescription, obtain a signed acknowledgment, and post required notices.

title: Forms of Identification
summary: Expands the forms of identification acceptable for certain voter registration applicants and requires some ID cards and driver licenses issued to noncitizens to bear specified letters.

title: Pub. Rec./Office of the Corrections Ombudsman
summary: Creates a public records exemption for correspondence and communications with the Corrections Ombudsman and Corrections Oversight Committee, with a future repeal review.

title: Construction Liens and Bonds
summary: Revises Florida construction lien and bond rules, including waiver forms, owner notices, and when liens may attach after the owner has paid the contractor in full.

title: Trust Fund Interest for Purposes Approved by Supreme Court
summary: Authorizes trust accounts holding funds for Supreme Court-approved purposes and directs how the resulting interest and dividends are used and paid.

title: Prostitution and Related Acts
summary: Prohibits adult prostitution and related acts, adds mandatory education, community service, civil penalties, and STD testing for certain violators, and reclassifies offenses.

title: Trustee Settlement and Discharge
summary: Lets trustees seek settlement and discharge after sending a trust disclosure document, and bars later liability for matters disclosed if no timely objections arrive.

title: Timeshare Plan Management
summary: Revises timeshare and community association management rules: adds good-faith duties, shields managers from monetary damages, requires annual board meetings and annual disclosures.

title: Community Rehabilitation Programs
summary: Sets minimum standards for community rehabilitation programs serving blind Floridians and lets the Division of Blind Services enter cooperative agreements with private vendors.

title: Insurer Disclosures on Prescription Drug Coverage
summary: Requires health insurers, HMOs and their PBMs to give formulary-change notices, keep records, file annual OIR reports, and credit certain drug payments toward cost-sharing.

title: Task Force on Artificial Intelligence in Public Postsecondary Education
summary: Creates a task force to study artificial intelligence in public postsecondary education. The bill itself changes no rules or funding.

title: Combatting Illegal Immigration
summary: Requires law enforcement to support federal immigration enforcement, including mandatory secure transport to federal custody, while shielding information about crime victims and witnesses in active cases.

title: Court-appointed Psychologists
summary: Requires parties to seek disqualification of a court-appointed psychologist before filing an administrative complaint, and revises fee and cost awards in related actions.

title: Diabetes Research
summary: Establishes a University of Florida Diabetes Institute within the UF College of Medicine. No funding is stated.

title: Corrections
summary: Restricts prisoner lawsuits with exhaustion, physical-injury and one-year limits, allows consecutive sentences for certain offenses, and exempts confinement-center workers from drone rules.

title: Florida Health Choices Program
summary: Renames the Florida Health Choices Program as the Employee Health Choices Program, creates a corporation, and removes several program rules on vendors, products, pricing and risk pooling.

title: Foreign Influence
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Creates penalties for officials who take things of value from foreign terrorist or concern-country entities, and lets tax collectors revoke business tax receipts of specified entities.

title: Florida Institute for Pediatric Rare Diseases
summary: Establishes a Florida Institute for Pediatric Rare Diseases at FSU College of Medicine, plus a Sunshine Genetics pilot program and consortium.

title: Incentive Gain-time
summary: Authorizes incentive gain-time for education, vocational and rehabilitation achievements, while requiring inmates to serve 65% or 85% of their sentences.

title: Occupational Therapy Licensure Compact
summary: Creates an interstate compact letting licensed occupational therapists and assistants practice across member states, with shared discipline reporting and a data system.

title: Coverage by Citizens Property Insurance Corporation
summary: Revises Citizens eligibility for residential structures in certain counties, requires annual rate increases there, and allows policies without a flood insurance requirement.

title: Probation for Misdemeanor Offenses
summary: Lengthens probation periods for certain misdemeanor offenses involving controlled or chemical substances.

title: Candidate Qualification
summary: Requires candidates to have been registered with a party or with no party for 365 consecutive days before qualifying, and bars recent legal name changes by petition.

title: Pub. Rec. and Meetings/Occupational Therapy Compact Commission
summary: Exempts certain Occupational Therapy Compact Commission records and meetings from Florida public records and open meeting requirements, with future legislative review and repeal.

title: Florida Building Code Construction Requirements
summary: Requires the Florida Building Commission to mandate specified materials and impact resistance for certain buildings in the next Florida Building Code edition.

title: Condominium and Cooperative Associations
summary: Bans people whose community manager license was revoked from owning or running management firms for a set period, and adds online licensure account and reporting requirements.

title: Inmate Services
summary: Directs maintenance and repair deduction fees from contractor-operated correctional facilities into a trust fund and specifies permitted uses of those funds.

title: Advertisements for Representation Services
summary: Bans notaries from using specified terms in advertising and requires disclosures from immigration service providers, with civil remedies for violations.

title: Medical Assistance Eligibility for Working Individuals with Disabilities
summary: Creates a Working People with Disabilities program in AHCA setting Medicaid eligibility, income and asset limits, and written notice requirements for eligible adults.

title: Enhanced Firearms Training Facilities
topics: Government and administration; Guns and weapons
summary: Creates DACS licensing for enhanced firearms training facilities, lets sheriffs train school guardians there, and exempts facilities from certain local requirements.

title: Health Care
summary: Lets patients refuse treatment, bars vaccine-status discrimination, allows conscience exemptions for minors' vaccines, and permits pharmacists to dispense ivermectin without a prescription.

title: Nursing Education Programs
summary: Tightens Board of Nursing oversight of nursing education programs, allowing approval revocation, inspections, evidence collection, and removal of probation and accreditation extensions.

title: Commercial Service Airports
summary: Preempts naming of major commercial service airports to the state, sets their names, and requires DOT to review and notify the Legislature annually.

title: Required Instruction in Cursive Writing
summary: Requires students in specified grades to receive cursive writing instruction and demonstrate cursive proficiency by the end of a set grade.

title: Animal Cruelty
summary: Requires certain animal professionals to report suspected animal cruelty, protects good-faith reporters, and penalizes altering records to conceal cruelty.

title: Housing
summary: Revises affordable housing provisions, property tax exemptions, discretionary sales surtax use, tax credits, and FHFC and Live Local Program funding allocations.

title: Recovery Residences
summary: Changes Florida recovery residence rules: sets DCF background screening levels, eases admission requirements for expanding licensed providers, and removes the housing-access protection for certified residences.

title: Threats from Foreign Nations
topics: AI and technology; Government and administration
summary: Bars state entities and governments from certain contracts with foreign principals, requires registration, and prohibits specified foreign-made software in critical infrastructure.

title: Clerks of the Court
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Lets clerks of court use excess funds in their combined budgets and shifts some penalty revenue from municipalities to the fine and forfeiture fund.

title: Pub. Rec. & Meetings/Reports on Adversarial Threats
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Exempts certain adversarial-threat reports, critical infrastructure notifications, and related Council on Pacific Conflict discussions from public records and meetings requirements, with future review and repeal.

title: Local Land Planning and Development
summary: Requires larger local governments to offer preapplication consultation for certain permits and bars local governments from adding extra conditions to administrative plat approvals.

title: Firefighter Health and Safety
summary: Requires the State Fire Marshal to adopt rules on firefighter education about chemical hazards, toxic substances and mental health, and to help reduce firefighter fatalities.

title: Local Government Regulation of Chickees
summary: Bars local governments from blocking certain chickee construction or adopting rules stricter than federal ones, exempts some chickees from fire code, and penalizes misuse of the building-code exemption.

title: Residential Swimming Pool Requirements
summary: Requires residential pools sold or transferred after a set date to meet pool safety and barrier standards, and requires certain persons to report violations.

title: Protection from Surgical Smoke
summary: Requires hospitals and ambulatory surgical centers to adopt and implement policies requiring smoke evacuation systems or other appropriate measures during surgery.

title: Online Access to Materials Harmful to Minors
summary: Requires app developers and device manufacturers to determine user ages and provide parental controls, and tightens age verification for websites with harmful-to-minors material, enforced by the Attorney General.

title: Career Offender Registration
summary: Tightens career offender registration with annual reregistration, yearly verification, higher penalties for assisting noncompliance, and broader prosecution venues.

title: Guardianship
summary: Adjusts guardianship orders and guardian duties, including notice requirements and authority to restrict ward contact with others in certain circumstances.

title: Children's Initiatives
topics: Children and families; Government and administration
summary: Establishes two children's initiatives run by nonprofits that must follow public records, meeting and procurement rules, and will build community child and family service networks.

title: Medicaid Oversight
summary: Creates a joint legislative committee to oversee Medicaid, with records access, subpoena-like power, and required agency reporting to it.

title: Community Health Worker Services
summary: Authorizes Medicaid payment for community health worker services as an optional benefit and requires managed care plans to cover them.

title: Consumer Finance Loans
summary: Prohibits evading Florida consumer finance loan requirements, and makes loans made in violation void and uncollectible.

title: Transportation
summary: Omnibus transportation bill changing motor carrier licensing and fuel tax decals, electronic filing, crash reporting, address proof, and license plate frame rules.

title: Timely Filing of Tax Returns
summary: Requires certain rules to let tax returns count as timely filed when specified requirements are met.

title: Pub. Rec./E-mail Addresses Collected by the Department of Highway Safety and Motor Vehicles
summary: Exempts certain e-mail addresses collected by DHSMV from public records requirements, applies retroactively, and provides for future legislative review and repeal.

title: Pharmacist Selection and Reimbursement
summary: Lets insured members and Medicaid enrollees choose in-network pharmacists, bars denying in-network pharmacists reimbursement in certain cases, and counts pharmacists toward network adequacy.

title: Trust Funds/Re-creation/Emergency Preparedness and Response Fund/EOG
summary: Re-creates the Emergency Preparedness and Response Fund within the Division of Emergency Management and removes its scheduled termination.

title: Real Property and Land Use and Development
summary: Limits local zoning limits on housing density, height, floor area and parking, bars building moratoriums, and lets religious-institution parcels host affordable housing.

title: Citizens Property Insurance Corporation
summary: Bars Citizens Property Insurance from writing commercial property coverage and creates a commercial lines clearinghouse for private surplus lines insurers, with OIR review.

title: Cost-of-living Adjustment of Retirement Benefits
summary: Revises the annual cost-of-living adjustment amount and how it is calculated for certain retirees and beneficiaries, with a declaration of important state interest.

title: Statewide Counterintelligence and Counterterrorism Unit
summary: Requires FDLE to establish and administer a statewide counterintelligence and counterterrorism unit, with requirements for its funding.

title: Civil Actions
topics: Consumer protection and business; Environment and energy
summary: Sets conditions for suits against former phosphate mine sites, requires prevailing-party attorney fees in certain insurer suits, and changes offer-of-judgment and medical-expense evidence rules.

title: Wireless Communications Devices on School Grounds
summary: Bans student use of wireless devices during the entire school day, not just instructional time, and requires school boards to adopt related rules.

title: Child Welfare
summary: Broadens the child welfare definitions of harm and neglect so parents' acute or chronic controlled substance use can establish neglect or child exposure.

title: Arrest Warrants for State Prisoners
summary: Lets state prisoners with unserved arrest warrants file notice in circuit court, requires status hearings, and provides for prosecution of violations.

title: Security Services on Religious Premises
summary: Exempts certain volunteers providing armed security at churches and religious organizations from specified requirements, if they meet listed qualifications.

title: Homelessness
summary: Prohibits denying public services solely because a person is homeless, grants homeless persons specified rights, and allows damages and attorney fees in civil suits.

title: One-cent Piece
summary: Lets dealers round cash payments to the nearest nickel under a set method, shielded from deceptive trade practice claims.

title: Gambling
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice
summary: Bans betting on rigged athletic contests, internet gambling offenses and certain gambling ads, revises gambling criminal penalties, and preempts local gaming regulation to state.

title: Commercial Driving Schools
summary: Lets the Department of Highway Safety and Motor Vehicles delegate specified functions to tax collectors through interagency agreements.

title: Employment Eligibility
summary: Requires all private employers, not just those above a headcount threshold, to use E-Verify to check new hires' employment eligibility.

title: Principal Offices of Limited Liability Companies and Corporations
summary: Lets companies use their registered agent's address as principal office and requires certain companies to give the state a physical address for a named member or manager.

title: Limits on Property Insurance Rates Filed with the Office of Insurance Regulation
summary: Limits the rates property insurers may file with the Office of Insurance Regulation to a specified percentage.

title: Deferred and Unpaid Taxes
summary: Limits property tax deferral to properties with just value of $1 million or less and raises the minimum value of tax certificates sold at auction.

title: Trust Fund/Creation/Emergency Residential Property Insurance Assistance Trust Funds/DFS
summary: Creates an Emergency Residential Property Insurance Assistance Trust Fund within DFS, with its purpose, funding, eligibility, and future review or termination provisions.

title: Electronic Payment Processing Fees for Motor Vehicle Purchases
summary: Authorizes motor vehicle retail installment contract holders and their agents to charge fees for processing electronic payments under certain circumstances.

title: Department of Highway Safety and Motor Vehicles
summary: Revises tax collector duties as DHSMV agents, issuance of certain registrations and licenses, and revocation of certain driving privileges.

title: Salvage Certificates of Title and Certificates of Destruction
summary: Requires insurers and their agents to implement identity-verification controls for electronic signatures on salvage titles and destruction certificates.

title: Veterans Rental Assistance Grant Program
summary: Creates a veterans' rental assistance grant program run by Florida Housing Finance Corporation, with eligibility requirements for applicants.

title: Administrative Efficiency in Public Schools
summary: Revises school district, school board, K-12 facilities, funding, teacher certification and contract, and early learning provisions; the summary gives no specifics.

title: Retirement Credit for Military Service
summary: Revises pension credit rules so members with military service can receive creditable service, requires DMS rulemaking, and broadens the statutory definition of veteran.

title: Voluntary Trial Resolution
summary: Lets parties in civil, family, and probate cases agree to a voluntary trial resolution judge, with proceedings open to the public.

title: County Constitutional Officers
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Changes when terms begin for certain elected county officers, lets officers-elect access specified facilities, and changes when budget limits take effect.

title: Electronic Payments Made to Units of Local Governments
summary: Requires local governments to accept certain electronic payment forms, including online payments.

title: Reporting of Student Mental Health Outcomes
summary: Requires OPPAGA to submit initial and final evaluations of student mental health outcomes to the Governor and Legislature by specified dates.

title: Detection of Developmental Delays and Autism Spectrum Disorder
summary: Requires the Department of Health, with school districts, to create developmental delay and autism detection materials, and early learning coalitions to notify parents of them.

title: Service of Process in Proceedings for Protection of Vulnerable Adults
summary: Allows substitute service on respondents who cannot be found in vulnerable adult protection cases and requires disputed fund or property transfers to be held for a set period.

title: Transportation Concurrency
summary: Revises which facilities small counties must identify in their comprehensive plan capital improvements element for transportation concurrency.

title: Pub. Rec./Commission on Human Relations
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Exempts personal identifying and location information of certain Human Relations Commission personnel, commissioners, and their families from public records law, with retroactive effect.

title: Family Law
summary: Requires weekend and after-hours judicial availability, priority scheduling, and set hearing procedures for time-sharing and parenting plan disputes.

title: Special Districts
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Abolishes certain soil and water conservation districts, shifting their assets and liabilities to DACS, and limits liability for special districts opening recreational lands.

title: Bleeding Control Kits in K-12 Schools
summary: Requires public schools to stock bleeding control kits, train staff, include kits in drills, and restock them under DOE-set guidelines.

title: Coverage of Dental Services under the Medicaid Program
summary: Requires Florida Medicaid to expand adult dental coverage, set provider reimbursement rates, seek federal approval, and create a statewide prepaid children's and adults' dental program.

title: Capitol Center and Complex
summary: Assigns DMS responsibility for Capitol Center aesthetics, requires enhanced parking security, and lets Capitol Police patrol the area around the Capitol Complex.

title: Contracting with Foreign Countries of Concern
topics: AI and technology; Government and administration
summary: Bars governmental entities from contracts for products with foreign-country-of-concern ownership, and removes local-government limits on contracts giving access to personal identifying information.

title: Benefits for Obesity under the State Group Health Insurance Plan
summary: Requires the Department of Management Services to cover obesity treatment and management under state group health insurance policies issued after a specified date.

title: State Department Customer Service Standards
summary: Requires state departments to use a callback queue system for customers who contact them by telephone.

title: Infill Redevelopment
summary: Requires local governments to allow denser infill development on qualifying parcels, with buffers, doubled park impact fees, and purchase-option notice rules.

title: Athlete Representation and Compensation
summary: Caps agent fees on athletes' name, image and likeness income, creates a public athlete-agent database, and lets high school athletes earn NIL pay with parental consent and advisor rules.

title: Tributaries of the St. Johns River
summary: Directs DEP to hire a project lead and develop Ocklawaha River restoration and outdoor recreation plans, creates an advisory council, and has Commerce develop an economic program for two counties.

title: Homeowners' Associations
summary: Revises homeowners' association rules on board recalls, elections, notices, arbitration, financial reporting, and buyer disclosures, with buyers able to cancel certain contracts.

title: Pet Insurance
summary: Requires pet insurance sellers to complete continuing education, revises policyholder disclosure rules, and requires insurers to file an annual report with OIR.

title: Deferred Compensation Plans for Public Employees
summary: Requires automatic enrollment in public employee deferred compensation plans unless employees opt out, with default contribution rates and investments, and lets local governments adopt similar arrangements.

title: Voter Registration and Identification
summary: Requires citizenship verification for voter applicants, stricter polling-place ID rules, and added checks on vote-by-mail requests and noncitizen licenses.

title: Transportation Facility Designations
summary: Designates certain transportation facilities in specified counties with honorary names and directs the Department of Transportation to erect markers.

title: Department of Labor
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Creates a Department of Labor to enforce the state minimum wage amendment, with new investigation, citation, and burden-shifting powers for employee claims.

title: Licensure of Family Foster Homes
summary: Requires DCF to adopt rules streamlining foster home licensure for licensed foster parents who relocate within Florida, including priority review and recognition of prior training.

title: Motor Vehicle Manufacturers, Importers, and Distributors and Franchised Motor Vehicle Dealers
summary: Lets manufacturers reject certain dealer ownership changes, clarifies repurchase duties after franchise termination, and requires high-volume licensees to maintain at least three independent dealers.

title: Graduation Requirements for English for Speakers of Other Languages Program Students
summary: Lets certain ESOL program students meet Algebra I end-of-course assessment requirements in a specified manner.

title: Reinsurance Intermediary Managers
summary: Revises the definition of 'reinsurance intermediary manager' so certain underwriting managers are excluded from that regulated category.

title: Community and Economic Development
summary: Revises, adds and deletes provisions on redevelopment agencies, agriculture, professional licensure and registration, and insurance; the title gives no specific changes.

title: Elections
summary: Requires voter registration applicants to acknowledge citizenship and requires supervisors to verify each voter's U.S. citizenship using state records.

title: Parental Rights of Qualified Patients
summary: Bars courts from denying or restricting parental rights, or presuming neglect, based solely on a parent being a medical marijuana patient.

title: Informed Consent for Assisted Reproductive Technology
summary: Requires providers to obtain informed consent for each IVF cycle, use patients' language, offer withdrawal rights, keep records, and follow embryo disposition agreements.

title: Areas of Critical State Concern
summary: Exempts specified entities from certain bond requirements, extends Florida Forever funds for Keys land purchases, and adds building permit allocations under Keys rules.

title: Public Employees Relations Commission
summary: Revises Florida public-employee labor rules: stricter union registration, certification and dues requirements, new employer prohibitions, impasse changes, and higher fines.

title: Labor Negotiations
summary: Bars certain people from knowingly disclosing labor negotiation information without authorization, and requires recipients to refer disclosers to the Commission on Ethics.

title: Pub. Rec./Public Employees Relations Commission
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Exempts certain PERC preliminary communications, union showing-of-interest statements, and personal information of PERC officials and their families from public records disclosure.

title: Legal Tender
summary: Revises the sales and use tax exemption for certain gold and silver coins, shifts the burden of proof to claimants, and sets a purity presumption.

title: Refrigerant Safety and Agricultural Continuity
summary: Requires the Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services to give the Legislature an annual report and lets it coordinate with certain entities.

title: Joint Session for Purpose of Receiving Governor's Message
summary: Concurrent resolution directing the House and Senate to convene in joint session to receive the Governor's message.

title: Equal Rights for Men and Women
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Ratifies a proposed U.S. constitutional amendment on equal rights for men and women.

title: Joint Session for Purpose of Receiving Governor's Message
summary: Concurrent resolution directing the House and Senate to convene in joint session to receive the Governor's message; no policy change.

title: Extension of the 2025 Regular Session of the Legislature
summary: Extends the 2025 Florida Regular Session under the State Constitution's Article III authority; it makes no substantive policy change.

title: Extension of the 2025 Regular Session of the Legislature
summary: Extends the 2025 Regular Session of the Florida Legislature under the State Constitution's authority; it changes no policy.

title: Extension of the 2025 Regular Session of the Legislature
summary: Extends the 2025 Regular Session of the Florida Legislature under Article III, Section 3(d) of the State Constitution.

title: Florida Legislative Investigation Committee
summary: Resolution acknowledging injustices by the 1956–1965 Florida Legislative Investigation Committee and offering a formal apology to those harmed.

title: Save our Homes from Excessive Property Taxes
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Proposes constitutional amendments to revise the homestead assessment cap, increase the homestead exemption, and limit how counties and municipalities use ad valorem taxes.

title: Assessed Value Freeze of Homestead Property
summary: Authorizes the Legislature to cap the assessed value of homestead property for certain low-income seniors.

title: Limitation on the Assessment of Homestead Property
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment letting the Legislature exclude flood-mitigation improvements to homesteads from assessed value for property taxes.

title: Homestead Exemption and Public Safety Funding
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Proposes constitutional amendments revising the homestead exemption, limiting its annual inflation adjustment, and requiring a trust fund to replace lost local revenue.

title: Ad Valorem Tax Exemption
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment exempting certain tangible personal property from ad valorem property taxation.

title: Property Tax Benefits for Residential Properties
summary: Proposes constitutional amendments adding an assessment limitation and exemptions for certain long-term leased property, plus an additional homestead exemption for first-time owners.

title: Election of County Commissioners and Superintendent of Schools
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment requiring county commissioners to be elected by district voters based on population, and requiring school superintendents to be elected.

title: Prohibition on Levying Ad Valorem Taxes on Tangible Personal Property
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment barring certain entities from levying ad valorem taxes on tangible personal property.

title: Succession to Office of Governor, Auditing, and Government Efficiency
summary: Proposes constitutional amendments creating a Commissioner of Government Efficiency Cabinet office, revising gubernatorial succession and auditing, and placing a repeal question on the ballot.

title: Assessment of Property with Decreasing Just Valuation
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment prohibiting assessed-value increases for certain property whose just valuation is decreasing.

title: Senate Confirmation of Gubernatorial Appointments and Legislative Approval of Extended States of Emergency
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment requiring Senate confirmation of gubernatorial appointments and removals, and legislative authorization to extend gubernatorial emergency declarations.

title: Appointments to the Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment revising how members of the Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission are appointed.

title: Ad Valorem Property Tax Exemption for the Surviving Spouse of Quadriplegics
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment letting the Legislature exempt homestead property of a quadriplegic's surviving spouse from ad valorem taxes.

title: Elimination of Non-school Property Tax for Homesteads
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment exempting homesteads from all property taxes except school levies, and barring local cuts to law enforcement funding.

title: Elimination of Non-school Property for Homesteads
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment exempting homestead property from all non-school ad valorem taxes and barring local cuts to first-responder funding.

title: Elimination of Non-School Property Tax for Homesteads for Persons Age 65 or Older
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment exempting homesteads of residents 65 and older from non-school levies and barring local cuts to law enforcement funding.

title: Assessed Home Value Homestead Exemption of Non-school Property Tax
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment adding a 25% homestead exemption from non-school property levies and barring local governments from cutting law enforcement funding.

title: Property Insurance Relief Homestead Exemption Non-school Property Tax
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment raising the non-school homestead tax exemption by $200,000 for insured homes and barring local first-responder funding cuts.

title: Accrued Save-Our-Homes Property Tax Benefit for Non-school Property Tax
topics: Criminal justice; Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment raising the transferable Save-Our-Homes benefit for non-school levies and barring counties and cities from cutting law enforcement funding.

title: Modification of Limitations on Property Assessment Increases
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment modifying assessment-increase limits for homestead and nonhomestead property and barring local cuts to first responder funding.

title: State Reapportionment
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment to change reapportionment methods and increase the number of Senate and House districts.

title: Term Limits for Members of Boards of County Commissioners and District School Boards
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment imposing term limits on county commissioners and district school board members, allowing later re-election after a specified period.

title: Property Tax Exemptions
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment creating a $100,000 exemption from the assessed value of real property for all levies.

title: Budget Stabilization Fund
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment raising the budget stabilization fund cap, requiring annual transfers absent a revenue shortfall, and letting the legislature withdraw funds for critical needs.

title: Protection of Religious Expression in Public Schools
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment protecting students and school personnel from discrimination for religious expression in public schools.

title: State Reapportionment
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment to revise reapportionment methods and increase the number of Senate and House districts.

title: Term Limits for State Representatives and Senators
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment to revise term limits for Florida state representatives and state senators.

title: Reduction of Annual Assessment Increases for Homestead Property
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment lowering the maximum annual increase in homestead property's assessed value.

title: Term Limits for Members of County Commissions and District School Boards
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment to impose term limits on county commissioners and district school board members, with applicability provisions.

title: Recall of County Officers and Commissioners
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment allowing voters to recall county officers and commissioners.

title: Revising How Homestead Property is Assessed
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment revising how homestead property is assessed for property tax purposes; details are not stated in the text.

title: County and School District Ad Valorem Taxing Authority
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment removing counties' and school districts' authority to levy ad valorem (property) taxes.

title: Assessment of Inherited Homestead Property
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment letting the Legislature exempt inherited homestead property from reassessment as a change of ownership.

title: Assessed Value of Nonhomestead Property
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment lowering the maximum annual percentage by which nonhomestead property's assessed value may increase.

title: Reorganization of Florida Government
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment reorganizing state government, including redistricting procedures, cabinet and board structure, the amendment process, and county charter options.

title: Relief of Maury Hernandez by the Department of Corrections
summary: Appropriates $5 million to compensate former Broward deputy Maury Hernandez for injuries tied to Department of Corrections probation-enforcement failures.

title: Combatting Illegal Immigration
summary: Establishes the Office of Secure Florida within the Department of Commerce to combat illegal immigration, with a $1.7 million appropriation.

title: Display of Flags by Governmental Entities
summary: Prohibits governmental entities from erecting or displaying certain flags, requires neutrality in some cases, and lets veterans use reasonable force to protect the U.S. flag.

title: Florida Statutes
summary: Adopts the 2026 Florida Statutes as the official compilation of state law and repeals prior general laws not included in it.

title: Court-ordered Sealing of Criminal History Records
summary: Revises eligibility rules for court-ordered sealing of criminal history records, letting courts seal additional adjudications of guilt in certain circumstances.

title: Trust Fund Interest for Purposes Approved by the Supreme Court
summary: Lets financial institutions hold certain trust account funds and requires specified entities to use the interest and dividends for Supreme Court-approved purposes.

title: Utility Service Restrictions
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration; Housing
summary: Preempts local governments from restricting energy types or fuel sources and bars state building and fire codes from mandating or prohibiting particular energy sources.

title: Child Welfare
summary: Broadens the definitions of child harm and neglect so parental acute or chronic controlled-substance use can establish neglect or exposure.

title: Affordable Housing and Supportive Services for Persons with Developmental Disabilities
summary: Creates rent subsidies and support centers for persons with developmental disabilities, with a property tax exemption, impact fee waivers, and a $1 million appropriation.

title: Domestic Animals
summary: Extends consumer remedy deadlines for unfit animal sales, requires pet dealers to provide medical records, and has FDLE post animal cruelty offender information.

title: Video Cameras in Public School Classrooms
summary: Requires school boards to vote on a policy providing classroom cameras in self-contained classrooms at parent request, and bars concealing employee identities in recordings.

title: Freedom of Speech and Religious Expression in Public Schools
summary: Bars public school districts from viewpoint discrimination, lets students express political beliefs and wear political clothing, and creates a private right to sue.

title: Waste Incineration
summary: Prohibits local governments and DEP from issuing construction permits for certain new solid waste or waste-to-energy incineration facilities in specified areas.

title: Student Support Services for K-12 Schools
summary: Lets district school boards refer students to outside organizations providing support services, with requirements for those organizations and background screenings, and website posting duties.

title: Occupational Therapy Licensure Compact
summary: Creates an occupational therapy licensure compact letting licensed therapists practice across member states on a compact privilege without a separate Florida license.

title: Enforcement of Protections for Minors
summary: Creates criminal penalties for health care practitioners who aid violations of specified minor-protection provisions, and allows injured minors or others to sue for damages.

title: Public Records and Meetings/Occupational Therapy Licensure Compact
summary: Creates public records and public meetings exemptions for information and meetings tied to the Occupational Therapy Licensure Compact, with future legislative review and repeal.

title: Inmate Services
summary: Directs maintenance and repair deduction fees from contractor-operated prisons into an inmate welfare trust fund and sets permitted uses for those funds.

title: Youth Conflict Resolution and Peer Mediation Pilot Program
summary: Creates a time-limited pilot program within the Community School Grant Program, run by UCF's Center for Community Schools, to teach youth conflict resolution and peer mediation.

title: Provision of Municipal Utility Service to Owners Outside the Municipal Limits
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Requires municipal utilities to extend service to outside-limits owners who request it under set conditions, with timelines and written determinations.

title: Medical Assistance Eligibility for Working Persons with Disabilities
summary: Creates a Medicaid eligibility program for working persons with disabilities, sets income and asset rules, and requires notice to waiver enrollees.

title: Homestead Exemptions
summary: Changes homestead property tax exemptions: raises the exemption amount for most levies while deleting exemptions for levies other than school district levies.

title: Deferred Compensation Plans for Public Employees
summary: Authorizes automatic enrollment in public employee deferred compensation plans, with employee contribution elections and a default investment, and lets local governments adopt it.

title: Exceptional Student Education
summary: Requires the Department of Education to create a workforce credential program for students with autism or on a modified curriculum, plus annual reports.

title: Florida Statutes
summary: Deletes obsolete Florida Statutes provisions that have expired or been repealed, a housekeeping revision with no policy change.

title: Coverage by Citizens Property Insurance Corporation
summary: Revises Citizens Property Insurance eligibility for residential structures in certain counties, requires annual rate increases there, and changes flood insurance conditions for some policies.

title: Regulation of Chickees
topics: Criminal justice; Government and administration; Housing
summary: Defines chickees, bars local governments from blocking chickee construction or exceeding federal floodplain rules, and penalizes non-tribe members who build chickees to evade the building code.

title: Fines for Public Nuisance Abatement
summary: Removes the cap on total fines that may be imposed for a public nuisance and revises how such fines are assessed and collected.

title: Children’s Initiatives
summary: Establishes two named children's initiatives in Bay and Broward counties, run by nonprofits, to build community service networks for children and families in disadvantaged areas.

title: Specialty License Plates/United States Naval Academy and United States Military Academy
summary: Directs the Department of Highway Safety and Motor Vehicles to develop Naval Academy and Military Academy specialty license plates.

title: Coverage by Citizens Property Insurance Corporation
summary: Revises Citizens Property Insurance eligibility in certain counties, requires annual rate increases for single policies there, and lets some policies skip flood insurance requirements.

title: Expunction of Qualifying Marijuana Offenses
summary: Creates a process for expunging qualifying marijuana offenses, requiring FDLE to issue certificates of eligibility and setting petition requirements.

title: Community Health Worker Services
summary: Authorizes Florida Medicaid to pay for community health worker services as an optional covered service, with defined coverage requirements.

title: Public Records/Expunged Criminal History Records
summary: Creates a public records exemption for criminal history records ordered expunged that the department retains, with future legislative review and repeal.

title: Citizens Property Insurance Corporation
summary: Limits Citizens Property Insurance from writing new commercial coverage in certain cases and creates a personal lines clearinghouse to move policyholders to private insurers.

title: Food and Hemp Products
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice
summary: The bill sets conditions on hemp extract sales, bans unpermitted, street and festival sales, bars child-attractive hemp products, restricts locations, and appropriates $2 million.

title: Recovery Residences
