summary: Limits Florida DCF to requiring only level 2 background screening for certain recovery residence individuals and bars forcing certain licensed providers to admit clients during probation.

title: Licenses for Marijuana for Personal Use
summary: Requires the Department of Health to let medical marijuana treatment centers operate as cultivators, processors, distributors and retailers, and to issue specified numbers of new licenses.

title: Medical Marijuana
summary: Raises the marijuana supply limit a physician may certify at once, lengthens patient evaluation frequency, and caps veterans' ID card fees.

title: Florida Employee Health Choices Program
summary: Renames the Florida Health Choices Program, changes vendor eligibility and available insurance products, and deletes certain pricing transparency requirements.

title: Central Service Technician Services
summary: Requires hospitals and ambulatory surgical centers to use only central service technicians who meet set criteria, and mandates annual continuing education hours.

title: Conversion of Hotels Into Residential Housing
summary: Creates a Hotel-to-home tax credit program, with a capped credit value, allocated by Florida Housing Finance Corporation to projects converting hotels into residential housing.

title: School Counselors
summary: Bill sets evaluation criteria for certified school counselors based on specified standards and exempts persons seeking school counselor jobs from certain educator certification requirements.

title: Proration of or not Requiring Continuing Education
summary: Provides that an existing exemption from continuing education requirements does not apply to veterinarians, so they must meet those requirements.

title: Florida Strategic Cryptocurrency Reserve
summary: Creates a Florida Strategic Cryptocurrency Reserve Act letting the CFO buy cryptocurrency for the reserve only if a condition is met, plus an advisory committee.

title: Cardiac Emergencies
summary: Requires each public school to develop a cardiac emergency response plan, integrate it with local responders, and meet AED placement requirements, and revises CPR/AED instruction.

title: Florida Statutes
summary: Revisor's clean-up bill that deletes expired or obsolete statute provisions and fixes cross-references, typos and inconsistencies without changing policy.

title: Homelessness
summary: Creates the Homeless Persons Dignity Act, barring denial of public services solely because a person is homeless and allowing civil suits with damages and fees.

title: Trust Funds/Florida Cryptocurrency Reserve
summary: Creates a Florida Cryptocurrency Reserve trust fund within the CFO's office, with a funding source and purpose, subject to future review or termination.

title: Interfering with an Officer’s Means of Protection or Communication
summary: Creates offenses for depriving or disabling law enforcement officers' weapons, radios, digital recording devices, or restraint devices.

title: Public Waters
summary: Requires state and local governments to close certain beach waters and public bathing places, requires DOH rules, and bars local mooring-field permit applications in some cases.

title: Emergency Residential Property Insurance Assistance Trust Fund/Department of Financial Services
summary: Creates a trust fund within the Department of Financial Services to provide emergency financial assistance for residential property insurance, with funding and eligibility rules.

title: Informed Consent for Assisted Reproductive Technology
summary: Requires informed consent before in vitro fertilization, revises embryo disposition agreements, and limits embryo discarding over nonpayment.

title: Relative Caregiver Program Payments
summary: Lets relative and nonrelative caregivers of children in out-of-home care start receiving monthly Relative Caregiver Program payments at placement, not at the dependency finding.

title: Detection of Developmental Delays and Autism Spectrum Disorder
summary: Requires the Department of Health and school districts to develop developmental delay and autism detection materials, and early learning coalitions to notify parents.

title: Medicaid Coverage for Dental Services
summary: Revises optional Medicaid adult dental coverage, requires reimbursing adult dental providers at a specified rate, and directs managed care dental benefit changes.

title: Reimagining Education and Career Help Act
summary: Revises the statutory definition of "credential" to include leadership and soft skills certificates from certain accredited education organizations.

title: Services for Individuals with Developmental Disabilities
summary: Requires the Agency for Persons with Disabilities to publish provider lists and quarterly reports, adds crisis enrollment, and creates a Statewide Family Care Council.

title: Veterinary Prescription Disclosure
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Requires veterinarians to tell clients they may take prescriptions to a pharmacy of their choice, with a signed acknowledgement recorded in medical records.

title: Admission to Practice Law by an Unauthorized Alien
summary: Requires certain Florida law licenses held by unauthorized aliens to be revoked on a specified date under certain circumstances.

title: Education
summary: Bill waives tuition for State Guard members, bars colleges from admitting non-citizens not lawfully present, and changes GATE and homeless-student eligibility rules.

title: Tampering with an Electronic Monitoring Device
summary: Reclassifies tampering with an electronic monitoring device into graduated penalties and requires termination of pretrial release for anyone who tampers while on release.

title: Traffic Infractions Resulting in a Crash with Another Vehicle
summary: Requires civil penalties and driver license suspensions for specified traffic infractions that cause a crash with another vehicle, after a mandatory hearing.

title: Rental Assistance for Veterans
summary: Creates a Veterans' Rental Assistance Grant Program, letting the Florida Housing Finance Corporation award grants to eligible veterans for rent.

title: Open Containers of Marijuana Products in Motor Vehicles
summary: Prohibits possessing an open container of marijuana products while operating, riding in, or stopped in a vehicle, with penalties.

title: Gulf of America
summary: Requires state agencies and school boards to update maps and materials to use the federal name "Gulf of America" instead of "Gulf of Mexico."

title: Perfluoroalkyl and Polyfluoroalkyl Substances
summary: Ratifies PFAS cleanup target rules, requires interim screening values for other PFAS, and bans certain Class B firefighting foam after a set date.

title: Exploitation of Vulnerable Adults
summary: Lets courts use substitute service on unknown respondents and requires holding disputed fund or property transfers for a set period to protect vulnerable adults from exploitation.

title: Treatment of Inmates
summary: Specifies certain inmate rights, requires a written copy of those rights at entry into the correctional system, and revises the definition of permanently incapacitated inmate for conditional medical release.

title: Medicaid Oversight
summary: Creates a joint legislative committee to oversee Medicaid and requires a data-sharing agreement between the Auditor General and AHCA.

title: Neurofibromatosis Research Grants
summary: Creates a Department of Health grant program for neurofibromatosis research, with council consultation and conflict-of-interest rules for reviewers.

title: Adult Day Care Centers
summary: Exempts certain adult day care services from Medicaid reimbursement rates and requires operators to complete an annual 8-hour continuing education course.

title: Speech and Debate Education
summary: Creates a speech and debate hall of fame and debate week, establishes the Florida Debate Initiative, requires new debate coursework and credentials, and appropriates $2.4 million.

title: Medicaid Pharmacy Discounted Drug Prices
summary: Requires AHCA to conduct or contract for a fiscal impact study on implementing 340B discounted drug price provisions for Medicaid pharmacy, reporting by a set date.

title: Disclosure of Public Servants’ Personal Information
summary: Lets public employees and officials ask data brokers in writing to stop disclosing their and related persons' personal data, and creates civil actions for noncompliance.

title: Labor Negotiations
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Prohibits knowingly disclosing certain labor negotiation information or work products without authorization, and requires recipients to refer the source to the Commission on Ethics.

title: Tributaries of the St. Johns River
summary: Creates a project lead, a required Ocklawaha River restoration plan under a general permit, and an advisory council on northeast Florida river and springs recreation.

title: Deferred Compensation Plans for Public Employees
summary: Authorizes local governments to adopt automatic enrollment in public employee deferred compensation plans, with a default contribution rate and employee election rights.

title: Home Health Services
summary: Requires nurse registries to give clients written disclosures, bars certain terms in their names and ads, and subjects registered homemakers and companions to agency inspections.

title: Electrocardiograms for Student Athletes
summary: Requires student athletes to complete an electrocardiogram screening before competing, lets certain out-of-state practitioners perform evaluations, and bars students with abnormal results until cleared.

title: State Group Insurance Program Coverage for Obesity Treatment
summary: Requires the state group health insurance plan to cover obesity treatment, barring weight-loss drug coverage criteria stricter than FDA indications.

title: Expedited DNA Testing Grant Program
summary: Creates a grant program within the Department of Law Enforcement to fund expedited DNA testing, defining eligible private labs and grant uses, with recipients reporting back to the department.

title: Antisemitism Task Force
summary: Creates an Antisemitism Task Force within the Department of Legal Affairs to study the issue, meet quarterly, and report recommendations annually.

title: Transportation Concurrency
summary: Revises which transportation facilities must be identified in local comprehensive plan capital improvements elements where transportation concurrency applies.

title: One-cent Piece
summary: Eliminates the penny for cash transactions by letting dealers round cash totals to the nearest nickel, and shields that rounding from deceptive-practice claims.

title: Roof Contracting
topics: Consumer protection and business; Labor and employment
summary: Changes roofing contractor definitions, adds continuing education for certain roofers, and revises post-emergency contract cancellation rights and contractor notice requirements.

title: Research and Development Tax Credit
summary: Raises the combined total of research and development tax credits that may be granted to business enterprises.

title: Fire Prevention
summary: Sets deadlines for local permits and inspections of fire alarm and sprinkler projects, and makes certain local fire code amendments unenforceable.

title: Gubernatorial Transition
summary: Requires the Governor and state agency heads to designate transition liaisons, provides temporary office space, and grants the Governor-elect access to agency records.

title: Administrative Procedures
summary: Sets new timelines and procedures for state agency rulemaking, including notice requirements, ratification deadlines, and expiration of emergency rules.

title: Resolution of Disputed Property Insurance Claims
summary: Makes mediation mandatory and a precondition to suing over disputed property insurance claims, requires insureds to attend and share documents, and appropriates $1 million.

title: Local Government Land Regulation
summary: Limits local governments' application information requirements and processing timeframes for development permits, restricts certain school district fees, and limits building-permit fee uses.

title: Transportation
summary: Lengthens yellow signal timing at certain intersections and authorizes school zone speed camera enforcement under specified conditions, with revised camera placement and penalty rules.

title: Building Inspections
summary: Revises the Florida Building Code energy conservation edition's maximum tested air leakage measure for buildings and dwelling units, and revises an exception.

title: Statewide Provider and Health Plan Claim Dispute Resolution Program
summary: Adds circumstances in which a disputed claim is excluded from review under the statewide provider and health plan claim dispute resolution program.

title: Sexual Cyberharassment
summary: Creates criminal penalties for sexually cyberharassing others and lets victims sue for punitive damages, with time limits for prosecution.

title: Public Records/State Attorney’s Office and Office of Statewide Prosecution Nonlegal Support Staff
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Exempts personal identifying and location information of state attorney and statewide prosecution nonlegal support staff, and their spouses and children, from public records requirements.

title: Department of Elderly Affairs
summary: Revises Department of Elderly Affairs duties, including area agency designation, community care funding requirements, public guardian office requirements, and more frequent guardian audits.

title: Health Care Services Jurisdiction and Reimbursement
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Subjects insurers and HMOs to Florida court jurisdiction and bars providers from billing patients for emergency services that insurers owe.

title: State Department Customer Service Standards
summary: Requires state departments to use a callback queue system for customers who call them, plus other customer service standards.

title: Guardianship
summary: Limits guardians from restricting an adult ward's contact with others and requires notice of residential changes and information-sharing plans.

title: Online Sellers from Foreign Countries of Concern
summary: Requires online marketplaces to verify seller locations, disclose foreign-concern seller locations to consumers, and hold certain sales proceeds in U.S.-based accounts.

title: Education
summary: Omnibus bill: requires parental written consent for public school reproductive health instruction, lets private schools stock FDA-approved epinephrine devices, and changes other education and funding rules.

title: Assessment of Homestead Property
summary: Changes how homestead property is assessed, using recent purchase price or construction cost, and lets the Department of Revenue create a grant program.

title: Podiatric Medicine
summary: Narrows continuing education for podiatric physicians and allows certain procedures using non-FDA-approved cellular or tissue-based products, with patient consent required.

title: Career Planning Opportunities for Students
summary: Requires schools to expand work-based learning access, add career fair interviews with employers, review student career plans annually, and let apprenticeship training earn postsecondary credit.

title: Relief of Sean Hurley by the Orange County Sheriff’s Office
summary: Appropriates state funds to compensate Sean Hurley for injuries from Orange County Sheriff's Office negligence, with limits on payment and attorney fees.

title: Weapons and Firearms
summary: Requires background checks on all firearm transfers, bars firearms without serial numbers, revises safe storage rules, and creates a veterans firearm suicide task force.

title: Florida Civil Rights Act
summary: Revises Florida Civil Rights Act procedures: drops a registered-mail requirement, changes civil action timeframes, and lets complainants sue if no timely determination is made.

title: Elections
summary: Revises candidate qualification filing requirements and deadlines, adds a challenge method for certain forms, and changes ballot intake station placement, access and party name approval rules.

title: Universal Free School Breakfast and Lunch Program
summary: Creates a state-run program, subject to appropriations, providing free breakfast and lunch to all public school students and removing school district charging requirements.

title: Rural Communities
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget; Transportation
summary: Creates an Office of Rural Prosperity and grant programs for rural communities, and appropriates about $200.8 million to support rural infrastructure and local governments.

title: Homestead Exemptions
summary: Revises when a person may be treated as holding legal or beneficial and equitable title to property for homestead exemption purposes.

title: Protective Services for Certain Victims and Witnesses
summary: Revises the definition of 'serious felony offense' in a law on protective services for certain victims and witnesses.

title: Charter Schools
summary: Lets Florida College System institutions and state universities sponsor job engine charter schools and requires specified tax funds go annually to those sponsors.

title: School Readiness Program
summary: Revises which children get priority for School Readiness Program participation and sets provider requirements for eligibility for specified funding.

title: Funding for Body Cameras
summary: Provides funding for body cameras and redefines infrastructure to include body cameras in certain circumstances.

title: Local Government Code Enforcement
summary: Revises local code enforcement procedures, requires body-camera policies for code inspectors, and reclassifies certain offenses against code officers.

title: Public Records/Body Camera Recordings Recorded by a Code Inspector
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Creates a public records exemption for code inspector body camera recordings in certain circumstances and requires local governments to retain those recordings for a set period.

title: Recognizing Judea and Samaria
summary: Bans state agencies from using the term "West Bank" in official materials and requires certain instructional materials and library collections to say "Judea and Samaria."

title: Fire Detection and Alarm Documents
summary: Exempts certain fire alarm contractors from engineer licensing and requires specified persons to prepare fire detection and alarm documents for certain new buildings.

title: Capitol Center and Complex
summary: Assigns the Department of Management Services responsibility for Capitol Center aesthetics and requires enhanced parking-area security measures with Capitol Police.

title: Large-scale County Destination Marketing Organizations
summary: Requires large-scale county destination marketing organizations to register with the Department of State, be listed publicly, and match private contributions one-to-one with public funds.

title: Coverage for Orthotics and Prosthetics Services
summary: Authorizes Medicaid to pay for specified orthotics and prosthetics services and requires private health insurance policies to cover them for eligible individuals.

title: Mathematics Instruction
summary: Requires teacher preparation and certificate programs to include minimum mathematics content hours and revises criteria for reviewing math instructional materials.

title: Labor Pool Act
summary: Bars labor pools from charging certain fees to third-party users who directly employ laborers, requires annual state registration, and revises court remedies.

title: Tourist Development Tax
summary: Limits how much tourist development tax revenue must be spent annually on tourism promotion before the remainder can go to a specified other purpose.

title: Equity and Inclusion
summary: Repeals provisions on minority representation on boards and committees and on the Center for Environmental Equity and Justice.

title: Tourist Development Tax
summary: Authorizes local tourist development tax proceeds to fund public safety improvements, affordable housing, and workforce housing.

title: Crimes Evidencing Prejudice
summary: Requires higher penalties for crimes shown to be motivated by prejudice against a disabled adult victim, and defines "disabled adult."

title: Land Use and Development Regulations
summary: Limits counties from imposing certain conditions on development permits, revises state review of comprehensive plan amendments, and sets plat-processing deadlines.

title: Public Records/Data Centers
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Creates a public records exemption for information about a person's plans or interest in locating a data center, with future legislative review and repeal.

title: Children with Developmental Disabilities
summary: Expands a children's health screening grant to cover autism services and funds Early Steps and autism summer programs with a $755,904 appropriation.

title: Reapportionment
summary: Limits when congressional and state legislative district boundaries may be drawn, to specified census-year or session timing and federal or court-ordered exceptions.

title: Onsite Sewage Treatment and Disposal Systems
summary: Makes septic system construction permits valid indefinitely and bars local governments from imposing certain requirements on single-family building permit applicants.

title: Water Management Districts
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Requires Ethics Commission investigations of prohibited lobbyist expenditures, Everglades cost reporting, water district property tax authority, and capital improvement plans in budgets.

title: Florida Virtual School
summary: Revises Florida Virtual School governance: drops a student enrollment priority, extends sovereign immunity to officers and employees, and moves expenditure approval to the president.

title: Activities of Special Districts
summary: Lets certain special districts jointly form and control collaborations across their boundaries, with state action immunity and authority to act despite certain consequences.

title: Pharmacist Selection and Reimbursement
summary: Lets health plan members and Medicaid enrollees choose in-network pharmacists for services in certain circumstances, and addresses pharmacist reimbursement.

title: Public Records/Autopsy Reports of Certain Sudden and Unexpected deaths
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Creates a public records exemption for autopsy reports of certain sudden and unexpected deaths, with limited disclosure circumstances and future legislative review.

title: Cost-of-living Adjustment of Retirement Benefits
summary: Revises the Florida Retirement System annual cost-of-living adjustment amount and how it is calculated for certain retirees and beneficiaries.

title: Prohibited Contracting with Covered Foreign Entities
summary: Bars state agencies from contracting with covered foreign entities, requires bidder certification, and mandates terminating contracts with entities found to be covered foreign entities.

title: Building Permits for a Single-family Dwelling
summary: Bars expiration of certain single-family building permits before a specified event and deems some permit applications compliant, easing permit requirements.

title: Family Law
summary: Requires priority court calendar settings and procedural rules for time-sharing and parental responsibility hearings, plus an annual public court report on those hearings.

title: Portable Benefits Accounts for Independent Contractors and Sole Proprietors
summary: Creates a voluntary portable benefits account system for independent contractors and bars contributions from being used to classify workers as employees.

title: Insurance Claims Payments to Health Care Providers
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Bans payment adjudicators from downcoding provider claims in certain cases, assigns them sole liability for related violations, and requires a specified prior authorization form.

title: Consumers’ Right to Repair Certain Equipment
summary: Requires portable wireless device and agricultural equipment makers to give owners and independent shops repair parts, diagnostic information, and access to repair data.

title: Procedures for Discharging Persons to Avoid Homelessness
summary: Encourages facilities to adopt discharge procedures that prevent homelessness, requires a DCF pilot program in specified counties, and sets client-level data sharing.

title: Alternative Plans Review and Inspections
summary: Lets private providers use automated plans review and sets permit issuance deadlines for certain single-family and two-family dwelling permits, streamlining building inspections.

title: Official Actions of Local Governments
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Bans counties and municipalities from funding, promoting, or taking official action on DEI, voids conflicting local measures, and makes violating officials liable for misfeasance or malfeasance.

title: Age as an Element of a Criminal Offense
summary: Removes mistake-of-age defenses for certain offenses where the victim's age is an element, and revises age requirements for child luring offenses.

title: Dental Screenings for K-12 Students
summary: Authorizes school dental screenings under the school health program after written notice and parent opt-out, and removes the parental consent requirement for them.

title: Central Service Technician Services
summary: Limits hospitals and ambulatory surgical centers to employing central service technicians who meet set criteria, and requires certification and annual continuing education.

title: Qualified Contractors
summary: Requires larger counties and cities to offer preapplication development consultations through qualified contractors and to expedite building permits for planned unit developments.

title: Insurance Research
summary: Renames the Florida catastrophic storm risk center, requires an annual property insurance market report, and transfers the hurricane loss model to Florida State University.

title: Continuity of Care in Health Insurance Contracts
summary: Requires insurers and HMOs to give notice of provider contract terminations and let affected policyholders continue coverage and care for a set period.

title: Criminal Offender Substance Abuse Pilot Program
summary: Creates a substance abuse accountability pilot program for criminal offenders in one county, with a $2.5 million appropriation and a report due to officials.

title: Patient Access to Records
summary: Requires mental health and substance abuse providers to furnish clinical records within set timeframes after written requests, and revises nursing home record-access deadlines.

title: Release of Conservation Easements
summary: Requires certain water management districts to release conservation easements on application by owners who meet set conditions, allowing development of the released land.

title: Pharmacy
summary: Expands pharmacy benefit manager contract rules so covered prescription drugs can be dispensed and administered offsite, not only onsite, as part of hospital-affiliated outpatient care.

title: Hope Florida
summary: Creates the Hope Florida Act and an office in the Governor's Executive Office to run family-support programs with eligibility rules and community navigators.

title: Recording of Protective Investigations
summary: Requires investigators to audio or video record interviews in protective investigations, with exceptions, and bars certain objections based on unrecorded interviews.

title: Public Records/Hope Florida Program
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Creates a public records exemption shielding personal identifying information of Hope Florida program participants, with retroactive application and future repeal review.

title: Public Records/Recordings of Protective Investigations
topics: Children and families; Civil rights and liberties
summary: Creates a public records exemption for recordings of DCF protective investigation interviews, allows release to certain persons, and sets future legislative review.

title: Carbon Sequestration
summary: Creates a Carbon Sequestration Task Force under the Department of Environmental Protection to study and report, with a $350,000 appropriation.

title: My Safe Florida Home Program
summary: Requires the Department of Financial Services to notify My Safe Florida Home applicants in specified circumstances and lets them resubmit or avoid withdrawal by correcting deficiencies.

title: School Social Workers
summary: Exempts persons employed as school social workers from certain teacher certification requirements, with an exception.

title: Grandparent Visitation
summary: Revises the criteria a grandparent must meet to petition for visitation with a minor child, and when courts may award it.

title: Specialty License Plates/Florida Wildflower
summary: Raises the annual use fee for the Florida Wildflower specialty license plate and adds a discount for owners registering multiple vehicles.

title: Traffic Offenses
summary: Prohibits handheld wireless device use while driving, requires hands-free use for sustained calls, and revises related penalties.

title: Coverage of Prescription Drugs for Pain
summary: Requires Medicaid and Medicaid managed care plans to cover nonopioid pain drugs without disadvantaging them relative to opioids.

title: Dietetics and Nutrition Practice Act
summary: Creates a dietitian/nutritionist licensing framework, bars unlicensed practice, revises exemptions, and lets certain existing credential holders obtain licenses without added requirements.

title: Home Health Aide for Medically Fragile Children Program
summary: Revises a Medicaid home health aide program for medically fragile children, adding annual assessments, a justification requirement for aides working over 40 hours, and federal waiver steps.

title: Ambulatory Surgical Centers
summary: Sets ambulatory surgical center licensing standards, requires inspection record access, bans referral kickbacks, limits staff privilege denials, and mandates physician peer review.

title: Working Floridians Tax Rebate Program
summary: Creates a Working Floridians Tax Rebate Program, requiring the Department of Revenue to issue rebate payments to eligible taxpayers.

title: Drug Prices and Coverage
summary: Requires state reference drug prices, caps pharmacy cash prices and insurer drug reimbursement at those prices, and mandates manufacturer international price reporting.

title: Veterans
summary: Requires a veterans' affairs study and survey, expands a veteran suicide prevention training pilot to include mental health training, and plans adult day health care facilities, with a $350,000 appropriation.

title: Protection of Specified Persons Against the Fraudulent and Exploitative Conveyance of Property Interests
summary: Requires deeds conveying real property to be signed before independent witnesses and lets clerks refer fraud objections to legal aid to protect vulnerable adults.

title: Benefits for Certain Officers Injured in the Line of Duty
summary: Revises eligibility criteria for health insurance coverage for law enforcement and correctional officers injured in the line of duty, and their families.

title: Office of the Corrections Ombudsman
summary: Creates a legislative Corrections Ombudsman and Oversight Committee with access to prison facilities and records, and confidential in-person communications, funded at $250,000.

title: Water Access Facilities
summary: Creates competitive grants for public parking for boat-hauling vehicles and trailers, and authorizes sovereignty submerged land leases for Clean Marine Manufacturer facilities.

title: Public Records/Office of the Corrections Ombudsman and the Corrections Oversight Committee
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Creates a public records exemption for correspondence and communications with the Corrections Ombudsman and the Corrections Oversight Committee.

title: Electronic Delivery of Notices Between Landlords and Tenants
summary: Allows landlords and tenants to deliver notices electronically under set conditions, lets either party revoke that agreement, and deems emailed notices delivered when sent.

title: Gambling
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Bans internet gambling and internet sports wagering, bars betting on rigged athletic contests, and preempts local governments from regulating gaming.

title: Services for Medically Needy Children
summary: Moves Children's Medical Services managed care operation to the Agency for Health Care Administration and requires Medicaid payment for certain individual and family therapy services.

title: Insurer Disclosures on Prescription Drug Coverage
summary: Requires health insurers to notify current and prospective insureds and their doctors of prescription drug formulary changes and keep records of them.

title: Installation or Use of Tracking Devices or Applications
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice
summary: Creates enhanced criminal penalties for knowingly installing tracking devices or apps on others without consent to commit or facilitate dangerous crimes.

title: Background Screenings
summary: Lets an independent sanctioning authority join the Care Provider Background Screening Clearinghouse and bars denying people based on expunged or sealed criminal records.

title: Conduct in Polling Places
summary: Authorizes members of the public to take photographs in polling places before polls open and after they close.

title: Education
summary: Lets certain parents request classroom video cameras in self-contained classrooms, requires operation within a set timeframe, and bars concealing employee identities in recordings.

title: Preferences for Veterans and Military Spouses
summary: Requires state and local governments to give hiring and retention preference to veterans and military spouses, and creates contracting preferences for veteran- and military spouse-owned businesses.

title: Administrative Procedures
summary: Revises state administrative procedures: rule review summaries and regulatory plan contents, hyperlink responsibilities, and the Division of Administrative Hearings director's appointment.

title: Licensure of Family Foster Homes
summary: Directs DCF to adopt rules streamlining foster home licensure for relocating foster parents, with priority review and recognition of prior training.

title: School Safety Equipment
summary: Requires public and private schools to have specified safety equipment on each campus, with the Education Department setting minimum specifications and schools allowed to use specified funds.

title: Assessment of Property Used for Residential Purposes
summary: Bars property appraisers from counting wind-resistance improvements toward a residential property's just value, which would limit assessment increases for those upgrades.

title: Local Business Tax Receipts
summary: Requires businesses applying for or renewing a local business tax receipt to show an active OFAC license or authorization for certain transactions.

title: Homestead Assessment Limitation
summary: Creates a homestead assessment limit for senior homesteaders meeting income and age conditions, and requires reassessment when eligibility lapses.

title: Foreign Influence
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Bans preplanned adoption agreements absent conditions, bars specified persons from accepting value from foreign adversaries, lets tax collectors revoke business tax receipts, and limits government contracts with foreign sources of concern.

title: Regulation of Presidential Libraries
summary: Preempts regulation of presidential libraries to the state and bars local governments from enacting or enforcing rules on them.

title: Assessments Levied on Recreational Vehicle Parks
summary: Limits local special assessments on RV parks so they cannot be levied against a portion of a parking space or campsite, and requires consideration of occupancy rates.

title: Sexual Images
summary: Creates new crimes for possessing, soliciting, or viewing sexual images of minors and altered sexual depictions of identifiable people without consent.

title: Community Development Districts
summary: Lets community development districts enforcing deed restrictions skip synthetic turf rules and allows recall of certain CDD board supervisors.

title: Medicaid Coverage of Continuous Glucose Monitors
summary: Directs the state Medicaid agency to seek federal approval and cover continuous glucose monitors and supplies as a durable medical equipment benefit.

title: Business Development Incentives for Veterans and Military Spouses
topics: Consumer protection and business; Taxes and budget
summary: Creates a veterans and military spouses business development act, waiving Department of State fees and offering tax exemptions for qualifying businesses, subject to registration and annual reporting.

title: Residual Market Insurers
summary: Revises residual market insurance rules, bars post-loss benefit assignments on property policies, and conditions third-party liability suits on a prior judgment or settlement.

title: Homestead Assessment Limitation Transfer
summary: Addresses transfer of homestead assessment limitations and conforming changes to align state law with the State Constitution; details are not provided.

title: Applicants for President of a State University or Florida College System Institution
summary: Addresses confidentiality and definitions for applicants seeking presidencies at state universities and Florida College System institutions.

title: Local Governing Authorities
summary: Exempts charter school construction from local concurrency rules, lets developers make in-lieu education impact fee contributions, and limits local building requirements for startup charter schools.

title: Municipal Water and Sewer Utility Rates
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Requires municipalities to charge out-of-city utility customers the same water and sewer rates, fees and charges as in-city customers in certain circumstances.

title: Enforcement of School Attendance
summary: Requires district school boards to set up a mandatory alert system that notifies specified persons when a student reaches the truancy absence threshold.

title: Assessment of Homestead Property
summary: Caps assessed value growth for elevated homestead property and requires owners using the cap to keep homeowner's and flood insurance, or lose the benefit.

title: Customer Service Callback Queues
summary: Creates a pilot program requiring the Department of Commerce to use a callback queue for returning certain calls and to report to the Legislature.

title: Mail Theft
summary: Prohibits possessing or using unlawfully obtained mail and unauthorized copying of mail depository keys or locks, with criminal penalties.

title: Artificial Intelligence in Education
summary: Requires the State Board of Education to adopt statewide AI standards for schools, direct teacher training and review district compliance, and teach students digital literacy and AI ethics.

title: Local Business Taxes
summary: Title-only summary: lets certain local governments keep levying a business tax and limits how some municipalities may reclassify businesses or set new rates.

title: Waste Facilities
summary: Prohibits local governments and DEP from issuing construction permits for certain solid waste disposal and waste-to-energy facilities under specified circumstances.

title: Fraudulent Use of Gift Cards
summary: Creates criminal penalties, including enhanced penalties, for intent-to-defraud acts involving gift cards and gift card redemption information.

title: Health Insurance Claims
summary: Expands the mandatory health claim dispute program to denied prior authorizations, bars opt-outs, and limits credit-card-only physician payments.

title: Relief of L.P., a Minor, by the Department of Children and Families
summary: Appropriates $28 million to a special needs trust to compensate a minor for injuries from Department of Children and Families negligence.

title: Relief of Maximus Giannikos by the City of Clearwater
summary: Appropriates state funds to compensate Maximus Giannikos for injuries from Clearwater's negligence, with limits on compensation and attorney fees.

title: Combatting Illegal Immigration
summary: Revises the voter registration oath and creates criminal penalties for unauthorized noncitizens who falsely swear oaths in voting, and for people who knowingly assist them.

title: Homeowners’ Association Ombudsman
summary: Creates a Homeowners' Association Ombudsman office within DBPR's condominium division, with an election monitoring process for HOAs.

title: Contract Protection for Elderly Persons and Disabled Adults
summary: Requires contracts involving elderly or disabled adults to be in their primary language, undergo a comprehensive pre-signing review, and be video recorded.

title: Special Alcoholic Beverage Licenses Issued to Residential Condominiums
summary: Exempts certain residential condominiums from license caps, limits licenses to food and beverage managers, and bars off-premises alcohol sales.

title: Regulation of Public Swimming Pools and Bathing Places
summary: Requires Department of Health inspections of previously exempt pools and gives a new technical committee authority over variances and staff certification.

title: Benefits for Firefighters Injured During Training Exercises
summary: Makes firefighters totally and permanently disabled during official training exercises, plus their spouses and dependent children, eligible for certain insurance coverage.

title: Eyewitness Identification
summary: Requires law enforcement to record eyewitness descriptions, prefer lineups over show-ups, and limit facial recognition-based identifications and in-court identifications.

title: Career-themed Courses
summary: Changes how many career-themed courses districts must offer and requires at least two such courses to meet certain requirements; details are not in the summary.

title: Bleeding Control Kits in K-12 Schools
summary: Requires public schools to stock bleeding control kits, train designated staff, and include severe-bleeding response in emergency plans and drills.

title: Transportation Network Company Driver Insurance
summary: Revises automobile insurance requirements for transportation network company drivers; the title gives no detail on the changes.

title: School Personnel Screening Standards
summary: Requires applicants for certain school positions to submit specified information, and requires schools to review it as part of personnel screening.

title: Service Lateral Assessment and Rehabilitation
summary: Requires all utility systems to create and maintain a comprehensive condition assessment program for service laterals, and lets them contract the assessments out.

title: Sovereign Immunity of County Constitutional Officers in Tort Actions
summary: Expands the state sovereign immunity waiver definition to include county constitutional officers in tort actions, making them subject to suit.

title: Traffic Infractions Resulting in a Crash with Another Vehicle
summary: Requires civil penalties and driver license suspensions, after a mandatory hearing, for certain traffic infractions that cause a crash with another vehicle.

title: Firefighter Health and Safety
summary: Directs the State Fire Marshal to help reduce firefighter deaths and adopt rules on chemical-hazard education and employer mental health practices.

title: Transfer of Homestead Property by Inheritance
summary: Provides that certain homestead property transferred by inheritance is not a change of ownership, which would keep its assessment from resetting.

title: Automatic Sealing of Criminal History Records
summary: Eliminates some circumstances in which criminal history records are automatically sealed, and preserves prosecutor access to sealed records.

title: Cybersecurity of Mortgage Brokers and Lenders and Money Services Businesses
topics: AI and technology; Consumer protection and business
summary: Requires mortgage brokers, lenders and money services businesses to maintain an information security program, investigate cybersecurity events, and notify the state regulator.

title: Public School Personnel Compensation
summary: Limits cost-of-living salary adjustments to employees with direct student contact and removes certain limits on performance salary schedule adjustments.

title: County Administrators
summary: Requires certain counties to elect their county administrator for a set term, with population certification and first-election timing specified.

title: Building Requirements of Certain Structures
summary: Requires the Florida Building Commission to mandate stronger wind and impact resistance for the building envelope of certain structures.

title: Mental Health Professionals
summary: Renames intern registrations as associate registrations for three mental health professions and removes the requirement for an on-premises licensed supervisor in private practice.

title: Local Business Taxes
summary: Repeals local business tax provisions while letting certain municipalities keep imposing a business tax and revise the 'merchant' definition.

title: Air-conditioning Systems
summary: Revises the statutory definition of "class A air-conditioning contractor"; the text provided gives no detail on the change.

title: Transportation
summary: Omnibus transportation bill revising research institute membership, emergency vehicle signals, and driver course limits, and requiring a human operator for personal delivery devices.

title: Rate Standards for Property Insurers
summary: Sets new rate standards for property insurers, bars the insurance regulator from approving certain rate filings, and revises consumer advocate powers.

title: Medical Debt
summary: Restricts medical debt collection activities, caps interest on medical debt, and bars interest and late fees for certain debtors.

title: Administration of Controlled Substances
summary: Lets a practitioner authorize certified paramedics to administer controlled substances while providing emergency services.

title: Fraudulent Entry of Residential Dwellings
summary: Creates a crime for fraudulently entering and taking possession of a residential dwelling unit, and makes such entry grounds for a landlord to terminate a rental agreement.

title: Pet Insurance and Wellness Programs
summary: Creates a Pet Insurance Act, adds pet insurance to property insurance, bans unfair practices in pet wellness programs, and requires insurer disclosures about veterinary exam requirements.

title: Refrigerant Safety and Agricultural Continuity
summary: Lets food processing and cold chain businesses keep buying, installing and servicing R-410A refrigerant equipment until a set date, and grants liability immunity.

title: Spring Restoration
summary: Lets domestic wastewater facilities request that reclaimed water projects in Outstanding Florida Springs plans be incorporated, with DEP required to approve within a set time.

title: Victims of Violence
summary: Creates a presumption that force used against a known abuser was reasonably feared as deadly, mandates trauma-informed training, and creates a case review panel.

title: Transportation Facility Designations/Chandra Cheeseborough Ribault River Bridge
summary: Designates a bridge over the Ribault River in Duval County as the Chandra Cheeseborough Ribault River Bridge, an honorary designation.

title: Perfluoroalkyl and Polyfluoroalkyl Substances
summary: Bans aqueous film-forming foam use, sale, and possession on set dates and requires quarterly PFAS sampling of biosolids and treated effluent reported to the state.

title: Notification of Anti-harassment Policies and Supportive Measures
summary: Requires schools to adopt anti-harassment policies and supportive measures, notify specified people of them, and publish them on websites.

title: Recording of Instruments Conveying Real Property
summary: Requires watermarked electronic notarial signatures, bars recording certain property instruments without specified identification, and lets clerks return instruments for correction.

title: Bump-fire Stocks
summary: Repeals Florida's prohibition on bump-fire stocks, allowing devices that mimic automatic fire to be possessed.

title: Building Permits and Inspections
summary: Limits local zoning and land-use rules, bars denial of manufactured building permits, sets permit expiration, and requires statewide uniform permit applications.

title: Centralized Medicaid Provider Credentialing
summary: Centralizes Medicaid provider credentialing through a single web portal, requires accreditation, and makes claims payable from the approval date.

title: Employers Receiving Economic Development Incentives from State Agencies
summary: Requires employers to sign agreements before receiving state economic development incentives, lets people report suspected violations to the Attorney General, and requires agencies to use separate written agreements.

title: Verification of Reemployment Assistance Benefit Eligibility
summary: Adds identity verification before reemployment benefits are paid, revises disqualification grounds, and requires periodic cross-checks of claimant information to deter fraud.

title: Residential Living Arrangements
summary: Classifies community residences as residential use, allows family and transitional community residences in specified zoning districts, and requires recovery communities to be licensed or certified.

title: Grandparent Visitation Rights
summary: Lets grandparents of a minor child petition a court for visitation with the child in certain circumstances.

title: Florida Virtual School
summary: Revises Florida Virtual School rules, removing student priority provisions and letting it use supplemental funding and direct-support revenue.

title: Substance Abuse and Mental Health Care
summary: Expands mental health crisis services to include the 988 lifeline and changes involuntary placement, guardian advocate discharge, and facility transfer and release rules.

title: Insurance Regulation
summary: Makes clarifying changes to insurance definitions, bars insurers from imposing certain policy conditions, and revises claim-denial and claim-payment timeframes.

title: Community Redevelopment Agencies
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Restricts community redevelopment agencies: bars expanding redevelopment boundaries or extending plan deadlines, limits increment-funded projects, and sets an earlier termination date.

title: Medical Marijuana Treatment Center Licensure
summary: Requires the Department of Health to treat a medical marijuana license application as cured when its only deficiency is a legal partnership with an eligible recognized class member, and bars denial on that basis.

title: Research and Development Tax Credit
summary: Raises the total amount of research and development tax credits that may be provided to businesses and deletes an obsolete provision.

title: Specialty License Plates/Save Coastal Wildlife
summary: Directs the Highway Safety department to create a Save Coastal Wildlife specialty license plate and sets how its sale fees are distributed and used.

title: Linking Industry to Nursing Education Fund
summary: Revises the LINE Fund nursing-education matching program to let nonmonetary contributions count toward proposals, while barring proposals made solely of such contributions.

title: Carrying Concealed Weapons and Firearms into Athletic Events
summary: Lets actively sworn law enforcement officers carry concealed weapons and firearms into certain athletic events when attending as private citizens.

title: Abandoned Cemeteries
summary: Requires the state to be granted an easement for access to abandoned cemeteries located on private property.

title: Political Activities on School Grounds
summary: Allows certain political activities and candidate speeches on school grounds under conditions, while prohibiting other political activities there.

title: Florida Commission on Human Relations
summary: Removes the requirement that the Florida Commission on Human Relations send certain information by registered mail, a procedural change.

title: Feasibility Study Relating to a Statewide Pawn Data Database
summary: Requires the Department of Law Enforcement to study the feasibility of creating a statewide pawn data database. It changes no existing rules.

title: Pilot Program for Students with Reading Deficiencies
summary: Creates a time-limited first-grade summer reading immersion pilot for students at risk of reading deficiencies, with Department of Education and district duties.

title: Student Data
topics: AI and technology; Government and administration
summary: Requires school boards to include a specified provision in third-party contracts, publish student-data agreements online, and terminate contracts when a vendor violates it.

title: Rapid Rail Transit Compact
summary: Authorizes the Governor to sign a rapid rail transit compact with other states and join the Southern Rail Commission.

title: Motor Vehicle Insurance
summary: Repeals Florida's No-Fault motor vehicle insurance law and revises minimum liability coverage and registration insurance requirements, with an $83,651 appropriation.

title: Pharmacy Audits
summary: Tightens rules for pharmacy benefit plan audits of pharmacies, adding procedure, documentation, appeal and recoupment limits, with Office of Insurance Regulation enforcement and penalties.

title: Forms of Identification
summary: Adds passport cards, tribal ID cards and Merchant Mariner Credentials as accepted voter registration IDs, and requires driver licenses to denote certain individuals as noncitizens.

title: Delivery of Commercial Goods by Autonomous Vehicles
summary: Bars autonomous vehicles from delivering commercial goods to homes or businesses unless a licensed human operator is physically aboard, and requires a DHSMV report.

title: Prescription Hearing Aids
summary: Allows prescription hearing aids to be distributed and sold by mail to adults who have been fitted or are pre-appointment with a licensed provider.

title: Florida Public Service Commission
summary: Revises Public Service Commission membership and procedures, adds settlement negotiation and order-rationale requirements, expands intervention, and lets the PSC set affordable rates.

title: County Constitutional Officer Budget Processes
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Lets supervisors of elections and circuit clerks appeal county budget decisions to the Administration Commission, with the Governor's office holding hearings and making recommendations.

title: Services During a State of Emergency
summary: Requires the Department of Management Services to maintain state term contracts for building code inspection services, used during states of emergency.

title: Construction Contracting
summary: Adds financial literacy and consumer protection hours to contractor continuing education, requires a standardized disciplinary form, and requires local board reports.

title: Physical Therapy Treatment Plans
summary: Exempts specified physical therapy services from the requirement that a practitioner of record review and sign the treatment plan.

title: Rural and Urban Business Enterprises
summary: Creates the RISE Investment Tax Credit Program under Commerce, letting tax credits go to qualifying private funds, with revocation and recapture if requirements aren't met.

title: Private Schools
summary: Makes qualifying private schools a permitted zoning use, exempts certain private schools from additional building codes, and sets fire-safety evaluation rules for existing facilities.

title: Public Records/Crime Victims/Officers Involved in Use of Force Incidents
summary: Expands public records confidentiality for crime victims' identifying information and makes officers' identities in use-of-force records confidential for a set period.

title: Cybersecurity Internships
summary: Creates a Commerce-run Cybersecurity Experiential Learning Program, subject to appropriation, designed with Cyber Florida at USF.

title: Department of Law Enforcement
summary: Repeals the Violent Crime and Drug Control Council provisions, revises Domestic Security Oversight Council membership, adds the Governor's mansion to Capitol Complex, and raises the retired police dog veterinary care cap.

title: Insurance
summary: Tightens insurance oversight: mandates annual adjuster continuing education, expands mandatory discipline, bars excluding public adjusters' attorneys from meetings, and requires prompt claimant payments.

title: Department of Health
summary: Lets certain physician assistants receive temporary practice certificates in critical-need areas, and adds medical marijuana theft and loss reporting and background-screening definitions.

title: Food and Hemp Products
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice
summary: Sets conditions for hemp extract sales, bans unpermitted street and festival sales, requires ad preapproval and lab-record keeping, and appropriates $2 million.

title: Guardianship
summary: Bars guardians from restricting an adult ward's contact with others except in limited circumstances, and requires guardianship plans to identify who gets information, notice, and visits.

title: Instructional Personnel and School Administrator Salaries
summary: Raises the minimum base salary for certain teachers, revises the definition of minimum base salary, and requires districts to submit salary structure plans to the Department of Education.

title: Deceptive and Unfair Trade Acts or Practices
summary: Makes certain actions during consumer sales or leases of goods or services unfair or deceptive practices, enforceable under the Deceptive and Unfair Trade Practices Act.

title: Transportation
summary: Omnibus transportation bill: longer minimum yellow signal times, private license plate reader authorization, a plate-frame rule, a traffic signal grant program, and seaport space-industry reporting.

title: Procurement Compliance
summary: Lets the Department of Management Services give governmental entities electronic system access to check compliance with bans on contracting with foreign countries of concern.

title: Foreign Students Enrolled in Public Postsecondary Educational Institutions
summary: Requires Florida public colleges and universities to cap enrollment of noncitizen, non-permanent-resident foreign students at a set percentage of total enrollment.

title: Public Records/Department of Management Services Vendor Information
summary: Exempts certain vendor information held electronically by the Department of Management Services from public records requirements, with future legislative review and repeal.

title: Employment Eligibility
summary: Requires all private employers, not only those above a headcount threshold, to use E-Verify to check new employees' work eligibility starting on a set date.

title: Residential Property Insurers
summary: Requires homeowner's policy insurers to send specified notices to policyholders by mail, and by email in certain cases, with some exceptions.

title: Homeowners’ Insurance Policies
summary: Requires insurers to reimburse homeowners for a specified roof inspection in certain circumstances and to send certain notices at a set time.

title: Military Affairs
summary: Renames the state flagship and a veterans employment program, updates a federal reference, and appropriates $2.5 million for a grant agreement.

title: Interpersonal Violence Injunctions
summary: Revises domestic violence injunction procedures: ex parte petition review, earlier final hearings, clerk forms and service duties, and bars courts from issuing mutual protection orders.

title: Public Records/Veterans Florida Opportunity Program
summary: Creates a public records exemption for materials Florida Is For Veterans, Inc. handles while administering the Veterans Florida Opportunity Program, with future legislative review.

title: Bingo Games
summary: Defines instant bingo ticket dispensers and revises rules for manufacturing, issuing, and operating instant bingo tickets, including required dispenser features.

title: Civil Liability for the Wrongful Death of an Unborn Child
summary: Lets parents sue for wrongful death of an unborn child, but not the mother, and not providers whose care meets the standard of care.

title: Arrest and Search Warrants
summary: Expands when police may make warrantless arrests, including for injunction violations and DUI or BUI, and lets judges issue warrants or summonses for some misdemeanors.

title: Harming or Neglecting Children
summary: Revises the statutory definitions of 'harm' and 'neglect of a child' as they relate to a child's health or welfare.

title: First Responders
summary: Renames a law enforcement recruitment bonus program to include firefighters, lets the CFO appoint grant review panels, and creates a PTSD institute subject to appropriation.

title: Parental Rights
summary: Requires parental consent for minors' treatment for certain diseases, requires school notice before student questionnaires, and creates parental consent for biofeedback devices.

title: Waterbody Designations/Andrew “Red” Harris Spoil Island
summary: Designates the Andrew "Red" Harris Spoil Island and directs DEP to erect markers identifying it.

title: Department of Highway Safety and Motor Vehicles
summary: Replaces motor carrier registration with licensure for certain qualified vehicles, swaps identifying devices for fuel use decals, changes motor fuel tax return due dates, and requires a Florida address for registration.

title: Recovery Residence Accountability and Protection Act
summary: Requires every owner, operator, or manager of a recovery residence to obtain and maintain DCF certification, making the previously voluntary program mandatory.

title: Public Records/E-mail Addresses/DHSMV
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Expands the public records exemption for driver and vessel e-mail addresses collected by DHSMV for notifications, and applies it retroactively.

title: Information Technology Procurement and Contracting
summary: Creates a Bureau of Enterprise Project Management and Oversight within the Florida Digital Service to manage certain IT contracts and report annually.

title: Biosolids Management
summary: Limits land application of Class AA biosolids to agronomic rates, requires application records, has UF IFAS publish recommended rates, and conditions marketing of biosolids products.

title: Use of Wireless Communications Devices in Schools
summary: Directs the Education Commissioner to implement a pilot ban on student cell phone use on school grounds in selected districts, with a report to the Legislature.

title: Public Employees Relations Commission
summary: Makes procedural changes to public employee union registration, election criteria, bargaining-unit petitions, and charge filing with the Public Employees Relations Commission.

title: Building Construction
summary: Revises Florida building construction rules: inspector internship and certification criteria, virtual owner signing, qualifying agent changes, and the notice of commencement threshold.

title: Public Records/Public Employees Relations Commission
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Exempts employee showings of interest to decertify a union from public records disclosure, with future legislative review and repeal.

title: Compensation of Victims of Wrongful Incarceration
summary: Expands the filing window and deletes the violent-felony definition for wrongful incarceration compensation, while barring compensation for concurrent sentences and revising award offsets.

title: Protection of Parental Rights
summary: Bars courts from denying or restricting parental rights, or presuming neglect, solely because a parent is a registered medical marijuana patient.

title: Permits for Drilling, Exploration, and Extraction of Oil and Gas Resources
summary: Requires DEP to weigh factors and a balancing test when deciding whether nearby waters and shores are adequately protected from oil and gas drilling accidents or blowouts.

title: Education and Workforce Development for Current and Former Inmates
summary: Lets Florida's transportation department spend workforce funds on all programs and lets employers seek state reimbursement of insurance premiums for hiring former inmates, subject to appropriation.

title: Pediatric Behavioral and Mental Health Screenings
summary: Directs AHCA to set rules for pediatric behavioral and mental health screenings under EPSDT and requires providers to give parents sleep, screen time, and nutrition information.

title: Solar Facilities
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration; Housing
summary: Lets counties require decommissioning of certain solar facilities and removes solar's automatic permitted-use status and the substation exemption from local land-use rules.

title: Special Risk Class
summary: Expands Special Risk Class pension membership criteria to cover certain prosecutors and special investigators and adjusts years of service for full retirement eligibility.

title: Exemption from Ad Valorem Taxes of Child Care Facilities
topics: Children and families; Taxes and budget
summary: Exempts from ad valorem property taxes any portion of a child care facility that has achieved Gold Seal Quality status, with lessor operators able to claim it.

title: Criminal Activity of Insurance Professionals
summary: Requires fingerprint background checks for insurance professionals, with submitters paying state and federal processing costs, and lets the Office of Insurance Regulation review results.

title: Ad Valorem Tax
summary: Authorizes counties and municipalities to create property tax rebate programs for property owners, with program requirements to be specified.

title: Reproductive Freedom
summary: Creates the Reproductive Freedom Act, establishing a fundamental right to reproductive health care and barring the state from denying, interfering with, or penalizing its exercise.

title: Reporting of Student Mental Health Outcomes
summary: Requires OPPAGA to submit an initial evaluation and a final review of student mental health outcomes to the Governor and Legislature.

title: Railroad Crossing Safety
summary: Requires the Department of Transportation to study advanced detection and monitoring systems at public railroad-highway grade crossings.

title: Crimes Evidencing Prejudice
summary: Expands crime reclassification for prejudice-based offenses to cover victim gender and actual or perceived characteristics, and revises the disability definition.

title: Interstate Podiatric Medical Licensure Compact
summary: Creates the Interstate Podiatric Medical Licensure Compact, letting podiatrists obtain expedited licenses in member states and establishing a compact commission.

title: Public Records/Criminal Acts that Evidence Prejudice
summary: Moves hate-crime data collection from the Governor to the Attorney General via FDLE and expands the public records exemption for that data.

title: Public Records and Meetings/Interstate Podiatric Medical Licensure Compact
summary: Creates public records and public meetings exemptions for information and meetings tied to the Interstate Podiatric Medical Licensure Compact, with future review and repeal.

title: Resilience Districts
summary: Creates a Resilience District Act allowing petition-based infrastructure and condominium resilience districts, with specified uses and project-management fees; details are not in the text provided.

title: Injunctions for Protection Against Marriage Fraud
summary: Creates a civil cause of action letting marriage-fraud victims seek protective injunctions regardless of other pending cases, with no clerk filing fee.

title: Traffic Offenses
summary: Bans handheld wireless device use while driving, requires hands-free use for sustained calls, revises penalties, and mandates hearings for crash-causing infractions.

title: Florida Tax Credit Scholarship Program
summary: Removes language that required certain Florida Tax Credit Scholarship Program funds to revert to the state.

title: Legal Tender
summary: Requires the Department of Financial Services to contract a vendor to study legal tender issues and report to the Legislature, with no change to current law.

title: Restoration of Voting Rights
summary: Creates a Commission on Offender Review database to help people confirm voting-rights restoration, and shields those who register in good-faith reliance on it from certain criminal charges.

title: Resilient Florida Trust Fund/Department of Environmental Protection
summary: Re-creates the Resilient Florida Trust Fund within the Department of Environmental Protection and deletes its termination provisions, so the fund continues.

title: Tax Referenda
summary: Defines "local government spending analysis" and requires it be included on certain local tax referenda.

title: Tax Credits for Investment in Rural Communities
summary: Creates the Florida Rural Jobs Act, granting state tax credits to investors in certified rural funds and setting application and redistribution procedures.

title: Clerks of the Court
summary: Lets clerks of court retain or deposit certain funds and lets the clerks' corporation seek reimbursement for specified filings and fees.

title: Fees/Equity Investment Certified as a Capital Investment
summary: Requires rural funds seeking capital-investment certification for specified tax credits to pay a nonrefundable application fee to the Department of Commerce.

title: Principal Offices of Limited Liability Companies and Corporations
summary: Revises the statutory definition of "principal office" for LLCs and corporations; the text provided is a short summary only.

title: Areas of Critical State Concern
summary: Exempts Habitat for Humanity construction contracts from payment and performance bonds, extends Florida Forever Keys land-purchase deadlines, and limits added Keys building permit allocations.

title: Prosecution of Defendants
summary: Revises insanity defense qualifications, dismissal rules, sentencing mitigators, and requires involuntary commitment for some persons found not guilty by reason of insanity.

title: Public Employee Collective Bargaining
summary: Revises public-sector union certification, recertification and decertification procedures, including ballot placement by showing of interest, and repeals a union certification revocation provision.

title: Release of Driver License Information
summary: Allows DHSMV to give state agencies and third parties access to driver license data with consent, while barring third parties from retaining or selling that data.

title: Elections
summary: Requires prominent election instructions on websites, DHSMV voter registration opportunities, third-party registration affirmations, and supervisor eligibility checks using all available data.

title: Disability Awareness and Inclusion Education
summary: Authorizes the Department of Education to create a disability awareness and inclusion program and instruction, with grants subject to appropriation.

title: Flood Zone Disclosures for Dwelling Units
summary: Requires landlords to disclose flood zone information before a tenancy begins and notify current tenants of flood zone designation changes.

title: Career Offender Registration
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice
summary: Requires career offenders to obtain driver licenses or ID cards with a required marking, and allows DHSMV to share images with FDLE for public notification.

title: Disqualification from Educator Certification and Employment
summary: Prohibits automatic ineligibility for educator certification and certain employment when specified offenses meet defined criteria, loosening disqualification rules.

title: Elections
summary: Adds citizenship proof definitions and acknowledgment to voter registration, requires DHSMV-State citizenship matching and supervisor eligibility checks, and mandates official ballots marked with specified pens.

title: Public Records/Licensed Veterinary Technicians
summary: Creates a temporary public records exemption for records relating to licensed veterinary technicians until specified criteria are met.

title: Firearm Hold Agreements
summary: Grants civil liability immunity to federal firearms licensees operating lawfully in Florida for acts or omissions relating to firearm hold agreements under specified circumstances.

title: Assault Weapons and Large-capacity Magazines
summary: Bans the sale, transfer and possession of assault weapons and large-capacity magazines, with conditions for continued possession of existing ones.

title: Charitable Giving
summary: Requires charities to honor donor-imposed gift restrictions and notify donors when they cannot, and bars state agencies from imposing burdensome annual filing requirements on regulated charities.

title: Sales Tax Exemption of Bullion
summary: Exempts sales of gold, silver, and platinum bullion from the state sales tax, reducing state sales tax revenue.

title: Telephone Solicitation
summary: Revises the definitions of telephone solicitor and telephonic sales call and the conditions for awarding attorney fees in telephone solicitation suits.

title: Gay and Transgender Panic Legal Defenses
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice
summary: Bars defendants from using a nonviolent sexual advance or perceived sexual orientation or gender identity of another person as a criminal defense or mitigation.

title: Coordinated Screening and Progress Monitoring
summary: Requires school districts to follow specified screening steps, including further dyslexia or dyscalculia screening when a student shows characteristics.

title: Insurer Disclosures on Prescription Drug Coverage
summary: Requires health insurers to notify insureds and their doctors of drug formulary changes, report annually to OIR, and credit drug payments toward cost-sharing.

title: Transportation Infrastructure Land Development Regulations
summary: Creates the Transit-Oriented Development Act, requiring local governments to establish TOD zones and barring certain local regulations within them.

title: Juvenile Justice
summary: Revises juvenile contempt penalties, allows custody after a contempt finding, appoints counsel in some cases, and adds early truancy intervention services.

title: Companion Artificial Intelligence Chatbots
topics: AI and technology; Children and families
summary: Requires companion AI chatbot operators to verify user age through accounts, protect verification data, and take steps for minors, with violations treated as deceptive trade practices.

title: Fentanyl Testing
summary: Requires hospitals and hospital-based emergency departments to test overdose-related urine samples for fentanyl, confirm positives, and retain the results in patient records.

title: Public Records/Department of Legal Affairs/Artificial Intelligence Violations
summary: Creates a public records exemption for Department of Legal Affairs investigation information about certain artificial intelligence violations, with future review and repeal.

title: Department of Highway Safety and Motor Vehicles
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration; Transportation
summary: Revises penalties for wireless device use while driving, bars unauthorized sale of certain service appointments, and lets tax collectors mail or offer vehicle titles.

title: Terminology Associated with the Florida Housing Finance Corporation
summary: Revises and adds definitions for terms used by the Florida Housing Finance Corporation; no substantive policy change is described.

title: Taxation of Indigenous Products
summary: Exempts the sale of indigenous products from the state sales tax.

title: Affordable Housing Property Tax Exemptions
summary: Revises conditions for property tax exemptions on affordable multifamily housing, including charitable-use eligibility, exempt unit counts, and compliance-report evidence.

title: Communication Services
summary: Creates a tax exemption for certain communications and Internet equipment, revises the date after which the communications services tax may be increased, and creates a working group.

title: Motor Vehicles
summary: Creates a secure online portal for license plate seizures, lets disabled veterans keep their plate designation on reissue or transfer, and bans plate covers that obscure plates.

title: Behavioral Health Managing Entities
summary: Requires DCF to contract for managing-entity functions and transparency recommendations, and requires managing entities to report data electronically.

title: Small Employer Health Insurance
summary: Deletes provisions creating the Florida Small Employer Health Reinsurance Program and revises related definitions in small-employer health insurance law.

title: Florida Institute for Pediatric Rare Diseases
summary: Creates the Florida Institute for Pediatric Rare Diseases at FSU's College of Medicine, which would run a Sunshine Genetics Pilot Program with participation and data rules.

title: Handling of Animals
summary: Requires dog breeders to register with the state and renew certificates, directs agriculture rules for breeding, and sets requirements for retail pet stores.

title: Cybersecurity Risks from Unmanned Aircraft Systems
summary: Requires the Florida Cybersecurity Advisory Council to meet quarterly to assess cybersecurity risks from unmanned aircraft systems and make recommendations.

title: Fees for Department of Highway Safety and Motor Vehicles Services
summary: Redirects certain motor vehicle and license fees from the Highway Safety Operating Trust Fund to tax collectors, who keep a portion after a specified charge.

title: Public School Personnel Salary Schedules
summary: Removes cost-of-living salary adjustment requirements and the bar on cutting performance salary schedules for budget reasons, and revises school employee salary schedule rules.

title: Protections for Public Employees who use Medical Marijuana as Qualified Patients
summary: Bars public employers from taking adverse personnel action against qualified medical marijuana patients or applicants, and requires notice of the right to contest positive tests.

title: Controlled Substances
summary: Exempts FDA-approved xylazine drug products from Schedule I controlled-substance status and creates a new offense of trafficking in xylazine.

title: Historic Cemeteries Trust Fund/Department of State
summary: Creates a Historic Cemeteries Trust Fund within the Department of State's Division of Historical Resources and governs how its moneys are deposited and disbursed.

title: Claims for Adverse Reactions to Vaccines and Drugs Under the Medicare, Medicaid, and Medically Needy Programs
