summary: Requires the Agency for Health Care Administration to expedite review and payment of Medicare and Medicaid claims for adverse reactions to vaccines and drugs.

title: Vertiports
summary: Revises the definition of airport infrastructure and authorizes the Department of Transportation to fund up to set percentages of public vertiport project costs.

title: Autism Spectrum Disorder Training for Law Enforcement Officers
summary: Requires the Criminal Justice Standards and Training Commission to mandate autism-interaction training for law enforcement officers in recruit and continuing instruction.

title: Toll Discounts for Veteran-owned Businesses
summary: Creates a pilot program giving veteran-owned businesses a discount on tolls, administered by the Florida Turnpike Enterprise with veterans' and management services agencies.

title: Claims Against the Government
summary: Raises the statutory caps on state and local government tort liability and revises claim procedures and limitation periods.

title: Florida Bright Futures Scholarship Program
summary: Requires specified test preparation resources be provided to certain students, sets continued Bright Futures eligibility criteria for them, and provides funding for the resources.

title: THC
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice; Transportation
summary: Defines THC-infused beverages, bans open containers and consumption in vehicles, bars sales to under-21s, and sets criminal penalties.

title: Ambulatory Surgical Centers
summary: Sets licensing criteria, inspection requirements, building standards, and internal risk management and sexual-misconduct reporting duties for ambulatory surgical centers.

title: Habitual Traffic Offender Designation
summary: Revises the definition of 'habitual traffic offender' and cites the act as Isaiah's Law; the summary gives no detail on the change.

title: Declarations of a Public Health Emergency
summary: Lets individuals refuse emergency exams, testing or treatment by written notice, excludes vaccines from 'treatment,' and revises emergency declaration expiration and renewal.

title: Coverage for Cancer Imaging and Genetic Testing
summary: Requires health insurers and HMOs to cover cancer imaging and genetic testing without cost-sharing requirements.

title: School District Reporting Requirements
summary: Requires school boards to adopt a policy temporarily removing instructional personnel after certain arrests, and requires law enforcement and school employees to report those arrests within set timeframes.

title: Civil Remedies Pertaining to Abortions
summary: Creates a civil cause of action for certain abortion-inducing or performing violations, allows damages and injunctions, and blocks Florida courts from enforcing other states' clawback judgments.

title: State Purchasing
summary: Requires the Department of Management Services to inventory state fleet vehicles, maintenance facilities and fuel depots, and creates two fleet-related pilot programs.

title: Grants for Genetic Counseling Education
summary: Creates a State University System grant program, subject to appropriation, rewarding excellent genetic counseling education programs.

title: Leaving the Scene of a Crash Involving Only Damage to Vehicle or Property
summary: Authorizes courts to order drivers convicted of leaving the scene of a property-damage-only crash to pay restitution for the damage.

title: Traffic Enforcement
summary: Adds a ban on operating vehicles with improperly issued plates or stickers, revises abandoned-vehicle removal, and lets police seize vehicles used to flee.

title: Driving and Boating Offenses
summary: Creates Trenton's Law, barring driving under any impairing substance and making refusal to submit to breath or urine tests a misdemeanor, and lets state attorneys create DUI diversion programs.

title: Advanced Practice Registered Nurse Autonomous Practice
summary: Authorizes certain advanced practice registered nurses to practice autonomously, without physician supervision, in providing mental health services.

title: Reproductive Health Rights
summary: Creates the Protect Reproductive Options Act, declaring individuals have a fundamental right to make their own reproductive health decisions.

title: Unauthorized Aliens
summary: Bars state licenses and down payment aid for unauthorized immigrants, requires county proof of lawful presence for borrowers, and adds English-language requirements.

title: Access to School Readiness Programs for Economically Disadvantaged Households
summary: Revises Department of Education duties and early learning coalition requirements for school readiness programs, including a uniform waiting list, to improve access for economically disadvantaged households.

title: Practice of Veterinary Medicine
summary: Revises the Board of Veterinary Medicine's membership and defines which veterinary services technicians may perform under supervision and which only licensed veterinarians may provide.

title: Child Restraint Requirements
summary: Prohibits operating a motorcycle or moped with a child under a certain age unless listed requirements are met.

title: Assault or Battery on a Utility Worker
summary: Creates a definition of utility worker and reclassifies assault or battery offenses committed against utility workers on critical infrastructure to higher penalties.

title: Implementation of the Recommendations of the Blue-Green Algae Task Force
summary: Requires periodic inspections of certain onsite sewage systems and tightens basin management action plan pollutant load reduction requirements to address blue-green algae.

title: Vessels
summary: Restricts officers from stopping or boarding vessels without probable cause, expands spring protection zones to modify vessel positioning, and creates a boater safety decal and an energy-source act.

title: Offenses Evidencing Prejudice
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice
summary: Expands Florida's hate-crime reclassification to cover gender and gender identity, requires reclassification when bias is in part based on listed traits, and replaces 'mental or physical disability' with 'disability'.

title: Availability of Marijuana for Adult Use
summary: Limits the marijuana sales tax exemption to qualified patients and caregivers, and changes medical marijuana treatment center operations, contractors, wholesale sales, and facility permits.

title: Surrendering to Law Enforcement
summary: Creates Vassallo's Law, requiring law enforcement procedures for interviewing surrendering persons, authorizing temporary detention or arrest, and transport for involuntary mental health examination when warranted.

title: Special Districts
summary: Repeals the requirement that special districts set performance goals and measures and publish annual reports on achieved and unachieved objectives.

title: Right Turns at Intersections Using Traffic Infraction Detectors
summary: Prohibits certain right turns at intersections that use traffic infraction detectors and requires signage marking those intersections.

title: Required Instruction in Cursive Writing
summary: Requires students in specified grades to receive cursive writing instruction and demonstrate proficiency by the end of a set grade.

title: Department of Business and Professional Regulation
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice; Immigration
summary: Omnibus DBPR bill: shifts alcohol and tobacco enforcement duties, adds the department to employment-verification record requesters, and penalizes hemp extract sales in lodging and food venues.

title: Withholding Funds from the Return of Cash Bonds
summary: Requires clerks to withhold funds from cash bonds posted by criminal defendants or their spouses, rather than from bonds posted by others.

title: Litigation Financing Consumer Protection
summary: Regulates litigation financing: restricts financier conduct and requires parties with foreign-linked funding agreements to disclose them to the court and other parties.

title: Resilience Infrastructure Loans
summary: Creates a Department of Commerce loan program for resilience infrastructure, with contracting through the State Board of Administration and an indeterminate appropriation.

title: Availability of Marijuana for Adult Use
summary: Limits the marijuana sales tax exemption to qualified patients, allows MMTC contractors and conditional wholesale sales between MMTCs, and requires facility permits.

title: Relief of the Estate of Peniel Janvier by the City of Miami Beach
summary: Appropriates $1.7 million from the state to compensate the Janvier estate for negligence damages caused by the City of Miami Beach, with payment limits.

title: Relief of Jose Correa by Miami-Dade County
summary: Appropriates $4.1 million to compensate Jose Correa for injuries caused by a Miami-Dade County employee's negligence, with limits on fees and payment.

title: Combatting Illegal Immigration
summary: Requires state, county and larger law enforcement agencies to sign ICE immigration agreements, creates an Unauthorized Alien Transport Program, and appropriates $3 million.

title: Charter Schools
summary: Expands who may apply for conversion charter schools, lets municipalities seek job engine charters, and adds charter schools to a workforce grant program.

title: Whistleblower Protections for Employees and Independent Contractors of Property Insurers
topics: Consumer protection and business; Labor and employment
summary: Prohibits property insurers and their agents or affiliates from retaliating against employees or contractors, and lets those workers sue within a set period.

title: Removal of Altered Sexual Depictions Posted Without Consent
summary: Requires covered online platforms to set up a process for removing altered sexual depictions of identifiable people posted without consent, with immunity for good-faith compliance.

title: Towing Disabled Vehicles
summary: Requires officers and wrecker operators to give drivers specified information about impounded or disabled vehicles, and lets disabled-vehicle drivers take certain actions.

title: Students Enrolled in Dropout Retrieval Programs
summary: Revises assessment and accountability rules for a virtual instruction provider and lets dropout retrieval programs choose a school grade or improvement rating.

title: Gambling
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Tightens gambling rules by banning betting on prearranged athletic contests and slot machine trafficking, adds a revolving-door employment ban, and lets cardroom operators set a 21+ age limit.

title: Memory Care
summary: Requires assisted living facilities that serve or advertise memory care to obtain a separate memory care services license, with AHCA rules to follow.

title: Nicotine Products
summary: Creates the Florida Age Gate Act, adding fines and penalties for selling unauthorized single-use nicotine devices and restricting their retail advertising and display.

title: Transportation Facility Designations
summary: Creates honorary names for certain transportation facilities in specified counties and directs FDOT to erect markers.

title: Medical Coverage Assistance Program for Working Individuals with Disabilities
summary: Creates a Medicaid buy-in program letting certain working people with disabilities purchase coverage, contingent on federal approval, with AHCA seeking a waiver or state plan amendment.

title: Public Postsecondary Education
summary: Requires state boards to keep Florida colleges and universities free from undue government influence, and deletes a provision barring shielding of protected speech.

title: Optional Retirement Programs
summary: Requires employer contribution rates for certain optional retirement programs to match the FRS Investment Plan rate.

title: Home Health Care Services
summary: Removes geographic limits on home health administrators' agency oversight and drops the direct-employee requirement for certain patient visits; revises Excellence in Home Health Program award criteria.

title: Minimum Wage Requirements
summary: Exempts employers from state minimum wage rules for specified employees, allowing voluntary opt-out by waiver while requiring at least the federal minimum wage.

title: Elections
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Revises the AG's advisory-opinion criteria, expands Office of Election Crimes and Security duties, updates voter records, and lets candidates challenge rivals' oath compliance.

title: Education on Congenital Cytomegalovirus
summary: Requires the Department of Health to develop congenital cytomegalovirus education materials and requires certain hospitals, birth centers, and OB practices to distribute them to expectant and new parents.

title: Election Dates for Municipal Office
summary: Requires municipal elections to be held on the general election date, moves control of municipal election dates to the state, and repeals for-cause date changes.

title: Elections During Emergencies
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Requires elections during emergencies to follow set procedures, lets supervisors seek Secretary of State approval for changes, and mandates a statewide election emergency contingency plan.

title: Heated Tobacco Products
summary: Defines heated tobacco products and revises the statutory definitions of cigarette and tobacco product.

title: Testing of Cosmetics on Animals
summary: Prohibits animal testing of cosmetics and sales of animal-tested cosmetics, and requires manufacturers to hold a permit subject to state inspections.

title: Protections for Public Employees Who Use Medical Marijuana as Qualified Patients
summary: Bars public employers from taking adverse action against employees or applicants for medical marijuana use, requires notice of test-result rights, and creates a cause of action.

title: Termination of a Rental Agreement by a Victim of Domestic Violence, Dating Violence, Sexual Violence, or Stalking
summary: Bars landlords from terminating leases or evicting tenants who are domestic, dating, sexual violence or stalking victims, and lets victims end leases early.

title: Heavy Equipment Rental Recovery Fee
summary: Lets heavy equipment rental dealers charge and collect a recovery fee, barred from certain entities and from being part of taxable sales price.

title: Local Utility Revenues
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Bars counties and cities from diverting utility revenues to other purposes, requires surpluses returned to ratepayers, and limits higher rates or surcharges on certain customers.

title: Unmanned Aircraft or Unmanned Aircraft Systems
summary: Expands critical infrastructure drone restrictions, raises penalties for prohibited drone actions, and allows reasonable force against drones conducting surveillance.

title: Coral Reefs
summary: Revises legislative findings on coral reefs and provides a legislative designation; the summary is too thin to determine any policy change.

title: K-12 School Transportation
summary: Requires school boards to transport K-12 students living over 1 mile from school, mandates AI program use within a timeframe, and revises hazardous walking criteria.

title: Voluntary Trial Resolution
summary: Lets parties in civil, family, or probate cases agree to a voluntary trial resolution judge who decides the case to final judgment.

title: Occupational Injury Benefit Plans
summary: Lets qualifying employers offer their own occupational injury benefit plans as an alternative to standard workers' compensation, with offsets to benefits paid.

title: Accessing Personnel Files of Law Enforcement Officers
summary: Requires law enforcement employers to log the name, address and ID of anyone who requests and receives an officer's personnel file.

title: Consumer Protection in Insurance Matters
summary: Requires public adjusters and insurers to respond to claim status requests and pay or deny claims within set timeframes, and adds universal life policy reporting requirements.

title: Redesignations of State University and Florida College System Institution Roads
summary: Requires state university and college boards to rename specified roads after Charlie Kirk, with state funds withheld from institutions that fail to comply.

title: Postjudgment Execution Proceedings Relating to Terrorism
summary: Adds requirements for postjudgment execution proceedings to enforce judgments against terrorist parties, with retroactive application.

title: Ad Valorem Tax Exemption for Nonprofit Homes for the Aged
summary: Revises an eligibility requirement for Florida limited partnerships seeking property tax exemptions for nonprofit homes for the aged.

title: Public Employee Housing Benefits
summary: Lets specified public employers pay employees a one-time cash-out of sick and annual leave for a housing purpose, with escrow rules for disbursement.

title: Public Records
summary: Strengthens public records requests by requiring prompt, good-faith acknowledgment, limiting exemption claims, and adding civil penalties for violations.

title: Infill Redevelopment
summary: Requires local governments to permit residential development on qualifying infill parcels, limits subdivision-based restrictions, doubles parks impact fees, and preempts certain local rules.

title: Sanitary and Stormwater System Standards
summary: Requires county and municipal sanitary and stormwater systems to meet state DOT standards for certain elements, adds inspections, and overrides conflicting local standards.

title: Grand Jury Testimony and Materials
summary: Allows courts to disclose certain grand jury testimony and materials, and requires clerks and prosecutors to preserve and track those materials.

title: Online Access to Materials Harmful to Minors
topics: AI and technology; Children and families
summary: Requires app developers and device manufacturers to determine users' ages, notify app stores, offer parental protections for child users, and provide age verification.

title: Agency for Health Care Administration
summary: Requires background screening and sets admission eligibility rules for medically complex children's homes, with license denial, suspension, and revocation provisions.

title: Marriage Between Persons of the Same Sex
topics: Children and families; Civil rights and liberties
summary: Repeals Florida's statutory ban on recognizing same-sex marriages and the related prohibitions on state recognition of such marriages or relationships.

title: Public Records/Judicial Qualifications Commission
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Exempts personal identifying and location information of Judicial Qualifications Commission employees and their spouses and children from public records requirements, with retroactive application and repeal review.

title: Educational Choice
summary: Revises Florida Tax Credit Scholarship rules on allowable instructional materials and tutoring, adds home education program requirements, and changes a scholarship renewal deadline.

title: Public Records/Office of Financial Regulation
summary: Creates public records exemptions for cybersecurity-event information, customer data, and financial exploitation reports held by the Office of Financial Regulation, with future review and repeal.

title: Construction Defects
summary: Bill declares deviations from initial construction plans and specifications are not construction defects, and changes notice and inspection timelines for construction defect claims.

title: Long-range Program Plans
summary: Requires state agency and judicial branch long-range program plans to be policy-based, priority-driven, and to include specified performance measures and trends.

title: Public Safety
summary: Lets amputee first responders keep serving under conditions, bans vehicle kill switches, allows certain persons to carry concealed firearms like on-duty officers, and bars interfering with officers' recording or restraint devices.

title: Preemption to the State
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration; Housing
summary: Preempts local regulation of religious services, bars localities from substantially burdening free exercise of religion, and limits certificate-of-occupancy denials over landscaping noncompliance.

title: Assault or Battery of Contractors Performing State Functions
summary: Reclassifies certain assault or battery offenses against contractors performing state functions, which would generally raise the penalty level for those offenses.

title: Interception and Disclosure of Oral Communications
summary: Allows a party to a conversation to intercept and record it under certain conditions, with use limited to evidencing domestic violence.

title: Annual Rate Increases for Coverages by Citizens Property Insurance Corporation
summary: Exempts new Citizens Property Insurance policies issued after a set date, and their renewals, from required annual rate increases and rate limits.

title: Florida Hurricane Catastrophe Fund
summary: Revises the Hurricane Catastrophe Fund's retention definition and requires its reimbursement contracts to cover insurers' loss adjustment expenses at specified amounts.

title: Arrest and Detention of Individuals with Significant Medical Conditions
summary: Gives law enforcement officers discretion over whether to make an immediate arrest of people with significant medical conditions.

title: Transportation
summary: Transfers the Florida Highway Patrol and commercial vehicle enforcement from the Highway Safety department to the Law Enforcement department, and makes the highway safety director a Senate-confirmed gubernatorial appointee.

title: Department of Business and Professional Regulation
summary: Repeals assorted DBPR board, council, and licensing provisions, including interior design practice and compensation-disclosure requirements, per the title alone.

title: Department of Financial Services
summary: Makes assorted Department of Financial Services changes, including reporting subsystems, salary payments, My Safe Florida Home eligibility, and abandoned property rules.

title: Aggravated Stalking
summary: Creates a new offense of aggravated stalking for repeated, willful, malicious following, harassment, or cyberstalking with specified aggravating acts.

title: Elections of County Commissioners, District School Board Members, and District School Superintendents
summary: Requires county commissioners and district school board members to be nominated and elected by voters residing in their own district, and revises school superintendent election rules.

title: Doula Workforce Development
summary: Creates a Department of Commerce grant program supporting doula training entities, prioritizing high-need regions, with a $7.5 million appropriation and annual reporting.

title: Apprenticeship and Preapprenticeship Program Funding
summary: Revises apprenticeship program standards, requires a model contract template for school districts and apprenticeship programs, and sets steering committee meeting rules.

title: Artificial Intelligence in Higher Education
summary: Creates a study group on artificial intelligence in higher education and requires it to report its findings to the Governor and Legislature.

title: Protection of Parental Rights
summary: Bars courts from denying or restricting parental rights, or presuming neglect, based solely on a parent's status as a medical marijuana patient.

title: Use of Artificial Intelligence by State Agencies
summary: Requires the Florida Digital Service to conduct a study on state agencies' use of artificial intelligence.

title: Mental Health Services for First Responders
summary: Requires the State Fire Marshal to create a statewide behavioral health program offering mental wellness services to first responders, with training requirements for licensed counselors.

title: Florida Health Choices Program
summary: Renames the Florida Health Choices Program as the Florida Employee Health Choices Program and revises vendor eligibility, available insurance products, and marketplace structure.

title: Virtual Instruction
summary: Lets students use Florida scholarship awards for virtual programs at private schools and lets public schools operate hybrid models.

title: Temporary Cash Assistance Eligibility
summary: Bars denying temporary cash assistance to certain people solely because of a drug trafficking conviction, under specified circumstances.

title: Veterans’ Assistance
summary: Directs the Department of Veterans' Affairs, subject to appropriation, to expand programs connecting veterans and families to services, hold public events, and report annually.

title: Food and Plastic Waste Reduction
summary: Directs the Department of Education, with Agriculture, to create a school pilot program on food and plastic waste reduction, offered in a set share of schools with district reports.

title: My Safe Florida Home Trust Fund/Department of Financial Services
summary: Creates the My Safe Florida Home Trust Fund within the Department of Financial Services, funded by a share of insurance premium tax, with future review or termination.

title: Taxation of Home Hardening
summary: Exempts impact-resistant doors, garage doors, and windows from sales and use tax during a specified month, subject to qualifications.

title: Advanced Wastewater Treatment
summary: Requires certain sewage disposal facilities to submit annual reports to DEP, and DEP to report to the Governor and Legislature on advanced wastewater treatment.

title: School Safety
summary: Expands the school guardian program to child care facilities, requires sheriffs to set up guardian programs in some cases, and revises guardian firearm requirements.

title: Behavioral Health Intervention Services
summary: Authorizes, subject to appropriation, a Medicaid demonstration pilot in a specified region letting managed care plans offer behavioral health intervention services.

title: Public Records/School Security Guards
summary: Exempts certain information about school security guards held by state, local law enforcement, school districts, or charter schools from public records requirements, with future legislative review.

title: Required Instruction
summary: Requires schools to provide instruction on Hispanic contributions to the United States; the text is only a title and short summary.

title: Private Provider Building Inspection Services
summary: Requires building code and inspection boards to include private provider representatives and changes private provider inspection arrangements from written contracts to agreements.

title: Biosolids Management
summary: Bars the Department of Environmental Protection from issuing or renewing certain biosolids land application site permits when a qualifying higher-treatment septage facility exists.

title: Florida Museum of Black History
summary: Establishes the Florida Museum of Black History, sets its functions and locations, creates a governing board, and appropriates $1.5 million.

title: Homeowners’ Insurance Premium Discounts
summary: Requires residential property insurers to give premium reductions for claim-free periods and mitigation upgrades, bars storm claims from denying eligibility, and directs OIR rulemaking.

title: Patient Referrals by Medicaid Managed Care Organizations and Managed Care Plans
summary: Authorizes the Agency for Health Care Administration to review and investigate Medicaid managed care plans for improper patient referrals, and sets penalties.

title: Intellectual Freedom and Viewpoint Diversity
summary: Requires the State Board of Education to keep Florida College System institutions free from political influence and grants specified rights to students and faculty.

title: Legal Representation Contracts
summary: Bars the Department of Legal Affairs from certain contingency-fee attorney contracts until the Attorney General makes a written determination, then requires a request for proposals.

title: Temporary Licensure of Anesthesiologist Assistants
summary: Creates a temporary license pathway letting qualified applicants practice as anesthesiologist assistants, but only under an anesthesiologist's direct supervision.

title: Intestate Succession Involving Persons Born Out of Wedlock
summary: Revises the circumstances used to determine intestate inheritance for certain persons born out of wedlock.

title: Temporary Certificates for Practice in Areas of Critical Need
summary: Revises when medical and nursing boards may issue temporary practice certificates in critical-need areas and lets holders keep providing primary care after designation ends.

title: Education on Abusive Head Trauma
summary: Directs the Department of Health to adopt parent education materials on abusive head trauma and phase in their distribution.

title: Electric Utility 10-year Site Plans
summary: Revises electric utility 10-year site plan estimate requirements, sets a PSC final-order deadline, and lets the commission reject plans and require revisions.

title: Family Law Proceedings
summary: Requires court transcripts or audio recordings in certain family disputes, mandates written findings on certain allegations against parents, and creates a judicial circuit pilot project.

title: Fees/Florida Public Service Commission
summary: Raises the maximum administrative fee the Florida Public Service Commission may set to carry out its duties.

title: Elections Affected by Disasters
summary: Requires disaster-related election notices, Secretary of State impact assessments, equipment reserves, and lets certain disaster-affected voters receive vote-by-mail requests without the uniform application.

title: Structure and Legislative Oversight of Executive Agencies
summary: Requires that executive agency divisions, offices, bureaus, and similar units be created only by statute, and subjects certain agency appointments to legislative review and approval.

title: Booking Officer Duties Related to Minor Children of Arrested Persons
summary: Requires booking officers to ask arrested persons about their minor children and take certain actions to protect those children.

title: Children’s Medical Services Program
summary: Moves operation of the Children's Medical Services managed care plan from DOH to AHCA and requires clinical eligibility screening for certain children with special health care needs.

title: Required Notice of Intent to Contact a Victim
summary: Requires defense-side persons to file a standard notice before contacting a crime victim for specified purposes during a criminal proceeding.

title: Mental Health and Substance Abuse
summary: Lets a qualified professional, not only a psychiatrist, support guardian advocate petitions, restrict patient record access, and document consent for admission.

title: Instruction on Reproductive Health
summary: Requires district school boards to approve reproductive health teaching materials annually in open meetings, replacing Department of Education approval.

title: Public Records and Public Meetings/Hearings Relating to Mental Health and Substance Abuse
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Makes mental health and substance abuse hearings confidential and closed to the public, and exempts related records and petitions from public records requirements.

title: Insurance Coverage for Breast Cancer Screening
summary: Requires certain health insurance policies and plans to include minimum coverage for breast cancer screening and diagnosis.

title: State Renewable Energy Goals
summary: Bans oil and gas drilling and related structures in certain locations, sets statewide net zero emissions by a date, and directs a renewable energy plan.

title: Florida Museum of History
summary: Creates a Florida Museum of History advisory committee and local boards, and requires state funding for feasibility studies.

title: Services to Noncitizens
summary: Limits homeownership assistance eligibility to lawfully present persons, lets counties require lawful-presence proof, and requires all private employers to use E-Verify.

title: Community Associations
summary: Revises community association rules on condo records violations, electronic ballots, co-op turnover inspections (now for all buildings), and HOA records access.

title: Abandoning Restrained Dogs During Natural Disasters
summary: Creates criminal penalties for tethering a dog outside during a natural disaster and then abandoning it, under the name Trooper's Law.

title: Designation of the State Birds
summary: Designates the American flamingo as Florida's official state bird and the Florida scrub-jay as its state songbird.

title: Vacating Premises After Rental Agreement Termination
summary: Requires landlords to give certain tenants a specified time to vacate after a termination notice before filing an eviction-type action.

title: Estates
summary: Revises probate procedures, including court issues for personal representatives, attorney fee awards, summary administration, and the payment threshold for financial institutions.

title: Special Mobile Equipment
summary: Revises the definition of special mobile equipment and lets DOT issue mobile crane special blanket permits for certain purposes.

title: My Safe Florida Home Program
summary: Adds inspection and grant eligibility requirements to the My Safe Florida Home Program, revises allowable improvements and a report, and requires a DFS online dashboard.

title: Religious Expression and Classroom Requirements in K-12 Schools
summary: Protects religious expression for K-12 students and school personnel, bars school districts from discriminating based on religious viewpoints, and lets students pray and form religious clubs.

title: Insurance Customer Representative Licensing Qualifications
summary: Revises qualifications for insurance customer representative license applicants and requires the Department of Education to develop an insurance and personal finance course.

title: Failure to Comply with a Time-sharing Schedule
summary: Creates a civil cause of action against a parent who fails or refuses to follow a court-ordered time-sharing schedule, with affirmative defenses.

title: Civil Litigation
summary: Revises the criteria courts must consider when deciding whether money damage awards are excessive or inadequate.

title: Property Insurance Claims
summary: Creates a mandatory dispute-resolution procedure for property insurance claims, requires insurers to notify policyholders, and lets policyholders petition the Division of Administrative Hearings.

title: Maternal Health and Early Learning
summary: Creates the Motherhood Initiative, including a DOH home visit program for expectant mothers, reduced birthing center fees, blood pressure monitors, and doula or midwife presence at hospital births.

title: Department of Environmental Protection
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Deletes the Environmental Regulation Commission and requires certain larger residential properties in a defined area to connect to sewer or upgrade to nutrient-reducing septic systems.

title: Property Tax Exemption and Assessment Limitation on Long-term Leased Property
summary: Creates property tax exemptions for long-term leased property that meets eligibility rules, with an application requirement and specified assessment treatment for improvements.

title: Space Florida
summary: Lets Space Florida-authorized private lessees' property be treated as governmental and exempt from property tax, and exempts certain equipment leased to private entities from sales tax.

title: Anaphylaxis in Public and Charter Schools
summary: Requires school boards and charter governing boards to mandate anaphylaxis training for school personnel and keep student emergency action plans effective on campus.

title: Public Records and Meetings/Space Florida
summary: Creates public records and open meetings exemptions for Space Florida trade secrets, closes related board discussions, and sets legislative review and repeal of the exemptions.

title: Aerospace Industry
summary: Creates the International Aerospace Innovation Fund, administered by Space Florida, to fund aerospace projects through an application process.

title: Caller Identification Information
summary: Prohibits misleading or inaccurate caller ID transmission and requires telecom companies to provide call origin info and file STIR/SHAKEN certification with the FCC.

title: Activities of Special Districts
summary: Authorizes certain special districts to jointly enter into or establish specified joint relationships if they make a required determination.

title: Recess Requirements for Middle School Students
summary: Requires district school boards to provide a set amount of free-play recess weekly for students in grades 6 through 8.

title: Protection from Surgical Smoke
summary: Requires hospitals and ambulatory surgical centers to adopt and implement policies mandating smoke evacuation systems during certain surgical procedures.

title: Medicaid Provider Networks
summary: Requires Medicaid managed care plans and providers to negotiate payment rates and terms, sets minimum dentist payment rates, and adds network contract requirements.

title: Evidence of Damages to Prove Medical Expenses in Personal Injury or Wrongful Death Actions
summary: Sets rules on what evidence may be admitted to prove past and future medical expenses in personal injury and wrongful death lawsuits.

title: Affordable Housing Property Tax Exemption
summary: Revises a required taxing-authority finding for affordable housing exemptions and lets certain multifamily property owners apply for and keep the exemption.

title: Department of Financial Services
topics: Government and administration; Housing; Labor and employment
summary: Omnibus Department of Financial Services bill that revises funeral director endorsement licensing, requires carbon monoxide alarms on certain boilers, and creates a firefighter recruitment bonus program.

title: Security of State Information Technology Systems
summary: Requires state agencies to deploy certain cloud-native cybersecurity platforms and has the state CIO brief legislative committees by a set date.

title: Department of State
summary: Omnibus Department of State bill: repeals a commission fee, changes oath timing for commissions, revises library council duties, and adds arts council membership changes.

title: Practice of Chiropractic Medicine
summary: Expands chiropractors' scope to possess, prescribe and administer vitamins, supplements, homeopathic remedies and epinephrine, with Board certification required for injections.

title: Health Insurance Claims
summary: Bars insurer contracts from restricting physician payment methods and requires physician consent before electronic payments or ACH transfer fees.

title: Safety Design Standards for Office Surgery Suites
summary: Requires the Florida Building Commission and State Fire Marshal to adopt safety design standards for certain office surgery suites by a set date.

title: Educational Opportunities for Military Children
summary: Requires school district-military installation agreements to include a training module on military children's educational needs, which the Department of Education provides to district school boards.

title: Transferring Years of Creditable Service
summary: Requires the Department of Management Services to adopt rules creating a process for Florida Retirement System employees to transfer creditable service years to another member.

title: Smart Living Course
summary: Requires grade 8 students to complete a Smart Living Course for promotion and adds Smart Living as required stand-alone courses, changing diploma credit requirements.

title: Court Records of Eviction Proceedings
summary: Lets eviction defendants ask courts to seal eviction records and substitute their names on the progress docket under certain conditions.

title: Executive Branch
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Revises state government equal employment policies, repeals minority business enterprise contracting and certification provisions, changes Florida-business procurement preferences, and lets the Attorney General sue vendors.

title: Florida Public Service Commission
summary: Requires the Public Service Commission to boost utility transparency, bar certain cost recovery from ratepayers, cap allowed utility returns on equity, and add cost-sharing to fuel cost tracking.

title: Litigation Financing
summary: Requires courts to consider litigation funding conflicts and mandates disclosures on foreign and sovereign-wealth involvement, and voids certain financing agreements in specified cases.

title: Patient-directed Blood Donations
summary: Requires blood banks to honor licensed physicians' orders for directed or autologous donations for named patients, and lets providers charge administrative fees.

title: Cybersecurity
summary: Revises Florida Digital Service purposes and Cybersecurity Advisory Council membership, and requires local governments to report ransomware and certain cyber incidents within set deadlines.

title: Digital Voyeurism
summary: Revises the definition of "reasonable expectation of privacy" used in the digital voyeurism offense; the summary does not say whether scope widens or narrows.

title: Contracting with Foreign Countries of Concern
topics: AI and technology; Government and administration
summary: Bars governments from buying products from foreign countries of concern that hold ownership stakes in them, and removes a ban on contracts giving those entities personal data access.

title: Motor Vehicle Racing Penalties
summary: Increases penalties for violations of prohibitions on organizing or facilitating street races, drag races, street takeovers, and stunt driving.

title: Florida Commission on Human Relations
summary: Removes the requirement that the Florida Commission on Human Relations send certain information by registered mail; a procedural change.

title: Mobile Opportunity by Interstate Licensure Endorsement Act
summary: Revises which persons are ineligible for a license by endorsement under the interstate licensure act.

title: Physician Assistants
summary: Removes the physician's notice requirement for delegating prescribing authority to physician assistants and creates a registration path for PAs to practice without physician supervision.

title: Missing Endangered Persons
topics: AI and technology; Civil rights and liberties
summary: Lets hospitals disclose admitted patients' information to law enforcement and search records to match patients to the missing persons clearinghouse.

title: Coverage for Colorectal Cancer Screening and Diagnosis
summary: Requires individual and group health insurance policies to cover specified colorectal cancer screening tests, procedures, and examinations under certain circumstances.

title: Immigration
summary: Requires all private employers to use E-Verify for new hires and raises penalties, including license suspension and fines, for employing unauthorized workers.

title: Opticianry
summary: Removes opticians' ability to delegate certain acts to unlicensed support staff and deletes the licensure exception for employees working under physician or optometrist supervision.

title: Complaints Against Law Enforcement and Correctional Officers
summary: Requires sworn, signed complaints against officers to be copied to them before interrogation or personnel action, and waives names and signatures when corroborating evidence is attached.

title: Background Screening of Athletic Coaches
summary: Changes the date by which certain background screenings of athletic coaches must be conducted; the text is a short summary only.

title: Public Records/Commission on Ethics
summary: Creates a public records exemption shielding personal identifying and location information of Ethics Commission employees, commissioners, and their families, with future repeal review.

title: Florida Building Code
summary: Requires local governments to use excess building code fee funds for stormwater system repairs and limits state funds to those with unspent balances.

title: Affordable Housing
summary: Requires counties and cities to allow certain residential use on their own and school district property, extends land-use anti-discrimination rules to affordable housing, and waives sovereign immunity for housing discrimination claims.

title: Historical Records Concerning Enslaved Individuals
summary: Prohibits selling or trading historical records of enslaved individuals, with exceptions, penalties for violations, and Department of State compliance oversight.

title: Mobile Home Park Lot Tenancies
summary: Revises mobile home park lot tenancy rules, adding proof requirements for lot rent increases, limiting owner billing practices, and changing termination grounds and timelines.

title: Division of Labor Standards
summary: Creates a Division of Labor Standards in the Department of Commerce as the state's chief employee-protection agency and revises employee protected rights.

title: Experimental Treatments for Terminal Conditions and Life-threatening Rare Diseases
summary: Authorizes physicians and eligible facilities to prescribe and administer experimental treatments for terminal conditions and rare diseases, creates a patient registry, and requires manufacturers to provide a temporary price concession.

title: Public Safety
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Omnibus public safety bill creating a counterterrorism unit at FDLE, barring first responder employment discrimination, requiring unified county 911 systems, and creating valor medals.

title: Public Records/Experimental Treatment Outcomes
summary: Creates a public records exemption for certain information in a Department of Health report on experimental treatment outcomes and safety signals.

title: Special Elections
summary: Revises special election timing, vacancy-filling deadlines, resignation filing rules, and overseas vote-by-mail receipt deadlines.

title: Experimental Treatment Access Trust Fund/Department of Health
summary: Creates an Experimental Treatment Access Trust Fund in the Department of Health and lets licensed experimental treatment centers contribute to it or provide care at no cost.

title: Access to Historic Cemeteries
summary: Requires the state to hold an access easement across certain privately owned land to maintain historic cemeteries and conduct research.

title: Admissible Evidence in Personal Injury or Wrongful Death Actions
summary: Lets evidence admissible in personal injury or wrongful death suits be used to rebut, not just prove, certain damages, and be offered by any party.

title: Safe Waterways Act
summary: Requires local governments to report incidents affecting beach and public bathing water quality, and directs agencies to study and agree on transferring sampling duties.

title: Criminal Offenses Against Law Enforcement Officers and Other Personnel
summary: Increases punishments for resisting, assaulting, or killing law enforcement officers and other specified personnel, and names the act the Officer Jason Raynor Act.

title: Public Records/Florida Commission on Human Relations
summary: Exempts personal identifying and location information of certain Florida Commission on Human Relations personnel and commissioners, and their spouses and children, from public records law.

title: Medical Placement for High-acuity Children
summary: Requires considering high-acuity children's specific needs in placement decisions, revises Child Protection Team roles, and mandates medical screening for children removed from their homes.

title: Security Deposits
summary: Caps residential security deposits at the equivalent of one month's rent, limiting what landlords may collect before and during a tenancy.

title: Motor Vehicle Manufacturers, Importers, and Distributors and Franchised Motor Vehicle Dealers
summary: Lets motor vehicle manufacturers reject some dealer franchise succession and transfers, and caps distribution of certain vehicles to commonly owned dealers.

title: Thoroughbred Permitholders
summary: Lets thoroughbred permitholders opt out of live racing while keeping their permits, slot eligibility and transfer rights, and voids permits for certain tax nonpayment.

title: Emergencies
summary: Lets certain servicemembers provide medical care in specified emergencies, lets the Division of Emergency Management create local organizations, and sets division command over emergency efforts.

title: Local Government Finances
summary: Requires counties to post budgets longer, prepare quarterly compensation summaries, and meet new requirements for certain local impact fees.

title: Electronic Prescribing
summary: Revises which health care practitioners may electronically transmit prescriptions for certain drugs, and revises related exceptions.

title: Use of Digital Currency by the Department of Financial Services
summary: Creates a DFS pilot program letting the state accept payment stablecoins, with DFS examinations and audits of permitted stablecoin issuers and program monitoring.

title: Suits Against the Government
summary: Raises statutory tort liability caps for the state, its agencies and subdivisions, and lets subdivisions settle claims above the cap without legislative action.

title: Statewide Project for Missing Persons with Special Needs
summary: Amends the missing persons with special needs statewide project, routes it through autism and disability centers, and appropriates $1 million.

title: Adaptive Reuse of Land
summary: Requires counties and cities to allow certain uses for adaptive reuse projects, creates an initiative act, and has a council study parking reductions.

title: Department of Financial Services
summary: Creates the Florida Agency for Fiscal Oversight within DFS, requires local governments to notify it of certain referenda, adds whistleblower protections and training, and removes a hotline hours requirement.

title: Energy Infrastructure Investment
summary: Directs the Public Service Commission to create an experimental mechanism to facilitate certain utility gas infrastructure investments; the text is a brief summary.

title: Newborn Screenings
summary: Requires newborns to be screened for biliary atresia starting on a set date, with hospitals performing the screening under specified methods.

title: Cybersecurity Incident Liability
summary: Shields compliant local governments, covered entities and third-party agents from liability for cybersecurity incidents, and requires them to align programs with revised standards.

title: Residential Utility Disconnections
topics: Consumer protection and business; Environment and energy
summary: Bars electric, public and water utilities from disconnecting residential customers for nonpayment in specified circumstances, requires fee waivers, and mandates payment-assistance notices.

title: Coverage for Mammograms and Supplemental Breast Cancer Screenings
summary: Requires Medicaid coverage of annual mammograms and supplemental breast cancer screenings for eligible women, subject to funds, and revises private mammogram coverage rules.

title: Coverage for Diagnostic and Supplemental Breast Examinations
summary: Bars the state group insurance program from charging enrollees cost-sharing for diagnostic and supplemental breast examinations.

title: Pet Insurance
summary: Revises pet insurer disclosure requirements, bars agents from soliciting pet insurance or wellness products in certain circumstances, and adjusts agent training credit rules.

title: Infrastructure and Resiliency
summary: Gives the Department of Environmental Protection exclusive authority to run coastal resiliency projects via public-private partnerships and to encourage private investment.

title: Illegal Gaming
summary: Adds criminal penalties for betting on prearranged sports or game outcomes, lets slot licensees seek to move gaming areas, and revises gambling and commission employment rules.

title: Elections
summary: Authorizes DHSMV to preregister certain individuals to vote, revises third-party voter registration reporting, and repeals an Office of Election Crimes and Security provision.

title: Statewide Data Sharing of Secondhand Dealer and Pawnbroker Transactions
summary: Revises secondhand dealer and pawnbroker recordkeeping and reporting duties, requiring transaction information be shared with law enforcement for a statewide database.

title: Agents of Student Athletes
summary: Caps the percentage of a student athlete's name, image, or likeness income an agent may take and requires licensing for agents of high school athletes.

title: Fees/Agents of Student Athletes
summary: Requires agents who represent student athletes to pay a application fee to DBPR and an annual renewal fee.

title: Public Safety
summary: Requires counties and their public agencies to route 911 and dispatch services through a centralized call center, with local boards choosing the operator and funding.

title: Agency for Health Care Administration
summary: Deletes a state health advisory council and repeals Alzheimer's special-care provisions, requiring memory care providers to follow specified operating standards.

title: Legal Tender
summary: Ratifies specified legal tender rules so a prior 2025 law's effectiveness condition can be met; the summary describes no substantive policy change.

title: Educator Preparation
summary: Creates a Department of Education workgroup to revise the Florida Educator Accomplished Practices and sets core curricula guidelines for teacher preparation programs.

title: Sexual Assault Education and Support
summary: Requires school districts to appoint sexual assault response liaisons, creates a Department of Health grant program, and adds sexual assault prevention and consent to middle and high school health instruction.

title: Housing
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration; Housing
summary: Creates a housing and tenant rights department, rental agreement requirements, a junk-fee ban for renters, and bars evicting domestic violence victims.

title: Causes of Action Based on Improvements to Real Property
summary: Revises the statute of limitations for lawsuits over the design, planning, or construction of improvements to real property, including when the period starts.

title: Housing
summary: Revises eligibility for affordable housing property tax exemptions, allows adaptive reuse projects to qualify, and lets developments prepay future ad valorem taxes at permit issuance.

title: Veteran Benefit Payments to Minor Clients
summary: Lets DCF, DOH, or APD access certain veteran benefit payments for minor clients and bars them from supplanting other financial assistance.

title: Uniform Mitigation Verification Inspection Form
summary: Authorizes the Financial Services Commission to add flood mitigation criteria to the uniform mitigation verification inspection form.

title: Medical Malpractice Liability Coverage
summary: Raises the minimum professional liability coverage that certain physicians and osteopathic physicians must maintain as a condition of licensure.

title: Refund of Taxes for Residential Improvements Rendered Uninhabitable by a Catastrophic Event
summary: Provides a property tax refund for residential improvements made uninhabitable by a catastrophic event and changes the date appraisers must act on them.

title: Elections
summary: Lets eligible people register and vote during early voting or on Election Day, adds DHSMV preregistration, changes third-party registration reporting, and makes the Secretary of State elected.

title: Relief of the Estate of Danielle Maudsley by the Department of Highway Safety and Motor Vehicles
summary: Provides a $1.75 million appropriation to compensate the estate of Danielle Maudsley over a death allegedly caused by a state trooper's negligence.

title: Relief of Heriberto A. Sanchez-Mayen by the City of St. Petersburg
summary: Provides a $2.3 million appropriation to compensate Heriberto Sanchez-Mayen for injuries from St. Petersburg's alleged negligence, with limits on compensation and attorney fees.

title: Combatting Illegal Immigration
summary: Bars licensed money transmitters from sending foreign remittances unless they verify the sender is not an unauthorized alien, with recordkeeping requirements.

title: Public Accountancy
summary: Revises CPA license education and work experience requirements, lets the Board of Accountancy contract out certain Division duties, and changes ethics CE provider approval.

title: Emergency Residential Property Insurance Assistance Trust Fund/Department of Financial Services
summary: Creates a state trust fund within the Department of Financial Services to provide emergency financial assistance for residential property insurance.

title: Community Associations
summary: Bars condo associations from suspending voting rights during board recall votes, voids prior suspensions, and makes division arbitration binding with fee-shifting for prevailing owners.

title: Community-based Care Lead Agency Liability Insurance
topics: Children and families; Consumer protection and business
summary: Requires the Office of Insurance Regulation to review data and report on community-based care lead agency liability insurance, and lets regulators fine noncompliant insurers and lead agencies.

title: Health Care Patient Protection
summary: Requires hospital emergency departments to adopt pediatric emergency policies, training, weight recording and assessments, and requires AHCA to publish hospital assessment results.

title: Housing for Veterans
summary: Creates a pilot program offering landlords incentive funding for property management tied to housing veterans, subject to appropriation, in certain counties.

title: Corrections
summary: Limits prisoner lawsuits with a one-year filing deadline and exhaustion rule, and requires consecutive prison terms for multiple specified felonies.

title: Trust Funds/Vacancy Relief and Risk Mitigation Trust Fund
summary: Creates a trust fund within the Florida Housing Finance Corporation for vacancy relief and risk mitigation, with reversion and periodic review provisions.

title: Patient Access to Records
summary: Requires mental health and substance abuse providers to furnish records within set timeframes after patient requests, and revises nursing home record-access deadlines.

title: Serving as Personal Representative after a Felony Conviction
summary: Creates an exception letting a non-incarcerated person with a felony conviction serve as a personal representative of an estate if they have a specified relationship to the decedent.

title: Private Schools
summary: Allows a capped number of full-time virtual private school students to join the Family Empowerment Scholarship Program and adds orientation and online-contact requirements.

title: Assessment of Property with Decreasing Just Valuation
summary: Prohibits increasing a property's assessed valuation when its just value has decreased since the previous assessment.

title: Disclosure of Public Servants’ Personal Information
summary: Lets certain public employees and officials notify data brokers in writing to stop releasing their personal data and that of related persons, with civil liability for noncompliance.

title: Financial Services
summary: Financial services omnibus bill revising insurance export eligibility, state financial institution assessments, and credit union officer expense reimbursement.

title: Electronic Payments Made to Units of Local Governments
summary: Requires local governments to accept certain electronic payment forms, including online payments, with an exception. Limits local discretion over payment methods.

title: Expedited Service Fees
summary: Authorizes persons to request expedited services from the Department of State for a fee, per a specified manner.

title: Enforcement of the Florida Building Code
summary: Revises how local governments must spend excess building-permit funds and addresses enforcement of the Florida Building Code.

title: Fees/Expedited Services
summary: Sets filing fees for expedited services, specifies how those fees may be paid, and makes them nonrefundable.

title: Liability of Advanced Driving System Manufacturers and Developers
summary: Limits liability of manufacturers and developers of advanced driving systems for certain damages and claims, allowing punitive damages only in specified circumstances.

title: Education
summary: Removes school advisory council and apprenticeship diversity requirements, shifts apprenticeship language to underrepresented groups, and makes technical statutory changes.

title: Coordinated Access Model Pilot Program
summary: Requires DCF to contract for a Coordinated Access Model pilot program in Clay, Duval, and St. Johns Counties, with university subcontracts.

title: Consumer Finance Loans
summary: Prohibits persons from evading consumer finance loan rules under ch. 516, and makes loans made in violation void and uncollectible.

title: Protection from Surgical Smoke
summary: Requires hospitals and ambulatory surgical centers to adopt and implement policies preventing patient and staff exposure to harmful surgical smoke.

title: Mental Health and Substance Use Disorders
summary: Requires certain providers to use a specified assessment tool and facilities to update treatment plans on set timelines, and directs best-practice dissemination to grantees.

title: Public Education
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Gives school board members specified rights, makes certain board meeting documents public records, and bars districts from requiring employees to sign nondisclosure agreements.

title: Beaches
summary: Repeals the recreational customary-use beach provision, requires Board of Trustees to set the erosion control line by resolution in some cases, and lets DEP proceed with beach restoration projects.

title: Penalties for Late-filed Disclosures or Statements of Financial Interests
summary: Bars fining a reporting person for a first late financial disclosure or statement of financial interests if certain conditions are met.

title: Higher Education
summary: Omnibus higher education bill with mostly administrative changes, including tuition assistance for State Guard members and new cooperative agreements among Florida College System institutions.

title: Harassment and Cyberstalking
summary: Revises the statutory definitions of "harass" and "cyberstalk"; the summary gives no detail on how the changes alter penalties or obligations.

title: Child Welfare
summary: Child welfare bill letting DCF partner with military installations on family investigations, allowing custody under court orders, and setting a room-and-board rate methodology.

title: Rent Reporting to Credit Reporting Agencies
summary: Lets landlords report tenants' rent payment history to credit bureaus with written consent, and requires notice that tenants may opt out anytime without penalty.

title: Medicaid Pharmacy Services
summary: Removes the requirement that Medicaid managed care plans cover prescription drugs, shifting pharmacy reimbursement to fee-for-service set by the agency.

title: Net-zero Policies by Governmental Entities
summary: Bars governmental entities from adopting net-zero policies, spending funds on them, imposing related taxes or fees, and running cap-and-trade programs.

title: Electric Vehicle Battery Management
summary: Creates end-of-life requirements for electric vehicle propulsion batteries and prohibits disposing of specified batteries by landfilling.

title: Aging and Disability Services
summary: Revises aging and disability services: deletes expired Medicaid enrollment offer rules, shifts CARES assessments, sets area agency procurement rules, and prioritizes high-risk adults for CCE services.

title: Sudden Cardiac Arrest Treatment
summary: Requires the Department of Health to create an informational poster on treating sudden cardiac arrest and make it available electronically.

title: Ideologies Inconsistent with American Principles
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice
summary: Creates crimes for military training with or material support to designated domestic terrorist organizations, and lets the state administratively dissolve such corporations.

title: Voting Opportunities on Florida College System Institution and State University Campuses
summary: Requires Florida college and university campuses to establish early voting sites and polling places and publicize voting opportunities.

title: Public Records/Chief of Domestic Security
summary: Creates a public records exemption for information about the Chief of Domestic Security's designation of domestic or foreign terrorist organizations, with future legislative review and repeal.

title: Nurse Registries
summary: Deems nurse registry practitioners independent contractors for Medicaid reimbursement and makes them ineligible for overtime or holiday pay.

title: Big Cypress Basin
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Revises the Big Cypress Basin governing board membership and boundaries, and requires basin ad valorem tax revenue be used in a specified manner.

title: Medspas
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Defines "medspa" and requires medspas to publicly post information about their supervising physician on their website and in their facility.

title: Prohibitions Against Discriminatory Practices Relating to 340B Entities and 340B Drugs
summary: Bars drug manufacturers, insurers and PBMs from discriminatory acts against 340B entities and their 340B drug acquisition, delivery and reimbursement.

title: Vessel Accountability
summary: Creates penalties for anchoring or mooring vessels in state waters under specified conditions and requires a free long-term anchoring permit through an electronic system.

title: Civil Liability for the Wrongful Death of an Unborn Child
summary: Allows parents to sue for wrongful death of an unborn child, while barring such suits against the mother or against providers for lawful medical care.

title: Public Records/Lethality Assessment Forms
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice
summary: Exempts domestic violence lethality assessment forms from public records requirements, allows sharing with domestic violence centers and state attorneys, and sets future review and repeal.

title: Medicaid Dental Pilot Program for Persons with Disabilities
summary: Creates a Medicaid dental pilot program in a specified region offering enhanced dental services to persons with disabilities, with specified provider reimbursement and data collection.

title: High-speed Broadband Development Incentives
topics: AI and technology; Taxes and budget
summary: Creates a state-funded broadband grant program under the Office of Broadband, prioritizes certain partners, and authorizes tax credits for farmers in underserved communities.

title: Gender Identity Employment Practices
summary: Bars certain employers from requiring employees to use pronouns that don't match their sex, from listing gender-identity options on forms, and from mandating certain training.

title: Emergency Services
summary: Omnibus emergency services bill: removes a cap on warning lights for certain vehicles, revises a certificate exemption, and penalizes fraudulent affidavits.

title: Interpersonal Violence Injunctions
summary: Revises domestic violence and stalking injunction procedures, including forms, court factors, a ban on mutual protective orders, and expedited stalking hearings.

title: Water Quality Improvements
summary: Requires a lead-in-drinking-water study at certain public facilities and directs DEP and the St. Johns River district to prioritize water quality projects.

title: Educational Facilities
summary: Revises the school facilities funding formula for remodeling, maintenance and repairs, prioritizes funds for unsafe conditions, and adds design review and contingency contracting provisions.

title: First in Your Family Florida Medical School Scholarship and Grant Program
summary: Creates a First in Your Family medical school scholarship and grant program within the Department of Education, funded with a $10 million appropriation.

title: Access to Applied Behavior Analysis Services
summary: Requires Medicaid managed care plans to ensure network adequacy and credentialing transparency for ABA providers and bars moratoriums on ABA providers unless specified criteria are met.

title: Vexatious Litigants
summary: Expands the actions covered by Florida's vexatious litigant law, revises designation eligibility, and bars clerks from accepting certain filings from designated litigants.

title: Public Records/Commission on Ethics
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Creates a public records exemption for information the Ethics Commission receives or derives from its investigations, with future legislative review and repeal.

title: Public Records/Pleading, Request for Relief, or Other Document Stricken by a Court
summary: Creates a public records exemption for matters in court filings that a court has struck in noncriminal cases, if the court makes specific findings.

title: Terminology Associated with Autism
summary: Revises the statutory definition of the term 'autism' and related terminology; the summary describes no change to services, coverage or rules.

title: Registration of Sexual Predators and Sexual Offenders
summary: Revises reporting and verification requirements for registered sexual predators and sexual offenders; the summary gives no detail on direction.

title: Cooling Towers
summary: Requires owners of cooling towers, domestic water tanks and disinfection systems to register with the Department of Health, report information, and notify health officials and the public under certain circumstances.

title: Insurance Regulations
summary: Adds rate-filing limits and transparency reporting for residential property insurers, and makes several other procedural insurance changes.

title: Designation of the Official State Flagship
summary: Redesignates Florida's official state flagship as the S.S. American Victory, a naming change with no policy effect.

title: Public Records/Uniform Mitigation Verification Inspection Form Database
summary: Creates a public records exemption for certain data entered into the uniform mitigation verification inspection form database, with future legislative review.

title: Cattle Grazing on State Land
summary: Requires land managers to consider leasing state land for private cattle grazing when updating management plans, and to allow such leases under certain conditions.

title: Administrative Efficiency in Public Schools
summary: Makes various administrative changes to Florida K-12 schools, including removing an internal auditor requirement, setting advanced-degree pay rules, and revising teacher apprenticeship and diploma assessment rules.

title: Parental Rights
summary: Requires parental consent for certain minor treatments, repeals minors' access to outpatient crisis services, and requires schools to notify parents before student questionnaires.

title: Prostitution and Related Acts
summary: Bill expands prostitution-related prohibitions, including penalties for owning or renting premises known to be used for commercial sex, and repeals a coercion provision.

title: Responsible Firearm Safety Awareness Month
summary: Designates June as Responsible Firearm Safety Awareness Month and encourages agencies and organizations to sponsor related events.

title: Transportation
summary: Creates a transportation research institute, makes spaceport and shipbuilding projects grant-eligible, lets DOT fund infrastructure, and requires airports to offer DOT emergency use of property.

title: Prohibited Preferences
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Bars state agencies from using racial or gender set-asides, preferences, or quotas, revises local bid factors, and removes minority representation requirements.

title: Local Option Taxes
summary: Requires specified local option taxes to have expiration dates and be renewed or reenacted by ordinance or voter approval.

title: Property Insurer Financial Strength Ratings
summary: Requires the Office of Insurance Regulation to include property insurers' financial strength ratings in annual reports and to maintain and provide that rating information on request.

title: Uniform Commercial Code
summary: Adopts a Uniform Commercial Code article on controllable electronic records, setting rules for control, qualifying purchasers, account debtor discharge, and perfection of security interests.

title: Department of Business and Professional Regulation
summary: Omnibus DBPR bill making technical changes, including dropping a required criminal-record review for cosmetology applicants and renaming and reorganizing boards and councils.

title: Immigration and State-issued Identification
summary: Creates an Office for New Americans, deletes the state E-Verify mandate for private employers, and bars discrimination based on non-REAL ID driver licenses.

title: Florida Birth-Related Neurological Injury Compensation Association
summary: Revises the birth-injury compensation plan, including Medicaid cost recovery, eligible benefits, assessments, and a new family health coverage requirement.

title: Statewide Health Care Coverage
summary: Creates a task force to study universal health care and recommend a Health Care for All Florida Plan design, with a $1.17 million appropriation.

title: Specialty License Plates/Outsider License Plate
summary: Directs the Department of Highway Safety and Motor Vehicles to develop an Outsider specialty license plate and distribute its sale fees.

title: Labor Pool Act
summary: Repeals the Labor Pool Act's provisions on definitions, duties and rights, and remedies; the summary gives no replacement details.

title: Tax Credits for Contributions to Assist Homebuyers
summary: Creates a tax credit for contributions made to employees' or programs' homebuyer expenses, capped and approved first-come, first-served by the Department of Revenue.

title: Unrated Bonds
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Prohibits local governments from requiring minimum bond ratings for certain investments, limiting their authority over investment rules.

title: K-12 School Lunches and Breakfasts
summary: Requires K-12 public schools to participate in the National School Lunch and School Breakfast programs, sets meal provision rules, and bars third-party debt collectors for meal payments.

title: Diabetes Management
summary: Lets pharmacists prescribe and dispense 30-day diabetes drug and device supplies, requires insurers to cover diabetes testing and screening, and adds dispenser reporting to health records.

title: Advanced Education Options
summary: Creates an advanced education options supplement for students with specified diplomas, passing scores, exams, or courses, and requires dual enrollment and private school articulation agreements.

title: Entities that Boycott Israel
summary: Requires public funds to identify and list entities boycotting Israel for possible divestment, and requires grant applicants to certify they will not engage in antisemitic discrimination or speech.

title: THC-infused Beverages
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice
summary: Lets active alcoholic beverage licensees sell THC-infused beverages at retail and bars everyone else from selling or distributing them.

title: Mental Health
summary: Expands mental health diversion grants and training, adds veterans treatment courts and Hillsborough County to the forensic diversion pilot; appropriates $794,880.

title: Public Nuisances
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice
summary: Adds gambling house sites to places that may be declared public nuisances and removes the cap on total fines for public nuisances.

title: Deactivation from Transportation Network Company Digital Networks
summary: Limits when transportation network companies may deactivate drivers, and requires them to adopt a deactivation policy and an appeal process with timelines.

title: Surrogacy and Assisted Reproduction
summary: Adds surrogacy-agency requirements, including mental health evaluations and level 2 background checks for participants, limits preplanned adoption arrangements, and orders AHCA rules for donor banks and fertility clinics.

title: First Responders
summary: Defines the term 'first responder' and redefines 'public agency' and 'public safety agency'; the summary describes no substantive change.

title: Local Administration of Vessel Restrictions
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Lets counties and cities adopt ordinances and designate code officers to enforce vessel anchoring, derelict vessel, and migrant vessel rules with FWC.

title: Parkinson’s Disease Registry
summary: Requires physicians and advanced practice nurses to report Parkinson's data to a statewide registry maintained by USF's Institute, subject to appropriation.

title: Medical Coverage Assistance Program For Working Individuals With Disabilities
summary: Creates a Medicaid buy-in program letting working people with disabilities purchase Medicaid coverage, contingent on federal approval, with AHCA setting income eligibility.

title: Public Records/Parkinson’s Disease Registry
summary: Creates a public records exemption for certain records and personal identifying information submitted to the Parkinson's Disease Registry, with future legislative review and repeal.

title: Education
summary: Modifies education rules on internship counseling, a strategic plan, and how Gold Seal CAPE Scholars award amounts are calculated, excluding a transportation access fee.

title: Penalties for Prostitution and Related Acts
summary: Revises penalties and criminal penalties for prostitution and related offenses; the summary does not state whether they increase or decrease.

title: Surrendered Infants
summary: Authorizes hospitals, EMS stations, and fire stations to use infant safety devices to accept surrendered infants, with monitoring and testing requirements.

title: Child Care and Early Learning Services
topics: Children and families; Consumer protection and business
summary: Revises child care information requirements, drops annual parent notices for family child care homes, sets minimum standards for some exempt facilities, and bars residential property policies from covering large family child care home operations liability.

title: Material that is Harmful to Minors
summary: Revises the definition of 'harmful to minors' and the list of classroom materials subject to parent and resident objection.

title: Materials Harmful to Minors
summary: Revises the list of classroom materials subject to parent or resident objection and defines 'harmful to minors'; the summary gives no detail on the effect.

title: Prohibited Preferences in Government Contracting
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Bans government awarding bodies from giving contracting preferences by race or ethnicity and repeals minority business set-asides and the Office of Supplier Diversity.
