title: Technology Education
summary: Requires general education core courses with a technology component and adds artificial intelligence instruction to high school computer science courses.

title: Prearranged Transportation Services
summary: Prohibits impersonating a rideshare (TNC) driver, exempts prearranged TNC services from bus-transit classification, and requires providers to give drivers training materials.

title: Advanced Nuclear Reactors
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Gives the Public Service Commission sole authority to regulate advanced nuclear reactors and sets lab certification and utility site-plan criteria.

title: Certificates of Completion
summary: Deletes provisions awarding certificates of completion to certain students and revises eligibility criteria for certificate career education programs.

title: Notice Requirements for Certain Employers to their Employees
summary: Lets certain employers, employment agencies, and labor organizations satisfy employee notice duties by posting the required information online in an accessible way.

title: Quality of Care in Nursing Homes
summary: Revises nursing home quality-of-care rules: consumer satisfaction surveys, medical director qualifications, biennial safety culture surveys, and health information exchange data sharing.

title: Emergency Relief
summary: Creates the People's Relief Program within DCF to provide grants to eligible residents under specified conditions.

title: End-of-life Options
summary: Creates the Florida End-of-Life Options Act, letting qualified terminally ill patients request prescribed medication to end their lives, with physician duties and disposal rules.

title: Recovery of Damages for Medical Negligence Resulting in Death
summary: Deletes a provision that barred certain persons from recovering damages for medical negligence resulting in death, expanding wrongful-death recovery.

title: Education
summary: Omnibus education bill covering school bus trespass notice, private school construction, charter monitoring, virtual student athletics, and a statewide school cell phone ban pilot.

title: Employer Immunity from Civil Liability
summary: Grants employers immunity from civil liability for certain actions against current or prospective employees; the text gives no detail on the circumstances.

title: Utility Services
summary: Bill limits local utility agreements and municipal utility revenue use, and bars local governments from restricting certain energy appliances and fuel sources.

title: Charter School Funding
summary: Provides local funding sources for certain charter schools, bars districts from delaying payments to them, exempts their facilities from some fees, and revises capital outlay eligibility.

title: Warehouse Distribution Centers
summary: Requires certain warehouse employers to form and run safety committees, give employees written job descriptions, keep employee records, and provide information on request.

title: My Safe Florida Condominium Pilot Program
summary: Revises eligibility for the My Safe Florida Condominium Pilot Program, adds household income verification, and limits how grant funds are awarded to condo associations.

title: Education
summary: Lets schools of hope colocate in certain public school facilities, bars rent or lease fees charged to them, and counts their students in district calculations.

title: Veterinary Licensure
summary: Changes veterinary licensure by endorsement: drops the prior-license duration requirement and requires applicants to hold a current, active, good-standing license elsewhere.

title: Prohibitions and Limitations on Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion and Requirements for Medical Institutions of Higher Education
summary: Bars state agencies from funding DEI offices, requires grant and contract certifications, and sets DEI limits and requirements for medical higher-education institutions.

title: Office of the Department of Corrections Ombudsperson
summary: Creates a corrections ombudsperson office with subpoena power, periodic facility inspections, a family complaint form, and a $1.5 million appropriation.

title: Florida Hurricane Catastrophe Fund and Reinsurance Assistance
summary: Adjusts Florida Hurricane Catastrophe Fund reinsurance parameters, making some formulas and RAP coverage purchases optional and revising FORA coverage layers.

title: Statewide Counterintelligence and Counterterrorism Unit
summary: Creates a Statewide Counterintelligence and Counterterrorism Unit within FDLE, with teams aligned to each regional domestic security task force.

title: Local Housing Assistance Plans
summary: Lets counties and cities use local housing aid funds for mobile home lot rent assistance and related home repairs, and adds this to required housing plans.

title: Sale and Delivery of Firearms
summary: Removes state prohibitions on people under a certain age buying firearms and on licensed persons selling or transferring firearms to them.

title: Dispute Resolutions Involving Citizens Property Insurance Corporation
summary: Deletes statutory provisions authorizing dispute resolution of Citizens Property Insurance Corporation claim determinations in Division of Administrative Hearings proceedings.

title: Harm to Minors
summary: Requires smartphone and tablet makers to enable a content filter upon activation in Florida and increases criminal penalties for luring children.

title: Educator Preparation and Certification
summary: Revises Florida educator certification rules, including temporary certificates for some holders of expired certificates, and reinstatement of subject endorsements, plus Anchin Center collaboration.

title: Health Care Practitioner Specialty Titles and Designations
summary: Bans non-physicians from using specialty physician titles, treating such use as unlicensed practice of medicine and enabling Department of Health enforcement.

title: Pregnant Women In Custody
summary: Requires pregnancy tests on request for arrested women held over 72 hours, notice of that right at booking, and court factors for stays of incarceration.

title: Exemption of Assets
summary: Creates a "homeowner savings plan" and exempts certain moneys held in it from specified legal processes such as creditor claims.

title: Public School Personnel Compensation
summary: Lets public school employees with direct student contact receive cost-of-living raises, removes a limit on those adjustments, and revises the advanced-degree rule for salary schedules.

title: Acupuncture
summary: Revises acupuncturist licensure and continuing education requirements and bars unlicensed people from using acupuncture titles or letters.

title: Application Stores
topics: AI and technology; Children and families
summary: Requires app store providers to verify users' ages, obtain parental consent for minors' accounts, protect personal information, and allows private lawsuits for violations.

title: Access to Veterans Treatment Court Programs
summary: Removes the state attorney application and eligibility review for veterans treatment courts and lets more defendants, including post-adjudication, enter the program.

title: Utility Services
summary: Requires written, public-meeting-approved agreements for municipal utility service outside city limits, revises outside-customer rates, and mandates annual reporting to the Public Service Commission.

title: Higher Education
summary: Sets citizenship and residency rules for university trustees and Board of Governors members, adds financial disclosure for some governors, and revises board term limits and approval roles.

title: Housing
summary: Lets local governments adopt rent control and create land bank programs, and creates an Affordable Housing Construction Loan Program.

title: Uterine Fibroid Research Database
summary: Adds uterine fibroids to the Department of Health's disease list for a research database and removes the ban on including personal identifying information in it.

title: Licensure of Medical Spas
summary: Creates the Medical Spa Prescription Drug Oversight Act, requiring certain medical spas to be licensed, publishing a licensee database, and authorizing Board of Pharmacy inspections and penalties.

title: Affordable Housing
summary: Lets local governments approve affordable housing on religious-institution parcels and requires counties and cities to allow multifamily and mixed-use housing in flexibly zoned areas.

title: Child Welfare
summary: Creates emergency custody and visitation hearing procedures, revises the domestic violence definition, and bars infringing parents' custody or visitation rights without due process and a court order.

title: Criminal Justice
summary: Creates criminal penalties for adults who cause, encourage or contribute to minors committing offenses, including certain animal cruelty violations.

title: Blood Testing Required Following Civilian-involved Shootings
summary: Requires a civilian who discharges a firearm in Florida causing injury or death to submit to a blood test within a set time, with penalties for refusal.

title: Florida Kratom Consumer Protection Act
summary: Creates a regulatory framework for kratom products, requiring processor permits, FDA registration, product standards, and bans on mixing kratom beverages with alcohol or drugs, with a $3.7 million appropriation.

title: Juvenile Justice
summary: Authorizes medals for juvenile detention and probation officers, expands the statutory definition of "officer" to include them, and requires DJJ to review county detention payments.

title: Insulin Administration by Direct-support Professionals and Relatives
summary: Lets direct-support professionals and relatives in developmental disability group homes administer prescribed insulin to clients if specified conditions are met.

title: Political Activity at Public Institutions of Higher Education
summary: Requires public colleges to promote debates and candidate-related actions, and requires outside groups to get prior approval before political activity on campus.

title: Transportation Concurrency
summary: Revises which transportation facilities must be identified in the capital improvements element of comprehensive plans that impose transportation concurrency.

title: Educational Facilities
summary: Directs the Office of Educational Facilities and Office of Safe Schools to collaborate with specified entities to review state requirements for educational facilities.

title: Transportation Facility Designations/Charlie Kirk Memorial Avenue
summary: Designates a transportation facility in a specified county as Charlie Kirk Memorial Avenue and directs DOT to erect markers.

title: Insurance
summary: Omnibus insurance bill that adds limits on My Safe Florida Home grants, changes insurer surplus requirements, bars certain insolvent-insurer and reciprocal-insurer officials, and restricts waiver requests on rate filings.

title: Craft Brewing
summary: Lets licensed craft breweries hold tastings and sales at certain events, drops the manufacturer surety bond requirement, and revises a license tax and contract brewer transfer rules.

title: Condominium and Cooperative Associations
summary: Tightens community association manager rules by barring revoked licensees from firm ownership and unlawful acts, allows remote board meetings, and appropriates $250,000.

title: Indecent Exposure of Sexual Organs While Observing a Child
summary: Creates a crime for intentionally exposing sexual organs lewdly or performing specified sexual acts while observing a child under 16, with criminal penalties, and repeals the unnatural and lascivious acts provision.

title: Toxic Chemicals in Cosmetic Products
summary: Prohibits, starting on a specified date, the manufacture, sale or distribution of cosmetics containing specified added toxic chemicals, and requires DBPR to publish related determinations.

title: Official Records of Condominium Associations, Residential Cooperative Associations, and Homeowners’ Associations
summary: Lets condo, co-op and homeowners' associations hold meetings and elections by audioconference, and adds audio conference recordings to required official records.

title: Property Insurance Policies
summary: Lets insurers offer property policies with roof covering reimbursement schedules, but bars applying those schedules in certain circumstances.

title: Pricing Based on Collection of Consumer Information
summary: Declares surveillance pricing unlawful and requires a clear disclosure on advertised or published surveillance-priced offers, with penalties.

title: Alcohol Consumption
summary: Lets the alcohol division weigh vendors' electronic ID scanner use when mitigating penalties, and requires police to refer impaired-driving crash reports to the division.

title: Evidence in Civil Actions Relating to Firearms
summary: Bars using the absence of certain firearm safety mechanisms or features as evidence of defective design, negligence, or failure to warn in civil suits.

title: First Responders
summary: Renames the EMS Trust Fund as the First Responders Trust Fund and allows its money to fund grants for first responder mental health.

title: Sexual Offenses
summary: Increases criminal penalties and mandatory minimum sentences for certain sexual offenses, including child sexual performance and transmitting child pornography.

title: Comprehensive Health Care for Residents
summary: Creates a state-run Florida Health Plan with eligibility and coverage rules, a Florida Health Board, provider choice, and a patient advocacy ombudsman office.

title: Suicide and Drug Overdose Prevention
summary: Creates Department of Health committees to review drug overdose and suicide deaths and report annually to the department and a drug policy council.

title: Florida Museum of History at the Town of Eatonville
summary: Authorizes a partnership to design, build, and operate a Florida Museum of History in Eatonville, with a governing board and marketing plan.

title: Public Records and Meetings/Drug Overdose Death Review Committee/Suicide Death Review Committee
summary: Creates public records and public meetings exemptions for confidential information held by overdose and suicide death review committees, with future legislative review and repeal.

title: Medical Freedom
summary: Bans vaccine makers from paying incentives for vaccine administration and requires practitioners to give parents specified materials before vaccinating minors.

title: Restrictive Housing in Prisons
summary: Requires OPPAGA to conduct an annual study on restrictive housing in Florida prisons.

title: Public Assistance
summary: Requires Florida to seek federal approval for Medicaid work requirements for able-bodied adults and expands Medicaid drug preferred-list and claims-audit authority.

title: Assessment of Homestead Property
summary: Requires that homestead improvements made to replace or elevate property be assessed in a specified manner, with appraiser evidence rules.

title: Public Postsecondary Education Safety Policies and Procedures
summary: Requires state universities and Florida College System institutions to adopt, implement and annually review campus safety policies and procedures.

title: Public Officers and Employees
summary: Requires state executive appointees and Board of Governors members to be U.S. citizens and state residents, and bars career service employees from using their positions for specified purposes.

title: Health Care Coverage
summary: Tightens pharmacy benefit manager rules and contracts, creates a Medicaid oversight committee, and adds managed care affiliation and encounter data reporting.

title: Local Government Salaries and Benefits
summary: Changes county commissioner salary calculations and requires a referendum before a municipal governing body can raise its members' pay or benefits.

title: Criminal Justice Commission
summary: Creates a Criminal Justice Commission within the Department of Corrections, with membership, terms, and reporting duties; the text does not describe substantive policy changes.

title: Public Records/Public Employees Relations Commission
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Creates public records exemptions for certain Public Employees Relations Commission communications and personnel identifying and location information, with future repeal review.

title: Public Employees Relations Commission
summary: Modernizes Public Employees Relations Commission procedures, allowing service by any method proving delivery and removing some filing and written-service requirements, and sets commissioner salaries.

title: Stem Cell Therapy
summary: Authorizes physicians to perform non-FDA-approved stem cell therapy under certain conditions, with advertising notice and signed patient consent requirements.

title: Duties of a Real Estate Licensee
summary: Revises real estate licensees' duties when representing buyers, sellers, or both, and defines limited confidentiality.

title: Guaranteed Income Programs
summary: Prohibits local governments from adopting or enforcing guaranteed income programs and lets the Attorney General issue cease and desist orders to violators.

title: Rebuttable Presumption for Certain Deaths
summary: Creates a rebuttable presumption that an alleged victim's death resulted from a controlled substance under specified circumstances.

title: Employment Rights
summary: Revises the independent contractor definition, raises employees' proof standard for retaliation claims, and makes attorney fees mandatory for the prevailing party.

title: Redemption Rights and Deeds in Lieu of Foreclosure
summary: Makes redemption rights non-waivable, lets parties cure a debtor's default to stop a sale, and bars mortgagees from acquiring title through deeds in lieu of foreclosure.

title: Agronomic Study on Emerging Crops
summary: Requires Florida A&M University to study emerging crops, subject to appropriation, and report findings to the Governor and Legislature.

title: Athletics in Public K-12 Schools
summary: Lets high school athletic association bylaws allow coaches to use personal funds for student welfare benefits, presumed not impermissible, with reporting.

title: Early Education Workforce Support
summary: Creates a time-limited Early Education Workforce Support Pilot Program within the Department of Education, with dedicated funding and provider responsibilities.

title: Dangerous Excessive Speeding
summary: Defines dangerous excessive speeding, allows driver's license revocation after a second or later conviction, and changes citation civil-penalty indication rules.

title: Sewer Collection Systems
summary: Authorizes municipalities to use certain funds for a specified purpose related to sewer collection systems; details are not in the text.

title: Parole for Long-term Prisoners
summary: Makes certain long-term prison sentences parole-eligible under specified circumstances, sets parole conditions, and directs how resulting savings are used.

title: Door Alarms for Multifamily Residential Properties
summary: Requires certain multifamily properties to install and maintain door alarms on specified doors, inspected annually, enforced by DBPR.

title: Court Records of Eviction Proceedings
summary: Lets eviction defendants ask courts to seal eviction records and substitute their names on the progress docket, subject to eligibility limits.

title: Dry Sandy Beaches
topics: Environment and energy; Taxes and budget
summary: Revises conservation land definitions, tax exemption requirements, and a statewide land plan goal, and creates a pilot inventory of dry sandy beaches.

title: Public Records/Pawnbroker Transactions
summary: Expands the public records exemption for pawnbroker transaction records delivered to the Department of Law Enforcement, and sets future legislative review and repeal.

title: Criminal Justice Accountability
summary: Lets the Attorney General take certain cases from state attorneys on the Governor's request, revises trust fund use, and makes the AG a permanent Justice Administrative Commission member.

title: Siblings Placed in Out-of-home Care
summary: Requires courts to hold hearings and take evidence when sibling visitation or contact motions are contested, and keeps jurisdiction over certain permanently guardianship-placed children for sibling visitation.

title: Health Care During a Declared Emergency
summary: Requires certain health insurers to adopt specified emergency policies and lets state regulators extend policy time periods during declared emergencies.

title: Relief of H.H. by the Department of Children and Families
summary: Appropriates $14,926,640 to compensate H.H. for injuries caused by Department of Children and Families negligence, with limits on fees and compensation.

title: Relief of the Estate of M.N. by the Broward County Sheriff’s Office
summary: Provides a $2,588,259 appropriation to compensate the estate of M.N. for injuries and death caused by Broward Sheriff's Office negligence, with limits on fees.

title: Petition Process
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Revises petition rules: AG advisory-opinion criteria, a uniform candidate petition form, and political committee registration for initiative sponsors before circulating petitions.

title: Emergencies
summary: Bars certain local governments from adopting cumulative substantial-improvement repair ordinances and limits impact fees on specified replacement structures, among other emergency provisions.

title: Sale, Transfer, and Storage of Firearms
summary: Revises Florida's firearm storage rules, including criminal negligence standards, the minor-access exception, and the definition of minor, with criminal penalties.

title: Parkinson’s Disease
summary: Creates a Parkinson's disease research consortium at USF and a board that directs and awards research funds, with an indeterminate appropriation.

title: Public Records/Parkinson’s Disease Research Program Registry
summary: Creates a public records exemption keeping background information on individuals served by the Parkinson's Disease Research Program Registry confidential, subject to future review and repeal.

title: Capital Human Trafficking of Vulnerable Persons for Sexual Exploitation
summary: Adds capital human trafficking penalties for exploiting vulnerable persons, requires sexual predator designation on conviction, and makes certain recorded confessions admissible at trial.

title: Guardianship of Property
summary: Requires property guardians to file quarterly rather than annual accounting reports and lets certain guardians submit monthly bank statements; the court appoints an appraiser for the ward's property.

title: Refund of Overpayments Made by Patients
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Requires health care facilities and practitioners to refund patient overpayments within a set timeframe, with administrative fines and expanded disciplinary grounds for violations.

title: Ownership of Single-family Residential Property by Business Entities
summary: Prohibits certain business entities from buying single-family homes and then leasing or renting them, and shields sellers from liability for certain violations.

title: Derelict Vessels
summary: Revises when officers may deem a vessel at risk of becoming derelict, where required notices are placed, and the definition of derelict vessel.

title: Custodial Interrogations of Minors
summary: Limits when law enforcement officers and school employees may conduct custodial interrogations of minors, permitting them only under specified circumstances.

title: Protection of Historic Monuments and Memorials
summary: Preempts local governments from removing or damaging historic monuments, voids conflicting local ordinances and official actions, and bars public funds for defending unlawful conduct.

title: Craft Breweries
summary: Lets craft breweries transfer contract-made alcoholic beverages to licensed facilities and transport beer in company or disclosed vehicles, and requires written distributor agreements.

title: Tax Credits for Charitable Contributions
summary: Creates Home Away From Home tax credits against several Florida taxes for charitable contributions, with a $208,000 appropriation.

title: Education
summary: Bars certain charter schools from dismissing students for academic performance, requires cursive instruction in specified grades, and creates a teacher training and mentoring program.

title: Motor Vehicle Manufacturers and Franchised Motor Vehicle Dealers
summary: Restricts motor vehicle manufacturers from using certain sales or service performance criteria against franchised dealers and revises when franchise terminations count as unfair.

title: Waste Management
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Preempts local regulation of auxiliary containers, allows beach-specific glass container limits, and bars certain solid waste facility construction permits in listed counties.

title: Fleeing or Attempting to Elude a Law Enforcement Officer
summary: Authorizes law enforcement to impound vehicles driven by people who willfully flee or attempt to elude officers, with notice and release requirements.

title: Ultra-processed Food
summary: Bars public schools from serving or selling ultra-processed food during the school day and limits USDA-driven federal cafeteria guideline mandates.

title: Trespass
summary: Creates enhanced criminal penalties for trespassing on law enforcement-secured property with posted notice, and bars unauthorized entry into ticketed event venues.

title: Dog Breeding
summary: Requires dog breeders to obtain state registration and facility inspection certificates from the Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services, and presumes breeding use for certain female dogs.

title: Fees/Dog Breeders
summary: Requires dog breeders to pay registration and annual renewal fees, with amounts set by the Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services, subject to a limit.

title: Dog Breeders Trust Fund/Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Creates a Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services trust fund for dog breeders, keeps its year-end balance in the fund, and provides for future review or termination.

title: Gaming Control
summary: Revises Florida Gaming Control Commission authority, removes a premises ban on minors placing bets, bans advertising illegal gambling, and deletes a slot-machine presumption.

title: Tampering With, Harassing, or Retaliating Against Court Officials
summary: Creates new criminal penalties for knowingly threatening, harassing, or retaliating against specified court officials and personnel.

title: Housing
summary: Requires local governments to adopt accessory dwelling unit ordinances by a set date, and adds landlord screening, density bonus, and study provisions.

title: Seaport Security
summary: Requires seaports to staff a 24/7 onsite fire station, certified hazmat response teams, and a set number of operational fireboats.

title: Attorney Fees and Costs for Motor Vehicle Personal Injury Protection Benefits
summary: Makes prevailing parties in certain provider suits over overdue motor vehicle PIP medical benefits entitled to reasonable attorney fees and costs.

title: Health Care Provider Referrals
summary: Requires certain health care providers to disclose specified information in writing to patients before making a referral for certain services.

title: Safe Storage of Firearms and Ammunition in Motor Vehicles and Vessels
summary: Requires people who store or leave firearms or ammunition in vehicles or vessels they control to lock them inside specified compartments when unattended, with criminal penalties.

title: Student Health and Safety
summary: Revises school epilepsy and seizure care rules, including seizure action plans, required staff training, the definition of school, and approved posters.

title: Possession or Use of a Firearm in a Sensitive Location
summary: Prohibits possessing or using a firearm in sensitive locations, with criminal penalties and listed exceptions.

title: Medical Examiners’ Duties
summary: Requires medical examiners to report certain sudden unexpected deaths to a national registry, with state administrative penalties for late reporting.

title: Storage of Handguns in Private Conveyances and Vessels
summary: Requires safe storage of handguns in private vehicles and vessels, adds a law enforcement awareness campaign, and has counties adopt ordinances on parents of children who steal handguns.

title: Impact of Perimenopause and Menopause on Women’s Health
summary: Requires the Department of Health to create a perimenopause and menopause policy workgroup and publish related information online.

title: Debt Reduction
summary: Creates a Debt Reduction Program in the State Board of Administration and revises the annual debt affordability report on state debt.

title: Revenue Administration
summary: Renames tax assessors as property appraisers, revises property tax definitions, and bars certain non-ad valorem assessments on agricultural lands.

title: Patient Funds Held in Trust by Chiropractic Physicians
summary: Deletes the cap on how much patient money a chiropractic physician may hold in trust, loosening a provider financial rule.

title: Insurance Solutions Advisory Council
summary: Creates an Insurance Solutions Advisory Council within the Office of Insurance Regulation to study insurance issues and report annually.

title: Charlie Kirk Day of Remembrance
summary: Designates October 14 each year as Charlie Kirk Day of Remembrance and authorizes an annual gubernatorial proclamation.

title: Chemicals in Consumer Products
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Requires cosmetics makers to publish added-ingredient notices online, and deems foods containing vaccine material misbranded unless labeled.

title: Uterine Fibroid Research Database
summary: Deletes the ban on putting personal identifying information in the uterine fibroid research database, allowing identifiable data to be included.

title: Virtual Currency Kiosks
summary: Requires virtual currency kiosk businesses to register or renew registration before operating in Florida, and expands money services business rules and disciplinary grounds.

title: Relief of C.C. by the Department of Children and Families
topics: Children and families; Taxes and budget
summary: Provides a $20 million appropriation to compensate C.C. for injuries caused by Department of Children and Families negligence.

title: Relief of the Estate of Danielle Maudsley by the Department of Highway Safety and Motor Vehicles
summary: Appropriates $1,750,000 to compensate the Estate of Danielle Maudsley for her death allegedly caused by a Florida Highway Patrol trooper's negligence.

title: Combatting Illegal Immigration
summary: Creates a presumption that no release conditions will secure an unauthorized alien's trial appearance, requiring pretrial detention motions when courts so determine.

title: Immigration
summary: Creates a state immigration enforcement office and a local law enforcement grant program under the Department of Agriculture, with a $515 million appropriation.

title: Immigration
summary: Creates an immigration enforcement board and council, bars driver licenses for unauthorized immigrants, adds penalties for certain offenders, and appropriates about $299 million.

title: Artificial Intelligence Bill of Rights
topics: AI and technology; Children and families
summary: Bars certain government AI contracts, requires companion chatbot platforms to block minors without parental consent, and requires periodic bot notifications to users.

title: Retirement
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Lets elected officers, except legislators, keep serving while receiving DROP proceeds after a set age, and revises Special Risk COLA and employer pension contribution rates.

title: Relief of J.N., a Minor, by Hillsborough County
summary: Appropriates $400,000 to compensate a minor injured by Hillsborough County's negligent sidewalk and culvert maintenance, subject to fee and cost limits.

title: Relief of H.H. by the Department of Children and Families
summary: Appropriates $14,926,640 to compensate H.H. for injuries caused by Department of Children and Families negligence, with limits on fees and costs.

title: Postsecondary Out-of-state Fee Waivers
summary: Deletes state provisions waiving out-of-state tuition fees for certain students, including students who are undocumented for federal immigration purposes.

title: Comprehensive Waste Reduction and Recycling Plan
summary: Directs the Department of Environmental Protection to develop a statewide waste reduction and recycling plan, convene a technical assistance group, and report to the Legislature.

title: Utilities
summary: Lets counties regulate end-of-life solar decommissioning with financial assurance, and requires utility storm protection improvements to show benefits exceeding costs.

title: Municipal Water and Sewer Utility Rates
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Requires municipalities to charge out-of-city utility customers the same water and sewer rates, fees and charges as in-city customers in certain cases.

title: Mandatory Human Reviews of Insurance Claim Denials
topics: AI and technology; Consumer protection and business
summary: Requires insurers' claim denials to be made by qualified humans and bars AI, algorithms, or machine learning as the sole basis for denying or adjusting claims.

title: Educator Certifications and Training
summary: Requires teacher preparation and certification training on mass casualty incidents, and directs the Department of Education to approve those trainings.

title: Gaming
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice
summary: Requires organizations unsure whether a machine is an amusement game to get a Gaming Commission ruling before buying or operating it, and adds criminal penalties for slot machine offenses.

title: Pregnant Women in Custody
summary: Creates Ava's Law: pregnancy tests on request for women held in custody, possible sentence stays for pregnant offenders, and new data reporting by detention facilities.

title: Students with Autism Spectrum Disorder
summary: Creates an autism educator loan forgiveness program and annual teacher payments, and adds autism and disability training requirements to teacher preparation programs.

title: Agreement Among the States to Elect the President by National Popular Vote
summary: Joins a interstate compact so the state's presidential electors are awarded to the national popular vote winner once enough states join.

title: Land Use and Development Regulations
summary: Requires local governments to permit offsite-built homes as of right in certain zones, allow manufactured buildings in RV parks, and tie application fees to actual costs.

title: Animal Cremation
summary: Creates Sevilla's Law requiring companion animal cremation providers to give written service descriptions free of false or misleading information, with civil penalties for violations.

title: Public Records/Petitions for Injunctions for Protection Against Serious Violence by a Known Person
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice
summary: Creates a public records exemption for petitions for injunctions against serious violence by a known person, and for information identifying the petitioner or respondent.

title: Official State Bird
summary: Requires the Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission to develop and conduct a bird survey and report its results to the Legislature.

title: Sexual Offenders and Sexual Predators
summary: Revises residency and distance restrictions for sex offenders, requires notice to schools and child care facilities, and authorizes warrantless arrests on probable cause.

title: Special Observances/Fentanyl Awareness and Education Day
summary: Designates August 21 each year as Fentanyl Awareness and Education Day and encourages related awareness events.

title: Special District Funding
summary: Lets state agencies pay special districts' invoices under financial assistance agreements, requires expedited payment requests, and expands the rural community definition.

title: Campaign Finance
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Bars state agencies from using state funds to advocate for or against constitutional amendments and revisions, and defines 'state agency.'

title: Verification of Reemployment Assistance Benefit Eligibility
summary: Revises when claimants are disqualified from reemployment assistance benefits and requires the Department of Commerce to verify claimants' identities before paying.

title: Tax Exemption for Disabled Ex-servicemembers
summary: Increases the value of a property tax exemption for certain disabled ex-servicemembers.

title: Land Use Regulations
summary: Defines the term "impacted local government" and makes other changes to land use regulations; the summary gives no operative details.

title: Relief of Eric Miles, Jr., and Jennifer Miles by the South Broward Hospital District
summary: Appropriates $200,000 to compensate the Miles family for their minor son's injuries from alleged South Broward Hospital District negligence.

title: Relief of L.P. by the Department of Children and Families
summary: Appropriates $28 million to compensate L.P., a minor, for injuries from Department of Children and Families employees' negligence, subject to a limitation on fees.

title: Combatting Illegal Immigration
summary: Creates criminal penalties for adults who knowingly enter Florida after eluding federal inspection, adds civil liability for aiding such entry, and grants liability immunity and state indemnification to officials.

title: Social Work Licensure Compact
summary: Creates a Social Work Licensure Compact letting licensed social workers obtain multistate licenses and practice across member states without separate state licenses.

title: Paid Parental Leave
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Requires the state to provide paid parental leave to certain state employees for a set period, without forcing them to use annual or sick leave.

title: Public Records and Meetings/Social Work Licensure Compact
summary: Creates public records and public meetings exemptions for information and meetings tied to the Social Work Licensure Compact, with future legislative review and repeal.

title: Cost-sharing Requirements for Diabetes Management
summary: Prohibits health insurers from imposing cost-sharing above a set amount for a 30-day supply of insulin and diabetes devices.

title: Resolution of Disputed Property Insurance Claims
summary: Requires property insurance claim disputes to go through mediation before litigation, mandates insured attendance and document sharing, and appropriates $1 million.

title: Rating Factors for Automobile Liability Insurers
summary: Bars auto liability insurers from setting rates or rating classifications based on certain information.

title: Smoking in Public Places
summary: Expands the definitions of smoking and vaping, prohibits smoking in public places with exceptions, and bars marijuana smoking and vaping in customs smoking rooms.

title: Trade-in Vehicle Valuation
summary: Revises the definition of "purchase price" in Florida's Motor Vehicle Warranty Enforcement Act to address how trade-in vehicle value is treated.

title: Toll Discounts for Certified Veteran Business Enterprises
summary: Creates a pilot program giving certified veteran business enterprises a discount on certain toll expenses, administered by the Turnpike Enterprise with veterans' and management services agencies.

title: Insurance
summary: Revises Florida insurance rules on bad-faith extracontractual damages, public adjuster conduct, policy cancellation circumstances, and flood coverage disclosure statements.

title: Transparency in Insurance Matters
summary: Defines trade secrets for insurance filings, limits trade-secret claims, and requires insurer-affiliate fee and commission agreements to be filed and publicly posted.

title: Debt Collection
summary: Revises prohibited practices for persons attempting to collect consumer debt; the title gives no detail on direction.

title: Agreement Among the States to Elect the President by National Popular Vote
summary: Joins Florida to an interstate compact so its presidential electors go to the national popular vote winner, once enough states join.

title: Criminal Offenses Against Law Enforcement Officers and Other Personnel
summary: Creates the Officer Jason Raynor Act, enhancing punishment for manslaughter and assault or battery against specified law enforcement and other personnel.

title: Insurers’ Financial Transactions
summary: Requires certain insurers to report annually to the Office of Insurance Regulation, mandates an annual outside review of transactions, and restricts insurer affiliate transactions, dividends and executive bonuses.

title: Community Violence Task Force
summary: Creates a Community Violence Task Force within FDLE to study community violence, with membership, duties, agency assistance, and a report due to the Governor and Legislature.

title: Rental Assistance for Veterans
summary: Creates a veterans' rental assistance grant program, letting the Florida Housing Finance Corporation award grants to eligible applicants for rent.

title: Preemption of Firearms and Ammunition
summary: Repeals the state's preemption of firearms and ammunition regulation, letting local governments regulate those areas instead of only the Legislature.

title: Corporate Income Tax
summary: Revises Florida's corporate income tax base by prohibiting certain deductions, limiting carryovers, and changing unitary combined group reporting rules.

title: Relief of Mande Penney-Lemmon by Sarasota County
summary: Appropriates $2,291,365 to compensate Mande Penney-Lemmon for injuries caused by Sarasota County employee negligence, with limits on compensation and attorney fees.

title: Relief of Lourdes Latour and Edward Latour by Miami-Dade County
summary: Appropriates $500,000 to compensate Lourdes and Edward Latour for injuries from Miami-Dade County's alleged negligence, with limits on compensation and attorney fees.

title: Victims of Domestic Violence and Dating Violence
summary: Extends Florida's address confidentiality program to victims of dating violence and directs a feasibility study of a victim alert system.

title: Auxiliary Containers
summary: Preempts local regulation of auxiliary containers to the state, requires DEP to draft a uniform ordinance, and bans certain single-use containers on state lands.

title: Public Records and Public Meetings/Helping Abuse Victims Escape Now (HAVEN) Coordinating Council
summary: Keeps confidential information held by the HAVEN Coordinating Council protected and exempts closed portions of its meetings from public meeting requirements.

title: Pregnancy Support and Wellness Services
summary: Repeals an unspecified provision on pregnancy support and wellness services; the text does not describe the effect.

title: Postsecondary Education
summary: Bars Florida colleges and universities meeting specified criteria from admitting or accepting applications from undocumented individuals, and deletes an out-of-state fee waiver for certain students.

title: Residential Swimming Pool Requirements
summary: Requires residential pools to meet safety and barrier requirements when the property is sold or transferred, and home inspectors must report violations to local enforcement.

title: Grandparent Visitation
summary: Revises the criteria a grandparent must meet to petition for visitation, plus court hearing, mediation, and guardian ad litem procedures.

title: Specialty License Plates
summary: Requires specialty plate organizations to report financial information, bars certain plate fee distributions, and directs creation of new specialty plates, including an Endless Summer motorcycle plate.

title: Student Participation in Interscholastic and Intrascholastic Extracurricular Sports
summary: Revises eligibility rules for private and home-education students to take part in school sports and activities, per the title and summary.

title: Public Records/Municipal Clerks and their Staff
summary: Creates a public records exemption shielding personal identifying and location information of municipal clerks, their staff, and their families, with future review and retroactive application.

title: Prescriptive Authority Certification for Psychologists
summary: Lets the Board of Psychology certify qualified psychologists to prescribe drugs and controlled substances, with recordkeeping and an interim panel.

title: Rural Communities
summary: Creates an Office of Rural Prosperity and several rural infrastructure and grant programs, appropriating about $144.8 million.

title: Appropriations
summary: General appropriations act providing about $115.1 billion for state agencies for fiscal year 2025-26 and supplemental 2024-25 funding.

title: Appropriations
summary: Appropriates $115.0 billion for state agencies and programs for fiscal year 2026-27, plus supplemental funding for 2025-26.

title: Appropriations
summary: Provides $115 billion in state appropriations for fiscal year 2026-27 and supplemental 2025-26 funding for state agencies.

title: Implementing the 2025-2026 General Appropriations Act
summary: Implements the 2025-2026 appropriations act, reallocating reserves, revising Medicaid funding and provider payment pools, and extending a medical marijuana rulemaking exemption.

title: Implementing the 2026-2027 General Appropriations Act
summary: Implements the 2026-2027 appropriations act, creates a rural teacher incentive program, revises regional consortia services, and lets AHCA seek added spending authority.

title: Implementing the 2026-2027 General Appropriations Act
summary: Implements the 2026-27 appropriations act, creates a rural educator incentive program and a consortium supplemental services program, and lets AHCA request added spending authority.

title: Collective Bargaining
summary: Sets how state employee collective bargaining impasses are resolved, sending some issues to personnel rules and otherwise keeping the status quo.

title: State Employees
summary: Sets a process for resolving collective bargaining disputes at impasse between the state and certified state employee bargaining units.

title: State Employees
summary: Provides a process for resolving collective bargaining disputes at impasse between the state and certified state employee bargaining units.

title: Natural Resources
summary: Repeals the Local Trail Management Grant Program, revises land acquisition application rules, and directs DEP to dedicate funds to rural areas of opportunity.

title: Fuel Taxes
summary: Revises how proceeds of the fuel sales tax are distributed and how funds flow into the Fuel Tax Collection Trust Fund.

title: Fuel Taxes
summary: Revises how proceeds from the fuel sales tax are distributed among recipients; the summary gives no amounts or rate changes.

title: Judges
summary: Increases the number of circuit judges, county court judges, and Sixth District Court of Appeal judges, and reduces Second District judges under specified conditions.

title: State Agency Law Enforcement Radio System
summary: Removes the scheduled expiration of surcharge remissions to the Department of Revenue, keeping funding for the state agency law enforcement radio system.

title: State Agency Law Enforcement Radio System
summary: Removes the scheduled expiration of surcharge remission to the Department of Revenue, keeping funding flowing for the state agency law enforcement radio system.

title: Prekindergarten Through Grade 12 Education
summary: Moves loan-fund money to the Schools of Hope program, revises how Schools of Hope are established, extends CAPE digital tool certificates to elementary students, and changes FEFP recalculations.

title: Trust Funds of the State Courts System
summary: Terminates the Mediation and Arbitration Trust Fund of the state courts system and provides for disposing of its remaining balances and revenues.

title: Higher Education
summary: Creates the Florida Center for Nursing at USF to administer the LINE Fund and requires state universities to waive certain student out-of-pocket expenses.

title: Judges
summary: Increases the number of circuit judges in certain judicial circuits and county court judges in certain counties.

title: Judges
summary: Adds circuit and county court judgeships in certain Florida judicial circuits and counties.

title: Health and Human Services
summary: Omnibus health bill: lets dental students apply for loan repayment early, creates cancer and eye research initiatives, and revokes medical marijuana registrations for certain convictions.

title: Pre-K-12 Education
summary: Revises when scholarship account funds revert to the state, and adds funding supplements and higher calculations for declining-enrollment and fiscally constrained districts.

title: Pre-K-12 Education
summary: Revises when unused scholarship account funds revert to the state, and adds funding supplements for declining-enrollment and fiscally constrained school districts.

title: Higher Education
summary: Creates the Florida Center for Nursing at USF, extends the LINE Fund to health science shortages, applies a fee waiver after other aid, and changes reporting recipients.

title: Higher Education
summary: Establishes a Florida Center for Nursing at USF, expands the LINE Fund to health science shortages, and adjusts a fee waiver and reporting duties.

title: Health
summary: Revises foster parent and caregiver room and board rates, authorizes a grief support contract for children, renames a workforce pilot, and requires estimating-conference data on a developmental disabilities pilot.

title: Health
summary: Omnibus bill authorizing DCF grief support contracts, revising foster parent room and board rates, requiring disability pilot program estimates, and renaming a workforce program.

title: Weapons and Firearms
summary: Requires background checks on everyone involved in firearm sales or transfers, sets licensed-dealer requirements, and adds criminal penalties.

title: Prohibited Discrimination Based on Hairstyle
summary: Adds a CROWN Act ban on discrimination based on protected hairstyles against students in Florida's K-20 public education system and private school choice participants.

title: Firearms
summary: Revises the definition of "machine gun" and ranks bump-fire stock offenses on level 5 of the Criminal Punishment Code, increasing penalties.

title: Nursing Education Programs
summary: Requires nurse licensure applicants who wait over six months to take a remedial course, provides provisional licenses for graduate nurses, and revises nursing program approval rules.

title: Sale or Transfer of Ammunition
summary: Requires background checks for sales or transfers of ammunition, and names the act 'Jaime's Law'.

title: Storage of Handguns in Private Conveyances and Vessels
summary: Adds statewide storage requirements for handguns kept in private vehicles and vessels, plus related firearm education and warning changes.

title: Public Records/Sale or Transfer of Ammunition
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Guns and weapons
summary: Exempts from public records disclosure information about ammunition buyers or transferees not found prohibited, with future legislative review and repeal.

title: Public Records/Medical Examiners
summary: Creates a public records exemption for personal identifying and location information of current and former medical examiners and their spouses and children, with future review and repeal.

title: Relief of Kristen and Lia McIntosh by the Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services
summary: Appropriates $2,252,000 to compensate Kristen and Lia McIntosh for injuries caused by a Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services employee's negligence.

title: Relief of the Estate of Mark LaGatta by the Department of Transportation
summary: Appropriates $2.2 million to compensate the estate of Mark LaGatta for injuries caused by Department of Transportation negligence, with limits on fees.

title: Statewide, Standardized Assessments
summary: Requires the Education Department to develop translated versions of statewide assessments and screening tools, and lets parents bar their use in certain languages.

title: Removal, Storage, and Cleanup of Electric Vehicles
summary: Requires counties to set daily storage fees for damaged or submerged electric vehicles, requires towers to report data to the Fire Marshal, and relieves insurers of certain costs.

title: Trusts
summary: Revises trust administration and devise rules, and keeps homestead property moved into community property trusts from being reassessed as a change of ownership.

title: Storage and Disposal of Prescription Drugs and Sharps
summary: Exempts establishments that hold noncontrolled prescription drugs solely for arranging their destruction from specified compliance provisions.

title: Step-therapy Protocols
summary: Requires Florida Medicaid to approve certain mental-illness drugs without step-therapy prior authorization in specified circumstances, and defines serious mental illness.

title: Official State Bird
summary: Requires the Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission to develop and conduct a bird survey and share survey information during a set timeframe.

title: Tax of Electric Vertical Takeoff and Landing Aircraft
summary: Exempts sales of electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft from state sales tax when a manufacturer sells to an operator.

title: Public Adjuster Contracts
summary: Lets certain persons rescind public adjuster service contracts and clarifies conduct that can lead to discipline of public adjusters and apprentices.

title: Public Records/Congressional Members and Public Officers
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Exempts partial home addresses and phone numbers of current congressional members and public officers, plus their families' personal and school information, from public records requirements.

title: Public Records/Emergency Department Physicians
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Creates a public records exemption shielding personal identifying and location information of current emergency department physicians and certain family members, subject to future review and repeal.

title: Florida Bright Futures Scholarship Program
summary: Revises Bright Futures scholarship eligibility, including out-of-state diploma holders and an AP Capstone criterion for Florida Academic Scholars.

title: Local Government Official Salaries
summary: Revises the base salary used to calculate pay for certain county constitutional officers, such as clerks, comptrollers, supervisors of elections and property appraisers.

title: Homestead Exemption for Persons 65 and Older
summary: Expands the homestead exemption for seniors 65 and older with household income limits, fully exempting homestead property from non-school ad valorem taxes.

title: Transportation Facility Designations/Harris Rosen Way and Geraldine Thompson Way
summary: Designates certain transportation facilities in a specified county with honorary names, directing FDOT to erect markers.

title: Sheltering or Aiding Unmarried Minors
summary: Creates a presumption of knowledge and a defense for unlawfully sheltering or aiding unmarried minors, and increases related criminal penalties.

title: Homestead Property Tax Benefits for Long-term Owners and Permanent Residents
summary: Requires certain long-term owner-occupied homes to be assessed below just value, capping assessed value and adding a homestead exemption for long-term owners and residents.

title: Misuse of Emergency Communications Systems
summary: Creates enhanced criminal penalties for misusing emergency communications systems that cause bodily injury or property damage, and requires courts to order restitution.

title: Relief of Darline Angervil and J.R. by the South Broward Hospital District
summary: Provides a $6.1 million appropriation to compensate a mother and minor child for injuries from South Broward Hospital District negligence.

title: Relief of Reginald Jackson by the City of Lakeland
summary: Provides a $312,500 appropriation to compensate Reginald Jackson for injuries from a Lakeland police officer's negligence, and limits fees and payment.

title: Candidate Qualification
summary: Sets new eligibility requirements for party and no-party candidates and bars certain people from qualifying or appearing on the ballot.

title: Assessment of Homestead Property
summary: Limits the assessed value of homestead property upon change of ownership when the prior assessed value is below a set amount and the buyer qualifies for the homestead exemption.

title: Warranty Associations
summary: Revises insurance and reserve requirements for service warranty associations, easing some obligations and adding coverage requirements for accidental handling damage.

title: Recreational Customary Use of Beaches
summary: Repeals a statutory provision on establishing recreational customary use of beaches; the one-line title gives no further detail.

title: Assessment of Property Owned and Used by Small Businesses
summary: Caps annual assessed-value increases for small-business commercial real property and resets it to just value upon ownership or control changes.

title: Mobile Opportunity by Interstate Licensure Endorsement Act
summary: Revises the list of people ineligible for a license by endorsement under the interstate licensure act. The summary does not say whether eligibility widens or narrows.

title: Assessment of Changes, Additions, or Improvements to Homestead Properties
summary: Revises how the value of changes, additions, or improvements to homestead property is assessed for property tax purposes.

title: Exceptions to the Limitation on Termination of Pregnancies
summary: Revises the fatal fetal abnormality definition and requires one physician, rather than two, to make medical determinations for abortion exceptions.

title: Rural Electric Cooperatives
summary: Prohibits rural electric cooperatives that sell retail electricity from adopting, enacting, or enforcing fees that meet specified criteria.

title: Property Tax Exemption for Surviving Spouses of Veterans
summary: Lets surviving spouses of veterans who died before a federal disability rating letter was issued use other proof to claim the property tax exemption.

title: Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration; Housing
summary: Bars counties from restricting gasoline-powered farm and landscape equipment, requires developer attestation for some ecologically significant parcel approvals, and creates a food animal veterinary loan repayment program.

title: Virtual Currency Kiosk Businesses
summary: Requires virtual currency kiosk businesses to register and renew with the Office of Financial Regulation, and criminalizes operating or soliciting business without registration.

title: Public Records/Appellate Court Clerks
summary: Creates a public records exemption protecting personal identifying and location information of current appellate court clerks and their spouses and children, subject to future legislative review.

title: Collaborative Pharmacy Practice for Chronic Health Conditions
summary: Narrows collaborative pharmacy practice by excluding specified heart conditions from the definition of chronic health condition.

title: Connecting to Care Act
summary: Creates the Connecting to Care Act, authorizing pharmacists to administer certain medications under certain circumstances.

title: Middle School and High School Start Times
summary: Lets school districts and charter schools count as compliant with middle and high school start-time rules by submitting a report to the Department of Education.

title: Victims of Domestic Violence and Dating Violence
summary: Lets dating violence victims apply to the Attorney General's address confidentiality program and orders a feasibility study of a victim alert system.

title: Ad Valorem Tax Exemption for Nonprofit Homes for the Aged
summary: Revises an eligibility requirement for Florida limited partnerships seeking the property tax exemption for nonprofit homes for the aged.

title: Public Records/Victims of Domestic and Dating Violence
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice
summary: Exempts identifying information of dating violence victims in the Address Confidentiality Program from public records disclosure, including voter records, with retroactive application and future repeal review.

title: Relief of the Estate of M.N. by the Broward County Sheriff’s Office
summary: Private claim bill appropriating $2,498,259 to compensate the estate of M.N. for injuries and death allegedly caused by Broward County Sheriff's Office negligence.

title: Rate Filings for Property Insurers
summary: Revises property insurance rate filing rules and consumer advocate powers, and bars the insurance regulator from approving certain rate filings.

title: Public Records/Appellate Court Clerks and their Spouses and Children
summary: Exempts personal identifying and location information of current appellate court clerks and their spouses and children from public records requirements, with future review and repeal.

title: Alternative Judicial Sales Procedures
summary: Requires courts to direct alternative auctioneers to conduct judicial property sales and limits deviations from standard sale procedures in foreclosure actions.

title: Public Records/Judicial Qualifications Commission
summary: Creates a public records exemption for personal identifying and location information of current and former Judicial Qualifications Commission employees and their spouses and children.

title: Coastal Resiliency
summary: Restricts dredging and filling in Terra Ceia Aquatic Preserve, allows dredging, filling and seawalls in Biscayne Bay Aquatic Preserve, and creates a statewide coastal resiliency permitting process.

title: Specific Medical Diagnoses in Child Protective Investigations
summary: Requires child protection teams to consult a physician or APRN on certain medical-diagnosis reports and lets removed parents request specified child examinations in some cases.

title: Violations of State Immigration Laws
summary: Creates state fines for certain immigration-law violations, directs the proceeds to compensate victims harmed by unauthorized aliens, and allows suits against certain local entities.

title: Medicaid Providers
summary: Requires the state Medicaid agency to include specified requirements in its contracts with Medicaid managed care plans; the specifics are not given.

title: Luggage for Children Placed in Out-of-home Care
summary: Requires DCF to provide luggage to children in out-of-home care and to pursue partnerships and donations to fund it.

title: Injunctions for Protection in Cases of Repeat or Serious Violence
summary: Expands the civil injunction for protection to cover serious violence, not just repeat violence, and renames the cause of action accordingly.

title: Florida Museum of Black History
summary: Establishes a Florida Museum of Black History Board of Directors, sets its membership, and bars certain members from holding elective office while serving.

title: Historic Cemeteries Program
summary: Requires local governments to approve historic African-American cemeteries' applications to rezone excess vacant land when sold to fund upkeep.

title: Immigration
summary: Sets duties for agencies certifying U-visa applications, requires written notice of denials, allows court petitions for delays, and bars disclosing victims' immigration status.

title: Florida Institute for Human and Machine Cognition, Inc.
summary: Shifts authority over the Florida Institute for Human and Machine Cognition's subsidiaries and board composition from the Board of Governors to the institute's own board.

title: Patient-directed Medical Orders
summary: Creates patient-directed medical orders for withholding or withdrawing life-prolonging procedures, requires certain comfort services continue, and sets up an AHCA order database.

title: Payment Stablecoin
summary: Brings payment stablecoin issuers under Florida's money services business act, requiring a license or exemption and limiting licensed issuers' activities.

title: Limited Liability Companies
summary: Creates a Uniform Protected Series Provisions framework letting domestic LLCs establish protected series and defining foreign series LLCs for Florida law.

title: Law Enforcement and Immigration Officer Identifying Information and Face Coverings
summary: Requires immigration officers to wear visible identification and bans face coverings for immigration and law enforcement officers performing official duties.

title: Educational Scholarship Programs
summary: Creates a scholarship implementation fund and enrollment stabilization funding, renames Hope Scholarship to Hope Program, and requires a single scholarship application and parent information.

title: Relief of L.E. by the Department of Children and Families
summary: Appropriates $3.8 million to compensate L.E. for injuries caused by Department of Children and Families negligence, with limits on fees.

title: Injunctions for Protection
summary: Creates a cause of action for protective injunctions in serious violence by a known person, waives clerk filing fees, and requires faster law enforcement service.

title: Licensure Requirements for Surveyors and Mappers
summary: Creates an alternative licensing pathway for surveyors and mappers, with eligibility rules for the exam and expiring licenses granted under it.

title: Administrative Efficiency in Public Schools
summary: Makes administrative changes to district school boards, including rulemaking exemptions, internal auditor requirements, teacher hiring and pay rules, and the Teacher Apprenticeship Program.

title: Property Rights
summary: Lets commercial property owners ask sheriffs to immediately remove unlawful occupants and makes unlawful occupancy or trespass with intentional damage prohibited.

title: Construction
summary: Requires landlords to maintain functioning cooling facilities and lets the construction board award continuing education credit for certain association work, while barring credit for some activities.

title: Construction Disruption Assistance
summary: Creates a revolving loan program at the Department of Commerce to give financial assistance to small businesses affected by construction zones.

title: Transportation Concurrency
summary: Revises which facilities small counties must identify in the capital improvements element of comprehensive plans that impose transportation concurrency.

title: Curators of Estates
summary: Revises court authority to appoint estate curators, adjusts their bond requirements, clarifies who may seek their removal or surcharge, and allows more frequent reporting.

title: Applicability of Valued Policy Law to Surplus Lines Insurers
summary: Requires surplus lines insurers to comply with Florida's valued policy law, paying full policy value after certain total losses.

title: Immigration, Law Enforcement, and State-issued Identification
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice; Immigration
summary: Creates the Florida Economic Prosperity and Immigration Act: adds driver license ID proof, limits DHSMV photo sharing with immigration agencies, repeals private E-Verify mandate, and bars immigration-status discrimination.

title: Residential Utility Disconnections
topics: Consumer protection and business; Environment and energy
summary: Bars electric, public and water utilities from disconnecting residential customers for nonpayment in certain circumstances, waives some fees, and requires advance notice.

title: Disability Provisions for Firefighters and Law Enforcement and Correctional Officers
summary: Lets firefighters and law enforcement and correctional officers use prior employers' physical exams to support heart disease presumptions, making those presumptions easier to claim.

title: Patient Protection
summary: Requires health care facilities to meet minimum direct-care nurse staffing levels, bars video monitoring as a substitute for nurse observation, and protects whistleblowers.

title: Public Records and Public Meetings/Private Property Rights
summary: Creates a public meetings exemption for agency attorney discussions of private property rights claims, requiring transcripts that become public later.

title: Marijuana Products
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice
summary: Lets qualified patients apply for certificates to grow up to two cannabis plants at home, and adds conditions on hemp extract sales, with a $2 million appropriation.

title: Deactivation from Transportation Network Company Digital Networks
summary: Defines driver deactivation, limits when it may occur, requires TNCs to adopt a deactivation policy, and lets deactivated drivers appeal to a third-party arbitrator.

title: Educational Dollars for Duty Program
summary: Expands the Educational Dollars for Duty program to set aside funds for tuition assistance to spouses and children of Florida National Guard members.

title: Gay and Transgender Panic Legal Defenses
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice
summary: Prohibits criminal defendants from using nonviolent sexual advances or perceptions about a person's sexual orientation or gender identity as a defense or mitigation.

title: Florida Bright Futures Scholarship Program
summary: Requires public high schools to establish a Bright Futures Scholarship mentorship program for students.

title: Relief of Michael Barnett by the Department of Children and Families
summary: Appropriates $296,400 to compensate Michael Barnett and his minor child R.B. for injuries caused by the Department of Children and Families.

title: Historic Cemeteries Program
summary: Requires local governments to approve rezoning and land-use change applications from historic African-American cemeteries for their excess vacant land, under certain conditions.

title: International Health Organization Policies
summary: Bars governmental entities and educational institutions from adopting, implementing, or enforcing international health organizations' public health policies or guidelines.

title: Human Trafficking Education for Nurse Licensure
summary: Requires registered nurse and practical nurse applicants for initial licensure to complete a human trafficking education course, starting on a specified date.

title: Public Records/Agency for Health Care Administration
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Exempts personal identifying and location information of certain AHCA personnel and their families from public records requirements, with future review and retroactive application.

title: Statewide, Standardized Assessments
topics: Children and families; Government and administration
summary: Requires the Education Department to develop translated statewide assessments and screening portions, and lets parents opt their children out of non-English versions.

title: Telecommunications Access System Act of 1991
summary: Revises Public Service Commission oversight, administrator duties, device distribution procedures, and advisory committee makeup for Florida's telecommunications access system.

title: Use of Artificial Intelligence in Psychological, Clinical, Counseling, and Therapy Services
summary: Prohibits using artificial intelligence in the practice of psychology, clinical social work, marriage and family therapy, and mental health counseling.

title: State Preemption of the Regulation of Hoisting Equipment
summary: Deletes state preemption provisions over certain hoisting equipment regulation, returning that regulatory authority to local governments.

title: Assault Weapons and Large-capacity Magazines
summary: Bans the sale, transfer and possession of assault weapons and large-capacity magazines, and requires certificates for those lawfully owned before a set date.

title: Ethics
summary: Bars candidates and public officials and employees from knowingly misrepresenting military service records or wearing unauthorized military uniforms, medals, or insignia.

title: Statewide Health Care Coverage
summary: Creates a task force on universal health care and requires AHCA to develop a plan for a Medicaid buy-in or public option, with $1,174,816 appropriated.

title: Unlawful Speed
summary: Adds an exception to the ban on driving below the speed limit for drivers complying with certain local ordinances.

title: Public Records/Crime Victims
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice
summary: Expands the public records exemption protecting crime victims' names, IDs, and locating information, and creates a parallel exemption for their family members.

title: Employee Protections
summary: Bars agencies and contractors from retaliating against employees who disclose information to the Commission on Ethics, and extends protections to complainants and witnesses.

title: Common Entities of Motor Vehicle Distributors and Manufacturers
summary: Revises the definition of "common entity" for motor vehicle distributors and manufacturers; the summary gives no details on the effect.

title: Florida Public Service Commission
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Restructures the Public Service Commission, requires utility returns near the risk-free rate, and requires storm protection improvements to show benefits exceeding costs.

title: Blue Ribbon Projects
summary: Creates a blue ribbon project category with set maximum development density and intensity, plus certain local government credits.

title: Holocaust Remembrance Day
summary: Requires the Governor to annually proclaim Holocaust Remembrance Day and authorizes its observance in public schools and by public exercise.

title: Utility Terrain Vehicles
summary: Allows utility terrain vehicles to operate at all hours and on certain roadways, with DOT able to prohibit operation in some circumstances.

title: Treatment of Inmates
summary: Specifies certain rights of inmates in the correctional system and authorizes relief when those rights are deprived.

title: Division of Labor Standards
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Creates a Division of Labor Standards in the Department of Commerce with investigation and citation powers, revises employee protected rights, and creates an advisory board.

title: Florida Statutes
summary: Adopts the 2025 Florida Statutes as official compilation of state law, repealing unincluded general laws from 2024 and earlier; makes no substantive policy change.

title: Use of Professional Nursing Titles
summary: Allows licensed advanced practice nurses with specified doctoral degrees to use doctor titles, but requires advertising to also state their nursing license.

title: Resident Status for Tuition Purposes
summary: Bars a person from losing Florida resident status for tuition purposes because of incarceration or similar circumstances.

title: Home Inspectors
summary: Revises home inspector course requirements and disclosure rules, and requires inspectors to carry a specified errors and omissions insurance policy.

title: Reusable Tenant Screening Reports
summary: Lets landlords accept reusable tenant screening reports with a required statement and bars them from charging certain fees to applicants using such reports.

title: Reports of Child Abuse, Abandonment, or Neglect
summary: Requires the child abuse hotline to transfer reports to law enforcement and DCF, and bars DCF from returning children to parents without court determinations.

title: Council on the Social Status of Black Men and Boys
summary: Moves the Council on the Social Status of Black Men and Boys to Florida Memorial University, with the university providing staff support, and sets remote-meeting notice rules.

title: Public Accountancy
summary: Revises education and work experience requirements for CPA licensure, requires specified coursework, and lets the Board of Accountancy contract out certain Division duties.

title: Disability Provisions for Firefighters and Law Enforcement and Correctional Officers
summary: Defines "heart disease" and updates disability provisions for firefighters, law enforcement and correctional officers, and removes obsolete language.

title: Initiating a Property Insurance Interstate Compact
summary: Directs the Insurance Commissioner to join an interstate compact creating a national property insurance risk pool for natural disasters.

title: Community Associations
summary: Creates a Department of Legal Affairs pilot program to investigate economic crime in condominium and homeowners' associations, funded from the condo division's trust fund.

title: Presumptive Medicaid Eligibility for Pregnant Women
summary: Lets qualified entities make presumptive Medicaid eligibility determinations for pregnant women and requires AHCA to cover those presumptively eligible during a set period.

title: Health Screenings for K-12 Students
summary: Authorizes specified health screenings for K-12 students after written parental notice and gives parents specified opportunities; the text does not detail the screenings.

title: Public Records/Commissioners of the Florida Commission on Human Relations
summary: Creates a public records exemption for personal identifying and location information of Florida Commission on Human Relations personnel, commissioners, and their spouses and children.

title: Dense Breast Tissue Screenings
summary: Lets certain patients get ultrasound or other supplemental screenings for dense breast tissue without first getting a conventional mammogram.

title: Public Postsecondary Tuition and Fee Waivers for Sheriff’s Office Employees
summary: Requires state universities and Florida College System institutions to waive tuition and fees for sheriff's office employees, under set eligibility requirements.

title: Farm Products
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Redefines farm product and bars local governments from prohibiting or restricting collection, storage, processing, and distribution of farm products as bona fide farm operations.

title: Prescribing Authority
summary: Removes supervising-physician notice and prescription name requirements for physician assistants and revises formulary rules for physician assistants and nurses.

title: Guardians Ad Litem
summary: Authorizes courts to consider certain information provided by a guardian ad litem in cases involving children.

title: Public Records/Sexual Assault Counselors
summary: Creates a public records exemption for personal identifying and location information of sexual assault counselors, with future review and retroactive application.

title: Ad Valorem Taxation
summary: Lets taxpayers rescind homestead exemption applications, requires appraisers to adjust tax rolls, and revises conditions for a property tax exemption.

title: Special Districts
