summary: Repeals a statutory provision on special districts' performance measures and standards.

title: Florida Statutes
summary: Technical reviser's bill renaming the Division of Investigative and Forensic Services to Division of Criminal Investigations throughout the Florida Statutes.

title: Parity for Nonnursing Services Under Long-term Managed Care Plans
summary: Requires Florida's Medicaid agency to pay licensed providers of long-term care nonnursing services at least what it pays unlicensed providers, with annual rate adjustments.

title: Clinical Laboratory Personnel
summary: Removes state exam and trainee registration requirements for clinical lab personnel and deems applicants meeting specified criteria to satisfy licensure qualifications.

title: Legal Notices
summary: Revises legal notice rules: some notices must run continuously, while certain local governments may publish notices on a public website instead of newspapers.

title: Rent of Affordable Housing Dwelling Units
summary: Defines affordable housing and base rent, and bars certain landlords of affordable units from raising base rent during a rental agreement's term.

title: Micromobility Devices
summary: Sets operating requirements for electric bicycles, bars speeding e-bikes in certain circumstances, and creates a micromobility safety task force.

title: Annexing State-owned Lands
summary: Requires a municipality proposing to annex state-owned lands to notify the county's legislative delegation members at a set time.

title: Department of Transportation Contractor Liability
summary: Makes contractors agents of the state in certain circumstances and requires DOT contracts to indemnify the department for contractor negligence.

title: Self-storage Spaces
summary: Revises lien enforcement and sale notice rules for self-storage owners and requires rental agreements to include specified Self-storage Facility Act information.

title: Farm Equipment
summary: Lets farm equipment buyers report defective equipment during a set period, requiring manufacturers or their agents to repair it to meet warranty terms.

title: Trust Funds for Wildlife Management
summary: Revises Florida wildlife trust fund uses, letting the commission spend proceeds on law enforcement and enter agreements with private landowners.

title: Specialty License Plates/Florida Wildflower
summary: Raises the annual use fee for Florida Wildflower specialty license plates and adds a discount for owners buying the plate for multiple vehicles.

title: Ballot Boxes
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Elections and voting
summary: Requires law enforcement to transport ballot boxes and related election papers, and sets body camera data guidelines for law enforcement policies.

title: Living Organ Donation
summary: Defines living organ donor and requires state agencies and certain employers to grant leave so employees can serve as living organ donors.

title: Requirements of Lenders of Money
summary: Requires lenders and mortgage assignors to provide dated receipts, borrower notices, and loan history statements on request.

title: Issuance of Special Beverage Licenses
summary: Revises the square footage and capacity limits for food service establishments eligible for special beverage licenses.

title: Elections
summary: Requires state minimum security standards for election systems, a supply chain analysis, and state certification before local purchases, with criminal penalties for violations.

title: Reinsurance Intermediary Managers
summary: Revises the definition of reinsurance intermediary manager to exclude certain underwriting managers and defines 'controlling' for insurance regulation.

title: Elections
summary: Requires vote-by-mail requests to state an allowed reason, mandates post-election audits, adds signature and envelope verification, and lets PACs send poll watchers.

title: Cardiac Services Providers
summary: Revises licensure requirements for Level I and II adult cardiovascular programs and requires AHCA to update rules as new industry standards are published.

title: Awareness Program for Alzheimer’s Disease and Dementia-related Disorders
summary: Requires the Department of Elderly Affairs to contract for an Alzheimer's and dementia awareness program, which the advisory committee would evaluate.

title: Child Pornography Terminology
summary: Replaces the terms 'pornography' and 'child pornography' with 'child sexual abuse material' in Florida statutes, a terminology change.

title: Relief of Patricia Ermini by the Lee County Sheriff’s Office
summary: Appropriates $626,770 to compensate Patricia Ermini for injuries from Lee County Sheriff's Office negligence, and limits attorney fees.

title: Relief of C.C. by the Department of Children and Families
summary: Appropriates $20 million to compensate C.C. for injuries from the Department of Children and Families' negligence, with limits on fees.

title: Combatting Illegal Immigration
summary: Requires law enforcement agencies to support federal immigration enforcement, including transporting certain persons to federal custody rather than merely being authorized to do so.

title: Immigration
summary: Creates state criminal penalties, with enhanced penalties for repeat offenses, for unauthorized adult aliens who enter or are found in Florida after illegal entry or removal.

title: Public Records/Investigations by the Department of Legal Affairs
summary: Exempts Department of Legal Affairs records on companion chatbot and bot-related consumer protection investigations from public records requirements, with future review and repeal.

title: Property Tax Administration
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Revises definitions and millage-rate limits for certain county and municipal property taxes, and lets a specified constitutional amendment's ballot summary exceed the word limit.

title: Florida Statutes
summary: Revisor's bill deleting Florida Statutes provisions that are inoperative due to repeal or expiration, with no substantive policy change.

title: Medicaid Providers
summary: Requires AHCA to include specified requirements, including a defined 'outside of regular business hours' term, in Medicaid managed care plan contracts.

title: Interstate Compact on Educational Opportunity for Military Children
summary: Keeps the Interstate Compact on Educational Opportunity for Military Children and removes a provision about its future repeal. It makes no substantive change to services.

title: Carryforward Funding of Certain Managing Entities
summary: Allows certain managing entities to carry forward unspent funds and requires them to maximize subcontract use of current-year behavioral health allocations.

title: Unlawful Use of Uniforms, Medals, or Insignia
summary: Prohibits persons from wearing the uniform, medals, or insignia authorized for Space Force members or veterans.

title: Offenses Evidencing Prejudice
summary: Requires reclassifying offenses evidencing prejudice based on the victim's political ideology, which would raise the penalty level for those offenses.

title: Ticket Sales and Resales
summary: Requires ticket operators, resellers and online marketplaces to disclose specified information and bars certain ticket sales and resale practices.

title: Postsurgical Recovery Homes
summary: Creates a licensure regime for postsurgical recovery homes, with pre-license and annual inspections, staffing requirements, and a ban on operating or advertising without a license.

title: Hate Crimes
summary: Makes falsely reporting a crime motivated by bias against another person a hate crime, with criminal penalties and optional court-ordered prevention training.

title: Carrying Weapons and Firearms
summary: Prohibits carrying weapons or firearms into certain locations and creates criminal penalties for violations.

title: Thoroughbred Permitholders
summary: Requires certain thoroughbred permitholders to keep a full live racing schedule, revises their handle tax criteria, and removes some cardroom renewal requirements.

title: Advertisement of a Harmful Vaccine
summary: Creates manufacturer liability and a private cause of action for advertising a harmful vaccine, defining 'advertise' for that purpose.

title: Personal Mobility Device Battery Safety Standards
summary: Requires certain e-scooter and e-bike batteries to be certified to a specified ingress protection standard, with DHSMV coordinating compliance with local governments.

title: Public Records/Private Investigators
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Creates a public records exemption for personal identifying and location information of licensed private investigators and their spouses and children, with future review and retroactive application.

title: Repair of Motorized Wheelchairs
summary: Requires manufacturers to provide parts, tools and repair documentation for motorized wheelchairs, with violations enforced under Florida's Deceptive and Unfair Trade Practices Act.

title: Parole
summary: Requires the Parole Commission to give the Legislature a statistical analysis and requires DOC to share information with the commission for review.

title: Use of Campaign Funds for Campaign-related Child Care Expenses
summary: Allows candidates to use campaign account funds for campaign-related child care expenses, with recordkeeping and disclosure requirements.

title: Property Damage Caused by Limestone Mining Operations
summary: Gives property owners damaged by limestone mining a right to file compensation claims, adjudicated by the Division of Administrative Hearings.

title: Law Enforcement Officer Interactions with Individuals with Autism Spectrum Disorder
summary: Requires state agencies to create an autism communication program, a card and envelope for drivers, and autism training for law enforcement officers.

title: Florida Statutes
summary: Technical revisor's bill that deletes obsolete statutory provisions, fixes cross-references and typos, and clarifies statutes without changing policy.

title: Specific Medical Diagnoses in Child Protective Investigations
summary: Changes child protective investigations involving medical diagnoses, requires physician consultation for certain reports, and lets parents request specified medical exams for their child.

title: Official Actions of Local Governments
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Prohibits Florida counties and municipalities from funding, promoting or acting on DEI, penalizes violating officials, and requires contractors to certify compliance.

title: Patriotic Displays at Public Schools
summary: Requires school districts to adopt rules displaying George Washington and Abraham Lincoln portraits in each public school, subject to appropriation.

title: Earned Wage Access Services
summary: Creates a Florida framework for earned wage access providers, requiring them to register with the Financial Services Commission and comply with consumer requirements.

title: Automatic Dependent Surveillance-broadcasts
summary: Prohibits airports from using information broadcast or collected by ADS-B systems for specified purposes under certain circumstances.

title: Office Surgery Standards of Practice
summary: Creates Hillary's Law: bars physicians from performing certain office surgeries on immediate family members and requires office surgeries to report adverse incidents to the Department of Health.

title: Educational Facilities
summary: Deletes provisions letting schools of hope colocate in district facilities, require districts to offer underused space, and count their students in district capital outlay FTE.

title: Attorney Fees in Insurance Matters
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Requires courts to award attorney fees to insureds in certain declaratory relief claims, removes an insurer's total-denial defense, and applies rules to international health policies.

title: Adoption and Display of Flags by Governmental Entities
summary: Bars governmental entities from displaying certain flags on real property, sets penalties, lists permitted flags, and preempts local flag ordinances.

title: Country of Origin for Wild and Farm-raised Fish
summary: Requires country-of-origin disclosure for wild and farm-raised fish, creates a Florida wild seafood certification program, and requires food service establishments to publish fish origin information.

title: Drowning Prevention
summary: Revises the swimming lesson voucher program's age requirements and purpose, and requires DOH drowning-prevention educational materials provided to new parents by hospitals and birth providers.

title: Cardiac Emergencies
summary: Requires public schools, including charter schools, to adopt cardiac emergency response plans, keep an operational AED on campus, and revise CPR and AED instruction.

title: Oaths of School Personnel
summary: Requires school personnel, and administrative or instructional staff at Florida College System institutions and state universities, to take a specified oath before starting their duties.

title: Power of County Commissioners to Levy Special Assessments
summary: Removes county authority to levy and collect special assessments, including for municipal facilities and unincorporated-area services.

title: Intoxicating Substances
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice
summary: Bans tobacco and nicotine dealers from selling nitrous oxide, exempts certain veterinary xylazine products from Schedule I, and creates a xylazine trafficking offense.

title: Interstate Compact for School Psychologists
summary: Creates an interstate compact letting school psychologists practice in other member states using recognized equivalent licenses, with a new commission to administer it.

title: Assessment of Property Used for Residential Purposes
summary: Bars property appraisers from counting value added by wind-resistance improvements when assessing residential property, lowering assessed values for homeowners who make them.

title: Public Records and Meetings/Interstate Compact for School Psychologists
summary: Creates public meeting and public records exemptions for certain portions of the Interstate Compact for School Psychologists Commission's meetings, with future repeal review.

title: Felony Battery
summary: Expands the prison releasee reoffender definition to cover battery on officers causing injury and adds enhanced penalties for repeat battery offenders.

title: Food and Hemp Products
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice
summary: Tightens hemp extract sales and distribution rules, bans child-attractive hemp products, restricts business locations, and adds penalties, with a $2 million appropriation.

title: Child Welfare
summary: Creates a rebuttable presumption of detriment to children in certain cases, requires trained supervision of some visitation, and sets shelter hearing and trauma-therapy referral rules.

title: Motor Vehicles
summary: Makes certain unlawful lighting on highway vehicles a third-degree felony and bans knowing use, sale, or possession of license plate obscuring devices.

title: Electronic Payment of Public Records Fees
summary: Requires agencies subject to the public records law to offer an electronic option for paying public records request fees.

title: Gender Identity Employment Practices
summary: Bars employers from requiring employees or contractors to use pronouns inconsistent with their sex, and bars government employers from requiring certain gender-identity training as a job condition.

title: Florida Employee Health Choices Program
summary: Renames the Florida Health Choices Program as the Employee Health Choices Program, changes vendor eligibility and available products, and removes some Insurance Code exemptions.

title: Reading Instruction
summary: Requires intensive reading instruction for students with reading deficiencies and directs the Just Read, Florida! Office to coordinate training for reading personnel and coaches, subject to appropriation.

title: Search Warrants
summary: Lets judges issue search warrants to recover deceased bodies, extends warrant return deadlines, and allows officers to appear remotely when applying.

title: Human Trafficking Awareness
summary: Requires the Department of Education to identify a human trafficking awareness curriculum and requires public schools to ensure certain personnel receive training.

title: Required Instruction in Cursive Writing
summary: Requires students in specified grades to receive cursive writing instruction and demonstrate proficiency in cursive by the end of a set grade.

title: Financing Qualifying Improvements to Residential Property
summary: Revises how a non-ad valorem assessment used to finance residential property improvements is collected.

title: Large-scale County Destination Marketing Organizations
topics: Consumer protection and business; Taxes and budget
summary: Creates a registration requirement for large-scale county destination marketing organizations and requires a one-to-one match of private to public contributions to fund them.

title: Administrative Procedure
summary: Restricts agencies from issuing guidance or rules without statutory delegation, and requires retrospective cost-benefit analyses for certain rules.

title: Career and Academic Planning for Middle and High School Students
summary: Requires school boards to give students and parents career and technical education information and requires middle school career and academic planning meetings.

title: Crimes Evidencing Prejudice
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice
summary: Expands hate-crime style reclassification to cover gender and gender identity and makes reclassification mandatory when a crime is based on protected characteristics, including disability.

title: Ad Valorem Tax Exemption for Disabled Veterans
summary: Revises the limit on how much disabled-veteran property tax exemption a surviving spouse may transfer to a new residence.

title: Restrictions on Redevelopment
summary: Allows barrier island residential property to be redeveloped at the highest density allowed on a specified date, overriding contrary zoning and land use rules.

title: Family Court Report Cards
topics: Children and families; Government and administration
summary: Requires the state courts office to publish annual report cards on each family court judge and maintain a public online database.

title: Telephone Solicitation
summary: Revises the definitions of telephone solicitor and telephonic sales call and the conditions for awarding attorney fees in telephone solicitation suits.

title: Tourist Development Taxes
summary: Deletes a requirement that a set percentage of tourist development tax revenue be spent on tourism promotion and advertising.

title: Bail Bonds
summary: Bill removes the real-estate qualification for bail sureties, requires non-agent sureties to post cash or equivalent instruments, and makes bond discharge automatic upon pretrial detention.

title: Tourist Development Tax
summary: Authorizes local tourist development tax proceeds to be used for public safety, affordable housing, and workforce housing.

title: Public Records and Meetings/Competitive Solicitations
summary: Creates public records and public meetings exemptions for Department of Transportation competitive solicitations, including vendor negotiations and team strategy discussions, subject to future review and repeal.

title: Tourist Development Tax
summary: Changes the share of tourist development tax revenue that must go to tourism promotion and advertising before funds can be used for a specified other purpose.

title: Nonpublic Religious Postsecondary Educational Institutions
summary: Removes religious colleges' exemption from Commission for Independent Education oversight, requiring them to comply with conditions, get licensed, or cease operations.

title: Nonparticipating and Out-of-network Nurse Registries and Home Health Agencies
summary: Bars insurers, Medicaid managed care plans and related entities from restricting enrollees from using out-of-network nurse registries or home health agencies.

title: Student Elopement
summary: Requires public schools to create a SAFE team and elopement plan, student-specific quick reference guides, and annual plan submissions to district school boards.

title: Special Elections
summary: Requires the Governor to call special elections within set timeframes, lets electors petition courts over election dates, and removes waiver authority for those timeframes.

title: Transportation
summary: Transportation bill revising definitions for autonomous driving and micromobility, aviation financing, road contract bidding, county reporting, and Greater Miami Expressway Agency membership.

title: Autonomous Practice by a Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist
summary: Lets certified registered nurse anesthetists practice autonomously, revising clinical privilege requirements and authorizing specified acts under certain circumstances.

title: Certified Recovery Residences
summary: Revises the definition of certified recovery residence and requires revoking certificates of compliance for willful false or misleading information given to credentialing entities.

title: Observance of Veterans’ Day by K-12 Schools
summary: Requires school districts to observe Veterans' Day as a school holiday.

title: Florida Museum of Black History
summary: Establishes a Florida Museum of Black History Board of Directors, bars certain members from holding elective office while serving, and requires joint work with a foundation.

title: Public Records/Legal Assistants/Office of the Public Defender/Office of Criminal Conflict and Civil Regional Counsel
summary: Exempts home addresses, phone numbers, birth dates and photos of public defender legal assistants, and their spouses' and children's information, from public records law, with future repeal review.

title: Fleeing or Attempting to Elude a Law Enforcement Officer
summary: Revises patrol vehicle marking rules for fleeing or eluding offenses and authorizes impounding a vehicle involved in certain violations for a set period.

title: Animal Cruelty
summary: Requires veterinary professionals to report suspected animal cruelty, protects good-faith reporters, and penalizes knowingly altering records to conceal cruelty.

title: Naturopathic Medicine
summary: Creates a Board of Naturopathic Medicine and licensure by examination for naturopathic physicians, who may prescribe or recommend legend drugs and natural substances.

title: Fraternal Order of Police License Plate
summary: Removes a restriction on who may receive the Fraternal Order of Police license plate and revises how its annual use fees are distributed.

title: Education in Correctional Facilities for Professional Licensure
summary: Requires the correctional education program to plan and deliver classes that inmates can take for credit toward professional licensure requirements.

title: Trust Funds/Tariffs Result in Untimely Money Problems (TRUMP)
summary: Creates a Tariffs Result in Untimely Money Problems (TRUMP) Trust Fund, provides for its funding, and sets a future review and termination.

title: Modified Sentences for Veterans
summary: Authorizes courts to impose modified sentences for veterans under specified circumstances, creating an alternative to standard sentencing.

title: Military Affairs
summary: Expands state and local employees' military leave authorization to include Coast Guard service and revises the FRS Senior Management Service military position list.

title: Prohibited Discrimination Based on Hairstyle
summary: Prohibits hairstyle-based discrimination in K-20 public schools and applies anti-discrimination requirements to private schools in the scholarship program.

title: Registration and Protection of Trademarks
summary: Makes technical updates to Florida trademark law, including adopting USPTO classification and creating a secure online trademark registration system.

title: Deferred Retirement Option Program Eligibility for School Employees and Personnel
summary: Removes the time limit on Deferred Retirement Option Program (DROP) eligibility for certain school instructional, administrative and support employees.

title: Music Therapy
summary: Creates a Music Therapy Advisory Committee and a state license for professional music therapists, with collaboration requirements for licensees.

title: Foreclosure Procedures
summary: Sets mandatory requirements for foreclosure sales and requires courts to put any deviations from procedures in writing in the final judgment.

title: Housing
summary: Requires local governments to adopt an ordinance allowing accessory dwelling units in certain areas, and has OPPAGA study mezzanine finance and tiny homes.

title: Nonprofit Agricultural Organization Medical Benefit Plans
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Lets nonprofit agricultural organizations offer medical benefit plans that are not treated as insurance under the Florida Insurance Code.

title: Information Technology
summary: Transfers the Florida Digital Service into a new Division of Integrated Government Innovation and Technology within the Executive Office of the Governor.

title: Impact Fees
summary: Requires a demonstrated-need study before local impact fee increases and bars certain increases unless extraordinary circumstances are shown.

title: Artificial Intelligence Bill of Rights
topics: AI and technology; Children and families
summary: Creates an AI Bill of Rights limiting government AI contracts, requiring companion chatbot platforms to block minors without parental consent, and requiring bot operators to send periodic user notifications.

title: Student Mental Health
summary: Requires minimum staffing ratios of school psychologists, counselors, social workers and other licensed mental health professionals to students, starting a specified school year.

title: Data Centers
topics: AI and technology; Environment and energy
summary: Requires utilities to set minimum tariff and service terms for large-load customers, bars some water permits for large data centers, and orders a study.

title: Limestone Mining Operations
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Gives the Division of Administrative Hearings exclusive jurisdiction over property damage claims from limestone mining and lets owners start those proceedings.

title: Discrimination in Education
summary: Requires school districts and state colleges and universities to designate Title VI coordinators and lets people file discrimination complaints, including parents for minors.

title: Affordable Property Ad Valorem Tax Exemption for Leased Land
summary: Authorizes certain leased land to qualify for an affordable-housing ad valorem property tax exemption.

title: Transportation
summary: Omnibus transportation bill moving motor carriers to licensing, changing fuel tax reporting, adjusting crash-reporting damage thresholds, and allowing certain license plate frames.

title: Concealed Carry Licensing Requirements for Law Enforcement Officers, Correctional Officers, Correctional Probation Officers, and Military Servicemembers
summary: Lets off-duty correctional probation officers carry concealed firearms at superiors' discretion, and revises exceptions to the 3-day firearm waiting period.

title: Public Records/E-mail Addresses Collected by the Department of Highway Safety for Providing Renewal Notices
summary: Expands the public records exemption for DHSMV-collected email addresses to cover all notification uses and vessel registration notices, with retroactive effect.

title: Mitigation Banks
summary: Revises wetland mitigation bank credit release schedules, bars freshwater wetland credit release until conditions are met, and shortens permit applicants' reliance on credit determinations.

title: Contracting
summary: Revises contracting rules and sets minimum penalties for certain unlawful actions; the summary gives no detail on the activities covered.

title: Aggravated Animal Cruelty
summary: Creates "Dexter's Law" to increase sentences for aggravated animal cruelty and has FDLE post names of violators online.

title: Student Elopement
summary: Requires public schools to create a SAFE Team and an elopement plan, plus student-specific quick reference guides for certain students.

title: Timeshare Management Firms
summary: Revises conflict-of-interest and management rules for community associations and timeshare condominiums, and requires their boards to meet once a year.

title: Protection of Historic Monuments and Memorials
summary: Preempts local removal or damage to historic Florida monuments and memorials, voids contrary local rules, penalizes officials, and allows temporary relocation under conditions.

title: Trust Fund Interest for Purposes Approved by the Supreme Court
summary: Lets financial institutions hold trust-account funds for Supreme Court-approved purposes, requires a minimum interest rate, and mandates quarterly CFO rate affidavits.

title: School Zone and Pedestrian Safety
summary: Requires design and construction plans for school-zone and certain road crosswalks to include specified traffic control devices.

title: Nature-based Methods for Improving Coastal Resilience
summary: Establishes the flood hub at USF, requires it to develop green and gray infrastructure design standards, directs DEP to adopt nature-based coastal resilience rules, and appropriates $250,000.

title: Veterans Affairs
summary: Revises veterans treatment court admissions, lets the multidisciplinary team set eligibility, allows sentencing courts to divert defendants, and makes program completion a probation or community control condition.

title: Spectrum Alert
summary: Creates a Spectrum Alert system for missing children with autism, with FDLE training and alert programs, funded by a $190,000 appropriation.

title: Security for Statewide Constitutional Office Candidates
summary: Requires the Department of Law Enforcement to give certain statewide constitutional office candidates a protective security detail for a set period.

title: Animal Cruelty Offenses
summary: Revises animal cruelty offenses, defines "domestic animal," and adjusts criminal punishment scoring; the provided text gives no details.

title: Concurrent Legislative Jurisdiction over United States Military Installations
summary: Accepts concurrent state legislative jurisdiction with the federal government over certain juvenile delinquency matters on military installations and gives circuit courts jurisdiction over them.

title: Department of Transportation Construction Projects
summary: Revises the percentage of certain DOT construction contract amounts that must be allocated to purchasing plant materials.

title: Code Inspector Body Cameras
summary: Lets code inspectors wear body cameras if their agency sets policies, training, retention and periodic review, and exempts those recordings from wiretap interception rules.

title: Graduation Requirements for English for Speakers of Other Languages Program Students
summary: Lets certain ESOL program students meet the Algebra I end-of-course assessment requirement in a specified alternative manner for graduation.

title: Public Records/Body Camera Recordings Recorded by a Code Inspector
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Exempts certain code inspector body camera recordings from public records requirements, requires local governments to retain them for a set period, and sets future repeal review.

title: Family Empowerment Scholarship Program
summary: Requires private schools in the Family Empowerment Scholarship Program to give certain parents written information before a student's first enrollment, and sets some service requirements.

title: Landscape Irrigation
topics: Environment and energy; Labor and employment
summary: Creates landscape irrigation standards and a watering schedule, and limits irrigation system work and water-supply connections to licensed contractors or owners.

title: Heat Illness Prevention
summary: Requires certain employers to adopt an approved outdoor heat exposure safety program and provide annual heat illness training.

title: Educator Certifications and Training
summary: Requires teacher preparation programs and certified educators to receive training on mass casualty incidents, with the Department of Education approving training options.

title: Medical Marijuana Edibles
summary: Revises packaging and labeling requirements for medical marijuana edibles in Florida; the summary gives no detail on the changes.

title: Funding for the Voluntary Prekindergarten Education Program
summary: Revises VPK funding and the base student allocation calculation, and requires the Division of Early Learning to publish specified information annually.

title: Medical Review Committees
summary: Revises the definition of medical review committee and conforming discovery and evidence provisions in civil and administrative actions.

title: Doula Support for Healthy Births Pilot Program
summary: Creates a Department of Health doula support pilot in three South Florida counties, subject to appropriation, and a task force on doula certification.

title: Complaints Against Law Enforcement and Correctional Officers
summary: Requires officers under investigation to receive a sworn copy of the complaint before personnel action, and penalizes false complaints.

title: Domestic Violence Centers
summary: Bars DCF and courts from treating a parent's temporary stay in a certified domestic violence center as grounds for an unfavorable home study or child removal.

title: Transportation Facility Contractors
summary: Lets FDOT enter construction, maintenance and operation agreements with contractors, and states those contractors do not act for the department under public records requirements.

title: Products Liability Actions Under the Florida Pesticide Law
summary: Bars product liability lawsuits against pesticide makers for failure to warn when the product label meets specified conditions.

title: School Buses
summary: Expands the legal definition of "school bus" to include vehicles transporting students to and from charter schools, for traffic control and driver license purposes.

title: Security Services at Places of Worship
topics: Guns and weapons; Labor and employment
summary: Exempts certain volunteers who provide armed security at places of worship from security licensure requirements.

title: Curators of Estates
summary: Revises when courts appoint curators for certain estates and sets curator authority, duties, custody requirements, and removal and surcharge rules.

title: Public Records/State Retirement Plan/Division of Retirement
summary: Creates a public records exemption for records identifying participants in state retirement plans, repeals a limited retirement-records exemption, and sets future review.

title: Sickle Cell Care Management and Treatment Education
summary: Requires health care licensing boards to add a 2-hour sickle cell disease care management course to biennial license renewals, with multi-license holders able to use one course.

title: Motor Vehicle Insurance
summary: Repeals Florida's no-fault auto insurance law and revises minimum liability coverage and related motor vehicle policy requirements, with a $83,651 appropriation.

title: Newborn Screenings
summary: Requires Department of Health rules to mandate newborn screening for Duchenne muscular dystrophy, subject to legislative appropriation.

title: Department of Law Enforcement
summary: Omnibus Department of Law Enforcement bill covering medal rules, medical examiner appointments, and fingerprint processing for licensees.

title: Nursing Education Programs
summary: Lets graduate nurses practice under clinical preceptors with provisional licenses, requires preceptorship standards, and revises program approval and reporting rules.

title: Construction Regulations
summary: Revises construction rules: sets commercial permit acceptance standards, requires higher flood elevation for new nonresidential buildings, adds mitigation products to statewide approval, and reduces certain permit fees.

title: Political Polls
summary: Requires political polls to include a specified phrase and makes violations a criminal offense.

title: Manufacturing
summary: Creates a Chief Manufacturing Officer and a manufacturers' workforce development grant program within the Department of Commerce, funded from the Economic Development Trust Fund.

title: Assessments Levied on Recreational Vehicle Parks
summary: Bars local governments and special districts from levying non-ad valorem assessments on certain portions of RV park spaces or campsites, and requires considering park occupancy rates.

title: State Lotteries
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Revises Lottery Department powers and procurement disclosure, lets Security sworn officers buy and present tickets to claim prizes, and bans false lottery ticket claims.

title: Toll Payments
summary: Exempts certain disabled veterans and vehicles displaying specified license plates from paying tolls on toll facilities.

title: Clerks of the Court
summary: Lets clerks of court use excess funds for combined budgets and sets foreclosure sale procedures, with only clerks conducting foreclosure sales.

title: Animal Cruelty
summary: Prohibits confining an animal in an unattended motor vehicle under certain circumstances and creates criminal penalties for violations.

title: Hunger-Free Campus Pilot Program
summary: Creates a subject-to-appropriation pilot program through the Department of Agriculture to address food insecurity at three high-Pell-eligibility state universities or colleges.

title: Criteria for Determining Criminal Gang Membership
summary: Revises the legal definition and criteria for who counts as a criminal gang member and defines 'gang-related language.'

title: State Courts System
summary: Requires at least one circuit judge per circuit to be available for limited-notice hearings, and makes several court administrative and procedural changes.

title: Extracurricular Activities
summary: Revises student eligibility for interscholastic and intrascholastic activities, limits two-school participation in a year, requires eligibility records, allows activity fees, and authorizes funding policies.

title: Criminal Offenses
summary: Revises the definitions of harass, course of conduct and cyberstalk, adds penalties for harassing justice personnel, and changes aggravated stalking elements.

title: Use of Substances Affecting Cognitive Function
summary: Requires autopsies of violent offenders to report substance findings, lets patient records go to police without authorization, and mandates school staff training on substance effects.

title: Disability History and Awareness Instruction
summary: Requires the Department of Education to develop disability history and awareness curricula, and lets it consult the Evin B. Hartsell Foundation on them.

title: Office of Financial Regulation
topics: AI and technology; Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Requires mortgage and money services businesses to adopt written information security programs, adds disciplinary grounds for loan originators, and has OFR aid DCF on adult financial exploitation probes.

title: Decreasing Racial and Ethnic Disparities in Mental Health and Substance Abuse Services
summary: Revises Closing the Gap grant priorities to favor projects addressing racial and ethnic disparities in mental health and substance use services and outcomes.

title: Naturopathy
summary: Creates a Board of Naturopathy within the Department of Health and sets licensure requirements, permitted titles, and scope-of-practice limits for naturopaths.

title: Foster Care Payments
summary: Authorizes foster care payments to relatives or nonrelatives who obtain a child-specific Level I foster license within a specified timeframe.

title: Golf Courses
summary: Creates a golf course best management practices certification act and transfers the certification program from DEP to the Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services.

title: Home Cultivation of Marijuana
summary: Lets qualified medical patients apply for a certificate to grow up to two cannabis plants at home, with state rules and plant registration.

title: Conservation Lands
summary: Requires public website posting of information before boards review proposed sales or exchanges of conservation lands, and sets appraisal criteria for exchanges.

title: Carrying Concealed Weapons and Firearms in Courthouses
summary: Lets judges and magistrates carry concealed weapons and firearms into any courthouse in their circuit, revising the list of prohibited places.

title: Growth Management
summary: Adds procedural requirements for local comprehensive plan coordination, interlocal agreements, impact fee studies, and limits on certain data use by local governments.

title: Investments of Public Funds in Bitcoin
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Authorizes state investment of public funds, including pension trust funds, in Bitcoin and digital assets, exempt from certain security requirements.

title: Medical Marijuana
summary: Adds qualifying medical conditions for medical marijuana, lengthens physician evaluation intervals, and creates nonresident visitor registration procedures.

title: Prohibition on Levying Ad Valorem Taxes on Tangible Personal Property
summary: Bars counties, school districts and municipalities from levying ad valorem taxes on tangible personal property, conforming to a proposed constitutional amendment, and repeals related filing provisions.

title: Insurance Practices
summary: Requires insurers to give policyholders written loss estimates and the OIR to report on insurer affiliates and executive pay, and revises rate-review factors.

title: Nonprofit Corporations
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Revises the Florida Not For Profit Corporation Act, renaming it, adjusting document correction and name registration rules, and restating nonprofit distribution limits.

title: Resale-restricted Affordable Housing
summary: Requires owners of resale-restricted affordable housing to apply to the property appraiser and sets how that housing is assessed for property tax.

title: Requirements for a Standard High School Diploma
summary: Lets students substitute marching band experience for physical education and performing fine arts credits, and lets students with disabilities meet PE through Special Olympics.

title: Contracts for Postadoption Contact
summary: Allows adoptive and birth parties to sign enforceable written contracts for postadoption contact between an adopted child and birth parents and siblings.

title: Standards for Stormwater Systems
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Requires county and municipal stormwater systems to meet specified DOT standards and inspections, and supersedes certain local standards.

title: Geoengineering and Weather Modification Activities
summary: Repeals Florida's weather modification licensing law and prohibits acts intended to alter temperature, weather, or sunlight intensity in the state's atmosphere.

title: Residential Impacts from Mining Activities
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Makes the State Fire Marshal the sole authority over mining-blast explosives rules and requires monitoring and recording of blast sites.

title: Chemical Additives in Food Products
summary: Beginning on a specified date, bans food establishments from making, selling, or distributing food containing specified chemical additives.

title: Child Welfare
summary: Limits when new medical reports are needed for psychotropic medication for children in DCF custody, and requires quarterly coordination meetings between DCF, lead agencies, and partner organizations.

title: Use of Artificial Intelligence to Detect Firearms
topics: AI and technology; Civil rights and liberties
summary: Prohibits using artificial intelligence to detect firearms in public areas and provides criminal penalties for violations.

title: Communication Rights of Individuals with Disabilities
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Health care
summary: Gives people with disabilities a right to communicate in their preferred manner, bars state agencies, schools and health providers from restricting alternative communication methods, and creates an advisory board.

title: Chiropractic Medicine
summary: Expands chiropractic practice to let chiropractic physicians order, store, prescribe and administer certain natural-origin articles, lets pharmacists fill those orders, and revises PIP medical benefit limits.

title: Student Volunteers at Polling Locations
summary: Exempts specified high school students who volunteer to assist poll workers from state rules barring election agencies from accepting personal services.

title: Patient-directed Medical Orders
summary: Creates patient-directed medical orders, lets providers withhold or withdraw life-prolonging procedures without penalty, and requires certain palliative services to continue.

title: Certificate of Title Application Requirements
summary: Adds proof of identification and residency requirements for vehicle certificate of title applications, and lets documents include fingerprints or other biometric identifiers.

title: Swimming Safety
summary: Creates drowning-prevention rules for certain children at public pools and water areas, including information requirements, flotation devices, and county or municipal pilot programs.

title: Managed Care Plans
summary: Bars Medicaid managed care plans from medical-necessity review of certain prior authorization claims and requires coverage of DME from enrollee-chosen qualified providers.

title: Swimming Pool and Spa Contractors
summary: Revises definitions in Florida's construction contractor law (ch. 489, part I) as they apply to swimming pool and spa contractors; the summary gives no operative change.

title: Task Force on Payment Scams
summary: Creates a Task Force on Payment Scams under the Department of Financial Services, with a future repeal and legislative review.

title: Dangerous Dogs
summary: Requires stricter confinement, mandatory confiscation and impoundment, and liability insurance for owners of dangerous dogs, under the Pam Rock Act.

title: Ethics for Public Officers and Employees
summary: Expands the definition of relative to include foster parents and children, while exempting boards from nepotism limits on appointing related elected officials to leadership roles.

title: Toll Exemptions for Purple Heart Medal Recipients
summary: Adds holders of Purple Heart special license plates and motorcycle plates to the groups eligible for toll exemptions.

title: Recruitment and Retention of Speech-language Pathologists
summary: Requires the Department of Education to create and maintain a statewide plan for recruiting and retaining speech-language pathologists, with districts submitting data.

title: Service of Process
summary: Expands registered agent office hours for service of process, allows personal service on receivers during receivership, and revises substituted service requirements.

title: Local Government Cybersecurity
topics: AI and technology; Government and administration
summary: Creates a Florida Digital Service cybersecurity protection program and grant for local governments, with data-sharing agreements and state IT contracting.

title: Wine Containers
summary: Revises an exception to the maximum allowable container size for wine sold in Florida; the summary does not say whether it loosens or tightens the limit.

title: Alzheimer’s Disease Awareness Initiative
summary: Requires the Department of Elderly Affairs to contract for an Alzheimer's Disease Awareness Initiative and sets requirements for the contractor.

title: Boating Safety
summary: Adds a lifetime boating safety ID card symbol, raises penalties for reckless vessel operation causing serious injury, and revises boating under the influence offenses.

title: Animal Cremation
summary: Creates Sevilla's Law, requiring companion animal cremation providers to give written service descriptions and certify returned remains, with civil penalties for violations.

title: Persons Authorized to Solemnize Matrimony
summary: Authorizes members of the Legislature to solemnize marriages, adding them to the persons who may perform wedding ceremonies.

title: Local Licensing of Home Caregivers
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Authorizes counties and municipalities to create their own licensing requirements for home caregivers within their jurisdictions.

title: Unlawful Demolition of Historical Buildings and Structures
summary: Lets code enforcement boards or special magistrates impose higher fines for unlawfully demolishing certain historical buildings, capped at a percentage of market value.

title: Required Reports of the Office of Insurance Regulation
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Requires the Office of Insurance Regulation to create reports on insurers and licensees, including executive compensation, and declares certain underlying data not trade secrets.

title: Young Adult Housing Support
summary: Requires college and university housing plans to prioritize certain students, directs agencies to administer federal foster youth housing vouchers, and orders an OPPAGA study of young adult housing barriers.

title: Commercial Driving Schools
summary: Authorizes DHSMV to delegate certain functions to tax collectors through interagency agreements, which may include broad grants of authority.

title: Actions by Condominium Associations
summary: Revises the time limits within which condominium associations may bring legal actions.

title: Repair of Mobility Devices
summary: Requires manufacturers of mobility devices to make repair documentation, parts, and tools available, with violations treated as unfair trade practices.

title: Campaign Communications
topics: Consumer protection and business; Elections and voting
summary: Prohibits campaign-related calls and texts to specified voters, requires immediate cessation when voters opt out, and lets voters sue to enforce.

title: Local Government Enforcement Actions
summary: Prohibits certain enforcement actions by counties, municipalities, and special districts, requires them to adopt rules, and allows legal action against violations.

title: State Board of Administration
summary: Revises fiduciary standards for the Florida Retirement System Investment Plan, cancellation timing for certain financial instruments, and State Board of Administration investment limits.

title: Statute of Limitations Period for Violations Involving Required Reports Concerning Children
summary: Delays the start of the statute of limitations for violations of required child-related reporting until a law enforcement agency becomes aware of the violation.

title: My Safe Florida Condominium Pilot Program
summary: Limits My Safe Florida Condominium grants to certain buildings and to improvements that yield insurance mitigation credits, with verification at final inspection.

title: Specialty License Plates/Miami Carol City Senior High School Alumni
summary: Directs the Department of Highway Safety and Motor Vehicles to create a Miami Carol City Senior High School Alumni license plate and sets how its fees are distributed.

title: Anchoring or Mooring at Seaports
summary: Lets certain seaports ask FWC to prohibit anchoring or mooring in set boundary areas, with annual boundary reviews.

title: Local Housing Assistance Plans
summary: Lets counties and eligible cities use housing assistance funds for mobile home lot rent and repairs, and requires plans to include related strategies.

title: Cardiac Services Providers
summary: Revises licensure requirements for Level I and II adult cardiovascular programs and requires AHCA to update rules as new industry standards are published.

title: Transparency in Health Care
summary: Requires health care practitioners to report personal benefits from pharmaceutical companies to the Department of Health, which would create a public online database of the reports.

title: Enhanced Firearms Training Facilities
summary: Creates licensure procedures for enhanced firearms training facilities, lets sheriffs train school guardians there, and exempts licensed facilities from certain local requirements.

title: Funeral, Cemetery, and Consumer Services
topics: Consumer protection and business; Labor and employment
summary: Bans funeral and cemetery licensees from certain contracts, tightens funeral director education requirements, revises embalmer endorsement rules, and lets providers dispose of unclaimed remains.

title: Relief of Jose Correa by Miami-Dade County
summary: Appropriates $4.1 million from state funds to compensate Jose Correa for injuries caused by a Miami-Dade County employee's negligence.

title: Relief of L.E. by the Department of Children and Families
summary: Appropriates $3.8 million to compensate L.E. for injuries caused by the Department of Children and Families' negligence, with limits on compensation and attorney fees.

title: Combatting Illegal Immigration, Terrorist Organizations, and Transnational Organized Crime and Their Illegal Immigrant Participants
summary: Expands criminal gang definitions, adds penalty enhancements for specified purposes, subjects related proceeds and property to forfeiture, and creates criminal penalties for leading hate, terrorist, or transnational criminal groups.

title: Medical Freedom
summary: Bans vaccine financial incentives for practitioners and requires providers to give parents specified materials before vaccinating minors.

title: Child Welfare
summary: Requires DCF investigators to verify custody arrangements in investigations, schools to enforce custody orders and parenting plans, and removes good-faith presumption for anonymous reports.

title: Criminal Conflict and Civil Regional Counsel Membership in the Senior Management Service Class
summary: Makes Senior Management Service Class membership compulsory for regional counsel assistant supervisors and appropriates $950,000.

title: Manufacturing
summary: Creates a Chief Manufacturing Officer in the Department of Commerce, requires a manufacturing report, and creates a manufacturers' workforce development grant program.

title: Bail Bonds
summary: Shortens bail bond agent prelicensing course requirements, requires specified means for monetary pretrial release conditions, and has clerks discharge bonds upon pretrial detention revocation.

title: Fees/Florida Manufacturing Promotional Campaign
topics: Consumer protection and business; Taxes and budget
summary: Requires the Department of Commerce to collect an annual fee from manufacturers to fund a voluntary Florida manufacturing promotional campaign, deposited into the Economic Development Trust Fund.

title: Watercraft Restrictions Based on Energy Source
summary: Creates an exception to the ban on state and local restrictions on watercraft based on energy source, allowing such limits on certain bodies of water.

title: Residential Swimming Pool Requirements
summary: Requires residential pools to meet safety and barrier requirements when the property is sold or transferred, with reporting duties and a criminal penalty.

title: Portable Benefits Accounts for Independent Contractors and Sole Proprietors
summary: Creates a voluntary portable benefits account system for independent contractors and sole proprietors, and bars using contributions as a worker classification criterion.

title: Public Lodging and Public Food Service Establishments
summary: Revises guest-removal notice rules for lodging and food service businesses and requires food service establishments charging operations charges to disclose them on bills and receipts.

title: Drowning Prevention Education
summary: Requires the Department of Health to develop drowning prevention and safe bathing materials, which hospitals and birth providers must give to new parents.

title: Gulf of America
summary: Renames the Gulf of Mexico as the Gulf of America throughout the Florida Statutes, with no change to policy.

title: Vacation Rentals
summary: Requires vacation rental license applicants and renewals to install a pool safety feature where a pool exists, with DBPR able to suspend, revoke or fine noncompliant licensees.

title: Mental Health Support Residences
summary: Declares that converting certain dwellings into mental health support residences is not a change in occupancy under the building code or a reclassification under the fire code.

title: Residential Swimming Pool Requirements
summary: Requires residential swimming pools to meet pool safety and barrier requirements when the property is sold or transferred after a specified date.

title: Unlawful Distribution of Controlled Substances Resulting in Death
summary: Creates a third-degree murder offense for unlawfully distributing controlled substances, including fentanyl analogs, that result in death.

title: Construction Disruption Assistance
summary: Creates a Department of Commerce revolving loan program giving financial assistance to small businesses hurt by nearby construction zones, plus a promotional campaign.

title: Public Education of Background Screening Requirements
summary: Requires AHCA and FDLE to create and maintain a public webpage educating people about care provider background screening requirements, and to link to it.

title: Parole for Long-term Prisoners
summary: Makes certain long-term prisoners parole eligible under specified conditions, sets parole conditions, and directs disposition of savings from the program.

title: Damages Recoverable in Wrongful Death Actions
summary: Removes a bar on adult children and parents of adult children recovering certain wrongful death damages in medical negligence suits.

title: Florida Highway Patrol Body Camera Use
summary: Requires Florida Highway Patrol members to wear functioning body cameras in certain situations, sets DHSMV policies and training, and appropriates $2 million.

title: Community-based Care Lead Agency and Subcontractor Liability
summary: Lowers tort damage limits and insurance minimums for child welfare lead agencies and their subcontractors, shielding them from liability above specified aggregate amounts.

title: Workers’ Compensation Insurance
summary: Limits when workers' compensation insurers may charge excess rates and revises the guaranty association's board composition.

title: Resilient Buildings
summary: Defines resilient buildings, makes their owners eligible for a tax credit with an application deadline, and creates an advisory council within DBPR.

title: Candidate Qualification
summary: Requires candidates to be registered with a party, or with no affiliation, for 365 consecutive days before qualifying, and lets candidates or parties sue to enforce it.

title: Specialty License Plates/Miami Dade College and St. Petersburg College
summary: Directs the Department of Highway Safety and Motor Vehicles to create Miami Dade College and St. Petersburg College specialty license plates and distribute their fees.

title: Candidate Qualifying
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Revises candidate qualifying: federal candidates must state stock-trading intentions, dual citizenship must be disclosed for some offices, and congressional petition signature thresholds are set.

title: Jai Alai Permitholders
summary: Lets pari-mutuel permitholders lease jai alai facilities to other permitholders nearby and apply for a license, while barring cardrooms and slot machines there.

title: Conditional Geriatric Release
summary: Creates a conditional geriatric release program letting the Commission on Offender Review release eligible elderly inmates, considering public safety and housing costs.

title: Forwarding Agents
summary: Defines an electronic database term and limits when dealer registration applications can be required, and requires forwarding agents to surrender certificates in certain cases.

title: Batterers’ Intervention Program Activities
summary: Authorizes batterers' intervention programs to offer supplemental faith-based activities to participants.

title: Council on the Social Status of Black Men and Boys
summary: Lowers the quorum for the Council on the Social Status of Black Men and Boys to nine members and allows remote attendance counted toward quorum.

title: School Attendance Immunizations
summary: Revises which communicable diseases require immunization for school attendance, without stating whether requirements are added or removed.

title: Boating Safety
summary: Revises boating safety laws, increasing penalties for vessel collisions and reckless operation, requiring license suspensions and boater safety education for certain violations.

title: Transportation Facility Designations
summary: Gives honorary designations to certain transportation facilities in specified counties and a municipality, and directs DOT to erect markers.

title: Review of Compensation for Legislators and Cabinet Members
summary: Requires OPPAGA to research and report on compensation for legislators and Cabinet members, without changing any pay rules.

title: Administrative Efficiency in Public Schools
summary: Streamlines district school administration by exempting boards from some rule-adoption steps, dropping an internal auditor requirement, and changing teacher pay and hiring rules.

title: Treatment of Chronic and Terminal Illnesses
summary: Lets chronically and terminally ill patients, with provider guidance, choose their treatment, and lets compounding pharmacies obtain certain active ingredients for it.

title: Transportation Network Company, Driver, and Vehicle Owner Insurance
summary: Revises automobile insurance requirements for transportation network companies, their drivers, and vehicle owners; the summary gives no direction.

title: Land Use and Zoning
summary: Lets local governments regulate or prohibit single-family hybrid residential use in land use categories while allowing owner use.

title: Rates for Citizens Property Insurance Corporation Coverage
summary: Exempts new Citizens Property Insurance policies, and their renewals, from the caps on annual rate increases.

title: Motor Vehicles Using the Furthermost Left-hand Lane
summary: Prohibits drivers from using the furthermost left-hand lane on specified roadways, with exceptions, and requires DOT to designate those roadways and install signage.

title: Beach Management
summary: Requires DEP to review data for beach critical-erosion designations and mandates designation of certain beaches meeting specified criteria; also revises critical state concern areas.

title: Home Inspectors
summary: Revises home inspector exam and disclosure rules and requires inspectors to carry a specified errors and omissions insurance policy.

title: Condominium Associations
summary: Requires condo associations to keep turnover certificates and annual reports in official records, file turnover certificates with the Division, and the Division to maintain a searchable database.

title: Electronic Monitoring Devices in Long-term Care Facilities
summary: Lets nursing home and assisted living residents or their representatives install electronic monitoring devices in rooms, with protections against facility retaliation.

title: Medical Review Committees
summary: Revises the statutory definition of 'medical review committee'; the summary gives no detail on any change in obligations or permissions.

title: Retail Sale of Ephedrine and Related Compounds
summary: Creates rules for retail sales of ephedrine and related compounds, including an electronic recordkeeping system, and provides criminal penalties.

title: Senior Management Service Class
summary: Lets the Chief Justice place certain judicial branch managerial positions, and Judicial Qualifications Commission executive director and general counsel, into the Senior Management Service Class of the Florida Retirement System.

title: Fees/Retail Sale of Ephedrine and Related Compounds
summary: Requires retailers selling ephedrine products to pay monthly fees to the electronic recordkeeping system administrator, with criminal penalties for nonpayment.

title: Foreign and Alien Bail Bond Insurers
summary: Requires certain foreign and alien bail bond insurers to report bail bond premiums to the Office of Insurance Regulation, keep records of payments, and disclose related financial information.

title: Dual Enrollment Student Eligibility
summary: Makes students enrolled in adult education programs eligible for dual enrollment, expanding who can take college courses while in high school or adult education.

title: Attorney Fees, Suit Money, and Costs
summary: Authorizes courts to award, deny, or reduce attorney fees, suit money, and costs in appellate proceedings.

title: Drug Paraphernalia
summary: Revises the definition of drug paraphernalia to exclude certain narcotic-drug-testing products, so possessing them would no longer count as paraphernalia.

title: Diabetes Prevention and Obesity Treatment Act
summary: Requires Florida's Medicaid agency to cover diabetes prevention programs for eligible recipients and certain obesity treatments, and to seek federal approval if needed.

title: Medicaid Reimbursement for Private Duty Nursing Services
summary: Requires Medicaid managed care plans to reimburse licensed home health agencies for private duty nursing in community group homes at a set rate and negotiate rates annually.

title: Hazardous Walking Conditions
summary: Revises the criteria used to determine whether a walking route is hazardous for public school students; the text does not say how.

title: Local Business Taxes
summary: Repeals provisions on local business taxes while letting certain counties keep imposing a business tax and revise the merchant definition, without changing rates.

title: Veterinary Professional Associates
summary: Creates a veterinary professional associate role that may perform certain duties only under a licensed veterinarian's supervision, barred from prescribing controlled drugs or surgery.

title: Mobile Homes
summary: Revises mobile home park owners' general obligations and authorizes local governments to adopt and enforce local codes or ordinances for specified purposes.

title: Transportation Facility Designations/Heroes Memorial Overpass
summary: Designates a transportation facility as the Heroes Memorial Overpass in a specified county, an honorary commemorative designation.

title: Traffic Infraction Enforcement
summary: Revises school zone speed camera enforcement periods, bans traffic detectors for remote surveillance, and requires school board authorization and public hearings for school bus cameras.

title: Health Care Billing and Collection Activities
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Revises the definition of extraordinary collection action and lets licensed facilities use such actions in certain circumstances.

title: Internet Crimes Against Children Programs
summary: Renames and expands a state grant program for internet crimes against children, revising its purpose, authorized uses, and creating a task force funding program.

title: Waiver or Release of Liens
summary: Revises construction lien waiver and release forms so a lienor can condition the waiver on receipt of funds rather than on payment by check.

title: Water Safety Requirements for the Rental of Residential and Vacation Properties
summary: Requires landlords and licensed vacation rentals to install specified water safety features, adds certificate-of-compliance filings for vacation rentals, and sets criminal penalties.

title: Firefighter Benefits
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Adds acute myeloid leukemia to the statutory definition of cancer, expanding cancer treatment benefits for firefighters.

title: Self-storage Spaces
summary: Revises self-storage lien notice rules and requires rental agreements entered on or after a set date to include specified information.

title: Prohibition of Pyramid Promotional Schemes
summary: Bans pyramid promotional schemes and lets the Department of Legal Affairs issue cease and desist orders, with court-appointed receivers available.

title: Community-based Care Lead Agency and Subcontractor Liability
summary: Revises when community-based care lead agencies and their subcontractors can be held liable in tort for officer, employee, or subcontractor acts.

title: Transportation Facility Designations/Harry Frisch Street
summary: Designates a transportation facility in a specified county as Harry Frisch Street, an honorary naming with no policy effect.

title: Corporal Punishment
summary: Prohibits school district employees from using corporal punishment on public school students.

title: Transportation Facility Designations/Congresswoman Frederica S. Wilson Boulevard
summary: Designates a Miami-Dade road segment as Congresswoman Frederica S. Wilson Boulevard and directs DOT to erect markers.

title: Rent of Affordable Housing Dwelling Units
summary: Defines affordable housing and base rent, and bars certain landlords from raising a unit's base rent during an existing rental agreement.

title: Specialty License Plates/Miami Northwestern Alumni Association
summary: Directs the Department of Highway Safety and Motor Vehicles to develop a Miami Northwestern Alumni Association specialty license plate with specified design elements.

title: Performance Reports of Circuit and County Court Judges
summary: Requires circuit court clerks to publish annual performance reports on each circuit and county judge, and lets judges add explanatory statements.

title: Storage and Disposal of Prescription Drugs and Sharps
summary: Requires a state study of safe sharps disposal, sets requirements for facilities holding prescription drugs for destruction, and appropriates $200,000.

title: Physician Assistants
summary: Creates a registration pathway letting physician assistants practice without physician supervision, with financial responsibility and patient-disclosure requirements.

title: Instructional Personnel and School Administrator Salaries
summary: Creates the Save Our Teachers Act, raising minimum base salaries for certain teachers and setting district salary structure and schedule requirements.

title: Right of Medical Conscience of Health Care Providers and Health Care Payors
summary: Creates a medical conscience right for health care providers and payors, and lets them sue if the Attorney General does not act on a violation.

title: Acupuncture
summary: Revises acupuncturist licensure requirements, eliminates certain examination fees, and changes continuing education requirements for acupuncturists.

title: Bonuses for Employees of County Tax Collectors and Property Appraisers
summary: Authorizes specified county tax collectors and property appraisers to budget for and pay bonuses to their employees, subject to a specified approval.

title: Grandparent Visitation Rights
summary: Lets grandparents of a minor child petition a court for court-ordered visitation in certain circumstances.

title: Minimum Wage Requirements
summary: Creates exceptions to Florida's state minimum wage requirement, letting certain employees opt out by waiver, with a parent signing for minors.

title: Animal Welfare
summary: Creates new offenses for enticing minors into animal cruelty or fighting, mandates evaluations and counseling for minors, posts offender info online, and raises civil penalties.

title: Pawnbroker Transaction Forms
summary: Allows pawnbroker transaction forms to be kept in digital or printed format and revises related recordkeeping requirements.

title: Deductions for Certain Losses of Alcoholic Beverages
topics: Consumer protection and business; Taxes and budget
summary: Lets alcohol distributors take an excise tax deduction for unsellable or unfit beverages and requires immediate notice of extraordinary losses.

title: Health Facilities
summary: Broadens health facility definitions and lets health facilities authorities issue loans, and makes a hospital's confirmation test optional rather than required.

title: Health Care Patient Protection
summary: Requires hospitals with emergency departments to adopt emergency policies, conduct training, and meet AHCA rules for emergency management plans.

title: Individualized Investigational Treatments for Life-threatening or Severely Debilitating Illnesses
summary: Lets eligible patients with life-threatening or severely debilitating illnesses request individualized investigational treatments, shields heirs from related debt, and bars state interference.

title: Electric Vehicle Charging Taxation
summary: Exempts electricity sold to owners or operators of EV charging stations from sales and use tax, with affidavit and penalty provisions.

title: Recording of Protective Investigations
summary: Requires audio and video recording of certain protective investigator interviews, and limits remedies when a recording is missing.

title: Domestic Violence and Protective Injunctions
summary: Adds enhanced penalties for repeat domestic violence offenders, allows or requires electronic monitoring orders, revises injunction petitions, and raises victim relocation assistance caps.

title: Credit for Military Service
summary: Revises how military service counts as creditable service and the definition of veteran, including more recent wartime periods, for public retirement credit.

title: Electronic Signatures Associated with Total Loss Vehicles and Vessels
summary: Requires insurers and their agents to set control processes for certain electronic signatures on total loss vehicle and vessel documents, and removes a specified execution method for odometer disclosures.

title: Specialty License Plates/K9s for Warriors
summary: Directs the state to create a K9s for Warriors specialty license plate and distributes the plate's sale fees to the organization.

title: Agricultural Enclaves
summary: Lets landowners seek local certification of agricultural enclave parcels, which could then be developed for commercial, industrial, or single-family residential use.

title: Canine Support Grant Program for First Responders
summary: Creates a jointly administered grant program for canine support for first responders, with support dog requirements.

title: Naturopathic Medicine
summary: Creates a Board of Naturopathic Medicine, bars unlicensed people from practicing naturopathy, and sets licensure by examination and endorsement.

title: Condominium Structural Integrity Reserve Studies
summary: Defines a structural integrity reserve study and requires condo associations of a specified building height to conduct one; shorter buildings are exempt.

title: Family Empowerment Scholarship Program
summary: Requires private schools participating in the Family Empowerment Scholarship Program to give specified written information to certain parents before a student's first enrollment.

title: Swimming Lesson Voucher Program
summary: Revises the Swimming Lesson Voucher Program's vendor contract requirements and participant eligibility criteria.

title: Cybersecurity Standards and Liability
topics: AI and technology; Government and administration
summary: Bars local governments from imposing certain cybersecurity standards on vendors and shields compliant covered entities from liability for cybersecurity incidents.

title: Cold Case Murders
summary: Requires law enforcement to review cold murder cases on written application, reinvestigate certain cases, provide training, and report data to FIU's Global Forensic and Justice Center.

title: Compensation of the Descendants of Charles Greenlee, Walter Irvin, Samuel Shepherd, and Ernest Thomas
summary: Appropriates $4 million from General Revenue to the Department of State as relief for descendants of four men, the Groveland Four.

title: Grants for Low-income Senior Citizen Condominium Unit Owners
summary: Directs the Florida Housing Finance Corporation to create rules and a capped grant program for low-income senior condominium unit owners.

title: Registration of Trademarks
summary: Updates Florida trademark registration to use the international schedule of goods and services classes and adds an online application and renewal system run by the Department of State.

title: Timely Filing of Tax Returns
summary: Requires certain tax rules to treat a return as timely filed when it meets specified requirements.

title: Onsite Sewage Treatment and Disposal System Permits
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration; Housing
summary: Bars local governments from requiring DEP septic-system construction permits before issuing building or plumbing permits, and shifts specified liabilities to applicants and owners.

title: Instructional Hours for the Voluntary Prekindergarten Education Program
summary: Revises the instructional hours required in the Voluntary Prekindergarten program for school-year and summer programs; the summary does not state the direction of change.

title: Step-therapy Protocols
summary: Requires Florida Medicaid to cover certain serious mental illness drugs without step-therapy prior authorization in specified circumstances, and to account for resulting rate impacts.

title: Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration; Transportation
summary: Omnibus agriculture bill covering agency staffing, agricultural land rules, utility land offers, EV charger permits, and a beef marketing program.

title: States of Emergency
summary: Limits how long a gubernatorially renewed state of emergency lasts, lets the Legislature extend it, and requires quarterly Auditor General updates to a related audit.

title: OGSR/Site-specific Location Information for Endangered and Threatened Species
summary: Removes the scheduled repeal of the public records exemption for site-specific location information on endangered and threatened species, keeping it in effect.

title: OGSR/Persons Provided Public Emergency Shelter
summary: Removes the scheduled repeal so the public records exemption for addresses and phone numbers of people in public emergency shelters continues.

title: Water Management Districts
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Authorizes water management districts to levy certain ad valorem taxes, requires Ethics Commission investigations of prohibited lobbyist expenditures, and requires an Everglades cost report.

title: OGSR/Department of Military Affairs/United States Department of Defense
summary: Extends the repeal date of a public records exemption for Department of Military Affairs information tied to U.S. Department of Defense systems and networks.

title: OGSR/Applicants or Participants in Certain Federal, State, or Local Housing Assistance Programs
summary: Removes the scheduled repeal, so the public records exemption for housing assistance applicants' and participants' property photographs and personal information continues.

title: OGSR/Conviction Integrity Unit Reinvestigation Information
