summary: Removes the scheduled repeal of the public records exemption for conviction integrity unit reinvestigation information, keeping that exemption in place.

title: Public Records and Meetings/NG911 Systems
summary: Expands the public records and public meetings exemptions to cover NG911 system components and extends the exemptions' repeal review date.

title: OGSR/Florida Public Service Commission
summary: Deletes the scheduled repeal of an open-meetings exemption, so Public Service Commission hearings can keep closed portions covering proprietary confidential business information.

title: OGSR/Financial Technology Sandbox
summary: Removes the scheduled repeal of a public records exemption for certain Financial Technology Sandbox records held by the Office of Financial Regulation.

title: OGSR/Florida Gaming Control Commission
summary: Removes the scheduled repeal of a public records and meetings exemption for information the Florida Gaming Control Commission obtains, so the exemption continues.

title: OGSR/Department of Financial Services
summary: Exempts certain Department of Financial Services receivership records from public records requirements, revises the exempt list, and removes the exemption's scheduled repeal.

title: Roth Contribution Plans in Deferred Compensation Programs
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Authorizes state and local government deferred compensation plans to offer Roth contribution options and retroactively ratifies the CFO's earlier Roth contributions.

title: Child Welfare
summary: Omnibus child welfare bill: removes DCF exemption authority for background screening, adds recruitment and treatment foster care pilot programs subject to appropriation, and protects research incentives.

title: OGSR/Department of Highway Safety and Motor Vehicles
summary: Removes the scheduled repeal of several public records exemptions for information the Highway Safety department receives during investigations, keeping those exemptions in place.

title: Trust Funds of the State Courts System
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Terminates the Mediation and Arbitration Trust Fund, transfers its balances to the State Courts Revenue Trust Fund, and closes out its accounts.

title: OGSR/Social Media Platform Investigations
summary: Extends public records exemptions for information received in Attorney General and Department of Legal Affairs investigations into social media platforms, delaying their scheduled repeal.

title: Amendments to the State Constitution
summary: Adds procedural prerequisites before initiative petitions go to the Attorney General and revises criteria for Supreme Court advisory opinions on proposed constitutional amendments.

title: OGSR/Administration of Small Business Loan Programs Held by an Economic Development Agency
summary: Removes the scheduled repeal of a public records exemption for small business loan program administration held by an economic development agency, keeping it in effect.

title: OGSR/Parental Consent Requirements Before Terminating a Pregnancy
summary: Removes the scheduled repeal of the public records exemption protecting identifying information about minors who petition courts to waive parental consent for abortion.

title: Child Welfare
summary: Renames the foster youth workforce pilot as a permanent program, requiring cohorts, mentors, internship placements, and trauma-informed mentor training.

title: Provenance of Digital Content
summary: Requires AI-generated content depicting candidates to carry provenance data, mandates providers apply it, and creates a Division of Emergency Management provenance pilot.

title: Mental Health Programs for Gun Violence Prevention
topics: Children and families; Guns and weapons; Health care
summary: Creates a Gainesville gun violence prevention pilot with mental health services and youth alternatives to incarceration, funded by a $500,000 appropriation.

title: OGSR/Agency Cybersecurity Information
summary: Extends the scheduled repeal date for public records and meetings exemptions protecting state agency cybersecurity information and risk assessments.

title: OGSR/Aquaculture Records Held by the Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services
summary: Removes the scheduled repeal of a public records exemption for certain aquaculture records held by the Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services, so the exemption continues.

title: Retirement
summary: Revises the required employer retirement contribution rates for each membership class and subclass of the Florida Retirement System.

title: Public Records/Examination and Assessment Instruments
summary: Removes a duplicate public records exemption for exam instruments, extends another exemption's repeal date, and requires rules on record retention and disposal.

title: State Planning and Budgeting
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Revises long-range program plan requirements and sets new legislative budget request deadlines for state agencies, the judicial branch, and DOAH.

title: OGSR/Cybersecurity, Information Technology, and Operational Technology Information
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Exempts cybersecurity, IT, and operational technology information held by agencies from public records and meetings requirements, with future legislative review.

title: Information Technology
summary: Creates the Agency for State Systems and Enterprise Technology to govern state IT, set standards, and report on state technology.

title: OGSR/Trade Secret Held by an Agency
summary: Amends a public records exemption for trade secrets held by agencies; the title gives no detail on the change.

title: Cancer
summary: Creates a cancer research collaborative and incubator within the Department of Health to fund cancer innovation grants and research.

title: Retirement
summary: Lets elected officers, other than legislators, keep serving and receive DROP proceeds after a set age, with recoupment rules; also revises Special Risk COLA and disability allocations.

title: Educational Scholarship Programs
summary: Creates a Family Empowerment Scholarship operating fund and an enrollment stabilization program for supplemental K-12 funds, renames Hope Scholarship, and directs cross-checking of student data.

title: Public Records/Investigations by the Department of Legal Affairs
summary: Creates public records exemptions for Department of Legal Affairs information on companion chatbot and bot-related consumer protection investigations, kept confidential after investigations end, subject to future review.

title: Medicaid Enrollment for Permanently Disabled Individuals
summary: Presumes permanently disabled Medicaid enrollees eligible during redetermination, continues payments, and seeks federal authority to exempt them from annual redeterminations.

title: Fleet Management
summary: Removes the Department of Management Services' prior approval for state vehicle, watercraft, and aircraft purchases and lets agencies buy from certain nonstate vendors.

title: Taxation
topics: Children and families; Taxes and budget
summary: Tax package revising agricultural land rules, exempting child care facility property and certain sales, adding an oil and gas credit, and creating a rural investment program.

title: Ratification of Rules of the Department of Environmental Protection
summary: Ratifies a Department of Environmental Protection rule on minimum flows and recovery for the Lower Santa Fe and Ichetucknee Rivers so it can take effect.

title: Education
summary: Omnibus education bill: lets students carry FDA-approved epinephrine delivery devices, lets marching band satisfy two credit requirements, and makes other reporting and curriculum changes.

title: Education
summary: Requires public colleges and universities to waive tuition for eligible Florida State Guard members and requires fee-based services for blind or visually impaired people to disclose free alternatives.

title: Coverage for Ground Ambulance Emergency Services
summary: Requires certain health insurers and HMOs to reimburse out-of-network ground ambulance providers at the lowest of specified rates.

title: Emergency Preparedness and Response Fund/Executive Office of the Governor
summary: Re-creates the Emergency Preparedness and Response Fund in the Governor's office, sets its appropriations and federal reimbursement accounts, and bars using fund money for aircraft, boats, or vehicles.

title: Public Records/Custodians of Gold Coin and Silver Coin
summary: Expands a public records exemption for Office of Financial Regulation investigation information and deferred presentment records to cover money transmitters acting as gold and silver coin custodians.

title: Taxation
summary: Limits local special assessments on RV parking spaces and campsites, bars certain penalties and interest, and revises an ad valorem exemption finding, among other tax changes.

title: Internal Revenue Code
summary: Revises Florida's definition of the Internal Revenue Code for state tax purposes, applies it retroactively, and directs the Department of Revenue to adopt rules.

title: Transportation Facility Designations/Senator James A. Sebesta Memorial Highway
summary: Designates a highway segment in specified counties as the Senator James A. Sebesta Memorial Highway and directs DOT to erect markers.

title: Commercial Service Airports
summary: Preempts local governments' authority to name major commercial service airports, sets state-designated names, and requires annual DOT review of those names.

title: Disclosure of Estimated Ad Valorem Taxes
topics: Consumer protection and business; Housing; Taxes and budget
summary: Requires certain property listings to include estimated ad valorem taxes, with duties for listing platforms, the Department of Revenue, and property appraisers.

title: State Immigration Enforcement Action Database
summary: Creates a searchable public database of immigration enforcement actions and requires law enforcement and private correctional contractors to report detentions and arrests to the State Board of Immigration Enforcement.

title: Public Records/Crime Stoppers Organizations
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Creates a public records exemption for personal identifying and location information of crime stoppers employees, board members and volunteers, with future review and repeal.

title: Underground Utility and Excavation Contractors
summary: Revises the definition of underground utility and excavation contractor and authorizes those contractors to act on underground fire protection piping.

title: Construction Regulations
summary: Requires DEP to set minimum synthetic turf installation standards, sets local price-quote deadlines, bars volume-based bid scoring, and requires elevator support rails.

title: Prohibition of Pyramid Promotional Schemes
summary: Prohibits establishing, promoting, operating, or participating in pyramid promotional schemes, with Department of Legal Affairs cease and desist orders and penalties.

title: Nonopioid Advance Directives
summary: Creates a voluntary nonopioid advance directive form posted by AHCA, and requires health care facilities to post it or link to it.

title: Sexual Offenses by Persons Previously Convicted of Sexual Offenses
summary: Imposes mandatory minimum prison terms for specified sexual offenses committed by registered sexual offenders or sexual predators.

title: Rental Agreements for Residential Tenancies
summary: Extends the rent payment grace period from 3 to 5 days and bars landlords from charging fees or surcharges during that period.

title: Autonomous Practice by a Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist
summary: Expands certified registered nurse anesthetists' authority to perform specified acts and revises staff privilege and practice rules for autonomous APRNs.

title: Water Management
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Bars counties and municipalities from regulating water quality or quantity, pollution, discharges, or wetlands, preempting that authority to the state, and repeals a land management review provision.

title: Use of Campaign Funds for Child Care Expenses
summary: Allows candidates to use campaign account funds for child care expenses, with recordkeeping requirements for those expenditures.

title: Individual Education Plans
summary: Sets timelines for IEP eligibility evaluations, gives parents a right to request provider logs or notes, and requires orientation for newly identified exceptional students.

title: Classroom Teacher Mental Health Care
summary: Requires district school boards to give classroom teachers access to mental health services and mental health days.

title: Resident Status for Tuition Purposes
summary: Bars a person from losing Florida resident status for tuition purposes because of incarceration or similar circumstances.

title: Location of Equipment Owned by Amusement Business Owners
summary: Bars counties and cities from requiring amusement business owners to pay for parking or storing equipment on certain agricultural lands.

title: Condominium Structural Integrity Reserve Studies
summary: Requires condo associations of tall buildings to conduct structural integrity reserve studies; lets certain associations vote to waive or reduce reserve contributions.

title: Property Owner Liability
summary: Makes property owners liable for damage from their trees or shrubs falling onto neighboring property, and allows shared trees to be removed after notice.

title: False Reporting
summary: Makes people who misuse emergency systems or file false police reports liable for prosecution, investigation costs, and restitution.

title: Alternative Sources of Weather Information
summary: Requires the state emergency plan and Division of Emergency Management to evaluate and integrate supplemental weather data and advanced forecasting products.

title: Cannabis Research
summary: Exempts cannabis and its derivatives from Schedule I controlled-substance rules for certain bona fide scientific research.

title: Clerks of the Circuit Court
summary: Makes the clerk of circuit court the county auditor, lets financial institutions give county auditors records without extra court orders, and allows an inspector general credential.

title: Sexual Violence Policies
summary: Requires schools to adopt sexual violence policies and supportive measures, notify specified people, and publish them on websites.

title: County Officers
summary: Aligns compensation of county property appraisers, supervisors of elections, clerks, and comptrollers with tax collectors, using a 5-day workweek basis and proration.

title: Education on Abusive Head Trauma
summary: Requires the Department of Health to adopt evidence-based parent education materials on abusive head trauma and run a phased statewide public education campaign.

title: Actions for Recovery of Damages for Wrongful Death
summary: Deletes a provision barring certain related parties from recovering specified damages in wrongful death suits.

title: Powers of Neighborhood Improvement Districts
summary: Lets neighborhood improvement districts plan, finance, or complete structural safety and building compliance improvements if residents or an advisory council approve.

title: Brownfields
topics: Environment and energy; Taxes and budget
summary: Revises Florida's brownfield program: removes an institutional-controls mapping reporting requirement, changes conditions for claiming site rehabilitation tax credits, and adjusts award timing.

title: Medicaid Coverage of Blood Pressure Monitoring Devices
summary: Requires Florida Medicaid, subject to available funds, to cover validated at-home blood pressure monitors and cuffs for certain recipients.

title: Child Care and Early Learning Providers
topics: Children and families; Government and administration
summary: Revises child care licensing and personnel training standards, exempts preschools from certain municipal special assessments, and expands the inspection-reduction plan to more provider types.

title: Virtual Currency Transfers
summary: Subjects out-of-state defendants to Florida state court jurisdiction when they request that Florida residents transfer virtual currency to accounts outside the state.

title: Universal Free School Breakfast and Lunch Program
summary: Creates a state program, subject to appropriations, to provide free breakfast and lunch to all public school students, and removes existing breakfast mandates.

title: Social Work Licensure Interstate Compact
summary: Joins Florida to a multistate compact so social workers licensed in member states can obtain multistate licenses and practice across state lines.

title: Continuing Education Requirements
summary: Exempts certain building code administrators and inspectors from a continuing education requirement for license renewal.

title: Comprehensive Health Care for Residents
summary: Creates a state "Florida Health Plan" with no enrollee cost-sharing, lets providers participate, and sets payment default penalties.

title: Workforce Education
summary: Makes charter schools eligible for a workforce capitalization grant and changes how many programs must carry money-back guarantees, with new reporting to the State Board.

title: Nursing Licensure
summary: Creates a provisional license pathway for registered and practical nurses, who may practice only under direct supervision; also revises nursing program information on the Board of Nursing website.

title: Arrest Warrants for State Prisoners
summary: Lets state prisoners with unserved warrants file a notice in circuit court, which must schedule a status hearing within a set timeframe.

title: Public Records Requests Made to Law Enforcement Officers
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Bars law enforcement officers from accepting or processing public records requests during certain activities, requires verbal notice, and criminalizes persistent attempts to compel acceptance.

title: Public Records/Medical Examiners
summary: Creates a public records exemption shielding personal identifying and location information of current and former medical examiners and their spouses and children.

title: Notice of Restoration of Voting Rights Information on Sentencing Scoresheets
summary: Requires sentencing scoresheets to include information about restoration of voting rights, and provides the scoresheet to defendants before sentencing.

title: Tax Exemptions for Surviving Spouses of Quadriplegics
summary: Lets surviving spouses of certain quadriplegics carry over a tax exemption in specified circumstances; directs the Department of Revenue to adopt emergency rules.

title: Alternative Plans Review and Building Inspection
summary: Removes local authority to charge an administrative fee when owners or contractors use private providers for plans review or building inspection.

title: Defamation, False Light, and Unauthorized Publication of Name or Likenesses
summary: Requires media to remove allegedly defamatory articles from their websites within a set period, grants due-care immunity to newspaper staff, and treats continued online posting as republication.

title: Taxation of First-time Buyers
summary: Exempts deeds and conveyances of residential property to first-time homebuyers, plus certain buyer-executed documents, from documentary stamp taxes.

title: International Baccalaureate Bonus Funding
summary: Expands the International Baccalaureate bonus funding calculation to include students who earn a minimum grade in a specified course.

title: Heated Tobacco Products
summary: Redefines cigarette and tobacco products and defines heated tobacco products, which would bring them under state tobacco laws; details are not in the text provided.

title: Health Insurance Coverage for Individuals with Developmental Disabilities
summary: Revises the definitions of "autism spectrum disorder" and "eligible individual" in Florida's health insurance coverage provisions for developmental disabilities.

title: Affordable Housing
summary: Lengthens affordability periods for zoning variances, requires certain incentives go to affordable construction, narrows tax-incentive income limits, and exempts first-time homebuyers from doc stamp tax.

title: Autonomous Practice by Certain Psychiatric Nurses
summary: Authorizes certain psychiatric advanced practice registered nurses to practice autonomously, performing specified acts and mental health practice without physician supervision.

title: Justice Administrative Commission
summary: Revises the membership of the Justice Administrative Commission; the summary gives no other details of policy change.

title: Paid Parental Leave
summary: Requires the state to provide paid parental leave to certain state employees for a specified period, and bars the state from refusing such leave.

title: Public Records and Meetings/Social Work Licensure Interstate Compact
summary: Exempts certain Social Work Licensure Compact records and meetings from Florida public records and open meeting requirements, with future review and repeal.

title: State University Student Fee Waivers
summary: Requires state universities to waive specified fees for graduate students who meet a full-time equivalent appointment requirement.

title: Violations of Pretrial Release Conditions for Violent Crimes
summary: Makes willful violation of pretrial release conditions a separate crime for people on release for violent offenses, allows warrantless arrests, and shields officers from certain civil suits.

title: Preventing the Spread of Avian Influenza
summary: Creates a Department of Health task force on avian influenza prevention and requires it to develop recommendations, then dissolves.

title: Offices of Criminal Conflict and Civil Regional Counsel
summary: Sets procedures for appointing conflict counsel from another region, including court notice, judicial economy considerations, and reimbursement documentation subject to appropriation.

title: Food Additives
summary: Requires warning labels on food and drink containing synthetic dyes, with penalties enforced through Department of Agriculture inspections.

title: HIV Prevention Justice Act
summary: Reduces criminal penalties for people with HIV who donate tissue, revises rules on intentional sexual transmission of disease, and changes HIV testing requirements in criminal cases.

title: Registration of Agents and Organizations Associated with Foreign Countries of Concern
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Requires agents of foreign countries of concern and foreign-supported political organizations to register with the Division of Elections and file periodic updates.

title: Waste Management
summary: Preempts local regulation of auxiliary containers to the state, while letting local governments restrict glass containers on public beaches and letting state parks regulate them.

title: Foreign Countries of Concern
summary: Prohibits laboratories from using certain operational or research software made in or by foreign countries of concern, and protects licensees who fail to obtain ownership assurances.

title: Marriage and Family Therapist Licensure by Endorsement
summary: Requires the Board of Clinical Social Work, Marriage and Family Therapy, and Mental Health Counseling to issue licenses by endorsement to certain qualifying applicants.

title: Cybersecurity
summary: Revises state agency cybersecurity risk assessment standards, has the Florida Digital Service support electronic credentials, and requires immediate incident notification to state officials.

title: Public Records
summary: Requires public records custodians to acknowledge and act on requests within set timeframes, bars certain request fees, and sunsets public records exemptions unless reenacted.

title: Diabetes Management in Schools
summary: Authorizes school districts to stock undesignated glucagon, seek donations or grants, and request prescriptions, and requires staff to call emergency services and notify parents after use.

title: Limited Licenses for Portable Electronics or Eyewear Insurance
summary: Extends the limited license for portable electronics insurance to also cover eyewear, and revises related definitions.

title: Electronic Transmittal of Court Orders
summary: Requires clerks to electronically transmit involuntary commitment orders and related summonses and petitions to sheriffs or law enforcement for service.

title: 911 Public Safety Telecommunicator Employment-related Mental or Nervous Injuries
summary: Extends existing first-responder workers' compensation benefits for mental or nervous injuries to 911 public safety telecommunicators.

title: Aggravating Factors for Capital Felonies
summary: Adds a new aggravating factor for capital felonies, such as crimes committed against the head of a state, which increases sentencing severity.

title: Home Cultivation of Marijuana
summary: Lets qualified medical marijuana patients grow up to six flowering cannabis plants at home and buy seeds and clones from licensed treatment centers.

title: Qualifying Medical Conditions for Medical Use of Marijuana
summary: Adds opioid addiction or dependence to Florida's list of qualifying conditions for medical marijuana use.

title: Forensic Services for Certain Defendants
summary: Revises the statutory definition of "forensic client" in the forensic services program for certain criminal defendants; the summary gives no further detail.

title: Relief of the Estate of Mark LaGatta by the Department of Transportation
summary: Appropriates $2.2 million to compensate the Estate of Mark LaGatta for injuries caused by Department of Transportation negligence, with limits on fees.

title: Home Hardening Products
summary: Creates a sales tax exemption for home hardening products on eligible residential property, with a cap and an application process through the Department of Revenue.

title: Doula Support for Healthy Births Pilot Program
summary: Creates a Department of Health pilot program in three South Florida counties to integrate doula support into maternal health services for targeted populations.

title: Government Waste and Misconduct
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Requires audits and a report evaluating all state spending, and creates a Working Floridians Tax Rebate Program paying state funds to EITC recipients.

title: Immigration
summary: Requires all Florida private employers to use E-Verify for new hires and increases penalties, including license suspension and fines, for employing unauthorized workers.

title: Health Care Freedom Act
summary: Repeals state-funding bans on abortion travel and sex-reassignment care and conscience protections, and requires covered entities to give patients written notice of refused services.

title: Platting
summary: Requires certain plat and replat submittals to be administratively approved within set timeframes, with a designated county or municipal administrative authority handling review.

title: Medicaid Coverage of Continuous Glucose Monitors
summary: Requires AHCA to seek federal approval as needed to cover continuous glucose monitors and supplies as Medicaid durable medical equipment.

title: Improvements to Structures on Agricultural Lands
summary: Prohibits property tax assessment of certain agricultural improvements used for specified purposes on qualifying agricultural lands.

title: Trusts
summary: Lets trustees seek discharge after sending a disclosure document, and discharges them if no timely objections are received.

title: Veterans’ Nursing Homes
summary: Defines veteran- and spouse-designated nursing home beds and lets the Veterans' Affairs executive director approve creating or modifying them under set conditions.

title: Health Care
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Lets AHCA authorize database access, lets some assisted living facilities keep licenses in certain cases, requires referral agencies to disclose information, and creates a task force.

title: Policy Cancellations and Nonrenewals by Property Insurers
summary: Prohibits insurers from canceling or nonrenewing property policies on homes damaged by hurricanes or wind until repairs are made or a renewal expires, and adds notice duties.

title: Education
summary: Repeals bans on DEI-related training, pronoun rules, and K-12 instruction on sexual orientation and gender identity, and authorizes DEI programs at colleges and universities.

title: Property Insurer Financial Strength Ratings
summary: Requires the Office of Insurance Regulation's annual reports to include financial strength ratings of property insurers facing delinquency proceedings.

title: Community Rehabilitation Programs
summary: Sets minimum requirements for community rehabilitation programs to get Division of Blind Services agreements and gives qualifying programs priority for program funding.

title: Mandatory Human Reviews of Insurance Claim Denials
topics: AI and technology; Consumer protection and business
summary: Requires insurers' claim denials to be made by qualified humans and bars AI or algorithms from being the sole basis for denying or adjusting claims.

title: Agency for Persons with Disabilities
summary: Requires level 2 background screening for all employees of disability residential facilities and adult day training programs, and directs the agency to gather input and recommend assessment standards.

title: General Permits for Distributed Wastewater Treatment Systems
summary: Authorizes a general permit letting septic systems be replaced with distributed wastewater treatment units, installed after notice to DEP without further agency action.

title: Veterinary Medicine
summary: Creates a veterinary professional associate registration with DBPR, publishes the registrant list, allows rescission, and extends telehealth-based veterinary prescription periods.

title: Electronic Payment of Public Records Fees
summary: Requires agencies subject to public records law to offer an electronic option for paying public records request fees.

title: Locations of Sheriffs’ Offices
summary: Lets sheriffs' offices be located anywhere in the county instead of being required to sit at the county seat.

title: Relief of Marcus Button by the Pasco County School Board
summary: Appropriates $1.2 million to compensate Marcus Button, and his mother, for injuries caused by a Pasco County School Board employee's negligence.

title: Relief of Patricia Ermini by the Lee County Sheriff’s Office
summary: Appropriates $626,770 to compensate Patricia Ermini for injuries from Lee County Sheriff's Office negligence, with a limit on compensation and attorney fees.

title: Combatting Illegal Immigration
summary: Reclassifies certain crimes committed after unlawful reentry into the U.S. to carry enhanced penalties, along with other unspecified immigration provisions.

title: Establishing the Congressional Districts of the State
summary: Redraws Florida's congressional district boundaries using 2020 census data under plan EOGPCRP2026, with provisions on applicability.

title: State Land Management
summary: Creates the State Park Preservation Act, requiring public hearings on land management plans, advisory group input for state park parcel plans, and compliance rules for park leases and permits.

title: Safe Storage of Firearms and Ammunition in Motor Vehicles and Vessels
summary: Requires people who leave firearms or ammunition in vehicles or vessels to lock them inside specified compartments when they are away from the vehicle.

title: Requirements for Battery Manufacturers
summary: Requires battery manufacturers to meet new rules and prohibits cell manufacturers or marketers from selling certain battery-powered products; the text is brief.

title: Engineering
summary: Adds penalties for people who repeatedly practice engineering without a license.

title: Public Officers and Employees
summary: Requires top executive-branch appointees to be U.S. citizens and state residents, creates automatic vacancies for noncompliance, and directs Ethics Commission investigations of prohibited lobbyist expenditures.

title: Designation of the Official State Flagship
summary: Redesignates Florida's official state flagship as the S.S. American Victory, a ceremonial naming change with no policy effect.

title: Electric Vehicle Registration Fees
summary: Imposes an annual registration fee on battery electric vehicle owners, with proceeds deposited into the State Transportation Trust Fund.

title: Florida Trust Code
summary: Limits when the Attorney General has exclusive authority over charitable trust interests and bars other states' officers from asserting those rights.

title: Consumers’ Right to Repair Certain Equipment
summary: Requires device and agricultural equipment makers to give owners and independent repair providers access to parts, diagnostic and repair information.

title: Underground Utility and Excavation Contractors
summary: Revises and defines key contractor terms, including underground utility and excavation contractor, which may change licensing scope; the text gives no details.

title: Roofing Requirements for Property Insurance
summary: Bars insurers from refusing to issue or renew residential property insurance solely because the roof is younger than a specified age, and expands who counts as an authorized roof inspector.

title: Stormwater Management Systems
summary: Defines MS4 terms and requires MS4 entities to inspect certain stormwater management systems by a set date using a checklist.

title: Sealing of Criminal History Records
summary: Makes people convicted of certain misdemeanors eligible to petition a court to seal their criminal history, and loosens eligibility criteria.

title: Traffic Infraction Enforcement
summary: Authorizes railroad-crossing traffic infraction detectors and enforcement officers to issue citations, and requires specified fines for work-zone violations.

title: Public Records/Sealed Criminal History Records
summary: Expands an existing public records exemption to cover sealed criminal history records of certain adjudicated persons and nonviolent misdemeanants, and allows disclosure to state attorneys.

title: Weapons or Firearms at School-sponsored Events or on School Property
summary: Bars storing firearms at school events and school property, allows carry on college campuses, and lets universities seek sensitive-location bans at sporting events.

title: Emergency Alerts
summary: Requires local law enforcement to activate emergency alerts for schools and child care facilities under certain circumstances, keep facility lists, and grants good-faith immunity.

title: Required Life Skills Instruction
summary: Expands required life skills instruction in schools to add career readiness, financial literacy, and home economics.

title: Diabetes Research
summary: Creates a University of Florida Diabetes Institute to run statewide pilot programs, keep a secure deidentified data repository, and share data under conditions.

title: Utility Relocation
summary: Creates a $50 million Utility Relocation Reimbursement Grant Program funded from communications services tax remittances, and shifts certain utility relocation costs away from counties and municipalities.

title: Education in the Criminal Justice System
summary: Lets the Department of Corrections award gain time to inmates who complete specified education programs, and creates a Florida Virtual School justice education program.

title: Dental Therapy
summary: Authorizes Medicaid reimbursement for mobile dental services, creates dental therapist licensure and scope of practice under dentist supervision, and allows exam retakes.

title: Office of Faith and Community
summary: Creates an Office of Faith and Community in the Governor's office, appoints a liaison, and provides administrative support to a faith-based advisory council.

title: Problem-solving Court Reports
summary: Requires the state courts office to report annually to the Legislature on problem-solving courts, and requires those court programs to collect and report data for evaluation.

title: Education
summary: Lets charter schools expand enrollment beyond charter capacity, adopt their own student conduct codes, and take over high-performing peers' charters; also expands lab school capital fund uses.

title: Community Association Management
topics: Consumer protection and business; Labor and employment
summary: Requires certain community associations to hire a licensed management firm or a certified community association manager.

title: Specialty License Plates
summary: Raises the annual use fee for the Florida Wildflower license plate, adds a multi-vehicle discount, and directs DHSMV to develop specialty plates.

title: School District Unimproved Real Property
summary: Requires school districts to annually submit complete inventories of their unimproved real property to the Department of Education, which would publish a statewide report.

title: Service of Process
summary: Requires sheriffs to serve all process, allows substituted service on spouses in the county, and repeals certified process server authorizations.

title: Gift Certificates
summary: Revises the definition of gift certificate and deletes provisions allowing gift certificates to expire under specified circumstances.

title: Temporary Cash Assistance Eligibility
summary: Removes the state ban on Temporary Cash Assistance for people with felony drug trafficking convictions and eases related drug-felony eligibility requirements.

title: Sovereign Immunity for Public Transit Contractors
summary: Deems public transit contractors and their employees or agents to be agents of the state for sovereign immunity purposes.

title: Disposition of Migrant Vessels
summary: Defines "migrant vessel" and extends law enforcement's vessel relocation or removal authority to cover migrant vessels, with new disposition procedures.

title: Public Records/County Administrators and City Managers
topics: AI and technology; Government and administration
summary: Exempts personal identifying and location information of county and city administrators and their spouses and children from public records requirements, with future review and repeal.

title: Former Phosphate Mining Lands
summary: Sets conditions for lawsuits against former phosphate mine sites, has the Health Department survey radiation on petitioned parcels, and requires radiation documentation in related civil actions.

title: Residential Property Insurance
summary: Requires residential property insurers' rate filings to include transparency reports, creates an OIR resource center, and bars counting land value in certain coverage and claims calculations.

title: Recreational Fishing Vessel Licenses
summary: Requires a license to operate certain freshwater recreational fishing vessels and sets related licensure fees.

title: Nonprofit Religious Organizations
summary: Revises when nonprofit religious organizations are exempt from the Insurance Code and requires agents to give a written disclaimer on certain applications.

title: Auxiliary Containers, Wrappings, and Disposable Plastic Bags
summary: Removes state preemption so local governments can regulate certain auxiliary containers, wrappings, and disposable plastic bags.

title: Risk Retention Groups
summary: Declares that risk retention groups registered to do business in Florida are insurance companies authorized to do business in the state.

title: Florida Building Code
summary: Bars local governments from adopting stricter lookback ordinances for substantial improvements or repairs and voids existing ones.

title: Electronic Payments of Retail Installment Contracts
summary: Authorizes holders of motor vehicle retail installment contracts and their agents to charge fees for processing electronic payments under certain circumstances.

title: Housing for Legally Verified Agricultural Workers
summary: Bars local governments from adopting or enforcing rules that inhibit building housing for verified agricultural workers on bona fide farmland.

title: Insurance Solutions Advisory Council
summary: Creates an Insurance Solutions Advisory Council within the Office of Insurance Regulation, with staffing support and a sunset provision.

title: Public Records/Municipal Clerks
summary: Creates public records exemptions shielding personal identifying and location information of current municipal clerks, their staff, and their spouses and children.

title: Land Use Regulations for Local Governments Affected by Natural Disasters
summary: Bars disaster-affected local governments from enforcing certain moratoriums, new rebuilding requirements, and procedure changes, and narrows when they can enforce amendments and permits.

title: Public Records/County Administrators and City Managers
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Exempts personal identifying and location information of current county and city administrators, their spouses and children from public records requirements, with future review and repeal.

title: Local Government Official Salaries
summary: Revises base salaries used to set pay for certain county constitutional officers, including clerks of court, comptrollers, and supervisors of elections.

title: Domestic Violence
summary: Revises the legal definition of domestic violence to include coercive control of one family or household member by another.

title: Sickle Cell Disease Care Management and Treatment Continuing Education
summary: Revises continuing education requirements for health care practitioners on prescribing controlled substances, with a sickle cell disease care focus; details are not in the text.

title: Advertisements for Representation Services
summary: Restricts notaries from using certain terms in advertising and requires immigration service providers to post a conspicuous notice, with civil remedies for violations.

title: Reporting Lost or Stolen Firearms
summary: Requires individuals to report lost or stolen firearms to local law enforcement within a set timeframe, and requires agencies to create incident reports.

title: Restoration of Voting Rights
summary: Requires the Florida Commission on Offender Review to build and maintain a public database on voting-rights restoration, fed by monthly agency reporting.

title: Stormwater Treatment
summary: Restricts certain stormwater treatment and net improvement activities, requires financial responsibility documentation, and lets governments use water quality credits to meet permit standards.

title: Federal Approval for Community Health Workers as Medicaid Providers
summary: Directs AHCA to seek federal approval to enroll community health workers as Medicaid providers and secure financing for their services.

title: Fortification of Enriched Grain Products with Folic Acid
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Requires enriched grain products sold in Florida to contain folic acid, adds labeling rules and penalties, and appropriates $250,000 for enforcement by the Department of Agriculture.

title: Study on the Elimination of Property Taxes
summary: Requires the Office of Economic and Demographic Research to study eliminating property taxes and report to the Legislature by a set date.

title: Food Insecure Areas
summary: Authorizes local governments to allow small-footprint grocery stores in food insecure areas through land development regulations and comprehensive plans.

title: Consumer Protection
summary: Requires unlicensed home repair vendors to act within set timeframes after payment and bars holding excess payments without performing work, with prosecution for violations.

title: Small Independent Special Fire Control Districts
summary: Lets small independent special fire control districts apply to join the state group health insurance and prescription drug programs, with the district paying for a required actuarial analysis.

title: Public Records/Sexual Assault Counselors
summary: Creates a public records exemption shielding personal identifying and location information of sexual assault counselors, with future legislative review and retroactive application.

title: Disclosure of Estimated Ad Valorem Taxes
summary: Requires certain property listings to include estimated ad valorem taxes, with DOR providing county links, a calculation formula, and annual average millage rates.

title: Protective Injunctions and Protection Orders
summary: Requires domestic violence respondents to surrender firearms, ammunition and carry licenses after a final injunction, returns them if vacated, and raises penalties for repeat violations.

title: Peer Support for First Responders
summary: Expands the definition of first responder to include specified support personnel who provide peer support.

title: Commercial Motor Vehicles Operated by Unauthorized Aliens
summary: Requires law enforcement to detain unauthorized aliens operating commercial vehicles, transfer them to federal immigration custody, impound vehicles, and penalize motor carriers.

title: Political Advertisements by Governmental Officials
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Prohibits elected and appointed officials from coercing or threatening broadcasters to air or refrain from airing political ads, with criminal and administrative penalties.

title: Compounded Drugs
summary: Prohibits selling, transferring or distributing compounded weight-loss medications unless specified documentation is provided to DBPR, with administrative penalties.

title: Social Services Estimating Conference
summary: Requires the Social Services Estimating Conference to develop specified information about the Medicaid home and community-based services waiver program.

title: Correctional Officers, Correctional Probation Officers, and Institutional Security Specialists
summary: Sets a $60,000 minimum base salary for correctional officers, probation officers and security specialists, with annual raises subject to appropriation and an annual compensation report.

title: Public Records/Uterine Fibroid Research Database
summary: Creates a public records exemption for certain records and personal identifying information submitted to DOH for the uterine fibroid research database, with future repeal review.

title: Anchoring Limitation Areas
summary: Limits local authority over vessel anchoring outside mooring fields and expands no-anchoring distances near public mooring fields in specified areas.

title: Health Care Practitioner Maternal Mental Health Continuing Education Requirements
summary: Requires maternal mental health curriculum within practitioner continuing education hours for licensure renewal, with boards or DOH updating the curriculum periodically.

title: Social Media Use by Minors
topics: AI and technology; Children and families; Civil rights and liberties
summary: Requires social media platforms to offer decryption for warrant-backed law enforcement requests, give parents access to minors' messages, and bars minors from disappearing messages.

title: Practice of the Profession of Pharmacy
summary: Lets pharmacists who meet specified criteria administer medications at Level I or II trauma centers under a physician's direction, and requires trauma centers to keep related documentation.

title: Termination of Pregnancies
summary: Prohibits physicians from knowingly performing or inducing an abortion once the fetus is determined sustainable outside the womb, with exceptions.

title: Operating Drones Over Critical Infrastructure Facilities
summary: Revises the state prohibition on operating drones over critical infrastructure facilities; the summary does not say whether it widens or narrows it.

title: Price Controls for the Storage of Electric Vehicles
summary: Requires counties and municipalities to set specified storage rates for certain electric vehicles and lets wreckers charge cleanup costs for EV accident scenes.

title: Division of State Fire Marshal
summary: Requires the State Fire Marshal to accept out-of-state firefighter training and certification in some cases, bar denials without a finding, and adopt contaminated gear rules.

title: Gift Certificate Forgery
summary: Creates criminal penalties for falsely making, altering, forging, or counterfeiting gift certificates with intent to injure or defraud.

title: Professional Licensure Reciprocity for the Practice of Surveying and Mapping
summary: Expands eligibility for surveyor and mapper licensure by endorsement to qualifying out-of-state applicants and lets the board require and verify supporting documents.

title: Chimeric Antigen Receptor T-cell Therapy
summary: Prohibits health insurers and HMOs from refusing to contract with or denying coverage for certain CAR-T therapy providers.

title: Public Records and Public Meetings/Hearings Relating to Mental Health and Substance Abuse
summary: Closes hearings on mental health and substance abuse treatment to the public and exempts related records from public records requirements.

title: Probation for Misdemeanor Offenses
summary: Increases probation periods for certain misdemeanor offenses involving controlled or chemical substances.

title: Clinical Laboratory Personnel
summary: Lets applicants who meet specified criteria qualify for clinical laboratory personnel licensure as technologists or technicians, by deeming minimum qualifications satisfied.

title: Utility Terrain Vehicles
summary: Lets utility terrain vehicles operate at all hours and on certain State Highway System roads, and requires the state to issue them license plates.

title: Sale or Transfer of Ammunition
summary: Requires background checks for the sale or transfer of ammunition, with listed exceptions, and is cited as Jaime's Law.

title: Designation of the State Birds
summary: Designates the American flamingo as Florida's official state bird and the Florida scrub-jay as its state songbird, replacing the mockingbird designation.

title: Specialty License Plates/Miami Northwestern Alumni Association
summary: Directs the DHSMV to create a Miami Northwestern Alumni Association specialty license plate and distributes the fees from its sale.

title: Taxes on Homestead Property
summary: Lets certain persons defer payment of homestead property taxes up to a set assessed just value, and revises the cap on tax certificates that cannot be sold at auction.

title: Fee Waivers
summary: Specifies that the requirement for certain Florida public institutions to waive out-of-state fees covers students who are undocumented for federal immigration purposes.

title: Florida State Guard
summary: Authorizes leave for State Guard members on ordered training, discounts state park passes for members, sets a gold sportsman's license fee, and creates a Guard scholarship program.

title: Public Records/Owners and Operators of Family Foster Homes
topics: Children and families; Civil rights and liberties
summary: Creates a public records exemption shielding personal identifying and location information of foster home owners, operators, and their spouses and children, with future review and retroactive application.

title: Crisis Care Coordination
summary: Creates subject-to-appropriation crisis care coordination pilot programs in specified counties run by DCF, plus an independent evaluation and report.

title: Discounted Drug Pricing Study
summary: Requires the Agency for Health Care Administration to conduct or contract for a study of discounted drug pricing and report results to the Governor and Legislature.

title: Consumer Transparency for Homeowners’ Insurance
summary: Requires residential property insurers' rate filings to include transparency reports, provides them to consumers, and has the state office create a website resource center.

title: Professional Services Contracts
summary: Limits design professionals' indemnification duties in contracts with contracting parties to certain liabilities and sets a professional standard of care.

title: Improving Screening for and Treatment of Blood Clots
summary: Requires hospitals with emergency departments and surgical centers to adopt blood-clot policies and training, creates a no-cost statewide registry, and revises nursing assistant training.

title: Felony Battery
summary: Removes the great-bodily-harm element from battery by strangulation and domestic battery by strangulation, and reclassifies the offense on the severity ranking chart.

title: Florida State University Election Law Center
summary: Creates an FSU College of Law Election Law Center to assist the Legislature and governments on election law, with funding mechanisms.

title: Habitual Felony Offenders, Habitual Violent Felony Offenders, Three-time Violent Felony Offenders, and Violent Career Criminals
summary: Revises definitions and court procedures for habitual felony, habitual violent felony, three-time violent felony, and violent career criminal sentencing enhancements.

title: Faith-based Activities in Batterers’ Intervention Programs
summary: Allows batterers' intervention programs to offer supplemental faith-based activities, while barring courts or programs from requiring participation in them.

title: Restrictions on Employer-owned Life Insurance Policies
topics: Consumer protection and business; Taxes and budget
summary: Authorizes employer-owned life insurance on key persons under set conditions, bars tax deductions for related costs, and fines insurers up to $1 million per violation.

title: State Lotteries
summary: Makes administrative lottery changes, including allowing debit card purchases from lottery vending machines and raising the retailer bond amount.

title: School Safety
summary: Lets public colleges join the school guardian armed-staff program with sheriff assistance, and creates an offense for discharging a firearm within 1,000 feet of a school.

title: Practice of Veterinary Medicine
summary: Creates a licensure exam requirement for veterinary technicians and technologists, sets Board rules, and allows licensed techs to perform specified services under veterinarian supervision.

title: Online Media Transparency
topics: AI and technology; Consumer protection and business
summary: Requires certain content creators to clearly disclose sponsorships, makes failure an unfair or deceptive practice, and requires foreign-sponsorship filings with the Department of State.

title: Postsecondary Out-of-state Fee Waivers
summary: Deletes existing statutory provisions that waive out-of-state fees for certain postsecondary students.

title: Public Records/Receipt or Transfer of Ammunition
summary: Creates a public records exemption for information about ammunition buyers or transferees not found prohibited, with future review and repeal provisions.

title: Fees/Veterinary Technician or Veterinary Technologist
summary: Sets licensing fees, including an examination fee, that veterinary technician and technologist applicants must pay the board.

title: Boating Safety
summary: Requires DHSMV to put a symbol on certain ID cards in certain circumstances, and adds a mandatory minimum sentence for fatal boating-under-the-influence violations.

title: Panelized Construction
summary: Defines panelized construction and exempts it from state approval, while requiring compliance with local installation-site requirements.

title: Department of Health
summary: Bill revises medical marijuana physician and facility rules, creates a neurofibromatosis grant program, and lets nurses delegate certain controlled substances to home health aides.

title: Subsidy Payments for the Home Care for the Elderly Program
summary: Ends Elder Affairs home care subsidy payments for certain elderly people once they enroll in Medicaid long-term care managed care.

title: Electric Personal Assistive Mobility Devices
summary: Raises the minimum age for riders required to wear helmets on electric personal assistive mobility devices.

title: Pharmacy
summary: Lets remote-site pharmacies be permitted to store and dispense drugs, and lets registered technicians handle sales and delivery in certain circumstances.

title: Homeowners’ Associations
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Creates a Homeowners' Association Ombudsman office in DBPR's condominium division, with complaint duties, citation authority, rulemaking, and a toll-free line for owners.

title: Cyberintimidation by Publication
summary: Increases criminal penalties for electronically publishing someone's personal identifying information to incite violence or threaten them, and lets victims sue perpetrators.

title: Fees/Homeowners’ Associations
summary: Requires homeowners' associations with more than two parcels to pay an annual per-parcel fee to the state division, with penalties and loss of standing to sue if unpaid.

title: Veterans’ Benefits Assistance
summary: Regulates paid veterans' benefits assistance by banning referral fees, requiring disclosures, limiting certain fees, and mandating background screening of assistants.

title: Parking on Public Property
summary: Bans towing and parking tickets for certain vehicles after parking on public property, requires fee refunds in some cases, and bars local governments from leasing public parking to private businesses.

title: Threats from Foreign Nations
summary: Requires certain foreign agents to file statements and periodic supplements with the Attorney General, with criminal penalties for willful violations, and creates related infrastructure and communications acts.

title: Battery Collection and Recovery
topics: Consumer protection and business; Environment and energy
summary: Creates battery collection and recovery rules requiring producers to meet obligations before selling covered batteries, with an industry stewardship plan approved by DEP and annual reporting.

title: Public Records and Meetings/Reports on Adversarial Threats
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Creates public records and public meetings exemptions for adversarial threat reports, notifications to critical infrastructure owners, and related Council on Pacific Conflict meetings, with future review and repeal.

title: Dry Needling
summary: Defines dry needling and trigger points, and requires the Occupational Therapy Board to set minimum standards and possibly added supervision and training for OT dry needling.

title: Indemnification of Commuter Rail Transportation Providers
summary: Creates the Coastal Link Commuter Rail Service Act, letting an agency assume indemnification of commuter rail providers and setting how passenger and employee invitee status and liability are allocated.

title: Spaceport Operations
summary: Defines spaceport terms and directs Space Florida to promote quintimodal transportation hubs; sets spaceport operator powers and duties.

title: Employment of Minors
summary: Removes certain restrictions on 16- and 17-year-olds working, revises exceptions, and deletes DBPR's authority to waive those restrictions.

title: Juvenile Justice
summary: Requires courts to set minimum commitment periods for delinquent children, requires them to finish programs, and lowers the age for maximum-risk commitment to 10.

title: Motor Vehicle Safety
summary: Requires front and rear license plates and has repair shops report finalized repair estimates to a new FDLE crash-related database when no crash report is provided.

title: Employee Protections
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Bans agencies and contractors from retaliating against employees who report ethics violations to the Commission on Ethics, and makes certain retaliation a breach of public trust.

title: Firearm Purchase or Transfer
summary: Lowers the minimum age to buy a firearm and narrows dealer age restrictions and the waiting-period exception for rifles and shotguns.

title: Mathematics Education
summary: Requires the Education Department to develop applied algebra courses that state universities would accept as math credit, following mathematics pathway requirements.

title: Employment Agreements
summary: Creates the CHOICE Act, letting employers enforce garden leave and noncompete agreements with covered high-earning employees and cut their pay for gross misconduct.

title: Coverage for Treatment of Stuttering
summary: Requires insurers and health maintenance contracts to cover stuttering treatment, and authorizes Medicaid to pay for stuttering services and devices.

title: Coverage for Fertility Preservation Services
summary: Requires the Department of Management Services to cover certain fertility retrieval and preservation services in state group health plans and bars preauthorization for covered services.

title: Roofing Material Restrictions for Homeowners’ Associations
summary: Bars homeowners' associations from requiring specific roofing materials when a rebuilt or built roof meets set criteria and standards.

title: Public Service Announcements by State Agencies
summary: Prohibits state agencies from producing or funding certain public service announcements and from using resources to influence statewide ballot initiatives, with discipline for violators.

title: Attorney Fees and Costs for Motor Vehicle Personal Injury Protection Benefits
summary: Makes prevailing parties in certain provider suits over overdue motor vehicle PIP medical benefits entitled to reasonable attorney fees and costs.

title: Nonapproved Disposable Nicotine Dispensing Devices
summary: Creates the Florida Age Gate Act, defining nonapproved disposable nicotine devices, barring their advertising or display in certain locations, and expanding tobacco inspection and location rules.

title: Dangerous Crimes
summary: Requires courts to immediately remand people who plead guilty or are convicted of dangerous crimes, denying bond until sentencing.

title: Education
summary: Repeals prohibition on certain race and sex-based training, encourages DEI programs at colleges and universities, and lets school libraries offer all viewpoints.

title: Florida Retirement Savings Task Force
summary: Creates a Florida Retirement Savings Task Force under the Department of Commerce, with departmental staff support and per diem for members.

title: Health Care Freedom Act
summary: Repeals bans on state funds for out-of-state abortion travel and gender-transition care, repeals provider conscience protections, and revises the abortion timeframe.

title: Ad Valorem Tax Revenue in Fiscally Constrained Counties
summary: Requires the Legislature to appropriate funds to fiscally constrained counties, distributed by formula, with applications and reversion provisions.

title: Pregnancy Support and Wellness Services
summary: Revises contract requirements for the Florida Pregnancy Care Network and requires the Department of Health to make annual visits to network organizations.

title: Areas of Critical State Concern
summary: Exempts specified entities from certain payment and performance bond requirements under set conditions, and extends the deadline to spend Florida Forever funds on Florida Keys land acquisition.

title: Statewide Study on Automation and Workforce Impact
summary: Requires the Department of Commerce's workforce statistics bureau to study AI, automation and robotics' employment impact and report to the Governor and Legislature.

title: Temporary Door Locking Devices
summary: Authorizes temporary door locking devices at any height, requires building code standards for them, and requires their use in school safety plans and drills.

title: Student Absences
summary: Requires teachers to report chronically absent students to principals and directs the State Board of Education to create student absence guidelines.

title: Conservation Easements
summary: Requires water management districts to release conservation easements on qualifying parcels, allowing development consistent with adjacent zoning and shifting stormwater responsibility to the owner.

title: Sales or Transfers of Firearms to Persons Under 21 Years of Age
summary: Deletes the state ban on selling or transferring firearms to people under 21 and its exceptions.

summary: Shields Federal Home Loan Bank collateral rights against insurer-members in delinquency proceedings from court stays and receiver clawbacks, and requires capital stock repurchases.

title: Relating to the Oregon Insurance Guaranty Association.
summary: Makes unspecified changes to the Oregon Insurance Guaranty Association's responsibilities for covering obligations of insolvent member insurers.

title: Relating to earned income access services; prescribing an effective date.
summary: Requires a license from the Department of Consumer and Business Services to provide earned income access services, with rules on conduct and civil penalties up to $2,500 per violation.

title: Relating to medical assistance reimbursement rates for residential care facilities.
summary: Directs ODHS to set Medicaid reimbursement rates for residential care facilities at levels comparable to assisted living facilities, sunsetting June 30, 2027.

title: Relating to children with hearing impairments; prescribing an effective date.
summary: Creates a program to assess and track language milestones of deaf or hard-of-hearing children, with an advisory committee and an annual report.

title: Relating to termination of fixed term residential tenancies.
summary: Lets tenants end fixed-term leases early without penalty on 30 days' notice when landlords give notice ending the tenancy after the term.

title: Relating to battery-charged fences.
summary: Allows battery-charged fences on properties that are not used as residences, loosening where they may be installed.

title: Relating to fairgrounds; prescribing an effective date.
summary: Directs the Oregon Department of Emergency Management to create a grant program for fairgrounds used as emergency evacuation sites.

title: Relating to state parks; prescribing an effective date.
summary: Eliminates the day-use parking pass for Oregon-registered vehicles at state parks, funded by voluntary donations made at vehicle registration, through 2032.

title: Relating to land use; and declaring an emergency.
summary: Allows denser middle housing and accessory units, expands expedited land divisions, and voids private restrictions in planned-community documents that limit such housing.

title: Relating to housing; declaring an emergency.
summary: Creates a Tribal Housing Grant Fund, appropriates money to it, and directs OHCS to grant funds to federally recognized Oregon tribes for housing and homelessness prevention.

title: Relating to funding of the State School Fund; and declaring an emergency.
summary: Changes how the State School Fund amount is calculated and distributed to school districts, and how program costs are projected; declares an emergency.

title: Relating to registration for commercial interior designers; prescribing an effective date.
summary: Creates a voluntary registry for commercial interior designers under the architect board, letting registrants stamp and sign building-permit technical submissions within their scope.

title: Relating to controlled substances.
summary: Requires mandatory prison sentences for repeat controlled-substance delivery or manufacturing offenses by people with certain prior convictions.

title: Relating to five-needle protocol; and prescribing an effective date.
summary: Allows individuals with required training to provide the five-needle addiction protocol without an acupuncture license, through a Medical Board registry.

title: Relating to virtual public charter school enrollment; declaring an emergency.
summary: Changes how the three percent virtual charter school enrollment cap is set, alters district approval timelines, and requires state enrollment data collection.

title: Relating to county fairs; declaring an emergency.
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Removes the $1.53 million annual cap on lottery money for the County Fair Account, changes its percentage share, and funds a fairground master plan report.

title: Relating to adult foster homes.
summary: Requires the Department of Human Services to study certain adult foster homes and report findings to legislative interim committees by September 2026.

title: Relating to addiction medicine fellowship program; declaring an emergency.
summary: Appropriates state funds through HECC to Oregon Health and Science University for its Addiction Medicine Fellowship program, effective July 1, 2025.

title: Relating to health care costs.
summary: Sets required primary care spending targets for insurers and state plans, creates primary care funding programs, and mandates reimbursement rates with balance-billing limits.

title: Relating to pharmacy services administrative organization licensing.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Requires pharmacy services administrative organizations operating in Oregon to be licensed by the Department of Consumer and Business Services under new licensing rules.

title: Relating to compensation of service providers.
summary: Requires DHS to adjust for inflation the payments it makes to provider agencies serving people with intellectual or developmental disabilities, and sunsets January 2, 2027.

title: Relating to seismic risk mitigation; prescribing an effective date.
summary: Adds new purposes for which Seismic Risk Mitigation Fund moneys may be spent, effective 91 days after sine die adjournment.

title: Relating to statewide fuel storage capacity; prescribing an effective date.
summary: Directs the Oregon Department of Energy to develop and implement an action plan for geographically diverse fueling stations and disaster fuel reserves.

title: Relating to aviation fuel; prescribing an effective date; providing for revenue raising that requires approval by a three-fifths majority.
summary: Raises the tax on turbine aircraft fuel and adjusts the rate biennially for Consumer Price Index increases, effective 91 days after sine die.

title: Relating to county safety corridors.
summary: Makes permanent the county safety corridor program, which lets counties designate high-crash parts of county roads as safety corridors.

title: Relating to transportation.
summary: Allows law enforcement agencies to use confidential vehicle accident reports for investigations, and requires ODOT to study speed bump standards.

title: Relating to transportation.
summary: Requires ODOT to study uniform standards for speed bump height and markings, with the study provision sunsetting January 2, 2027.

title: Relating to transportation funding; prescribing an effective date.
summary: Directs ODOT to study transportation funding issues and report the results to the Joint Committee on Transportation.

title: Relating to transportation funding; prescribing an effective date.
summary: Directs ODOT to study transportation funding issues and report the results to the Joint Committee on Transportation.

title: Relating to transportation.
summary: Requires ODOT to study developing uniform standards for speed bump height and markings, sunsetting January 2, 2027.

title: Relating to transportation.
summary: Directs ODOT to study uniform standards for speed bump height and markings; the study sunsets January 2, 2027.

title: Relating to highways.
summary: Transfers jurisdiction over Hall Boulevard to the City of Tigard and a portion of Hood River Highway to the City of Hood River.

title: Relating to Willamette Valley brassica production.
summary: Repeals restrictions on brassica, including canola, production in the Willamette Valley.

title: Relating to the classification of persons with disabilities under the wildlife laws.
summary: Classifies people with documented intellectual or developmental disabilities as disabled under wildlife laws on angling and shellfish harvesting, extending existing disability privileges to them.

title: Relating to a program of state inspection by the State Department of Agriculture; declaring an emergency.
summary: Appropriates state money to the Department of Agriculture for a state inspection program covering meat from nonamenable species; declares an emergency.

title: Relating to the financial administration of the Water Resources Department; declaring an emergency.
summary: Appropriates General Fund money to the Water Resources Department for well construction and compliance costs, effective July 1, 2025.

title: Relating to supporting Oregon agriculture; prescribing an effective date.
summary: Requires the State Department of Agriculture to report on the economic competitiveness of Oregon's agricultural sector by December 31, 2026.

title: Relating to state financial administration; declaring an emergency.
summary: Appropriates General Fund money through HECC to Oregon State University for its veterinary programs and the Oregon Veterinary Diagnostic Laboratory.

title: Relating to rural water supplies; declaring an emergency.
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Directs OSU Extension to create an assistance program for well and septic households and appropriates General Fund money for well repair, septic loans, and related purposes.

title: Relating to water reuse; and declaring an emergency.
summary: Sets state policy on water reuse and directs DEQ to create an interagency water reuse team, effective July 1, 2025.

title: Relating to aquatic invasive species.
summary: Lets state fish, marine and agriculture agencies contract with tribal, local or service-district governments to run aquatic invasive species boat inspections.

title: Relating to camping sites on county fairgrounds; prescribing an effective date.
summary: Lets the tax collector keep state lodging tax from small fairground campsites, if the money is used to operate or promote those sites.

title: Relating to concealed handgun license reciprocity; prescribing an effective date.
summary: Extends Oregon concealed handgun license protections to licensees from listed states that recognize Oregon permits and require similar competency testing.

title: Relating to controlled substance crimes; prescribing an effective date.
summary: Creates a new crime for unlawfully using controlled substances in an enclosed place in a way that endangers another person, with escalating penalties for repeat offenses.

title: Relating to drug treatment; prescribing an effective date.
summary: Requires courts to order evaluation and treatment as part of probation for certain drug and property crimes, effective 91 days after sine die.

title: Relating to controlled substance crimes; prescribing an effective date.
summary: Creates a new crime for possessing, buying, making, delivering or selling pill presses, punishable by up to five years and a $125,000 fine.

title: Relating to the repeal of the corporate activity tax; prescribing an effective date.
summary: Repeals Oregon's corporate activity tax for tax years beginning on or after January 1, 2026, effective 91 days after sine die adjournment.

title: Relating to exempt amount under corporate activity tax; prescribing an effective date.
summary: Raises the exempt amount and filing threshold for the Corporate Activity Tax, starting with tax years beginning January 1, 2026.

title: Relating to standing in land use appeals.
summary: Limits who may appeal land use decisions to LUBA to residents or businesses within 25 miles who appeared before the decision maker.

title: Relating to school safety; prescribing an effective date.
summary: Requires school districts to adopt safety policies providing a resource officer or other law enforcement coverage for each school, with State School Fund money for the costs.

title: Relating to school safety; declaring an emergency.
summary: Directs the Department of Education to study hiring retired police officers for school security and report to an interim committee by September 2026.

title: Relating to funding for school safety; declaring an emergency.
summary: Directs the Department of Education to study funding sources for secure single-point-of-entry systems at public schools and report by September 2026.

title: Relating to school safety; declaring an emergency.
summary: Directs the Education Department to study school safety improvement costs and funding sources, reporting to a legislative interim committee by September 2026.

title: Relating to certification of private security professionals.
summary: Directs DPSST to let applicants who are or were police officers use a refresher course and exam in place of required private security training.

title: Relating to transportation.
summary: Directs the State Treasurer to issue general obligation bonds over two biennia to fund replacing the Hood River-White Salmon Bridge.

title: Relating to enrollment in virtual public charter schools; declaring an emergency.
summary: Removes the enrollment cap on virtual public charter schools and the resident district approval requirement, and takes effect immediately on passage.

title: Relating to public charter school eligibility for grants from the Student Investment Account; declaring an emergency.
summary: Makes virtual public charter schools eligible for Student Investment Account grants, and declares an emergency effective on passage.

title: Relating to children who are not taught in a public school; declaring an emergency.
summary: Removes notification and certain examination requirements for children taught privately by a teacher, parent or guardian, and declares an emergency effective July 1, 2025.

title: Relating to repeal of the paid family leave benefits program.
summary: Repeals Oregon's paid family and medical leave insurance program and the laws that required paid family leave benefits.

title: Relating to traffic violations.
summary: Requires a written warning, not a ticket, for a first speeding or red-light offense caught by photo radar or red light cameras.

title: Relating to revenues derived from the corporate activity tax; prescribing an effective date.
summary: Redirects corporate activity tax revenue, keeping two-thirds for education through the Fund for Student Success and sending one-third to the State Highway Fund.

title: Relating to immigration enforcement; declaring an emergency.
summary: Repeals Oregon's limits on state and local cooperation with federal immigration enforcement, including protections against denying services and citizenship inquiries, and declares an emergency.

title: Relating to personal information collected and maintained by public bodies; declaring an emergency.
summary: Requires public bodies that collect personal data to also collect and maintain each individual's immigration or citizenship status, with uniform standards set by state rules.

title: Relating to social credit scoring; prescribing an effective date.
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Consumer protection and business
summary: Bars businesses and public accommodations from trading, denying entry, or refusing service based on social credit scores or protected beliefs, enforced under the Unlawful Trade Practices Act.

title: Relating to the Oregon Hotels Against Human Trafficking Training Program; prescribing an effective date.
