summary: Allows the Oregon Board of Accountancy to create a scholarship grant program for accounting students and aspiring Oregon CPAs.

title: Relating to public accountancy.
summary: Modifies Oregon laws regulating public accountancy professionals such as C.P.A.s; the specific changes are not described.

title: Relating to in-state tuition for members of the Oregon National Guard.
summary: Extends in-state tuition and other higher education benefits to Oregon National Guard members, including those who are out-of-state residents.

title: Relating to administration of taxes; and prescribing an effective date.
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Makes technical tax-code updates, including a uniform statute of limitations for Department of Revenue tax programs and replacing statutory citations.

title: Relating to behavioral health.
summary: Requires the Oregon Health Authority to study behavioral health and report findings to legislative interim committees by September 15, 2026, then sunsets.

title: Relating to water quality permits for confined animal feeding operations; declaring an emergency.
summary: Prohibits DEQ from issuing water quality permits to certain confined animal feeding operations in ground water management areas.

title: Relating to compliance with tax laws; prescribing an effective date.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Labor and employment
summary: Requires businesses, trades and professions seeking licenses, and state or local contractors, to provide a Department of Revenue tax compliance certificate.

title: Relating to the office of Adjutant General.
summary: Lets the Adjutant General appoint two Air National Guard assistants instead of one and sets fidelity bond deadlines for acting AG.

title: Relating to the Teacher Standards and Practices Commission; and declaring an emergency.
summary: Lets unlicensed applicants teach in public schools for more time while TSPC reviews their license application, by changing when the 90-day period starts.

title: Relating to the state-sponsored life insurance program for Oregon National Guard members.
summary: Requires the Adjutant General to allow efforts to make the state life insurance program available to Oregon National Guard members.

title: Relating to moneys collected by the Teacher Standards and Practices Commission.
summary: Lets the Teacher Standards and Practices Commission impose civil penalties or order payment of disciplinary proceeding costs, and addresses how those moneys are handled.

title: Relating to complaints filed with the Teacher Standards and Practices Commission.
summary: Lets the Teacher Standards and Practices Commission impose civil penalties on educators for misconduct and shortens its wait before investigating complaints.

title: Relating to the use of armories.
summary: Allows the Civil Air Patrol to use Oregon National Guard armories and facilities for official business at no cost.

title: Relating to the Oregon National Guard; and declaring an emergency.
summary: Authorizes the Adjutant General to pay Oregon National Guard reenlistment or retention bonuses, with repayment required if agreed service terms are not met.

title: Relating to preference given to servicemembers in public employment.
summary: Gives National Guard members and former members hiring and promotion preferences in civil service and public employment.

title: Relating to the state meat inspection program.
summary: Clarifies that poultry are part of the state meat inspection program and that the Department of Agriculture may inspect poultry products.

title: Relating to natural climate solutions.
summary: Directs the Oregon Climate Action Commission to study natural climate solutions and report findings to environment interim committees by September 15, 2026; sunsets January 2, 2027.

title: Relating to developmental disabilities services; and prescribing an effective date.
summary: Establishes an employment-first policy for people with intellectual or developmental disabilities, barring employment and transition services in sheltered work settings.

title: Relating to community-based care; prescribing an effective date.
summary: Adds licensing requirements for residential facilities and adult foster homes, adds inspections, allows two-year adult foster home licenses, and sets memory care standards.

title: Relating to the landowner preference program.
summary: Makes the existing landowner preference hunting program permanent by repealing its sunset.

title: Relating to exposure to bodily fluids.
summary: Adds Oregon Youth Authority and county juvenile department employees to those who may petition a court to compel a third party to be tested for communicable diseases after bodily fluid exposure.

title: Relating to rental assistance.
summary: Changes eligibility for a long-term rental assistance program for certain under-25 individuals and expands the groups consulted on its design.

title: Relating to the Department of Human Services as a party in dependency proceedings.
summary: Changes when the Department of Human Services is recognized as a party in juvenile dependency proceedings.

title: Relating to youth.
summary: Modifies state law on local juvenile diversion plans and juvenile crime prevention basic services; the summary gives no direction of change.

title: Relating to Land Use Board of Appeals fees.
summary: Raises filing fees for some Land Use Board of Appeals notices of intent and motions to intervene, and eliminates fee awards to respondents when petitioners do not file.

title: Relating to the Oregon Youth Authority.
summary: Modifies the Oregon Youth Authority's duties and discretion to enter into contracts and award grants; the summary gives no specific policy change.

title: Relating to sex offenders.
summary: Lets the parole board and PSRB decide sex offender risk reclassification and reporting-relief petitions administratively, without a hearing, except where a hearing is required.

title: Relating to reducing wildfire risk; declaring an emergency.
summary: Appropriates General Fund money to the Higher Education Coordinating Commission for wildfire risk reduction grant-supported projects and changes related grant consultation requirements.

title: Relating to sex offender risk levels.
summary: Limits when the parole board must assign risk levels to sex offender registrants convicted before 2014, to specified circumstances only.

title: Relating to sex offender risk levels.
summary: Removes the deadline for the parole board to assess existing sex offender registrants into risk levels and repeals the sunset on its biennial reporting.

title: Relating to provider networks.
summary: Extends network adequacy rules to large-employer health plans and lets certain plans count telemedicine providers toward network standards, as DCBS rules permit.

title: Relating to the Oregon Department of Emergency Management.
summary: Authorizes the Oregon Department of Emergency Management to purchase or contract for certain materials, supplies and equipment.

title: Relating to health insurance.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Requires certain health carriers to report additional information to DCBS, which must keep that information confidential.

title: Relating to reporting requirements for energy programs.
summary: Reduces energy program reporting burdens by minimizing duplicate reports and removing a biennial report on small-scale local energy loan funds.

title: Relating to the Oregon Statewide Communication Interoperability Plan; and declaring an emergency.
summary: Transfers responsibility for the statewide communication interoperability plan from the State CIO to the Oregon Department of Emergency Management, and declares an emergency.

title: Relating to the Oregon Solar and Storage Rebate Program.
summary: Expands the Oregon Solar and Storage Rebate Program to cover energy storage systems paired with previously installed solar systems.

title: Relating to grid resilience.
summary: Creates a Grid Resilience Matching Fund and appropriates money to the Department of Energy to match federal grants for grid resilience projects.

title: Relating to affordable housing; and declaring an emergency.
summary: Creates a fund and program to help affordable housing, shelters and facilities pay property and liability insurance premiums, and studies a reinsurance option.

title: Relating to wildfire; and declaring an emergency.
summary: Eliminates some wildfire building code and mapping requirements, directs new defensible-space and code standards, reshapes an advisory council, and appropriates General Fund money.

title: Relating to on-site septic systems; and prescribing an effective date.
summary: Allows the on-site septic system loan program to offer grants and expands who qualifies for help.

title: Relating to insurance accreditation; and prescribing an effective date.
summary: Tightens insurer solvency oversight by requiring group capital and liquidity stress tests, deposits or bonds for troubled insurers, and affiliate oversight, with confidentiality rules for holding-company information.

title: Relating to civil penalties for laws implemented by the State Department of Agriculture.
summary: Adds and changes civil penalties for Department of Agriculture violations involving animal disease control, swine, and commercial animal feeds.

title: Relating to soil-enhancing products.
summary: Changes label requirements and tonnage reporting rules for soil-enhancing products; the text gives no specific details.

title: Relating to facilities that provide mental health treatment.
summary: Bars state hospitals from providing inpatient mental health services to minors and makes several administrative changes to hospital leadership, commitment criteria, and evaluations.

title: Relating to tribal affiliation data; declaring an emergency.
summary: Directs OHA, with tribes and possibly ODHS, to adopt rules governing collection, storage and use of tribal affiliation data.

title: Relating to fees imposed by the State Department of Geology and Mineral Industries.
summary: Increases fees charged by the Oregon Department of Geology and Mineral Industries (DOGAMI).

title: Relating to a volunteer registry.
summary: Expands the SERV-OR health volunteer registry to more volunteer types and services, allows deployment outside declared emergencies, and requires workers' compensation coverage for interstate volunteers.

title: Relating to State Parks and Recreation Department procurements; and prescribing an effective date.
summary: Exempts the State Parks and Recreation Department from the Public Contracting Code and state printing rules, with limited exceptions.

title: Relating to regulation of commercial vehicles.
summary: Modifies Oregon laws regulating the operation of commercial vehicles; the summary gives no specific changes.

title: Relating to local government authority on wildfire policy.
summary: Lets cities and counties keep their earlier wildfire building rules and exempts them from certain state wildfire hazard standards.

title: Relating to transportation.
summary: Modifies Oregon laws on vehicle drivers, vehicles, insurance, driver records, dealers and dismantlers; specific changes are not described.

title: Relating to tribal public health data.
summary: Lets the Oregon Health Authority make agreements letting tribes and tribal epidemiology centers take disease reports, investigate cases, and use prescription monitoring data.

title: Relating to health care facilities; and prescribing an effective date.
summary: Raises hospital licensing fees, lets OHA accept accreditation in place of state review, makes complaint intake confidential, and appropriates funds to the State Hospital for the fees.

title: Relating to reports by the Public Utility Commission.
summary: Removes the PUC's requirements to report to the Legislature on the volumetric incentive rates pilot program, including the biennial report.

title: Relating to public health.
topics: Children and families; Labor and employment
summary: Makes assorted public health changes: confidentiality for psilocybin licensees, school-based health center contracting, environmental health authorizations, lab rules aligned with federal law, and an overdose report date.

title: Relating to water utilities regulated by the Public Utility Commission.
summary: Lets the PUC order a failing water utility sold to another utility, and raises the emergency repair fund cap from $5,000 to $100,000.

title: Relating to health care of children served by coordinated care organizations.
summary: Changes how the Oregon Health Authority monitors coordinated care organizations' progress on children's and youth health access and quality.

title: Relating to health insurance subsidies under the Public Employees Retirement System.
summary: Increases the PERS retiree health insurance subsidy and lets Oregon Public Service Retirement Plan members receive the Retiree Health Insurance Premium Account subsidy.

title: Relating to driving while under the influence of intoxicants; prescribing an effective date.
summary: Creates a DUII task force, lets the DUII fund pay for indigent defendants' screenings and education, and lets nonresident diversion participants complete treatment out of state.

title: Relating to the School Districts Unfunded Liability Fund; and declaring an emergency.
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Changes how PERS applies money in the School Districts Unfunded Liability Fund, and declares an emergency effective on passage.

title: Relating to wildfire risk reduction; and declaring an emergency.
summary: Creates a wildfire resilience grant program funded by the General Fund, and directs agencies to study and recommend insurance-linked wildfire risk mitigation.

title: Relating to regional health equity coalitions; declaring an emergency.
summary: Appropriates state money to fund regional health equity coalitions and declares an emergency effective July 1, 2025.

title: Relating to administration of Public Employees Retirement System member account data.
summary: Modifies Public Employees Retirement System member account data administration; the summary gives no specific changes.

title: Relating to post-retirement death benefits under the Public Employees Retirement System.
summary: Modifies certain post-retirement death benefits under the Public Employees Retirement System.

title: Relating to Oregon Racing Commission license fees; and declaring an emergency.
summary: Raises the maximum amounts the Oregon Racing Commission may charge for certain licenses, and declares an emergency effective on passage.

title: Relating to penalties for violation of animal racing law.
summary: Authorizes the Oregon Racing Commission to impose civil penalties for certain violations of the animal racing law.

title: Relating to civil penalties related to racing.
summary: Requires the Oregon Racing Commission to adopt civil penalty rules for race meet violations and raises the maximum penalty amounts.

title: Relating to prohibited activities related to racing.
summary: Allows Oregon Racing Commission officers and employees to place bets or wagers on certain race meets during official audits.

title: Relating to reporting on violation of animal racing laws.
summary: Makes the identity of anyone reporting animal racing law violations to the Oregon Racing Commission confidential and exempt from public records disclosure.

title: Relating to the administration of the family and medical leave insurance program; and prescribing an effective date.
summary: Requires periodic solvency assessments of the paid family and medical leave fund and lets the director act if insolvency risk arises; other changes are technical.

title: Relating to accounting adjustments concerning the paid leave program; and prescribing an effective date.
summary: Authorizes the Employment Department director to make accounting adjustments and compromise or adjust certain paid leave debts and overpayments.

title: Relating to multiemployer sick time policies; prescribing an effective date.
summary: Clarifies how state sick leave laws apply to multiemployer benefit plans, and takes effect 91 days after sine die adjournment.

title: Relating to fire protection.
summary: Grants the State Fire Marshal and Department of the State Fire Marshal certain authorities and makes changes to the Governor's Fire Service Policy Council.

title: Relating to firefighting costs; and declaring an emergency.
summary: Changes funding rules for the State Fire Marshal Mobilization Fund used for firefighting, and requires biennial reporting on related amounts and expenditures.

title: Relating to fire protection.
summary: Directs the State Fire Marshal to adopt a base fire prevention code and makes changes to rural fire protection district rules and names.

title: Relating to cost recovery for fire protection.
summary: Lets the State Fire Marshal recover fire abatement costs from persons who start fires, with AG and deputy fire marshal investigative authority.

title: Relating to bonding requirements for landscape contracting businesses.
summary: Requires landscape contracting license applicants and licensees to post a bond of $20,000 or $50,000, depending on job charges.

title: Relating to work performed by a landscape contracting business; and prescribing an effective date.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Labor and employment
summary: Expands which landscape work requires a license, exempts some CCB-licensed water feature installers, and lets more people cancel landscape contracts within three days.

title: Relating to social emotional health in public schools.
summary: Directs the Department of Education to study ways to improve student and staff social emotional health in public schools and report by September 2026.

title: Relating to investigations by the Department of Education.
topics: Children and families; Civil rights and liberties; Education
summary: Expands ODE investigation powers and sanctions for discrimination, revises school sexual-conduct rules and disclosures, shares child-abuse information with ODE, and changes religious-activity standards.

title: Relating to special education for children with a low incidence disability.
summary: Directs the Oregon Department of Education to study special education costs, develop a cost formula, and report on it.

title: Relating to beverage containers.
summary: Sets the hours during which beverage container dealers must accept container returns.

title: Relating to the authority of agencies that regulate building safety in this state.
summary: Raises state building code penalties to $7,500 per violation and lets state and local agencies share enforcement duties and retain more penalty revenue.

title: Relating to public records disclosure of OLCC permittee personal information.
summary: Exempts the residential address and personal phone number of certain OLCC permit holders from public records disclosure.

title: Relating to alcohol; and prescribing an effective date.
summary: Requires OLCC retail licensees to keep delivery invoices, expands the alcoholic beverage definition to 0.5% ABV, and removes a required commission report.

title: Relating to disciplinary actions imposed by the State Mortuary and Cemetery Board.
summary: Modifies the State Mortuary and Cemetery Board's authority to impose disciplinary actions on applicants and regulated persons.

title: Relating to physician qualifications for special licenses; and prescribing an effective date.
summary: Repeals the Oregon Medical Board license that let physicians licensed in other jurisdictions practice in Oregon, effective 91 days after sine die.

title: Relating to Oriental medicine.
summary: Renames references to "Oriental medicine" as "Traditional Eastern medicine" and defines the new term, without changing what practitioners may do.

title: Relating to the rights of children in care; and declaring an emergency.
summary: Modifies Oregon's foster child and sibling bills of rights and declares an emergency, effective on passage. Details are not in the summary.

title: Relating to the conveyance of real property to Coos County.
summary: Requires the State Board of Forestry to offer certain state-owned real property to Coos County under specified terms.

title: Relating to golf courses on exclusive farm use lands in Coos County.
summary: Lets Coos County approve golf courses on exclusive farm use lands under new criteria for two years, sunsetting January 1, 2028.

title: Relating to housing; prescribing an effective date.
summary: Lets homeowners outside urban growth boundaries site one additional family dwelling unit on their property tract.

title: Relating to child support obligations of persons in custody.
summary: Changes the procedure for rebutting the presumption that incarcerated or state hospital patients cannot pay child support, when they earn wages.

title: Relating to expenditures nonrecoverable from ratepayers; declaring an emergency.
summary: Bars utilities from recovering advertising, political, litigation, fine and certain compensation costs from ratepayers, limits contested-proceeding costs, and requires annual reporting.

title: Relating to attorneys.
summary: Requires newly admitted Oregon attorneys to provide at least 120 hours of public defense work in their first three years, with OPDC providing training.

title: Relating to substance use.
summary: Transfers Oversight and Accountability Council duties to the Criminal Justice Commission, which will fund drug treatment and related services grants.

title: Relating to health education curriculum.
summary: Requires health education courses to include instruction on human development from conception to birth.

title: Relating to vaccination against COVID-19; declaring an emergency.
summary: Prohibits state agencies from enforcing any rules requiring COVID-19 vaccination, and declares an emergency effective on passage.

title: Relating to individuals with complex health care needs; declaring an emergency.
summary: Directs OHA to study mental health access for people civilly committed or with complex needs and to pilot hospital-community regional grants.

title: Relating to insuring against the peril of wildfire; declaring an emergency.
summary: Creates a state wildfire fire and property insurance program through a SAIF subsidiary, funded by a new Wildfire Risk Insurance Fund, prioritizing underserved areas.

title: Relating to renewable energy facilities in highway right of way.
summary: Directs ODOT and county authorities to prioritize applications to place renewable energy facilities and transmission lines within state highway and county road rights of way.

title: Relating to an organic policy special assistant to the Director of Agriculture.
summary: Directs the Director of Agriculture to employ an organic policy special assistant to advise on organic policy tasks.

title: Relating to the use of natural gas as an energy source.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Prohibits local governments from banning or limiting residential natural gas use, with certain exceptions.

title: Relating to pretrial incarceration.
summary: Limits pretrial release for felony and Class A misdemeanor defendants to security release and reimburses counties for pretrial incarceration costs of felony defendants.

title: Relating to energy.
summary: Directs ODOE to create a statewide clearinghouse and single application process for energy efficiency incentives, with multilingual outreach and navigation support.

title: Relating to the Oregon Sunshine Committee.
summary: Changes Oregon Sunshine Committee report dates and reviewing committees, and disestablishes the public records subcommittee.

title: Relating to the Oregon Empowerment Scholarship Program.
summary: Creates the Oregon Empowerment Scholarship Program, transferring state money to students for qualified school expenses, with enrollment capped by district for ten years.

title: Relating to the provision of information for courses of study offered by school districts; declaring an emergency.
summary: Requires school boards to post specified information about district courses of study on the district website.

title: Relating to first-time home buyer savings accounts; prescribing an effective date.
summary: Doubles annual contribution limits for first-time home buyer savings accounts, extends eligibility to 2030, and lets non-holders claim contribution subtractions.

title: Relating to credit for student activities; prescribing an effective date.
summary: Directs ODE, with the STEM Investment Council, to review and recommend standards letting technology-based competitive activities count toward diploma or CTE credit; sunsets 2026.

title: Relating to administrative rules.
summary: Requires agencies to appear before a legislative committee for a hearing on a rule when ten legislators object in writing.

title: Relating to funding for after-school programs; declaring an emergency.
summary: Creates the After-School Learning and Enrichment Grant Program, administered by the Department of Education, and appropriates General Fund money to it.

title: Relating to exemption of health care receipts from corporate activity tax; prescribing an effective date.
summary: Exempts health care service reimbursements, including Medicaid and Medicare care, from Oregon's corporate activity tax, starting tax years on or after January 1, 2026.

title: Relating to urbanization; declaring an emergency.
summary: Lets certain cities with demonstrated housing need add project areas to their urban growth boundaries under conditions, sunsetting in 2035.

title: Relating to gender reassignment surgery.
summary: Raises the age for some gender-affirming treatments to 18 and bans irreversible gender reassignment surgery on minors, with exceptions.

title: Relating to taking the drive test.
summary: Directs rural Oregon DMV field offices to prioritize drive test requests from applicants living in rural Oregon or within 50 miles.

title: Relating to aviation; prescribing an effective date.
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget; Transportation
summary: Creates an income tax credit for aircraft owners converting to unleaded fuel, funds airport unleaded-fuel and noise grants, and expands the State Aviation Board.

title: Relating to laws concerning job-protected leave from work.
summary: Directs the Employment Department to study job-protected leave laws and report findings to legislative committees by September 15, 2026.

title: Relating to residence requirements for women upon release from a Department of Corrections institution.
summary: Directs the Department of Corrections to study residence requirements for women released from its institutions and report findings by September 15, 2026.

title: Relating to age qualifications for retirement under the Public Employees Retirement System.
summary: Requires the Public Employees Retirement Board to study PERS retirement age qualifications and report findings by September 15, 2026.

title: Relating to the payment of certain bonuses under the pay equity requirements.
summary: Requires BOLI to study issues around paying certain bonuses under pay equity law and report to legislative committees by September 15, 2026.

title: Relating to self-insured employers.
summary: Lets school districts apply for exemption from the financial-security rules that self-insured employers must meet for workers' compensation claims.

title: Relating to the accessibility of information under a Healthy and Safe Schools Plan.
summary: Removes redundant and extra reporting requirements under Oregon's Healthy and Safe Schools Plan, streamlining how school safety information is reported.

title: Relating to transparency concerning employer deductions from wages.
summary: Requires employers to give employees written explanations of pay stub earnings and deductions at hire and yearly, with BOLI penalties and model guidance.

title: Relating to ownership of premises; and prescribing an effective date.
summary: Requires marijuana and psilocybin license and registration applicants and renewals to disclose premises ownership and location, and bars issuance or renewal in specified cases.

title: Relating to labeling requirements for items containing cannabis.
summary: Requires cannabis item labels and hemp-derived vapor product labels to state that the minimum age for use is 21.

title: Relating to children with complex needs; declaring an emergency.
summary: Expands Medicaid eligibility for children with complex needs by disregarding parental income and creating psychiatric level-of-care criteria and home-based mental health services.

title: Relating to firefighting foam.
summary: Prohibits the sale, use and disposal of PFAS-containing firefighting foam in certain places, and directs the EQC to set up a safe collection and disposal program.

title: Relating to cardiac events of student athletes.
summary: Requires schools and coaches to train on, and share information about, cardiac event symptoms for student athletes, with guidelines for students.

title: Relating to independent living transition services; prescribing an effective date.
summary: Requires DHS to adopt a payment methodology for providers of independent living transition services for foster children.

title: Relating to child abuse.
summary: Sets out parental duties to protect children and meet their basic needs, and defines when chronic or extreme neglect counts as child abuse.

title: Relating to justice of the peace districts.
summary: Removes state limits on counties creating justice of the peace districts that include cities or county seats.

title: Relating to problem gambling.
summary: Requires certain state lottery billboards to include information about a problem gambling helpline.

title: Relating to the investigation of child abuse committed by a person who is unrelated to the child.
summary: Directs DHS to ensure child abuse assessment and investigation standards for unrelated perpetrators are handled by a specialized department program.

title: Relating to unemployment insurance benefits for employees unemployed due to a labor dispute.
summary: Removes the labor-dispute bar on unemployment benefits for strikers but adds an extra disqualified week, possible limits, and overpayment recovery when back pay is received.

title: Relating to the labeling of items that contain marijuana.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice
summary: Requires marijuana retailers and dispensaries to post pregnancy warning signs, and requires labeling warning that marijuana use during pregnancy may be dangerous.

title: Relating to health education curriculum.
summary: Requires health education courses to include instruction on human development from conception to birth.

title: Relating to graduation requirements; declaring an emergency.
summary: Requires high school students to meet reading, writing and math standards and show proficiency in Essential Learning Skills before receiving a diploma.

title: Relating to community solar projects.
summary: Expands Oregon's community solar program by raising the capacity cap, allowing cross-territory subscribers, and adding utility penalties for interconnection delays.

title: Relating to Oregon State University Extension Service oversight of behavioral health promotion; and declaring an emergency.
summary: Directs OSU Extension Service to oversee a project promoting behavioral health and improving mental health and substance use services, and declares an emergency.

title: Relating to shipyards.
summary: Authorizes a state infrastructure loan to the Port of Coos Bay for shipyard repairs, funded by allocating economic development fund moneys, and requires a shipyard study.

title: Relating to the payment of tips received by employees in the food service industry.
summary: Requires food service employers to distribute credit card tips to employees within 24 hours after the transaction is processed.

title: Relating to an appropriation for a multiuse recreational facility; declaring an emergency.
summary: Appropriates state money to seed the capital campaign for a multiuse recreational sports facility serving Douglas County, effective on passage.

title: Relating to the forensic testing of controlled substances; declaring an emergency.
summary: Directs the State Police to study ways to speed up forensic testing of controlled substances and report to interim committees by January 31, 2026.

title: Relating to tolling on Interstate 205.
summary: Prohibits the Oregon Transportation Commission from establishing tolls on Interstate 205.

title: Relating to wildfires resulting from the fault of an electric company; declaring an emergency.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Environment and energy
summary: Bars utilities from recovering wildfire negligence judgment costs from customers and restricts shareholder payouts while judgments are unpaid. Adds a wildfire safety certification requirement.

title: Relating to renewable energy.
topics: Environment and energy; Taxes and budget
summary: Creates an income or corporate excise tax credit for transmission-service payments by owners of solar, wind, or storage facilities, requiring State Department of Energy certification.

title: Relating to ensuring that forced labor is not used for electric products that public bodies procure; prescribing an effective date.
topics: Environment and energy; Labor and employment; Transportation
summary: Requires public bodies buying EVs and solar panels to obtain supplier certifications that no forced or oppressive child labor was used, with penalties for false certifications.

title: Relating to the Oregon Coast Trail; prescribing an effective date.
summary: Appropriates General Fund and lottery money to State Parks to develop, maintain and complete the Oregon Coast Trail.

title: Relating to tax incentives for financial institution lending in rural areas; prescribing an effective date.
summary: Creates Oregon tax subtractions and commercial activity tax exemptions for bank interest on rural farm, residence and coastal fishing boat loans, 2026-2031.

title: Relating to a tax credit for reforestation; prescribing an effective date.
summary: Reinstates a tax credit for reforestation, the creation of new forests, effective 91 days after sine die adjournment.

title: Relating to interpretation of laws.
summary: Bars courts from deferring to state agency interpretations of statutes or rules and directs interpretations that limit agency power and maximize individual liberty.

title: Relating to restoring driving privileges; declaring an emergency.
summary: Adds a waiting period before a revoked driver can petition to restore privileges after a new car-related conviction.

title: Relating to reports on talented and gifted children.
summary: Requires school districts to report talented and gifted student information to ODE, which will publish annual district and state report cards.

title: Relating to the identification of talented and gifted children.
summary: Sets requirements for school districts to identify talented and gifted children.

title: Relating to the Joint Task Force on Regional Behavioral Health Accountability; declaring an emergency.
summary: Extends the deadlines and sunset date for the Joint Task Force on Regional Behavioral Health Accountability, and declares an emergency.

title: Relating to public health infrastructure facilities; declaring an emergency.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration; Housing
summary: Makes public health infrastructure facilities an allowed use in any zone where an agency deadline exists, and limits local approval criteria.

title: Relating to foster youth; declaring an emergency.
summary: Directs DHS to make an annual distribution to the Oregon Foster Youth Connection for foster youth advocacy and support.

title: Relating to restorative justice.
summary: Changes which entities may receive restorative justice grants and creates a dedicated grant account with continuous appropriation to the Criminal Justice Commission.

title: Relating to security for nonprofit organizations; declaring an emergency.
summary: Directs the Oregon Department of Emergency Management to create a grant program funding security upgrades for nonprofit organizations, effective on passage as an emergency.

title: Relating to vehicle weight limits; prescribing an effective date.
summary: Directs ODOT to study heavier milk-hauling trucks, then create a pilot allowing 129,000-pound loads on approved routes.

title: Relating to rural residential lands.
summary: Expands the rural residential zoning definition and allows accessory dwellings, RVs, or emergency shelters on certain farmland with nonfarm dwellings.

title: Relating to the supply of land to build homes and grow businesses.
summary: Requires the Department of Land Conservation and Development to study the supply of land for homes and businesses and report to legislative committees by September 15, 2026.

title: Relating to health insurance coverage for adults over the age of 26.
summary: Requires individual and group health plans to cover children over 26 in certain circumstances, adding a coverage mandate on insurers.

title: Relating to audiology; prescribing an effective date.
summary: Revises audiology practice definitions and scope of practice, and requires the speech-language and audiology board to set investigation timelines by rule.

title: Relating to older foster children.
summary: Removes the rent requirement for older foster children living alone, allows DHS background-check exemptions, and modifies independent living rules.

title: Relating to foster children.
summary: Makes youth aging out of foster care under age 26 eligible for Medicaid and requires seeking federal matching funds for out-of-state cases.

title: Relating to funding the operations of the Bureau of Labor and Industries.
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Lets the Workers' Benefit Fund pay the Bureau of Labor and Industries commissioner's expenses for carrying out statutory duties.

title: Relating to the national guard.
summary: Replaces the term "militia" with "National Guard" in state statutes and removes the phrase "unorganized militia"; no substantive change is described.

title: Relating to play-based education.
summary: Lets school boards offer play-based learning in grades preK-5 and directs the Education Department to provide related professional development.

title: Relating to affordable housing; declaring an emergency.
summary: Directs the housing department to disburse money to Self Enhancement, Inc. to develop affordable housing, sunsetting in 2028.

title: Relating to judicial positions; and declaring an emergency.
summary: Creates new circuit court judge positions in certain judicial districts and declares an emergency effective on passage.

title: Relating to sign language interpreters; and prescribing an effective date.
summary: Creates new sign language interpreter license types, lets out-of-state interpreters and certain temporary providers work without a license, and repeals specialty licenses.

title: Relating to the practice of health care; and declaring an emergency.
summary: Bars management services organizations and their affiliates from controlling professional medical entities, voids related noncompetes and nondisclosure agreements for medical professionals, and creates a private right to sue.

title: Relating to vacancies in the United States Senate.
summary: Requires the Governor to appoint a U.S. Senator of the same party after a vacancy and call a special election within a set period.

title: Relating to transitions to kindergarten.
summary: Creates a task force to recommend best practices for helping children with disabilities transition into kindergarten, sunsetting December 31, 2026.

title: Relating to penalties for causing fires.
summary: Increases criminal penalties for unlawfully causing fires, with escalating jail terms and fines for repeat offenses and offenses causing injury or property damage.

title: Relating to a specially assessed value for the residences of veterans; prescribing an effective date.
summary: Gives veterans and surviving spouses a specially assessed property tax value for their owner-occupied primary residences, ending on death, remarriage, or sale.

title: Relating to wastewater treatment; prescribing an effective date.
topics: Environment and energy; Taxes and budget
summary: Appropriates General Fund money to DAS for a grant to Heard Farms to expand wastewater treatment infrastructure.

title: Relating to restrictive covenants in health care provider agreements; declaring an emergency.
summary: Voids noncompetition agreements involving licensed health care providers, with specified exceptions, applying to existing and new agreements, effective on signing.

title: Relating to local designation of lands outside of an urban growth boundary.
summary: Lets cities and counties designate land outside urban growth boundaries for homes or light commercial use, exempt from statewide land use planning laws.

title: Relating to alarm systems.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Criminal justice
summary: Makes possessing a signal jammer to break in or steal a crime, adds jammers to burglary tool law, and exempts alarm systems from right-to-repair tool access.

title: Relating to compensation of judges; declaring an emergency.
summary: Increases the salaries of Oregon state court judges and declares an emergency, effective on passage.

title: Relating to state financial administration; and declaring an emergency.
summary: Budget bill that appropriates funds, transfers money between accounts, repeals a summer learning account, and makes several program and deadline adjustments.

title: Relating to a sister state committee for Oregon and Ireland.
summary: Creates an Oregon-Ireland Sister State Committee to handle sister-state relations between Oregon and Ireland.

title: Relating to funding to support use of rental units as family child care homes.
summary: Creates a Department of Early Learning and Care grant program helping tenants update rental homes for use as family child care homes, sunsetting in 2045.

title: Relating to redemption centers; prescribing an effective date.
summary: Directs the OLCC to create a grant program funding full-service redemption centers in each city over 10,000 population, with an appropriation for the grants.

title: Relating to the definition of postal indicator for ballot envelopes.
summary: Defines "postal indicator" for ballot envelopes as an official USPS mark used to determine when a ballot was mailed.

title: Relating to ballots.
summary: Bans individuals from collecting and returning others' ballots, with exceptions, and sets per-ballot fines for violations.

title: Relating to health professional licensing interstate compacts; prescribing an effective date.
summary: Joins the Nurse Licensure Compact, letting nurses licensed in other member states practice in Oregon without an Oregon license.

title: Relating to local improvements.
summary: Lets local governments enter agreements governing local improvements proposed for unincorporated areas within an urban growth boundary.

title: Relating to deductions from employee wages.
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Lets public employers deduct erroneous overpayments from public employees' wages under set conditions and procedures.

title: Relating to the permitting of energy facilities.
summary: Bars the state Energy Facility Siting Council from reviewing renewable energy facilities and transmission lines wholly on federal land that undergo NEPA review.

title: Relating to funding for services in domestic relations cases; and declaring an emergency.
topics: Children and families; Consumer protection and business
summary: Requires county and court financial reports on conciliation and mediation accounts and lets counties raise marriage license and domestic partnership fees.

title: Relating to the provision of instruction in a manner that is not in person.
summary: Limits when students may be placed in remote or online learning and makes enrollment in those programs voluntary, with exceptions.

title: Relating to educational surrogates; prescribing an effective date.
summary: Creates a certification program for educational surrogates, run through a disability advocacy agency under contract, and appropriates funds to DAS for it.

title: Relating to intervention in juvenile dependency matters.
summary: Changes who may claim a caregiver relationship with a child and the procedure for intervening in child welfare proceedings.

title: Relating to publicly supported housing; and prescribing an effective date.
summary: Extends landlords' notice period to tenants before affordability restrictions on publicly supported housing expire, from 20 to 30 months, and requires notice to applicants.

title: Relating to the timeline for reviewing land use applications for housing; and prescribing an effective date.
summary: Creates a limited land use review process for residential development inside urban growth boundaries, bars certain design review requirements, and sets a 120-day engineering plan review timeline.

title: Relating to exempting certain private firearm transfers from the criminal background check requirement.
summary: Exempts certain transferees, such as Address Confidentiality Program participants and continuous-traveler license holders, from the private firearm transfer background check requirement.

title: Relating to providing animal health care; and declaring an emergency.
summary: Lets non-veterinarians verify cattle pregnancy without a state veterinary license in certain cases, with ODA rules, and creates an equine dentistry task force.

title: Relating to post-secondary education for individuals with disabilities; declaring an emergency.
summary: Directs the HECC to create a college program for youth with intellectual and developmental disabilities and appropriates funds, and creates a task force to study related law changes.

title: Relating to legal processes involving education districts.
summary: Requires school districts and education service districts to prepare an annual report on their legal processes and legal expenditures for the school year.

title: Relating to a study on post-secondary educational opportunities for individuals with disabilities; declaring an emergency.
summary: Directs the Higher Education Coordinating Commission to study post-secondary opportunities for people with disabilities, convene an advisory group, and report by September 2026.

title: Relating to court processes; and declaring an emergency.
summary: Modifies unspecified court processes and procedures and declares an emergency, effective on passage.

title: Relating to job profiles for unlicensed school jobs; prescribing an effective date.
summary: Directs DAS to study and develop standardized job profiles for unlicensed school jobs, convene an advisory committee, and report to legislative education committees.

title: Relating to the maximum age for students in public education; declaring an emergency.
summary: Raises the maximum age at which students may receive public education; declares an emergency effective July 1, 2025.

title: Relating to out-of-state residential placements of students; and declaring an emergency.
summary: Limits school districts' use of public funds for out-of-state student placements to cases meeting specified criteria, with some exceptions, and lets DHS charge districts licensing costs.

title: Relating to the adoption of local budgets; and declaring an emergency.
summary: Lets local public officials debate and vote on local budgets that include their own or a relative's compensation, after announcing a conflict of interest.

title: Relating to the use of land within an urban growth boundary.
summary: Allows battery-charged fences within urban growth boundaries on properties not used as residences, loosening where such fences are permitted.

title: Relating to appropriations for livestock loss; declaring an emergency.
topics: Environment and energy; Taxes and budget
summary: Appropriates General Fund money to the Department of Agriculture for the Wolf Management Compensation and Proactive Trust Fund, addressing livestock losses, and declares an emergency.

title: Relating to livestock brands; declaring an emergency.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Taxes and budget
summary: Appropriates General Fund money to the Department of Agriculture for the livestock brand inspection program and declares an emergency.

title: Relating to felon in possession of a firearm.
summary: Raises the sentencing crime category for felon in possession of a firearm to category 8, increasing penalties.

title: Relating to treatment of minor children.
summary: Lets parents admit minors, with or without the child's consent, to licensed inpatient mental health or substance use treatment, with assessments and a review process for children 14 and older.

title: Relating to treatment of minor children.
summary: Lets parents admit minor children, with or without consent, to licensed inpatient mental health or substance use treatment, with assessments, reviews, and a child-14-and-older review process.

title: Relating to property tax incentive benefit programs for brownfields; and prescribing an effective date.
summary: Extends the sunset date for property tax incentive programs for brownfields and property on brownfields, keeping those breaks in place longer.

title: Relating to exempting certain jurisdictions within the state from the requirement to pay a prevailing rate of wage.
summary: Exempts smaller cities and counties from paying prevailing wage on public construction projects by narrowing the definition of public agency.

title: Relating to temporary total disability benefits.
summary: Removes two grounds on which workers can refuse modified work without losing temporary total disability benefits, making more modified job offers qualify.

title: Relating to beverage containers; and declaring an emergency.
summary: Lets the OLCC approve alternative redemption centers and lets dealers, wineries and large-city dealers refuse certain bottle returns, and orders a study of the Bottle Bill.

title: Relating to the release of booking photos; and prescribing an effective date.
summary: Authorizes law enforcement agencies to release booking photos to licensed private investigators; takes effect 91st day after sine die.

title: Relating to small modular reactor energy facilities.
summary: Exempts small modular reactor power plants from the requirement that voters approve their siting and site certificates.

title: Relating to small modular reactor energy facilities; providing that this Act shall be referred to the people for their approval or rejection.
summary: Exempts small modular reactor power plant siting from the statewide voter approval requirement and refers the change to voters at the next general election.

title: Relating to small modular reactor energy facilities.
summary: Allows small modular reactor power plants to be sited in Oregon without first having a licensed high-level radioactive waste disposal repository.

title: Relating to small modular reactor energy facilities; providing that this Act shall be referred to the people for their approval or rejection.
summary: Exempts small modular reactor power plants from the requirement that a radioactive waste disposal site exist before siting, and refers the Act to voters.

title: Relating to the Director of the Department of Environmental Quality.
summary: Moves appointment of the DEQ Director from the Environmental Quality Commission to the Governor, subject to Senate confirmation.

title: Relating to farmworker camps.
summary: Narrows the definition of "farmworker camp" so related laws apply only to camps serving seasonal or temporary workers.

title: Adjourning sine die the 2025 regular session of the Eighty-third Legislative Assembly.
summary: Adjourns the 2025 regular legislative session sine die, ending the session with no policy change.

title: In memoriam: Senate President Peter Courtney, 1943-2024.
summary: Memorial resolution honoring the life and memory of former Senate President Peter Courtney.

title: Recognizing and honoring the National Conference of State Legislatures on its 50th anniversary in 2025.
summary: Honors the National Conference of State Legislatures on its 50th anniversary in 2025; no policy effect.

title: Recognizing and honoring Robin A. Church for her outstanding service to the people of the State of Oregon.
summary: Honors Robin A. Church for her service to Oregon; a ceremonial resolution with no policy effect.

title: Designating the T-bone as the official state steak.
summary: Designates the T-bone as Oregon's official state steak, a ceremonial honor with no policy effect.

title: Adjourning the organizational session of the Eighty-third Legislative Assembly.
summary: Adjourns the organizational session of the 2025 Legislative Assembly and sets the regular session to convene January 21, 2025.

title: Recognizing and honoring Hector Hinojosa Robles for his remarkable contributions to the people of this state.
summary: Honors Hector Hinojosa Robles for his contributions to the people of Oregon; ceremonial with no policy effect.

title: In memoriam: Dr. Ralph Franklin Helzerman Jr.
summary: Memorial resolution honoring the life and memory of Dr. Ralph Franklin Helzerman Jr.

title: Celebrating the life and accomplishments of Colonel Richard Kidd and honoring him for his service to his country.
summary: Honors and celebrates the life and military service of Colonel Richard Kidd through a commemorative resolution.

title: Recognizing and honoring John McArdle for his leadership and service to the City of Independence and the State of Oregon.
summary: Honors John McArdle for his leadership and service to Independence and Oregon; no policy effect.

title: In memoriam: Leonard Warren Krug.
summary: Honors the life and memory of Leonard Warren Krug through a memorial resolution with no policy effect.

title: Recognizing the important role of Aurora State Airport in the State of Oregon's emergency preparedness and response efforts.
summary: A concurrent resolution recognizing Aurora State Airport's role in Oregon's emergency preparedness and response.

title: Recognizing and honoring the Oregon Institute of Marine Biology for a century of leadership in marine research and service to the State of Oregon, the United States and all maritime nations.
summary: Honors the Oregon Institute of Marine Biology for a century of marine research and service; no policy effect.

title: Celebrating the 250th anniversary of the United States Postal Service.
summary: Resolution celebrating the 250th anniversary of the United States Postal Service; no policy effect.

title: Urging Oregonians to avoid psychoactive drug use except for legitimate medical purposes.
summary: A non-binding resolution urging Oregonians to avoid psychoactive drug use except for legitimate medical purposes.

title: In memoriam: Moses Ross.
summary: Memorial resolution honoring the life and memory of Moses Ross, with no policy effect.

title: Honoring the Association of Oregon Counties on the 120th anniversary of its founding.
summary: Honors the Association of Oregon Counties on the 120th anniversary of its founding.

title: Adjourning sine die the 2026 regular session of the Eighty-third Legislative Assembly.
summary: Adjourns the 2026 regular legislative session of Oregon's Eighty-third Legislative Assembly sine die.

title: In memoriam: State Senator Aaron Lionel Woods.
summary: Memorial resolution honoring the life and memory of former State Senator Aaron Lionel Woods, with no policy effect.

title: Establishing procedural rules for legislative branch.
summary: Sets firm deadlines and procedural rules for completing legislative measures during the 2026 regular session.

title: Amending Legislative Branch Personnel Rule 27 and adopting Legislative Branch Personnel Rule 27-C.
summary: Consolidates legislative workplace conduct report and complaint processes and limits public disclosure to the final investigative report.

title: Establishing deadlines for presession-filed legislative measures for the 2027 regular session of the Eighty-fourth Legislative Assembly.
summary: Sets filing deadlines for presession bill requests and measures for Oregon's 2027 legislative session.

title: Commemorating the 100th anniversary of Multnomah Falls Lodge.
summary: Commemorates the 100th anniversary of Multnomah Falls Lodge with no policy effect.

title: Commending the 2024 University of Oregon Ducks football team.
summary: Commends the 2024 University of Oregon Ducks football team for its outstanding season; no policy effect.

title: Creating a ceremonial relationship between the State of Oregon and Cherkasy Oblast, Ukraine.
summary: Creates a ceremonial relationship between Oregon and Cherkasy Oblast, Ukraine, with no policy effect.

title: Recognizing and honoring Brian Edward Flowers for his service to Gresham and to this state.
summary: Honors Brian Edward Flowers for his service to Gresham and Oregon; ceremonial resolution with no policy effect.

title: Recognizing and honoring Ruth McEwen for her outstanding service to the people of the State of Oregon.
summary: Honors and recognizes Ruth McEwen for her service to the people of Oregon; no policy effect.

title: Reaffirming the State of Oregon's commitment to its relationship with Taiwan.
summary: Resolution reaffirming Oregon's commitment to its relationship with Taiwan and honoring past cooperation, with no policy effect.

title: Providing that Senators and Representatives may use their services and supplies account to pay for parking permits to be supplied to member staff or to reimburse member staff for parking costs associated with parking at or near the State Capitol.
summary: Allows legislators to use their services and supplies accounts to pay for staff parking permits or reimburse staff parking costs near the Capitol.

title: In memoriam: Charles Benjamin "Chuck" Mawhinney.
summary: Memorial resolution honoring the life and service of Charles Benjamin "Chuck" Mawhinney, with no policy effect.

title: In memoriam: William D. (Bill) Thorndike, Jr., 1953-2025.
summary: Memorial resolution honoring the life and service of former Oregon legislator Bill Thorndike, Jr.

title: Requiring written authorization for the use of emergency clauses.
summary: Requires written sponsor authorization before bills or amendments containing emergency clauses can be filed, started, or adopted in committee.

title: Designates April 10, 2025, as Purple Up! Day for Month of the Military Child.
summary: Designates April 10, 2025, as Purple Up! Day for Month of the Military Child in Oregon.

title: Commending the Legislative Commission on Indian Services on its 50th anniversary.
summary: Commends the Legislative Commission on Indian Services on its 50th anniversary; has no policy effect.

title: Reaffirming the State of Oregon's commitment to its relationship with the People's Republic of China.
summary: Resolution honoring Oregon's past work with China and reaffirming the state's commitment to that relationship; it makes no policy changes.

title: Recognizing and honoring former Wallowa County Commissioner Susan Roberts for her service to this state.
summary: Honors former Wallowa County Commissioner Susan Roberts for her service to Oregon.

title: Establishing limitations and deadlines for legislative measures for the 2026 regular session of the Eighty-third Legislative Assembly, and providing certain labor negotiation procedures.
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Sets 2026 legislative deadlines and provides that certain labor negotiations are conducted in executive session, not as legislative deliberations.

title: Requiring that a committee of the Legislative Assembly may adopt an amendment to a legislative measure only if the chief sponsor of the measure approves the amendment prior to its adoption by the committee.
summary: Requires that a legislative committee adopt an amendment to a measure only if the measure's chief sponsor approves it first.

title: Commending the 2023 and 2024 state champion Thurston High School baseball teams.
summary: Commends the 2023 and 2024 state champion Thurston High School baseball teams.

title: Recognizing and honoring the South Eugene Robotics Team for its accomplishments in robotics and its commitment to the greater good.
summary: Honors the South Eugene Robotics Team for its robotics accomplishments and commitment to the greater good.

title: In memoriam: Dr. Phillip David Creighton.
summary: Memorial resolution honoring the life and memory of Dr. Phillip David Creighton; no policy effect.

title: Recognizing and honoring Private William Ezra Leon "Billy" Calkins for his service to his country.
summary: Honors the life and service of Private Billy Calkins with a legislative resolution; no policy effect.

title: Commending the Legislative Commission on Indian Services on its 50th anniversary.
summary: Commends the Legislative Commission on Indian Services on its 50th anniversary; has no policy effect.

title: Urging Congress to conduct public hearings on anti-military bias and improve enforcement of hate-crime protections for military families.
summary: Non-binding memorial urging Congress to hold hearings on anti-military bias and improve hate-crime enforcement for military families.

title: Urging the President, the Executive Director of the Maritime Administration and Congress to purchase the SS United States, designate it as a National Historic Landmark, restore it and name it the flagship of our nation.
summary: Oregon joint memorial urging federal officials to buy, designate, restore and name the SS United States as the national flagship.

title: Urging Congress to enact legislation alleviating the funding crisis in the Crime Victims Fund.
summary: Urges Congress to pass legislation to address the funding crisis in the federal Crime Victims Fund.

title: Urging the federal government to reimburse real property owners for damage from wildfires originating on federal lands.
summary: Urges the federal government to create and fund a system reimbursing property owners for damage from wildfires that start on federal lands.

title: Urging the President, the United States Secretary of the Interior and the United States Secretary of Agriculture to direct federal agencies to be as aggressive as possible in preventing, mitigating and suppressing wildfires on federal lands.
summary: Urges federal leaders to aggressively prevent, mitigate and suppress wildfires on federal lands in Oregon; the memorial has no direct legal effect.

title: Urging the President and Congress to pursue Oregon and California Railroad grant land management reforms.
summary: Memorial urging the President and Congress to pursue land management reforms for Oregon and California Railroad grant lands.

title: Urging Congress to propose an amendment to the United States Constitution to require the federal government to operate under a balanced budget wherein federal government expenditures do not exceed federal government revenues.
summary: Urges Congress to propose a U.S. constitutional amendment requiring a balanced federal budget, with expenditures not exceeding revenues.

title: Requesting discussion regarding the Oregon and Idaho border.
summary: Urges Oregon and Idaho governments to discuss relocating the state border between them.

title: Requesting the FTC and the NIST to coordinate on a repair score for consumer electronic devices.
summary: Asks federal agencies to coordinate on voluntary criteria for a one-to-ten repair score that manufacturers may display to consumers.

title: Urging the President, the United States Secretary of the Interior and the United States Secretary of Agriculture to direct federal agencies to be as aggressive as possible in preventing, mitigating and suppressing wildfires on federal lands.
summary: Urges the President and federal Interior and Agriculture secretaries to aggressively prevent, mitigate and suppress wildfires on federal lands in Oregon.

title: Proposing an amendment to the Oregon Constitution relating to a property tax relief program for the owner-occupied primary residences of certain seniors.
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Refers a constitutional amendment to voters directing the legislature to enact a property tax break for seniors' owner-occupied primary residences.

title: Proposing an amendment to the Oregon Constitution relating to limits on state governmental appropriations.
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment capping state general-purpose appropriation growth at the lowest of several economic measures, sending excess revenue to a reserve, for voter approval.

title: Proposing an amendment to the Oregon Constitution relating to lottery revenues.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment, for voter approval, requiring a set percentage of lottery revenues go to wildfire prevention, suppression or management.

title: Proposing an amendment to the Oregon Constitution relating to requiring a two-thirds vote to pass bills during even-numbered year regular sessions.
summary: Refers a constitutional amendment to voters requiring a two-thirds vote in each House to pass bills in even-numbered year regular sessions.

title: Proposing an amendment to the Oregon Constitution relating to fishing, hunting, harvesting wildlife or gathering wild foods.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Refers a constitutional amendment to voters declaring a right to fish, hunt, harvest wildlife and gather wild foods, subject to legal restrictions.

title: Proposing an amendment to the Oregon Constitution relating to the legislative districts of Senators.
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Refers a constitutional amendment to voters to expand the Oregon Senate from 30 to 36 members, with districts matching county boundaries.

title: Proposing an amendment to the Oregon Constitution relating to surplus revenue.
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Would end the constitutional requirement to return surplus state revenue to personal income taxpayers, referring the change to voters.

title: Proposing an amendment to the Oregon Constitution relating to the death penalty.
summary: Refers a constitutional amendment to voters that would prohibit the death penalty in Oregon.

title: Proposing an amendment to the Oregon Constitution relating to banks.
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Refers a constitutional amendment to voters clarifying that the state may establish a state-owned public bank despite an existing restriction on certain banks.

title: Proposing an amendment to the Oregon Constitution relating to declarations of emergency.
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment placing durational and other limits on the Governor's emergency declarations, to go to voters at the next general election.

title: Proposing an amendment to the Oregon Constitution relating to executive clemency.
summary: Refers a constitutional amendment to voters requiring a Senate majority to approve any pardon or commutation.

title: Proposing an amendment to the Oregon Constitution relating to excluding partial exemptions and property tax credits from the requirement of redetermining the maximum assessed value of property granted exemption or credit.
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment, subject to voter approval, exempting partial exemptions and property tax credits from maximum assessed value redetermination.

title: Proposing an amendment to the Oregon Constitution relating to executive clemency.
summary: Refers a constitutional amendment to voters requiring a Senate majority to approve any reprieve, commutation, or pardon.

title: Proposing an amendment to the Oregon Constitution relating to surplus revenue.
summary: Constitutional amendment directing part of surplus revenue, now returned as the personal kicker, to K-12, community colleges and wildfire, subject to voter approval.

title: Proposing an amendment to the Oregon Constitution relating to the duration of regular sessions of the Legislative Assembly.
summary: Refers a constitutional amendment to voters to extend regular legislative sessions by one day for each day a chamber lacks a quorum.

title: Proposing an amendment to the Oregon Constitution relating to the identifiability of law enforcement officers.
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment, for voter approval, barring masked law enforcement officers and requiring identifying information, with specified exceptions.

title: Proposing an amendment to the Oregon Constitution relating to redistricting.
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment creating a Citizens Redistricting Commission to draw Oregon legislative and U.S. House maps, referred to voters.

title: Proposing an amendment to the Oregon Constitution relating to a property tax relief program for the owner-occupied primary residences of certain seniors.
summary: Refers a constitutional amendment to voters directing the Legislature to create a property tax relief program for seniors' owner-occupied homes.

title: Proposing an amendment to the Oregon Constitution expanding the scope of the term "bills for raising revenue."
summary: Refers a constitutional amendment to voters that broadens what counts as a revenue bill, so more tax measures need a three-fifths legislative vote.

title: Proposing an amendment to the Oregon Constitution relating to educational choice.
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment giving parents a right to choose their child's school, and requires school choice accounts for nonpublic education.

title: Proposing an amendment to the Oregon Constitution relating to education budgets.
summary: Refers a constitutional amendment to voters requiring the Legislature to pass the public education budget first, within 80 days, in odd-year sessions.

title: Proposing an amendment to the Oregon Constitution relating to sessions of the Legislative Assembly.
summary: Refers a constitutional amendment to voters to eliminate short even-numbered-year regular legislative sessions.

title: Proposing an amendment to the Oregon Constitution relating to the right to carry concealed firearms.
summary: Refers a constitutional amendment to voters that would add a right to carry concealed firearms.

title: Proposing an amendment to the Oregon Constitution relating to a clean, safe and healthy environment.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Refers a constitutional amendment to voters creating a fundamental right to a clean, safe and healthy environment.

title: Proposing an amendment to the Oregon Constitution relating to the authority of the Legislative Assembly to conduct business.
summary: Refers a constitutional amendment to voters lowering the legislative quorum from two-thirds to a majority of each house.

title: Proposing an amendment to the Oregon Constitution relating to ad valorem property taxation.
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Refers a constitutional amendment to voters that would reassess property on sale, set a 0.75 assessed-to-market floor, and extend local option taxes exempt from compression.

title: Proposing an amendment to the Oregon Constitution relating to initiative petition signatures.
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment raising initiative petition signature thresholds and requiring signatures spread across all congressional districts, subject to voter approval.

title: Proposing an amendment to the Oregon Constitution relating to vaccine mandates.
summary: Refers a constitutional amendment to voters barring the Governor and executive agencies from requiring medical procedures or vaccines unless the Legislature passes a specific law.

title: Proposing an amendment to the Oregon Constitution relating to natural gas.
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Refers to voters a constitutional amendment creating a right for every Oregonian to access and use natural gas as an energy source.

title: Proposing an amendment to the Oregon Constitution relating to school choice options.
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment establishing parents' right to choose school choice options, with funding, for voter approval.

title: Proposing an amendment to the Oregon Constitution relating to wildfire funding.
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment creating a fund for wildfire prevention, suppression or management, referred to voters at the next general election.

title: Proposing an amendment to the Oregon Constitution relating to motor vehicle fuel taxation.
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment requiring any motor vehicle fuel tax rate to be indexed to inflation, subject to voter approval.

title: Proposing an amendment to the Oregon Constitution relating to voter registration.
summary: Refers a constitutional amendment to voters that would allow voter registration on the day of an election.

title: Proposing an amendment to the Oregon Constitution relating to elections for recalling public officers.
topics: Elections and voting; Government and administration
summary: Refers a constitutional amendment to voters requiring recall questions appear on the ballot at the next regularly scheduled election.

title: Proposing an amendment to the Oregon Constitution relating to the declaration of an emergency in legislative bills.
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment requiring a two-thirds vote in each chamber to pass bills declaring an emergency, referred to voters.

title: Proposing an amendment to the Oregon Constitution relating to an independent redistricting commission.
summary: Refers a constitutional amendment to voters creating an independent redistricting commission to adopt Oregon legislative and congressional district maps.

title: Proposing an amendment to the Oregon Constitution relating to conflict of interest rules for the Legislative Assembly.
summary: Refers a constitutional amendment to voters that would bar legislators from voting on bills when they have a conflict of interest, with exceptions.

title: Modifying Senate Rules to permit certain parking expenses to be paid for out of members' services and supplies account.
summary: Amends Senate Rules to allow staff parking permits and parking reimbursements to be paid from members' services and supplies accounts.

title: Recognizing the important role of Aurora State Airport in the State of Oregon's emergency preparedness and response efforts.
summary: Senate resolution recognizing Aurora State Airport's role in Oregon's emergency preparedness and response efforts.

title: Commending Dr. Mark Terry for his unrivaled contributions to ophthalmology and medical research.
summary: Senate resolution commending Dr. Mark Terry for his contributions to ophthalmology and medical research.

title: Controlled subst. violations
summary: Expands the circumstances that can count as a major violation of the Uniform Controlled Substances Act, broadening conduct subject to the more serious charge.

title: Fire protection projects
summary: Creates a Commerce grant program funding rural local governments' fire protection facilities, capped at $2 million per jurisdiction per biennium, with a committee to set criteria.

title: PTSD/coroners & examiners
summary: Exempts certain county coroner and medical examiner staff hired after 2026 from the L&I rule excluding stress-caused PTSD from workers' compensation occupational disease claims.

title: Service of notice/tenants
summary: Sets rules for mailed notice service, adds five days before actions based on mailed notices, and requires termination notices to state a vacate or compliance date.

title: Property tax exemption
summary: Raises the personal property tax exemption from $15,000 to $50,000, removes the head-of-family restriction, and exempts it from performance review and 10-year expiration.

title: Prearrang. funeral services
summary: Exempts certain funeral merchandise and transportation agreements from prearrangement trust requirements and cuts the required trust share from 90 to 80 percent.

title: Service contracts
summary: Equalizes financial responsibility rules for vehicle service contract and protection product providers, allows per-contract reimbursement insurance, and adds policy terms, disclosure, direct-claim rights, and filing requirements.

title: Small claims actions notice
summary: Changes small claims notice wording so defendants are told judgment may, rather than will, be entered if they fail to appear.

title: County local roads
summary: Concerning county local roads; the text gives no specific change to law or funding.

title: Pharmacy commission members
summary: Adds a pharmacy technician member to the Pharmacy Quality Assurance Commission and lets a pharmacist seat be filled by a pharmacy owner or operator.

title: Rural area ADUs
summary: Authorizes accessory dwelling units in rural areas, allowing additional housing units on rural properties.

title: School safety capital grants
summary: Creates school safety capital grants limited to physical security improvements at common, tribal compact, and charter schools, with matching and administration requirements.

title: Women's commission/gifts
summary: Allows the Washington State Women's Commission to solicit gifts, grants, and endowments from public and private sources.

title: DSHS civil service
summary: Exempts certain Department of Social and Health Services personnel from civil service rules.

title: Child support schedule
summary: Revises the child support schedule and self-support reserve, deducts certain state premiums from income, and allows abatement of support for obligors in court-ordered behavioral health treatment.

title: Energy labeling/residential
summary: Lets cities and counties require home energy performance reports before residential properties are advertised for sale, after an financial impact analysis and mitigation program.

title: Veterans/employer incentives
summary: Creates a B&O and PUT tax credit for employers that hire veterans or military spouses, starting in 2026, capped at $5 million per fiscal year.

title: Kimchi day
summary: Designates November 22 as Kimchi Day, a legislatively recognized day, with no policy effect.

title: Fusion energy facilities
summary: Lets fusion facilities opt into EFSEC certification while requiring radiation control licenses, and limits the nuclear power facility definition to fission plants.

title: Tax incentives for farmers
summary: Creates a tax incentive for farmers who receive conservation grants or join state conservation programs, expiring in 10 years with a JLARC review.

title: Academic reengagement
