title: School projects/engineering
summary: Codifies existing school-project architecture and engineering fee rules into law, but halves the square-footage-based percentage calculations.

title: Pupil transp. safety net
summary: Moves the pupil transportation safety net into statute, providing OSPI-administered awards to districts and schools for excess costs of transporting special-needs, homeless and foster students.

title: Competency-based assessments
summary: Adds competency-based assessments as an option for high school students to meet graduation pathway requirements, including college-level placement and AP, IB, and Cambridge pathways.

title: School board compensation
summary: Raises school director pay limits, paid only from local excess levy funds, and requires director funding training.

title: Education/community rep.
summary: Encourages community representation in education; the text gives no details on what it changes.

title: TRS & PERS plan 1 COLA
summary: Provides a one-time 3 percent benefit increase, capped at $110 monthly, to eligible PERS and TRS Plan 1 retirees starting July 1, 2026.

title: State historical records
summary: Opens state archives' restricted records after 75 years and bars destruction of Lakeland Village preservation records until fiscal year 2030.

title: Vehicle insurance verif.
summary: Concerns verification of motor vehicle insurance; the summary gives no detail on what the verification requires.

title: Garnishment forms
summary: Replaces statutory wage-garnishment answer forms with forms to be developed by a state committee, changing procedure rather than substantive garnishment limits.

title: DCYF frontline staffing
summary: Increases frontline staffing at the Department of Children, Youth, and Families.

title: Mobile pregnancy application
summary: Partners with a mobile pregnancy application to improve maternal and infant health; the text gives no details on rules or funding.

title: Superior court judges
summary: Increases the statutorily authorized number of superior court judges in Skagit County from four to five and in Yakima County from eight to nine.

title: Construction hazards notice
summary: Makes permanent and expands L&I's duty to notify employers or owners of immediately identifies worker hazards to residential and non-residential construction sites, and drops the related reporting requirement.

title: AI systems/suicide liability
summary: Creates civil liability for suicides linked to the use of artificial intelligence systems.

title: Vehicle glass repair claims
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care; Transportation
summary: Bans insureds from assigning property and casualty policy benefits to others, and requires glass shops to notify customers about advanced driver assistance system calibration.

title: PreK promise account
summary: Creates a PreK Promise Account in the State Treasury to hold gifts, grants and donations for ECEAP, spendable only by the DCYF Secretary.

title: DOC/escorted leave
summary: Expands DOC escorted leave for incarcerated people to attend funerals or bedsides of relatives, broadens eligible family, and allows leave for reentry mentorship programs.

title: Unemployment info. reporting
summary: Lets the Employment Security Department waive penalties for minor or inadvertent unemployment insurance reporting errors, including software-caused errors.

title: School liability/WLAD
summary: Addresses school district liability for violations of the Washington Law Against Discrimination; the summary gives no detail on the change.

title: Peace officer false ident.
summary: Concerns false identification as a peace officer; the summary gives no details on the specific change.

title: Anesth. assistant surcharges
summary: Adds a $70 license surcharge for anesthesiologist assistants, expands the impaired-practitioner surcharge to all Commission licensees, and gives them WPHP and HEAL-WA access.

title: Plant-based food in schools
summary: Requires or encourages schools to offer plant-based food options; the bill text is a single sentence with no details.

title: JLARC work plans
summary: Eliminates JLARC's biennial report on municipal lodging tax use and its periodic evaluation of the Program.

title: Toxicology testing
summary: Makes blood or breath toxicology analysis valid in DUI and physical control cases only if performed by an ISO/IEC 17025-accredited lab; localities may accept donations for this.

title: Enhanced medicaid payments
summary: Provides enhanced Medicaid payments to providers and hospitals; the summary gives no detail on amounts or eligibility.

title: Correctional workers/stress
summary: Creates a presumption that PTSD is an occupational disease for local correctional workers and exempts them from an L&I rule excluding stress-based mental conditions from workers' compensation.

title: SEBB membership/second year
summary: Sets a 630-hour prior-year work threshold for school employees to be presumed eligible for SEBB benefits.

title: Underutilized property/tax
summary: Lets mid-sized cities defer sales and use taxes on redevelopment of underdeveloped land, with affordability conditions and reduced-affordability zones.

title: Housing dev./religious orgs.
summary: Creates density bonuses and a sales tax exemption for affordable housing built on religious organization property, with long-term affordability covenants.

title: Personality rights
summary: Expands personality rights to forged digital likenesses, raises the civil penalty to $3,000, and allows actual and noneconomic damages for deepfake infringement.

title: Transfers to charities
summary: Protects charitable organizations and ensures timely, secure transfer of property designated to them.

title: Women's commission members
summary: Removes Senate confirmation for the non-legislative members of the Washington State Women's Commission, who remain appointed by the Governor.

title: PFML/public supp. benefits
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Limits supplemental employer benefits that public employees receive while on Washington paid family and medical leave.

title: Reckless driving, speed
summary: Expands the definition of reckless driving to include driving a vehicle over the posted speed limit by a specified amount, varying by location.

title: Northern state hospital
summary: Requires preserving records and artifacts documenting historical treatment of people with developmental disabilities at Northern State Hospital.

title: Voter registration database
summary: Bars county elections offices from releasing voter database records, requires requests go to the Secretary of State, and makes knowing unauthorized disclosure a class C felony.

title: Forest health appropriation
summary: Appropriates $65 million from the Natural Climate Solutions Account to the WRFRCR Account for forest health in fiscal year 2026, toward a $125 million 2025-27 target.

title: Precious metals tax exempt.
summary: Restores the 1985 sales tax exemptions for the sale of precious metals and bullion.

title: Ex. medical placement
summary: Expands eligibility for extraordinary medical placement of incarcerated people with serious or degenerative conditions, excludes persistent offenders, and adds denial explanations and ombuds review.

title: Water quality pollution
summary: Modifies the standards used to determine whether water quality pollution exists; the text does not state the direction of change.

title: Pulse oximeters in schools
summary: Ensures public schools have a supply of pulse oximeters, per a one-line summary without operative details.

title: Aircraft fuel tax proceeds
summary: Directs all proceeds from aircraft fuel taxes (HST, petroleum product tax, oil spill response tax) to the aeronautics account.

title: Chiropractic/animals
summary: Creates a license endorsement letting qualified licensed chiropractors perform chiropractic diagnosis and adjustments on nonhuman animals.

title: Cannabis/health facilities
summary: Permits qualifying patients to use medical cannabis in specified health care facilities.

title: On-base school construction
summary: Raises state school construction funding assistance by 15 percent for projects on military bases and excludes on-base facilities from district space inventories.

title: Voter notifications & forms
summary: Lets voters register or update addresses in person, by phone, email, or mail, and limits mailed acknowledgment notices when voters respond electronically.

title: Cemetery district elections
summary: Cemetery district commissioner candidates who are unopposed are deemed elected, and their position does not appear on the ballot.

title: Use of nursing titles
summary: Restricts use of nursing titles and abbreviations to licensed humans, barring nonhuman entities such as AI from using them.

title: Port workers PERS membership
summary: Addresses public employees' retirement system membership for port workers who participate in other pension plans.

title: Data and personal safety
summary: Bars schools, early learning providers and other facilities from collecting students' immigration status and letting immigration officers enter nonpublic areas without a judicial warrant.

title: ECEAP access/military
summary: Extends ECEAP preschool eligibility and enrollment priority to children of active, reserve, and National Guard military parents, without an enrollment expiration.

title: WDFW public participation
summary: Changes public participation requirements for Department of Fish and Wildlife actions; the text gives no specifics.

title: Undergraduate programs
summary: Requires review and possible discontinuation of low-enrollment undergraduate programs at public baccalaureate institutions.

title: School communications
summary: Concerns how school districts communicate with the general public; the summary gives no details of any required change.

title: DCYF/financial stability
summary: Bars DCYF from using extended foster care youths' benefits to reimburse care costs and requires help securing Social Security benefits and protected accounts.

title: Indigent defense task force
summary: Reinstates the Indigent Defense Task Force to review how legal representation is provided to indigent persons where the right to counsel applies.

title: Public defense caseloads
summary: Clarifies public defense caseload standards that apply to local jurisdictions; the summary gives no detail on the change.

title: Public defense services
summary: The bill concerns public defense services, but the text provided does not state what it changes.

title: Health technology assessment
summary: Changes Washington's health technology assessment priorities and evidence standards, including accepting expert input in place of randomized trials for rare or life-threatening diseases.

title: Nonopioid drugs for pain
summary: Requires health plans, public employee and school plans, and Medicaid managed care to cover at least one nonopioid pain drug without prior authorization or step therapy, and directs DOH to publish an educational pamphlet.

title: Abortion medications
summary: Expands the state's abortion medication distribution program to cover broader reproductive care, adds misoprostol, and no longer requires payment from providers.

title: School operating costs
summary: Adds a $100-per-student MSOC allocation for school districts starting 2026-27, with a $100,000 minimum per district, inflation-adjusted annually.

title: Fire best practices
summary: Directs fire districts and insurers to collaborate on optional incentives for agricultural wildfire mitigation best practices.

title: School district PRA requests
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Provides school districts protections against burdensome public records requests, relaxing their response obligations under public records law.

title: Psilocybin
summary: Creates a Department of Health program letting adults with a qualifying condition be prescribed and take psilocybin in medical settings, starting July 1, 2028.

title: Transportation vehicle fund
summary: Lets school districts that shrink their student bus fleet petition OSPI to move transportation vehicle fund money, including depreciation and interest, to other uses.

title: Hospitals in Skagit county
summary: Makes a hospital on an island in Skagit County eligible for critical access hospital payment once CMS certifies it.

title: Pharmacist prescriptive auth
summary: Lets pharmacists prescribe a range of drugs and devices, including hormonal contraception, starting December 2027, and expands the legal definition of pharmacy practice.

title: AGO investigation powers
summary: Lets the Attorney General issue civil investigative demands for documents, testimony and interrogatories, sets process and confidentiality rules, and requires a report on their use.

title: Child care providers/PRA
summary: Expands the public records exemption protecting personal information of family home child care providers to all licensed or certified child care providers.

title: Workers' comp. adjustments
summary: Caps annual cost-of-living adjustments for workers' compensation benefits at 3 percent starting July 1, 2026.

title: Wildfire risk models
summary: Concerns wildfire risk models and disclosure of wildfire risk scores; the text does not state the specific requirements.

title: Deed of trust assignment/fee
summary: Exempts assignments or substitutions of previously recorded deeds of trust from the document recording fee and the covenant homeownership program assessment.

title: Irrigation dist. directors
summary: Concerns irrigation district directors' beneficial interests in contracts; the title alone does not show whether it tightens or loosens current rules.

title: Workforce board admin.
summary: Adjusts the WEIAO Board's cochair terms, meeting and reporting schedule, and consultation duties, and eliminates its public data dashboard requirement.

title: Alternative jet fuel
summary: Aims to provide regulatory certainty for developing low-to-zero carbon alternative jet fuel production in Washington; the summary gives no operative details.

title: Overdose mapping information
summary: Starting January 2027, DOH must set up near-real-time sharing of EMS-reported overdose and near-fatal overdose data with the ODMAP mapping system.

title: Postconviction DNA testing
summary: Requires courts to grant postconviction DNA testing motions unless the state proves by clear and convincing evidence the testing could not show likely innocence.

title: Office of homeless youth
summary: Updates provisions of the Office of Homeless Youth program; the summary gives no detail on specific changes.

title: Human trafficking
summary: Narrows when businesses can be prosecuted for trafficking, adds fines and debarment penalties, keeps victim identities confidential, and requires explanation of denied crime-victim certifications.

title: Smart access systems/tenants
topics: AI and technology; Civil rights and liberties; Housing
summary: Requires landlords to offer tenants non-biometric, non-app entry options on request and limits data that smart access systems may collect.

title: Foreclosure prevention fee
summary: Modifies the foreclosure prevention fee, including its exemptions, payment options, and the Department of Commerce's authority to administer it.

title: WA simply unaffordable fund
summary: Creates a state fund called the Washington is simply unaffordable fund; the text gives no purpose, amounts, or rules.

title: Foster care housing pilot
summary: Creates a two-year DCYF pilot giving rental assistance to up to 50 foster youth experiencing homelessness, with at-risk youth eligible subject to appropriation.

title: Schools/renewable energy
summary: Exempts small rural school districts (500 or fewer students in Climate Zone One) from the State Energy Code requirement to include renewable energy systems in large new buildings.

title: DCYF accountability board
summary: Renames the DCYF ombuds board as an Accountability Board, created to provide independent oversight of DCYF's operations, policies, and outcomes.

title: Use of school impact fees
summary: Temporarily lets school districts use impact fee money for safety upgrades and, in financial distress, for operations and maintenance, and repeals a 2009 timeline study directive.

title: Language access providers
summary: Makes missed-appointment payments part of bargainable economic compensation for language access providers, and lets their collective bargaining agreements override conflicting rules and executive orders.

title: Persistent offenders
summary: Requires resentencing for persistent offenders whose strike convictions occurred before age 18, with victim notice and statement rights; excludes murder and most serious sex offenses.

title: Medical assist. eligibility
summary: Expands the income eligibility limits for Washington's medical assistance program, making more people eligible for coverage.

title: Health care board
summary: Creates a Health Care Board to design a state health plan covering all medically necessary services for residents, contingent on a federal waiver, federal funding and legislation.

title: Universal health deadlines
summary: Sets deadlines for the universal health care commission's work; the title and summary do not describe changes to health coverage rules.

title: Insurer taxes
summary: Narrows the B&O tax exemption for insurers to premium-taxed revenue, makes non-premium payments taxable, and applies retroactively to October 2, 2019.

title: Nonlegal state holidays
summary: Designates several religious and cultural dates as legislatively recognized, non-legal holidays in Washington.

title: Albuterol access in schools
summary: Authorizes schools to keep an albuterol supply for students with asthma, with prescription and uniform administration procedures and liability protections.

title: High school PE waivers
summary: Requires school districts, charters, and tribal compact schools to recognize a high school PE excusal granted by a student's previous district after transfer.

title: Medical loss ratio
topics: Consumer protection and business; Health care
summary: Requires health plans to maintain a medical loss ratio of at least 90 percent.

title: Vet. survivor tuition waiver
summary: Extends eligibility for mandatory tuition and fee waivers for children and surviving spouses or domestic partners of eligible veterans and National Guard members.

title: Medicaid fee-for-service
summary: Concerns the Medicaid deprivatization act, with a heading referencing Medicaid fee-for-service; the text gives no operative details.

title: AI use/student discipline
topics: AI and technology; Civil rights and liberties; Education
summary: Bars K-12 schools from using automated decision systems, facial recognition, surveillance tech, or biometric data for certain decisions, and requires vendor attestations and guidance.

title: Homeless youth committee
summary: Expands the Homeless Youth Advisory Committee's membership to add people with lived experience of youth homelessness or publicly funded youth care systems.

title: Law enf. training option
summary: Creates an additional regional training option for the basic law enforcement academy.

title: Charity care residency
summary: Addresses residency requirements for hospital charity care, but the summary gives no detail on whether they are added, loosened, or removed.

title: Ungulate populations
summary: Requires WDFW to designate at-risk ungulate populations and mandate predator mitigation, including wolf translocation and removal, until deer benchmarks are met.

title: Early literacy programs
summary: Transfers the Imagination Library early literacy program from DCYF to OSPI, which must contract with a nonprofit, subject to appropriations.

title: Spring blade knives
summary: Removes spring blade knives from the statutory list of dangerous weapons and declares them not dangerous weapons.

title: Passport to careers program
summary: Makes Passport to Careers students automatically income-eligible for the Washington College Grant and aligns the program's financial need formula with the federal Student Aid Index.

title: Independent living ombuds
summary: Establishes an independent living ombuds to support seniors living in independent living facilities and continuing care retirement communities.

title: Retail bags
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Requires retailers to collect rising passthrough charges on plastic carryout bags from 2028, drops the thicker-bag requirement, and preempts local bag ordinances.

title: Medically tailored meals
summary: Creates standards for medically tailored meals provided to Medicaid enrollees through DSHS or HCA contracts, including nutrition, accommodation, and vendor requirements.

title: Preventive health services
summary: Modifies coverage requirements for preventive services and changes cost-estimation procedures for vaccine purchases through the Washington Vaccine Association.

title: Permitting and licensing
topics: Consumer protection and business; Government and administration
summary: Requires state agencies to catalog their credentials, report licensing data to ORIA, and publish decision times, with fee refunds for missed deadlines.

title: IEP transition plans
summary: Requires the statewide IEP online system and the HSBP platform to integrate students' IEP transition plans to the greatest extent possible.

title: Senior citizen centers/tax
summary: Exempts multipurpose senior citizen centers' property tax exemption from the automatic ten-year expiration.

title: Green fertilizer incentives
topics: Consumer protection and business; Environment and energy
summary: Directs the Department of Agriculture to create an incentive program promoting in-state production and use of lower-emission green nitrogen fertilizer.

title: Correctional officers/arb.
summary: Removes the county population threshold so all uniformed and non-uniformed jail security staff become eligible for interest arbitration.

title: Initiatives and referenda
summary: Bans pay-per-signature initiative gathering with civil penalties and citizen suits, and requires at least 1,000 voter signatures to file an initiative.

title: Local law enforcement
summary: Adds background investigation and eligibility requirements for sheriffs, police chiefs and marshals, and limits the use of volunteers and youth cadets.

title: Safe cookware
summary: Restricts intentionally added lead in aluminum and brass cookware from 2027, shifts lead limits, and adds cookware to Ecology's Safer Products program.

title: Commercial electronic mail
summary: Narrows the Commercial Electronic Mail Act and repeals several per se Consumer Protection Act violations for commercial email, limiting liability and damage claims.

title: Child near fatality reviews
topics: Children and families; Government and administration
summary: Requires DCYF to issue and publicly post reports on child near-fatality reviews within 180 days, subject to public disclosure with confidential information redacted.

title: Guaranteed admissions prg.
summary: Requires WSIPC member districts to transfer grade 11-12 student transcript data for a guaranteed admissions program, and directs OSPI to develop a transfer process for non-members.

title: Dependency/substance abuse
summary: Changes dependency petition and initiation rules, directs DCYF to weigh substance use and prior referrals, and expands in-home dependency options.

title: Live presentations/sales tax
summary: Exempts live presentations from state retail sales and use tax, reducing sales tax collected on those events.

title: 340B drug pricing program
summary: Bars drug manufacturers from restricting 340B drug delivery to covered entities or their contract pharmacies, adds civil penalties and AG enforcement, and requires covered entities to report program data.

title: Consumer-owned utilities
summary: Extends CETA clean-energy compliance to ports and self-generating market customers, adds UTC reporting and enforcement, and delays a consumer-owned utility report to 2030.

title: Current use land/sale to gov
summary: Exempts current-use land sold or transferred to a government entity from the additional tax otherwise owed.

title: AI companion chatbots
topics: AI and technology; Children and families
summary: Requires operators of AI companion chatbots to give certain notifications, take precautions for minors, and detect and respond to self-harm expressions.

title: Endometriosis
summary: Requires UW, with WSU, to create an online resource center on endometriosis awareness, diagnosis, care, and provider communication by 2028.

title: Disability/property tax ex.
summary: Creates a property tax exemption for qualifying housing occupied by tenants who meet certain disability criteria.

title: SR 165 replacements
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration; Transportation
summary: Declares the Fairfax bridge closure an emergency and lets WSDOT waive or suspend certain statutory and regulatory requirements to expedite its replacement on SR 165.

title: Opioid treatment prg. fees
summary: Lets the Health Department seek federal accreditor status for opioid treatment programs, set accreditation fees in rule, and use opioid settlement funds to offset costs.

title: Aircraft fuel tax distrib.
summary: Requires the aviation division to report to the Legislature on funds awarded for airport projects and estimated tax revenues those projects generate.

title: Rural local health officers
summary: Lets rural counties under 100,000 population appoint an APRN or physician assistant as acting local health officer until a permanent officer is appointed.

title: Carbon capture
summary: Addresses use of carbon capture, utilization, mineralization, or sequestration technologies under the Clean Energy Transformation Act; specific changes are not described.

title: Youth development fund
summary: Authorizes the Superintendent of Public Instruction to award grants from a youth development account to eligible entities for youth development programs, with prioritization rules.

title: Medical debt interest
summary: Caps interest on medical debt without a written agreement at 1% simple per year, and bars interest on debt during charity care screening or if not lawfully owed.

title: Timber tax distributions
summary: Extends timber tax distributions to school districts without qualifying levies if they had levies in either of the two prior years, using the highest recent levy rate.

title: Zero emission cargo handling
summary: Removes the 2031 sunset on port authority to buy zero-emission cargo equipment and on the ban on buying fully automated cargo equipment, making both permanent.

title: Commercial shellfish fees
summary: Concerns fees charged for commercial shellfish; the title and summary give no details of the change.

title: Self-insurers/claims
summary: Allows self-insurers to accept certain industrial insurance (workers' compensation) claims; the text is a one-line summary with no detail.

title: Operating budget, supp.
summary: Modifies the 2025-2027 biennial state operating budget appropriations for various agencies and programs.

title: Ecosystem services
summary: Seeks to expand revenue and economic opportunities from natural climate solutions and ecosystem services; specific mechanisms are not stated.

title: OPMA/natural disasters
summary: Changes Open Public Meetings Act rules for governing body gatherings and actions during state or federally declared natural disaster emergencies.

title: Scissor stairs
summary: Directs the State Building Code Council to convene a task group to recommend code amendments allowing scissor stairs in certain multi-unit occupancies.

title: Driver privacy
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice
summary: Bars government use of automated license plate readers except by explicitly authorized agencies, and adds retention limits, sharing limits, reporting, audits, and prohibited uses.

title: Capital budget, supplemental
summary: Modifies the 2025-2027 biennial capital budget appropriations for general government, human services, natural resources, and education.

title: Electric/public contracts
summary: Broadens the clean power cities and PUDs may contract for, and removes the per-unit rate cap on their electricity purchase contracts.

title: Transportation budget, supp.
summary: Modifies 2025-27 appropriations for state transportation agencies and programs in a supplemental transportation budget.

title: Food banks/sales tax
summary: Exempts food banks from the retail sales tax on certain services, reducing their tax obligations.

title: DCYF assessment practices
summary: Authorizes the Washington State Institute for Public Policy to evaluate outcomes of DCYF assessment practices.

title: Residential energy storage
topics: AI and technology; Environment and energy
summary: Creates a residential battery incentive grant program, requires large utilities to offer flexible demand programs, and bars selling or aggregating customer data.

title: Administrative appeals
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Revises judicial review procedures: clean energy board decisions go directly to the appeals court, LUPA transfer provisions are kept, and withheld consent cannot be used against a party.

title: EFSEC tribal consultation
topics: Environment and energy; Government and administration
summary: Exempts EFSEC's government-to-government tribal consultations from open meetings rules and requires the chair and staff to offer consultation, share summaries, and let tribes correct them.

title: Court of appeals bailiffs
summary: Authorizes Court of Appeals bailiffs to assess threats and receive criminal history, including non-conviction data, solely for threat investigations, with limits on other uses.

title: Schools/services sales tax
summary: Exempts schools from retail sales tax on certain services, reducing sales tax collected on those purchases.

title: Ski areas and winter sports
summary: Extends ski lift safety duties, skier conduct rules, and $1 million liability insurance requirements to aerial tramways, tows, and conveyors.

title: Pregnancy accommodations
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Labor and employment
summary: Restores a broader list of pregnancy accommodations employers cannot claim as undue hardship, and makes L&I complaint records about pregnancy accommodations confidential.

title: Residential building plans
summary: Concerning permit-ready residential building plans; the title alone does not state what rules change.

title: Aquifer recharge areas
summary: Allows counties to revise urban growth areas for development patterns if conditions are met, including limits on critical areas and no net increase in aquifer recharge areas.

title: Crime victims & witnesses
summary: Expands crime victim protections, lets courts control questioning of victims by pro se defendants, allows minors 13+ to consent to strangulation forensic exams, and renames and reauthorizes the SAFE Advisory Group.

title: Housing finance commission
summary: Makes unspecified changes concerning the housing finance commission; the text gives no details.

title: Home care rates
summary: Sets home care agency vendor rates with a wage and benefits portion, restricts training funds to training costs, and requires DSHS to verify expenditures.

title: DCYF oversight board name
summary: Renames the Department of Children, Youth, and Families oversight board, with no change to its policy duties.

title: Green Hill school contraband
summary: Aims to reduce contraband entering the Green Hill juvenile facility; the text gives no specific mechanism.

title: Juvenile rehabilitation
summary: Title-only bill stating an intent to improve juvenile rehabilitation; the text does not specify any changes.

title: Children/imminent risk
summary: States a goal of protecting children from imminent risk of harm, but the text describes no specific provisions.

title: DD res. service providers
summary: Streamlines monitoring and oversight activities for community residential service business providers serving people with developmental disabilities.

title: Definition of fetal death
summary: Updates the state's legal definition of fetal death; the summary gives no detail on what changes.

title: Residential dev./zones
summary: Bars certain cities from excluding housing in commercial and mixed-use zones, caps ground-floor commercial requirements, and preempts conflicting local rules.

title: Affordable housing funding
summary: Authorizes a local sales and use tax for housing, with at least 60 percent going to operating and rehabilitating existing affordable housing.

title: Homeownership dev. loans
summary: Establishes a revolving loan fund to finance mixed-income affordable homeownership development.

title: Military code/victim rights
summary: Adds protections for victims of offenses committed against members serving in the Washington organized militia, within the state military justice code.

title: Plastic carryout bags
topics: Consumer protection and business; Environment and energy
summary: Allows film plastic and paper carryout bags if they meet recycled content standards, drops film bag thickness rules, and lowers the film bag charge to $0.08.

title: Insurance crimes
summary: Enhances public safety and enforcement against crimes that affect insurance; the text gives no specifics.

title: Vehicle loads
summary: Requires vehicles towed on a trailer to be cleaned of mud, rocks, or debris, or covered, before travelling on paved public highways.

title: Services tax penalty waiver
summary: Requires the Department of Revenue to waive penalties and interest for taxpayers who failed to collect sales tax on certain retail services under ESSB 5814.

title: Office of Indian affairs
summary: Codifies the Governor's Office of Indian Affairs as a cabinet agency, sets its duties, and requires an annual report to the Governor and Legislature.

title: Voting services
summary: Directs county auditors and the Secretary of State to meet with tribes on reservation voting access and authorizes a feasibility study of an electronic ballot return portal.

title: Adult family home licensure
summary: Lets DSHS exempt certain former foster care providers from adult family home licensure if they meet experience, record, and client-limit conditions.

title: Fire protection districts
topics: Government and administration; Taxes and budget
summary: Changes fire protection district formation rules, including city levy caps, a new $0.25 per $1,000 district levy outside limits, notice rules, and consultation duties.

title: Postgrad degree requirements
summary: Eliminates unnecessary postgraduate degree requirements for state employment to reduce barriers to public jobs.

title: LNI communication methods
summary: Lets the Department of Labor and Industries send many notices electronically and adjusts certain appeal and rulemaking notice timelines.

title: Lottery promotional entries
summary: Changes the manner and method for receiving promotional entries in lottery promotions; the summary gives no further detail.

title: Personality rights
summary: Expands publicity rights to voice and likeness in any medium, makes them transferable, and raises the civil penalty for unconsented use to $3,000.

title: School maps
summary: Requires safe school plans to include detailed digital school maps shared with first responders, with data kept in the U.S. and exempt from public records disclosure.

title: Non-legal holidays
summary: Recognizes Rosh Hashanah, Yom Kippur, and Hanukkah as non-legal holidays, with no policy effect.

title: Diwali and Bandi Chhor Divas
summary: Designates the new moon day of Kartik, also known as Diwali and Bandi Chhor Divas, as a legislatively recognized day.

title: Agricultural employees/PERC
summary: Places agricultural employees under the Public Employment Relations Commission's jurisdiction so they can collectively bargain.

title: Civil air patrol
summary: Establishes a Washington Civil Air Patrol Division, sets membership and leadership rules, and lets the Governor order it into state service.

title: State capital projects
summary: Concerns statutory guidelines for administering state capital projects; the summary gives no specific changes.

title: Professional engineers
summary: Amends the professional engineers' registration act; the provided text does not state specific changes.

title: PRA/students & employees
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Government and administration
summary: Expands Public Records Act exemptions for employees who are hate-crime survivors, individual voluntary state survey responses, and Healthy Youth Survey student records.

title: Distributed energy resources
summary: Aims to expand the use of distributed energy resources, but the text gives no mechanism or details.

title: School district waivers
summary: Authorizes school districts to request waivers, providing flexibility, but the text does not specify which rules would be waived.

title: Digital school transcripts
summary: Authorizes a statewide digital transcript data-sharing environment, requires K-12 and public college participation, and allows disclosure only with revocable student or parent permission.

title: Domestic workers
summary: Establishes labor protections for domestic workers, defining covered nannies, caregivers, housekeepers and similar workers and the employers who hire them.

title: Wildfire home hardening/CICs
summary: Bars common interest community governing documents from banning fire-hardened building materials, while allowing reasonable rules on their design, placement, and appearance.

title: Firearms background checks
summary: Concerns firearms background checks, but the text gives no detail on what it changes.

title: Utility service vehicles
summary: Requires Ecology to exempt utility service vehicles by rule from California motor vehicle emission standards adopted in Washington.

title: Concurrent medicaid enroll.
summary: Directs savings from concurrent Medicaid enrollment to fund science, technology, engineering, and mathematics education opportunities.

title: Wage enforcement discretion
summary: Lets L&I choose which wage complaints to investigate, sets a 60-day decision deadline, and starts the civil statute of limitations when a complaint is filed.

title: Social workers board
summary: Creates a Washington state board of governors to oversee licensed social workers.

title: Social worker licensure
summary: Concerns alternative routes to social worker licensure; the title alone does not specify the changes.

title: Tourism assessment
summary: Authorizes the state tourism marketing authority to create an industry-ratified assessment on tourism businesses' gross revenue, overseen by a ratepayer board.

title: Criminal offenses under 18
summary: Requires courts to grant suspended dispositions to eligible juveniles, expands eligible offenses, and lowers sentencing grid ranges for several robbery offenses.

title: DSHS terminology
summary: Renames references to former DSHS administrations (ATLSA, DDA, BHA) to new names HCLA and BHAA across statutes, with no substantive policy change.

title: International fire code
summary: Concerns administration of the international fire code; the summary gives no detail on any substantive change.

title: School vehicle funds
summary: Lets financially distressed school districts borrow interest-free from, or petition OSPI to transfer, their transportation vehicle fund money to other school funds.

title: Crash prevention zones
summary: Creates crash prevention zones on high-crash roads, allowing added traffic enforcement, speed-camera use, and doubled phone-use penalties within zones.

title: Workers' compensation
summary: Raises the share of employer health care contributions an injured worker receives in workers' compensation monthly benefits to 100 percent, unless the employer continues those payments.

title: Construction worker wages
summary: Makes owners and contractors jointly liable for unpaid construction wages, mandates penalties and double damages, voids indemnity waivers, and presumes workers are employees.

title: Supportive & emerg. housing
summary: Requires cities and counties in urban growth areas to allow shelters, transitional and supportive housing in specified zones, limiting local standards and design review for them.

title: Recovery of missing persons
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice
summary: Expands when police may use cell-site simulators, pen registers and trap-and-trace devices to locate missing endangered persons, narrows an officer penalty, and broadens warrant authority.

title: Health carrier overpayments
summary: Standardizes the requirements health carriers must follow when recovering overpayments.

title: Veterinarian relationship
summary: Specifies which veterinarian services may be provided to patients through telehealth.

title: Wildland firefighters/LEOFF
summary: Expands LEOFF 2 pension membership to Department of Natural Resources firefighters and defines full-time wildland firefighter employment as 160 hours monthly for over six months.

title: Parole
summary: Creates a work group to recommend how to reinstate parole, develop parole eligibility criteria, and report to the Legislature by October 2027.

title: Habitat mitigation grants
summary: Makes landowners eligible for Habitat Conservation Account grants when Ecology or WDFW mitigation requirements are unusually costly or cut off most of the property's use value.

title: Utility procurement
summary: Creates a separate PUD procurement category, through 2045, for clean generation, energy storage, and transmission or distribution projects.

title: Property assessment appeals
summary: Extends from 21 to 28 business days the deadline for county assessors to share valuation information and new evidence with taxpayers before property assessment appeal hearings.

title: Child care provider supports
summary: Lets the Department of Children, Youth, and Families optionally help prospective providers navigate child care licensing, within existing resources.

title: Wildfire risk
summary: Creates a Strengthen Washington Homes Program offering grants to homeowners, contractors, nonprofits and tribes for wildfire risk mitigation of dwellings.

title: Federal custody contracts
summary: Lets jails accept federal detainees at their discretion, requires a federal contract within 180 days, and sets a minimum fee at the daily bed rate.

title: Government record privacy
summary: Restricts state agencies from disclosing or displaying sex designation change records, removes sex-change indicators from credentials, and expands public records exemptions.

title: Student financial aid fraud
summary: Aims to safeguard student financial aid from fraud; the summary gives no detail on specific mechanisms.

title: Restitution/postsecondary
summary: Limits courts' ability to waive restitution owed to postsecondary institutions, discouraging violent protests on campuses.

title: Voting more than once
summary: Makes intentionally voting more than once in the same election a class C felony and defines 'same election' by election date.

title: Institutional welfare acct
summary: Lets the institutional welfare account accept appropriations, donations, grants and federal or private funds, and requires DOC to create an expenditure-approval process informed by incarcerated people's input.

title: Judicial security
topics: Civil rights and liberties; Criminal justice
summary: Lets court security personnel and Supreme Court bailiffs conduct threat assessments and receive criminal history, including nonconviction data, for threat investigations only.

title: Donations for children
summary: Extends limited immunity for free children's item donations to religious groups and strollers and car seats, while requiring car seat safety checks, disclosures, and bans on expired or recalled seats.

title: Game farm/water quality
summary: Addresses water quality impacts from publicly owned or operated game farms to protect the public; specific requirements are not described.

title: Education data/P20W system
summary: Directs OFM to contract with a nonprofit to improve P20W education system coordination, develop recommendations, and help build a public-facing P20W data dashboard.

title: Heritage orchard program
summary: Requires Washington State University to establish a heritage orchard program and defines heritage orchards by tree age or rare apple varieties.

title: Real estate/exclusive market
summary: Prohibits brokers from marketing residential property only to exclusive buyer or broker groups, and makes violations grounds for DOL discipline.

title: Waste to energy facilities
summary: Addresses fair treatment of waste-to-energy facilities under the Climate Commitment Act; the summary does not say how.

title: Payroll expense tax
summary: Creates an excise tax on large companies' payroll expenses above a threshold, with revenue deposited into a new Well Washington fund account for services.

title: Pediatric transitional care
summary: Directs HCA to seek Medicaid facility payments for pediatric recovery centers and provides interim grants and a DCYF bundled funding model for substance-exposed infants.

title: Political violence
summary: Protects elected officials, candidates, election officials and other public participants from political violence threats and incidents.

title: Delayed utility conn. fees
summary: Requires cities and towns to offer deferred collection of water and sewer connection charges for new residential construction, with payment due by final inspection or occupancy.

title: Conservation futures/tribes
summary: Allows federally recognized Indian tribes to participate in the Conservation Futures program.

title: Adv. clean trucks reporting
summary: Requires annual reporting of information about sales of vehicles covered by the advanced clean trucks regulations.

title: Tax changes/enforcement
summary: Delays Department of Revenue action on tax changes until the related rulemaking is finalized.

title: Wage disclosure corrections
summary: Removes the sunset date, making permanent an employer's ability to correct wage and salary disclosures.

title: Coroner appointment
summary: Keeps existing law allowing some counties to appoint a medical examiner; makes no change to that authority.

title: Quality assurance fee
summary: Freezes the ambulance quality assurance fee rate from July 2026 and sets how HCA recalculates the Medicaid add-on to match the fee amount.

title: Rural hospital payments
summary: Makes Medicaid payments to rural emergency hospitals apply regardless of a beneficiary's managed care enrollment status, subject to appropriation.

title: Agriculture impacts
summary: Bill text is a title only, stating it concerns agriculture impacts and protecting agriculture, with no operative provisions described.

title: Medical debt garnishments
summary: Raises the wage exemption from garnishment for medical debt and requires garnishment writs and notices to disclose the medical-debt basis and increased exemption.

title: Laid-off employees
topics: Government and administration; Labor and employment
summary: Exempts Indian tribes from layoff notice rules, changes what layoff notices must contain, and makes employee names and addresses given to ESD exempt from public disclosure.

title: Nursing delegation
summary: Concerns nursing delegation; the text gives no detail on what changes.

title: State shark
summary: Designates a state shark for Washington, a symbolic naming measure with no policy effect.

title: Private detention/investment
summary: Prohibits the State Investment Board from new investments in private detention operators and requires divesting existing holdings by 2030.

title: Electric bicycle, motorcycle
summary: Directs the Department of Licensing to convene a work group that will study and recommend a legal framework for electric motorcycles.

title: Minors/digital services
summary: Bill title and one-line summary say it protects children online; the text gives no specific provisions.

title: HVAC scope/electricians
summary: Directs L&I to adopt rules clarifying which ductless mini-split work HVAC/refrigeration specialty electricians may perform.

title: Tax administration
summary: Codifies Department of Revenue guidance on implementing 2025 ESSB 5814 into statute, without changing the underlying tax rules.

title: Excise tax/fixture defined
summary: Defines 'fixture' for excise tax purposes and authorizes the Department of Revenue to adopt administering rules.

title: Cancer education programs
summary: Subject to appropriation, DOH contracts a training entity to deliver voluntary single-session cancer education programs to grades 6-12 students, with reporting by 2027.

title: Vapor products/tax
topics: Consumer protection and business; Taxes and budget
summary: Removes vapor products from the OTP tobacco tax definition, subjecting nicotine vaping products to the vapor products tax retroactively to January 1, 2026.

title: Collective bargaining
summary: Concerns collective bargaining rights for employees not covered by the National Labor Relations Act; the text does not specify the changes.

title: Cardiac emerg. plans/schools
summary: Requires school districts to create cardiac emergency response plans, AED placement and maintenance rules, and staff training, contingent on appropriated state funding.

title: Tires/6PPD and substitutes
topics: Environment and energy; Taxes and budget
summary: Creates a 6PPD mitigation fee on motor vehicle tires starting in 2027, funding stormwater monitoring and activities protecting salmon and aquatic species.

title: High-risk AI
summary: Regulates development, deployment, and use of high-risk artificial intelligence systems; the text gives no specific requirements.

title: Large energy use facilities
summary: Addresses electricity service to large energy use facilities, but the text gives no details on what it changes.

title: Education funding/use
summary: Gives school districts more flexibility in how they spend basic education funding.

title: Local gov. employees/PRA
summary: Exempts voluntarily submitted personal demographic details of local government employees from public inspection and copying.

title: Appliance afford. index
summary: Directs a feasibility assessment of creating an affordability index for appliances sold in Washington; no rules change.

title: School stabilization funding
summary: Requires OSPI to give school districts, charters, and tribal compact schools a stabilization payment when state revenue falls due to enrollment declines in 2026-27 and 2027-28.

title: State resources/fraud, waste
summary: Strengthens transparency measures intended to prevent fraudulent, wasteful, or improper use of state resources.

title: Paid leave integrity audit
summary: Requires a performance audit of program integrity measures in Washington's paid family and medical leave program.

title: Independent medical exams
summary: Allows independent medical exams in workers' compensation claims to be recorded through a state-approved third-party recording platform.

title: Cigarettes, nicotine/tax
topics: Consumer protection and business; Taxes and budget
summary: Replaces nicotine product taxes with a 95% rate and adds a cigarette tax reaching $5 per 20-pack, with revenue to state and health accounts.

title: National voter reg. day
summary: Requires public high schools to hold voter registration events on National Voter Registration Day and Temperance and Good Citizenship Day, with OSPI materials and reporting.

title: Roadway fatalities
summary: Designates a traffic safety commission as a public health authority to collect crash and health data, review fatal pedestrian and bicyclist crashes, and analyze causes of roadway deaths.

title: Inland port district debt
summary: Sets conditions under which an inland port district may incur debt, tying borrowing to tax increment finance areas and public improvements.

title: Address confid./ALJs & OAH
summary: Allows administrative law judges and Office of Administrative Hearings staff to participate in the address confidentiality program.

title: Striking workers/UI overpay
summary: Requires the Employment Security Department to notify striking workers applying for benefits about possible overpayment assessments from retroactive wages.

title: Interest arbitration factors
summary: Changes the factors used in interest arbitration for uniformed personnel, as described in a one-line title with no detail.

title: Industrial insurance rates
summary: Promotes transparency in certain industrial insurance (workers' compensation) rate increases; specific disclosure requirements are not described.

title: Regulated sports wagering
summary: Permits sports wagering on Washington college athletics and tribal sports betting, while prohibiting wagers on individual college athletes' performance.

title: Dental deep sedation
summary: Requires dental procedures under deep sedation or analgesia to use a multiprovider system, with separate dentist and sedation-monitoring providers.

title: Rental payments
summary: Requires landlords to keep accepting agreed payment methods after late rent, and says partial past-due payments do not reinstate a lease or stop eviction deadlines.

title: Paid leave solvency
summary: Establishes solvency protections for the paid family and medical leave program without raising the premium rate cap or contribution rates.

title: Paid leave annual adjustment
summary: Temporarily limits the annual inflation adjustment to the maximum weekly benefit for paid family and medical leave.

title: Paid leave maximum duration
summary: Changes the maximum duration of paid family and medical leave to improve the program's solvency.

title: Paid leave claim period
summary: Changes the claim period duration for Washington's paid family and medical leave program; the summary does not say whether it lengthens or shortens it.

title: Juvenile rehab. safety
summary: Aims to improve safety at state juvenile rehabilitation institutions; the summary gives no specific mechanism.

title: Correctional fac. contraband
summary: Addresses possession of contraband at correctional facilities by employees; the summary gives no detail on the specific penalty or rule change.

title: Preventive dental care
summary: Bill aims to expand oral health equity and increase access to preventive dental care; the text gives no mechanism.

title: Grocery estab. closures
summary: Requires large grocery closures in food deserts or low-income areas to give four months' notice, negotiate alternatives, and voids certain negative use restrictions.

title: RTA bond issues maximum term
summary: Sets a 75-year maximum term for Regional Transit Authority bonds and bars RTAs issuing bonds over 40 years from regional mobility grant funds.

title: Public facilities funding
summary: Expands the statutory definition of rural county to include certain dense counties with no city over 45,000 people, for public facilities funding purposes.

title: Fairfax bridge closure/tax
summary: Provides tax relief for businesses and properties affected by the Fairfax bridge closure.

title: Env. programs/fee accounts
summary: Creates an appropriated account for lab accreditation fees and redirects landfill methane fee revenue into the Air Pollution Control Account.

title: Workers' comp./PTs & OTs
summary: Adds licensed occupational and physical therapists as attending providers for workers' compensation claims, expanding who can treat injured workers.

title: Senior independent housing
summary: Requires senior independent housing facilities to register annually with the Department of Commerce and applies the Consumer Protection Act to related landlord-tenant violations.

title: Culvert replacement permits
summary: Concerns local government permits for replacing existing culverts; the text does not state the specific change.

title: Parking, person w/disability
summary: Extends disability parking placard renewal from five to ten years, drops the practitioner authorization at renewal, and lets DOL require proof through a low-barrier process.

title: Plastics/recycled content
summary: Concerns postconsumer recycled content requirements for plastic products; the text does not state the specific change.

title: Wildfire prevention
summary: Creates a Washington wildfire prevention and protection council to address wildfire prevention.

title: Factory built structures
summary: Adopts national standards for factory-built housing and commercial structures; the summary gives no detail on what changes.

title: Public hospitals
summary: Creates a $0.75-per-coverage-month assessment on insurers, deposited into a public hospital infrastructure account, and lets public hospital districts form cooperative agreements.

title: Reports by state agencies
summary: Repeals some state agency reporting requirements and changes the frequency or due dates of other agency reports.

title: Dementia information
summary: Directs the Department of Health to consider adding dementia risk reduction and diagnosis information to public health and provider materials, consulting dementia experts.

title: Property tax
summary: Expands retiree property tax relief with higher income thresholds and larger exemptions, and consolidates the state levy into one rate.

title: DD services waiver/budget
summary: Requires IFS waiver expenditures to be included in maintenance-level budgets starting with the December 2026 Governor's proposal, and DSHS to submit annual budget requests for them.

title: WaTech/PRA exemption
summary: Exempts information submitted to WaTech for digital experience platform services from public disclosure and copying.

title: Eminent domain/electrical
summary: Limits the use of eminent domain to build electrical transmission facilities on agricultural lands.

title: Health care credentials
